import { handleDailyMatrixEmail } from './_lib/dailyMatrixEmailHandler.js';
import { handleDailyFollowUp } from './_lib/dailyFollowUpHandler.js';
import {
  handleSyncEmailReplies,
  handleIngestXlsxReply,
  handleGetReplySyncLogs
} from './_lib/imapReplySyncHandler.js';
import { supabase } from './_lib/supabase.js';
import {
  createSmtpTransport,
  DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL,
  normalizeSandboxEmail,
  formatTestEmailSubject,
  getDiagnosticHelp
} from './_lib/smtpMailer.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  // CORS configuration
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT');
  res.setHeader(
    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers',
    'X-CSRF-Token, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Version, Content-Length, Content-MD5, Content-Type, Date, X-Api-Version, Authorization, x-cron-secret, x-vercel-cron'
  );

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  try {
    let payload = req.body;
    if (typeof payload === 'string') {
      try {
        payload = JSON.parse(payload);
      } catch (e) {
        // use as-is
      }
    }

    const requestedAction = String(req.query?.action || payload?.action || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (requestedAction === 'daily-matrix') {
      return await handleDailyMatrixEmail(req, res, payload);
    }
    if (requestedAction === 'daily-followup') {
      return await handleDailyFollowUp(req, res, payload);
    }
    if (requestedAction === 'sync-email-replies') {
      return await handleSyncEmailReplies(req, res, payload);
    }
    if (requestedAction === 'reply-sync-logs') {
      return await handleGetReplySyncLogs(req, res);
    }
    if (requestedAction === 'ingest-xlsx-reply') {
      return await handleIngestXlsxReply(req, res, payload);
    }

    const smtp = createSmtpTransport();
    const { smtpUser, rawPass, cleanPass, transporter, configured } = smtp;

    if (!configured || !cleanPass) {
      console.warn('SMTP credentials (GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) not configured in Vercel environment variables yet.');
      return res.status(200).json({
        success: false,
        notConfigured: true,
        user: smtpUser,
        message: 'SMTP credentials (GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) not configured in Vercel environment variables. Email notifications will be logged in console.'
      });
    }

    // Diagnostic/Testing Connection Ping
    if (req.method === 'GET' || payload?.action === 'test-connection') {
      try {
        console.log(`[SMTP Diagnostic Ping] Testing credentials for user: ${smtpUser} (password length: ${cleanPass.length}, had spaces originally: ${rawPass.includes(' ')})`);
        await transporter.verify();
        return res.status(200).json({
          success: true,
          verified: true,
          user: smtpUser,
          passLength: cleanPass.length,
          hadSpaces: rawPass.includes(' '),
          message: `Google SMTP connection & authentication successfully verified for ${smtpUser}!`
        });
      } catch (verifyErr) {
        console.error('SMTP Verify failed:', verifyErr);
        return res.status(200).json({
          success: false,
          verified: false,
          user: smtpUser,
          passLength: cleanPass.length,
          hadSpaces: rawPass.includes(' '),
          error: verifyErr.message,
          diagnostic: getDiagnosticHelp(verifyErr.message, smtpUser, cleanPass)
        });
      }
    }

    const {
      from,
      fromName,
      to = 'azgodev@gmail.com',
      cc = [],
      subject,
      html,
      text,
      isTestMode = false,
      isTestModeExplicitRecipients = false,
      emailType = '',
      attachments = []
    } = payload || {};

    const senderEmail = from || smtpUser;
    const formattedFrom = fromName ? `"${fromName}" <${senderEmail}>` : senderEmail;

    const normalizeEmailArray = (raw) => {
      if (!raw) return [];
      const items = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : String(raw).split(/[,;\s]+/);
      const seen = new Set();
      for (const entry of items) {
        const clean = String(entry || '').trim();
        if (clean && clean.includes('@') && clean.includes('.') && !clean.toLowerCase().endsWith('.test')) {
          const lower = clean.toLowerCase();
          if (!seen.has(lower)) seen.add(lower);
        }
      }
      return Array.from(seen);
    };

    const validToList = normalizeEmailArray(to);
    const normalizedTo = validToList.length > 0 ? validToList.join(', ') : 'azgodev@gmail.com';
    const validCc = normalizeEmailArray(cc).filter((e) => !validToList.includes(e));

    let finalTo = normalizedTo;
    let finalCc = validCc;
    let finalSubject = subject || 'New RMA Return Submission Notification';
    let finalHtml = html || text || '';
    let finalText = text || '';

    // If Test Mode is active:
    // NEVER send to Live recipients or Live customer AE unless explicitly configured inside Test Mode settings!
    // Priority:
    //   1. Explicit Test Mode TO/CC passed from Test Mode frontend profile/editor (isTestModeExplicitRecipients)
    //   2. Saved per-type Test Mode profile (test_email_recipients_by_type[emailType])
    //   3. Saved global Test Mode recipients (test_email_recipients)
    //   4. Sandbox fallback (test_sandbox_email -> DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL)
    if (isTestMode) {
      const originalTo = isTestModeExplicitRecipients ? 'Bypassed (Using Test Mode Profile)' : normalizedTo;
      const originalCc = isTestModeExplicitRecipients ? 'Bypassed (Using Test Mode Profile)' : validCc.join(', ');
      let resolvedSandboxEmail = payload?.sandboxEmail
        ? normalizeSandboxEmail(payload.sandboxEmail)
        : DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL;
      let savedTestGlobal = null;
      let savedTestByType = null;

      try {
        const { data: testSettingRows } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('key, value')
          .in('key', ['test_sandbox_email', 'test_email_recipients', 'test_email_recipients_by_type']);
        for (const row of testSettingRows || []) {
          if (row.key === 'test_sandbox_email' && row.value && !payload?.sandboxEmail) {
            resolvedSandboxEmail = normalizeSandboxEmail(row.value);
          } else if (row.key === 'test_email_recipients') {
            savedTestGlobal = typeof row.value === 'string'
              ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(row.value); } catch { return null; } })()
              : row.value;
          } else if (row.key === 'test_email_recipients_by_type') {
            savedTestByType = typeof row.value === 'string'
              ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(row.value); } catch { return null; } })()
              : row.value;
          }
        }
      } catch {}

      const cleanTypeKey = String(emailType || '').trim();
      const typeProf = cleanTypeKey && savedTestByType && typeof savedTestByType === 'object'
        ? savedTestByType[cleanTypeKey]
        : null;
      const typeToList = normalizeEmailArray(typeProf?.toList ?? typeProf?.toEmail ?? typeProf?.to);
      const typeCcList = normalizeEmailArray(typeProf?.ccList ?? typeProf?.cc);
      const globalTestToList = normalizeEmailArray(savedTestGlobal?.toList ?? savedTestGlobal?.toEmail);
      const globalTestCcList = normalizeEmailArray(savedTestGlobal?.baseCcList ?? savedTestGlobal?.ccList);

      const payloadTestToList = payload?.hasCustomTestRecipients ? normalizeEmailArray(payload?.testToList) : [];
      const payloadTestCcList = payload?.hasCustomTestRecipients ? normalizeEmailArray(payload?.testCcList) : [];

      let testToList = [];
      let testCcList = [];
      if (payloadTestToList.length > 0) {
        testToList = payloadTestToList;
        testCcList = payloadTestCcList.filter((e) => !testToList.includes(e));
      } else if (isTestModeExplicitRecipients && validToList.length > 0) {
        testToList = validToList;
        testCcList = validCc.filter((e) => !testToList.includes(e));
      } else if (typeToList.length > 0) {
        testToList = typeToList;
        testCcList = typeCcList.filter((e) => !testToList.includes(e));
      } else if (globalTestToList.length > 0) {
        testToList = globalTestToList;
        testCcList = globalTestCcList.filter((e) => !testToList.includes(e));
      } else {
        testToList = [resolvedSandboxEmail];
        testCcList = [];
      }

      finalTo = testToList.join(', ');
      finalCc = testCcList;
      finalSubject = formatTestEmailSubject(finalSubject, true);

      const testBanner = `
        <div style="background-color: #fef3c7; border: 2px dashed #f59e0b; color: #92400e; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px;">🧪 TEST MODE ACTIVE (Safe Sandbox Delivery)</div>
          <div>This test email was safely routed exclusively to Test Mode recipient(s) <strong>${finalTo}</strong>${finalCc.length ? ` (CC: <strong>${finalCc.join(', ')}</strong>)` : ''} — Live production stakeholders remain completely isolated.</div>
          <div style="margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #fde68a; font-size: 11px; color: #78350f;">
            <strong>Test Isolation Audit (Sandbox Fallback: ${resolvedSandboxEmail}):</strong><br/>
            • <strong>Test Mode TO:</strong> ${finalTo}<br/>
            • <strong>Test Mode CC:</strong> ${finalCc.length ? finalCc.join(', ') : 'None'}<br/>
            • <strong>Bypassed / Suppressed Live Target:</strong> ${originalTo}${originalCc && originalCc !== 'Bypassed (Using Test Mode Profile)' ? ` (CC: ${originalCc})` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      finalHtml = testBanner + finalHtml;
      finalText = `[TEST MODE ACTIVE - Safe Sandbox Delivery -> TO: ${finalTo}${finalCc.length ? ` | CC: ${finalCc.join(', ')}` : ''} | Sandbox: ${resolvedSandboxEmail}]\n\n${finalText}`;
      console.log(`🧪 [TEST MODE] Dispatched safely via SMTP to ${finalTo} (CC: ${finalCc.join(', ') || 'none'})`);
    }

    const mailOptions = {
      from: formattedFrom,
      replyTo: payload?.replyTo || from || smtpUser,
      to: finalTo,
      cc: finalCc,
      subject: finalSubject,
      text: finalText,
      html: finalHtml,
      attachments: Array.isArray(attachments) ? attachments : []
    };

    let info;
    try {
      info = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
    } catch (sendErr) {
      if (mailOptions.attachments && mailOptions.attachments.length > 0) {
        const inlineDocAttachments = mailOptions.attachments.filter(
          (a) =>
            a &&
            !a.path &&
            (a.contentType === 'application/pdf' ||
              a.contentType === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' ||
              /\.(pdf|xlsx)$/i.test(String(a.filename || '')))
        );
        if (inlineDocAttachments.length > 0 && inlineDocAttachments.length < mailOptions.attachments.length) {
          console.warn('sendMail with remote image attachments failed, retrying with PDF/XLSX attachments only:', sendErr.message);
          mailOptions.attachments = inlineDocAttachments;
          try {
            info = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
          } catch (pdfRetryErr) {
            console.warn('sendMail with PDF attachment failed, retrying without attachments:', pdfRetryErr.message);
            mailOptions.attachments = [];
            info = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
          }
        } else {
          console.warn('sendMail with attachments failed, retrying without attachments:', sendErr.message);
          mailOptions.attachments = [];
          info = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
        }
      } else {
        throw sendErr;
      }
    }

    console.log('Email dispatched successfully via Gmail SMTP:', info.messageId, 'TestMode:', isTestMode);

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      messageId: info.messageId,
      testMode: isTestMode,
      deliveredTo: finalTo
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in send-email API handler:', error);
    const smtpUser = String(process.env.SMTP_USER || process.env.GMAIL_USER || 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com').trim();
    const rawPass = process.env.SMTP_PASS || process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD || process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD || '';
    const cleanPass = String(rawPass).replace(/\s+/g, '').trim();

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: false,
      error: error.message,
      diagnostic: getDiagnosticHelp(error.message, smtpUser, cleanPass),
      user: smtpUser,
      passLength: cleanPass.length
    });
  }
}

import crypto from 'crypto';
import { setCorsHeaders } from './_lib/auth.js';
import { inspectPaperworkWithGemini, inspectDriverLicenseWithGemini, inspectTruckPlateWithGemini } from './_lib/geminiInspector.js';

/**
 * Cache access token across warm lambda invocations
 */
let cachedToken = null;
let tokenExpiresAt = 0;
let cachedDriveId = null;
const folderCache = new Map();

/**
 * Discovers and caches the Shared Drive (Team Drive) ID for Wholesale RMA Photos
 */
async function getSharedDriveId(creds, accessToken, signal) {
  if (cachedDriveId) return cachedDriveId;
  if (creds?.folderId && String(creds.folderId).startsWith('0A')) {
    cachedDriveId = creds.folderId;
    return cachedDriveId;
  }
  try {
    const drivesRes = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/drives?pageSize=10', {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
      signal
    });
    if (drivesRes.ok) {
      const dData = await drivesRes.json();
      const matched = (dData.drives || []).find(d =>
        /wholesale\s*rma/i.test(d.name || '') || d.name === 'Wholesale RMA Photos' || d.name === 'Wholesale RMA Reports'
      );
      if (matched) {
        cachedDriveId = matched.id;
        return cachedDriveId;
      }
      if (dData.drives && dData.drives.length > 0) {
        cachedDriveId = dData.drives[0].id;
        return cachedDriveId;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[Google Drive] Shared Drives discovery notice:', e.message);
  }
  return creds?.folderId || null;
}

/**
 * Searches Google Drive files and folders robustly across Shared Drives and My Drive.
 * Avoids unsupported 'corpora=allDrives' query errors on service accounts.
 */
async function searchFiles(query, { accessToken, driveId = null, pageSize = 50, signal = null }) {
  // Strategy 1: Search directly in Shared Drive if driveId is known
  if (driveId) {
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        q: query,
        corpora: 'drive',
        driveId: driveId,
        supportsAllDrives: 'true',
        includeItemsFromAllDrives: 'true',
        pageSize: String(pageSize),
        fields: 'files(id, name, mimeType, parents, trashed)'
      });
      const res = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?${params.toString()}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
        signal
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.files && Array.isArray(data.files) && data.files.length > 0) {
          return data.files;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Shared Drive Search Notice]:', e.message);
    }
  }

  // Strategy 2: Search with supportsAllDrives=true and includeItemsFromAllDrives=true
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      q: query,
      supportsAllDrives: 'true',
      includeItemsFromAllDrives: 'true',
      pageSize: String(pageSize),
      fields: 'files(id, name, mimeType, parents, trashed)'
    });
    const res = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?${params.toString()}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
      signal
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.files && Array.isArray(data.files)) {
        return data.files;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[Google Drive General Search Notice]:', e.message);
  }

  return [];
}

/**
 * Extracts Google Service Account credentials from environment variables
 */
function getGoogleCredentials() {
  let clientEmail = null;
  let privateKey = null;
  let folderId = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID || null;
  let impersonateUser = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_IMPERSONATE_USER || process.env.GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_USER || null;

  // Option 1: Direct JSON string in GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY or GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
  const jsonStr = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON;
  if (jsonStr) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
      if (parsed.client_email && parsed.private_key) {
        clientEmail = parsed.client_email;
        privateKey = parsed.private_key.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
        if (!folderId) folderId = parsed.folder_id || null;
        if (!impersonateUser) impersonateUser = parsed.impersonate_user || null;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Auth] Failed to parse service account JSON:', e.message);
    }
  }

  // Option 2: Individual env vars
  if (!clientEmail || !privateKey) {
    clientEmail = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL || process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_EMAIL;
    privateKey = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_PRIVATE_KEY;
  }

  if (clientEmail && privateKey) {
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    return { clientEmail, privateKey, folderId, impersonateUser };
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Generates an OAuth2 JWT assertion for Google APIs (RS256)
 * Supports optional user impersonation (domain-wide delegation) if configured.
 */
function createGoogleJwtAssertion(clientEmail, privateKey, impersonateUser = null) {
  const header = {
    alg: 'RS256',
    typ: 'JWT',
  };

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claimSet = {
    iss: clientEmail,
    scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file',
    aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
    exp: now + 3600,
    iat: now,
  };

  // If user delegation configured, set sub
  if (impersonateUser) {
    claimSet.sub = impersonateUser;
  }

  const encodeBase64Url = (obj) =>
    Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(obj))
      .toString('base64')
      .replace(/=/g, '')
      .replace(/\+/g, '-')
      .replace(/\//g, '_');

  const unsignedToken = `${encodeBase64Url(header)}.${encodeBase64Url(claimSet)}`;

  const sign = crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256');
  sign.update(unsignedToken);
  sign.end();
  const signature = sign
    .sign(privateKey, 'base64')
    .replace(/=/g, '')
    .replace(/\+/g, '-')
    .replace(/\//g, '_');

  return `${unsignedToken}.${signature}`;
}

/**
 * Obtains an OAuth2 Access Token using JWT bearer grant
 */
async function getGoogleAccessToken(creds, signal) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (cachedToken && tokenExpiresAt > now + 60000) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  // Try with impersonateUser first if set, fallback to direct service account if unauthorized
  let assertion = createGoogleJwtAssertion(creds.clientEmail, creds.privateKey, creds.impersonateUser);
  let body = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
    assertion,
  });

  let res = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: body.toString(),
    signal,
  });

  if (!res.ok && creds.impersonateUser) {
    // If impersonation failed (e.g. domain delegation not configured in admin.google.com), retry as pure service account
    console.warn('[Google Drive Auth] Impersonation failed, retrying without sub claim...');
    assertion = createGoogleJwtAssertion(creds.clientEmail, creds.privateKey, null);
    body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
      assertion,
    });
    res = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: body.toString(),
      signal,
    });
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errText = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Google OAuth Token Error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  cachedToken = data.access_token;
  tokenExpiresAt = now + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000;
  return cachedToken;
}

/**
 * Finds or creates a Google Drive folder by name inside a parent folder
 * Passing supportsAllDrives=true and includeItemsFromAllDrives=true for Shared Drives.
 */
async function findOrCreateFolder(folderName, parentFolderId, accessToken, signal, driveId = null) {
  const safeName = (folderName || 'General').trim();
  const escapedName = safeName.replace(/'/g, "\\'");

  let query = `mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '${escapedName}' and trashed = false`;
  if (parentFolderId) {
    query += ` and '${parentFolderId}' in parents`;
  }

  const existingFiles = await searchFiles(query, { accessToken, driveId, pageSize: 1, signal });
  if (existingFiles.length > 0) {
    return existingFiles[0].id;
  }

  // Create subfolder inside parent with supportsAllDrives=true
  const meta = {
    name: safeName,
    mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder',
    ...(parentFolderId ? { parents: [parentFolderId] } : {}),
  };

  const createRes = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?fields=id&supportsAllDrives=true', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(meta),
    signal,
  });

  if (!createRes.ok) {
    const errText = await createRes.text();
    console.warn(`[Google Drive] Folder creation notice for "${safeName}": ${errText}`);
    return parentFolderId;
  }

  const created = await createRes.json();
  return created.id || parentFolderId;
}

/**
 * Cached version of findOrCreateFolder to avoid redundant API queries
 */
async function findOrCreateFolderCached(folderName, parentFolderId, accessToken, signal, driveId = null) {
  if (!parentFolderId) return null;
  const cacheKey = `${parentFolderId}::${folderName}`;
  if (folderCache.has(cacheKey)) {
    return folderCache.get(cacheKey);
  }
  const folderId = await findOrCreateFolder(folderName, parentFolderId, accessToken, signal, driveId);
  if (folderId) {
    folderCache.set(cacheKey, folderId);
  }
  return folderId;
}

/**
 * Robust JSON body parser for Vercel Serverless Functions
 * Handles pre-parsed req.body objects, raw JSON strings, and unparsed stream bodies on DELETE / POST.
 */
async function parseRequestBody(req) {
  if (req.body && typeof req.body === 'object') return req.body;
  if (typeof req.body === 'string' && req.body.trim()) {
    try { return JSON.parse(req.body); } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let raw = '';
    req.on('data', chunk => { raw += chunk; });
    req.on('end', () => {
      if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return resolve({});
      try {
        resolve(JSON.parse(raw));
      } catch {
        resolve({});
      }
    });
    req.on('error', () => resolve({}));
  });
}

/**
 * Resolves structured folder hierarchy under Root Shared Drive:
 * 1. RMA Proof Items: Root -> RMA-Reports-Item -> [RMA_NUMBER] -> uploaded files
 * 2. RMA Official Paperwork: Root -> RMA-Reports-SI/DR/PO -> [RMA_NUMBER] -> uploaded files
 * 3. Product Catalog: Root -> Products -> [SKU] [Product Name] -> uploaded files
 */
async function resolveTargetFolder({
  rootFolderId,
  rmaNumber,
  category,
  sku = null,
  productName = null,
  targetFolderId: preResolvedFolderId = null,
  accessToken,
  signal
}) {
  if (preResolvedFolderId) {
    return {
      targetFolderId: preResolvedFolderId,
      rmaFolderId: preResolvedFolderId,
      rmaFolderUrl: `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${preResolvedFolderId}`
    };
  }

  let rootId = rootFolderId;
  if (!rootId) {
    rootId = await getSharedDriveId({ folderId: rootFolderId }, accessToken, signal);
  }

  const isProduct = category === 'product' || category === 'products' || category === 'catalog' || Boolean(sku && !rmaNumber);
  const isPaperwork = category === 'official_paperwork' || category === 'paperwork' || category === 'invoice' || category === 'si_dr_po' || category === 'si' || category === 'dr' || category === 'po';

  if (isProduct) {
    // Hierarchy: Root -> Products -> [SKU] [Name]
    const productsRootId = await findOrCreateFolderCached('Products', rootId, accessToken, signal, rootId);
    const cleanSku = (sku || 'SKU').trim();
    const cleanName = (productName || '').trim();
    const folderName = cleanName ? `${cleanSku} ${cleanName}`.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '-').trim() : cleanSku;
    const prodFolderId = await findOrCreateFolderCached(folderName, productsRootId, accessToken, signal, rootId);
    return {
      targetFolderId: prodFolderId || productsRootId,
      rmaFolderId: prodFolderId || productsRootId,
      rmaFolderUrl: prodFolderId ? `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${prodFolderId}` : null
    };
  }

  const cleanRma = (rmaNumber && rmaNumber !== 'GENERAL') ? String(rmaNumber).trim() : 'General_Intake';

  if (isPaperwork) {
    // Hierarchy: Root -> RMA-Reports-SI/DR/PO -> [RMA_NUMBER]
    const siDrPoRootId = await findOrCreateFolderCached('RMA-Reports-SI/DR/PO', rootId, accessToken, signal, rootId);
    const rmaFolderId = await findOrCreateFolderCached(cleanRma, siDrPoRootId, accessToken, signal, rootId);
    return {
      targetFolderId: rmaFolderId || siDrPoRootId,
      rmaFolderId: rmaFolderId || siDrPoRootId,
      rmaFolderUrl: rmaFolderId ? `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${rmaFolderId}` : null
    };
  }

  // Default: RMA Damage Proof Items -> Root -> RMA-Reports-Item -> [RMA_NUMBER]
  const itemRootId = await findOrCreateFolderCached('RMA-Reports-Item', rootId, accessToken, signal, rootId);
  const rmaFolderId = await findOrCreateFolderCached(cleanRma, itemRootId, accessToken, signal, rootId);
  return {
    targetFolderId: rmaFolderId || itemRootId,
    rmaFolderId: rmaFolderId || itemRootId,
    rmaFolderUrl: rmaFolderId ? `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/${rmaFolderId}` : null
  };
}

/**
 * Serverless Upload Handler:
 * Uploads compressed WebP proof photo directly to Google Workspace Drive
 * with automatic Supabase Storage fallback.
 */
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  // Robust body parsing across Vercel / Node runtime
  const parsedBody = await parseRequestBody(req);

  const isDeleteAction = req.method === 'DELETE' || 
    req.query?.action === 'delete' || 
    parsedBody?.action === 'delete' ||
    req.url?.includes('action=delete');

  // Handle DELETE / Deletion request to remove stored proof photos and folders from Google Drive
  if (isDeleteAction) {
    const creds = getGoogleCredentials();
    if (!creds) {
      return res.status(200).json({ success: false, message: 'Google Drive credentials not configured' });
    }

    try {
      const accessToken = await getGoogleAccessToken(creds);
      const driveId = await getSharedDriveId(creds, accessToken);

      const rawUrlsOrIds = [];
      if (req.query?.fileId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.fileId);
      if (req.query?.fileUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.fileUrl);
      if (req.query?.folderId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.folderId);
      if (req.query?.folderUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(req.query.folderUrl);
      if (parsedBody?.fileId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.fileId);
      if (parsedBody?.fileUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.fileUrl);
      if (parsedBody?.folderId) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.folderId);
      if (parsedBody?.folderUrl) rawUrlsOrIds.push(parsedBody.folderUrl);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.fileIds)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.fileIds);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.fileUrls)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.fileUrls);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.folderIds)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.folderIds);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.folderUrls)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.folderUrls);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.urls)) rawUrlsOrIds.push(...parsedBody.urls);

      // Collect RMA numbers or SKUs for folder-level cleanup
      const rmaNumbers = [];
      if (req.query?.rmaNumber) rmaNumbers.push(req.query.rmaNumber);
      if (parsedBody?.rmaNumber) rmaNumbers.push(parsedBody.rmaNumber);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.rmaNumbers)) rmaNumbers.push(...parsedBody.rmaNumbers);

      const skus = [];
      if (req.query?.sku) skus.push(req.query.sku);
      if (parsedBody?.sku) skus.push(parsedBody.sku);
      if (Array.isArray(parsedBody?.skus)) skus.push(...parsedBody.skus);

      const fileIdsToDelete = new Set();
      const folderIdsToDelete = new Map(); // id -> name
      const deletedIds = [];
      const failed = [];
      const SYSTEM_PROTECTED_FOLDERS = new Set([
        'Wholesale RMA Reports',
        'Wholesale RMA Photos',
        'RMA-Reports-Item',
        'RMA-Reports-SI/DR/PO',
        'Products'
      ]);

      // 1. If RMA numbers provided, locate their specific folders AND all files inside them
      for (const rma of [...new Set(rmaNumbers.filter(Boolean))]) {
        try {
          const cleanRma = String(rma).replace(/'/g, "\\'").trim();
          const q = `mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '${cleanRma}' and trashed = false`;
          const foundFolders = await searchFiles(q, { accessToken, driveId, pageSize: 20 });
          for (const f of foundFolders) {
            if (f.id && f.id !== driveId && f.id !== creds.folderId && !SYSTEM_PROTECTED_FOLDERS.has(f.name)) {
              // Find ALL files inside this RMA folder
              const childrenQ = `'${f.id}' in parents and trashed = false`;
              const children = await searchFiles(childrenQ, { accessToken, driveId, pageSize: 100 });
              for (const child of children) {
                if (child.id) fileIdsToDelete.add(child.id);
              }
              folderIdsToDelete.set(f.id, f.name);
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`[Google Drive RMA Folder Search Notice for ${rma}]:`, e.message);
        }
      }

      // 2. If SKUs provided, locate their specific product folders AND all files inside them
      for (const skuItem of [...new Set(skus.filter(Boolean))]) {
        try {
          const cleanSku = String(skuItem).replace(/'/g, "\\'").trim();
          if (cleanSku.length >= 2) {
            const q = `mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name contains '${cleanSku}' and trashed = false`;
            const foundFolders = await searchFiles(q, { accessToken, driveId, pageSize: 20 });
            for (const f of foundFolders) {
              if (f.id && f.id !== driveId && f.id !== creds.folderId && !SYSTEM_PROTECTED_FOLDERS.has(f.name)) {
                const childrenQ = `'${f.id}' in parents and trashed = false`;
                const children = await searchFiles(childrenQ, { accessToken, driveId, pageSize: 100 });
                for (const child of children) {
                  if (child.id) fileIdsToDelete.add(child.id);
                }
                folderIdsToDelete.set(f.id, f.name);
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`[Google Drive SKU Folder Search Notice for ${skuItem}]:`, e.message);
        }
      }

      // 3. Process explicit file/folder IDs & URLs passed from caller
      for (const item of rawUrlsOrIds) {
        if (!item) continue;
        let cleanItem = '';
        if (typeof item === 'string') cleanItem = item.trim();
        else if (typeof item === 'object') {
          cleanItem = String(item.fileId || item.folderId || item.id || item.fileUrl || item.url || '').trim();
        }
        if (!cleanItem) continue;

        let extractedId = null;
        const idMatch = cleanItem.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) || 
                        cleanItem.match(/\/folders\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) ||
                        cleanItem.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) ||
                        cleanItem.match(/\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
        
        if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
          extractedId = idMatch[1].split(/[?&=/]/)[0];
        } else if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{15,65}$/.test(cleanItem)) {
          extractedId = cleanItem;
        }

        if (extractedId) {
          if (cleanItem.includes('/folders/') || folderIdsToDelete.has(extractedId)) {
            folderIdsToDelete.set(extractedId, folderIdsToDelete.get(extractedId) || 'Folder');
            // If it's a folder, also harvest child files inside it
            try {
              const children = await searchFiles(`'${extractedId}' in parents and trashed = false`, { accessToken, driveId, pageSize: 100 });
              for (const child of children) {
                if (child.id) fileIdsToDelete.add(child.id);
              }
            } catch (cErr) {}
          } else {
            fileIdsToDelete.add(extractedId);
          }
        }
      }

      if (fileIdsToDelete.size === 0 && folderIdsToDelete.size === 0) {
        return res.status(200).json({ success: true, count: 0, message: 'No assets found to delete.' });
      }

      // 4. Delete/Trash all individual files
      for (const fileId of fileIdsToDelete) {
        if (!fileId || fileId === driveId || fileId === creds.folderId) continue;
        try {
          // Attempt 1: Permanent delete
          const delRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
            method: 'DELETE',
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
          });

          if (delRes.status === 204 || delRes.ok || delRes.status === 404) {
            deletedIds.push(fileId);
            continue;
          }

          // Attempt 2: Trash
          const trashRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: {
              Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ trashed: true }),
          });

          if (trashRes.ok || trashRes.status === 200 || trashRes.status === 404) {
            deletedIds.push(fileId);
            continue;
          }

          const trashErrText = await trashRes.text();
          failed.push({ fileId, error: trashErrText });
        } catch (fileErr) {
          failed.push({ fileId, error: fileErr.message });
        }
      }

      // 5. Delete/Trash/Rename folders
      for (const [folderId, folderName] of folderIdsToDelete.entries()) {
        if (!folderId || folderId === driveId || folderId === creds.folderId || SYSTEM_PROTECTED_FOLDERS.has(folderName)) continue;
        try {
          // Attempt 1: Permanent delete
          const delRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${folderId}?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
            method: 'DELETE',
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
          });

          if (delRes.status === 204 || delRes.ok || delRes.status === 404) {
            deletedIds.push(folderId);
            continue;
          }

          // Attempt 2: Trash
          const trashRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${folderId}?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: {
              Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ trashed: true }),
          });

          if (trashRes.ok || trashRes.status === 200 || trashRes.status === 404) {
            deletedIds.push(folderId);
            continue;
          }

          // Attempt 3: Rename to [Deleted] if 403 on Shared Drive
          const renameRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${folderId}?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: {
              Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ name: `[Deleted] ${folderName || folderId}` }),
          });

          if (renameRes.ok || renameRes.status === 200) {
            deletedIds.push(folderId);
          } else {
            const renameErr = await renameRes.text();
            failed.push({ folderId, error: renameErr });
          }
        } catch (folderErr) {
          failed.push({ folderId, error: folderErr.message });
        }
      }

      return res.status(200).json({
        success: deletedIds.length > 0 || failed.length === 0,
        deletedCount: deletedIds.length,
        deletedIds,
        failed
      });
    } catch (delErr) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Delete Global Exception]:', delErr.message);
      return res.status(200).json({ success: false, error: delErr.message });
    }
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return res.status(405).json({ success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED' });
  }

  // 1. Handle Gemini Flash Paperwork Inspection
  if (req.query?.action === 'inspect-paperwork' || parsedBody?.action === 'inspect-paperwork' || req.url?.includes('inspect-paperwork')) {
    try {
      const { fileData, imageUrl, mimeType } = parsedBody || {};
      const result = await inspectPaperworkWithGemini({
        fileData: fileData || parsedBody?.image || parsedBody?.photo,
        imageUrl: imageUrl || parsedBody?.url,
        mimeType: mimeType || 'image/jpeg'
      });
      return res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Gemini Paperwork Inspection Error]:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({
        is_valid_document: false,
        confidence: 0,
        error: err.message,
        rejection_reason: `AI inspection error: ${err.message}`
      });
    }
  }

  // 1B. Handle Gemini Flash Driver License / ID OCR Inspection
  if (req.query?.action === 'inspect-license' || parsedBody?.action === 'inspect-license' || req.url?.includes('inspect-license')) {
    try {
      const { fileData, imageUrl, mimeType } = parsedBody || {};
      const result = await inspectDriverLicenseWithGemini({
        fileData: fileData || parsedBody?.image || parsedBody?.photo,
        imageUrl: imageUrl || parsedBody?.url,
        mimeType: mimeType || 'image/jpeg'
      });
      return res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Gemini Driver License OCR Error]:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({
        is_valid_id: false,
        confidence: 0,
        error: err.message,
        rejection_reason: `AI ID reader error: ${err.message}`
      });
    }
  }

  // 1C. Handle Gemini Flash Delivery Truck Plate OCR Inspection
  if (req.query?.action === 'inspect-plate' || parsedBody?.action === 'inspect-plate' || req.url?.includes('inspect-plate')) {
    try {
      const { fileData, imageUrl, mimeType } = parsedBody || {};
      const result = await inspectTruckPlateWithGemini({
        fileData: fileData || parsedBody?.image || parsedBody?.photo,
        imageUrl: imageUrl || parsedBody?.url,
        mimeType: mimeType || 'image/jpeg'
      });
      return res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Gemini Truck Plate OCR Error]:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({
        is_valid_plate: false,
        plate_number: null,
        confidence: 0,
        error: err.message,
        rejection_reason: `AI plate reader error: ${err.message}`
      });
    }
  }

  // 2. Check if Google Drive credentials exist
  const creds = getGoogleCredentials();
  if (!creds) {
    return res.status(200).json({
      success: false,
      fallback: 'supabase',
      message: 'Google Drive credentials not configured. Please use Supabase Storage fallback.',
    });
  }

  // 3. Parse body: expect base64 fileData, rmaNumber, category, sku, productName
  const {
    fileData,
    fileName,
    mimeType = 'image/webp',
    rmaNumber = 'GENERAL',
    category = 'damaged_items',
    sku = null,
    code = null,
    productName = null,
    name = null,
    rmaType = 'customer_inbound',
    customerName = null,
    storeBranch = null,
    supplierName = null,
    targetFolderId: clientTargetFolderId = null
  } = parsedBody || {};

  if (!fileData) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'MISSING_FILE_DATA',
      message: 'Base64 fileData is required for photo upload.',
    });
  }

  // Clean base64 prefix if present (e.g. data:image/webp;base64,...)
  const pureBase64 = fileData.includes(',') ? fileData.split(',')[1] : fileData;
  const buffer = Buffer.from(pureBase64, 'base64');

  // Hard timeout guard: 25s for resilient Google Drive upload
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 25000);

  try {
    const accessToken = await getGoogleAccessToken(creds, controller.signal);

    // 4. Resolve target folder in Google Drive:
    // Root -> RMA-Reports-Item/[RMA] OR RMA-Reports-SI/DR/PO/[RMA] OR Products/[SKU Name]
    const resolvedFolder = await resolveTargetFolder({
      rootFolderId: creds.folderId,
      rmaNumber,
      category,
      sku: sku || code,
      productName: productName || name,
      targetFolderId: clientTargetFolderId,
      accessToken,
      signal: controller.signal
    });

    const targetFolderId = resolvedFolder?.targetFolderId;
    const rmaFolderId = resolvedFolder?.rmaFolderId;
    const rmaFolderUrl = resolvedFolder?.rmaFolderUrl;

    if (!targetFolderId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'MISSING_TARGET_FOLDER',
        message: 'Google Drive requires a valid root folder or shared drive to store files without quota limits.'
      });
    }

    // 5. Construct Multipart Upload to Drive v3 with supportsAllDrives=true
    const safeName = fileName || `RMA_${rmaNumber}_${category}_${Date.now()}.webp`;
    const boundary = `----RmaPhotoBoundary${Date.now()}`;

    const metadataPart = JSON.stringify({
      name: safeName,
      parents: targetFolderId ? [targetFolderId] : undefined,
      description: `Wholesale RMA ${category} for ${rmaNumber} - Uploaded ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
    });

    const bodyParts = [
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${metadataPart}\r\n`,
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: ${mimeType}\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64\r\n\r\n${buffer.toString('base64')}\r\n`,
      `--${boundary}--\r\n`,
    ];

    const multipartBody = bodyParts.join('');

    const uploadRes = await fetch(
      'https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart&supportsAllDrives=true&fields=id,name,webViewLink',
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`,
        },
        body: multipartBody,
        signal: controller.signal,
      }
    );

    if (!uploadRes.ok) {
      const errText = await uploadRes.text();
      console.error('[Google Drive Upload Error]:', errText);
      return res.status(200).json({
        success: false,
        fallback: 'supabase',
        error: `Google Drive upload failed: ${errText}`,
      });
    }

    const file = await uploadRes.json();
    const fileId = file.id;

    // 5. Grant public read permission so the photo can be rendered directly in web portals & emails
    try {
      await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}/permissions?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          role: 'reader',
          type: 'anyone',
        }),
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
    } catch (permErr) {
      console.warn('[Google Drive Permission Notice]:', permErr.message);
    }

    // Direct Google CDN image preview link (no interstitials, embeds smoothly in <img src>)
    const directCdnUrl = `https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/${fileId}`;
    const webViewLink = file.webViewLink || `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${fileId}/view?usp=sharing`;

    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      provider: 'google_drive',
      fileId,
      url: directCdnUrl,
      previewUrl: directCdnUrl,
      webViewLink,
      rmaFolderUrl,
      rmaFolderId,
      category,
      fileName: safeName,
      sizeBytes: buffer.length,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    console.warn('[Photo Upload Fallback Notice]:', err.message);

    // Gracefully instruct client to fall back to Supabase Storage
    return res.status(200).json({
      success: false,
      fallback: 'supabase',
      message: err.name === 'AbortError' ? 'Google Drive upload timed out (>7.5s)' : err.message,
    });
  }
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/api-keys/index.js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { generateApiKeyPair, ALLOWED_SYSTEMS } from '../../_lib/keyUtils.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';
import { handleVerifyPin, handleClearCooldown } from '../../_lib/verifyPinHandler.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  // Route: /api/v1/auth/verify-pin or action=verify-pin
  if (req.query?.action === 'verify-pin' || req.url?.includes('verify-pin')) {
    return handleVerifyPin(req, res);
  }

  // Route: /api/v1/auth/clear-cooldown or action=clear-cooldown
  if (req.query?.action === 'clear-cooldown' || req.url?.includes('clear-cooldown')) {
    return handleClearCooldown(req, res);
  }

  // GET: List all API Keys (Masked only, safe for admin dashboard)
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API Keys GET] Database error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'DATABASE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        count: data ? data.length : 0,
        keys: data || []
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Keys GET] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // POST: Generate a new API Key for one of the 4 systems
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(body);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      const { name, rateLimit, expiresAt } = body || {};

      if (!name || typeof name !== 'string' || !name.trim()) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'Client name is required. Must be one of: ' + ALLOWED_SYSTEMS.join(', ')
        });
      }

      const cleanName = name.trim();
      const limit = Number(rateLimit) > 0 ? Number(rateLimit) : 60;
      const expiry = expiresAt ? new Date(expiresAt).toISOString() : null;

      // Generate raw secret key and compute SHA-256 hash
      const { rawKey, keyHash, maskedKey } = generateApiKeyPair();

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .insert({
          name: cleanName,
          key_hash: keyHash,
          masked_key: maskedKey,
          is_active: true,
          rate_limit: limit,
          expires_at: expiry
        })
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, created_at')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API Keys POST] Insert error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'INSERT_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      // CRITICAL: Raw secret key is returned ONCE here so user can copy it!
      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key successfully generated for ${cleanName}. Please copy and save the secret key now; it cannot be viewed again.`,
        apiKey: rawKey,
        keyRecord: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Keys POST] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // DELETE: Revoke / Delete API key via query (?id=...) or body ({ id })
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }
      const targetId = req.query.id || (body && body.id);

      if (!targetId) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'API Key ID is required (e.g., ?id=<uuid> or body { id }).'
        });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', targetId)
        .select('id, name, masked_key')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `API Key with ID ${targetId} was not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${data.name} (${data.masked_key}) has been permanently deleted/revoked.`,
        deletedKey: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // PATCH: Rotate API key via query (?id=...) or body ({ id })
  if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }
      const targetId = req.query.id || (body && body.id);

      if (!targetId) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'API Key ID is required (e.g., ?id=<uuid> or body { id }).'
        });
      }

      const { rawKey, keyHash, maskedKey } = generateApiKeyPair();

      const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .update({
          key_hash: keyHash,
          masked_key: maskedKey,
          is_active: true,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('id', targetId)
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, updated_at')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (updateErr) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: updateErr.message });
      }

      if (!updated) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `API Key with ID ${targetId} was not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${updated.name} has been rotated successfully. Old key is revoked. Please copy and store the new secret key now.`,
        apiKey: rawKey,
        keyRecord: updated
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, {
    success: false,
    error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
    message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.`
  });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { generateApiKeyPair } from '../../_lib/keyUtils.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const { id } = req.query;

  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, {
      success: false,
      error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
      message: 'API Key ID is required in URL path.'
    });
  }

  // DELETE: Revoke / Delete API key
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', id)
        .select('id, name, masked_key')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API Key DELETE] Database error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'DELETE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, {
          success: false,
          error: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: `API Key with ID ${id} was not found.`
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${data.name} (${data.masked_key}) has been permanently deleted/revoked.`,
        deletedKey: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Key DELETE] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // PATCH: Rotate / Renew API Key (Revokes current, generates new replacement key)
  if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
    try {
      // 1. Generate new key pair and rotate in a single round-trip
      const { rawKey, keyHash, maskedKey } = generateApiKeyPair();

      const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .update({
          key_hash: keyHash,
          masked_key: maskedKey,
          is_active: true,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('id', id)
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, updated_at')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (updateErr) {
        console.error('[API Key ROTATE] Update error:', updateErr);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'UPDATE_ERROR',
          message: updateErr.message
        });
      }

      if (!updated) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, {
          success: false,
          error: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: `API Key with ID ${id} was not found.`
        });
      }

      // Return the new raw secret key ONCE
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `API Key for ${updated.name} has been rotated successfully. Old key is revoked. Please copy and store the new secret key now.`,
        apiKey: rawKey,
        keyRecord: updated
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API Key ROTATE] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, {
    success: false,
    error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
    message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.`
  });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/credit-memos/index.js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  // 1. GET: List credit memos
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { search, rma_number, barcode, limit = '50', offset = '0' } = req.query;

      const numLimit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limit, 10) || 50, 1), 200);
      const numOffset = Math.max(parseInt(offset, 10) || 0, 0);

      let query = supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact' });

      if (rma_number) {
        query = query.eq('rma_number', rma_number.trim());
      }
      if (barcode) {
        query = query.eq('barcode', barcode.trim());
      }
      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`credit_memo_number.ilike.%${search}%,pull_out_ref.ilike.%${search}%,product_name.ilike.%${search}%,customer_ae_name.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      query = query
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .range(numOffset, numOffset + numLimit - 1);

      const { data, count, error } = await query;

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      const isTestRequested = req.query.test_mode === 'true' || req.query.is_test === 'true' || req.headers['x-test-mode'] === 'true';
      const filteredData = (data || []).filter(m => {
        const isTest = Boolean(m.notes && m.notes.includes('[TEST_MODE]'));
        return isTestRequested ? isTest : !isTest;
      });

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        client: client.name,
        test_mode: isTestRequested,
        total: filteredData.length,
        limit: numLimit,
        offset: numOffset,
        data: filteredData
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. POST: Issue Credit Memo
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const {
        rma_number,
        barcode,
        product_name,
        sku,
        supplier_name = 'Savemore',
        company = 'Wholesale Distribution',
        customer_ae_name,
        customer_ae_email,
        quantity = 1,
        unit_name = 'pc',
        unit_price = 0,
        pull_out_ref,
        pull_out_date,
        credit_amount,
        notes
      } = body || {};

      if (!rma_number || !barcode || !product_name || !pull_out_ref || credit_amount === undefined) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: '"rma_number", "barcode", "product_name", "pull_out_ref", and "credit_amount" are required.'
        });
      }

      // Standardized CM Number: CM-[YEAR]-[4-DIGIT-ASCENDING]-[4-CHAR-ALPHANUMERIC]
      // Example: CM-2026-0001-6TYH
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      let nextSeq = 1;
      try {
        const { count } = await supabase.from('credit_memos').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true });
        if (typeof count === 'number' && count >= 0) {
          nextSeq = count + 1;
        }
      } catch (countErr) {
        console.warn('Count query notice for CM sequence:', countErr.message);
      }

      const seqStr = String(nextSeq).padStart(4, '0');
      const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
      let rand = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
      }
      const cmNumber = `CM-${currentYear}-${seqStr}-${rand}`;

      const numQty = parseFloat(quantity) || 1;
      const numUnitPrice = parseFloat(unit_price) || 0;
      const calculatedAmount = numQty * numUnitPrice;
      const finalCreditAmount = parseFloat(credit_amount) || calculatedAmount;

      const payload = {
        credit_memo_number: cmNumber,
        rma_number: String(rma_number).trim(),
        barcode: String(barcode).trim(),
        product_name: String(product_name).trim(),
        sku: sku ? String(sku).trim() : null,
        supplier_name: supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        company: company || 'Wholesale Distribution',
        customer_ae_name: customer_ae_name || null,
        customer_ae_email: customer_ae_email || null,
        quantity: numQty,
        unit_name: unit_name || 'pc',
        unit_price: numUnitPrice,
        amount: calculatedAmount,
        pull_out_ref: String(pull_out_ref).trim(),
        pull_out_date: pull_out_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        credit_amount: finalCreditAmount,
        credit_issued_by: `${client.name} (API)`,
        credit_issued_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        notes: (body?.is_test === true || req.query.test_mode === 'true' || req.headers['x-test-mode'] === 'true')
          ? `[TEST_MODE] ${notes || `Issued via REST API by ${client.name}`}`
          : (notes || `Issued via REST API by ${client.name}`),
        status: 'issued'
      };

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .insert(payload)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'INSERT_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `Credit Memo ${cmNumber} issued successfully by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, { success: false, error: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Credit Memo ID or CM Number is required in URL.' });
  }

  const cleanId = String(id).trim();
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(cleanId);

  const matchCM = (query) => {
    return isNumeric ? query.eq('id', parseInt(cleanId, 10)) : query.eq('credit_memo_number', cleanId);
  };

  // 1. GET: Fetch Credit Memo
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchCM(supabase.from('credit_memos').select('*')).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Credit Memo ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, data });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. DELETE: Remove Credit Memo
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchCM(
        supabase.from('credit_memos').delete().select('id, credit_memo_number, product_name')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Credit Memo ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `Credit Memo ${data.credit_memo_number} deleted by ${client.name}.`,
        deleted: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/health.js ---
import { supabase } from '../_lib/supabase.js';
import { setCorsHeaders, sendJson } from '../_lib/auth.js';
import { hashApiKey } from '../_lib/keyUtils.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  const startTime = Date.now();
  let dbStatus = 'connected';
  let dbLatencyMs = 0;

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('api_keys').select('id').limit(1);
    dbLatencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    if (error) {
      dbStatus = 'degraded';
    }
  } catch (e) {
    dbStatus = 'disconnected';
    dbLatencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
  }

  // Optional client identity check
  let clientIdentity = 'public / unauthenticated';
  let rawKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];
  if (!rawKey && req.headers['authorization']) {
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
    rawKey = authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.substring(7).trim() : authHeader.trim();
  }

  if (rawKey) {
    const keyHash = hashApiKey(rawKey);
    const { data: keyRecord } = await supabase
      .from('api_keys')
      .select('name, masked_key, is_active')
      .eq('key_hash', keyHash)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (keyRecord && keyRecord.is_active) {
      clientIdentity = `${keyRecord.name} (${keyRecord.masked_key})`;
    } else {
      clientIdentity = 'invalid or revoked key';
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 200, {
    status: 'healthy',
    version: '1.0.0',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    environment: 'production',
    service: 'Wholesale RMA Multi-System REST API',
    database: {
      status: dbStatus,
      latency_ms: dbLatencyMs
    },
    authenticated_client: clientIdentity,
    documentation: '/docs'
  });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/products/index.js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  // 1. GET: Search / list products
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { barcode, code, search, limit = '50', offset = '0' } = req.query;

      const numLimit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limit, 10) || 50, 1), 200);
      const numOffset = Math.max(parseInt(offset, 10) || 0, 0);

      let query = supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact' });

      if (barcode) {
        query = query.eq('barcode', barcode.trim());
      }
      if (code) {
        query = query.eq('code', code.trim());
      }
      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.%${search}%,code.ilike.%${search}%,barcode.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      query = query
        .order('name', { ascending: true })
        .range(numOffset, numOffset + numLimit - 1);

      const { data, count, error } = await query;

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        client: client.name,
        total: count || 0,
        limit: numLimit,
        offset: numOffset,
        data: data || []
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. POST: Create or upsert product
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const {
        barcode,
        name,
        code,
        price = 0,
        price_with_vat = 0,
        supplier_name = 'Savemore',
        brand_name,
        unit_name = 'pc',
        image_url
      } = body || {};

      if (!barcode || !name) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: '"barcode" and "name" are required.'
        });
      }

      const payload = {
        barcode: String(barcode).trim(),
        name: String(name).trim(),
        code: code ? String(code).trim() : null,
        price: parseFloat(price) || 0,
        price_with_vat: parseFloat(price_with_vat) || 0,
        supplier_name: supplier_name ? String(supplier_name).trim() : 'Savemore',
        brand_name: brand_name ? String(brand_name).trim() : null,
        unit_name: unit_name || 'pc',
        image_url: image_url || null,
        is_verified: true,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .upsert(payload, { onConflict: 'barcode' })
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPSERT_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `Product ${data.name} (${data.barcode}) upserted successfully by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

--- START FILE: api/v1/products/[id].js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';
import lookupHandler from '../../_lib/lookupHandler.js';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  // Gracefully route /api/v1/products/lookup to lookupHandler if invoked by dynamic router
  if (req.query?.id === 'lookup' || req.url?.includes('/lookup')) {
    return lookupHandler(req, res);
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, { success: false, error: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Product ID or Barcode is required in URL.' });
  }

  const cleanId = String(id).trim();
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(cleanId);

  const matchProduct = (query) => {
    return isNumeric ? query.or(`id.eq.${cleanId},barcode.eq.${cleanId}`) : query.eq('barcode', cleanId);
  };

  // 1. GET: Fetch product
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchProduct(supabase.from('products').select('*')).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Product ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, data });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. PATCH: Update product
  if (req.method === 'PATCH' || req.method === 'PUT') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) {}
      }

      const allowedFields = ['name', 'code', 'price', 'price_with_vat', 'supplier_name', 'brand_name', 'unit_name', 'image_url', 'is_verified'];
      const updateData = { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };

      for (const field of allowedFields) {
        if (body && body[field] !== undefined) {
          updateData[field] = body[field];
        }
      }

      const { data, error } = await matchProduct(
        supabase.from('products').update(updateData).select('*')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Product ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `Product ${data.name} updated by ${client.name}.`,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 3. DELETE: Remove product
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchProduct(
        supabase.from('products').delete().select('id, barcode, name')
      ).maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Product ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `Product ${data.name} (${data.barcode}) deleted by ${client.name}.`,
        deleted: data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}
