--- START FILE: api/v1/rma/index.js ---
import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';
import { handleRmaEmailEdit } from '../../_lib/rmaEmailEditHandler.js';

const resolveApiReorderStatus = (item) => {
  const meta = (item?.ai_document_metadata && typeof item.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? item.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const reorderMeta = (meta.reorder && typeof meta.reorder === 'object') ? meta.reorder : {};
  const workflowRes = String(meta.workflow_resolution || item?.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const explicitStatus = String(reorderMeta.status || item?.reorder_status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const hasPendingReset = explicitStatus === 'pending' || explicitStatus === 'pending_reorder';
  const isReordered = !hasPendingReset && (
    explicitStatus === 'reordered' ||
    Boolean(reorderMeta.reordered_at || item?.reordered_at) ||
    workflowRes === 'reordered'
  );
  return {
    status: isReordered ? 'reordered' : 'pending',
    isReordered,
    reorderedAt: isReordered ? (reorderMeta.reordered_at || item?.reordered_at || (workflowRes === 'reordered' ? meta.resolved_at : null) || null) : null,
    reorderedBy: isReordered ? (reorderMeta.reordered_by || item?.reordered_by || (workflowRes === 'reordered' ? meta.resolved_by : null) || null) : null,
    poNumber: String(reorderMeta.po_number || item?.reorder_po_number || (isReordered ? (item?.po_number || '') : '')).trim() || null,
    notes: String(reorderMeta.notes || item?.reorder_notes || '').trim() || null
  };
};

const getItemNeedsReorder = (item) => {
  if (item?.needs_reorder !== undefined && item?.needs_reorder !== null) {
    return Boolean(item.needs_reorder);
  }
  if (item?.ai_document_metadata?.needs_reorder !== undefined && item?.ai_document_metadata?.needs_reorder !== null) {
    return Boolean(item.ai_document_metadata.needs_reorder);
  }
  const notes = String(item?.notes || '');
  if (notes.includes('[REORDER: NO]')) return false;
  if (notes.includes('[REORDER: YES]')) return true;
  return true;
};

const getRecoverySource = (item) => {
  const disp = String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  if (disp.includes('buffer')) return 'buffer_swap';
  if (disp.includes('rtv') || disp.includes('vendor') || item?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound') return 'vendor_rtv';
  return 'scrap';
};

function normalizeWarehouseLocation(loc, item = null) {
  const raw = String(loc || '').trim();
  const isSupplierOutbound = item?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' || 
    String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().includes('rtv') || 
    String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().includes('vendor');

  if (!raw || raw === '—' || raw === 'N/A' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'dock' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'dock-intake' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'rtv-dock') {
    return isSupplierOutbound ? 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)' : 'Receiving Area';
  }

  const upper = raw.toUpperCase();
  if (upper.includes('SCRAP') || upper.includes('DISPOS')) return 'Disposal / Scrap Area';
  if (upper.includes('QUARANTINE') || upper.includes('HOLD') || upper.includes('INSPECT')) return 'Hold / Inspection Area';
  if (upper.includes('OUTBOUND-RETURN') || upper.includes('CUSTOMER RETURN') || upper.includes('STORE')) return 'Customer Return Area';
  if (upper.includes('GOOD STOCK') || upper.includes('SHELF') || upper.includes('RESTOCK')) return 'Good Stock Area';
  if (upper.includes('SUPPLIER') || upper.includes('RTV') || upper.includes('VENDOR')) return 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)';
  if (upper.includes('RECEIV') || upper.includes('DOCK')) return 'Receiving Area';

  return raw;
}

function isTestRecord(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  return Boolean(
    item.is_test === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.is_test === true ||
    String(item.notes || '').includes('[TEST_MODE]')
  );
}

function isTrashedRecord(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  return Boolean(
    item.is_trashed === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.is_trashed === true ||
    String(item.notes || '').includes('[TRASHED]')
  );
}

function isArchivedRecord(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (isTrashedRecord(item)) return false;
  return Boolean(
    item.is_archived === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.is_archived === true ||
    String(item.notes || '').includes('[ARCHIVED]')
  );
}

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  // Email-bound Google Identity RMA Editor route (enforces Supabase OAuth JWT + Invite Token)
  if (req.query?.action === 'email-edit') {
    return handleRmaEmailEdit(req, res);
  }

  // 1. Authenticate API Key
  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return; // Response already sent by middleware

  // 2. GET: List RMA Reports with query filters & dedicated coworker queues
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { 
        rma_type, 
        status, 
        barcode, 
        search, 
        disposition, 
        condition_grade, 
        warehouse_location, 
        queue, 
        is_parent, 
        test_mode,
        is_test,
        lifecycle = 'active',
        limit = '50', 
        offset = '0' 
      } = req.query;

      const isTestModeRequested = test_mode === 'true' || is_test === 'true' || req.headers['x-test-mode'] === 'true';

      const numLimit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limit, 10) || 50, 1), 200);
      const numOffset = Math.max(parseInt(offset, 10) || 0, 0);

      // Fetch reports and catalog products for accurate SKU/location enrichment and manifest unpacking
      const [{ data: rawReports, error }, { data: catalogProducts }] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
        supabase.from('products').select('barcode, code, name, supplier_name, price, price_with_vat, pieces_per_case')
      ]);

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API v1 RMA GET] Query error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'DATABASE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      const productByBarcode = new Map();
      (catalogProducts || []).forEach(p => {
        if (p && p.barcode) {
          productByBarcode.set(String(p.barcode).trim(), p);
        }
      });

      const allRows = Array.isArray(rawReports) ? rawReports : [];
      const unpackedList = [];
      const seenManifestLineKeys = new Set();

      // If caller explicitly requests is_parent=true, only return parent manifest container rows
      if (is_parent === 'true') {
        allRows.forEach(r => {
          if (r && r.is_parent === true) {
            unpackedList.push(r);
          }
        });
      } else {
        // First pass: unpack parent batch manifests into individual line items with real SKUs, names, quantities, and warehouse_location
        allRows.forEach(r => {
          if (!r) return;
          let parsedItems = [];
          if (Array.isArray(r.items) && r.items.length > 0) {
            parsedItems = r.items;
          } else if (typeof r.items === 'string' && r.items.trim()) {
            try {
              const p = JSON.parse(r.items);
              if (Array.isArray(p)) parsedItems = p;
            } catch (e) {}
          }

          const isManifestParent = Boolean(
            r.is_parent === true ||
            parsedItems.length > 1 ||
            String(r.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest')
          );

          if (isManifestParent) {
            parsedItems.forEach((child, idx) => {
              const cBarcode = String(child.barcode || '').trim();
              const matchedProd = cBarcode ? productByBarcode.get(cBarcode) : null;
              const rawSku = String(child.code || child.sku || matchedProd?.code || '').trim();
              const validSku = (rawSku && rawSku !== cBarcode && !rawSku.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting')) ? rawSku : null;
              const cName = (child.name || child.productName || matchedProd?.name || `Item #${idx + 1}`).trim();
              const lineKey = `${r.rma_number}::${cBarcode || idx}::${idx}`;
              seenManifestLineKeys.add(`${r.rma_number}::${cBarcode}`);

              // Look up if there is also a separate child row in rma_reports for this barcode to merge latest status/location
              const matchingChildRow = allRows.find(other => (
                other &&
                other.id !== r.id &&
                !other.is_parent &&
                other.rma_number === r.rma_number &&
                String(other.barcode || '').trim() === cBarcode
              ));

              const effectiveStatus = child.status || matchingChildRow?.status || (
                (r.status === 'restocked' || r.status === 'scrapped' || r.status === 'closed')
                  ? r.status
                  : 'under_inspection'
              );
              const effectiveDisposition = child.disposition || matchingChildRow?.disposition || r.disposition || '1- Pending Triage';
              const effectiveLocation = child.warehouse_location || matchingChildRow?.warehouse_location || r.warehouse_location || null;

              unpackedList.push({
                ...r,
                ...child,
                id: matchingChildRow?.id || r.id,
                manifest_item_id: child.id || lineKey,
                parent_rma_id: r.id,
                is_parent: false,
                is_unpacked_manifest_item: true,
                rma_number: r.rma_number,
                barcode: cBarcode || r.barcode,
                sku: validSku,
                code: validSku,
                name: cName,
                quantity: Number(child.quantity || child.qty) || 1,
                unit_name: child.unit_name || child.unit || r.unit_name || 'pc',
                pieces_per_case: child.pieces_per_case || child.piecesPerCase || matchedProd?.pieces_per_case || null,
                supplier_name: (child.supplier_name && child.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment')
                  ? child.supplier_name
                  : (matchedProd?.supplier_name || r.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment'),
                price: Number(child.price_with_vat || child.price || matchedProd?.price_with_vat || matchedProd?.price || 0),
                condition_grade: child.condition_grade || matchingChildRow?.condition_grade || r.condition_grade || 'B - Damaged Packaging Only',
                disposition: effectiveDisposition,
                warehouse_location: effectiveLocation,
                status: effectiveStatus,
                items: undefined
              });
            });
          }
        });

        // Second pass: add standalone single-item tickets (and any child rows not already unpacked from a parent's items array)
        allRows.forEach(r => {
          if (!r) return;
          const isManifestParent = Boolean(
            r.is_parent === true ||
            (Array.isArray(r.items) && r.items.length > 1) ||
            String(r.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest')
          );
          if (isManifestParent) return; // Never push generic parent manifest container

          const rBarcode = String(r.barcode || '').trim();
          const dedupKey = `${r.rma_number}::${rBarcode}`;
          // Skip if already unpacked from parent manifest items array (prevents double-counting)
          if (seenManifestLineKeys.has(dedupKey) && !/-[B-Z]$/i.test(String(r.rma_number || ''))) {
            return;
          }

          const matchedProd = rBarcode ? productByBarcode.get(rBarcode) : null;
          const rawSku = String(r.code || r.sku || matchedProd?.code || '').trim();
          const validSku = (rawSku && rawSku !== rBarcode && !rawSku.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting')) ? rawSku : null;

          unpackedList.push({
            ...r,
            sku: validSku,
            code: validSku,
            name: (r.name && !String(r.name).toLowerCase().includes('unidentified'))
              ? r.name
              : (matchedProd?.name || r.name),
            supplier_name: (r.supplier_name && r.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment')
              ? r.supplier_name
              : (matchedProd?.supplier_name || r.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment'),
            price: Number(r.price_with_vat || r.price || matchedProd?.price_with_vat || matchedProd?.price || 0),
            warehouse_location: r.warehouse_location || null,
            batch_lot_number: r.batch_lot_number || null
          });
        });
      }

      // Apply filters on unpacked items
      const FINALIZED_RESTOCK = new Set(['restocked', 'closed', 'resolved', 'scrapped', 'disposed', 'rejected', 'deleted']);
      const FINALIZED_SCRAP = new Set(['scrapped', 'disposed', 'closed', 'resolved', 'restocked', 'rejected', 'deleted']);

      const filtered = unpackedList.filter(item => {
        // Scope filter: Live Production vs Sandbox Test Mode
        const itemIsTest = isTestRecord(item);
        if (isTestModeRequested && !itemIsTest) return false;
        if (!isTestModeRequested && itemIsTest) return false;

        // Lifecycle filter: active vs archived vs trashed
        const itemIsTrashed = isTrashedRecord(item);
        const itemIsArchived = isArchivedRecord(item);
        if (lifecycle === 'trashed') {
          if (!itemIsTrashed) return false;
        } else if (lifecycle === 'archived') {
          if (!itemIsArchived) return false;
        } else {
          // default 'active'
          if (itemIsTrashed || itemIsArchived) return false;
        }

        if (rma_type && item.rma_type !== rma_type) return false;
        if (barcode && String(item.barcode || '').trim() !== String(barcode).trim()) return false;

        const itemDisp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
        const itemStatus = String(item.status || 'received_at_dock').toLowerCase().trim();

        // Unified 5-Queue Filtering (restock, reorder, scrap_no_reorder, quarantine, rejected)
        const itemWorkflowRes = String(item.ai_document_metadata?.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase();
        const isOutcomeFinalized = itemWorkflowRes === 'restocked' || itemWorkflowRes === 'scrapped_no_reorder';
        const reorderInfo = resolveApiReorderStatus(item);

        if (req.query?.reorder_status) {
          const wantReorder = String(req.query.reorder_status).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (wantReorder === 'reordered' && !reorderInfo.isReordered) return false;
          if ((wantReorder === 'pending' || wantReorder === 'pending_reorder') && reorderInfo.isReordered) return false;
        }

        if (queue) {
          const cleanQueue = String(queue).trim().toLowerCase();
          const needsReorderFlag = getItemNeedsReorder(item);

          if (cleanQueue === 'restock') {
            const isRestockDisp = itemDisp.includes('restock') || itemDisp.includes('replacement stock received');
            if (!isRestockDisp) return false;
            if (FINALIZED_RESTOCK.has(itemStatus) || isOutcomeFinalized) return false;
          } else if (cleanQueue === 'reorder' || cleanQueue === 'scrap' || cleanQueue === 'scrapped') {
            const isLossDisp = itemDisp.includes('scrap') || itemDisp.includes('dispose') || itemDisp.includes('reorder') || itemDisp.includes('rtv') || itemDisp.includes('vendor') || itemDisp.includes('buffer') || itemDisp.includes('claim rejected by vendor') || itemDisp.includes('pending vendor pickup');
            const isExcluded = itemDisp.includes('restock') || itemDisp.includes('replacement stock received') || itemDisp.includes('quarantine') || itemDisp.includes('hold') || itemStatus === 'rejected' || itemDisp.includes('8- rejected');
            if (!isLossDisp || isExcluded) return false;
            if (needsReorderFlag === false) return false;
            if (reorderInfo.isReordered || FINALIZED_SCRAP.has(itemStatus) || isOutcomeFinalized) return false;
          } else if (cleanQueue === 'scrap_no_reorder') {
            const isLossDisp = itemDisp.includes('scrap') || itemDisp.includes('dispose') || itemDisp.includes('reorder') || itemDisp.includes('rtv') || itemDisp.includes('vendor') || itemDisp.includes('buffer') || itemDisp.includes('claim rejected by vendor') || itemDisp.includes('pending vendor pickup');
            const isExcluded = itemDisp.includes('restock') || itemDisp.includes('replacement stock received') || itemDisp.includes('quarantine') || itemDisp.includes('hold') || itemStatus === 'rejected' || itemDisp.includes('8- rejected');
            if (!isLossDisp || isExcluded) return false;
            if (needsReorderFlag !== false) return false;
            if (FINALIZED_SCRAP.has(itemStatus) || isOutcomeFinalized) return false;
          } else if (cleanQueue === 'rtv_debit' || cleanQueue === 'rtv') {
            const isRtv = itemDisp.includes('rtv') || itemDisp.includes('return to vendor') || itemDisp.includes('vendor') || item.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
            if (!isRtv) return false;
            if (['closed', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'deleted', 'restocked', 'scrapped', 'disposed'].includes(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (cleanQueue === 'quarantine' || cleanQueue === 'hold') {
            const isHold = itemDisp.includes('quarantine') || itemDisp.includes('hold') || itemStatus === 'quarantine' || itemStatus === 'hold';
            if (!isHold) return false;
            if (['closed', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'deleted'].includes(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (cleanQueue === 'rejected') {
            const isRejected = itemStatus === 'rejected' || itemDisp.includes('rejected') || itemDisp.includes('claim rejected by vendor');
            if (!isRejected) return false;
            if (['closed', 'resolved', 'deleted'].includes(itemStatus)) return false;
          }
        }

        // Status filter
        if (status) {
          const cleanStatus = String(status).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (cleanStatus === 'pending' || cleanStatus === 'open') {
            if (FINALIZED_RESTOCK.has(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (cleanStatus === 'restocked') {
            if (!['restocked', 'closed', 'resolved'].includes(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (cleanStatus === 'scrapped' || cleanStatus === 'disposed') {
            if (!['scrapped', 'disposed'].includes(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (itemStatus !== cleanStatus) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        // Disposition filter
        if (disposition) {
          const cleanDisp = String(disposition).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (cleanDisp.includes('restock')) {
            if (!itemDisp.includes('restock')) return false;
            if (!status && !queue && FINALIZED_RESTOCK.has(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (cleanDisp.includes('scrap') || cleanDisp.includes('dispose')) {
            if (!itemDisp.includes('scrap') && !itemDisp.includes('dispose')) return false;
            if (!status && !queue && FINALIZED_SCRAP.has(itemStatus)) return false;
          } else if (cleanDisp.includes('rtv') || cleanDisp.includes('return to vendor')) {
            if (!itemDisp.includes('rtv') && !itemDisp.includes('return to vendor') && !itemDisp.includes('vendor')) return false;
          } else if (!itemDisp.includes(cleanDisp)) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        if (condition_grade) {
          if (!String(item.condition_grade || '').toLowerCase().includes(String(condition_grade).trim().toLowerCase())) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        if (warehouse_location) {
          if (!String(item.warehouse_location || '').toLowerCase().includes(String(warehouse_location).trim().toLowerCase())) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        if (search) {
          const q = String(search).trim().toLowerCase();
          const matches = (
            String(item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(item.code || item.sku || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(item.rma_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(item.reporter_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            String(item.warehouse_location || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
          );
          if (!matches) return false;
        }

        return true;
      });

      const paginatedData = filtered.slice(numOffset, numOffset + numLimit);
      const enrichedData = paginatedData.map(item => {
        const needsReorder = getItemNeedsReorder(item);
        const reorderInfo = resolveApiReorderStatus(item);
        const itemObj = {
          ...item,
          needs_reorder: needsReorder,
          reorder_status: reorderInfo.status,
          reordered_at: reorderInfo.reorderedAt,
          reordered_by: reorderInfo.reorderedBy,
          reorder_po_number: reorderInfo.poNumber,
          reorder_notes: reorderInfo.notes
        };
        const cleanQueue = queue ? String(queue).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        if (cleanQueue === 'reorder' || cleanQueue === 'scrap' || cleanQueue === 'scrapped') {
          itemObj.recovery_source = getRecoverySource(item);
        }
        return itemObj;
      });

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        client: client.name,
        queue: queue || null,
        total: filtered.length,
        limit: numLimit,
        offset: numOffset,
        data: enrichedData
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API v1 RMA GET] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  // 3. POST: Create new RMA Report from client system
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      let body = req.body;
      if (typeof body === 'string') {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(body);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      const {
        barcode,
        name,
        rma_type = 'customer_inbound',
        code,
        quantity = 1,
        supplier_name,
        price = 0,
        price_with_vat = 0,
        unit_name = 'pc',
        status = 'received_at_dock',
        condition_grade = 'B - Damaged Packaging Only',
        disposition = 'Pending Triage',
        warehouse_location,
        inspected_by,
        reason = 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
        explanation,
        photos = [],
        reporter_name,
        reporter_contact,
        ae_name,
        ae_email,
        store_branch,
        invoice_dr_number,
        si_number,
        dr_number,
        po_number,
        expiry_date,
        batch_lot_number,
        notes
      } = body || {};

      if (!barcode || !name) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Both "barcode" and "name" are required fields.'
        });
      }

      // Mandatory Expiration Date across Customer Hub & Supplier RTV
      if (!expiry_date || !String(expiry_date).trim()) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'MISSING_EXPIRY_DATE',
          message: 'Product expiration date ("expiry_date") is mandatory for all RMA reports across Customer Hub and Supplier RTV.'
        });
      }

      const isTestMode = Boolean(body?.is_test === true || req.query.test_mode === 'true' || req.query.is_test === 'true' || req.headers['x-test-mode'] === 'true');

      // Standardized Unique RMA Number with Complete Sequence Isolation:
      // Live: RMA-[YEAR]-[4-DIGIT-ASCENDING]-[4-CHAR-ALPHANUMERIC] (e.g. RMA-2026-0001-6TYH)
      // Test: RMA-TEST-[YEAR]-[4-DIGIT-ASCENDING]-[4-CHAR-ALPHANUMERIC] (e.g. RMA-TEST-2026-0001-6TYH)
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      let nextSeq = 1;
      try {
        let countQuery = supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true });
        if (isTestMode) {
          countQuery = countQuery.or('notes.ilike.%[TEST_MODE]%,rma_number.ilike.%TEST%');
        } else {
          countQuery = countQuery.not('notes', 'ilike', '%[TEST_MODE]%').not('rma_number', 'ilike', '%TEST%');
        }
        const { count } = await countQuery;
        if (typeof count === 'number' && count >= 0) {
          nextSeq = count + 1;
        }
      } catch (countErr) {
        console.warn('Count query notice for RMA sequence:', countErr.message);
      }

      const seqStr = String(nextSeq).padStart(4, '0');
      const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
      let randomSuffix = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        randomSuffix += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
      }
      const rmaPrefix = isTestMode ? `RMA-TEST-${currentYear}` : `RMA-${currentYear}`;
      const rmaNumber = body.rma_number ? String(body.rma_number).trim() : `${rmaPrefix}-${seqStr}-${randomSuffix}`;

      if (!isTestMode && rmaNumber.includes('TEST')) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'INVALID_LIVE_RMA_NUMBER',
          message: "Live mode RMA IDs cannot contain 'TEST' prefix. Please use standard RMA-[YEAR]-[SEQ]-[RAND] format."
        });
      }

      const reportPayload = {
        rma_number: rmaNumber,
        rma_type: rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'supplier_outbound' : 'customer_inbound',
        barcode: String(barcode).trim(),
        code: code ? String(code).trim() : null,
        name: String(name).trim(),
        quantity: parseInt(quantity, 10) || 1,
        supplier_name: supplier_name ? String(supplier_name).trim() : 'Savemore',
        price: parseFloat(price) || 0,
        price_with_vat: parseFloat(price_with_vat) || 0,
        unit_name: unit_name || 'pc',
        status: status || 'received_at_dock',
        condition_grade: condition_grade || 'B - Damaged Packaging Only',
        disposition: disposition || 'Pending Triage',
        warehouse_location: normalizeWarehouseLocation(warehouse_location, { rma_type }),
        inspected_by: inspected_by ? String(inspected_by).trim() : null,
        inspected_at: inspected_by ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
        reason: reason || 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
        explanation: explanation || null,
        photos: Array.isArray(photos) ? photos : [],
        reporter_name: reporter_name ? String(reporter_name).trim() : client.name,
        reporter_contact: reporter_contact ? String(reporter_contact).trim() : null,
        reported_by: `${client.name} (API)`,
        ae_name: ae_name || null,
        ae_email: ae_email || null,
        store_branch: store_branch ? String(store_branch).trim() : null,
        invoice_dr_number: invoice_dr_number ? String(invoice_dr_number).trim() : null,
        si_number: si_number ? String(si_number).trim() : null,
        dr_number: dr_number ? String(dr_number).trim() : null,
        po_number: po_number ? String(po_number).trim() : null,
        expiry_date: expiry_date || null,
        batch_lot_number: batch_lot_number ? String(batch_lot_number).trim() : null,
        ai_document_metadata: {
          ...(body.ai_document_metadata || {}),
          ...(isTestMode ? { is_test: true } : {})
        },
        notes: isTestMode ? `[TEST_MODE] ${notes || ''}`.trim() : (notes ? String(notes).trim() : `Reported via REST API by ${client.name}`),
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .insert(reportPayload)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error('[API v1 RMA POST] Insert error:', error);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'INSERT_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        });
      }

      return sendJson(res, 201, {
        success: true,
        message: `RMA report ${rmaNumber} created successfully.`,
        client: client.name,
        data
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[API v1 RMA POST] Server error:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
        message: err.message
      });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, {
    success: false,
    error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
    message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.`
  });
}

import { supabase } from '../../_lib/supabase.js';
import { requireApiKey, sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from '../../_lib/auth.js';

function normalizeWarehouseLocation(loc, rmaType = 'customer_inbound') {
  const raw = String(loc || '').trim();
  const isSupplier = rmaType === 'supplier_outbound';
  if (!raw || raw === '—' || raw === 'N/A' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'dock' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'dock-intake' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'rtv-dock') {
    return isSupplier ? 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)' : 'Receiving Area';
  }
  const upper = raw.toUpperCase();
  if (upper.includes('SCRAP') || upper.includes('DISPOS')) return 'Disposal / Scrap Area';
  if (upper.includes('QUARANTINE') || upper.includes('HOLD') || upper.includes('INSPECT')) return 'Hold / Inspection Area';
  if (upper.includes('OUTBOUND') || upper.includes('CUSTOMER RETURN') || upper.includes('RETURN-TO-STORE')) return 'Customer Return Area';
  if (upper.includes('RTV') || upper.includes('SUPPLIER') || upper.includes('VENDOR')) return 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)';
  if (upper.includes('RESTOCK') || upper.includes('GOOD STOCK') || upper.includes('SHELF') || upper.includes('RACK') || upper.includes('BIN')) return 'Good Stock Area';
  return raw;
}

function mapReasonToConditionGrade(reason) {
  if (!reason) return 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';
  const r = String(reason).toLowerCase();
  if (r.includes('wrong item') || r.includes('pull-out') || r.includes('unsold') || r.includes('resellable') || r.includes('like new') || r.includes('incorrect shipment')) {
    return 'A - Like New / Resellable';
  }
  if (r.includes('expired') || r.includes('expiry') || r.includes('spoiled') || r.includes('leaking') || r.includes('broken seal') || r.includes('total loss') || r.includes('scrap')) {
    return 'D - Total Loss / Scrap';
  }
  if (r.includes('factory defect') || r.includes('not working') || r.includes('parts only') || r.includes('other defect') || r.includes('defective')) {
    return 'C - Defective / Parts Only';
  }
  if (r.includes('box') || r.includes('packaging') || r.includes('crushed') || r.includes('dent') || r.includes('damaged box')) {
    return 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';
  }
  return 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';
}

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  const client = await requireApiKey(req, res);
  if (!client) return;

  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, {
      success: false,
      error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
      message: 'RMA ID or RMA Number is required in URL.'
    });
  }

  const cleanId = String(id).trim();
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(cleanId);

  // Helper query builder for ID or rma_number
  const matchRma = (query) => {
    return isNumeric ? query.eq('id', parseInt(cleanId, 10)) : query.eq('rma_number', cleanId);
  };

  // 1. GET: Fetch single or manifest RMA
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchRma(supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*'));

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `RMA report ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      const result = data.length === 1 ? data[0] : data;
      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, data: result });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 2. PATCH / PUT: Update RMA status or fields
  if (req.method === 'PATCH' || req.method === 'PUT') {
    try {
      // Support both JSON request body and query parameters (for Scalar & URL parameter testing)
      let body = { ...req.query, ...(typeof req.body === 'object' && req.body !== null ? req.body : {}) };
      if (typeof req.body === 'string') {
        try { body = { ...body, ...JSON.parse(req.body) }; } catch (e) {}
      }
      delete body.id;

      const allowedFields = [
        'rma_number', 'created_at', 'barcode', 'rma_type', 'status', 'notes', 'explanation', 'price', 'price_with_vat',
        'code', 'name', 'supplier_name', 'unit_name', 'quantity', 'reporter_name', 'reporter_contact', 'reported_by',
        'ae_name', 'ae_email', 'condition_grade', 'disposition', 'warehouse_location', 'inspected_by', 'inspected_at',
        'store_branch', 'invoice_dr_number', 'si_number', 'dr_number', 'po_number', 'expiry_date', 'batch_lot_number',
        'is_test', 'reorder_status', 'reorder_notes'
      ];

      const updateData = {};
      for (const field of allowedFields) {
        if (body && body[field] !== undefined) {
          updateData[field] = body[field];
        }
      }

      // Check lifecycle action (archive, trash, restore)
      const lifecycleAction = body?.lifecycle || body?.action || null;

      if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0 && !lifecycleAction && body?.workflow_resolution === undefined && body?.needs_reorder === undefined) {
        return sendJson(res, 400, {
          success: false,
          error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: 'No valid fields provided to update.'
        });
      }

      // Separate independent Reorder Status update from 4-Choice Outcome / Scrap lifecycle updates
      const rawStatusLower = updateData.status ? String(updateData.status).toLowerCase().trim() : '';
      const rawWorkflowResLower = body?.workflow_resolution !== undefined ? String(body.workflow_resolution).toLowerCase().trim() : '';
      const rawReorderLower = body?.reorder_status !== undefined ? String(body.reorder_status).toLowerCase().trim() : '';

      let requestedReorderUpdate = null; // 'reordered' | 'pending' | null
      if (rawReorderLower === 'reordered') {
        requestedReorderUpdate = 'reordered';
      } else if (rawReorderLower === 'pending' || rawReorderLower === 'pending_reorder') {
        requestedReorderUpdate = 'pending';
      } else if (rawStatusLower === 'reordered' || rawWorkflowResLower === 'reordered') {
        requestedReorderUpdate = 'reordered';
      }

      if (rawStatusLower === 'reordered') {
        delete updateData.status;
      }

      // Normalize status and disposition for restock, scrap, RTV & hold sync
      let requestedWorkflowResolution = null;
      let explicitResetWorkflow = false;
      if (updateData.status) {
        const s = String(updateData.status).toLowerCase().trim();
        if (s === 'restocked' || s === '6- restocked') {
          updateData.status = 'resolved';
          requestedWorkflowResolution = 'restocked';
        } else if (s === 'scrapped' || s === 'disposed' || s === '7- scrapped / disposed') {
          updateData.status = 'resolved';
          requestedWorkflowResolution = 'scrapped_no_reorder';
        } else if (s === 'pending' || s === 'under_inspection' || s === 'received_at_dock' || s === 'reopen' || s === 'reset') {
          updateData.status = (s === 'received_at_dock' || s === 'pending') ? 'pending' : 'under_inspection';
          explicitResetWorkflow = true;
        } else if (s === 'vendor_claimed' || s === '3- vendor claimed' || s === 'vendor_claim') {
          updateData.status = 'vendor_claimed';
          if (!updateData.disposition) updateData.disposition = '3- Return to Vendor (RTV)';
        } else if (s === 'quarantine' || s === 'hold' || s === '4- quarantine') {
          updateData.status = 'under_inspection';
          if (!updateData.disposition) updateData.disposition = '4- Quarantine';
        } else if (s === 'rejected' || s === '8- rejected' || s === 'claim_rejected') {
          updateData.status = 'rejected';
        } else if (s === 'resolved' || s === 'closed') {
          updateData.status = 'resolved';
          const d = String(updateData.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
          if (rawWorkflowResLower === 'restocked') {
            requestedWorkflowResolution = 'restocked';
          } else if (rawWorkflowResLower === 'scrapped_no_reorder' || d.includes('scrap') || d.includes('dispose')) {
            requestedWorkflowResolution = 'scrapped_no_reorder';
          } else if (d.includes('restock')) {
            requestedWorkflowResolution = 'restocked';
          }
        }
      } else if (rawWorkflowResLower === 'restocked' || rawWorkflowResLower === 'scrapped_no_reorder') {
        requestedWorkflowResolution = rawWorkflowResLower;
      }

      if (updateData.reason && !updateData.condition_grade) {
        updateData.condition_grade = mapReasonToConditionGrade(updateData.reason);
      }

      if (updateData.warehouse_location) {
        updateData.warehouse_location = normalizeWarehouseLocation(updateData.warehouse_location);
      }

      if (updateData.disposition) {
        const d = String(updateData.disposition).trim();
        if (d === 'Restock to Inventory' || d === '2- Restock to Inventory' || /restock/i.test(d)) {
          updateData.disposition = '2- Restock to Inventory';
          if (!updateData.warehouse_location) updateData.warehouse_location = 'Good Stock Area';
        } else if (d === 'Scrap / Dispose' || d === '5- Scrap / Dispose' || /scrap|dispose/i.test(d)) {
          updateData.disposition = '5- Scrap / Dispose';
          if (!updateData.warehouse_location) updateData.warehouse_location = 'Disposal / Scrap Area';
        } else if (d === 'Return to Vendor (RTV)' || d === '3- Return to Vendor (RTV)' || /rtv|vendor/i.test(d)) {
          updateData.disposition = '3- Return to Vendor (RTV)';
          if (!updateData.status) updateData.status = 'vendor_claimed';
          if (!updateData.warehouse_location) updateData.warehouse_location = 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)';
        } else if (d === 'Quarantine' || d === '4- Quarantine' || /quarantine|hold/i.test(d)) {
          updateData.disposition = '4- Quarantine';
          if (!updateData.status) updateData.status = 'under_inspection';
          if (!updateData.warehouse_location) updateData.warehouse_location = 'Hold / Inspection Area';
        }
      }

      // First, retrieve the matching record(s) so we can update audit trails & parent manifest items
      const { data: existingRows, error: findError } = await matchRma(
        supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*')
      );

      if (findError) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: findError.message });
      }

      if (!existingRows || existingRows.length === 0) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `RMA report ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      const actorName = String(body?.actor || body?.user || body?.updated_by || client.name || 'Coworker').trim();
      const targetBarcode = body?.barcode ? String(body.barcode).trim() : null;
      const cleanReorderPo = body?.po_number ? String(body.po_number).trim() : '';
      const cleanReorderNotes = body?.reorder_notes ? String(body.reorder_notes).trim() : '';

      // Standardized Audit Trail Note
      let auditNote = `RMA updated by ${actorName}`;
      if (requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered' && !requestedWorkflowResolution && !updateData.status) {
        auditNote = `Supplier Re-order confirmed by ${actorName}${cleanReorderPo ? ` (PO: ${cleanReorderPo})` : ''}`;
      } else if (requestedReorderUpdate === 'pending' && !requestedWorkflowResolution && !updateData.status) {
        auditNote = `Reorder status reset to Pending by ${actorName}`;
      } else if (requestedWorkflowResolution === 'restocked') {
        auditNote = `ERP Restock confirmed by ${actorName}`;
      } else if (requestedWorkflowResolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder') {
        auditNote = `Scrap written off by ${actorName}`;
      } else if (updateData.status === 'vendor_claimed') {
        auditNote = `Vendor RTV claim confirmed by ${actorName}`;
      } else if (updateData.status === 'quarantine' || (updateData.disposition && updateData.disposition.includes('Quarantine'))) {
        auditNote = `Item placed on Hold / Quarantine by ${actorName}${body?.hold_reason ? `: ${body.hold_reason}` : ''}`;
      } else if (existingRows.some(r => r.disposition?.includes('Quarantine') || r.status === 'quarantine')) {
        auditNote = `Hold released by ${actorName}`;
      }

      const lifecycleStageLabel = requestedWorkflowResolution === 'restocked'
        ? '6- Restocked'
        : requestedWorkflowResolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder'
        ? '7- Scrapped / Written Off'
        : updateData.status === 'vendor_claimed'
        ? '3- Vendor Claimed'
        : (updateData.status === 'quarantine' || updateData.disposition?.includes('Quarantine'))
        ? '4- Quarantine'
        : undefined;

      const auditEntry = {
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        stage: requestedReorderUpdate && !requestedWorkflowResolution && !updateData.status
          ? (requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered' ? 'SUPPLIER_REORDER' : 'SUPPLIER_REORDER_RESET')
          : requestedWorkflowResolution === 'restocked'
          ? 'ERP_RESTOCK'
          : requestedWorkflowResolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder'
          ? 'SCRAP_DISPOSAL'
          : updateData.status === 'vendor_claimed'
          ? 'VENDOR_RTV'
          : ((updateData.status === 'quarantine' || updateData.disposition?.includes('Quarantine')) ? 'HOLD_QUARANTINE' : 'API_PATCH'),
        actor: actorName,
        ...(updateData.status ? { status: updateData.status } : {}),
        ...(requestedReorderUpdate ? { reorder_status: requestedReorderUpdate } : {}),
        ...(cleanReorderPo ? { po_number: cleanReorderPo } : {}),
        lifecycle_stage: lifecycleStageLabel,
        warehouse_location: updateData.warehouse_location || undefined,
        hold_reason: body?.hold_reason || undefined,
        note: auditNote
      };

      const updatedRows = [];
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

      const explicitNeedsReorder = body?.needs_reorder !== undefined ? Boolean(body.needs_reorder) : undefined;
      const explicitHoldReason = body?.hold_reason ? String(body.hold_reason).trim() : undefined;
      const explicitRejectionReason = body?.rejection_reason ? String(body.rejection_reason).trim() : undefined;

      for (const row of existingRows) {
        const currentAudit = Array.isArray(row.audit_trail) ? [...row.audit_trail] : [];
        currentAudit.push(auditEntry);

        // Merge operational metadata safely into JSONB ai_document_metadata
        const currentMeta = (row.ai_document_metadata && typeof row.ai_document_metadata === 'object') ? row.ai_document_metadata : {};
        const prevReorder = (currentMeta.reorder && typeof currentMeta.reorder === 'object') ? currentMeta.reorder : {};
        const updatedMeta = {
          ...currentMeta,
          ...(explicitNeedsReorder !== undefined ? { needs_reorder: explicitNeedsReorder } : {}),
          ...(explicitHoldReason ? { hold_reason: explicitHoldReason } : {}),
          ...(explicitRejectionReason ? { rejection_reason: explicitRejectionReason } : {}),
          ...(requestedWorkflowResolution ? {
            workflow_resolution: requestedWorkflowResolution,
            resolved_at: nowIso,
            resolved_by: actorName
          } : {})
        };
        if (explicitResetWorkflow) {
          delete updatedMeta.workflow_resolution;
          delete updatedMeta.resolved_at;
          delete updatedMeta.resolved_by;
        }
        if (requestedReorderUpdate) {
          updatedMeta.reorder = requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered'
            ? {
                status: 'reordered',
                reordered_at: nowIso,
                reordered_by: actorName,
                po_number: cleanReorderPo || prevReorder.po_number || row.po_number || '',
                ...(cleanReorderNotes ? { notes: cleanReorderNotes } : (prevReorder.notes ? { notes: prevReorder.notes } : {}))
              }
            : {
                status: 'pending',
                reset_at: nowIso,
                reset_by: actorName,
                ...(cleanReorderPo ? { po_number: cleanReorderPo } : {}),
                ...(cleanReorderNotes ? { notes: cleanReorderNotes } : {})
              };
          if (String(updatedMeta.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase() === 'reordered') {
            delete updatedMeta.workflow_resolution;
            delete updatedMeta.resolved_at;
            delete updatedMeta.resolved_by;
          }
        }

        if (lifecycleAction === 'archive' || lifecycleAction === 'archived') {
          updatedMeta.is_archived = true;
          updatedMeta.is_trashed = false;
          updatedMeta.archived_at = new Date().toISOString();
          updatedMeta.archived_by = actorName;
        } else if (lifecycleAction === 'trash' || lifecycleAction === 'trashed') {
          updatedMeta.is_trashed = true;
          updatedMeta.is_archived = false;
          updatedMeta.trashed_at = new Date().toISOString();
          updatedMeta.trashed_by = actorName;
          updatedMeta.purge_after = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
        } else if (lifecycleAction === 'restore' || lifecycleAction === 'active') {
          delete updatedMeta.is_trashed;
          delete updatedMeta.trashed_at;
          delete updatedMeta.trashed_by;
          delete updatedMeta.purge_after;
          delete updatedMeta.is_archived;
          delete updatedMeta.archived_at;
          delete updatedMeta.archived_by;
        }

        // Handle Test Mode promotion or toggling (promote test record to live production safely)
        if (body?.is_test !== undefined) {
          const makeLive = body.is_test === false || body.is_test === 'false';
          if (makeLive) {
            delete updatedMeta.is_test;
            updateData.is_test = false;
          } else {
            updatedMeta.is_test = true;
            updateData.is_test = true;
          }
        }

        // Clean operational tags from notes (avoid raw internal tags showing to customers)
        let updatedNotes = row.notes || '';
        updatedNotes = updatedNotes
          .replace(/\[REORDER:\s*(YES|NO)\]/gi, '')
          .replace(/\[HOLD REASON:\s*[^\]]+\]/gi, '')
          .replace(/\[REJECTED:\s*[^\]]+\]/gi, '')
          .trim();

        if (body?.is_test === false || body?.is_test === 'false') {
          updatedNotes = updatedNotes.replace(/\[TEST_MODE\]/gi, '').trim();
        } else if (body?.is_test === true || body?.is_test === 'true') {
          if (!updatedNotes.includes('[TEST_MODE]')) {
            updatedNotes = `[TEST_MODE] ${updatedNotes}`.trim();
          }
        }

        let rowPayload = {
          ...updateData,
          audit_trail: currentAudit,
          ai_document_metadata: updatedMeta,
          notes: updatedNotes
        };

        // Ensure non-existent columns are never sent to Supabase
        delete rowPayload.needs_reorder;
        delete rowPayload.reorder_status;
        delete rowPayload.reorder_notes;
        delete rowPayload.hold_reason;
        delete rowPayload.rejection_reason;
        delete rowPayload.actor;
        delete rowPayload.user;
        delete rowPayload.updated_by;
        delete rowPayload.is_test;
        delete rowPayload.test_mode;
        if (!updateData.barcode) {
          delete rowPayload.barcode;
        }
        delete rowPayload.lifecycle;
        delete rowPayload.action;

        // If this row is a parent batch manifest, also update its child items inside row.items
        let parsedRowItems = [];
        if (Array.isArray(row.items) && row.items.length > 0) {
          parsedRowItems = [...row.items];
        } else if (typeof row.items === 'string' && row.items.trim()) {
          try {
            const p = JSON.parse(row.items);
            if (Array.isArray(p)) parsedRowItems = p;
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        const isStatusOrDispositionChange = Boolean(updateData.status || updateData.disposition || updateData.warehouse_location || requestedWorkflowResolution || explicitResetWorkflow);

        if (parsedRowItems.length > 0) {
          parsedRowItems = parsedRowItems.map(it => {
            const itBarcode = String(it.barcode || '').trim();
            const itDisp = String(it.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
            const matchesSpecificBarcode = targetBarcode && itBarcode === targetBarcode;
            const matchesQueueDisposition = !targetBarcode && (
              (requestedWorkflowResolution === 'restocked' && itDisp.includes('restock')) ||
              (requestedWorkflowResolution && (itDisp.includes('scrap') || itDisp.includes('dispose'))) ||
              (updateData.status === 'vendor_claimed' && (itDisp.includes('rtv') || itDisp.includes('vendor'))) ||
              (updateData.status === 'quarantine' && (itDisp.includes('quarantine') || itDisp.includes('hold'))) ||
              (!updateData.status)
            );

            if (matchesSpecificBarcode || matchesQueueDisposition) {
              return {
                ...it,
                ...(updateData.status !== undefined ? { status: updateData.status } : {}),
                ...(requestedWorkflowResolution ? { workflow_resolution: requestedWorkflowResolution } : {}),
                ...(updateData.warehouse_location !== undefined ? { warehouse_location: updateData.warehouse_location } : {}),
                ...(updateData.disposition !== undefined ? { disposition: updateData.disposition } : {}),
                ...(requestedReorderUpdate ? {
                  reorder_status: requestedReorderUpdate,
                  reordered_at: requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered' ? nowIso : null,
                  reordered_by: requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered' ? actorName : null,
                  reorder_po_number: updatedMeta.reorder?.po_number || it.reorder_po_number || null
                } : {})
              };
            }
            return it;
          });

          if (isStatusOrDispositionChange) {
            // Recompute parent manifest lifecycle status only when status/disposition/resolution actually changed
            let restockCnt = 0;
            let scrapCnt = 0;
            let pendingCnt = 0;
            parsedRowItems.forEach(it => {
              const d = String(it.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
              const st = String(it.status || '').toLowerCase();
              const res = it.workflow_resolution;
              if (st === 'resolved' && res === 'restocked') restockCnt += 1;
              else if (st === 'resolved' && res === 'scrapped_no_reorder') scrapCnt += 1;
              else if (st === 'restocked' || d.includes('restock')) restockCnt += 1;
              else if (st === 'scrapped' || d.includes('scrap') || d.includes('dispose')) scrapCnt += 1;
              else if (!d || d.includes('pending')) pendingCnt += 1;
            });
            if (restockCnt === parsedRowItems.length) {
              rowPayload.status = 'resolved';
              updatedMeta.workflow_resolution = 'restocked';
            } else if (scrapCnt === parsedRowItems.length) {
              rowPayload.status = 'resolved';
              updatedMeta.workflow_resolution = 'scrapped_no_reorder';
            } else if (pendingCnt === parsedRowItems.length) {
              rowPayload.status = 'under_inspection';
            } else {
              rowPayload.status = 'partially_completed';
            }
          }
          rowPayload.items = parsedRowItems;
        }

        const { data: updatedRow, error: updateErr } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update(rowPayload)
          .eq('id', row.id)
          .select('*')
          .single();

        if (updateErr) {
          console.error(`[API v1 RMA PATCH] Error updating row ${row.id}:`, updateErr);
        } else if (updatedRow) {
          const res = updatedRow.ai_document_metadata?.workflow_resolution || requestedWorkflowResolution;
          const reorderMetaOut = updatedRow.ai_document_metadata?.reorder || {};
          const computedReorderStatus = reorderMetaOut.status || (res === 'reordered' ? 'reordered' : 'pending');
          let calculatedStage = updatedRow.status;
          if (res === 'restocked') calculatedStage = '6- Restocked';
          else if (res === 'scrapped_no_reorder') calculatedStage = '7- Scrapped / Written Off';
          else if (updatedRow.status === 'vendor_claimed') calculatedStage = '3- Vendor Claimed';
          else if (updatedRow.status === 'under_inspection') calculatedStage = '3- Under Inspection';
          else if (updatedRow.status === 'pending' || updatedRow.status === 'received_at_dock') calculatedStage = '2- Received at Dock';
          else if (updatedRow.status === 'partially_completed') calculatedStage = 'Partially Completed';

          updatedRows.push({
            ...updatedRow,
            lifecycle_stage: calculatedStage,
            reorder_status: computedReorderStatus,
            reordered_at: reorderMetaOut.reordered_at || null,
            reordered_by: reorderMetaOut.reordered_by || null,
            reorder_po_number: reorderMetaOut.po_number || updatedRow.po_number || null
          });
        }

        // If this row is a child item inside a parent manifest (has parent_rma_id):
        if (row.parent_rma_id) {
          try {
            const { data: parentRecord } = await supabase
              .from('rma_reports')
              .select('id, items, audit_trail')
              .eq('id', row.parent_rma_id)
              .maybeSingle();

            if (parentRecord) {
              let parentItems = Array.isArray(parentRecord.items)
                ? parentRecord.items
                : (typeof parentRecord.items === 'string' ? JSON.parse(parentRecord.items || '[]') : []);

              let itemModified = false;
              parentItems = parentItems.map(it => {
                const matchBarcode = it.barcode && String(it.barcode).trim() === String(row.barcode).trim();
                const matchId = it.id && (String(it.id) === String(row.id) || String(it.id) === String(row.barcode));
                const matchName = it.name && it.name === row.name;

                if (matchBarcode || matchId || matchName) {
                  itemModified = true;
                  return {
                    ...it,
                    status: updateData.status !== undefined ? updateData.status : it.status,
                    warehouse_location: updateData.warehouse_location !== undefined ? updateData.warehouse_location : it.warehouse_location,
                    disposition: updateData.disposition !== undefined ? updateData.disposition : it.disposition,
                    condition_grade: updateData.condition_grade !== undefined ? updateData.condition_grade : it.condition_grade,
                    ...(requestedReorderUpdate ? {
                      reorder_status: requestedReorderUpdate,
                      reordered_at: requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered' ? nowIso : null,
                      reordered_by: requestedReorderUpdate === 'reordered' ? actorName : null,
                      reorder_po_number: updatedMeta.reorder?.po_number || it.reorder_po_number || null
                    } : {})
                  };
                }
                return it;
              });

              if (itemModified) {
                const parentAudit = Array.isArray(parentRecord.audit_trail) ? [...parentRecord.audit_trail] : [];
                parentAudit.push({
                  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                  stage: 'CHILD_ERP_SYNC',
                  actor: `${client.name} (API)`,
                  note: `${auditNote} for item "${row.name}"`
                });

                await supabase
                  .from('rma_reports')
                  .update({
                    items: parentItems,
                    audit_trail: parentAudit
                  })
                  .eq('id', parentRecord.id);
              }
            }
          } catch (parentErr) {
            console.warn('[API v1 RMA PATCH] Notice syncing parent manifest items:', parentErr.message);
          }

          // Also synchronize child row in rma_items if present
          try {
            const childUpdates = {
              status: updateData.status,
              warehouse_location: updateData.warehouse_location,
              disposition: updateData.disposition
            };
            if (row.id && /^\d+$/.test(String(row.id))) {
              await supabase.from('rma_items').update(childUpdates).eq('id', Number(row.id));
            } else if (row.barcode) {
              await supabase.from('rma_items').update(childUpdates).eq('barcode', String(row.barcode));
            }
          } catch (childErr) {
            // non-blocking
          }
        }
      }

      if (updatedRows.length === 0) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'UPDATE_FAILED', message: `Failed to update RMA record ${cleanId}.` });
      }

      const result = updatedRows.length === 1 ? updatedRows[0] : updatedRows;
      const rmaNum = updatedRows[0]?.rma_number;

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `RMA report ${rmaNum || cleanId} updated by ${client.name} (${updatedRows.length} item${updatedRows.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} updated).`,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // 3. DELETE: Remove RMA
  if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await matchRma(
        supabase.from('rma_reports').delete().select('id, rma_number, name')
      );

      if (error) {
        return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message });
      }

      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
        return sendJson(res, 404, { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `RMA report ${cleanId} not found.` });
      }

      const result = data.length === 1 ? data[0] : data;
      const rmaNum = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0]?.rma_number : data?.rma_number;

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        message: `RMA report ${rmaNum || cleanId} deleted by ${client.name} (${data.length} item${data.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} removed).`,
        deleted: result
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
}

import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { hashApiKey } from './keyUtils.js';

/**
 * Applies standard RFC CORS headers to the response.
 * Dynamically reflects caller origin when present to support browser clients (fetch/axios) with credentials.
 */
export function setCorsHeaders(res, req = null) {
  const origin = req?.headers?.origin;
  if (origin) {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
    res.setHeader('Vary', 'Origin');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  }
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT');
  res.setHeader(
    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers',
    'X-CSRF-Token, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Version, Content-Length, Content-MD5, Content-Type, Date, X-Api-Version, x-api-key, Authorization'
  );
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Max-Age', '86400');
}

/**
 * Standardized JSON response helper.
 */
export function sendJson(res, statusCode, body, req = null) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);
  return res.status(statusCode).json(body);
}

/**
 * Validates request API key against SHA-256 hashed keys in Supabase database.
 * Supports:
 *  - Header: x-api-key: sk_live_...
 *  - Header: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...
 * 
 * Returns client context { id, name, rateLimit, maskedKey } or throws/responds with 401/403.
 */
export async function requireApiKey(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.status(204).end();
    return null;
  }

  // 1. Extract raw key
  let rawKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];

  if (!rawKey && req.headers['authorization']) {
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
    if (authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      rawKey = authHeader.substring(7).trim();
    } else {
      rawKey = authHeader.trim();
    }
  }

  if (!rawKey || typeof rawKey !== 'string' || !rawKey.trim()) {
    sendJson(res, 401, {
      success: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized',
      code: 'MISSING_API_KEY',
      message: "Missing API key. Provide via 'x-api-key' header or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'."
    });
    return null;
  }

  // 2. Hash key using SHA-256
  const keyHash = hashApiKey(rawKey);

  // 3. Query Supabase
  try {
    const { data: keyRecord, error } = await supabase
      .from('api_keys')
      .select('*')
      .eq('key_hash', keyHash)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      console.error('[API Auth] Database query error:', error);
      sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'Internal Server Error',
        code: 'AUTH_DB_ERROR',
        message: 'Failed to verify API key against database.'
      });
      return null;
    }

    if (!keyRecord) {
      sendJson(res, 401, {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized',
        code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',
        message: 'The provided API key does not exist or is invalid.'
      });
      return null;
    }

    // 4. Check active status
    if (!keyRecord.is_active) {
      sendJson(res, 403, {
        success: false,
        error: 'Forbidden',
        code: 'KEY_REVOKED',
        message: 'This API key has been revoked and is inactive.'
      });
      return null;
    }

    // 5. Check expiration if configured
    if (keyRecord.expires_at) {
      const expiry = new Date(keyRecord.expires_at);
      if (expiry < new Date()) {
        sendJson(res, 403, {
          success: false,
          error: 'Forbidden',
          code: 'KEY_EXPIRED',
          message: `This API key expired on ${expiry.toISOString()}.`
        });
        return null;
      }
    }

    // 6. Asynchronously update last_used_at timestamp (fire and forget)
    supabase
      .from('api_keys')
      .update({ last_used_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', keyRecord.id)
      .then(() => {})
      .catch((err) => console.warn('[API Auth] Update last_used_at notice:', err));

    // 7. Inject client context into request
    const client = {
      id: keyRecord.id,
      name: keyRecord.name,
      rateLimit: keyRecord.rate_limit || 60,
      maskedKey: keyRecord.masked_key
    };

    req.client = client;
    return client;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[API Auth] Unexpected exception:', err);
    sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'Internal Server Error',
      code: 'AUTH_EXCEPTION',
      message: 'Unexpected authentication error.'
    });
    return null;
  }
}

import { supabase } from './supabase.js';

const KNOWN_ADMIN_EMAILS = new Map([
  ['finance2@keysysincorporated.com', 'super_admin'],
  ['alleli.almaida@ph.keysys.com', 'admin'],
  ['finance@a2z2go.net', 'admin'],
  ['accountspayable@keysysincorporated.com', 'admin'],
  ['finance4@keysysincorporated.com', 'admin'],
  ['mark.aquino@a2z2go.net', 'admin'],
  ['ralph.alido@a2z2go.net', 'admin'],
  ['mgan@pingconmarketing.com', 'admin']
]);

/**
 * Shared authorization helper for automated Cron / GitHub Actions & Admin triggers
 * without adding extra Vercel serverless endpoints.
 */
export async function authorizeCronOrAdmin(req) {
  const cronSecret = String(process.env.CRON_SECRET || '').trim();
  const authHeader = String(req.headers['authorization'] || req.headers['Authorization'] || '').trim();
  const bearerToken = authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.slice(7).trim() : '';
  const xCronSecret = String(req.headers['x-cron-secret'] || '').trim();

  if (cronSecret && (xCronSecret === cronSecret || bearerToken === cronSecret)) {
    return { authorized: true, callerType: 'cron', actor: 'Scheduled Cron Runner', role: 'cron' };
  }

  // When CRON_SECRET env var is unset on Vercel, trust Vercel's internal edge-stripped cron header
  if (!cronSecret && req.headers['x-vercel-cron'] === '1' && process.env.VERCEL === '1') {
    return { authorized: true, callerType: 'cron', actor: 'Vercel Cron Scheduler', role: 'cron' };
  }

  if (!bearerToken) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      status: 401,
      error: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
      message: 'Authentication required. Provide valid CRON_SECRET or Admin Bearer JWT.'
    };
  }

  const authLookupStart = Date.now();
  let { data: userData, error: userErr } = await supabase.auth.getUser(bearerToken);
  if (
    (userErr || !userData?.user?.email) &&
    (!userErr?.status || userErr.status >= 500) &&
    Date.now() - authLookupStart < 4000
  ) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
    const retry = await supabase.auth.getUser(bearerToken);
    userData = retry.data;
    userErr = retry.error;
  }
  const userEmail = String(userData?.user?.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (userErr || !userEmail) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      status: 401,
      error: 'INVALID_SESSION',
      message: 'Session token is invalid or expired. Please sign in again.'
    };
  }

  let empRow = null;
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('admin_users')
      .select('email, role, is_active')
      .eq('email', userEmail)
      .maybeSingle();
    empRow = data || null;
  } catch {}

  const role = empRow?.role || KNOWN_ADMIN_EMAILS.get(userEmail) || '';
  const isActive = empRow ? empRow.is_active !== false : KNOWN_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(userEmail);

  if (!isActive || !['super_admin', 'admin'].includes(role)) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      status: 403,
      error: 'FORBIDDEN',
      message: `Admin or Super Admin privileges required. Account (${userEmail}) has role "${role || 'none'}".`
    };
  }

  return { authorized: true, callerType: 'admin', actor: userEmail, role };
}
