function normalizeDirKey(name) {
  return String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function buildDirectoryLookupMap(rawDir) {
  const map = new Map();
  if (!Array.isArray(rawDir)) return map;
  for (const entry of rawDir) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') continue;
    const k = normalizeDirKey(entry.supplier_name || entry.supplierName);
    if (!k) continue;
    map.set(k, {
      emailToList: splitEmailStringOrList(entry.email_to || entry.supplier_email_to || ''),
      emailCcList: splitEmailStringOrList(entry.email_cc || entry.supplier_email_cc || '')
    });
  }
  return map;
}

async function safeUpdateRmaReport(reportId, updates) {
  let { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('rma_reports')
    .update(updates)
    .eq('id', reportId)
    .select();

  if (error) {
    const fallback = { ...updates };
    if (String(error.message || '').includes('rma_reports_status_check') && fallback.status) {
      fallback.status = 'under_inspection';
    }
    const retry = await supabase
      .from('rma_reports')
      .update(fallback)
      .eq('id', reportId)
      .select();
    if (retry.error) throw retry.error;
    data = retry.data;
  }

  return Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0 ? data[0] : null;
}

/**
 * Handles automated & manual 10-Calendar-Day Pickup Follow-Up emails and Auto-Dispose (>10 days).
 * Invoked via /api/send-email?action=daily-followup to stay within Vercel's 12-function cap.
 */
export async function handleDailyFollowUp(req, res, preParsedBody = null) {
  if (!['GET', 'POST'].includes(req.method)) {
    res.setHeader('Allow', 'GET, POST');
    return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method Not Allowed' });
  }

  const auth = await authorizeCronOrAdmin(req);
  if (!auth.authorized) {
    return res.status(auth.status).json({
      error: auth.error,
      message: auth.message
    });
  }

  const body = (preParsedBody && typeof preParsedBody === 'object')
    ? preParsedBody
    : (typeof req.body === 'string'
        ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(req.body); } catch { return {}; } })()
        : (req.body || {}));

  const operation = String(body.operation || req.query?.operation || 'run_all').trim().toLowerCase();
  const targetRmaNumber = String(body.rmaNumber || req.query?.rmaNumber || '').trim();
  const isTestMode =
    auth.callerType !== 'cron' &&
    Boolean(
      body.isTestMode === true ||
      body.isTestMode === 'true' ||
      req.query?.testMode === 'true' ||
      req.query?.test === '1' ||
      targetRmaNumber.toUpperCase().startsWith('TEST-')
    );
  const alsoSyncReplies = Boolean(
    req.query?.syncReplies === '1' ||
    req.query?.syncReplies === 'true' ||
    body.syncReplies === true
  );
  const force = Boolean(
    body.force === true ||
    body.force === 'true' ||
    req.query?.force === 'true' ||
    req.query?.force === '1'
  );
  const dryRun = Boolean(
    body.dryRun === true ||
    body.dryRun === 'true' ||
    req.query?.dryRun === 'true' ||
    req.query?.dryRun === '1'
  );
  const respectSchedule = Boolean(
    body.respectSchedule === true ||
    body.respectSchedule === 'true' ||
    req.query?.respectSchedule === 'true' ||
    req.query?.respectSchedule === '1'
  );

  const nowDate = new Date();
  const nowIso = nowDate.toISOString();
  const todayManila = getManilaDateYmd(nowDate);
  const currentHhmm = getManilaTimeHhmm(nowDate);

  // 1. Load configuration from rma_settings
  const settingsMap = new Map();
  try {
    const { data: settingsRows } = await supabase
      .from('rma_settings')
      .select('key, value')
      .in('key', [
        EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY,
        EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY,
        TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY,
        TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY,
        DAILY_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG_KEY,
        TEST_SANDBOX_EMAIL_KEY,
        SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_KEY
      ]);

    if (Array.isArray(settingsRows)) {
      for (const row of settingsRows) {
        if (row?.key) settingsMap.set(row.key, row.value);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[dailyFollowUpHandler] Failed to read rma_settings:', err?.message);
  }

  const sandboxEmail = normalizeSandboxEmail(
    body.sandboxEmail || settingsMap.get(TEST_SANDBOX_EMAIL_KEY) || DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL
  );

  const rawFollowUpCfg = settingsMap.get(DAILY_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG_KEY);
  const followUpConfig = {
    ...DEFAULT_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG,
    ...(rawFollowUpCfg && typeof rawFollowUpCfg === 'object' ? rawFollowUpCfg : {})
  };
  const autoEnabled = followUpConfig.autoEnabled !== false;
  const targetTimePht = normalizeTimeHhmm(followUpConfig.autoSendTimePht, '13:00');
  const customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled = Number(followUpConfig.defaultPolicyVersion || 0) >= 2
    ? followUpConfig.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled !== false
    : true;
  const testStepIntervalSeconds = normalizeTestStepIntervalSeconds(
    followUpConfig.testStepIntervalSeconds ?? DEFAULT_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG.testStepIntervalSeconds
  );
  const testAutoCronEnabled = Boolean(followUpConfig.testAutoCronEnabled) && testStepIntervalSeconds > 0;

  let replySyncSummary = null;
  if (alsoSyncReplies && !dryRun) {
    try {
      replySyncSummary = await syncEmailRepliesInternal({
        triggerSource: auth.callerType === 'cron' ? 'cron_followup_sweep' : 'admin_followup',
        caller: auth.actor
      });
    } catch (syncErr) {
      replySyncSummary = { success: false, error: syncErr?.message || 'Reply sync failed' };
    }
  }

  let liveSkipReason = null;
  if (respectSchedule && operation === 'run_all' && !force) {
    if (!autoEnabled) {
      liveSkipReason = 'AUTO_DISABLED';
    } else if (!hasReachedManilaSchedule(targetTimePht, nowDate)) {
      liveSkipReason = 'BEFORE_SCHEDULED_TIME';
    }
  }

  // Cron requests skip Live Lane if before 13:00 PHT or disabled, EXCEPT when Test Sandbox Auto-Cron is enabled with an accelerated speed
  const runLiveLane = auth.callerType === 'cron'
    ? !liveSkipReason
    : !isTestMode && !liveSkipReason;
  const runTestLane = auth.callerType === 'cron'
    ? testAutoCronEnabled
    : isTestMode && !liveSkipReason;

  if (!runLiveLane && !runTestLane && liveSkipReason) {
    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      skipped: true,
      reason: liveSkipReason,
      phtDate: todayManila,
      phtTime: currentHhmm,
      targetTimePht,
      testStepIntervalSeconds,
      testAutoCronEnabled,
      ...(replySyncSummary ? { emailReplySync: replySyncSummary } : {})
    });
  }

  // 2. Resolve recipient profiles
  const legacyRecipients = settingsMap.get(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY);
  const recipientsByType = settingsMap.get(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY);
  const defaultTo = Array.isArray(DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS?.to) ? DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS.to : [];
  const defaultCc = Array.isArray(DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS?.cc) ? DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS.cc : [];

  const newRmaProfile = recipientsByType?.new_rma || legacyRecipients || {};
  const rawNewRmaTo = splitEmailStringOrList(newRmaProfile?.to);
  const newRmaToList = rawNewRmaTo.length > 0 ? rawNewRmaTo : splitEmailStringOrList(defaultTo);
  const rawNewRmaCc = splitEmailStringOrList(newRmaProfile?.cc);
  const newRmaCcList = (rawNewRmaCc.length > 0 || rawNewRmaTo.length > 0 ? rawNewRmaCc : splitEmailStringOrList(defaultCc))
    .filter((e) => !newRmaToList.includes(e));

  const followUpProfile = recipientsByType?.supplier_followup || {};
  const followUpProfileTo = splitEmailStringOrList(followUpProfile?.to ?? followUpProfile?.toList);
  const followUpProfileCc = splitEmailStringOrList(followUpProfile?.cc ?? followUpProfile?.ccList);
  const directoryMap = buildDirectoryLookupMap(settingsMap.get(SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_KEY));

  // Isolated Test Mode recipient profiles (never leaks Live recipients or Live defaults)
  const testGlobalRecipients = settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY);
  const testRecipientsByType = (settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY) && typeof settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY) === 'object')
    ? settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY)
    : {};
  const resolveTestRecipients = (profileKey, { overrideTo = [], overrideCc = [] } = {}) => {
    const prof = testRecipientsByType?.[profileKey] || {};
    const profTo = splitEmailStringOrList(prof?.toList ?? prof?.toEmail ?? prof?.to);
    const profCc = splitEmailStringOrList(prof?.ccList ?? prof?.cc);
    const globTo = splitEmailStringOrList(testGlobalRecipients?.toList ?? testGlobalRecipients?.toEmail);
    const globCc = splitEmailStringOrList(testGlobalRecipients?.baseCcList ?? testGlobalRecipients?.ccList);

    const toList = overrideTo.length > 0
      ? overrideTo
      : profTo.length > 0
        ? profTo
        : globTo.length > 0
          ? globTo
          : [sandboxEmail];
    const ccSource = overrideTo.length > 0
      ? overrideCc
      : profTo.length > 0
        ? profCc
        : globTo.length > 0
          ? globCc
          : [];
    const ccList = Array.from(new Set(ccSource)).filter((e) => !toList.includes(e));
    return { toList, ccList };
  };

  // 3. Prepare SMTP transport if sending real emails
  let transporter = null;
  const gmailUser = String(process.env.GMAIL_USER || '').trim();
  const gmailPass = String(process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD || '').trim();
  if (!dryRun) {
    if (!gmailUser || !gmailPass) {
      return res.status(500).json({
        error: 'SMTP_NOT_CONFIGURED',
        message: 'Server email credentials (GMAIL_USER / GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) are missing.'
      });
    }
    transporter = createSmtpTransport();
  }

  // 4. Fetch reports (targeted single-RMA lookup when rmaNumber is specified) + catalog products
  const buildReportsQuery = () => {
    const q = supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*');
    if (targetRmaNumber) {
      return q.ilike('rma_number', targetRmaNumber);
    }
    return q.order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  };

  const [reportsRes, productsRes] = await Promise.all([
    buildReportsQuery(),
    supabase
      .from('products')
      .select('*')
  ]);

  if (reportsRes.error) {
    return res.status(500).json({
      error: 'DB_QUERY_FAILED',
      message: reportsRes.error.message || 'Failed to query rma_reports'
    });
  }

  let allRows = Array.isArray(reportsRes.data) ? reportsRes.data : [];
  if (targetRmaNumber && allRows.length > 0) {
    const parentIds = allRows.map((r) => r.id).filter(Boolean);
    if (parentIds.length > 0) {
      const { data: childRows } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .select('*')
        .in('parent_rma_id', parentIds);
      if (Array.isArray(childRows) && childRows.length > 0) {
        const seen = new Set(allRows.map((r) => r.id));
        for (const c of childRows) {
          if (!seen.has(c.id)) allRows.push(c);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const catalogProducts = Array.isArray(productsRes.data) ? productsRes.data : [];

  const activeRows = allRows.filter((r) => !isTrashedRecord(r) && !isArchivedRecord(r));

  const followUpsSent = [];
  const autoDisposed = [];
  const skippedItems = [];
  const errors = [];

  const executeFollowUpLane = async (laneIsTestMode) => {
    const laneStepSeconds = laneIsTestMode ? testStepIntervalSeconds : 0;
    const candidates = activeRows.filter((r) => {
      if (isManifestSubItem(r, activeRows)) return false;
      if (targetRmaNumber) {
        const matchesNum = String(r.rma_number || '').trim().toUpperCase() === targetRmaNumber.toUpperCase();
        if (!matchesNum) return false;
        if (auth.callerType === 'cron') return Boolean(isTestRecord(r)) === Boolean(laneIsTestMode);
        return true;
      }
      return Boolean(isTestRecord(r)) === Boolean(laneIsTestMode);
    });

    for (const report of candidates) {
      const rmaNumber = report.rma_number || String(report.id);
      const effectiveTestRecord = Boolean(laneIsTestMode || isTestRecord(report));
      const wf = computeFourStepWorkflow(report, catalogProducts, {
        now: nowDate,
        customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled,
        testStepIntervalSeconds: effectiveTestRecord ? laneStepSeconds : 0
      });

      if (wf.isClosed) {
        if (targetRmaNumber) {
          skippedItems.push({ rmaNumber, reason: 'CASE_ALREADY_CLOSED' });
        }
        continue;
      }

      // Check Auto-Dispose (> 10 days or > 10 simulated intervals in accelerated Test Mode) first
      if (wf.isExpiredAfter10Days && !wf.isAutoDisposed) {
        const existingMeta = (report.ai_document_metadata && typeof report.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
          ? report.ai_document_metadata
          : {};
        const prevFollowUp = (existingMeta.follow_up && typeof existingMeta.follow_up === 'object')
          ? existingMeta.follow_up
          : {};

        const nextMeta = {
          ...existingMeta,
          workflow_resolution: 'scrapped_no_reorder',
          resolved_at: nowIso,
          simple_rtv_disposition: '5- Scrap / Dispose',
          follow_up: {
            ...prevFollowUp,
            enabled: false,
            started_at: wf.startedAtIso,
            auto_disposed_at: nowIso,
            case_closed_at: nowIso,
            case_status: 'auto_disposed_after_10_days'
          }
        };

        const simDisposeSuffix = wf.isAcceleratedTestSla
          ? ` [Simulated >10 Days @ ${wf.testStepIntervalSeconds}s/day]`
          : '';
        const existingAudit = Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? report.audit_trail : [];
        const nextAudit = [
          ...existingAudit,
          {
            timestamp: nowIso,
            action: 'AUTO_DISPOSED_AFTER_10_DAYS',
            stage: 'RESOLVED',
            actor: auth.actor || '10-Day SLA Auto-Dispose',
            note: `Auto-disposed on ${todayManila} after >${FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS} ${wf.isAcceleratedTestSla ? 'simulated ' : 'calendar '}days (${wf.calendarDay} days elapsed without pickup)${simDisposeSuffix}`
          }
        ];

        const updatedReportPreview = {
          ...report,
          status: 'resolved',
          disposition: '5- Scrap / Dispose',
          warehouse_location: 'Disposal / Scrap Area',
          ai_document_metadata: nextMeta,
          updated_at: nowIso,
          audit_trail: nextAudit
        };

        const emailPayload = buildAutoDisposedEmailContent({
          report: updatedReportPreview,
          allReports: activeRows,
          catalogProducts,
          workflow: wf,
          isTestMode: effectiveTestRecord,
          sandboxEmail,
          now: nowDate
        });

        const testDisposeRec = effectiveTestRecord ? resolveTestRecipients('new_rma') : null;
        const finalTo = effectiveTestRecord ? testDisposeRec.toList : newRmaToList;
        const finalCc = effectiveTestRecord
          ? testDisposeRec.ccList
          : Array.from(new Set([...newRmaCcList, ...(wf.party.aeEmail ? [wf.party.aeEmail] : [])]))
              .filter((e) => !finalTo.includes(e));

        try {
          if (!dryRun) {
            await safeUpdateRmaReport(report.id, {
              status: 'resolved',
              disposition: '5- Scrap / Dispose',
              warehouse_location: 'Disposal / Scrap Area',
              ai_document_metadata: nextMeta,
              updated_at: nowIso,
              audit_trail: nextAudit
            });

            try {
              await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .update({
                  status: 'resolved',
                  disposition: '5- Scrap / Dispose',
                  warehouse_location: 'Disposal / Scrap Area'
                })
                .eq('parent_rma_id', report.id);
            } catch {}

            if (finalTo.length > 0 && transporter) {
              await transporter.sendMail({
                from: `Pingcon Marketing RMA <${gmailUser}>`,
                to: finalTo.join(', '),
                ...(finalCc.length > 0 ? { cc: finalCc.join(', ') } : {}),
                subject: emailPayload.subject,
                html: emailPayload.html,
                text: emailPayload.text
              });
            }
          }

          autoDisposed.push({
            rmaNumber,
            supplierName: wf.party.supplierName,
            calendarDay: wf.calendarDay,
            isAcceleratedTestSla: wf.isAcceleratedTestSla,
            testStepIntervalSeconds: wf.testStepIntervalSeconds,
            to: finalTo,
            cc: finalCc,
            subject: emailPayload.subject,
            dryRun
          });
        } catch (err) {
          errors.push({ rmaNumber, step: 'auto_dispose', message: err?.message || 'Failed auto-dispose' });
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (operation === 'check_dispose_only') {
        continue;
      }

      if (!wf.isCountdownActive || wf.calendarDay > FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS) {
        if (targetRmaNumber) {
          skippedItems.push({
            rmaNumber,
            reason: !wf.followUpEnabled ? 'FOLLOW_UP_DISABLED' : 'OUTSIDE_COUNTDOWN_WINDOW'
          });
        }
        continue;
      }

      // In Accelerated Test Mode, wait cleanly until simulated Day 1 arrives (unless force=true for single-item inspection)
      if (wf.isAcceleratedTestSla && wf.calendarDay === 0 && !force) {
        skippedItems.push({
          rmaNumber,
          reason: 'WAITING_FOR_SIMULATED_DAY_1',
          nextStepInSeconds: wf.nextStepInSeconds
        });
        continue;
      }

      if (wf.alreadySentToday && !force) {
        skippedItems.push({
          rmaNumber,
          reason: wf.isAcceleratedTestSla ? 'ALREADY_SENT_SIMULATED_STEP' : 'ALREADY_SENT_TODAY',
          lastSentPhtDate: wf.lastSentPhtDate,
          lastSentSimDay: wf.lastSentSimDay
        });
        continue;
      }

      const dirContact = (!isMixedSuppliersSummary(wf.party.supplierName) && directoryMap.get(normalizeDirKey(wf.party.supplierName))) || null;
      const itemSuppliers = Array.isArray(report.items) ? extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems(report.items) : [];
      const itemDirTo = [];
      const itemDirCc = [];
      const perItemTo = [];
      const perItemCc = [];
      if (Array.isArray(report.items)) {
        for (const it of report.items) {
          splitEmailStringOrList(it?.supplier_email_to ?? it?.email_to).forEach((e) => perItemTo.push(e));
          splitEmailStringOrList(it?.supplier_email_cc ?? it?.email_cc).forEach((e) => perItemCc.push(e));
        }
      }
      for (const sup of itemSuppliers) {
        const match = directoryMap.get(normalizeDirKey(sup));
        if (match) {
          match.emailToList.forEach((e) => itemDirTo.push(e));
          match.emailCcList.forEach((e) => itemDirCc.push(e));
        }
      }
      const overrideTo = splitEmailStringOrList(body.overrideToEmail);
      const aggregatedSupplierTo = Array.from(new Set([
        ...wf.party.toEmails,
        ...perItemTo,
        ...(dirContact?.emailToList || []),
        ...itemDirTo
      ]));
      const liveTo = overrideTo.length > 0
        ? overrideTo
        : (aggregatedSupplierTo.length > 0 ? aggregatedSupplierTo : followUpProfileTo);

      if (!effectiveTestRecord && liveTo.length === 0) {
        skippedItems.push({ rmaNumber, reason: 'NO_SUPPLIER_EMAIL' });
        continue;
      }

      const testFollowUpRec = effectiveTestRecord
        ? resolveTestRecipients('supplier_followup', {
            overrideTo: body.isTestModeExplicitRecipients ? splitEmailStringOrList(body.toList ?? body.to) : overrideTo,
            overrideCc: body.isTestModeExplicitRecipients ? splitEmailStringOrList(body.ccList ?? body.cc) : []
          })
        : null;

      const finalTo = effectiveTestRecord ? testFollowUpRec.toList : liveTo;
      const finalCc = effectiveTestRecord
        ? testFollowUpRec.ccList
        : Array.from(
            new Set([
              ...wf.party.ccEmails,
              ...perItemCc,
              ...(dirContact?.emailCcList || []),
              ...itemDirCc,
              ...followUpProfileTo,
              ...followUpProfileCc,
              ...(wf.party.aeEmail ? [wf.party.aeEmail] : [])
            ])
          ).filter((e) => !finalTo.includes(e));

      const emailPayload = buildFollowUpEmailContent({
        report,
        allReports: activeRows,
        catalogProducts,
        workflow: wf,
        isTestMode: effectiveTestRecord,
        sandboxEmail,
        now: nowDate
      });

      try {
        if (!dryRun) {
          if (transporter && finalTo.length > 0) {
            await transporter.sendMail({
              from: `Pingcon Marketing RMA <${gmailUser}>`,
              to: finalTo.join(', '),
              ...(finalCc.length > 0 ? { cc: finalCc.join(', ') } : {}),
              subject: emailPayload.subject,
              html: emailPayload.html,
              text: emailPayload.text
            });
          }

          const existingMeta = (report.ai_document_metadata && typeof report.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
            ? report.ai_document_metadata
            : {};
          const prevFollowUp = (existingMeta.follow_up && typeof existingMeta.follow_up === 'object')
            ? existingMeta.follow_up
            : {};

          const prevSimDays = Array.isArray(prevFollowUp.sent_sim_days) ? prevFollowUp.sent_sim_days : [];
          const sameSimCfg = Number(prevFollowUp.last_sent_sim_interval_sec || 0) === wf.testStepIntervalSeconds;
          const nextSimDays = wf.isAcceleratedTestSla
            ? Array.from(new Set([...(sameSimCfg ? prevSimDays : []), wf.calendarDay])).slice(-15)
            : prevSimDays;

          const nextMeta = {
            ...existingMeta,
            follow_up: {
              ...prevFollowUp,
              enabled: true,
              started_at: wf.startedAtIso,
              last_sent_at: nowIso,
              last_sent_pht_date: todayManila,
              last_sent_day: wf.calendarDay,
              ...(wf.isAcceleratedTestSla ? {
                last_sent_sim_day: wf.calendarDay,
                last_sent_sim_interval_sec: wf.testStepIntervalSeconds,
                sent_sim_days: nextSimDays
              } : {}),
              sent_count: wf.sentCount + 1
            }
          };

          const simNoteTag = wf.isAcceleratedTestSla
            ? ` [Simulated @ ${wf.testStepIntervalSeconds}s/day]`
            : '';
          const existingAudit = Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? report.audit_trail : [];
          const nextAudit = [
            ...existingAudit,
            {
              timestamp: nowIso,
              action: 'FOLLOWUP_EMAIL_SENT',
              stage: 'FOLLOW_UP',
              actor: auth.actor || 'Daily Follow-Up Scheduler',
              note: `Sent Day ${wf.calendarDay} of ${FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS} follow-up to ${finalTo.join(', ')}${finalCc.length ? ` (CC: ${finalCc.join(', ')})` : ''}${simNoteTag}`
            }
          ];

          await safeUpdateRmaReport(report.id, {
            ai_document_metadata: nextMeta,
            updated_at: nowIso,
            audit_trail: nextAudit
          });
        }

        followUpsSent.push({
          rmaNumber,
          supplierName: wf.party.supplierName,
          calendarDay: wf.calendarDay,
          isAcceleratedTestSla: wf.isAcceleratedTestSla,
          testStepIntervalSeconds: wf.testStepIntervalSeconds,
          to: finalTo,
          cc: finalCc,
          subject: emailPayload.subject,
          dryRun
        });
      } catch (err) {
        errors.push({ rmaNumber, step: 'send_followup', message: err?.message || 'Failed sending follow-up' });
      }
    }

    return candidates.length;
  };

  let candidatesScanned = 0;
  if (runLiveLane) {
    candidatesScanned += await executeFollowUpLane(false);
  }
  if (runTestLane) {
    candidatesScanned += await executeFollowUpLane(true);
  }

  return res.status(200).json({
    success: errors.length === 0,
    dryRun,
    skipped: false,
    ...(liveSkipReason ? { liveSkipped: true, liveSkipReason } : {}),
    operation,
    phtDate: todayManila,
    phtTime: currentHhmm,
    targetTimePht,
    isTestMode: Boolean(isTestMode || (runTestLane && !runLiveLane)),
    testStepIntervalSeconds,
    testAutoCronEnabled,
    sandboxEmail,
    caller: auth.actor,
    summary: {
      scanned: candidatesScanned,
      followUpsSent: followUpsSent.length,
      autoDisposed: autoDisposed.length,
      skippedCount: skippedItems.length,
      errorCount: errors.length
    },
    followUpsSent,
    autoDisposed,
    skippedItems,
    errors,
    ...(replySyncSummary ? { emailReplySync: replySyncSummary } : {})
  });
}

--- END FILE: api/_lib/dailyFollowUpHandler.js ---

--- START FILE: api/_lib/dailyMatrixEmailHandler.js ---
import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from './auth.js';
import { authorizeCronOrAdmin } from './cronAuth.js';
import {
  createSmtpTransport,
  formatTestEmailSubject,
  escapeEmailHtml,
  getDiagnosticHelp,
  DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS,
  DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL,
  normalizeSandboxEmail
} from './smtpMailer.js';
import {
  buildRmaMatrixXlsxBytes,
  toManilaDateKey,
  formatManilaHhmm,
  formatManilaTimestampDisplay
} from '../../src/utils/exportMatrixXlsx.js';
import { isTestRecord, formatSaveFileTimestamp } from '../../src/utils/rmaHelpers.js';
import {
  normalizeTimeHhmm,
  formatTime12hFromHhmm,
  hasReachedManilaSchedule,
  getManilaTimeHhmm
} from '../../src/utils/followUpWorkflow.js';

const EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY = 'email_recipients';
const EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY = 'email_recipients_by_type';
const TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY = 'test_email_recipients';
const TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY = 'test_email_recipients_by_type';
const DAILY_MATRIX_CONFIG_KEY = 'daily_matrix_config';
const LAST_SENT_PHT_KEY = 'daily_matrix_last_sent_pht_date';
const TEST_SANDBOX_EMAIL_KEY = 'test_sandbox_email';

function splitEmailList(raw) {
  if (!raw) return [];
  const arr = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : String(raw).split(/[,;\s]+/);
  const unique = new Set();
  for (const entry of arr) {
    const clean = String(entry || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (clean && clean.includes('@') && clean.includes('.') && !clean.endsWith('.test')) {
      unique.add(clean);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(unique);
}

function sanitizeYmd(val) {
  const s = String(val || '').trim();
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) ? s : '';
}

function subtractCalendarDaysYmd(ymd, days) {
  const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
  const utc = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
  utc.setUTCDate(utc.getUTCDate() - days);
  return utc.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

  generatedManila,
  filename,
  toEmail,
  ccList,
  isTestMode,
  triggeredBy,
  sandboxEmail = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL,
  targetTimePht = '13:00'
}) {
  const {
    lineCount,
    monitoredSkuCount,
    grandTotalPcs,
    totalBadStockPcs,
    totalGoodStockPcs,
    grandTotalValue
  } = dataset;

  return `

        .container { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }
        .header { background: ${isTestMode ? '#92400e' : '#065f46'}; padding: 24px 28px; color: #ffffff; }
        .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; }
        .content { padding: 26px; }
        .kpi-grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 8px; margin: 12px 0 18px; }
        .kpi-box { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center; }
        .kpi-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
        .kpi-val { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 4px; }
        .meta-card { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #334155; }
        .footer { background: #f1f5f9; padding: 14px 24px; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
      </style>
    </head>
    <body>
      <div class="container">
        <div class="header">
          <span class="badge">${isTestMode ? '[TEST] DAILY MATRIX SANDBOX' : `DAILY ${escapeEmailHtml(formatTime12hFromHhmm(targetTimePht))} PHT REPORT`}</span>
          <h1 class="title">${isTestMode ? '[TEST] ' : ''}Daily Overall RMA Matrix Report</h1>
          <div style="font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 4px;">
            Customer Hub + Supplier RTV Combined Rolling Summary
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="content">
          ${isTestMode ? `
          <div style="background: #fef3c7; border: 2px dashed #f59e0b; color: #92400e; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;">
            [TEST] Sandbox Simulation Run — Routed exclusively to ${escapeEmailHtml(toEmail)}${ccList.length > 0 ? ` (CC: ${escapeEmailHtml(ccList.join(', '))})` : ''} (Sandbox: ${escapeEmailHtml(sandboxEmail)}). Live recipients bypassed.
          </div>` : ''}

          <div style="background: #ecfdf5; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; color: #065f46; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;">
            📎 Attached Excel Workbook: <span style="font-family: monospace;">${escapeEmailHtml(filename)}</span>

}

export async function handleDailyMatrixEmail(req, res, payload = {}) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'POST') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, {
      success: false,
      error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
      message: 'Use GET (Vercel Cron) or POST (Manual Admin Dispatch).'
    }, req);
  }

  const caller = await authorizeCronOrAdmin(req);
  if (!caller.authorized) {
    return sendJson(res, caller.status, {
      success: false,
      error: caller.error,
      message: caller.message
    }, req);
  }

  const body = (payload && typeof payload === 'object') ? payload : {};
  const force = req.query?.force === 'true' || req.query?.force === '1' || body.force === true;
  const dryRun = req.query?.dryRun === 'true' || req.query?.dryRun === '1' || body.dryRun === true;
  const respectSchedule = req.query?.respectSchedule === 'true' || req.query?.respectSchedule === '1' || body.respectSchedule === true;
  const includeAttachmentBase64 =
    req.query?.includeAttachmentBase64 === 'true' ||
    req.query?.includeAttachmentBase64 === '1' ||
    body.includeAttachmentBase64 === true;

  // Cron schedule strictly runs in Live Mode; manual admin run can explicitly request Test Sandbox
  const requestedTestMode =
    caller.callerType !== 'cron' &&
    Boolean(body.isTestMode === true || req.query?.isTestMode === 'true' || req.query?.mode === 'test');

  const todayManila = toManilaDateKey(new Date());
  const requestedStartDate = sanitizeYmd(body.startDate || req.query?.startDate);
  const requestedEndDate = sanitizeYmd(body.endDate || req.query?.endDate);
  const requestedStreamRaw = String(body.stream || req.query?.stream || '').trim();

  try {
    // 1. Read global recipients, per-type email profiles, matrix schedule config, and last daily cron marker from rma_settings
    const { data: settingsRows, error: settingsErr } = await supabase
      .from('rma_settings')
      .select('key, value')
      .in('key', [
        EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY,
        EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY,
        TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY,
        TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY,
        DAILY_MATRIX_CONFIG_KEY,
        LAST_SENT_PHT_KEY,
        TEST_SANDBOX_EMAIL_KEY
      ]);

    if (settingsErr) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'SETTINGS_QUERY_FAILED',
        message: settingsErr.message
      }, req);
    }

    const settingsMap = new Map((settingsRows || []).map((row) => [row.key, row.value]));
    const savedRecipients = settingsMap.get(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY);
    const profilesByType = (settingsMap.get(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY) && typeof settingsMap.get(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY) === 'object')
      ? settingsMap.get(EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY)
      : {};
    const testSavedRecipients = settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_KEY);
    const testProfilesByType = (settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY) && typeof settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY) === 'object')
      ? settingsMap.get(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_BY_TYPE_KEY)
      : {};
    const matrixConfig = (settingsMap.get(DAILY_MATRIX_CONFIG_KEY) && typeof settingsMap.get(DAILY_MATRIX_CONFIG_KEY) === 'object')
      ? settingsMap.get(DAILY_MATRIX_CONFIG_KEY)
      : {};
    const sandboxEmail = normalizeSandboxEmail(
      body.sandboxEmail || settingsMap.get(TEST_SANDBOX_EMAIL_KEY) || DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL
    );
    const autoEnabled = matrixConfig.autoEnabled !== false;
    const targetTimePht = normalizeTimeHhmm(matrixConfig.autoSendTimePht, '13:00');
    const lastSentPhtDate = String(settingsMap.get(LAST_SENT_PHT_KEY) || '').trim();

    if (respectSchedule && !force && !dryRun && !requestedTestMode) {
      const currentPhtTime = getManilaTimeHhmm(new Date());
      if (!autoEnabled) {
        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          skipped: true,
          reason: 'AUTO_DISABLED',
          phtDate: todayManila,
          phtTime: currentPhtTime,
          targetTimePht
        }, req);
      }
      if (!hasReachedManilaSchedule(targetTimePht, new Date())) {
        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          skipped: true,
          reason: 'BEFORE_SCHEDULED_TIME',
          phtDate: todayManila,
          phtTime: currentPhtTime,
          targetTimePht
        }, req);
      }
    }

    if (!force && !dryRun && !requestedTestMode && lastSentPhtDate === todayManila) {
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        skipped: true,
        reason: 'ALREADY_SENT_TODAY',
        phtDate: todayManila,
        message: `Daily Overall RMA Matrix already dispatched for Manila date ${todayManila}.`
      }, req);
    }

    const explicitZeroFlag = body.includeZeroCatalogSkus !== undefined
      ? body.includeZeroCatalogSkus
      : (req.query?.includeZeroCatalogSkus !== undefined ? req.query.includeZeroCatalogSkus === 'true' : undefined);
    const resolvedIncludeZero = explicitZeroFlag !== undefined
      ? Boolean(explicitZeroFlag)
      : Boolean(matrixConfig.includeZeroCatalogSkus);

    const hasExplicitDateOverride = Boolean(requestedStartDate && requestedEndDate);
    const explicitAllFlag = body.includeAllRecords !== undefined
      ? Boolean(body.includeAllRecords)
      : (req.query?.includeAllRecords !== undefined ? req.query.includeAllRecords === 'true' : undefined);
    const useAllRecords = !hasExplicitDateOverride && (
      explicitAllFlag !== undefined
        ? explicitAllFlag
        : (Number(matrixConfig.defaultPolicyVersion || 0) >= 2 ? matrixConfig.includeAllRecords !== false : true)
    );

    const validStreams = ['overall', 'customer_inbound', 'supplier_outbound'];
    const resolvedStream = validStreams.includes(requestedStreamRaw)
      ? requestedStreamRaw
      : (validStreams.includes(matrixConfig.stream) ? matrixConfig.stream : 'overall');

    // 2. Query Live or Test records in parallel (strictly isolated via isTestRecord)
    const [reportsRes, productsRes, memosRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('products').select('*'),
      supabase.from('credit_memos').select('*')
    ]);

    if (reportsRes.error) {
      return sendJson(res, 500, {
        success: false,
        error: 'REPORTS_QUERY_FAILED',
        message: reportsRes.error.message
      }, req);
    }

    const allReports = Array.isArray(reportsRes.data) ? reportsRes.data : [];
    const allProducts = Array.isArray(productsRes.data) ? productsRes.data : [];
    const allMemos = Array.isArray(memosRes.data) ? memosRes.data : [];

    const scopedReports = allReports.filter((r) => Boolean(isTestRecord(r)) === requestedTestMode);
    const scopedMemos = allMemos.filter((m) => Boolean(isTestRecord(m)) === requestedTestMode);

    // Resolve date window: explicit request override -> All Records (Start to Finish) -> saved matrixConfig (custom or rollingDays)
    let endDate = requestedEndDate;
    let startDate = requestedStartDate;
    if (useAllRecords) {
      const dateCandidates = scopedReports
        .map((r) => toManilaDateKey(r?.created_at || r?.updated_at))
        .filter((d) => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d))
        .sort();
      startDate = startDate || dateCandidates[0] || todayManila;
      const latestYmd = dateCandidates[dateCandidates.length - 1] || todayManila;
      endDate = endDate || (latestYmd > todayManila ? latestYmd : todayManila);
    } else if (!startDate || !endDate) {
      if (matrixConfig.rangeMode === 'custom' && sanitizeYmd(matrixConfig.startDate) && sanitizeYmd(matrixConfig.endDate)) {
        startDate = startDate || sanitizeYmd(matrixConfig.startDate);
        endDate = endDate || sanitizeYmd(matrixConfig.endDate);
      } else {
        const rollingDays = Math.max(1, Math.min(365, parseInt(body.rollingDays ?? req.query?.rollingDays ?? matrixConfig.rollingDays, 10) || 14));
        endDate = endDate || todayManila;
        startDate = startDate || subtractCalendarDaysYmd(endDate, rollingDays - 1);
      }
    }

    // 3. Build identical Microsoft Excel-valid OOXML .xlsx buffer used in browser download
    const { bytes, dataset } = buildRmaMatrixXlsxBytes({
      reports: scopedReports,
      catalogProducts: allProducts,
      creditMemos: scopedMemos,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      stream: resolvedStream,
      isTestMode: requestedTestMode,
      includeAllRecords: useAllRecords,
      includeZeroCatalogSkus: resolvedIncludeZero
    });

    // Resolve recipients strictly isolated by Live vs Test Mode
    let finalTo = sandboxEmail;
    let finalToList = [sandboxEmail];
    let finalCc = [];

    if (requestedTestMode) {
      const testAutoProfile = testProfilesByType?.daily_matrix_auto;
      const testManualProfile = testProfilesByType?.manual_matrix;
      const activeTestProfile = caller.callerType === 'cron'
        ? (testAutoProfile || testManualProfile)
        : (testManualProfile || testAutoProfile);

      const hasExplicitTestOverride = Boolean(body.isTestModeExplicitRecipients) && caller.callerType !== 'cron';
      const reqTestToOverride = hasExplicitTestOverride ? splitEmailList(body.toList ?? body.to) : [];
      const testProfileToList = splitEmailList(activeTestProfile?.toList ?? activeTestProfile?.toEmail);
      const testGlobalToList = splitEmailList(testSavedRecipients?.toList ?? testSavedRecipients?.toEmail);

      const resolvedTestToList = reqTestToOverride.length > 0
        ? reqTestToOverride
        : testProfileToList.length > 0
          ? testProfileToList
          : testGlobalToList.length > 0
            ? testGlobalToList
            : [sandboxEmail];

      const hasExplicitTestCc = hasExplicitTestOverride && (body.cc !== undefined || body.ccList !== undefined);
      const rawTestCcSource = hasExplicitTestCc
        ? (body.ccList ?? body.cc)
        : (activeTestProfile && Array.isArray(activeTestProfile.ccList))
          ? activeTestProfile.ccList
          : Array.isArray(testSavedRecipients?.baseCcList)
            ? testSavedRecipients.baseCcList
            : Array.isArray(testSavedRecipients?.ccList)
              ? testSavedRecipients.ccList
              : [];

      const testToSet = new Set(resolvedTestToList);
      finalCc = splitEmailList(rawTestCcSource).filter((e) => !testToSet.has(e));
      finalToList = resolvedTestToList;
      finalTo = resolvedTestToList.join(', ');
    } else {
      const autoProfile = profilesByType?.daily_matrix_auto;
      const manualProfile = profilesByType?.manual_matrix;
      const activeProfile = caller.callerType === 'cron'
        ? (autoProfile || manualProfile)
        : (manualProfile || autoProfile);

      const reqToOverride = caller.callerType !== 'cron' ? splitEmailList(body.toList ?? body.to) : [];
      const profileToList = splitEmailList(activeProfile?.toList ?? activeProfile?.toEmail);
      const matrixCfgToList = splitEmailList(matrixConfig?.toList ?? matrixConfig?.toEmail);
      const globalToList = splitEmailList(savedRecipients?.toList ?? savedRecipients?.toEmail);

      const configuredToList = reqToOverride.length > 0
        ? reqToOverride
        : profileToList.length > 0
          ? profileToList
          : matrixCfgToList.length > 0
            ? matrixCfgToList
            : globalToList.length > 0
              ? globalToList
              : [DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS.toEmail];

      const hasExplicitCcOverride = caller.callerType !== 'cron' && (body.cc !== undefined || body.ccList !== undefined);
      const rawCcSource = hasExplicitCcOverride
        ? (body.ccList ?? body.cc)
        : (activeProfile && Array.isArray(activeProfile.ccList))
          ? activeProfile.ccList
          : Array.isArray(matrixConfig?.ccList)
            ? matrixConfig.ccList
            : Array.isArray(savedRecipients?.baseCcList)
              ? savedRecipients.baseCcList
              : DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS.baseCcList;

      const configuredToSet = new Set(configuredToList);
      finalCc = splitEmailList(rawCcSource).filter((e) => !configuredToSet.has(e));
      finalToList = configuredToList;
      finalTo = configuredToList.join(', ');
    }

    const nowDate = new Date();
    const ts = formatSaveFileTimestamp(nowDate);
    const generatedManila = formatManilaTimestampDisplay(nowDate);
    const streamSlug = resolvedStream === 'supplier_outbound'
      ? 'Supplier_RTV_Matrix_Report'
      : resolvedStream === 'customer_inbound'
        ? 'Customer_Hub_Matrix_Report'
        : 'Overall_RMA_Matrix_Report';
    const streamTitle = resolvedStream === 'supplier_outbound'
      ? 'Supplier RTV Matrix Report'
      : resolvedStream === 'customer_inbound'
        ? 'Customer Hub Matrix Report'
        : 'Overall RMA Matrix Report';
    const filename = `${requestedTestMode ? 'TEST_' : ''}${streamSlug}_${startDate}_to_${endDate} ${ts}.xlsx`;

    const baseSubject = `[Daily RMA Matrix Report] ${streamTitle} (${startDate} to ${endDate}) — ${dataset.grandTotalPcs} pcs`;
    const finalSubject = formatTestEmailSubject(baseSubject, requestedTestMode);
    const finalFromName = requestedTestMode
      ? '[TEST] Pingcon RMA Operations Portal'
      : 'Pingcon RMA Operations Portal';

    const htmlBody = buildDailyMatrixEmailHtml({
      dataset,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      generatedManila,
      filename,
      toEmail: finalTo,
      ccList: finalCc,
      isTestMode: requestedTestMode,
      triggeredBy: caller.actor,
      sandboxEmail,
      targetTimePht
    });

    const textBody = `${requestedTestMode ? '[TEST] ' : ''}Daily Overall RMA Matrix Report (${startDate} to ${endDate})\nLine Items: ${dataset.lineCount}, SKUs: ${dataset.monitoredSkuCount}, Total Pcs: ${dataset.grandTotalPcs}, Total Value: PHP ${dataset.grandTotalValue.toFixed(2)}\nGenerated (PHT): ${generatedManila}\nTo: ${finalTo}${finalCc.length ? `\nCC: ${finalCc.join(', ')}` : ''}`;

    const smtp = createSmtpTransport();
    let emailMessageId = null;

    if (!dryRun) {
      if (!smtp.configured) {
        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: false,
          notConfigured: true,
          user: smtp.smtpUser,
          message: 'SMTP credentials (GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD) not configured in Vercel environment variables.'
        }, req);
      }

      try {
        const info = await smtp.transporter.sendMail({
          from: `"${finalFromName}" <${smtp.smtpUser}>`,
          to: finalTo,
          cc: finalCc.length > 0 ? finalCc : undefined,
          subject: finalSubject,
          html: htmlBody,
          text: textBody,
          attachments: [
            {
              filename,
              content: Buffer.from(bytes),
              contentType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
            }
          ]
        });
        emailMessageId = info?.messageId || null;
      } catch (smtpErr) {
        const diagnostic = getDiagnosticHelp(smtpErr.message, smtp.smtpUser, smtp.cleanPass);
        return sendJson(res, 500, {
          success: false,
          error: 'SMTP_SEND_FAILED',
          message: smtpErr.message,
          diagnostic
        }, req);
      }

      // Record daily Live PHT idempotency date only after genuine non-test SMTP send
      if (!requestedTestMode) {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .upsert({
            key: LAST_SENT_PHT_KEY,
            value: todayManila,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          });
      }
    }

    return sendJson(res, 200, {
      success: true,
      dryRun,
      isTestMode: requestedTestMode,
      stream: resolvedStream,
      includeAllRecords: useAllRecords,
      includeZeroCatalogSkus: resolvedIncludeZero,
      phtDate: todayManila,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      to: finalTo,
      toList: finalToList,
      sandboxEmail,
      targetTimePht,
      autoEnabled,
      cc: finalCc,
      subject: finalSubject,
      fromName: finalFromName,
      filename,
      messageId: emailMessageId,
      triggeredBy: caller.actor,
      dataset: {
        lineCount: dataset.lineCount,
        monitoredSkuCount: dataset.monitoredSkuCount,
        grandTotalPcs: dataset.grandTotalPcs,
        totalBadStockPcs: dataset.totalBadStockPcs,
        totalGoodStockPcs: dataset.totalGoodStockPcs,
        grandTotalValue: dataset.grandTotalValue
      },
      ...(includeAttachmentBase64 ? { attachmentBase64: Buffer.from(bytes).toString('base64') } : {})
    }, req);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Daily Matrix Handler Error]:', err);
    return sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'DAILY_MATRIX_ERROR',
      message: err.message || 'Failed to generate or dispatch Daily Overall RMA Matrix.'
    }, req);
  }
}

/**
 * Shared image normalization helper for Google Gemini Flash inspection calls.
 */
async function prepareGeminiImagePayload({ fileData, imageUrl, mimeType = 'image/jpeg' }) {
  let cleanMimeType = mimeType || 'image/jpeg';
  let base64String = '';

  if (fileData) {
    if (fileData.includes(';base64,')) {
      const parts = fileData.split(';base64,');
      cleanMimeType = parts[0].replace('data:', '') || cleanMimeType;
      base64String = parts[1];
    } else if (fileData.includes(',')) {
      base64String = fileData.split(',')[1];
    } else {
      base64String = fileData;
    }
  } else if (imageUrl) {
    const imgRes = await fetch(imageUrl);
    if (!imgRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch image from URL: ${imgRes.statusText}`);
    }
    const arrayBuf = await imgRes.arrayBuffer();
    cleanMimeType = imgRes.headers.get('content-type') || cleanMimeType;
    base64String = Buffer.from(arrayBuf).toString('base64');
  } else {
    throw new Error('Either fileData (Base64) or imageUrl must be provided.');
  }

  return { cleanMimeType, base64String };
}

/**
 * Shared Gemini Flash Vision REST runner with model cascade fallback.
 */
async function invokeGeminiVisionJson({ apiKey, promptText, cleanMimeType, base64String }) {
  const configuredModel = process.env.GEMINI_MODEL;
  const modelsToTry = [
    configuredModel || 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite',
    'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',
    'gemini-2.5-flash',
    'gemini-flash-latest'
  ].filter(Boolean);

  let lastError = null;

  for (const modelName of modelsToTry) {
    try {
      const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${modelName}:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;

      const apiRes = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          contents: [
            {
              role: 'user',
              parts: [
                { text: promptText },
                {
                  inlineData: {
                    mimeType: cleanMimeType,
                    data: base64String
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          ],
          generationConfig: {
            responseMimeType: 'application/json',
            temperature: 0.1
          }
        })
      });

      if (!apiRes.ok) {
        const errBody = await apiRes.text();
        throw new Error(`Google API ${apiRes.status} on model ${modelName}: ${errBody}`);
      }

      const resData = await apiRes.json();
      const partText = resData?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text?.trim() || '';
      if (!partText) {
        throw new Error(`Empty response from model ${modelName}`);
      }

      const jsonStart = partText.indexOf('{');
      const jsonEnd = partText.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (jsonStart !== -1 && jsonEnd !== -1) {
        return JSON.parse(partText.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd + 1));
      }

      throw new Error(`Invalid JSON format from model ${modelName}`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[Gemini Flash] Model ${modelName} attempt notice:`, err.message);
      lastError = err;
    }
  }

  throw new Error(`Gemini inspection failed: ${lastError?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
}

  return {

    document_type: parsed.document_type || (isValid ? 'Commercial Logistics Paperwork' : 'Non-Document / Rejected'),
    confidence: typeof parsed.confidence === 'number' ? parsed.confidence : (isValid ? 0.95 : 0.0),
    si_number: siNum,
    dr_number: drNum,
    po_number: poNum,
    invoice_dr_number: primaryDocNum,
    store_branch: parsed.store_branch ? String(parsed.store_branch).trim() : null,
    detected_date: parsed.detected_date || null,
    vendor_name: parsed.vendor_name ? String(parsed.vendor_name).trim() : null,
    rejection_reason: isValid ? null : (parsed.rejection_reason || 'Photo does not appear to be an authentic Sales Invoice, DR, or PO, or document numbers are unreadable.')
  };
}

  };

import tls from 'node:tls';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { authorizeCronOrAdmin } from './cronAuth.js';
import { DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS, DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL } from './smtpMailer.js';

  sumManifestQuantity,
  summarizeBatchSuppliers,
  isMixedSuppliersSummary,
  isRealSupplierName
