import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from './auth.js';
import { INITIAL_PRODUCTS } from './mockProducts.js';

const DEFAULT_KNOWN_GPS_LOCATIONS = [
  {
    name: 'Pingcon Warehouse',
    street: '64 Mendez Rd',
    barangay: 'Baesa',
    city: 'Quezon City',
    region: 'Metro Manila',
    zip: '1106',
    formatted: '64 Mendez Rd, Baesa, Quezon City, Metro Manila 1106',
    lat: 14.6683,
    lon: 121.0114,
    radiusMeters: 250
  }
];

function toRadians(deg) {
  return (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
}

function haversineMeters(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  if (![lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2].every((v) => Number.isFinite(Number(v)))) {
    return Infinity;
  }
  const R = 6371000;
  const dLat = toRadians(Number(lat2) - Number(lat1));
  const dLon = toRadians(Number(lon2) - Number(lon1));
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(toRadians(Number(lat1))) * Math.cos(toRadians(Number(lat2))) *
    Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return R * c;
}

function formatStructuredAddress({ street = '', barangay = '', city = '', region = '', zip = '' }) {
  const cleanStreet = String(street || '').trim();
  const cleanBarangay = String(barangay || '').trim();
  const cleanCity = String(city || '').trim();
  const cleanRegion = String(region || '').trim();
  const cleanZip = String(zip || '').trim();

  const regionZip = [
    cleanRegion && cleanRegion.toLowerCase() !== cleanCity.toLowerCase() ? cleanRegion : '',
    cleanZip
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();

  const uniqueParts = [];
  for (const part of [
    cleanStreet,
    cleanBarangay && cleanBarangay.toLowerCase() !== cleanCity.toLowerCase() ? cleanBarangay : '',
    cleanCity,
    regionZip
  ]) {
    const clean = String(part || '').trim();
    if (!clean) continue;
    if (!uniqueParts.some((existing) => existing.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) {
      uniqueParts.push(clean);
    }
  }

  const formatted = uniqueParts.join(', ');
  const line1 = [
    cleanStreet,
    cleanBarangay && cleanBarangay.toLowerCase() !== cleanStreet.toLowerCase() ? cleanBarangay : ''
  ].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || cleanCity || formatted;

  const line2Parts = [];
  if (cleanCity && cleanCity.toLowerCase() !== line1.toLowerCase()) {
    line2Parts.push(cleanCity);
  }
  if (regionZip && regionZip.toLowerCase() !== line1.toLowerCase()) {
    line2Parts.push(regionZip);
  }
  const line2 = line2Parts.join(', ');
  const lines = [line1, line2].filter(Boolean);

  return { formatted, lines };
}

async function loadKnownGpsAnchors() {
  try {
    const queryPromise = supabase
      .from('rma_settings')
      .select('value')
      .eq('key', 'known_gps_locations')
      .maybeSingle();
    const { data, error } = await Promise.race([
      queryPromise,
      new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve({ data: null, error: { message: 'timeout' } }), 3000))
    ]);

    if (!error && data && data.value != null) {
      let parsed = data.value;
      if (typeof parsed === 'string') {
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(parsed);
        } catch {
          parsed = null;
        }
      }
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        const valid = parsed.filter((a) => a && Number.isFinite(Number(a.lat)) && Number.isFinite(Number(a.lon ?? a.lng)));
        if (valid.length > 0) return valid;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Quiet fallback to default warehouse anchor
  }
  return DEFAULT_KNOWN_GPS_LOCATIONS;
}

/**
 * Retrieve the Laravel Cloud API Key:
 * 1. Checks server environment variables (EXTERNAL_CATALOG_API_KEY, etc.)
 * 2. Fallback to Supabase products table (__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__) saved by Admin in Settings
 */
async function getCatalogApiKey() {
  const envKey = process.env.EXTERNAL_CATALOG_API_KEY || 
                 process.env.EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO || 
                 process.env.VITE_EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO || 
                 process.env.PO_API_KEY || 
                 process.env.VITE_PO_API_KEY;

  if (envKey && envKey.trim() && envKey.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
    return envKey.trim();
  }

  const withTimeout = (p, ms = 3000) => Promise.race([
    p,
    new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve({ data: null }), ms))
  ]);

  try {
    const { data } = await withTimeout(
      supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('code')
        .eq('barcode', '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__')
        .maybeSingle()
    );

    if (data?.code && data.code.trim() && data.code.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      return data.code.trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Quiet catch
  }

  try {
    const { data: settingData } = await withTimeout(
      supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', 'EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO')
        .maybeSingle()
    );

    if (settingData?.value && typeof settingData.value === 'string' && settingData.value.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      return settingData.value.trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Quiet catch
  }

  return envKey || 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key';
}

function extractPcsPerCase(item) {
  const rawBrand = item?.brand_name || item?.brandName || '';
  const pcsMatch = String(rawBrand).match(/\[Pcs\/Cs:(\d+)\]/);
  const parsedBrandPcs = pcsMatch ? parseInt(pcsMatch[1], 10) : null;
  const rawPcs = item?.pieces_per_case ?? item?.piecesPerCase ?? parsedBrandPcs ?? null;
  const numPcs = Number(rawPcs);
  return Number.isFinite(numPcs) && numPcs > 0 ? numPcs : null;
}

function normalizeLookupItem(raw, source, fallbackBarcode = null) {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const isErply = source === 'erply_api';
  const isMock = source === 'verified_catalog';
  const barcodeVal = isErply
    ? (raw.ean_code || raw.code2 || raw.barcode || fallbackBarcode || null)
    : (raw.barcode || fallbackBarcode || null);
  const rawSku = raw.code || raw.sku || null;
  const cleanSku = (rawSku && rawSku !== barcodeVal) ? rawSku : null;
  const rawBrand = raw.brand_name || raw.brandName || raw.brand || '';
  const cleanBrand = String(rawBrand).replace(/\s*\[Pcs\/Cs:\d+\]/g, '').trim() || null;
  const parsedPcs = extractPcsPerCase(raw);

  const rawPrice = Number(isMock ? (raw.unit_price || 0) : (raw.price || 0));
  const priceWithVat = isMock
    ? rawPrice * 1.12
    : (parseFloat(raw.priceWithVat) || parseFloat(raw.price_with_vat) || parseFloat(raw.price) || 0);
  const netPrice = isMock
    ? rawPrice
    : (parseFloat(raw.price) || (priceWithVat > 0 ? priceWithVat / 1.12 : 0));

  const supplierVal = raw.supplierName || raw.supplier_name || raw.supplier || 'Savemore';
  const unitVal = raw.unitName || raw.unit_name || 'pc';

  return {
    id: String(raw.id || cleanSku || barcodeVal || ''),
    barcode: barcodeVal || cleanSku || null,
    code: cleanSku,
    sku: cleanSku,
    ean_code: raw.ean_code || (!isErply && !isMock ? raw.barcode : null) || null,
    name: raw.name || '',
    price: netPrice,
    price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
    priceWithVat: priceWithVat,
    supplier_name: supplierVal,
    supplierName: supplierVal,
    supplier: supplierVal,
    brand_name: cleanBrand,
    brandName: cleanBrand,
    brand: cleanBrand,
    unit_name: unitVal,
    unitName: unitVal,
    pieces_per_case: parsedPcs,
    piecesPerCase: parsedPcs,
    has_serial_numbers: Boolean(raw.hasSerialNumbers || raw.has_serial_numbers || raw.requires_serial),
    hasSerialNumbers: Boolean(raw.hasSerialNumbers || raw.has_serial_numbers || raw.requires_serial),
    image_url: raw.image_url || raw.imageUrl || null,
    imageUrl: raw.imageUrl || raw.image_url || null,
    ae_name: raw.ae_name || null,
    ae_email: raw.ae_email || null,
    company: raw.company || null,
    is_verified: isErply || isMock ? true : (raw.is_verified !== false),
    isVerified: isErply || isMock ? true : (raw.is_verified !== false),
    source
  };
}

/**
 * Public Secure Product Lookup Endpoint:
 * GET /api/v1/products/lookup?barcode=[barcode]&search=[search]
 * 
 * Securely proxies external Laravel Cloud catalog calls on the server
 * so anonymous dock workers, mobile phones, and incognito sessions
 * never need client-side credentials.
 */
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'GET') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, { success: false, error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: `Method ${req.method} not allowed.` });
  }

  const actionParam = String(req.query?.action || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (actionParam === 'reverse-geocode') {
    const rawLat = Number(req.query?.lat ?? req.query?.latitude);
    const rawLon = Number(req.query?.lon ?? req.query?.lng ?? req.query?.longitude);

    if (!Number.isFinite(rawLat) || !Number.isFinite(rawLon) || rawLat < -90 || rawLat > 90 || rawLon < -180 || rawLon > 180) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'INVALID_COORDINATES',
        message: 'Provide valid numeric lat (-90..90) and lon (-180..180) parameters.'
      });
    }

    const fallbackFormatted = `${rawLat.toFixed(5)}, ${rawLon.toFixed(5)}`;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5500);

    try {
      // Priority 1: Known Warehouse / Dock Geofence Anchors (exact warehouse street & ZIP)
      const anchors = await loadKnownGpsAnchors();
      let matchedAnchor = null;
      let matchedDist = Infinity;
      for (const anchor of anchors) {
        const anchorLat = Number(anchor.lat);
        const anchorLon = Number(anchor.lon ?? anchor.lng);
        const radius = Number(anchor.radiusMeters) > 0 ? Number(anchor.radiusMeters) : 250;
        const dist = haversineMeters(rawLat, rawLon, anchorLat, anchorLon);
        if (dist <= radius && dist < matchedDist) {
          matchedAnchor = anchor;
          matchedDist = dist;
        }
      }

      if (matchedAnchor) {
        const street = String(matchedAnchor.street || '').trim();
        const barangay = String(matchedAnchor.barangay || '').trim();
        const city = String(matchedAnchor.city || '').trim();
        const region = String(matchedAnchor.region || '').trim();
        const zip = String(matchedAnchor.zip || '').trim();
        const { formatted: builtFormatted, lines: builtLines } = formatStructuredAddress({
          street,
          barangay,
          city,
          region,
          zip
        });
        const formatted = String(matchedAnchor.formatted || '').trim() || builtFormatted || fallbackFormatted;
        const lines = builtLines.length > 0 ? builtLines : [formatted];

        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          source: 'known_gps_anchor',
          anchorName: String(matchedAnchor.name || '').trim(),
          distanceMeters: Math.round(matchedDist),
          latitude: rawLat,
          longitude: rawLon,
          street,
          barangay,
          city,
          region,
          zip,
          country: 'Philippines',
          formatted,
          lines,
          display_name: formatted
        });
      }

      // Priority 2: Google Maps Geocoding API (if configured in env)
      const googleMapsKey = String(
        process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY ||
        process.env.GOOGLE_GEOCODING_API_KEY ||
        ''
      ).trim();

      if (googleMapsKey) {
        try {
          const gUrl = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=${encodeURIComponent(rawLat)},${encodeURIComponent(rawLon)}&key=${encodeURIComponent(googleMapsKey)}`;
          const gRes = await fetch(gUrl, { signal: controller.signal });
          if (gRes.ok) {
            const gData = await gRes.json();
            if (gData?.status === 'OK' && Array.isArray(gData.results) && gData.results.length > 0) {
              const preferred =
                gData.results.find((r) => Array.isArray(r.types) && r.types.includes('street_address')) ||
                gData.results.find((r) => Array.isArray(r.types) && r.types.includes('premise')) ||
                gData.results[0];
              const comps = Array.isArray(preferred?.address_components) ? preferred.address_components : [];
              const getComp = (...types) => {
                for (const t of types) {
                  const found = comps.find((c) => Array.isArray(c.types) && c.types.includes(t));
                  if (found?.long_name) return String(found.long_name).trim();
                }
                return '';
              };
              const streetNum = getComp('street_number');
              const route = getComp('route');
              const street = [streetNum, route].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();
              const barangay = getComp('sublocality_level_2', 'sublocality_level_1', 'sublocality', 'neighborhood');
              const city = getComp('locality', 'administrative_area_level_2');
              const rawRegion = getComp('administrative_area_level_1');
              const region = /^national capital region$/i.test(rawRegion) ? 'Metro Manila' : rawRegion;
              const zip = getComp('postal_code');
              const country = getComp('country');
              const { formatted: builtFormatted, lines: builtLines } = formatStructuredAddress({
                street,
                barangay,
                city,
                region,
                zip
              });
              const formatted = builtFormatted || String(preferred?.formatted_address || '').trim() || fallbackFormatted;
              if (street || city || zip) {
                return sendJson(res, 200, {
                  success: true,
                  source: 'google_maps',
                  latitude: rawLat,
                  longitude: rawLon,
                  street,
                  barangay,
                  city,
                  region,
                  zip,
                  country,
                  formatted,
                  lines: builtLines.length > 0 ? builtLines : [formatted],
                  display_name: preferred?.formatted_address || formatted
                });
              }
            }
          }
        } catch {
          // Fall through cleanly to Priority 3 (Nominatim)
        }
      }

      // Priority 3: Nominatim Zoom-18 fallback prioritizing house_number + road -> barangay -> city -> region -> ZIP
      const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=jsonv2&lat=${encodeURIComponent(rawLat)}&lon=${encodeURIComponent(rawLon)}&addressdetails=1&zoom=18`;
      const geoRes = await fetch(url, {
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'Wholesale-RMA-Portal/2.0 (finance2@keysysincorporated.com)',
          Accept: 'application/json',
          'Accept-Language': 'en'
        },
        signal: controller.signal
      });

      if (!geoRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Nominatim responded HTTP ${geoRes.status}`);
      }

      const data = await geoRes.json();
      const addr = data?.address || {};
      const primaryRoad = String(
        addr.road ||
        addr.pedestrian ||
        addr.residential ||
        addr.footway ||
        addr.path ||
        addr.building ||
        ''
      ).trim();
      const street = [addr.house_number, primaryRoad].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();
      const barangay = String(
        addr.suburb ||
        addr.quarter ||
        addr.city_district ||
        addr.neighbourhood ||
        addr.village ||
        addr.hamlet ||
        ''
      ).trim();
      const city = String(addr.city || addr.town || addr.municipality || addr.county || '').trim();
      const rawRegion = String(addr.state || addr.region || '').trim();
      const isNcrCity = /^(quezon city|manila|makati|pasig|taguig|mandaluyong|caloocan|paranaque|para\u00f1aque|las pinas|las pi\u00f1as|marikina|pasay|valenzuela|malabon|navotas|san juan|muntinlupa|pateros)$/i.test(city);
      const region = rawRegion || (isNcrCity ? 'Metro Manila' : '');
      const zip = String(addr.postcode || '').trim();
      const country = String(addr.country || '').trim();

      const { formatted: builtFormatted, lines } = formatStructuredAddress({
        street,
        barangay,
        city,
        region,
        zip
      });
      const formatted = builtFormatted || String(data?.display_name || '').trim() || fallbackFormatted;

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        source: 'nominatim',
        latitude: rawLat,
        longitude: rawLon,
        street,
        barangay,
        city,
        region,
        zip,
        country,
        formatted,
        lines: lines.length > 0 ? lines : [formatted],
        display_name: data?.display_name || formatted
      });
    } catch (err) {
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: false,
        fallback: true,
        error: err?.message || 'Reverse geocode unavailable',
        latitude: rawLat,
        longitude: rawLon,
        street: '',
        barangay: '',
        city: '',
        region: '',
        zip: '',
        formatted: fallbackFormatted,
        lines: [fallbackFormatted]
      });
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  const barcodeParam = req.query.barcode || req.query.code || req.query.ean_code;
  const searchParam = req.query.search || req.query.q;
  const limitParam = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 50, 1), 100);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // MODE 1: SINGLE BARCODE / SKU LOOKUP
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (barcodeParam) {
    const cleanBarcode = String(barcodeParam).trim();
    if (!cleanBarcode) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, { success: false, error: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Barcode is required.' });
    }
    if (/^(RMA-|MANIFEST|NO-?LABEL-)/i.test(cleanBarcode)) {
      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, found: false, source: 'synthetic' });
    }

    try {
      // 1. Check Supabase 'products' table first (Priority 1)
      const { data: supaProds, error: supaErr } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .or(`barcode.eq.${cleanBarcode},code.ilike.${cleanBarcode}`)
        .limit(1);

      if (!supaErr && supaProds && supaProds.length > 0) {
        const item = supaProds[0];
        if (!item.name?.startsWith('[DELETED]')) {
          return sendJson(res, 200, {
            success: true,
            found: true,
            source: 'database',
            product: normalizeLookupItem(item, 'database')
          });
        }
      }

      // 2. Query Coworker's Live Catalog API (erply_products) securely from server
      const key = await getCatalogApiKey();
      const baseUrl = process.env.PO_API_URL || process.env.VITE_PO_API_URL || 'https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1';
      const codeCandidates = Array.from(new Set([cleanBarcode, cleanBarcode.toUpperCase(), cleanBarcode.toLowerCase()]));
      let matchedItem = null;

      for (const code of codeCandidates) {
        // Priority A: Direct equality on ean_code (Manufacturer / Retail Barcode)
        try {
          const eanUrl = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?ean_code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
          const rEan = await fetch(eanUrl, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4500) });
          if (rEan.ok) {
            const jEan = await rEan.json();
            if (jEan.data && jEan.data.length > 0) {
              matchedItem = jEan.data[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        // Priority B: Direct equality on code2 (Secondary Barcode / UPC)
        try {
          const code2Url = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?code2=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
          const r2 = await fetch(code2Url, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4500) });
          if (r2.ok) {
            const j2 = await r2.json();
            if (j2.data && j2.data.length > 0) {
              matchedItem = j2.data[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        // Priority C: Direct equality on code (Internal SKU)
        try {
          const skuUrl = `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
          const rSku = await fetch(skuUrl, { headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4500) });
          if (rSku.ok) {
            const jSku = await rSku.json();
            if (jSku.data && jSku.data.length > 0) {
              matchedItem = jSku.data[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (matchedItem) {
        const normalized = normalizeLookupItem(matchedItem, 'erply_api', cleanBarcode);

        // Cache into Supabase so subsequent scans find it directly in Supabase
        try {
          await supabase.from('products').upsert({
            barcode: normalized.barcode,
            code: normalized.code,
            name: normalized.name,
            supplier_name: normalized.supplier_name,
            price: normalized.price,
            price_with_vat: normalized.price_with_vat,
            brand_name: normalized.brand_name,
            unit_name: normalized.unit_name,
            is_verified: true,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'barcode' });
        } catch (err) {}

        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          found: true,
          source: 'erply_api',
          product: normalized
        });
      }

      // 3. Wholesale Verified Catalog Fallback (INITIAL_PRODUCTS)
      const mock = INITIAL_PRODUCTS.find(p => 
        p.barcode === cleanBarcode || 
        (p.sku && p.sku.toLowerCase() === cleanBarcode.toLowerCase())
      );

      if (mock) {
        return sendJson(res, 200, {
          success: true,
          found: true,
          source: 'verified_catalog',
          product: normalizeLookupItem(mock, 'verified_catalog')
        });
      }

      // 4. Not registered anywhere
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        found: false,
        product: null,
        message: `Barcode "${cleanBarcode}" is not registered in the catalog.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error during product lookup proxy:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // MODE 2: MULTI-PRODUCT KEYWORD SEARCH
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (searchParam) {
    const cleanSearch = String(searchParam).trim();
    if (!cleanSearch) {
      return sendJson(res, 200, { success: true, count: 0, products: [] });
    }

    try {
      const results = [];
      const seenKeys = new Set();

      // 1. Search Supabase
      const { data: supaItems } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .or(`name.ilike.%${cleanSearch}%,barcode.ilike.%${cleanSearch}%,code.ilike.%${cleanSearch}%`)
        .order('is_verified', { ascending: false })
        .limit(limitParam);

      if (supaItems && Array.isArray(supaItems)) {
        for (const item of supaItems) {
          if (item.name?.startsWith('[DELETED]') || item.barcode?.startsWith('__CONFIG_')) continue;
          const key = String(item.barcode || item.code || item.id).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
            seenKeys.add(key);
            results.push(normalizeLookupItem(item, 'database'));
          }
        }
      }

      // 2. Search Laravel Cloud API (test case variations + direct ?code= if term has no spaces)
      const key = await getCatalogApiKey();
      const baseUrl = process.env.PO_API_URL || process.env.VITE_PO_API_URL || 'https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1';
      const cols = 'id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers';
      const capitalized = cleanSearch.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + cleanSearch.slice(1);
      const uppercase = cleanSearch.toUpperCase();
      const lowercase = cleanSearch.toLowerCase();
      const searchVariations = Array.from(new Set([cleanSearch, capitalized, uppercase, lowercase]));
      const erplyUrls = searchVariations.map(
        (term) => `${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?search=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&per_page=25&columns=${cols}`
      );
      if (!/\s/.test(cleanSearch)) {
        const codeVariations = Array.from(new Set([cleanSearch, uppercase, lowercase]));
        codeVariations.forEach((codeTerm) => {
          erplyUrls.push(`${baseUrl}/data/erply_products?code=${encodeURIComponent(codeTerm)}&per_page=25&columns=${cols}`);
        });
      }

      try {
        const responses = await Promise.all(
          erplyUrls.map(async (url) => {
            try {
              const r = await fetch(url, {
                headers: { 'X-API-Key': key, 'Accept': 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)
              });
              if (!r.ok) return [];
              const j = await r.json();
              return Array.isArray(j?.data) ? j.data : [];
            } catch {
              return [];
            }
          })
        );
        for (const batch of responses) {
          for (const item of batch) {
            const normalized = normalizeLookupItem(item, 'erply_api');
            const prodKey = String(normalized.barcode || normalized.code || normalized.id).trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!seenKeys.has(prodKey)) {
              seenKeys.add(prodKey);
              results.push(normalized);
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {}

      // 3. Search Mock Catalog
      for (const mock of INITIAL_PRODUCTS) {
        const matchText = `${mock.name} ${mock.brand || ''} ${mock.category || ''} ${mock.sku || ''} ${mock.barcode || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        if (matchText.includes(cleanSearch.toLowerCase())) {
          const mockKey = String(mock.barcode || mock.sku || mock.id).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (!seenKeys.has(mockKey)) {
            seenKeys.add(mockKey);
            results.push(normalizeLookupItem(mock, 'verified_catalog'));
          }
        }
      }

      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        count: results.length,
        products: results.slice(0, limitParam)
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error during product search proxy:', err);
      return sendJson(res, 500, { success: false, error: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message });
    }
  }

  return sendJson(res, 400, {
    success: false,
    error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
    message: 'Provide either ?barcode=[code] or ?search=[term].'
  });
}

// Verified Wholesale Catalog Fallback (Group 1 & 2 Products)
export const INITIAL_PRODUCTS = [
  {
    id: 'prod-1',
    sku: 'BON-FT-200',
    barcode: '4806518330012',
    name: 'Bonita Soft Facial Tissue 2-Ply 200 pulls',
    brand: 'Bonita',
    supplier: 'Bonita Mills Inc.',
    unit_price: 68.50,
    unit_name: 'pc',
    image_url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1584308666744-24d5c474f2ae?w=500&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    requires_serial: false
  },
  {
    id: 'prod-2',
    sku: 'BON-KT-2R',
    barcode: '4806518330029',
    name: 'Bonita Kitchen Towel Jumbo Roll 2s',
    brand: 'Bonita',
    supplier: 'Bonita Mills Inc.',

import { OpenAPIRegistry, OpenApiGeneratorV31 } from '@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi';
import { registerHealthRoutes } from './schemas/health.schema.js';
import { registerRMARoutes } from './schemas/rma.schema.js';
import { registerProductRoutes } from './schemas/products.schema.js';
import { registerCreditMemoRoutes } from './schemas/creditMemos.schema.js';
import { registerApiKeyRoutes } from './schemas/apiKeys.schema.js';

/**
 * Builds the Code-First OpenAPI 3.1 Specification dynamically.
 * Whenever routes or Zod schemas are edited/added/removed in code,
 * this registry regenerates the full OpenAPI document automatically.
 */
export function generateCodeFirstOpenApiSpec() {
  const registry = new OpenAPIRegistry();

  // 1. Register Global Security Schemes
  registry.registerComponent('securitySchemes', 'ApiKeyHeader', {
    type: 'apiKey',
    in: 'header',
    name: 'x-api-key',
    description: 'Pass secret key via x-api-key header'
  });

  registry.registerComponent('securitySchemes', 'BearerAuth', {
    type: 'http',
    scheme: 'bearer',
    bearerFormat: 'API-Key',
    description: 'Pass secret key via Authorization: Bearer <key>'
  });

  // 2. Register all Route Schemas (Code-First)
  registerHealthRoutes(registry);
  registerRMARoutes(registry);
  registerProductRoutes(registry);
  registerCreditMemoRoutes(registry);
  registerApiKeyRoutes(registry);

  // 3. Generate OpenAPI 3.1 Document
  const generator = new OpenApiGeneratorV31(registry.definitions);

  return generator.generateDocument({
    openapi: '3.1.0',
    info: {
      title: 'Wholesale RMA Multi-System REST API',
      version: '1.0.0',
      description: `
**Code-First & Schema-Driven REST API** for Wholesale RMA Portal v2.
Built with Zod & \`@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi\`.

### 4 Authenticated Client Systems:
- **Primary System (Mine)**
- **Jarmen**
- **Jelo**
- **Arlito**

### Authentication:
Pass your secret API key in all requests:
- \`x-api-key: sk_live_rma_...\`
- Or \`Authorization: Bearer sk_live_rma_...\`

### 🧪 Coworker Simulation & Test Mode vs Live Mode:
- **🟢 Live Production Mode**:
  Requests made with live keys (\`sk_live_...\`) or without test flags operate directly on production books. Live returns appear in **Customer RMA Hub** or **Supplier Hub**.
- **🧪 Test Mode Sandbox (Safe Isolation)**:
  Coworkers can simulate inventory restocks, supplier re-orders, driver pickups, and consolidated credit memos safely without touching live financial ledgers or triggering live customer/boss emails. Test Mode emails honor customizable Admin-only per-email recipient profiles (\`rma_settings.test_email_recipients\` & \`rma_settings.test_email_recipients_by_type\`, defaulting to Sandbox \`mgan@pingconmarketing.com\`, **never exposed on public \`/\`**) with \`[TEST] \` as the very first subject word, and support Test Mode \`.xlsx\` reply ingestion (\`RMA-TEST-...\` strict Test-to-Test isolation):

  2. **HTTP Header**: Pass \`x-test-mode: true\`

import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from './auth.js';
import {
  sumManifestQuantity,
  summarizeBatchSuppliers,
  isMixedSuppliersSummary,
  isRealSupplierName,
  extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems
} from '../../src/utils/rmaHelpers.js';

const INVITES_SETTINGS_KEY = 'customer_rma_invites_store';

function isTestInvite(invite) {
  if (!invite) return false;
  return Boolean(invite.is_test || String(invite.token || '').startsWith('inv_test_'));
}

function isEditorInvite(invite) {
  if (!invite) return false;
  const token = String(invite.token || '');
  const entity = String(invite.entity_name || '');
  return (
    invite.stream_type === 'rma_editor' ||
    /^inv_(test_)?edit_/i.test(token) ||
    entity.startsWith('[RMA_EDITOR')
  );
}

function extractInviteRmaNumber(invite) {
  if (!invite) return '';
  if (invite.rma_number && String(invite.rma_number).trim()) {
    return String(invite.rma_number).trim();
  }
  const ent = String(invite.entity_name || '');
  const match = ent.match(/^\[RMA_EDITOR:([^|\]]+)(?:\|([^\]]*))?\]/);
  if (match && match[1] && match[1] !== 'ANY') {
    return match[1].trim();
  }
  const branch = String(invite.store_branch || '').trim();
  if (/^RMA-(TEST-)?\d{4}-/i.test(branch)) {
    return branch;
  }
  return '';
}

function extractAllowedEmails(invite) {
  if (!invite) return [];
  const set = new Set();
  const addEmail = (val) => {
    const clean = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (clean && clean.includes('@')) set.add(clean);
  };
  addEmail(invite.authorized_email);
  if (Array.isArray(invite.authorized_emails)) invite.authorized_emails.forEach(addEmail);
  if (Array.isArray(invite.allowed_emails)) invite.allowed_emails.forEach(addEmail);
  const ent = String(invite.entity_name || '');
  const match = ent.match(/^\[RMA_EDITOR:[^|\]]*\|([^\]]*)\]/);
  if (match && match[1]) {
    match[1].split(',').forEach(addEmail);
  }
  return Array.from(set);
}

function isPermanentInvite(invite) {
  if (!invite) return false;
  const exp = invite.expires_at;
  return Boolean(
    invite.no_expiry === true ||
    invite.never_expires === true ||
    String(invite.duration_unit || '').toLowerCase() === 'permanent' ||
    exp === null ||
    exp === undefined ||
    String(exp).startsWith('9999-') ||
    (typeof exp === 'string' && new Date(exp).getUTCFullYear() >= 9999)
  );
}

function isTestReport(report) {
  if (!report) return false;
  return Boolean(
    report.is_test === true ||
    report.ai_document_metadata?.is_test === true ||
    report.ai_document_metadata?.test_mode === true ||
    String(report.notes || '').includes('[TEST_MODE]') ||
    /^RMA-(?:TEST-)/i.test(String(report.rma_number || ''))
  );
}

async function resolveInviteByToken(token) {
  const cleanToken = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!cleanToken) return null;

  const [tblRes, settingsRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
    supabase.from('rma_invites').select('*').eq('token', cleanToken).maybeSingle(),
    supabase.from('rma_settings').select('value').eq('key', INVITES_SETTINGS_KEY).maybeSingle()
  ]);

  const tblRow = tblRes.status === 'fulfilled' && !tblRes.value?.error ? tblRes.value?.data : null;
  let settingsRow = null;
  if (settingsRes.status === 'fulfilled' && !settingsRes.value?.error && Array.isArray(settingsRes.value?.data?.value)) {
    settingsRow = settingsRes.value.data.value.find((i) => i && i.token === cleanToken) || null;
  }

  if (!tblRow && !settingsRow) return null;

  const merged = {
    ...(tblRow || {}),
    ...(settingsRow || {}),
    token: cleanToken
  };

  // Strict revocation / expiry win if either store marked revoked
  if (tblRow?.status === 'revoked' || settingsRow?.status === 'revoked') {
    merged.status = 'revoked';
  }
  merged.is_test = isTestInvite(merged);
  merged.stream_type = isEditorInvite(merged) ? 'rma_editor' : (merged.stream_type || 'customer_inbound');
  merged.rma_number = extractInviteRmaNumber(merged) || null;
  return merged;
}

async function findTargetReport(rmaNumber) {
  const cleanRma = String(rmaNumber || '').trim();
  if (!cleanRma) return null;

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('rma_reports')
    .select('*')
    .eq('rma_number', cleanRma)
    .order('is_parent', { ascending: false })
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

  if (error || !Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) return null;
  const parent = data.find((r) => !r.parent_rma_id) || data[0];
  return { parent, allRows: data };
}

export async function handleRmaEmailEdit(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'PATCH' && req.method !== 'POST') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, {
      success: false,
      error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
      message: `Method ${req.method} is not allowed. Use GET or PATCH.`
    }, req);
  }

  // 1. Verify Google / Supabase User Bearer JWT cryptographically with Supabase Auth
  const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'] || req.headers['Authorization'] || '';
  const bearerToken = authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.slice(7).trim() : '';
  if (!bearerToken) {
    return sendJson(res, 401, {
      success: false,
      error: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
      message: 'Google Sign-In session token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) is required.'
    }, req);
  }

  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await supabase.auth.getUser(bearerToken);
  const userEmail = userData?.user?.email ? String(userData.user.email).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  if (userErr || !userEmail) {
    return sendJson(res, 401, {
      success: false,
      error: 'INVALID_SESSION',
      message: 'Your Google Sign-In session is invalid or expired. Please sign in again.'
    }, req);
  }

  // 2. Resolve and verify Invite Token
  const body = (req.body && typeof req.body === 'object') ? req.body : {};
  const inviteToken = String(req.query?.token || body.token || body.inviteToken || '').trim();
  if (!inviteToken) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, {
      success: false,
      error: 'MISSING_INVITE_TOKEN',
      message: 'Invite authorization token is required.'
    }, req);
  }

  const invite = await resolveInviteByToken(inviteToken);
  if (!invite) {
    return sendJson(res, 404, {
      success: false,
      error: 'INVITE_NOT_FOUND',
      message: 'Authorization link was deleted or does not exist.'
    }, req);
  }

  if (invite.status === 'revoked') {
    return sendJson(res, 403, {
      success: false,
      error: 'INVITE_REVOKED',
      message: 'This RMA editor authorization link has been revoked.'
    }, req);
  }

  const inviteIsPermanent = isPermanentInvite(invite);
  if (!inviteIsPermanent) {
    const expTs = new Date(invite.expires_at).getTime();
    if (!Number.isFinite(expTs) || Date.now() > expTs) {
      return sendJson(res, 403, {
        success: false,
        error: 'INVITE_EXPIRED',
        message: 'This RMA editor authorization link has expired.'
      }, req);
    }
  }

  if (!isEditorInvite(invite)) {
    return sendJson(res, 403, {
      success: false,
      error: 'INVALID_INVITE_SCOPE',
      message: 'This invite token is not authorized for RMA record editing.'
    }, req);
  }

  const allowedEmails = extractAllowedEmails(invite);
  if (allowedEmails.length === 0 || !allowedEmails.includes(userEmail)) {
    return sendJson(res, 403, {
      success: false,
      error: 'IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
      message: `Access Denied: Signed-in Google account (${userEmail}) is not in authorized recipients (${allowedEmails.join(', ')}).`
    }, req);
  }
  const authorizedEmail = userEmail;

  // 3. Enforce RMA Scope & Live vs Test Isolation
  const requestedRma = String(req.query?.rma || req.query?.rma_number || body.rma_number || body.editRma || '').trim();
  const lockedRma = invite.rma_number ? String(invite.rma_number).trim() : '';

  if (lockedRma && requestedRma && requestedRma !== lockedRma) {
    return sendJson(res, 403, {
      success: false,
      error: 'RMA_SCOPE_MISMATCH',
      message: `This link is locked exclusively to RMA ${lockedRma} and cannot modify ${requestedRma}.`
    }, req);
  }

  const targetRmaNumber = lockedRma || requestedRma;
  if (!targetRmaNumber) {
    return sendJson(res, 400, {
      success: false,
      error: 'MISSING_RMA_NUMBER',
      message: 'Target RMA number is required.'
    }, req);
  }

  const found = await findTargetReport(targetRmaNumber);
  if (!found?.parent) {
    return sendJson(res, 404, {
      success: false,
      error: 'RMA_NOT_FOUND',
      message: `RMA record "${targetRmaNumber}" was not found.`
    }, req);
  }

  const report = found.parent;
  const inviteIsTest = isTestInvite(invite);
  const recordIsTest = isTestReport(report);
  if (inviteIsTest !== recordIsTest) {
    return sendJson(res, 403, {
      success: false,
      error: 'MODE_ISOLATION_VIOLATION',
      message: inviteIsTest
        ? 'Security Block: Test Mode editor links cannot access or modify Live Production RMA records.'
        : 'Security Block: Live Mode editor links cannot access or modify Test Sandbox RMA records.'
    }, req);
  }

  // 4. GET: Return scoped RMA details for standalone editor view
  if (req.method === 'GET') {
    let manifestItems = Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0
      ? report.items
      : (found.allRows.length > 1 ? found.allRows.filter((r) => r.id !== report.id) : []);

    if (manifestItems.length === 0 && report.id) {
      try {
        const { data: riRows } = await supabase
          .from('rma_items')
          .select('*')
          .eq('rma_report_id', report.id)
          .order('id', { ascending: true });
        if (Array.isArray(riRows) && riRows.length > 0) {
          manifestItems = riRows;
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    const totalQty = manifestItems.length > 1
      ? sumManifestQuantity(manifestItems, report.quantity)
      : (Number(report.quantity) || 1);

    return sendJson(res, 200, {
      success: true,
      mode: inviteIsTest ? 'test' : 'live',
      authorized_email: authorizedEmail,
      authorized_emails: allowedEmails,
      no_expiry: inviteIsPermanent,
      expires_at: inviteIsPermanent ? null : (invite.expires_at || null),
      scope_locked_rma: Boolean(lockedRma),
      report: {
        id: report.id,
        rma_number: report.rma_number,
        rma_type: report.rma_type,
        barcode: report.barcode,
        code: report.code || '',
        name: report.name || '',
        supplier_name: report.supplier_name || '',
        store_branch: report.store_branch || '',
        quantity: totalQty,
        total_quantity: report.total_quantity ?? totalQty,
        unit_name: report.unit_name || 'pc',
        price: report.price ?? 0,
        price_with_vat: report.price_with_vat ?? 0,
        expiry_date: report.expiry_date || '',
        si_number: report.si_number || '',
        dr_number: report.dr_number || '',
        po_number: report.po_number || '',
        invoice_dr_number: report.invoice_dr_number || '',
        notes: report.notes || '',
        reason: report.reason || '',
        explanation: report.explanation || '',
        status: report.status || '',
        disposition: report.disposition || '',
        created_at: report.created_at,
        updated_at: report.updated_at || null,
        ai_document_metadata: report.ai_document_metadata || {},
        items: manifestItems
      }
    }, req);
  }

  // 5. PATCH / POST: Persist sanitized edits + commercial documents + audit trail
  const u = (body.updates && typeof body.updates === 'object') ? body.updates : body;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  const updates = {};
  if (u.supplier_name !== undefined) updates.supplier_name = String(u.supplier_name || '').trim() || null;
  if (u.name !== undefined) updates.name = String(u.name || '').trim() || report.name;
  if (u.code !== undefined || u.sku !== undefined) {
    updates.code = String(u.code !== undefined ? u.code : u.sku || '').trim() || null;
  }
  if (u.barcode !== undefined && String(u.barcode).trim()) {
    updates.barcode = String(u.barcode).trim();
  }
  if (u.quantity !== undefined) {
    const qtyNum = Number(u.quantity);
    if (Number.isFinite(qtyNum) && qtyNum >= 1) {
      updates.quantity = Math.round(qtyNum);
    }
  }
  if (u.unit_name !== undefined) updates.unit_name = String(u.unit_name || '').trim() || 'pc';

  const hasNetPrice = u.price !== undefined && u.price !== '';
  const hasVatPrice = u.price_with_vat !== undefined && u.price_with_vat !== '';
  if (hasNetPrice) {
    const netNum = parseFloat(u.price);
    if (Number.isFinite(netNum) && netNum >= 0) {
      updates.price = Number(netNum.toFixed(2));
      if (!hasVatPrice) {
        updates.price_with_vat = Number((netNum * 1.12).toFixed(2));
      }
    }
  }
  if (hasVatPrice) {
    const vatNum = parseFloat(u.price_with_vat);
    if (Number.isFinite(vatNum) && vatNum >= 0) {
      updates.price_with_vat = Number(vatNum.toFixed(2));
      if (!hasNetPrice) {
        updates.price = Number((vatNum / 1.12).toFixed(2));
      }
    }
  }

  if (u.expiry_date !== undefined) {
    const cleanExp = String(u.expiry_date || '').trim();
    updates.expiry_date = cleanExp ? cleanExp.slice(0, 10) : null;
  }
  if (u.store_branch !== undefined) updates.store_branch = String(u.store_branch || '').trim() || null;

  if (u.si_number !== undefined) updates.si_number = String(u.si_number || '').trim() || null;
  if (u.dr_number !== undefined) updates.dr_number = String(u.dr_number || '').trim() || null;
  if (u.po_number !== undefined) updates.po_number = String(u.po_number || '').trim() || null;

  const effectiveDr = updates.dr_number !== undefined ? updates.dr_number : report.dr_number;
  const effectiveSi = updates.si_number !== undefined ? updates.si_number : report.si_number;
  const effectivePo = updates.po_number !== undefined ? updates.po_number : report.po_number;
  if (u.si_number !== undefined || u.dr_number !== undefined || u.po_number !== undefined) {
    updates.invoice_dr_number = effectiveDr || effectiveSi || effectivePo || null;
  }

  if (u.notes !== undefined) {
    const cleaned = String(u.notes || '').replace(/\[TEST_MODE\]/gi, '').trim();
    updates.notes = recordIsTest ? (`[TEST_MODE] ${cleaned}`).trim() : cleaned;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(u.items) && u.items.length > 0) {
    const fallbackSingleSup =
      (!isMixedSuppliersSummary(updates.supplier_name) && isRealSupplierName(updates.supplier_name))
        ? updates.supplier_name
        : ((!isMixedSuppliersSummary(report.supplier_name) && isRealSupplierName(report.supplier_name)) ? report.supplier_name : '');

    const sanitizedItems = u.items.map((it) => {
      const qtyVal = Number(it.quantity ?? it.qty);
      const netVal = parseFloat(it.price);
      const vatVal = parseFloat(it.price_with_vat ?? it.priceWithVat);
      const rawSup = String(it.supplier_name || it.supplierName || it.supplier || '').trim();
      const resolvedItemSup = isRealSupplierName(rawSup) ? rawSup : (fallbackSingleSup || 'Pending Assignment');
      return {
        ...it,
        name: String(it.name || it.productName || '').trim() || 'Item',
        code: String(it.code || it.sku || '').trim() || null,
        sku: String(it.sku || it.code || '').trim() || null,
        supplier_name: resolvedItemSup,
        supplierName: resolvedItemSup,
        supplier: resolvedItemSup,
        quantity: Number.isFinite(qtyVal) && qtyVal >= 1 ? Math.round(qtyVal) : 1,
        unit_name: String(it.unit_name || it.unit || 'pc').trim() || 'pc',
        price: Number.isFinite(netVal) && netVal >= 0 ? Number(netVal.toFixed(2)) : 0,
        price_with_vat: Number.isFinite(vatVal) && vatVal >= 0
          ? Number(vatVal.toFixed(2))
          : (Number.isFinite(netVal) && netVal >= 0 ? Number((netVal * 1.12).toFixed(2)) : 0),
        expiry_date: it.expiry_date ? String(it.expiry_date).slice(0, 10) : null
      };
    });
    const totalBatchQty = sumManifestQuantity(sanitizedItems, 1);
    updates.items = sanitizedItems;
    updates.total_items = sanitizedItems.length;
    updates.total_quantity = totalBatchQty;
    updates.quantity = totalBatchQty;
    updates.supplier_name = summarizeBatchSuppliers(sanitizedItems, fallbackSingleSup);
  } else if (Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0 && (updates.supplier_name || updates.expiry_date !== undefined)) {
    const existingDistinctSups = extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems(report.items);
    const hasMixedSups = existingDistinctSups.length > 1;
    updates.items = report.items.map((it) => {
      const shouldCascadeSup = updates.supplier_name && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(updates.supplier_name) && (!hasMixedSups || !isRealSupplierName(it.supplier_name));
      return {
        ...it,
        ...(shouldCascadeSup ? { supplier_name: updates.supplier_name, supplierName: updates.supplier_name, supplier: updates.supplier_name } : {}),
        ...(updates.expiry_date !== undefined ? { expiry_date: updates.expiry_date } : {})
      };
    });
  }

  const prevMeta = (report.ai_document_metadata && typeof report.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? report.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  updates.ai_document_metadata = {
    ...prevMeta,
    ...(recordIsTest ? { is_test: true, test_mode: true } : {}),
    last_email_edit: {
      edited_by_email: userEmail,
      edited_at: nowIso,
      invite_token: inviteToken
    }
  };

  const existingAudit = Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? report.audit_trail : [];
  updates.audit_trail = [
    ...existingAudit,
    {
      timestamp: nowIso,
      stage: 'EMAIL_EDITOR_UPDATE',
      actor: `${userEmail} (Email Editor)`,
      note: `RMA details & commercial documents updated via Google Identity email-bound editor by ${userEmail}.`
    }
  ];
  updates.updated_at = nowIso;

  let payloadToApply = { ...updates };
  let updatedRecord = null;
  let lastError = null;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('rma_reports')
      .update(payloadToApply)
      .eq('id', report.id)
      .select()
      .single();

    if (!error && data) {
      updatedRecord = data;
      lastError = null;
      break;
    }

    lastError = error;
    const msg = String(error?.message || '');
    const colMatch =
      msg.match(/Could not find the '([^']+)' column/i) ||
      msg.match(/column rma_reports\.([a-zA-Z0-9_]+) does not exist/i);
    if (colMatch && colMatch[1] && colMatch[1] in payloadToApply) {
      delete payloadToApply[colMatch[1]];
      continue;
    }
    break;
  }

  if (lastError || !updatedRecord) {
    return sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'UPDATE_FAILED',
      message: lastError?.message || 'Failed to update RMA record.'
    }, req);
  }

  // Cascade commercial documents & per-item qty/supplier/details to child rma_reports & rma_items rows
  const childRows = found.allRows.filter((r) => r.parent_rma_id === report.id);
  const editedItemsList = Array.isArray(updates.items) ? updates.items : [];

  if (childRows.length > 0) {
    const commonChildDocPatch = {};
    if (updates.si_number !== undefined) commonChildDocPatch.si_number = updates.si_number;
    if (updates.dr_number !== undefined) commonChildDocPatch.dr_number = updates.dr_number;
    if (updates.po_number !== undefined) commonChildDocPatch.po_number = updates.po_number;
    if (updates.invoice_dr_number !== undefined) commonChildDocPatch.invoice_dr_number = updates.invoice_dr_number;
    if (updates.store_branch !== undefined) commonChildDocPatch.store_branch = updates.store_branch;

    if (editedItemsList.length > 0) {
      const sortedChildren = [...childRows].sort((a, b) => Number(a.id || 0) - Number(b.id || 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < sortedChildren.length; i++) {
        const ch = sortedChildren[i];
        const matchedItem = editedItemsList.find((it) => (it.id != null && String(it.id) === String(ch.id)) || (it.barcode && ch.barcode && String(it.barcode).trim() === String(ch.barcode).trim())) || editedItemsList[i];
        const rowPatch = { ...commonChildDocPatch };
        if (matchedItem) {
          rowPatch.name = matchedItem.name;
          rowPatch.code = matchedItem.code || null;
          rowPatch.quantity = matchedItem.quantity;
          rowPatch.price = matchedItem.price;
          rowPatch.price_with_vat = matchedItem.price_with_vat;
          rowPatch.expiry_date = matchedItem.expiry_date || null;
          if (matchedItem.supplier_name) rowPatch.supplier_name = matchedItem.supplier_name;
        }
        if (Object.keys(rowPatch).length > 0 && ch.id) {
          await supabase.from('rma_reports').update(rowPatch).eq('id', ch.id).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    } else {
      const childUpdates = { ...commonChildDocPatch };
      if (updates.supplier_name !== undefined && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(updates.supplier_name) && childRows.length === 1) {
        childUpdates.supplier_name = updates.supplier_name;
      }
      if (Object.keys(childUpdates).length > 0) {
        await supabase.from('rma_reports').update(childUpdates).eq('parent_rma_id', report.id).catch(() => {});
      }
    }
  }

  if (editedItemsList.length > 0 && report.id) {
    try {
      const { data: rmaItemRows } = await supabase
        .from('rma_items')
        .select('*')
        .eq('rma_report_id', report.id)
        .order('id', { ascending: true });
      if (Array.isArray(rmaItemRows) && rmaItemRows.length > 0) {
        for (let i = 0; i < rmaItemRows.length; i++) {
          const ri = rmaItemRows[i];
          const matchedItem = editedItemsList.find((it) => (it.id != null && String(it.id) === String(ri.id)) || (it.barcode && ri.barcode && String(it.barcode).trim() === String(ri.barcode).trim())) || editedItemsList[i];
          if (!matchedItem || !ri.id) continue;
          const riPatch = {
            name: matchedItem.name,
            sku: matchedItem.code || matchedItem.sku || null,
            quantity: matchedItem.quantity,
            price: matchedItem.price,
            price_with_vat: matchedItem.price_with_vat,
            expiry_date: matchedItem.expiry_date || null,
            ...(matchedItem.supplier_name ? { supplier_name: matchedItem.supplier_name } : {})
          };
          await supabase.from('rma_items').update(riPatch).eq('id', ri.id).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return sendJson(res, 200, {
    success: true,
    message: `RMA ${report.rma_number} updated successfully.`,
    edited_by_email: userEmail,
    updated_at: updatedRecord.updated_at || nowIso,
    report: {
      ...updatedRecord,
      ...(editedItemsList.length > 0 ? {
        items: editedItemsList,
        total_quantity: updates.total_quantity,
        quantity: updates.quantity
      } : {})
    }
  }, req);
}

import { z, StandardErrorSchema } from './common.js';

export const ApiKeyRecordSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().uuid().openapi({ example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d' }),
  name: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Jarmen' }),
  masked_key: z.string().openapi({ example: 'sk_live_...e6c6' }),
  is_active: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
  rate_limit: z.number().int().default(60).openapi({ example: 60 }),
  expires_at: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional(),
  last_used_at: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional(),
  created_at: z.string().datetime().optional()
}).openapi('ApiKeyRecord');

export const CreateApiKeyRequestSchema = z.object({
  name: z.enum(['Primary System (Mine)', 'Jarmen', 'Jelo', 'Arlito']).openapi({
    description: 'Target client system',
    example: 'Jarmen'
  }),
  rateLimit: z.number().int().min(10).max(300).default(60).optional().openapi({ example: 60 }),
  expiresAt: z.string().datetime().optional()
}).openapi('CreateApiKeyRequest');

export function registerApiKeyRoutes(registry) {
  // GET /api/v1/api-keys
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys',
    summary: 'List Registered API Keys (Masked)',
    description: 'Returns all client keys with masked tokens. Never exposes secret keys or SHA-256 hashes.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'List of registered API keys',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              count: z.number().openapi({ example: 4 }),
              keys: z.array(ApiKeyRecordSchema)
            })
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // POST /api/v1/api-keys
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'post',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys',
    summary: 'Generate New API Key for Client System',
    description: 'Issues a new secret API key for Primary System, Jarmen, Jelo, or Arlito. Returns the raw secret key ONCE.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    request: {
      body: {
        required: true,
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: CreateApiKeyRequestSchema
          }
        }
      }
    },
    responses: {
      201: {
        description: 'API key generated with one-time raw secret',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'API Key successfully generated for Jarmen.' }),
              apiKey: z.string().openapi({ example: 'sk_live_rma_b68541b70325e2d858fbf11a4adbb6fcc79709c075cee6c6' }),
              keyRecord: ApiKeyRecordSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      400: { description: 'Validation error', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // PATCH /api/v1/api-keys/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'patch',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys/{id}',
    summary: 'Rotate Client API Key',
    description: 'Immediately revokes the current secret key and issues a new replacement key for the client.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().uuid().openapi({ description: 'API Key UUID', example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Key rotated with new raw secret returned once',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'API Key rotated successfully.' }),
              apiKey: z.string().openapi({ example: 'sk_live_rma_new_key_here' }),
              keyRecord: ApiKeyRecordSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'API key not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'delete',
    path: '/api/v1/api-keys/{id}',
    summary: 'Revoke and Delete API Key',
    description: 'Permanently deletes an API key. Calls made with this key will immediately fail with 401 Unauthorized.',
    tags: ['API Key Administration'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().uuid().openapi({ example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Key revoked and deleted',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'API key deleted.' }),
              deletedKey: ApiKeyRecordSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'Key not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });
}

export function registerCreditMemoRoutes(registry) {
  // GET /api/v1/credit-memos
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/credit-memos',
    summary: 'List Credit Memos',
    description: 'Retrieve financial credit memos with search and filters.',
    tags: ['Credit Memos'],
    request: {
      query: PaginationQuerySchema.extend({
        search: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Search term across CM #, pull out ref, or product' }),
        rma_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by RMA number' }),
        barcode: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by barcode' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Credit memos list',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              client: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Primary System' }),
              total: z.number().openapi({ example: 88 }),
              data: z.array(CreditMemoSchema)
            })
          }
        }
      },
      401: { description: 'Unauthorized', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // POST /api/v1/credit-memos
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'post',
    path: '/api/v1/credit-memos',
    summary: 'Issue Credit Memo',
    description: 'Creates a financial credit memo record with auto-generated CM / CM-TEST voucher number. Multi-RMA Consolidated Credit Memos in the UI bundle multiple Customer Inbound RMAs and store itemized breakdowns safely in rma_settings.consolidated_cm_items_store.',
    tags: ['Credit Memos'],
    request: {
      body: {
        required: true,
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: CreateCreditMemoSchema
          }
        }
      }
    },
    responses: {
      201: {
        description: 'Credit memo issued',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Credit Memo CM-20261026-4412 issued successfully.' }),
              data: CreditMemoSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      400: { description: 'Bad request', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // GET /api/v1/credit-memos/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/credit-memos/{id}',
    summary: 'Get Credit Memo Details',
    description: 'Retrieve a credit memo voucher by ID or CM number (e.g. CM-20261026-4412).',
    tags: ['Credit Memos'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().openapi({ example: 'CM-20261026-4412' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Credit memo found',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              data: CreditMemoSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'Not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });
}

export function registerProductRoutes(registry) {
  // GET /api/v1/products/lookup (Public Serverless Proxy + Reverse Geocode)
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/products/lookup',
    summary: 'Public Barcode/Product Lookup & Pinpoint GPS Reverse-Geocode Proxy',
    description: 'Secure server-side proxy resolving barcodes/SKUs across Supabase & ERPLY catalog OR reverse-geocoding dock GPS coordinates (`?action=reverse-geocode&lat=...&lon=...`) using Priority 1 Known Warehouse / Dock Geofence Anchors (`rma_settings.known_gps_locations`, seeded Pingcon Warehouse 64 Mendez Rd, Baesa, Quezon City 1106), Priority 2 Google Maps Geocoding API, and Priority 3 Nominatim `zoom=18` Street+ZIP resolution (`API_ROUTE_COUNT === 12`).',
    tags: ['Products & Catalog'],
    request: {
      query: z.object({
        action: z.enum(['reverse-geocode']).optional().openapi({ description: 'Set to `reverse-geocode` with `lat` and `lon` to resolve human-readable address details', example: 'reverse-geocode' }),
        lat: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'GPS latitude for reverse-geocode action', example: '14.5764' }),
        lon: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'GPS longitude for reverse-geocode action', example: '121.0851' }),
        barcode: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Barcode or SKU code to scan and resolve', example: '4800016644833' }),
        search: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Keyword search across product names and SKUs', example: 'Bonita' }),
        limit: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Maximum products to return', example: '25' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Product lookup or reverse-geocode result',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              found: z.boolean().optional().openapi({ example: true }),
              source: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'known_gps_anchor' }),
              anchorName: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Pingcon Warehouse' }),
              distanceMeters: z.number().optional().openapi({ example: 0 }),
              product: ProductSchema.nullable().optional(),
              products: z.array(ProductSchema).optional(),
              street: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '64 Mendez Rd' }),
              barangay: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Baesa' }),
              city: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Quezon City' }),
              region: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Metro Manila' }),
              zip: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '1106' }),
              formatted: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '64 Mendez Rd, Baesa, Quezon City, Metro Manila 1106' }),
              lines: z.array(z.string()).optional()
            })
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // GET /api/v1/products
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/products',
    summary: 'Search & List Products Catalog',
    description: 'Retrieve items from the wholesale master catalog filtered by barcode, SKU code, or keyword search.',
    tags: ['Products & Catalog'],
    request: {
      query: PaginationQuerySchema.extend({
        barcode: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by exact product barcode', example: '4800016644833' }),
        code: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by SKU item code', example: 'P2678P' }),
        search: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Search name or barcode', example: 'Crackers' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Matching products',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              client: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Arlito' }),
              total: z.number().openapi({ example: 450 }),
              limit: z.number().openapi({ example: 50 }),
              offset: z.number().openapi({ example: 0 }),
              data: z.array(ProductSchema)
            })
          }
        }
      },
      401: { description: 'Unauthorized', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // POST /api/v1/products
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'post',
    path: '/api/v1/products',
    summary: 'Create or Upsert Product',
    description: 'Adds or updates a product in the catalog indexed by barcode.',
    tags: ['Products & Catalog'],
    request: {
      body: {
        required: true,
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: CreateProductSchema
          }
        }
      }
    },
    responses: {
      201: {
        description: 'Product upserted',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Product saved successfully.' }),
              data: ProductSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      400: { description: 'Bad request', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // GET /api/v1/products/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/products/{id}',
    summary: 'Get Product Details',
    description: 'Retrieve a product by its numeric ID or its barcode.',
    tags: ['Products & Catalog'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().openapi({ description: 'Numeric ID or Barcode', example: '4800016644833' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Product found',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              data: ProductSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'Product not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });
}

  reason: z.string().default('Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging').openapi({ example: 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging' }),
  explanation: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'Crushed box during delivery transport.' }),
  photos: z.array(z.string()).default([]).openapi({ example: ['https://example.com/damage-photo-1.jpg'] }),
  reporter_name: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'Juan Dela Cruz' }),
  reporter_contact: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: '09171234567' }),
  reported_by: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Jarmen (API)' }),
  store_branch: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'Savemore Taguig - Branch 14', description: 'Customer store / branch (Customer Hub customer_inbound only; always null/omitted on Supplier RTV supplier_outbound)' }),
  invoice_dr_number: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'DR-2026-8891' }),
  si_number: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'SI-2026-9021' }),
  dr_number: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'DR-2026-8891' }),
  po_number: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'PO-2026-4401' }),
  expiry_date: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: '2026-12-31', description: 'ISO YYYY-MM-DD expiry date (required for Supplier RTV & Test Mode; optional for Live Customer Hub)' }),
  gps_latitude: z.number().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 14.6683 }),
  gps_longitude: z.number().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 121.0114 }),
  gps_address: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: '64 Mendez Rd, Baesa, Quezon City, Metro Manila 1106', description: 'Pinpoint geofence anchor (`known_gps_locations`) or Google/Nominatim reverse-geocoded street/barangay/city/ZIP address' }),
  is_parent: z.boolean().default(false).openapi({ example: false, description: 'True if this report is a batch return manifest container' }),
  parent_rma_id: z.number().int().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: null, description: 'Parent report ID if this is a line item inside a batch return manifest' }),
  items: z.array(z.any()).default([]).openapi({ example: [], description: 'Line item breakdown objects for multi-item return manifests' }),
  total_items: z.number().int().default(1).openapi({ example: 1, description: 'Total distinct items in manifest' }),
  total_quantity: z.number().int().default(1).openapi({ example: 1, description: 'Summed quantity across all items in manifest' }),
  notes: z.string().nullable().optional().openapi({ example: 'Customer returned item with receipt' }),
  reorder_status: ReorderStatusEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'pending', description: 'Independent replacement PO status (pending or reordered)' }),
  reordered_at: z.string().datetime().nullable().optional(),
  reordered_by: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  reorder_po_number: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  ai_document_metadata: z.object({
    is_test: z.boolean().optional(),
    test_mode: z.boolean().optional(),
    workflow_resolution: z.enum(['restocked', 'reordered', 'scrapped_no_reorder']).optional(),
    reorder: ReorderMetadataSchema.optional(),
    supplier_pickup: SupplierPickupMetadataSchema.optional(),
    follow_up: FollowUpMetadataSchema.optional()
  }).passthrough().optional().openapi({ description: 'Structured metadata including independent reorder tracking, 5-slot multi-photo driver pickup, 4-Step / 10-Day SLA follow-up tracking, and Test Mode isolation flags' }),
  created_at: z.string().datetime().openapi({ example: '2026-10-26T14:30:00.000Z' })
}).openapi('RMAReport');

  rejection_reason: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Customer damage outside return window' }),

  explanation: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Crushed box during unloading' }),

export const UpdateRMAReportSchema = z.object({
  rma_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'RMA-2026-0099-6KKW', description: 'Reconstruct or restore exact historical/deleted RMA ID' }),
  created_at: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '2026-11-01T09:30:00.000Z', description: 'Historical ingest timestamp' }),
  is_test: z.boolean().optional().openapi({ example: false, description: 'Toggle between Test Mode Sandbox (true) and Live Production Hub (false) with 100% silent guarantee (zero emails)' }),
  name: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Oishi Prawn Crackers 50g' }),
  barcode: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '4800016644833' }),
  code: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'P2678P' }),
  supplier_name: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Liwayway Marketing' }),
  unit_name: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'pc' }),
  status: z.union([RMAStatusEnum, z.literal('reordered')]).optional().openapi({ example: 'pending', description: 'Lifecycle status update ("pending" resets 4-Choice/SLA cleanly; "restocked" or "scrapped" resolves outcome; "reordered" updates reorder_status safely without marking Scrapped or closing SLA).' }),
  reorder_status: ReorderStatusEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'reordered', description: 'Set independent Replacement PO status ("pending" or "reordered") without altering 4-Choice Outcome or 10-day SLA' }),
  reorder_notes: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Replacement stock ordered under PO-2026-9901' }),
  warehouse_location: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Good Stock Area', description: 'Standardized warehouse area (e.g. Good Stock Area, Supplier Return Area (RTV), Disposal / Scrap Area, Receiving Area)' }),
  notes: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Confirmed restocked into WMS' }),
  disposition: RMADispositionEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'Restock to Inventory' }),
  condition_grade: RMAConditionGradeEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'A - Like New / Resellable' }),
  rma_type: RMATypeEnum.optional().openapi({ example: 'customer_inbound', description: 'Reclassify logistics type between customer_inbound and supplier_outbound' }),
  workflow_resolution: z.enum(['restocked', 'reordered', 'scrapped_no_reorder']).optional().openapi({ example: 'restocked', description: 'Resolution workflow flag stored safely in ai_document_metadata' }),
  needs_reorder: z.boolean().optional().openapi({ example: true, description: 'Purchasing replenishment switch: true flags for supplier re-order, false marks as write-off' }),
  hold_reason: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Packaging seal torn during transit' }),
  rejection_reason: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Outside return window' }),
  quantity: z.number().int().min(1).optional().openapi({ example: 3 }),
  store_branch: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'Savemore Taguig - Branch 14', description: 'Customer Hub (customer_inbound) branch only; null/ignored for supplier_outbound' }),
  invoice_dr_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'DR-2026-8891' }),
  si_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'SI-2026-9021' }),

  po_number: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: 'PO-2026-4401' }),
  expiry_date: z.string().optional().openapi({ example: '2026-12-31' }),
