export function registerRMARoutes(registry) {
  // GET /api/v1/rma
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/rma',
    summary: 'List RMA Return Reports (Restock & Re-order Queues)',
    description: `Fetch paginated return reports with dedicated support for ERP inventory queues.
Individual line items are automatically returned and generic parent manifest containers are filtered out, completely eliminating double-counting.

### 🟢 Queue 1: Ready to Restock Queue (?queue=restock)
To fetch all goods approved for warehouse restocking:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X GET "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma?queue=restock" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..."
\`\`\`
After restocking into ERP, confirm via PATCH:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X PATCH "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma/{id}" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..." \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"status": "restocked", "warehouse_location": "Good Stock Area"}'
\`\`\`

### 🔴 Queue 2: Supplier Re-Order Queue (?queue=reorder & ?reorder_status=pending)
To fetch items awaiting replacement PO without marking them Scrapped:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X GET "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma?queue=reorder" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..."
\`\`\`
After placing replacement PO, confirm independently via PATCH (keeps 4-Choice Outcome & 10-Day SLA untouched):
\`\`\`bash
curl -X PATCH "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma/{id}" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..." \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"reorder_status": "reordered", "po_number": "PO-2026-9901"}'
\`\`\`

### 🟣 Queue 3: Vendor Recovery / RTV (?queue=rtv_debit)
To fetch all merchandise scheduled for outbound Return to Vendor (RTV) claims:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X GET "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma?queue=rtv_debit" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..."
\`\`\`

### 🟡 Queue 4: Legacy Quarantine Query (?queue=quarantine)
Retained for backwards-compatible REST API consumers; portal UI workflows now route items directly via the 4-Choice Outcome & Pickup Wizard (\`picked_up\`, \`restocked\`, \`scrapped\`, or \`credit_memo_issued\`).
\`\`\`bash
curl -X GET "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma?queue=quarantine" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..."
\`\`\`

### 🧪 Test Mode Sandbox (?test_mode=true)
Pass \`test_mode=true\` to isolate queries and updates strictly within the Sandbox environment without altering live records:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X GET "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma?test_mode=true&queue=restock" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..."
\`\`\`
Reset any ticket back to pending for re-testing:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X PATCH "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma/{id}" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..." \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"status": "pending"}'
\`\`\`
`,
    tags: ['RMA Reports'],
    request: {
      query: PaginationQuerySchema.extend({
        rma_type: z.enum(['customer_inbound', 'supplier_outbound']).optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by logistics type: customer_inbound or supplier_outbound', example: 'customer_inbound' }),
        queue: z.enum(['restock', 'reorder', 'scrap', 'rtv_debit', 'quarantine']).optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by 4-pillar operational queue: "restock" (ready to restock in WMS), "reorder" or "scrap" (re-order replacement from supplier), "rtv_debit" (vendor recovery / outbound RTV claims), "quarantine" (items on hold)', example: 'restock' }),
        reorder_status: ReorderStatusEnum.optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by independent Reorder Status ("pending" or "reordered")', example: 'pending' }),
        test_mode: z.enum(['true', 'false']).optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by test mode: "true" returns sandbox test records only, "false" or omitted returns live production records only', example: 'false' }),
        lifecycle: z.enum(['active', 'archived', 'trashed']).optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by lifecycle state: "active" (default), "archived" (Enterprise Archive Vault), "trashed" (30-day soft trash bin)', example: 'active' }),
        status: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by status (pending, open, restocked, scrapped). "pending" and "open" return all pre-finalized active returns.', example: 'pending' }),
        barcode: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by exact product barcode', example: '4800016644833' }),
        disposition: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by warehouse triage disposition (e.g. "Restock to Inventory", "Return to Vendor (RTV)", "Scrap / Dispose")', example: 'Restock to Inventory' }),
        condition_grade: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by item grade condition', example: 'A - Like New / Resellable' }),
        warehouse_location: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by standardized warehouse area (e.g. "Good Stock Area", "Supplier Return Area (RTV)", "Disposal / Scrap Area")', example: 'Good Stock Area' }),
        is_parent: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Filter by parent manifest container (true) or individual items (false, default)', example: 'false' }),
        search: z.string().optional().openapi({ description: 'Search term across RMA #, name, SKU, or reporter', example: 'Oishi' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'List of RMA reports',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              client: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Jarmen' }),
              total: z.number().openapi({ example: 142 }),
              limit: z.number().openapi({ example: 50 }),
              offset: z.number().openapi({ example: 0 }),
              data: z.array(RMAReportSchema)
            })
          }
        }
      },
      401: { description: 'Missing or invalid API key', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // POST /api/v1/rma
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'post',
    path: '/api/v1/rma',
    summary: 'Submit New RMA Return Report',
    description: 'Submits a return report from an external system. Automatically assigns an RMA number and attributes the report to the authenticated client system.',
    tags: ['RMA Reports'],
    request: {
      body: {
        required: true,
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: CreateRMAReportSchema
          }
        }
      }
    },
    responses: {
      201: {
        description: 'RMA report successfully created',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'RMA report RMA-2026-0001-6TYH created successfully.' }),
              client: z.string().openapi({ example: 'Jarmen' }),
              data: RMAReportSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      400: { description: 'Validation error', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } },
      401: { description: 'Unauthorized', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // GET /api/v1/rma/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'get',
    path: '/api/v1/rma/{id}',
    summary: 'Get Single RMA Report',
    description: 'Retrieve a return report by its numeric database ID or its public RMA Number (e.g. RMA-2026-0001-6TYH).',
    tags: ['RMA Reports'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().openapi({ description: 'Numeric ID or RMA Number', example: 'RMA-2026-0001-6TYH' })
      })
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'RMA report retrieved',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              data: RMAReportSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'RMA report not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // PATCH /api/v1/rma/{id}
  registry.registerPath({
    method: 'patch',
    path: '/api/v1/rma/{id}',
    summary: 'Update RMA Report (Acknowledge Restocked / Scrapped)',
    description: `Update status, warehouse location, inspection notes, or details of an existing RMA report.

### 📦 1. Coworker Inventory Restock Acknowledgment:
When your ERP system has added the returned quantity to your warehouse stock count, call this endpoint to mark the RMA ticket as **restocked**:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X PATCH "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma/RMA-2026-0001-6TYH" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..." \\
  -d '{
    "status": "restocked",
    "disposition": "2- Restock to Inventory",
    "warehouse_location": "RACK-03-BIN-A",
    "notes": "Added to inventory counts in ERP (Ref #INV-8821)"
  }'
\`\`\`

### 🗑️ 2. Coworker Scrapped / Supplier Re-order Acknowledgment:
When your procurement system has processed the scrapped item and placed a replacement Purchase Order to the supplier:
\`\`\`bash
curl -X PATCH "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma/RMA-2026-0001-6TYH" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "x-api-key: sk_live_rma_..." \\
  -d '{
    "status": "scrapped",
    "disposition": "5- Scrap / Dispose",
    "warehouse_location": "SCRAP-BIN",
    "notes": "Item marked scrapped. Replacement supplier PO #PO-2026-9901 issued."
  }'
\`\`\``,
    tags: ['RMA Reports'],
    request: {
      params: z.object({
        id: z.string().openapi({ description: 'Numeric ID or RMA Number', example: 'RMA-2026-0001-6TYH' })
      }),
      body: {
        required: true,
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: UpdateRMAReportSchema
          }
        }
      }
    },
    responses: {
      200: {
        description: 'Report updated successfully',
        content: {
          'application/json': {
            schema: z.object({
              success: z.boolean().openapi({ example: true }),
              message: z.string().openapi({ example: 'RMA report updated.' }),
              data: RMAReportSchema
            })
          }
        }
      },
      404: { description: 'Report not found', content: { 'application/json': { schema: StandardErrorSchema } } }
    }
  });

  // DELETE /api/v1/rma/{id}
  registry.registerPath({

  // POST /api/v1/ai/inspect-paperwork
  registry.registerPath({

    responses: {

  // GET /api/v1/rma-email-edit
  registry.registerPath({

import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';

export const DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL = 'mgan@pingconmarketing.com';

export function normalizeSandboxEmail(raw) {
  const s = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(s) ? s : DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL;
}

export const DEFAULT_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS = {
  toEmail: 'azgodev@gmail.com',
  baseCcList: [
    'mgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'marketing@pingconmarketing.com',
    'azgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com'
  ]
};

export function escapeEmailHtml(val) {
  return String(val ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

/**
 * Ensures Test Mode email subjects ALWAYS begin with "[TEST] " as the first word,
 * stripping legacy "Test -" or "[TEST MODE]" prefixes to prevent duplication.
 */
export function formatTestEmailSubject(subject, isTestMode = false) {
  const raw = String(subject || '').trim();
  if (!isTestMode) return raw;
  let clean = raw;
  while (/^(?:\[test(?:\s+mode)?\]|test\s*[-:])\s*/i.test(clean)) {
    clean = clean.replace(/^(?:\[test(?:\s+mode)?\]|test\s*[-:])\s*/i, '').trim();
  }
  return clean ? `[TEST] ${clean}` : '[TEST] Notification';
}

export function getDiagnosticHelp(errMsg, user, pass) {
  const str = String(errMsg || '');
  if (str.includes('535') || str.includes('BadCredentials') || str.includes('Username and Password not accepted')) {
    return `Google SMTP rejected login for "${user}". Your App Password has ${pass.length} characters (Google App Passwords are 16 letters). If you see 535 Bad Credentials, please verify: (1) Ensure 2-Step Verification is enabled in your Google Account for ${user}, (2) Ensure the App Password was generated under ${user} (Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords), and (3) In Vercel Environment Variables, check GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD and make sure all 16 characters were pasted accurately.`;
  }
  return null;
}

export function createSmtpTransport() {
  const smtpUser = String(process.env.SMTP_USER || process.env.GMAIL_USER || 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com').trim();
  const rawPass = process.env.SMTP_PASS || process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD || process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD || '';
  const cleanPass = String(rawPass).replace(/\s+/g, '').trim();

  if (!cleanPass) {
    return {
      configured: false,
      transporter: null,
      smtpUser,
      rawPass,
      cleanPass,
      hadSpaces: rawPass.includes(' ')
    };
  }

  const isGmail = !process.env.SMTP_HOST || process.env.SMTP_HOST.includes('gmail.com');
  const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport(
    isGmail
      ? {
          service: 'gmail',
          auth: {
            user: smtpUser,
            pass: cleanPass
          }
        }
      : {
          host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,
          port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT || 465),
          secure: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT || 465) === 465,
          auth: {
            user: smtpUser,
            pass: cleanPass
          }
        }
  );

  return {
    configured: true,
    transporter,
    smtpUser,
    rawPass,
    cleanPass,
    hadSpaces: rawPass.includes(' ')
  };
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_URL || 'https://lschluviltzsknptwgrz.supabase.co';
const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || 'sb_publishable_Jrv9ZNgGXJ4PZoNWCJSHxQ_7hZtQqd3';

// Dummy WebSocket class to avoid Node.js Realtime WebSocket instantiation error in serverless environments
class NoopWebSocketTransport {}

/**
 * Free-Tier Connection Optimization:
 * Serverless lambdas run over HTTPS/PostgREST.
 * Caching on globalThis reuses TCP/TLS connections and HTTP keep-alive agents across warm Vercel invocations,
 * preventing connection spikes against Supabase's free-tier pool.
 * Note: If using direct PostgreSQL connections (e.g. pg / prisma), use Supavisor Transaction Pooler port 6543.
 */
function getSupabaseClient() {
  if (globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient) {
    return globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient;
  }

  const client = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, {
    auth: {
      persistSession: false,
      autoRefreshToken: false,
    },
    realtime: {
      transport: NoopWebSocketTransport,
    },
  });

  globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient = client;
  return client;
}

export const supabase = getSupabaseClient();

--- START FILE: api/_lib/verifyPinHandler.js ---
import { supabase } from './supabase.js';
import { sendJson, setCorsHeaders } from './auth.js';

/**
 * Enterprise Anti-Fraud Gatekeeper Verification & Cooldown Lockout Engine
 * 
 * Verifies 6-digit PIN against active QR profile, checks physical device fingerprint
 * and client IP against public.device_intake_sessions, and enforces unbypassable
 * hardware-level cooldown periods across Incognito, private tabs, and different browsers.
 */

export async function handleVerifyPin(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, {
      success: false,
      error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
      message: 'Only POST method is permitted for PIN verification.'
    });
  }

  try {
    let body = req.body;
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(body);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const { slug, pin, deviceFingerprint } = body || {};

    if (!slug || typeof slug !== 'string' || !slug.trim()) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        message: 'Station access slug is required.'
      });
    }

    if (!pin || !/^\d{6}$/.test(String(pin).trim())) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        message: 'A valid 6-digit numeric PIN is required.'
      });
    }

    // Extract client IP address from network headers
    const forwarded = req.headers['x-forwarded-for'];
    const clientIp = forwarded 
      ? String(forwarded).split(',')[0].trim() 
      : (req.headers['x-real-ip'] || req.socket?.remoteAddress || '127.0.0.1');

    const cleanSlug = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanPin = String(pin).trim();
    const cleanFingerprint = String(deviceFingerprint || `ip_${clientIp}`).trim();

    // 1. STEP A: Profile & PIN check
    let profile = null;

    // Check public.portal_access_keys in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('portal_access_keys')
        .select('*')
        .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!error && data) {
        profile = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('portal_access_keys query error:', e);
    }

    // Fallback to rma_settings if table empty or in migration
    if (!profile) {
      try {
        const { data: settingsData } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', 'portal_access_keys_store')
          .single();

        if (settingsData?.value && Array.isArray(settingsData.value)) {
          profile = settingsData.value.find(p => p.access_slug?.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Fallback to hardcoded defaults for seamless out-of-the-box bootstrapping
    if (!profile) {
      if (cleanSlug === 'dock') {
        profile = {
          name: 'Main Warehouse Floor',
          type: 'internal_warehouse',
          access_slug: 'dock',
          pin_code: '123456',
          session_duration_hours: 0,
          cooldown_duration_hours: 0,
          is_active: true
        };
      } else if (cleanSlug === 'returns') {
        profile = {
          name: 'Customer Delivery Boxes',
          type: 'external_customer',
          access_slug: 'returns',
          pin_code: '654321',
          session_duration_hours: 2,
          cooldown_duration_hours: 6,
          is_active: true
        };
      }
    }

    if (!profile) {
      return sendJson(res, 404, {
        success: false,
        error: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'QR Access Profile not found.'
      });
    }

    if (!profile.is_active) {
      return sendJson(res, 403, {
        success: false,
        error: 'INACTIVE',
        message: 'This QR Access Code has been deactivated by warehouse administration.'
      });
    }

    // Verify 6-digit PIN
    if (cleanPin !== String(profile.pin_code).trim()) {
      return sendJson(res, 401, {
        success: false,
        error: 'INVALID_PIN',
        message: 'Incorrect 6-digit PIN code. Please retry.'
      });
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const nowIso = now.toISOString();

    // 2. STEP B: Internal Warehouse profiles bypass customer cooldowns
    if (profile.type === 'internal_warehouse' || Number(profile.session_duration_hours) === 0) {
      const sessionToken = `gate_wh_${profile.access_slug}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
      return sendJson(res, 200, {
        success: true,
        profile: {
          id: profile.id,
          name: profile.name,
          type: profile.type,
          access_slug: profile.access_slug,
          session_duration_hours: 0,
          cooldown_duration_hours: 0
        },
        session: {
          token: sessionToken,
          slug: profile.access_slug,
          profileId: profile.id,
          profileName: profile.name,
          type: profile.type,
          durationHours: 0,
          unlockedAt: nowIso,
          expiresAt: null, // Permanent
          cooldownUntil: null,
          deviceFingerprint: cleanFingerprint
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. STEP C: External Customer Cooldown & Anti-Bypass Check
    // Query public.device_intake_sessions for this device or IP
    try {
      const { data: existingSessions, error: sessErr } = await supabase
        .from('device_intake_sessions')
        .select('*')
        .or(`device_fingerprint.eq.${cleanFingerprint},ip_address.eq.${clientIp}`)
        .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug)
        .order('cooldown_until', { ascending: false })
        .limit(5);

      if (!sessErr && Array.isArray(existingSessions) && existingSessions.length > 0) {
        for (const s of existingSessions) {
          const cooldownDate = new Date(s.cooldown_until);
          const expiresDate = new Date(s.session_expires_at);

          // CASE 1: Device is currently within an ACTIVE unlocked session window
          if (now < expiresDate) {
            return sendJson(res, 200, {
              success: true,
              existingActiveSession: true,
              profile: {
                id: profile.id,
                name: profile.name,
                type: profile.type,
                access_slug: profile.access_slug,
                session_duration_hours: profile.session_duration_hours,
                cooldown_duration_hours: profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
              },
              session: {
                token: `gate_cust_${profile.access_slug}_${new Date(s.session_started_at).getTime().toString(36)}`,
                slug: profile.access_slug,
                profileId: profile.id,
                profileName: profile.name,
                type: profile.type,
                durationHours: profile.session_duration_hours,
                unlockedAt: s.session_started_at,
                expiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
                cooldownUntil: s.cooldown_until,
                deviceFingerprint: cleanFingerprint
              }
            });
          }

          // CASE 2: Active session has expired, and device is strictly in COOLDOWN LOCKOUT
          if (now >= expiresDate && now < cooldownDate) {
            const diffMs = cooldownDate.getTime() - now.getTime();
            const cooldownRemainingMinutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000)));

            return sendJson(res, 429, {
              success: false,
              error: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
              message: 'Return Window Currently Locked: Your previous RMA session has concluded. To prevent duplicate submissions, this portal will unlock again once the cooldown concludes.',
              cooldownRemainingMinutes,
              unlocksAt: s.cooldown_until,
              sessionExpiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
              profileName: profile.name,
              cooldownDurationHours: profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('device_intake_sessions lookup notice:', err);
    }

    // 4. STEP D: Create new session record
    const durationHours = Math.max(0.01, parseFloat(profile.session_duration_hours) || 2);
    const cooldownHours = Math.max(0, parseFloat(profile.cooldown_duration_hours !== undefined ? profile.cooldown_duration_hours : 6));

    const sessionExpiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + (durationHours * 3600 * 1000));
    const cooldownUntil = new Date(sessionExpiresAt.getTime() + (cooldownHours * 3600 * 1000));
    const sessionToken = `gate_cust_${profile.access_slug}_${now.getTime().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;

    try {
      const isUuid = profile.id && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(profile.id);
      await supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').insert([{
        profile_id: isUuid ? profile.id : null,
        access_slug: profile.access_slug,
        device_fingerprint: cleanFingerprint,
        ip_address: clientIp,
        session_started_at: nowIso,
        session_expires_at: sessionExpiresAt.toISOString(),
        cooldown_until: cooldownUntil.toISOString(),
        status: 'active'
      }]);
    } catch (insertErr) {
      console.warn('device_intake_sessions insert notice:', insertErr);
    }

    return sendJson(res, 200, {
      success: true,
      profile: {
        id: profile.id,
        name: profile.name,
        type: profile.type,
        access_slug: profile.access_slug,
        session_duration_hours: durationHours,
        cooldown_duration_hours: cooldownHours
      },
      session: {
        token: sessionToken,
        slug: profile.access_slug,
        profileId: profile.id,
        profileName: profile.name,
        type: profile.type,
        durationHours,
        unlockedAt: nowIso,
        expiresAt: sessionExpiresAt.toISOString(),
        cooldownUntil: cooldownUntil.toISOString(),
        deviceFingerprint: cleanFingerprint
      }
    });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Verify PIN Endpoint] Internal error:', err);
    return sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
      message: err.message || 'An internal error occurred during PIN verification.'
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Admin Emergency Cooldown Reset
 * Clears all active device sessions and cooldown lockouts for a profile.
 */
export async function handleClearCooldown(req, res) {
  setCorsHeaders(res, req);

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return res.status(204).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return sendJson(res, 405, {
      success: false,
      error: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
      message: 'Only POST method is permitted for emergency cooldown reset.'
    });
  }

  try {
    let body = req.body;
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(body);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const { slug, profileId } = body || {};

    if (!slug && !profileId) {
      return sendJson(res, 400, {
        success: false,
        error: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        message: 'Profile slug or ID is required.'
      });
    }

    let query = supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').delete();
    if (slug) {
      query = query.eq('access_slug', String(slug).trim().toLowerCase());
    } else if (profileId) {
      query = query.eq('profile_id', profileId);
    }

    const { error } = await query;
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to clear device sessions:', error);
    }

    return sendJson(res, 200, {
      success: true,
      message: `Emergency reset successful: All device cooldown lockouts for "${slug || profileId}" have been cleared.`
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Clear Cooldown Endpoint] Error:', err);
    return sendJson(res, 500, {
      success: false,
      error: 'SERVER_ERROR',
      message: err.message || 'Failed to clear cooldown lockouts.'
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Resolves the QR Intake slug from pathname, hash, or query parameters.
 * Examples:
 * - /intake/dock -> "dock"
 * - /intake/returns -> "returns"
 * - #/intake/dock -> "dock"
 * - /?intake=dock -> "dock"
 * - /?slug=dock -> "dock"
 */
function getIntakeSlugFromUrl() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const path = window.location.pathname.toLowerCase();
  const hash = window.location.hash.toLowerCase();

  const pathMatch = path.match(/^\/intake\/([^/?#]+)/i);
  if (pathMatch && pathMatch[1]) return decodeURIComponent(pathMatch[1]);

  const hashMatch = hash.match(/^#\/intake\/([^/?#]+)/i);
  if (hashMatch && hashMatch[1]) return decodeURIComponent(hashMatch[1]);

  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const paramSlug = params.get('intake') || params.get('slug');
    if (paramSlug) return decodeURIComponent(paramSlug);
  } catch { }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Reconciles Google OAuth / Magic Link callback redirects for public invite tokens.
 * If Supabase's Site URL redirected an invite OAuth login to '/admin#access_token=...',
 * this immediately restores '/intake?token=...' while preserving the '#access_token' hash
 * so GatekeeperPinModal can verify the Google identity cleanly.
 */
function reconcileInviteOAuthRedirectOnLoad() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const hash = window.location.hash || '';
    const search = window.location.search || '';
    const path = window.location.pathname.toLowerCase();

    const hasAuthCallback =
      hash.includes('access_token=') ||
      hash.includes('id_token=') ||
      /[?&]code=/.test(search) ||
      /[?&]token_hash=/.test(search);

    const isOAuthInProgress =
      localStorage.getItem('rma_oauth_in_progress') === 'true' ||
      sessionStorage.getItem('rma_oauth_in_progress') === 'true';

    const pendingToken =
      new URLSearchParams(search).get('token') ||
      localStorage.getItem('rma_pending_oauth_token') ||
      sessionStorage.getItem('rma_pending_oauth_token') ||
      localStorage.getItem('rma_active_invite_token') ||
      sessionStorage.getItem('rma_active_invite_token');

    if (hasAuthCallback && isOAuthInProgress && pendingToken) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('rma_active_invite_token', pendingToken);
      sessionStorage.setItem('rma_pending_oauth_token', pendingToken);
      sessionStorage.setItem('rma_oauth_in_progress', 'true');
      localStorage.setItem('rma_active_invite_token', pendingToken);
      localStorage.setItem('rma_pending_oauth_token', pendingToken);
      localStorage.setItem('rma_oauth_in_progress', 'true');

      const currentParams = new URLSearchParams(search);
      if (path.startsWith('/admin') || currentParams.get('token') !== pendingToken) {
        window.history.replaceState(
          null,
          '',
          `/intake?token=${encodeURIComponent(pendingToken)}${hash}`
        );
      }
      return pendingToken;
    }

    // If visiting /admin directly (not returning from an invite OAuth flow), clear leftover invite token flags
    if (path === '/admin' || path.startsWith('/admin/') || hash.toLowerCase() === '#/admin' || search.includes('admin=true')) {
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_active_invite_token');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_pending_oauth_token');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_oauth_in_progress');
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_pending_oauth_token');
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_oauth_in_progress');
    }
  } catch { }
  return null;
}

const SESSION_QRS_LIVE_KEY = 'rma_portal_session_qrs_live';
const SESSION_QRS_TEST_KEY = 'rma_portal_session_qrs_test';

function readSessionSubmittedQrs(isTest = false) {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.sessionStorage) return [];
    const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(isTest ? SESSION_QRS_TEST_KEY : SESSION_QRS_LIVE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((r) => r && typeof r === 'object') : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function writeSessionSubmittedQrs(isTest = false, list = []) {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.sessionStorage) return;
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(
      isTest ? SESSION_QRS_TEST_KEY : SESSION_QRS_LIVE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify((Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).slice(0, 40))
    );
  } catch {}
}
