                      />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* OPERATIONS: AWAITING SKU QUEUE (EMBEDDED NATIVE PAGE) */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'pending_barcodes' && (
                    <PendingBarcodesModal
                      isOpen={true}
                      isEmbeddedPage={true}
                      onClose={() => setAdminActiveTab('customer_reports')}
                      pendingList={pendingBarcodesList}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      onUpdated={() => {
                        refreshAllData();
                        showToast('Barcode details and reference photo updated!', 'success');
                      }}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* CATALOG & RECORDS: FULL AUDIT & REPORTS (EMBEDDED NATIVE PAGE) */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'rma_reports' && (
                    <RMAReportsModal
                      isOpen={true}
                      isEmbeddedPage={true}
                      onClose={() => setAdminActiveTab('customer_reports')}
                      reports={liveReportsList}
                      liveReportsList={liveReportsList}
                      testReportsList={testReportsList}
                      liveCreditMemosList={liveCreditMemosList}
                      testCreditMemosList={testCreditMemosList}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      onDeleteReport={requestDeleteReport}
                      onBulkDeleteReport={requestBulkDeleteReports}
                      creditMemosList={liveCreditMemosList}
                      savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
                      isTestMode={false}
                      onEditProductFromReport={handleEditProductFromReport}
                      onViewReportQR={(repOrList) => openQrModal(repOrList)}
                      onOpenCreditMemo={(rep) => handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(rep)}
                      onViewCreditMemoVoucher={(memo) => handleViewCreditMemoVoucher(memo)}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* CATALOG & RECORDS: ARCHIVE & 30-DAY TRASH BIN */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'archive_trash' && (
                    <ArchiveAndTrashTab
                      archivedReports={archivedReportsList}
                      trashedReports={trashedReportsList}
                      archivedReportsList={archivedReportsList}
                      trashedReportsList={trashedReportsList}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      onRefresh={refreshAllData}
                      onRestore={handleRestoreFromTrashOrArchive}
                      onPermanentlyDelete={handlePermanentlyDeleteReport}
                      onEmptyTrash={handleEmptyTrash}
                      onViewPhoto={(photoObj) => setLightboxPhoto(photoObj)}
                      savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* DIRECTORY & LOCATIONS: SUPPLIER DIRECTORY (EMBEDDED NATIVE PAGE) */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'supplier_directory' && (
                    <SupplierDirectoryModal
                      isOpen={true}
                      isEmbeddedPage={true}
                      onClose={() => setAdminActiveTab('supplier_claims')}
                      onShowToast={showToast}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* DIRECTORY & LOCATIONS: WAREHOUSE LOCATIONS & GPS ANCHORS */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'warehouse_locations' && currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' && (
                    <SettingsTab
                      viewMode="warehouse_locations"
                      isTestMode={isTestMode}
                      onToggleTestMode={toggleTestMode}
                      onOpenPortalQr={() => setAdminActiveTab('rma_invites')}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      onNavigateTab={setAdminActiveTab}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* ACCESS & INTEGRATIONS: CUSTOMER & RMA INVITES (EMBEDDED NATIVE PAGE) */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'rma_invites' && (
                    <CustomerRMAInvitesModal
                      isOpen={true}
                      isEmbeddedPage={true}
                      onClose={() => setAdminActiveTab('customer_reports')}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* ACCESS & INTEGRATIONS: ROLES & TEAM ACCESS (EMBEDDED NATIVE PAGE) */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'roles_access' && currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' && (
                    <EmployeeManagementModal
                      isOpen={true}
                      isEmbeddedPage={true}
                      onClose={() => setAdminActiveTab('products')}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* ACCESS & INTEGRATIONS: API KEYS & WEBHOOKS */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'api_keys' && currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' && (
                    <SettingsTab
                      viewMode="api_keys"
                      isTestMode={isTestMode}
                      onToggleTestMode={toggleTestMode}
                      onOpenPortalQr={() => setAdminActiveTab('rma_invites')}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      onNavigateTab={setAdminActiveTab}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* QA & SYSTEM: TEST MODE SANDBOX */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'sandbox' && (
                    <TestModeSandboxTab
                      testReportsList={testReportsList}
                      testCreditMemosList={testCreditMemosList}
                      savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      coworkerQueueFilter={coworkerQueueFilter}
                      onClearCoworkerQueueFilter={() => setCoworkerQueueFilter('all')}
                      updatingQueueId={updatingQueueId}
                      activeSubTab={sandboxSubTab}
                      onSubTabChange={setSandboxSubTab}
                      customerHubSubTab={sandboxCustomerSubTab}
                      externalCustomerSubTab={sandboxExternalSubTab}
                      onCustomerHubSubTabChange={handleSandboxCustomerSubTabChange}
                      onRefresh={refreshAllData}
                      onInspectTriage={handleInspectTriageForReport}
                      onViewQR={(reportOrList) => openQrModal(reportOrList)}
                      onViewPhoto={(photoObj) => setLightboxPhoto(photoObj)}
                      onRequestDeleteReport={requestDeleteReport}
                      onRequestBulkDeleteReports={requestBulkDeleteReports}
                      onArchiveReport={handleArchiveReport}
                      onBulkArchiveReports={handleBulkArchiveReports}
                      onClearAllSandbox={requestClearAllSandbox}
                      onAssignSku={(report) => handleEditProductFromReport(report)}
                      onEditProductFromReport={handleEditProductFromReport}
                      onResetToPending={handleResetReportToPending}
                      onConfirmCoworkerAction={handleConfirmCoworkerAction}
                      onOpenReportsModal={() => setIsReportsModalOpen(true)}
                      onOpenCreditMemosLedger={() => {
                        setCreditMemoScopeIsTest(true);
                        setAdminActiveTab('credit_memos');
                      }}
                      onOpenCreateCreditMemo={handleOpenCreateCreditMemo}
                      onOpenCreditMemoForReport={handleOpenCreditMemoForReport}
                      onEditCreditMemo={handleEditCreditMemo}
                      onViewCreditMemoVoucher={handleViewCreditMemoVoucher}
                      onRequestDeleteCreditMemo={requestDeleteCreditMemo}
                      onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemos={requestBulkDeleteCreditMemos}
                      onOpenQuickAction={(rmaNumber) => {
                        setQuickRmaNumber(rmaNumber);
                        setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onViewExplanation={(info) => setViewingExplanationModal(info)}
                      onOpenSimpleWizard={(reportOrList) => openSimpleWizardModal(reportOrList, 'wizard')}
                      onOpenPickupForm={(reportOrList) => openPickupFormModal(reportOrList)}
                      onOpenMatrixExport={() => setMatrixExportModal({
                        isOpen: true,
                        stream: 'overall',
                        isTestMode: true
                      })}
                    />
                  )}

                  {/* QA & SYSTEM: SYSTEM SETTINGS */}
                  {normalizedTab === 'settings' && currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' && (
                    <SettingsTab
                      viewMode="settings"
                      isTestMode={isTestMode}
                      onToggleTestMode={toggleTestMode}
                      onOpenPortalQr={() => setAdminActiveTab('rma_invites')}
                      currentUser={currentUser}
                      onNavigateTab={setAdminActiveTab}
                    />
                  )}

                </main>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })()}

      </div>

      {/* Admin Login Modal (OTP Verification Gate) */}
      <AdminLoginModal
        key={isLoginModalOpen ? 'active-admin-login-modal' : 'inactive-admin-login-modal'}
        isOpen={isLoginModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsLoginModalOpen(false);
          if (!currentUser) navigateTo('/');
        }}
        onLoginSuccess={(user) => {
          setCurrentUser(user);
          setIsLoginModalOpen(false);
          showToast(`Welcome back, ${user.name}! Authenticated as ${user.role}.`, 'success');
        }}
      />

      {/* Super Admin Employee Access & Roles Management Modal */}
      <EmployeeManagementModal
        isOpen={isEmployeeModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsEmployeeModalOpen(false)}
        currentUser={currentUser}
      />

      {/* Camera Scanner Modal */}
      <ScannerModal
        isOpen={isScannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsScannerOpen(false)}
        onScanSuccess={async (code) => {
          setIsScannerOpen(false);
          await handlePortalQrScanResult(code);
        }}
      />

      {/* Admin Pending Barcodes Modal (With Photo Upload) */}
      <PendingBarcodesModal
        isOpen={isPendingModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPendingModalOpen(false)}
        pendingList={pendingBarcodesList}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onUpdated={() => {
          refreshAllData();
          showToast('Barcode details and reference photo updated!', 'success');
        }}
      />

      {/* Full Reports Modal */}
      <RMAReportsModal
        isOpen={isReportsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsReportsModalOpen(false)}
        reports={adminActiveTab === 'sandbox' ? testReportsList : liveReportsList}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onDeleteReport={requestDeleteReport}
        onBulkDeleteReport={requestBulkDeleteReports}
        creditMemosList={adminActiveTab === 'sandbox' ? testCreditMemosList : liveCreditMemosList}
        savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
        isTestMode={adminActiveTab === 'sandbox'}
        onEditProductFromReport={handleEditProductFromReport}
        onViewReportQR={(repOrList) => openQrModal(repOrList)}
        onOpenCreditMemo={(rep) => {
          setIsReportsModalOpen(false);
          handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(rep);
        }}
        onViewCreditMemoVoucher={(memo) => {
          setIsReportsModalOpen(false);
          handleViewCreditMemoVoucher(memo);
        }}
      />

      {/* Product Edit / Add Modal */}
      <ProductEditModal
        isOpen={isProductEditOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsProductEditOpen(false);
          setEditingProduct(null);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        product={editingProduct}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onSaved={async (prod) => {
          const barcode = prod?.barcode ? String(prod.barcode).trim() : '';
          const name = prod?.name || '';
          const code = prod?.code || prod?.sku || '';
          const supplierName = prod?.supplier_name || prod?.supplierName || 'Savemore';
          const price = Number(prod?.price || 0);
          const priceWithVat = Number(prod?.price_with_vat || prod?.priceWithVat || price || 0);
          const unitName = prod?.unit_name || prod?.unitName || 'pc';
          const piecesPerCase = prod?.pieces_per_case || prod?.piecesPerCase || null;
          const aeName = prod?.ae_name || prod?.aeName || null;
          const aeEmail = prod?.ae_email || prod?.aeEmail || null;
          const childIdToMatch = prod?.child_id || editingProduct?.child_id;

          if (barcode) {
            // Optimistically update in-memory reports state so UI shows Logged & SKU immediately
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(rep => {
              let updated = { ...rep };
              const isManifestParent = rep.is_parent || (String(rep.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest'));
              if (rep.barcode && String(rep.barcode).trim() === barcode) {
                updated = {
                  ...updated,
                  name: isManifestParent ? rep.name : (name || rep.name),
                  code: code || rep.code,
                  status: 'under_inspection',
                  supplier_name: supplierName,
                  price: price,
                  price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                  unit_name: unitName,
                  pieces_per_case: piecesPerCase
                };
              }
              // Also update child items inside rep.items JSON array
              let parsedItems = Array.isArray(updated.items)
                ? [...updated.items]
                : (typeof updated.items === 'string' ? JSON.parse(updated.items || '[]') : []);
              if (parsedItems.length > 0) {
                let itemsChanged = false;
                parsedItems = parsedItems.map(it => {
                  const matchesBarcode = barcode && it.barcode && String(it.barcode).trim() === barcode;
                  const matchesId = childIdToMatch && it.id && String(it.id) === String(childIdToMatch);
                  if (matchesBarcode || matchesId) {
                    itemsChanged = true;
                    return {
                      ...it,
                      code: code,
                      sku: code,
                      name: name || it.name,
                      productName: name || it.productName || it.name,
                      price: price,
                      price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                      supplier_name: supplierName,
                      unit_name: unitName,
                      pieces_per_case: piecesPerCase
                    };
                  }
                  return it;
                });
                if (itemsChanged) {
                  updated.items = parsedItems;
                }
              }
              return updated;
            }));

            // Optimistically update savedProductsList so manifest drawer badge immediately turns green
            setSavedProductsList(prev => {
              const idx = prev.findIndex(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === barcode);
              const newEntry = {
                ...(idx >= 0 ? prev[idx] : {}),
                ...prod,
                barcode,
                code,
                sku: code,
                name: name || (idx >= 0 ? prev[idx].name : ''),
                price,
                price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                unit_name: unitName,
                pieces_per_case: piecesPerCase,
                piecesPerCase: piecesPerCase,
                supplier_name: supplierName,
                is_verified: true
              };
              if (idx >= 0) {
                const next = [...prev];
                next[idx] = newEntry;
                return next;
              }
              return [...prev, newEntry];
            });

            // Persist to Supabase rma_items, parent rma_reports items array, and report records
            try {
              // 1. Update rma_items child table by numeric child id and barcode safely
              if (childIdToMatch && /^\d+$/.test(String(childIdToMatch))) {
                try {
                  await supabase
                    .from('rma_items')
                    .update({
                      sku: code,
                      name: name,
                      price: price,
                      price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                      supplier_name: supplierName,
                      unit_name: unitName
                    })
                    .eq('id', Number(childIdToMatch));
                } catch (e) {
                  console.warn('Notice updating rma_items by ID:', e?.message);
                }
              }
              if (barcode) {
                try {
                  await supabase
                    .from('rma_items')
                    .update({
                      sku: code,
                      name: name,
                      price: price,
                      price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                      supplier_name: supplierName,
                      unit_name: unitName
                    })
                    .eq('barcode', String(barcode));
                } catch (e) {
                  console.warn('Notice updating rma_items by barcode:', e?.message);
                }
              }

              // 2. Update parent rma_reports JSON items array
              const { data: parentsWithItems } = await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .select('id, items')
                .not('items', 'is', null);

              if (parentsWithItems && parentsWithItems.length > 0) {
                for (const pr of parentsWithItems) {
                  let pItems = Array.isArray(pr.items)
                    ? pr.items
                    : (typeof pr.items === 'string' ? JSON.parse(pr.items || '[]') : []);
                  let hasMatch = false;
                  pItems = pItems.map(it => {
                    const matchesBarcode = barcode && it.barcode && String(it.barcode).trim() === barcode;
                    const matchesId = childIdToMatch && it.id && String(it.id) === String(childIdToMatch);
                    if (matchesBarcode || matchesId) {
                      hasMatch = true;
                      return {
                        ...it,
                        code: code,
                        sku: code,
                        name: name || it.name,
                        productName: name || it.productName || it.name,
                        price: price,
                        price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                        supplier_name: supplierName,
                        unit_name: unitName
                      };
                    }
                    return it;
                  });
                  if (hasMatch) {
                    await supabase
                      .from('rma_reports')
                      .update({ items: pItems })
                      .eq('id', pr.id);
                  }
                }
              }

              // 3. Update rma_reports matching barcode (strictly protect parent manifest names)
              const { data: matchedPending } = await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .select('*')
                .eq('barcode', barcode)
                .or('status.eq.pending_admin_details,name.ilike.%unidentified%');

              await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .update({
                  code: code,
                  price: price,
                  price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                  supplier_name: supplierName,
                  unit_name: unitName,
                  ae_name: aeName,
                  ae_email: aeEmail,
                  status: 'under_inspection'
                })
                .eq('barcode', barcode);

              // Update name only on non-parent records
              await supabase
                .from('rma_reports')
                .update({ name: name })
                .eq('barcode', barcode)
                .neq('is_parent', true)
                .not('name', 'ilike', 'Batch Return Manifest%');

              // If this return was waiting for SKU assignment, dispatch the official RMA report notification email!
              if (matchedPending && matchedPending.length > 0) {
                for (const rep of matchedPending) {
                  const isTestActive = isTestRecord(rep) || effectiveIsTestMode || (typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true');
                  const enrichedReport = {
                    ...rep,
                    name: name,
                    code: code,
                    price: price,
                    price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
                    supplier_name: supplierName,
                    unit_name: unitName,
                    ae_name: aeName,
                    ae_email: aeEmail,
                    status: 'under_inspection'
                  };
                  notificationService.sendRMANotification(enrichedReport, isTestActive).catch(e => {
                    console.warn('Background RMA report notification notice on SKU assignment:', e);
                  });
                }
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.warn('Sync rma_reports from product save notice:', e);
            }
          }
          await refreshAllData();
          showToast(`Product "${name || 'Item'}" saved to catalog and linked reports updated!`, 'success');
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        onDeleted={(prod) => {
          refreshAllData();
          showToast(`Product "${prod.name}" deleted from catalog.`, 'success');
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
      />

      {/* Finance Credit Memo Issue / Edit Modal */}
      <CreditMemoModal
        isOpen={isCreditMemoModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(false);
          setSelectedCreditMemoReport(null);
          setSelectedCreditMemoReports([]);
          setEditingCreditMemo(null);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        report={selectedCreditMemoReport}
        reports={selectedCreditMemoReports}
        creditMemo={editingCreditMemo}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        isTestMode={Boolean(
          adminActiveTab === 'sandbox' ||
          (adminActiveTab === 'credit_memos' && creditMemoScopeIsTest) ||
          isTestRecord(editingCreditMemo) ||
          isTestRecord(selectedCreditMemoReport) ||
          selectedCreditMemoReports.some(r => isTestRecord(r))
        )}
        reportsList={
          Boolean(
            adminActiveTab === 'sandbox' ||
            (adminActiveTab === 'credit_memos' && creditMemoScopeIsTest) ||
            isTestRecord(editingCreditMemo) ||
            isTestRecord(selectedCreditMemoReport) ||
            selectedCreditMemoReports.some(r => isTestRecord(r))
          )
            ? testReportsList.filter(r => (r.rma_type === 'customer_inbound' || !r.rma_type) && !isManifestSubItem(r, testReportsList))
            : customerInboundReports
        }
        savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
        creditMemosCount={
          Boolean(
            adminActiveTab === 'sandbox' ||
            (adminActiveTab === 'credit_memos' && creditMemoScopeIsTest) ||
            isTestRecord(editingCreditMemo) ||
            isTestRecord(selectedCreditMemoReport) ||
            selectedCreditMemoReports.some(r => isTestRecord(r))
          )
            ? testCreditMemosList.length
            : liveCreditMemosList.length
        }
        onAssignSku={(targetRep) => {
          setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(false);
          handleEditProductFromReport(targetRep);
        }}
        onSaved={(memo) => {
          if (memo) {
            const linkedRmas = new Set(getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(memo).map(String));
            const linkedIds = new Set([
              ...(Array.isArray(memo.consolidated_report_ids) ? memo.consolidated_report_ids : []),
              memo.report_id
            ].filter(Boolean).map(String));
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(r => {
              if (
                (r.rma_number && linkedRmas.has(String(r.rma_number))) ||
                (r.id && linkedIds.has(String(r.id)))
              ) {
                return { ...r, status: 'credit_memo_issued' };
              }
              return r;
            }));
          }
          refreshAllData();
          showToast(`Credit Memo ${memo.credit_memo_number} saved!`, 'success');
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        onViewVoucher={(memo) => {
          setVoucherModalMemo(memo);
          setIsVoucherModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* FINANCIAL VALIDATION & SAFETY GUARD MODAL FOR CREDIT MEMO */}
      {creditMemoWarningTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-amber-500/30 max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in zoom-in-95">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5 min-w-0">
                <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {creditMemoWarningTarget.title || "Financial Validation & Safety Guard"}
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                  {creditMemoWarningTarget.message || "Cannot issue Finance Credit Memo for ₱0.00 or unassigned SKU. Please click 'Assign SKU' first to register the official item code and verified price into the catalog."}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCreditMemoWarningTarget(null)}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Dismiss
              </button>
              {creditMemoWarningTarget.item && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const target = creditMemoWarningTarget.item;
                    setCreditMemoWarningTarget(null);
                    handleEditProductFromReport(target);
                  }}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm shadow-blue-500/20 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Assign SKU Now</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Official Printable Credit Memorandum Voucher Modal */}
      <CreditMemoVoucherModal
        isOpen={isVoucherModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsVoucherModalOpen(false);
          setVoucherModalMemo(null);
          setVoucherModalMemos([]);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        creditMemo={voucherModalMemo}
        creditMemos={voucherModalMemos}
      />

      {/* Fullscreen Image Lightbox Modal */}
      <ImageLightboxModal
        isOpen={Boolean(lightboxPhoto)}
        imageUrl={lightboxPhoto?.url}
        images={lightboxPhoto?.images || (lightboxPhoto?.url ? [lightboxPhoto.url] : [])}
        initialIndex={lightboxPhoto?.initialIndex || 0}
        title={lightboxPhoto?.title}
        subtitle={lightboxPhoto?.subtitle}
        onClose={() => setLightboxPhoto(null)}
      />

      {/* Live Watermarked Camera Modal (Product / Paperwork Photos) */}
      <CameraCaptureModal
        isOpen={Boolean(cameraCaptureTarget)}
        onClose={() => setCameraCaptureTarget(null)}
        title={cameraCaptureTarget === 'paperwork' ? 'Paperwork Proof — Live Camera' : 'Damaged Item Photo — Live Camera'}
        subtitle="Stamps live PHT timestamp, street/barangay/city/ZIP address & reporter tag"
        gpsLocation={gpsLocation}
        tagName={currentUser?.name || reporterName.trim() || gateSession?.profileName || 'Reporter'}
        multiple={true}
        onCapture={async (files) => {
          const target = cameraCaptureTarget;
          setCameraCaptureTarget(null);
          if (!files?.length) return;
          if (target === 'paperwork') {
            await processPaperworkFiles(files);
          } else {
            await appendStampedItemPhotos(files);
          }
        }}
      />

      {/* Unified Printable RMA QR Card & Consolidated Multi-Select Studio */}
      <ReturnQRModal
        isOpen={Boolean(qrModalReport || qrModalReports.length > 0)}
        onClose={() => {
          closeQrModal();
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        report={qrModalReport}
        reports={qrModalReports}
        availableReports={qrScopedAvailableReports}
        lookupReports={qrScopedLookupReports}
        sessionReports={qrScopedSessionReports}
        onOpenQuickAction={(rmaOrReport) => {
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(null);
          const repObj = typeof rmaOrReport === 'object' && rmaOrReport !== null
            ? rmaOrReport
            : recentReportsList.find((r) => r.rma_number === rmaOrReport) || null;
          const rmaStr = typeof rmaOrReport === 'string'
            ? rmaOrReport
            : (rmaOrReport?.rma_number || rmaOrReport?.rmaNumber || '');

          closeQrModal();
          if (repObj?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' || isSupplierRtvPortal) {
            openSimpleWizardModal(repObj || { rma_number: rmaStr }, 'wizard');
          } else {
            setQuickRmaNumber(rmaStr);
            setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
          }
        }}
      />

      {/* RMA QR Code Quick Processing Modal */}
      <QuickRMAActionModal
        isOpen={isQuickRmaModalOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseQuickRma}
        rmaNumber={quickRmaNumber}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        gateSession={gateSession}
        onAdminVerified={(admin) => setCurrentUser(admin)}
        savedProductsList={savedProductsList}
        creditMemosList={creditMemosList}
        recentReportsList={recentReportsList}
        onOpenSimpleSupplierWizard={(rep) => {
          const currentRma = rep?.rma_number || quickRmaNumber;
          setQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          openSimpleWizardModal(rep, 'wizard');
        }}
        onOpenSupplierPickupForm={(rep) => {
          const currentRma = rep?.rma_number || quickRmaNumber;
          setQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          openPickupFormModal(rep);
        }}
        onAssignSku={(reportToEdit) => {
          const currentRma = reportToEdit?.rma_number || quickRmaNumber;
          setQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          handleEditProductFromReport(reportToEdit);
        }}
        onOpenCreditMemo={(rep, existing) => {
          const currentRma = rep?.rma_number || quickRmaNumber;
          setQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          if (existing) {
            setEditingCreditMemo(existing);
            setSelectedCreditMemoReport(rep);
            setSelectedCreditMemoReports([]);
            setIsCreditMemoModalOpen(true);
          } else {
            handleOpenCreditMemoForReport(rep);
          }
        }}
        onViewCreditMemoVoucher={(memo) => {
          const currentRma = memo?.rma_number || quickRmaNumber;
          setQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          setVoucherModalMemo(memo);
          setIsVoucherModalOpen(true);
        }}
        onViewReportQR={(rep) => {
          const currentRma = rep?.rma_number || quickRmaNumber;
          setQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(currentRma);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(false);
          openQrModal(rep);
        }}
        onOpenLightbox={setLightboxPhoto}
        onReportUpdated={(updated) => {
          if (updated?.rma_number) {
            setQuickRmaNumber(updated.rma_number);
          }
          if (updated && (updated.id || updated.rma_number)) {
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(r => {
              const idMatch = r && r.id && updated.id && String(r.id) === String(updated.id);
              const rmaMatch = r && r.rma_number && updated.rma_number && String(r.rma_number) === String(updated.rma_number) && !r.parent_rma_id;
              return (idMatch || rmaMatch) ? { ...r, ...updated } : r;
            }));
          }
        }}
        onRefresh={(updated, newChild) => {
          if (newChild) {
            setRecentReportsList(prev => {
              const filtered = prev.filter(r => r.id !== newChild.id && r.rma_number !== newChild.rma_number);
              const updatedList = filtered.map(r => {
                if (updated && (r.id === updated.id || (r.rma_number && r.rma_number === updated.rma_number))) {
                  return { ...r, ...updated };
                }
                return r;
              });
              return [newChild, ...updatedList];
            });
          } else if (updated && (updated.id || updated.rma_number)) {
            if (updated.rma_number) {
              setQuickRmaNumber(updated.rma_number);
            }
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(r => {
              const idMatch = r && r.id && updated.id && String(r.id) === String(updated.id);
              const rmaMatch = r && r.rma_number && updated.rma_number && String(r.rma_number) === String(updated.rma_number) && !r.parent_rma_id;
              if (idMatch || rmaMatch) {
                return { ...r, ...updated };
              }
              // Also synchronize child sub-items if parent manifest's supplier was updated
              if (updated.id && r && r.parent_rma_id && String(r.parent_rma_id) === String(updated.id)) {
                return {
                  ...r,
                  supplier_name: updated.supplier_name || r.supplier_name,
                  supplier: updated.supplier || r.supplier
                };
              }
              return r;
            }));
          }
          refreshAllData();
        }}
      />

      {/* Unified 4-Choice Outcome & Driver Pickup Wizard (Customer Hub + Supplier RTV) */}
      <SimpleSupplierRtvWizardModal
        isOpen={simpleRtvWizard.isOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setSimpleRtvWizard({ isOpen: false, report: null, reports: [], initialMode: 'wizard' });
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        report={simpleRtvWizard.report}
        reports={simpleRtvWizard.reports}
        allReports={recentReportsList}
        catalogProducts={savedProductsList}
        activeUser={currentUser || gateSession}
        isAdmin={Boolean(currentUser && (currentUser.role === 'admin' || currentUser.role === 'super_admin'))}
        initialMode={simpleRtvWizard.initialMode}
        onSuccess={(updatedOrList) => {
          const updatedList = Array.isArray(updatedOrList)
            ? updatedOrList.filter(Boolean)
            : (updatedOrList ? [updatedOrList] : []);
          if (updatedList.length > 0) {
            setRecentReportsList(prev => prev.map(r => {
              const match = updatedList.find(updated => {
                const idMatch = r && r.id && updated.id && String(r.id) === String(updated.id);
                const rmaMatch = r && r.rma_number && updated.rma_number && String(r.rma_number) === String(updated.rma_number) && !r.parent_rma_id;
                return idMatch || rmaMatch;
              });
              return match ? { ...r, ...match } : r;
            }));
          }
          refreshAllData();
          const primaryUpdated = updatedList[0];
          const batchSuffix = updatedList.length > 1 ? ` (${updatedList.length} RMAs)` : '';
          showToast(
            primaryUpdated?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound'
              ? `Supplier RTV decision saved${batchSuffix}!`
              : `Customer RMA decision saved${batchSuffix}!`,
            'success'
          );
        }}
        onOpenFullAdminModal={(rep) => {
          setPendingQuickRmaNumber(null);
          setSimpleRtvWizard({ isOpen: false, report: null, reports: [], initialMode: 'wizard' });
          setQuickRmaNumber(rep?.rma_number || rep?.rmaNumber);
          setIsQuickRmaModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Standalone Dual-Copy US Letter Pickup Form Preview / Re-print Modal */}
      <SupplierPickupFormModal
        isOpen={Boolean(pickupFormReport) || pickupFormReports.length > 0}
        onClose={() => {
          setPickupFormReport(null);
          setPickupFormReports([]);
          restoreQuickRmaIfPending();
        }}
        report={pickupFormReport}
        reports={pickupFormReports}
        allReports={recentReportsList}
        catalogProducts={savedProductsList}
      />

      {/* Overall RMA Excel Matrix (.xlsx) Exporter (Customer Hub + Supplier RTV, Live/Test Isolated) */}
      <RMAMatrixExportModal
        isOpen={matrixExportModal.isOpen}
        onClose={() => setMatrixExportModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
        reports={recentReportsList}
        catalogProducts={savedProductsList}
        creditMemos={creditMemosList}
        stream={matrixExportModal.stream}
        isTestMode={matrixExportModal.isTestMode}
      />

      {/* Toast Alert Notification */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div role={toastMessage.type === 'error' || toastMessage.type === 'warning' ? 'alert' : 'status'} className="fixed top-[68px] right-4 left-4 sm:left-auto sm:max-w-sm z-[120] pointer-events-none animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-3">
          <div className={`pointer-events-auto px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 ${toastMessage.type === 'error'
            ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-800'
            : toastMessage.type === 'warning'
              ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-900'
              : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 text-white'
            }`}>
            {toastMessage.type === 'error' || toastMessage.type === 'warning' ? (
              <AlertTriangle className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${toastMessage.type === 'error' ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`} />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Universal Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <DeleteConfirmationModal
        isOpen={Boolean(deleteModalState)}
        onClose={() => setDeleteModalState(null)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDelete}
        title={deleteModalState?.title || 'Confirm Deletion'}
        itemName={deleteModalState?.itemName}
        itemType={deleteModalState?.itemType || 'item'}
        itemDetails={deleteModalState?.itemDetails}
        isDeleting={isDeleteModalLoading}
      />


      {/* 1-Click Google Identity Lock Gatekeeper Screen */}
      <GatekeeperPinModal
        isOpen={(() => {
          if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
          if (isAdminView) return false;

          const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
          let urlToken = urlParams.get('token');
          if (!urlToken && window.location.hash.includes('token=')) {
            const m = window.location.hash.match(/token=([^&]+)/);
            if (m && m[1]) urlToken = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
          }
          if (!urlToken) {
            try {
              const isOAuthInProgress =
                localStorage.getItem('rma_oauth_in_progress') === 'true' ||
                sessionStorage.getItem('rma_oauth_in_progress') === 'true';
              if (isOAuthInProgress) {
                urlToken =
                  localStorage.getItem('rma_pending_oauth_token') ||
                  sessionStorage.getItem('rma_pending_oauth_token') ||
                  sessionStorage.getItem('rma_active_invite_token') ||
                  localStorage.getItem('rma_active_invite_token');
              }
            } catch { }
          }

          // If visiting an invite link with a token, the Gatekeeper MUST be locked until this specific token is authenticated!
          if (urlToken) {
            return !gateSession || gateSession.token !== urlToken;
          }

          // Strictly allow direct public portal access without a "?token=" ONLY if authenticated as Super Admin
          if (currentUser?.role === 'super_admin') return false;

          // Lock public portal for everyone else (non-super-admins, regular staff, or unauthenticated visitors without a token)
          return true;
        })()}
        currentSlug={intakeSlug}
        onUnlock={(session) => {
          setGateSession(session);
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_gate_session', JSON.stringify(session));
          } catch { }
          if (session?.authorized_email) {
            setReporterContact(session.authorized_email);
          }
          if (session?.stream_type !== 'rma_editor') {
            const entity = inviteService.normalizeEntityName(session?.entity_name || session?.store_branch);
            if (entity) {
              setStoreBranch(entity);
            } else {
              setStoreBranch('');
            }
          }
          showToast(`Portal Unlocked: ${session.profileName || session.authorized_email}`, 'success');
        }}
        onOpenAdminLogin={() => {
          setIsAdminView(true);
          setIsLoginModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Customer RMA Invites Modal (Google Identity Locked Return Links) */}
      <CustomerRMAInvitesModal
        isOpen={isCustomerInvitesModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCustomerInvitesModalOpen(false)}
        currentUser={currentUser}
      />

      {/* Full Reporter Explanation / Notes Viewer Modal */}
      {viewingExplanationModal && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[110] bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in"
          onClick={() => setViewingExplanationModal(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl p-6 space-y-4 animate-in zoom-in-95"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 font-mono font-black text-[11px] border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
                    {viewingExplanationModal.rmaNumber || 'RMA Report'}
                  </span>
                  {viewingExplanationModal.reason && (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/70 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-bold text-[10px] border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800">
                      {viewingExplanationModal.reason}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-snug">
                  {viewingExplanationModal.productName || 'Returned Item'}
                </h4>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setViewingExplanationModal(null)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                title="Close explanation"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-1.5">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block">
                Full Reporter Explanation / Notes:
              </span>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-medium">
                {cleanExplanationText(viewingExplanationModal.explanation)}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span>Reported by: <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{viewingExplanationModal.reporter || 'Staff'}</strong></span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setViewingExplanationModal(null)}
                className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Done
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/AdminLoginModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Lock, Mail, ShieldCheck, KeyRound, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, CheckCircle, ArrowRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';

export default function AdminLoginModal({ isOpen, onClose, onLoginSuccess }) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(() => {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('rma_login_pending_email') ? 'otp' : 'email';
  });
  const [emailInput, setEmailInput] = useState(() => {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('rma_login_pending_email') || '';
  });
  const [otpInput, setOtpInput] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState(null);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(0);

  // Countdown timer for resend OTP cooldown (prevents 429 errors)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (countdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setCountdown(c => c - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [countdown]);

  // Sync state when modal is opened fresh
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const savedEmail = sessionStorage.getItem('rma_login_pending_email');
      if (savedEmail) {
        setStep('otp');
        setEmailInput(savedEmail);
      } else {
        setStep('email');
      }
      setIsLoading(false);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Step 1: Request OTP
  const handleRequestOtp = async (e) => {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    const email = emailInput.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!email) return;

    if (countdown > 0) {
      return; // Under cooldown
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await authService.requestOtp(email);
      sessionStorage.setItem('rma_login_pending_email', email);
      setStep('otp');
      setCountdown(60); // 60 seconds cooldown to protect from rate limits
      if (res.rateLimited) {
        setErrorMessage(res.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Step 2: Verify OTP
  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const code = otpInput.trim();
    if (!code) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await authService.verifyOtp(emailInput, code);
      if (res.success && onLoginSuccess) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
        onLoginSuccess(res.user);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-md w-full p-6 sm:p-7 space-y-5 pb-safe max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto">
        
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden -mt-2 mb-2 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Top Icon & Title */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-1.5">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
            <Lock className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
            Company Staff Verification
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            One-Time Password (OTP) security gate for RMA admin access.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Error Notice */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span>{errorMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STEP 1: Enter Company Email */}
        {step === 'email' && (
          <form onSubmit={handleRequestOtp} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
                Official Company Email Address
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  autoFocus
                  value={emailInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmailInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                />
              </div>
              <span className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-1">
                Must be an active employee in company directory. Personal emails (@gmail) are not accepted.
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isLoading || !emailInput.trim()}
              className="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-extrabold text-sm rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all"
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
              <span>Send OTP Verification Code</span>
            </button>

            {onClose && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="w-full py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-center"
              >
                Cancel & Return to Public Portal
              </button>
            )}
          </form>
        )}

        {/* STEP 2: Enter 6-digit OTP */}
        {step === 'otp' && (
          <form onSubmit={handleVerifyOtp} className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-2xl text-xs text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>Verification code dispatched!</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                Please check your inbox at <strong>{emailInput}</strong> for your OTP access code.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1.5 text-center">
                Enter Verification Code or Token
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                autoFocus
                maxLength={64}
                value={otpInput}
                onChange={(e) => setOtpInput(e.target.value.trim())}
                placeholder="e.g. 123456"
                className={`w-full py-3.5 text-center font-black font-mono bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-blue-500 rounded-2xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 transition-all ${
                  otpInput.length <= 8 ? 'tracking-[0.35em] text-2xl' : 'text-xs tracking-normal px-3'
                }`}
              />
              <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-center mt-1">
                Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to your email
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isLoading || otpInput.length < 6}
              className="w-full py-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-extrabold text-sm rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-all"
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
              <span>Verify & Access Dashboard</span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold pt-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
                  setStep('email');
                  setOtpInput('');
                  setErrorMessage(null);
                }}
                className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Change Email
              </button>
              {countdown > 0 ? (
                <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-xs font-mono">
                  Resend Code ({countdown}s)
                </span>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRequestOtp}
                  className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-800 dark:hover:text-blue-300 underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Resend Code
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/AdminPinModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Lock, KeyRound, ShieldAlert, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AdminPinModal({ isOpen, onClose, onUnlock }) {
  const [pin, setPin] = useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pin === '1234' || pin === 'admin' || pin.trim() === '') {
      onUnlock();
      onClose();
      setPin('');
      setErrorMsg(null);
    } else {
      setErrorMsg('Incorrect security PIN. Default staff PIN is 1234.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-6 space-y-4 pb-safe max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto">
        
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden -mt-2 mb-2 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          aria-label="Close"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {/* Icon & Title */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-1.5 pt-2">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <Lock className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Admin & Staff Portal</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Enter staff PIN to access Tickets Vault, Finance Credit Memos, and Replenishment Buffer.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3 pt-2">
          <div>
            <div className="relative">
              <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />
              <input
                type="password"
                maxLength={6}
                autoFocus
                value={pin}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPin(e.target.value);
                  setErrorMsg(null);
                }}
                placeholder="Enter PIN (Default: 1234)"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl pl-10 pr-4 py-3 text-sm font-mono text-center tracking-widest text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </div>
            {errorMsg && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-500 font-medium text-center mt-1.5">
                {errorMsg}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full py-3 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
          >
            <span>Unlock Admin Workstation</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onUnlock();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="w-full py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            One-Click Staff Access (Skip PIN)
          </button>
        </form>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

                    )}
                  </span>

                      className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${
                        isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : item.badgeClass
                      }`}
                    >
                      {item.count}
                    </span>
                  )}

                  {compactMode && hasCount && Number(item.count) > 0 && item.id === 'pending_barcodes' && (

      {/* Sidebar Bottom Expand Toggle (when collapsed on Desktop) */}
      {compactMode && onToggleCollapse && (

      {/* Desktop Sticky Collapsible Rail */}
      <aside
        data-testid="admin-sidebar-desktop"
