        }`}
      >
        {renderSidebarBody(isCollapsed)}
      </aside>

      {/* Mobile & Tablet Slide-Out Navigation Drawer */}
      {isMobileOpen && (
        <div
          data-testid="admin-sidebar-mobile-drawer"
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 lg:hidden flex animate-in fade-in duration-150"
        >
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xs"
            onClick={onCloseMobile}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <aside className="relative w-72 max-w-[85vw] h-full z-10 shadow-2xl">
            {renderSidebarBody(false)}
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/AdminSidebar.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/ApiKeysManagementSection.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Key, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Trash2, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Plus, 
  Clock, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Lock,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { copyTextSafe } from '../utils/clipboard';
import { formatDateYmd, formatDateTimeYmdHm } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { useIsDesktopMd } from '../hooks/useIsDesktopMd';

const TARGET_SYSTEMS = [
  { id: 'primary', name: 'Primary System (Mine)', role: 'Internal Central System', badge: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300' },
  { id: 'jarmen', name: 'Jarmen', role: 'Partner Wholesale System', badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300' },
  { id: 'jelo', name: 'Jelo', role: 'Partner Operations System', badge: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/40 dark:text-purple-300' },
  { id: 'arlito', name: 'Arlito', role: 'Partner Inventory System', badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:text-amber-300' }
];

export default function ApiKeysManagementSection() {
  const isDesktopMd = useIsDesktopMd();
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);

  // New Key Generation / Reveal State
  const [showGenerateModal, setShowGenerateModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSystem, setSelectedSystem] = useState(TARGET_SYSTEMS[0].name);
  const [rateLimit, setRateLimit] = useState(60);
  
  // One-time revealed key
  const [revealedKey, setRevealedKey] = useState(null);
  const [hasCopied, setHasCopied] = useState(false);

  // Load existing API keys
  const loadKeys = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Fetch via Supabase table public.api_keys
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, last_used_at, created_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        // Table might not exist yet if user hasn't run the SQL migration
        if (error.code === '42P01') {
          setFeedback({
            type: 'warning',
            message: 'Database table "api_keys" not found. Please run the SQL migration script in your Supabase SQL Editor.'
          });
          setKeys([]);
          return;
        }
        throw error;
      }

      setKeys(data || []);
      setFeedback(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching API keys:', err);
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err.message || 'Failed to load API keys' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadKeys();
  }, []);

  // Generate a key via the API endpoint
  const handleGenerateKey = async () => {
    setActionLoading('generate');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/v1/api-keys', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: selectedSystem,
          rateLimit: parseInt(rateLimit, 10) || 60
        })
      });

      const text = await res.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!res.ok || !json?.success) {
        throw new Error(json?.message || `Failed to generate key (Status ${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 100)}`);
      }

      // Store revealed key to show user once
      setRevealedKey({
        rawKey: json.apiKey,
        name: selectedSystem,
        maskedKey: json.keyRecord?.masked_key
      });
      setShowGenerateModal(false);
      setHasCopied(false);
      await loadKeys();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error generating key:', err);
      alert('Failed to generate key: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  // Rotate a key
  const handleRotateKey = async (keyItem) => {
    const confirmRotate = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to rotate the API key for "${keyItem.name}"?\n\nThe current key (${keyItem.masked_key}) will be immediately revoked and a new secret key will be generated.`
    );
    if (!confirmRotate) return;

    setActionLoading(`rotate-${keyItem.id}`);
    try {
      // Use query parameter which routes cleanly to both index.js and [id].js
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/api-keys?id=${encodeURIComponent(keyItem.id)}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: keyItem.id })
      });
      
      const text = await res.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!res.ok || !json?.success) {
        throw new Error(json?.message || `Failed to rotate key (Status ${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 100)}`);
      }

      setRevealedKey({
        rawKey: json.apiKey,
        name: keyItem.name,
        maskedKey: json.keyRecord?.masked_key,
        isRotated: true
      });
      setHasCopied(false);
      await loadKeys();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Rotate key error:', err);
      alert('Failed to rotate key: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  // Revoke / Delete a key
  const handleRevokeKey = async (keyItem) => {
    const confirmRevoke = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to permanently revoke and delete the API key for "${keyItem.name}"? Any system currently using this key will immediately receive 401 Unauthorized.`
    );
    if (!confirmRevoke) return;

    setActionLoading(`revoke-${keyItem.id}`);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/api-keys?id=${encodeURIComponent(keyItem.id)}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: keyItem.id })
      });

      const text = await res.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!res.ok || (json && !json.success)) {
        // Direct Supabase fallback in case of serverless routing error
        const { error: dbErr } = await supabase
          .from('api_keys')
          .delete()
          .eq('id', keyItem.id);

        if (dbErr) {
          throw new Error(json?.message || dbErr.message || `Status ${res.status}`);
        }
      }

      await loadKeys();
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: `API Key for ${keyItem.name} revoked successfully.` });
      setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 4000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Revoke key error:', err);
      alert('Failed to revoke key: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCopySecret = () => {
    if (!revealedKey?.rawKey) return;
    copyTextSafe(revealedKey.rawKey);
    setHasCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setHasCopied(false), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Key className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                Multi-System REST API Keys & Integration
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  SHA-256 Hashed
                </span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Manage secure API keys for <strong>Primary System</strong>, <strong>Jarmen</strong>, <strong>Jelo</strong>, and <strong>Arlito</strong>.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <a
            href="/docs"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Interactive Docs (/docs)</span>
          </a>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(true)}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm shadow-purple-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Generate New Key</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {feedback && (
        <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 ${
          feedback.type === 'warning' ? 'bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:border-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300' :
          feedback.type === 'error' ? 'bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:border-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300' :
          'bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300'
        }`}>
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{feedback.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4 Client Systems Overview Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {TARGET_SYSTEMS.map((sys) => {
          const matchingKeys = keys.filter(k => k.name.toLowerCase().includes(sys.id) || k.name.toLowerCase().includes(sys.name.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0]));
          const activeKey = matchingKeys.find(k => k.is_active);

          return (
            <div
              key={sys.id}
              className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 space-y-2"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md ${sys.badge}`}>
                  {sys.name}
                </span>
                {activeKey ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Active
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400">
                    No Active Key
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                {sys.role}
              </div>

              {activeKey ? (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {activeKey.masked_key}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                    <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                    Last used (YYYY-MM-DD): {activeKey.last_used_at ? formatDateYmd(activeKey.last_used_at) : 'Never'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedSystem(sys.name);
                    setShowGenerateModal(true);
                  }}
                  className="w-full mt-2 py-1.5 px-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/40 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-dashed border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  + Issue Key for {sys.name.split(' ')[0]}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Active Keys Table */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider">
            All Registered API Keys ({keys.length})
          </h4>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadKeys}
            disabled={loading}
            className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        {keys.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center border border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-400">
            No API keys issued yet. Click <strong>Generate New Key</strong> above to issue a key for Primary System, Jarmen, Jelo, or Arlito.
          </div>
        ) : (
          isDesktopMd ? (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Client System</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Masked Key</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Rate Limit</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Last Used</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Status</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                {keys.map((k) => (
                  <tr key={k.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30">
                    <td className="p-3 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {k.name}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {k.masked_key}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {k.rate_limit || 60} req/min
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      {k.last_used_at ? formatDateTimeYmdHm(k.last_used_at) : 'Never'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      {k.is_active ? (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                          Active
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300">
                          Revoked
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRotateKey(k)}
                          disabled={actionLoading === `rotate-${k.id}`}
                          title="Rotate API Key (Invalidate current and create new)"
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${actionLoading === `rotate-${k.id}` ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                        </button>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRevokeKey(k)}
                          disabled={actionLoading === `revoke-${k.id}`}
                          title="Revoke and Delete API Key"
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            {keys.map((k) => (
              <div key={`mob-${k.id}`} className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-950/70 space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{k.name}</span>
                  {k.is_active ? (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">Active</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300">Revoked</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 break-all">{k.masked_key}</div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span>{k.rate_limit || 60} req/min • Used: {k.last_used_at ? formatDateTimeYmdHm(k.last_used_at) : 'Never'}</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRotateKey(k)} disabled={actionLoading === `rotate-${k.id}`} title="Rotate API Key" className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-purple-600 rounded-lg">
                      <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${actionLoading === `rotate-${k.id}` ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRevokeKey(k)} disabled={actionLoading === `revoke-${k.id}`} title="Revoke API Key" className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 rounded-lg">
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          )
        )}
      </div>

      {/* MODAL 1: Generate Key Modal */}
      {showGenerateModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                Issue New API Key
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Target Client System
                </label>
                <select
                  value={selectedSystem}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedSystem(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600"
                >
                  {TARGET_SYSTEMS.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.name}>
                      {s.name} ({s.role})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Rate Limit (Requests per minute)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="10"
                  max="300"
                  value={rateLimit}
                  onChange={(e) => setRateLimit(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/30 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-300">
                <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Security Notice
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1">
                  The secret API key will be hashed using SHA-256 before being stored in the database. You will only be shown the raw key <strong>once</strong>.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleGenerateKey}
                disabled={actionLoading === 'generate'}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-sm shadow-purple-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {actionLoading === 'generate' ? 'Generating...' : 'Generate Key'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL 2: One-Time Key Reveal Modal */}
      {revealedKey && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-2xl p-5 max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {revealedKey.isRotated ? 'API Key Rotated Successfully' : 'API Key Generated Successfully'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Client: <strong>{revealedKey.name}</strong>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 rounded-xl space-y-1">
              <div className="text-xs font-extrabold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                Copy this secret key now. It cannot be shown again!
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                For security reasons, only the SHA-256 hash is kept in the database. If you lose this key, you will need to rotate or generate a replacement.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Raw Secret Key
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-emerald-400 select-all break-all">
                  {revealedKey.rawKey}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCopySecret}
                  className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    hasCopied
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {hasCopied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  <span>{hasCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                Masked representation: <code className="font-mono">{revealedKey.maskedKey}</code>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRevealedKey(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                I have saved this key safely
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/ApiKeysManagementSection.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/ArchiveAndTrashTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Archive, 
  Trash2, 
  RotateCcw, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Search, 
  Clock, 
  Flame, 
  Package, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Sparkles,
  ArrowUpDown,
  Building2,
  FileText
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  isTestRecord, 
  getTrashDaysRemaining, 
  formatQuantityWithPackSize,
  normalizeWarehouseLocation,
  formatDateYmd,
  isManifestSubItem
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';
import { useIsDesktopMd } from '../hooks/useIsDesktopMd';

export default function ArchiveAndTrashTab({
  archivedReports = [],
  archivedReportsList = [],
  trashedReports = [],
  trashedReportsList = [],
  currentUser,
  onRefresh,
  onRestore,
  onPermanentlyDelete,
  onEmptyTrash,
  onViewPhoto,
  savedProductsList = []
}) {
  const isDesktopMd = useIsDesktopMd();
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState('trash'); // 'archive' | 'trash'
  const [envFilter, setEnvFilter] = useState('all'); // 'all' | 'live' | 'test'
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(15);
  const [actionInProgressId, setActionInProgressId] = useState(null);

  const canManage = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  // Support both prop names flexibly
  const effectiveArchived = useMemo(() => {
    return archivedReports.length > 0 ? archivedReports : (archivedReportsList || []);
  }, [archivedReports, archivedReportsList]);

  const effectiveTrashed = useMemo(() => {
    return trashedReports.length > 0 ? trashedReports : (trashedReportsList || []);
  }, [trashedReports, trashedReportsList]);

  // Base list depending on active view
  const baseList = activeView === 'archive' ? effectiveArchived : effectiveTrashed;

  // Filter list by environment and search query (collapse manifest sub-items under parent)
  const filteredList = useMemo(() => {
    return baseList.filter(item => {
      if (isManifestSubItem(item, baseList)) return false;
      const isTest = isTestRecord(item);
      if (envFilter === 'live' && isTest) return false;
      if (envFilter === 'test' && !isTest) return false;

      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matches = 
          (item.rma_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.code || item.sku || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.store_branch || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matches) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [baseList, envFilter, searchQuery]);

  // Pagination
  const paginatedList = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return filteredList.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [filteredList, currentPage, pageSize]);

  const handleRestoreItem = async (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    try {
      setActionInProgressId(item.id || item.rma_number);
      if (onRestore) {
        await onRestore(item);
      }
    } finally {
      setActionInProgressId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItemForever = async (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `PERMANENT DESTRUCTION WARNING:\n\nAre you sure you want to permanently delete return report ${item.rma_number}? This cannot be undone.`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      setActionInProgressId(item.id || item.rma_number);
      if (onPermanentlyDelete) {
        await onPermanentlyDelete(item);
      }
    } finally {
      setActionInProgressId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Top Banner & View Switcher */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Archive className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              <span>Enterprise Archive & 30-Day Trash Bin</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Soft-deleted records are retained for 30 days before automatic permanent purge. Archived records are preserved indefinitely.
            </p>
          </div>

          {activeView === 'trash' && effectiveTrashed.length > 0 && canManage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onEmptyTrash}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0"
              title="Permanently delete all items currently in Trash Bin"
            >
              <Flame className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Empty Trash ({effectiveTrashed.length})</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* View Toggle Tabs */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-1 rounded-2xl w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setActiveView('trash'); setCurrentPage(1); }}
              className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial justify-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeView === 'trash'
                  ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>Trash Bin — 30-Day Auto-Delete ({effectiveTrashed.length})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setActiveView('archive'); setCurrentPage(1); }}
              className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial justify-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeView === 'archive'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>Archive Vault ({effectiveArchived.length})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Environment Filter */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] uppercase mr-1">Scope:</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setEnvFilter('all'); setCurrentPage(1); }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                envFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white border-slate-800 dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900'
                  : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              All
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setEnvFilter('live'); setCurrentPage(1); }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                envFilter === 'live'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600'
                  : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              🟢 Live Production
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setEnvFilter('test'); setCurrentPage(1); }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                envFilter === 'test'
                  ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-600'
                  : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              🧪 Test Mode Sandbox
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search Bar */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => { setSearchQuery(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
            placeholder={`Search ${activeView === 'trash' ? 'trashed' : 'archived'} items by RMA number, barcode, product, vendor...`}
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Content */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        {filteredList.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-12 text-center space-y-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              {activeView === 'trash' ? 'Trash Bin is Clean' : 'Archive Vault is Empty'}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
              {activeView === 'trash'
                ? 'No items have been moved to the trash bin. Deleted returns will sit here for 30 days.'
                : 'No return reports are currently stored in the Archive Vault.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          isDesktopMd ? (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 tracking-wider">
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5 text-center">SN</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5">RMA Identifier</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5">Scope</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5">Product Description &amp; SKU</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Qty</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5">Location</th>
                  {activeView === 'trash' ? (
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5">Retention / Auto-Purge</th>
                  ) : (
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5">Archived Details</th>
                  )}
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-1.5 text-center">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                {paginatedList.map((item, idx) => {
                  const isTest = isTestRecord(item);
                  const daysRemaining = getTrashDaysRemaining(item);
                  const isSupplier = item.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
                  const loc = normalizeWarehouseLocation(item.warehouse_location, item);
                  const meta = item.ai_document_metadata || {};

                  return (
                    <tr 
                      key={item.id || item.rma_number}
                      className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 text-center font-mono font-bold text-slate-400">
                        #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 font-mono">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                          {item.rma_number}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {isSupplier ? (
                            <span className="text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold">📤 Supplier RTV</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold">📥 Customer Inbound</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {isTest ? (
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-black bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 inline-block whitespace-nowrap">
                            🧪 Sandbox
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-black bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 inline-block whitespace-nowrap">
                            🟢 Live
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 max-w-[155px]">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate" title={item.name}>
                          {item.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5 truncate">
                          BC: {item.barcode} {item.code || item.sku ? `• SKU: ${item.code || item.sku}` : ''}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                        {formatQuantityWithPackSize(item.quantity, item.unit_name, item.pieces_per_case)}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 max-w-[110px] truncate" title={loc}>
                        {loc}
                      </td>

                      {activeView === 'trash' ? (
                        <td className="py-2 px-1.5">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">
                            <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 border whitespace-nowrap ${
                              daysRemaining <= 7
                                ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 animate-pulse'
                                : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
                            }`}>
                              <Clock className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                              <span>{daysRemaining} days left</span>
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                            By {meta.trashed_by || 'Staff'} • <span className="font-mono">{meta.trashed_at ? formatDateYmd(meta.trashed_at) : 'N/A'}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      ) : (
                        <td className="py-2 px-1.5">
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">
                            Archived Vault
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                            By {meta.archived_by || 'Staff'} • <span className="font-mono">{meta.archived_at ? formatDateYmd(meta.archived_at) : 'N/A'}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      )}

                      <td className="py-2 px-1.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                          {canManage && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={actionInProgressId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => handleRestoreItem(item)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title="Restore item back to active hub"
                            >
                              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600" />
                              <span>Restore</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {canManage && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={actionInProgressId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => handleDeleteItemForever(item)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title="Permanently destroy this record forever"
                            >
                              <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
            {paginatedList.map((item, idx) => {
              const isTest = isTestRecord(item);
              const daysRemaining = getTrashDaysRemaining(item);
              const isSupplier = item.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
              const loc = normalizeWarehouseLocation(item.warehouse_location, item);
              const meta = item.ai_document_metadata || {};

              return (
                <div key={`mob-${item.id || item.rma_number}`} className="p-3.5 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-slate-400">#{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{item.rma_number}</span>
                      {isTest ? (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700">🧪 Sandbox</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700">🟢 Live</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                      {formatQuantityWithPackSize(item.quantity, item.unit_name, item.pieces_per_case)}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white break-words">{item.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      BC: {item.barcode} {item.code || item.sku ? `• SKU: ${item.code || item.sku}` : ''}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-2">
                      <span className={isSupplier ? 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold' : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold'}>
                        {isSupplier ? '📤 Supplier RTV' : '📥 Customer Inbound'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono">{loc}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
                    {activeView === 'trash' ? (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-black border inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${
                          daysRemaining <= 7
                            ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700'
                            : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
                        }`}>
                          <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{daysRemaining} days left</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono">{meta.trashed_at ? formatDateYmd(meta.trashed_at) : 'N/A'}</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 font-bold">
                        Archived by {meta.archived_by || 'Staff'} • <span className="font-mono">{meta.archived_at ? formatDateYmd(meta.archived_at) : 'N/A'}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {canManage && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={actionInProgressId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                          onClick={() => handleRestoreItem(item)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600" />
                          <span>Restore</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={actionInProgressId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteItemForever(item)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-lg"
                          title="Permanently destroy this record forever"
                        >
                          <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          )
        )}

        {filteredList.length > 0 && (
          <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <TablePagination
              currentPage={currentPage}
              totalItems={filteredList.length}
              pageSize={pageSize}
              onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
              onPageSizeChange={setPageSize}
              pageSizeOptions={[10, 15, 25, 50]}
              itemLabel="records"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/CameraCaptureModal.jsx ---
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Camera, RefreshCw, Upload, X, MapPin, CheckCircle2, SwitchCamera, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCameraTimestamp, getGpsCoordinatesText, getGpsAddressDisplay } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { drawWatermarkOverlay, stampWatermarkOnImage } from '../utils/cameraWatermark';

export default function CameraCaptureModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onCapture,
  title = 'Live Watermarked Camera',
  subtitle = 'Stamps live PHT timestamp & street address',
  gpsLocation = null,
  tagName = 'Staff',
  multiple = false
}) {
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);

  const [facingMode, setFacingMode] = useState('environment');
  const [liveTime, setLiveTime] = useState(() => formatCameraTimestamp(new Date()));
  const [isStarting, setIsStarting] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState('');
  const [isCapturing, setIsCapturing] = useState(false);
  const [localGeo, setLocalGeo] = useState({
    address: gpsLocation?.address || '',
    addressParts: gpsLocation?.addressParts || null,
    addressLines: gpsLocation?.addressLines || [],
    latitude: gpsLocation?.latitude ?? null,
    longitude: gpsLocation?.longitude ?? null
  });

  // Sync passed GPS info whenever parent resolves reverse-geocoded street address
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalGeo((prev) => ({
      address: gpsLocation?.address || prev.address || '',
      addressParts: gpsLocation?.addressParts || prev.addressParts || null,
      addressLines:
        Array.isArray(gpsLocation?.addressLines) && gpsLocation.addressLines.length > 0
          ? gpsLocation.addressLines
          : prev.addressLines,
      latitude: gpsLocation?.latitude ?? prev.latitude,
      longitude: gpsLocation?.longitude ?? prev.longitude
    }));
  }, [gpsLocation?.address, gpsLocation?.addressParts, gpsLocation?.latitude, gpsLocation?.longitude, gpsLocation?.addressLines]);

  // Live ticking Asia/Manila clock while modal is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;
    setLiveTime(formatCameraTimestamp(new Date()));
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setLiveTime(formatCameraTimestamp(new Date()));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Resolve clear GPS street/barangay/city/ZIP if parent has not resolved it yet
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;
    if (localGeo.address) return undefined;
    let cancelled = false;

    const resolveAddress = async (lat, lon) => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/products/lookup?action=reverse-geocode&lat=${encodeURIComponent(lat)}&lon=${encodeURIComponent(lon)}`);
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!cancelled && data?.formatted) {
          setLocalGeo({
            address: data.formatted,
            addressParts: {
              street: data.street || '',
              barangay: data.barangay || '',
              city: data.city || '',
              region: data.region || '',
              zip: data.zip || '',
              formatted: data.formatted
            },
            addressLines: Array.isArray(data.lines) ? data.lines : [data.formatted],
            latitude: lat,
            longitude: lon
          });
        }
      } catch {}
    };

    if (localGeo.latitude != null && localGeo.longitude != null) {
      resolveAddress(localGeo.latitude, localGeo.longitude);
    } else if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.geolocation) {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        (pos) => {
          if (pos?.coords?.accuracy <= 150) {
            resolveAddress(pos.coords.latitude, pos.coords.longitude);
          }
        },
        () => {},
        { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 6000, maximumAge: 60000 }
      );
    }

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [isOpen, localGeo.address, localGeo.latitude, localGeo.longitude]);

  // Start / switch MediaDevices camera stream
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => {
          try { t.stop(); } catch {}
        });
        streamRef.current = null;
      }
      return undefined;
    }

    let cancelled = false;
    setIsStarting(true);
    setCameraError('');

    const stopCurrent = () => {
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => {
          try { t.stop(); } catch {}
        });
        streamRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    const startCamera = async () => {
      stopCurrent();
      if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
        setCameraError('Live browser camera stream unavailable on this device. Use "Choose / Native Camera" below — your photo will still receive the live timestamp & address stamp.');
        setIsStarting(false);
        return;
      }
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: {
            facingMode: { ideal: facingMode },
            width: { ideal: 1280 },
            height: { ideal: 720 }
          },
          audio: false
        });
        if (cancelled) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => {
            try { t.stop(); } catch {}
          });
          return;
        }
        streamRef.current = stream;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
          try { await videoRef.current.play(); } catch {}
        }
        setIsStarting(false);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setCameraError(
            err?.name === 'NotAllowedError'
              ? 'Camera permission denied. Allow browser camera access or use "Choose / Native Camera" below (watermark stamp still applies).'
              : 'Live viewfinder unavailable on this device/camera. Use "Choose / Native Camera" below (watermark stamp still applies).'
          );
          setIsStarting(false);
        }
      }
    };

    startCamera();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      stopCurrent();
    };
  }, [isOpen, facingMode]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const coordFallback = getGpsCoordinatesText(localGeo);
  const fullDisplayAddr = getGpsAddressDisplay(localGeo);
  const resolvedAddressText = fullDisplayAddr || (coordFallback ? `Coords: ${coordFallback}` : 'GPS: Location not captured');
  const resolvedTag = String(tagName || 'Staff').trim();

  const handleCaptureSnap = async () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !video.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight || isCapturing) return;
    setIsCapturing(true);
    try {
      const srcW = video.videoWidth;
      const srcH = video.videoHeight;
      const maxDim = Math.max(srcW, srcH);
      const scale = maxDim > 1600 ? 1600 / maxDim : 1;
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = Math.round(srcW * scale);
      canvas.height = Math.round(srcH * scale);
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      drawWatermarkOverlay(ctx, canvas.width, canvas.height, {
        timestampText: formatCameraTimestamp(new Date()),
        addressText: resolvedAddressText,
        addressLines: localGeo.addressLines,
        tagText: resolvedTag
      });

      const blob = await new Promise((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/jpeg', 0.9));
      if (blob && onCapture) {
        const file = new File([blob], `camera-capture-${Date.now()}.jpg`, {
          type: 'image/jpeg',
          lastModified: Date.now()
        });
        await onCapture([file]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setCameraError(err?.message || 'Could not capture photo frame.');
    } finally {
      setIsCapturing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFallbackFiles = async (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (e.target) e.target.value = '';
    if (files.length === 0 || !onCapture) return;
    setIsCapturing(true);
    try {
      const stamped = [];
      for (const file of files) {
        stamped.push(await stampWatermarkOnImage(file, {
          timestampText: formatCameraTimestamp(new Date()),
          addressText: resolvedAddressText,
          addressLines: localGeo.addressLines,
          tagText: resolvedTag
        }));
      }
      await onCapture(stamped);
    } finally {
      setIsCapturing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
    >
      <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[94dvh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
              <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{title}</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">{subtitle}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFacingMode((prev) => (prev === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment'))}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer border border-slate-700"
              title="Switch Front / Back Camera"
            >
              <SwitchCamera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">{facingMode === 'environment' ? 'Back Cam' : 'Front Cam'}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-rose-600 text-slate-300 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Close Camera Modal"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Viewfinder */}
        <div className="relative bg-black w-full flex-1 min-h-[300px] sm:min-h-[340px] max-h-[64dvh] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
          {!cameraError ? (
            <video
              ref={videoRef}
              autoPlay
              playsInline
              muted
              className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 text-center max-w-sm space-y-3">
              <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">{cameraError}</p>
              <label className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-black cursor-pointer shadow-md">
                <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Select Image (Auto-Stamped)</span>
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  multiple={multiple}
                  onChange={handleFallbackFiles}
                  className="hidden"
                />
              </label>
            </div>
          )}

          {isStarting && !cameraError && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Starting camera...</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Live HUD Corner Preview (Mirrors Final Watermark) */}
          <div
            data-testid="camera-watermark-hud"
            className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 max-w-[88%] sm:max-w-[74%] px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/75 border border-white/20 text-left space-y-0.5 pointer-events-none shadow-lg"
          >
            <div className="text-[11px] font-black text-white font-mono tracking-tight">
              {liveTime}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-slate-200 flex items-start gap-1 leading-snug">
              <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{resolvedAddressText}</span>
            </div>
            {resolvedTag && (
              <div className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-amber-300">
                {resolvedTag.startsWith('#') ? resolvedTag : `#${resolvedTag}`}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer Controls */}
        <div className="p-3.5 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-900 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          {cameraError ? (
            <label className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
              <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
              <span>Fallback Photo (Auto-Stamped)</span>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                multiple={multiple}
                onChange={handleFallbackFiles}
                className="hidden"
              />
            </label>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 hidden sm:inline">
              Live watermarked viewfinder active
            </span>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 ml-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Done
            </button>
            {!cameraError && (
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isStarting || isCapturing}
                onClick={handleCaptureSnap}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/25"
              >
                {isCapturing ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
                <span>{isCapturing ? 'Stamping...' : 'Capture Photo'}</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
