--- START FILE: src/components/CreditMemosTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Receipt,
  Search,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Edit3,
  Trash2,
  DollarSign,
  Package,
  ArrowUpDown,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  Download,
  RotateCcw,
  Building2,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertCircle,
  Database,
  CheckSquare,
  Square
} from 'lucide-react';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';
import { formatFilenameDateTime } from '../utils/exportCsv';
import { downloadTableXlsx } from '../utils/exportXlsx';
import {
  formatDateYmd,
  formatSaveFileTimestamp,
  getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems,
  getCreditMemoRmaNumbers
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { useIsDesktopMd } from '../hooks/useIsDesktopMd';

export default function CreditMemosTab({
  creditMemosList = [],
  onOpenCreateModal,
  onEditCreditMemo,
  onViewVoucher,
  onPrintBulk,
  onRequestDeleteCreditMemo,
  onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo,
  recentReportsList = [],
  currentUser,
  isTestMode = false
}) {
  const canManageCreditMemos = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const isDesktopMd = useIsDesktopMd();
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [supplierFilter, setSupplierFilter] = useState('All');
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState('');
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('credit_issued_at');
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState('desc');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [selectedMemoNumbers, setSelectedMemoNumbers] = useState(new Set());

  // Extract unique suppliers from credit memos
  const suppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    creditMemosList.forEach(m => {
      const sup = (m.supplier_name || 'Savemore').trim();
      if (sup) set.add(sup);
    });
    return ['All', ...Array.from(set).sort()];
  }, [creditMemosList]);

  // Automatically prune orphan credit memo selection numbers whenever creditMemosList updates
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
      if (prev.size === 0) return prev;
      const valid = new Set(creditMemosList.map(m => m.credit_memo_number).filter(Boolean));
      const next = new Set([...prev].filter(num => valid.has(num)));
      return next.size === prev.size ? prev : next;
    });
  }, [creditMemosList]);

  // Financial summary metrics
  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    let totalCredited = 0;
    let totalGross = 0;
    let totalUnits = 0;

    creditMemosList.forEach(m => {
      totalCredited += Number(m.credit_amount || m.amount || 0);
      totalGross += Number(m.amount || 0);
      totalUnits += Number(m.quantity || 1);
    });

    return {
      count: creditMemosList.length,
      totalCredited,
      totalGross,
      totalUnits
    };
  }, [creditMemosList]);

  // Filter & sort (with date range support)
  const processedMemos = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    let list = creditMemosList.filter(item => {
      if (supplierFilter !== 'All') {
        const itemSup = (item.supplier_name || 'Savemore').toLowerCase();
        if (itemSup !== supplierFilter.toLowerCase()) return false;
      }

      if (q) {
        const linkedRmasStr = getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(item).join(' ').toLowerCase();
        const matches = (
          (item.credit_memo_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.rma_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          linkedRmasStr.includes(q) ||
          (item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.product_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.pull_out_ref || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.credit_issued_by || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      if (dateFrom) {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.credit_issued_at || item.created_at || 0).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (itemDate < dateFrom) return false;
      }

      if (dateTo) {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.credit_issued_at || item.created_at || 0).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (itemDate > dateTo) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA, valB;
      switch (sortField) {
        case 'credit_memo_number':
          valA = String(a.credit_memo_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.credit_memo_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'rma_number':
          valA = String(a.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'supplier_name':
          valA = String(a.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'credit_amount':
          valA = Number(a.credit_amount || 0);
          valB = Number(b.credit_amount || 0);
          break;
        case 'quantity':
          valA = Number(a.quantity || 0);
          valB = Number(b.quantity || 0);
          break;
        case 'gross_amount':
          valA = Number(a.amount || 0);
          valB = Number(b.amount || 0);
          break;
        case 'pull_out_ref':
          valA = String(a.pull_out_ref || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.pull_out_ref || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'credit_issued_by':
          valA = String(a.credit_issued_by || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.credit_issued_by || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'product_name':
          valA = String(a.product_name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.product_name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'credit_issued_at':
        default:
          valA = new Date(a.credit_issued_at || 0).getTime();
          valB = new Date(b.credit_issued_at || 0).getTime();
          break;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [creditMemosList, searchQuery, supplierFilter, dateFrom, dateTo, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedMemos = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return processedMemos.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [processedMemos, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // Selection handlers
  const isAllPageSelected = paginatedMemos.length > 0 && paginatedMemos.every(m => selectedMemoNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number));
  const isSomeSelected = selectedMemoNumbers.size > 0;

  const toggleSelect = (cmNum) => {
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(cmNum)) {
        next.delete(cmNum);
      } else {
        next.add(cmNum);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (isAllPageSelected) {
      setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        paginatedMemos.forEach(m => next.delete(m.credit_memo_number));
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        paginatedMemos.forEach(m => next.add(m.credit_memo_number));
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(new Set());
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setSupplierFilter('All');
    setDateFrom('');
    setDateTo('');
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(new Set());
  };

  const handleBulkPrint = () => {
    const selected = creditMemosList.filter(m => selectedMemoNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number));
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (onPrintBulk) {
      onPrintBulk(selected);
    } else if (onViewVoucher) {
      onViewVoucher(selected);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkDelete = () => {
    const selected = creditMemosList.filter(m => selectedMemoNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number));
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo) {
      onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo(selected);
    }
  };

  const handleSort = (field) => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
    if (sortField === field) {
      setSortDirection(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortField(field);
      setSortDirection('desc');
    }
  };

  // Genuine Excel (.xlsx) Export with numeric/currency formatting and plain-text barcodes/IDs
  const handleExportXlsx = () => {
    if (!processedMemos.length) return;
    const columns = [
      { header: 'Serial No.', width: 11, type: 'number' },
      { header: 'Credit Memo #', width: 20, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'RMA #', width: 20, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Issue Date (YYYY-MM-DD)', width: 22, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Supplier / Vendor', width: 24, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Barcode', width: 18, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Product Description', width: 38, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Quantity', width: 11, type: 'number' },
      { header: 'Unit', width: 12, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Net Unit Price (PHP)', width: 18, type: 'currency' },
      { header: '12% VAT Amount (PHP)', width: 18, type: 'currency' },
      { header: 'Total Credited Amount (PHP)', width: 22, type: 'currency' },
      { header: 'Gross Amount (PHP)', width: 18, type: 'currency' },
      { header: 'Pull Out Ref', width: 18, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Pull Out Date (YYYY-MM-DD)', width: 22, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Issued By', width: 20, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Customer AE', width: 22, type: 'text' }
    ];

    const rows = processedMemos.map((m, idx) => {
      const totalAmt = Number(m.credit_amount) || Number(m.amount) || 0;
      const netPrice = totalAmt / 1.12;
      const vatAmt = totalAmt - netPrice;
      const dateStr = m.credit_issued_at ? formatDateYmd(m.credit_issued_at) : '';

      return [
        idx + 1,
        m.credit_memo_number || '',
        m.rma_number || '',
        dateStr,
        m.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        m.barcode || '',
        m.product_name || '',
        Number(m.quantity || 1),
        m.unit_name || 'pc',
        Number((Number(m.unit_price) || (netPrice / (m.quantity || 1))).toFixed(2)),
        Number(vatAmt.toFixed(2)),
        Number(totalAmt.toFixed(2)),
        Number((Number(m.amount) || 0).toFixed(2)),
        m.pull_out_ref || '',
        m.pull_out_date || '',
        m.credit_issued_by || '',
        m.customer_ae_name || ''
      ];
    });

    const saveTs = formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date());
    downloadTableXlsx({
      sheetName: isTestMode ? 'Test Credit Memos' : 'Finance Credit Memos',
      title: `${isTestMode ? 'TEST MODE SANDBOX — ' : ''}PINGCON FINANCE CREDIT MEMOS REPORT`,
      subtitle: `Generated: ${saveTs} (Asia/Manila) | Total Credit Memos: ${rows.length}`,
      filename: `${isTestMode ? 'Sandbox_' : ''}Finance_Credit_Memos ${saveTs}.xlsx`,
      columns,
      rows
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">

      {/* Financial Summary KPI Strip: Fluid responsive grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3.5">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mb-1.5">
            <Receipt className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
              Approved
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
            {metrics.count}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Credit Memos</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Total vouchers issued</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mb-1.5">
            <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
              Credited
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono">
            ₱{metrics.totalCredited.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Total Credit Amount</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Financial deductions granted</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 mb-1.5">
            <Package className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
              Logistics
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
            {metrics.totalUnits}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Units Pulled Out</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Total defective/pull-out pcs</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 mb-1.5">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">
              Ledger
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
            ₱{metrics.totalGross.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Gross Invoiced Value</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Initial gross claim</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Table Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4 w-full min-w-0 box-border">

        {/* Title and Top Actions */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full min-w-0">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Finance Credit Memorandum Section
              </h2>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-black bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-mono shrink-0">
                {creditMemosList.length} Total
              </span>
              {isTestMode && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shrink-0">
                  🧪 Sandbox Test Mode
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
              Manage approved customer deductions, pull-out receipts, credit amounts, and printable accounting vouchers.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto flex-wrap shrink-0">
            {creditMemosList.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportXlsx}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 sm:px-3.5 sm:py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs shrink-0"
                title="Export all credit memos to Excel (.xlsx)"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Export Excel (.xlsx)</span>
              </button>
            )}

            {canManageCreditMemos && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenCreateModal}
                className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Issue Credit Memo</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Date Range Toolbar */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-3.5 space-y-2.5 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-2.5 w-full min-w-0">
            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative w-full md:flex-1 min-w-0">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3 shrink-0" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                placeholder="Search by CM #, RMA #, barcode, item name, pull-out ref, or issuer..."
                className="w-full min-w-0 pl-10 pr-9 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 transition-all box-border"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearchQuery('');
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Filter Controls Row */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:flex md:items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
              {/* Supplier Filter Dropdown */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                  Supplier:
                </label>
                <select
                  value={supplierFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setSupplierFilter(e.target.value);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="w-full md:w-auto px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs truncate box-border"
                  title="Filter by Supplier"
                >
                  {suppliers.map(sup => (
                    <option key={sup} value={sup}>
                      {sup === 'All' ? 'All Suppliers' : sup}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Custom Date Range Filter */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 w-full sm:w-auto min-w-0">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs min-w-0 box-border">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase truncate">From Date</span>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    aria-label="Credit Memos From Date"
                    value={dateFrom}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setDateFrom(e.target.value);
                      setCurrentPage(1);
                    }}
                    className="bg-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-[11px] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer w-full min-w-0"
                    title="Filter credit memos from date"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs min-w-0 box-border">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase truncate">To Date</span>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    aria-label="Credit Memos To Date"
                    value={dateTo}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setDateTo(e.target.value);
                      setCurrentPage(1);
                    }}
                    className="bg-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-[11px] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer w-full min-w-0"
                    title="Filter credit memos to date"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Reset Filters */}
              {(searchQuery || supplierFilter !== 'All' || dateFrom || dateTo) && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={resetFilters}
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer box-border"
                  title="Reset all filters"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span>Reset</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 px-1 font-medium">
            <span>
              Showing <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{processedMemos.length}</strong> of {creditMemosList.length} credit memos
              {(searchQuery || dateFrom || dateTo) && (
                <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold ml-1.5">• Date / search filters active</span>
              )}
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-400">
              Click column headers to sort (<strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{{
                credit_issued_at: 'Issued Date',
                credit_memo_number: 'CM #',
                rma_number: 'RMA #',
                supplier_name: 'Supplier',
                product_name: 'Product',
                quantity: 'Qty',
                pull_out_ref: 'Pull-Out Ref',
                credit_amount: 'Credit Amount',
                credit_issued_by: 'Issued By'
              }[sortField] || sortField}</strong> {sortDirection === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼'})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Floating Bulk Action Bar (When items are selected) */}
        {isSomeSelected && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 border-2 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-2xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
              <span className="text-xs font-black text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-200">
                {selectedMemoNumbers.size} Credit Memo{selectedMemoNumbers.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} Selected
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleBulkPrint}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
                title="Print all selected credit memos sequentially"
              >
                <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Print Selected ({selectedMemoNumbers.size})</span>
              </button>

              {canManageCreditMemos && onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleBulkDelete}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  title="Void and delete all selected credit memos"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Delete Selected ({selectedMemoNumbers.size})</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearSelection}
                className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Clear Selection
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Table Records */}
        {creditMemosList.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 space-y-3 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 p-6">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
              <Receipt className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
              No Credit Memos Issued Yet
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
              When items are returned and pulled out from stores or warehouse inventory, Finance can issue official Credit Memos with approved credit amounts and printable vouchers.
            </p>
            {canManageCreditMemos && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenCreateModal}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Issue First Credit Memo</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : processedMemos.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-10 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            No credit memos match "{searchQuery}"
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
            {isDesktopMd ? (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-800/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">

                    {/* Header Select All Checkbox */}
                    <th className="py-3 px-2.5 text-center w-9">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isAllPageSelected}
                        onChange={toggleSelectAll}
                        title="Select All on this page"
                        className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                    </th>

                    <th className="py-3 px-2 w-12 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      SN
                    </th>

                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_memo_number')}
                      className="py-3 px-2.5 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>CM # &amp; Issued</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_memo_number' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('rma_number')}
                      className="py-3 px-2.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>RMA &amp; Supplier</span>
                        {sortField === 'rma_number' || sortField === 'supplier_name' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('product_name')}
                      className="py-3 px-2.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Product &amp; Barcode</span>
                        {sortField === 'product_name' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('quantity')}
                      className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-center cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                        <span>Qty</span>
                        {sortField === 'quantity' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('pull_out_ref')}
                      className="py-3 px-2.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Pull-Out Ref</span>
                        {sortField === 'pull_out_ref' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_amount')}
                      className="py-3 px-2.5 font-black text-right cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        <span>Credit (₱)</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_amount' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_issued_by')}
                      className="py-3 px-2.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Issued By</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_issued_by' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2.5 text-center font-bold whitespace-nowrap">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 font-medium">
                  {paginatedMemos.map((memo, idx) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedMemoNumbers.has(memo.credit_memo_number);
                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={memo.credit_memo_number}
                        className={`transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30' : 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'}`}
                      >
                        {/* Checkbox */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 text-center w-9">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={isSelected}
                            onChange={() => toggleSelect(memo.credit_memo_number)}
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                          />
                        </td>

                        {/* SN */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                          <span className="font-black text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px]">
                            #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* CM # */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                            className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
                            title="Click to view official printable voucher"
                          >
                            <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{memo.credit_memo_number}</span>
                          </button>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">
                            {memo.credit_issued_at ? formatDateYmd(memo.credit_issued_at) : '—'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* RMA # */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs max-w-[185px]">
                          {(() => {
                            const cmRmas = getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(memo);
                            const cmItems = getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems(memo);
                            const count = Math.max(cmRmas.length, cmItems.length);
                            const isMulti = count > 1;
                            return (
                              <>
                                <div className="truncate" title={cmRmas.join(', ') || memo.rma_number || 'N/A'}>
                                  {isMulti ? `${cmRmas[0] || memo.rma_number} (+${count - 1})` : (memo.rma_number || 'N/A')}
                                </div>
                                {isMulti && (
                                  <span
                                    className="mt-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-black bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 whitespace-nowrap"
                                    title={`Consolidated RMA Tickets: ${cmRmas.join(', ')}`}
                                  >
                                    🔗 Consolidated ({count} RMAs)
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-sans mt-0.5 truncate">
                                  {memo.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
                                </div>
                              </>
                            );
                          })()}
                        </td>

                        {/* Product Name & Barcode */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 max-w-[175px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate" title={memo.product_name}>
                            {memo.product_name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                            {memo.barcode} {memo.sku ? `• ${memo.sku}` : ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Quantity */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                          {memo.quantity} {memo.unit_name || 'pc'}
                        </td>

                        {/* Pull Out Reference */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 max-w-[140px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate" title={memo.pull_out_ref}>
                            {memo.pull_out_ref || 'Warehouse Pull-Out'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                            {memo.pull_out_date || 'N/A'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Credit Amount (₱) & Gross Rate */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="font-black font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-xs">
                            ₱{Number(memo.credit_amount || memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                          </div>
                          {Number(memo.amount || 0) > 0 && (
                            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                              Gross: ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Credit Issued By */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 max-w-[120px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-[11px] truncate" title={memo.credit_issued_by}>
                            {memo.credit_issued_by || 'Finance'}
                          </div>
                          {memo.credit_issued_by_email && (
                            <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 font-mono truncate" title={memo.credit_issued_by_email}>
                              {memo.credit_issued_by_email}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-2.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title="Print Official Credit Voucher"
                            >
                              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </button>

                            {canManageCreditMemos && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onEditCreditMemo(memo)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Edit Credit Memo"
                              >
                                <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            )}

                            {canManageCreditMemos && onRequestDeleteCreditMemo && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onRequestDeleteCreditMemo(memo)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Void / Delete Credit Memo"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
              {paginatedMemos.map((memo, idx) => {
                const isSelected = selectedMemoNumbers.has(memo.credit_memo_number);
                const cmRmas = getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(memo);
                const cmItems = getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems(memo);
                const count = Math.max(cmRmas.length, cmItems.length);
                const isMulti = count > 1;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={`mob-${memo.credit_memo_number}`}
                    className={`p-3.5 space-y-2 transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => toggleSelect(memo.credit_memo_number)}
                          className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                        />
                        <span className="font-mono font-black text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10.5px]">
                          #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                        </span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                          className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                          <span>{memo.credit_memo_number}</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right font-mono shrink-0">
                        <div className="font-black text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-xs">
                          ₱{Number(memo.credit_amount || memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </div>
                        {Number(memo.amount || 0) > 0 && (
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            Gross: ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1 text-xs">
                      <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white break-words">{memo.product_name}</div>
                      <div className="font-mono text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
                        <span className="font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                          {isMulti ? `${cmRmas[0] || memo.rma_number} (+${count - 1})` : (memo.rma_number || 'N/A')}
                        </span>
                        <span>• {memo.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}</span>
                        <span>• {memo.quantity} {memo.unit_name || 'pc'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
                        <span>Pull-out: <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{memo.pull_out_ref || 'Warehouse Pull-Out'}</strong> ({memo.pull_out_date || 'N/A'})</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 min-w-0">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{memo.credit_issued_by || 'Finance'}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono ml-1.5">{memo.credit_issued_at ? formatDateYmd(memo.credit_issued_at) : '—'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                          title="Print Official Credit Voucher"
                        >
                          <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        {canManageCreditMemos && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onEditCreditMemo(memo)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                            title="Edit Credit Memo"
                          >
                            <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {canManageCreditMemos && onRequestDeleteCreditMemo && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onRequestDeleteCreditMemo(memo)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                            title="Void / Delete Credit Memo"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            )}

            {/* Pagination */}
            <TablePagination
              currentPage={currentPage}
              pageSize={pageSize}
              totalItems={processedMemos.length}
              onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
              onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
                setPageSize(newSize);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/CreditMemoVoucherModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { X, Printer, Receipt, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';
import { buildPickupFormCopiesList } from '../utils/pickupFormPdf';
import {
  formatDateYmd,
  formatDateTimeYmdHm,
  formatSaveFileTimestamp,
  stripCreditMemoMetaTag,
  getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems,
  getCreditMemoRmaNumbers
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

const clampCopies = (val) => {
  const parsed = parseInt(val, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(10, parsed));
};

/**
 * Plain B&W Letter-Size (8.5" x 11") Official Credit Memorandum Voucher.
 * Supports single & Multi-RMA Consolidated Credit Memos with Separated Full Pages,
 * customizable OUR COMPANY COPY / CUSTOMER COPY counts, repeating thead headers, and zero clipping.
 */
export default function CreditMemoVoucherModal({ isOpen, onClose, creditMemo, creditMemos = [] }) {
  // Declare ALL hooks unconditionally before early returns (zero React #310)
  const [ourCopyCount, setOurCopyCount] = useState(1);
  const [customerCopyCount, setCustomerCopyCount] = useState(1);

  const memosToRender = useMemo(() => {
    return (creditMemos && creditMemos.length > 0)
      ? creditMemos
      : (creditMemo ? [creditMemo] : []);
  }, [creditMemos, creditMemo]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setOurCopyCount(1);
    setCustomerCopyCount(1);
  }, [isOpen, memosToRender.length]);

  const copiesPerMemo = useMemo(() => {
    return buildPickupFormCopiesList({
      ourCopyCount,
      otherCopyCount: customerCopyCount,
      isCustomerStream: true
    });
  }, [ourCopyCount, customerCopyCount]);

  if (!isOpen || memosToRender.length === 0) return null;

  const isBulk = memosToRender.length > 1;
  const totalCopiesPerMemo = copiesPerMemo.length;
  const totalSheetsCount = memosToRender.length * totalCopiesPerMemo;

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (totalSheetsCount === 0) return;
    const baseTitle = (memosToRender.length === 1 && memosToRender[0]?.credit_memo_number)
      ? `Credit-Memo-${memosToRender[0].credit_memo_number}`
      : `Batch-Credit-Memos-${memosToRender.length}-Vouchers`;
    const docTitle = `${baseTitle} ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}`;

    printIsolatedElement({
      elementId: 'credit-memo-voucher-print-root',
      documentTitle: docTitle,
      pageSize: 'letter portrait',
      pageMargin: '0.4in',
      allowMultiPage: true,
      customStyles: `
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root, #credit-memo-voucher-print-root * {
          color: #000000 !important;
          background-color: #ffffff !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
        }
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root {
          display: block !important;
          width: 100% !important;
          max-width: 7.7in !important;
          margin: 0 auto !important;
          padding: 0 !important;
          border: none !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
          box-sizing: border-box !important;
        }
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root > div {
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        .voucher-sheet {
          display: block !important;
          page-break-inside: auto !important;
          break-inside: auto !important;
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
          padding: 0.22in !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          border: 1.5px solid #000000 !important;
          box-sizing: border-box !important;
        }
        .voucher-copy-break {
          page-break-before: always !important;
          break-before: page !important;
          height: 0 !important;
          margin: 0 !important;
          padding: 0 !important;
          border: none !important;
          display: block !important;
        }
        .voucher-sheet table {
          width: 100% !important;
          border-collapse: collapse !important;
        }
        .voucher-sheet thead {
          display: table-header-group !important;
        }
        .voucher-sheet tr, .voucher-signatures {
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .print-hidden, .print\\:hidden, .bottom-sheet-handle,
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root .print\\:hidden,
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root .bottom-sheet-handle {
          display: none !important;
        }
        input {
          border: none !important;
          outline: none !important;
          background: transparent !important;
        }
      `
    });
  };

  // Expand ordered list of (memo x copy) sheets
  const expandedSheets = [];
  memosToRender.forEach((memo, memoIdx) => {
    copiesPerMemo.forEach((copy) => {
      expandedSheets.push({ memo, memoIdx, copy });
    });
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in overflow-y-auto">
      <div
        id="credit-memo-voucher-print-root"
        className="bg-white rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-4xl w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[95vh] overflow-hidden text-black my-0 sm:my-auto pb-safe"
      >
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden print:hidden" />

        {/* Top Control Bar (Hidden when printing) */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 space-y-2.5 shrink-0 print:hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <Receipt className="w-5 h-5 text-black shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-extrabold text-xs text-black">
                {isBulk
                  ? `Batch Credit Vouchers (${memosToRender.length}) — US Letter B&W`
                  : 'Official Credit Memorandum Voucher (8.5" × 11" Letter • Plain B&W)'}
              </span>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-300 text-[10px] font-black">
                Separated Full Pages (Dedicated Paper per Copy)
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={totalSheetsCount === 0}
                onClick={handlePrint}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>
                  {isBulk
                    ? `Print All ${memosToRender.length} Vouchers (${totalSheetsCount} Papers)`
                    : `Print Letter Voucher / PDF (${totalSheetsCount} Copy Paper${totalSheetsCount === 1 ? '' : 's'})`}
                </span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Close voucher"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Customizable Copy Count Steppers & Presets */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 text-xs">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-700">
                Paper Copies{isBulk ? ' (Per Voucher)' : ''}:
              </span>

              <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-800">
                <span>Our Company Copies:</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="Our Company Copies"
                  min={0}
                  max={10}
                  value={ourCopyCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setOurCopyCount(clampCopies(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-11 text-center font-mono font-black bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-black"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-800">
                <span>Customer Copies:</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="Customer Copies"
                  min={0}
                  max={10}
                  value={customerCopyCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomerCopyCount(clampCopies(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-11 text-center font-mono font-black bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-black"
                />
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOurCopyCount(1);
                  setCustomerCopyCount(1);
                }}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
              >
                1 + 1 (2 Papers)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOurCopyCount(2);
                  setCustomerCopyCount(1);
                }}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
              >
                2 Ours + 1 Theirs (3 Papers)
              </button>
            </div>

            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-black text-slate-800">
              Total Output: {totalSheetsCount} Paper{totalSheetsCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {totalSheetsCount === 0 && (
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-300 text-rose-800 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>Total copy count is 0. Increase Our Company Copies or Customer Copies to at least 1 before printing.</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Document Container */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 sm:p-5 bg-slate-200 space-y-5 print:p-0 print:bg-white print:space-y-0 print:overflow-visible">
          {totalSheetsCount === 0 ? (
            <div className="my-8 mx-auto p-8 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-2 max-w-md">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-rose-500 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-sm font-black text-black">No Copies Selected (0 Total Copies)</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                Set Our Company Copies or Customer Copies to 1 or higher above to preview and print.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            expandedSheets.map(({ memo, memoIdx, copy }, sheetIdx) => {
              const consolidatedItems = getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems(memo);
              const rmaNumbers = getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(memo);
              const isConsolidated = consolidatedItems.length > 1 || rmaNumbers.length > 1;
              const rowsToRender = consolidatedItems.length > 0
                ? consolidatedItems
                : [
                    {
                      rma_number: memo.rma_number || 'N/A',
                      product_name: memo.product_name || 'Item',
                      barcode: memo.barcode || 'N/A',
                      sku: memo.sku || '',
                      quantity: memo.quantity || 1,
                      unit_name: memo.unit_name || 'pc',
                      unit_price: Number(memo.unit_price || 0),
                      amount: Number(memo.amount || 0)
                    }
                  ];
              const cleanNotes = stripCreditMemoMetaTag(memo.clean_notes ?? memo.notes ?? '');

              return (
                <React.Fragment key={`${memo.credit_memo_number || memoIdx}-${copy.key}`}>
                  {sheetIdx > 0 && (
                    <div className="voucher-copy-break border-t-2 border-dotted border-black pt-2 text-center text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-black print:hidden">
                      — Page Break Before {copy.title} —
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="voucher-sheet p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-4 sm:space-y-5 print:p-2 print:space-y-3.5 bg-white text-black border border-black shadow-sm print:shadow-none">
                    {/* Header */}
                    <div className="border-b-2 border-black pb-3 sm:pb-4 bg-white text-black">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap mb-2">
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 border-[1.5px] border-black bg-white text-black text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-block">
                          {copy.title}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                        <div className="pl-1">
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-black">
                            WHOLESALE DISTRIBUTION &amp; RETURNS
                          </div>
                          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-black mt-0.5">
                            FINANCE CREDIT MEMORANDUM
                          </h1>
                          <p className="text-xs text-black font-medium mt-0.5">
                            Finance &amp; Accounting Department • Official Accounting Voucher
                          </p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                            {isConsolidated && (
                              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 border border-black bg-white text-black text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-block">
                                CONSOLIDATED ({rmaNumbers.length} RMAs)
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <span className="px-3 py-1 border-[1.5px] border-black bg-white text-black text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-block">
                              CREDIT MEMO
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono font-black text-sm text-black mt-1">
                            {memo.credit_memo_number}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-black font-mono">
                            Date (YYYY-MM-DD): {formatDateYmd(memo.credit_issued_at || new Date())}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Reference Overview Grid */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs bg-white p-3.5 border border-black">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-black block">Customer / Supplier</span>
                        <div className="font-black text-black text-sm mt-0.5">
                          {memo.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-black mt-1 font-mono">
                          Assigned AE: <strong>{memo.customer_ae_name || 'N/A'}</strong>
                          {memo.customer_ae_email ? ` (${memo.customer_ae_email})` : ''}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-black block">
                          {isConsolidated ? `Linked RMA Tickets (${rmaNumbers.length})` : 'Linked RMA Return Ticket'}
                        </span>
                        <div className="font-mono font-black text-black text-xs sm:text-sm mt-0.5 break-words">
                          {rmaNumbers.length > 0 ? rmaNumbers.join(', ') : (memo.rma_number || 'N/A')}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-black mt-1">
                          Pull Out Ref: <strong className="font-semibold">{memo.pull_out_ref || 'N/A'}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-black">
                          Pull Out Date (YYYY-MM-DD): {memo.pull_out_date ? (formatDateYmd(memo.pull_out_date) || memo.pull_out_date) : 'N/A'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Line Items Table (Repeating thead across pages) */}
                    <div className="border border-black bg-white">
                      <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="bg-white border-b-[1.5px] border-black text-black font-black uppercase text-[10px]">
                            {isConsolidated && <th className="py-2 px-2.5 border-r border-black">RMA #</th>}
                            <th className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black">Item Description</th>
                            <th className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black font-mono">Barcode / SKU</th>
                            <th className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black text-center">Qty</th>
                            <th className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black text-right">Unit Price</th>
                            <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Gross Amount</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="font-medium">
                          {rowsToRender.map((item, rowIdx) => (
                            <tr key={`${item.rma_number || 'row'}-${rowIdx}`} className="border-b border-black last:border-b-0 bg-white text-black">
                              {isConsolidated && (
                                <td className="py-2 px-2.5 border-r border-black font-mono text-[10.5px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap">
                                  {item.rma_number || 'N/A'}
                                </td>
                              )}
                              <td className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black">
                                <div className="font-bold text-black text-xs">{item.product_name}</div>
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-black">Wholesale Return Pull-Out</div>
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black font-mono text-[11px] text-black">
                                <div>{item.barcode || 'N/A'}</div>
                                {item.sku && <div className="text-black">SKU: {item.sku}</div>}
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black text-center font-bold font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                                {item.quantity} {item.unit_name || 'pc'}
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-2 px-3 border-r border-black text-right font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                                ₱{Number(item.unit_price || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right font-bold font-mono text-black whitespace-nowrap">
                                ₱{Number(item.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>

                    {/* Financial Summary & Total Credit Box (Plain B&W Outline) */}
                    <div className="flex justify-end">
                      <div className="w-full sm:w-80 bg-white border-[1.5px] border-black p-3.5 text-right space-y-1">
                        <div className="text-xs text-black flex justify-between">
                          <span>Gross Returned Value ({rowsToRender.length} item{rowsToRender.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}):</span>
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold">
                            ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="pt-1.5 border-t border-black flex justify-between items-baseline">
                          <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-black">Total Credit Granted:</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-black">
                            ₱{Number(memo.credit_amount || memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-black font-semibold pt-0.5">
                          Approved for account deduction / statement credit
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Accounting Remarks (stripped of hidden [CM_META:...] JSON) */}
                    {cleanNotes && (
                      <div className="p-2.5 bg-white border border-black text-xs text-black">
                        <span className="font-bold block text-[10px] uppercase text-black mb-0.5">Finance Notes / Audit Remarks:</span>
                        <span>{cleanNotes}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Signatures & Certification Grid */}
                    <div className="voucher-signatures pt-6 sm:pt-7 border-t border-black grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center text-xs bg-white text-black">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          defaultValue={memo.credit_issued_by || 'Analiza B. Benoza'}
                          className="border-b border-black pb-1 font-bold text-black text-xs text-center w-full bg-transparent border-t-0 border-l-0 border-r-0 focus:outline-none print:border-b print:border-black"
                          title="Click to edit Finance Head name if needed"
                        />
                        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-black block">
                          Finance Head
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-black font-mono block">
                          Prepared Date &amp; Time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): {formatDateTimeYmdHm(memo.credit_issued_at || memo.created_at || new Date())}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="border-b border-black pb-1 font-bold text-black text-xs">
                          {memo.customer_ae_name || 'Customer AE'}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-black block">
                          Account Executive
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-black block">
                          Customer Coordination
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="border-b border-black pb-1 font-bold text-black text-xs italic">
                          (Customer Signature)
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-black block">
                          Received &amp; Acknowledged
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-black block">
                          Customer Authorized Rep
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Document Footer Notice */}
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-center text-black pt-2 border-t border-black bg-white">
                      This Credit Memorandum is an official accounting instrument. Authorized adjustments are directly applied to company ledger accounts.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </React.Fragment>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
