export default function CustomerHubTab({
  reportsList = [],
  creditMemosList = [],
  savedProductsList = [],
  currentUser,
  coworkerQueueFilter = 'all',
  onClearCoworkerQueueFilter,
  updatingQueueId = null,
  isTestMode = false,
  onOpenReportsModal,
  onOpenMatrixExport,
  onInspectTriage,
  onOpenSimpleWizard,
  onOpenPickupForm,
  onViewQR,
  onViewPhoto,
  onViewExplanation,
  onEditProductFromReport,
  onOpenCreditMemo,
  onViewCreditMemoVoucher,
  onConfirmCoworkerAction,
  onResetToPending,
  onArchiveReport,
  onBulkArchiveReports,
  onRequestDeleteReport,
  onRequestBulkDeleteReports,
  onOpenCreateCreditMemo,
  onEditCreditMemo,
  onPrintBulkCreditMemos,
  onRequestDeleteCreditMemo,
  onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo,
  onOpenCreditMemosLedger = null,
  defaultSubTab = 'returns',
  externalSubTab = null,
  onSubTabChange,
  selectionResetTick = 0,
  externalStatusFilter = null
}) {
  const isDesktopMd = useIsDesktopMd();
  const canEditProducts = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin' || currentUser?.role === 'staff';
  const canDeleteReports = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState(() => (
    defaultSubTab === 'credit_memos' ? 'credit_memos' : 'returns'
  ));
  const [followUpModalReport, setFollowUpModalReport] = useState(null);
  const [followUpConfig, setFollowUpConfig] = useState(() => notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig());
  const [customerRowBusyId, setCustomerRowBusyId] = useState(null);
  const [customerFollowUpBanner, setCustomerFollowUpBanner] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncCfg = () => setFollowUpConfig(notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig());
    window.addEventListener('rma-settings-changed', syncCfg);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('rma-settings-changed', syncCfg);
  }, []);

  const handleCustomerCloseCase = async (item) => {
    const key = item.id || item.rma_number;
    setCustomerRowBusyId(key);
    setCustomerFollowUpBanner(null);
    try {
      await catalogService.closeFollowUpCase(item, {
        markPickedUp: true,
        reason: 'Handover Completed — Case Closed',
        actorName: currentUser?.name || currentUser?.email || 'Admin'
      });
      setCustomerFollowUpBanner({
        type: 'success',
        text: `${item.rma_number} marked Case Closed.`
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', { detail: { type: 'followup-closed', rmaNumber: item.rma_number } }));
    } catch (err) {
      setCustomerFollowUpBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.message || 'Failed closing case.' });
    } finally {
      setCustomerRowBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkReordered = async (item, nextStatus = 'reordered') => {
    if (!item || customerRowBusyId) return;
    const key = item.id || item.rma_number;
    setCustomerRowBusyId(key);
    setCustomerFollowUpBanner(null);
    try {
      await catalogService.markAsReordered({
        item,
        reorderStatus: nextStatus,
        actorName: currentUser?.name || currentUser?.email || 'Admin'
      });
      setCustomerFollowUpBanner({
        type: 'success',
        text: nextStatus === 'reordered'
          ? `${item.rma_number} marked Reordered (4-Choice Outcome & 10-Day SLA unchanged).`
          : `${item.rma_number} reorder status reset to Pending.`
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', { detail: { type: 'reorder-updated', rmaNumber: item.rma_number } }));
    } catch (err) {
      setCustomerFollowUpBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.message || 'Failed updating Reorder status.' });
    } finally {
      setCustomerRowBusyId(null);
    }
  };
  const onSubTabChangeRef = React.useRef(onSubTabChange);
  onSubTabChangeRef.current = onSubTabChange;

  useEffect(() => {
    const requestedSub = typeof externalSubTab === 'string'
      ? externalSubTab
      : externalSubTab?.value;
    if (requestedSub === 'returns' || requestedSub === 'credit_memos') {
      setActiveSubTab(requestedSub);
    }
  }, [externalSubTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (onSubTabChangeRef.current) {
      onSubTabChangeRef.current(activeSubTab);
    }
  }, [activeSubTab]);

  const [reportsViewMode, setReportsViewMode] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('rma_admin_reports_view_mode') || 'table';
  });

  // Return Reports Filtering, Sorting & Pagination State
  const [reportsSearchQuery, setReportsSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [reportsReasonFilter, setReportsReasonFilter] = useState('all');
  const [reportsStatusFilter, setReportsStatusFilter] = useState('all');
  const [reportsDispositionFilter, setReportsDispositionFilter] = useState('all');
  const [reportsReorderFilter, setReportsReorderFilter] = useState('all');
  const [reportsConditionGradeFilter, setReportsConditionGradeFilter] = useState('all');
  const [reportsDateFrom, setReportsDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [reportsDateTo, setReportsDateTo] = useState('');
  const [reportsSortField, setReportsSortField] = useState('id');
  const [reportsSortDirection, setReportsSortDirection] = useState('desc');
  const [reportsCurrentPage, setReportsCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [reportsPageSize, setReportsPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [selectedReportIds, setSelectedReportIds] = useState(new Set());
  const [expandedManifestIds, setExpandedManifestIds] = useState(new Set());
  const toggleManifestExpand = (id) => {
    setExpandedManifestIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };


  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedReportIds(prev => {
      if (prev.size === 0) return prev;
      const valid = new Set(reportsList.flatMap(r => [r.id, r.rma_number].filter(Boolean)));
      const next = new Set([...prev].filter(id => valid.has(id)));
      return next.size === prev.size ? prev : next;
    });
  }, [reportsList]);


  // Clear selections when switching between Live Mode and Sandbox Test Mode
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedReportIds(new Set());
    setReportsCurrentPage(1);
  }, [isTestMode, selectionResetTick]);

  // Reset to page 1 when coworker queue filter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setReportsCurrentPage(1);
  }, [coworkerQueueFilter]);

  // Honor external status filter navigation (e.g. from notification bell)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (externalStatusFilter && externalStatusFilter.value) {
      setActiveSubTab('returns');
      setReportsStatusFilter(externalStatusFilter.value);
      setReportsCurrentPage(1);
    }
  }, [externalStatusFilter]);

  const handleSetReportsViewMode = (mode) => {
    setReportsViewMode(mode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('rma_admin_reports_view_mode', mode);
    } catch (e) { }
  };

  const handleReportsSort = (field) => {
    setReportsCurrentPage(1);
    if (reportsSortField === field) {
      setReportsSortDirection(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setReportsSortField(field);
      setReportsSortDirection('asc');
    }
  };


  const resetReportsFilters = () => {
    setReportsSearchQuery('');
    setReportsReasonFilter('all');
    setReportsStatusFilter('all');
    setReportsDispositionFilter('all');
    setReportsReorderFilter('all');
    setReportsConditionGradeFilter('all');
    if (onClearCoworkerQueueFilter) onClearCoworkerQueueFilter();
    setReportsDateFrom('');
    setReportsDateTo('');
    setReportsCurrentPage(1);
    setSelectedReportIds(new Set());
  };

  const customerScopedTotal = React.useMemo(() => {
    return reportsList.filter(item => item.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound' && !isManifestSubItem(item, reportsList)).length;
  }, [reportsList]);

  const isItemReadyToRestock = React.useCallback((item, allReports = reportsList) => {
    if (!item) return false;
    const isManifestRow = !item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && isBatchManifest(item, allReports);
    if (isManifestRow) {
      const children = getReportManifestItems(item, allReports);
      return children.some(c => {
        const d = String(c?.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
        const st = String(c?.status || '').toLowerCase();
        return d.includes('restock') && !['restocked', 'closed', 'resolved', 'scrapped', 'disposed'].includes(st);
      });
    }
    const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
    const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
    return disp.includes('restock') && !['restocked', 'closed', 'resolved', 'scrapped', 'disposed'].includes(st);
  }, [reportsList]);

  const isItemOnHold = React.useCallback((item, allReports = reportsList) => {
    if (!item) return false;
    const isManifestRow = !item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && isBatchManifest(item, allReports);
    if (isManifestRow) {
      const children = getReportManifestItems(item, allReports);
      return children.some(c => {
        const d = String(c?.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
        const st = String(c?.status || '').toLowerCase();
        return (d.includes('quarantine') || d.includes('hold') || st === 'quarantine' || st === 'hold') && !['closed', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'deleted'].includes(st);
      });
    }
    const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
    const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
    return (disp.includes('quarantine') || disp.includes('hold') || st === 'quarantine' || st === 'hold') && !['closed', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'deleted'].includes(st);
  }, [reportsList]);

  const processedReports = React.useMemo(() => {
    const q = reportsSearchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    let list = reportsList.filter(item => {
      // Customer RMA Hub strictly isolates to Customer Inbound Returns at ALL times
      if (item.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound') {
        return false;
      }
      // Omit child rows of manifest returns (which share identical rma_number with parent)
      // BUT keep Split tickets (which have their own unique rma_number like -B, -C)
      if (isManifestSubItem(item, reportsList)) {
        return false;
      }

      if (q) {
        const matchesChild = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.some(child => (
          (child.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (child.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (child.sku || child.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        ));

        const matches = (
          matchesChild ||
          String(item.id || '').includes(q) ||
          (item.rma_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.reporter_name || item.reported_by || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.reporter_contact || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.reason || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.warehouse_location || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.store_branch || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.invoice_dr_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.si_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.dr_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.po_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.batch_lot_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      if (reportsReasonFilter !== 'all') {
        const itemReasonNorm = (item.reason || '').replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const filterReasonNorm = reportsReasonFilter.replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (itemReasonNorm !== filterReasonNorm) return false;
      }

      if (reportsStatusFilter !== 'all') {
        const s = String(item.status || 'received_at_dock').toLowerCase();
        if (reportsStatusFilter === 'pending_admin_details') {
          const isManifestRow = isBatchManifest(item, reportsList);
          if (isManifestRow) {
            const children = getReportManifestItems(item, reportsList);
            const hasUnmappedChild = children.some(child => !hasAssignedSku(child, savedProductsList));
            if (!hasUnmappedChild) return false;
          } else {
            const isUnmappedStandalone = !hasAssignedSku(item, savedProductsList) || s === 'pending_admin_details';
            if (!isUnmappedStandalone) return false;
          }
        } else if (reportsStatusFilter === 'received_at_dock') {
          if (s !== 'pending' && s !== 'received_at_dock') return false;
        } else if (reportsStatusFilter === 'draft') {
          if (s !== 'draft') return false;
        } else if (reportsStatusFilter === 'restocked') {
          if (s !== 'restocked' && s !== 'closed' && s !== 'resolved') return false;
        } else if (reportsStatusFilter === 'scrapped') {
          if (s !== 'scrapped' && s !== 'disposed') return false;
        } else if (s !== reportsStatusFilter.toLowerCase()) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // Disposition filter (supports numbered prefix e.g. "1- Pending Triage")
      if (reportsDispositionFilter !== 'all') {
        const itemDispNorm = (item.disposition || 'Pending Triage').replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const filterDispNorm = reportsDispositionFilter.replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (itemDispNorm !== filterDispNorm) return false;
      }

      // Condition Grade filter
      if (reportsConditionGradeFilter !== 'all') {
        const itemGrade = item.condition_grade || 'Unassessed';
        if (!itemGrade.toLowerCase().startsWith(reportsConditionGradeFilter.toLowerCase().charAt(0))) return false;
      }

      // Date Range filters
      // Unified Coworker Workstation Queue Filters
      if (coworkerQueueFilter === 'restock') {
        if (!isItemReadyToRestock(item, reportsList)) return false;
      } else if (coworkerQueueFilter === 'reorder' || coworkerQueueFilter === 'scrap') {
        if (!isItemReorderNeeded(item, reportsList)) return false;
      } else if (coworkerQueueFilter === 'scrap_no_reorder') {
        if (!isItemScrappedNoReorder(item, reportsList)) return false;
      } else if (coworkerQueueFilter === 'hold' || coworkerQueueFilter === 'quarantine') {
        if (!isItemOnHold(item, reportsList)) return false;
      } else if (coworkerQueueFilter === 'rejected') {
        if (!isItemRejected(item, reportsList)) return false;
      }

      if (reportsDateFrom) {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.created_at || 0).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (itemDate < reportsDateFrom) return false;
      }

      if (reportsDateTo) {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.created_at || 0).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (itemDate > reportsDateTo) return false;
      }

      if (reportsReorderFilter !== 'all') {
        const rInfo = resolveReorderStatus(item);
        if (reportsReorderFilter === 'reordered' && !rInfo.isReordered) return false;
        if (reportsReorderFilter === 'pending' && rInfo.isReordered) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA, valB;
      switch (reportsSortField) {
        case 'id':
          valA = Number(a.id) || 0;
          valB = Number(b.id) || 0;
          break;
        case 'rma_number':
          valA = String(a.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'barcode':
          valA = String(a.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'name':
          valA = String(a.name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'quantity':
          valA = Number(a.quantity) || 1;
          valB = Number(b.quantity) || 1;
          break;
        case 'reason':
          valA = String(a.reason || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.reason || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'reporter':
          valA = String(a.reporter_name || a.reported_by || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.reporter_name || b.reported_by || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'store_branch':
          valA = String(a.store_branch || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.store_branch || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'invoice_dr_number':
          valA = String(a.invoice_dr_number || a.dr_number || a.si_number || a.po_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.invoice_dr_number || b.dr_number || b.si_number || b.po_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'status':
        case 'lifecycle_stage':
          valA = String(a.status || 'received_at_dock').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.status || 'received_at_dock').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'disposition':
          valA = String(a.disposition || 'Pending Triage').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.disposition || 'Pending Triage').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'warehouse_location':
          valA = String(a.warehouse_location || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.warehouse_location || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'created_at':
          valA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
          valB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
          break;
        default:
          valA = a.id;
          valB = b.id;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return reportsSortDirection === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return reportsSortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [
    reportsList,
    reportsSearchQuery,
    reportsReasonFilter,
    reportsStatusFilter,
    reportsDispositionFilter,
    reportsReorderFilter,
    reportsConditionGradeFilter,
    coworkerQueueFilter,
    isItemReadyToRestock,
    reportsDateFrom,
    reportsDateTo,
    reportsSortField,
    reportsSortDirection
  ]);

  // Paginated Return Reports Slice
  const paginatedReports = React.useMemo(() => {
    const start = (reportsCurrentPage - 1) * reportsPageSize;
    return processedReports.slice(start, start + reportsPageSize);
  }, [processedReports, reportsCurrentPage, reportsPageSize]);

  // Bulk Selection Helpers for Reports (Strictly defined AFTER paginatedReports)
  const isAllReportsPageSelected = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (paginatedReports.length === 0) return false;
    return paginatedReports.every(r => selectedReportIds.has(r.id || r.rma_number));
  }, [paginatedReports, selectedReportIds]);

  const toggleSelectReport = (id) => {
    setSelectedReportIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleSelectAllReportsPage = () => {
    setSelectedReportIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (isAllReportsPageSelected) {
        paginatedReports.forEach(r => next.delete(r.id || r.rma_number));
      } else {
        paginatedReports.forEach(r => next.add(r.id || r.rma_number));
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const selectAllFilteredReports = () => {
    const next = new Set();
    processedReports.forEach(r => next.add(r.id || r.rma_number));
    setSelectedReportIds(next);
  };

  const clearReportsSelection = () => {
    setSelectedReportIds(new Set());
  };

  const selectedReportsList = React.useMemo(() => {
    return reportsList.filter(r => selectedReportIds.has(r.id || r.rma_number));
  }, [reportsList, selectedReportIds]);

  const renderBulkActionBar = (isCardView = false) => {
    if (selectedReportIds.size === 0) return null;
    const eligibleForCm = selectedReportsList.filter(
      (r) => !isItemOnHold(r, reportsList) && !isItemRejected(r, reportsList)
    );
    return (
      <div
        className={`p-3 sm:px-4 bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 text-white flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in ${
          isCardView ? 'rounded-2xl border border-slate-700' : 'border-t border-slate-700'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">
            {selectedReportIds.size}
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
            {selectedReportIds.size} report{selectedReportIds.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
          </span>
          {selectedReportIds.size < processedReports.length && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={selectAllFilteredReports}
              className="text-xs text-blue-300 hover:text-white underline font-semibold ml-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Select all {processedReports.length} filtered
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {canEditProducts && onOpenCreditMemo && eligibleForCm.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenCreditMemo(eligibleForCm.length > 1 ? eligibleForCm : eligibleForCm[0])}
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Issue ONE Consolidated Credit Memo for all selected Customer Hub RMAs"
            >
              <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>+ Consolidated Credit Memo ({eligibleForCm.length} RMA{eligibleForCm.length > 1 ? 's' : ''})</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {onOpenSimpleWizard && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenSimpleWizard(selectedReportsList.length > 1 ? selectedReportsList : selectedReportsList[0])}
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Process 4-Choice Outcome & Pickup Form for all selected Customer Hub RMAs in one consolidated batch"
            >
              <span>⚡ Process Consolidated 4-Choice ({selectedReportIds.size} RMA{selectedReportIds.size > 1 ? 's' : ''})</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {onViewQR && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewQR(selectedReportsList.length === 1 ? selectedReportsList[0] : selectedReportsList)}
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Open Consolidated QR Print & PNG Studio for all selected Customer Hub RMAs"
            >
              <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>🖨️ Print / Save QRs ({selectedReportIds.size})</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={clearReportsSelection}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Deselect
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onBulkArchiveReports(selectedReportsList)}
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-300" />
            <span>Archive Selected ({selectedReportIds.size})</span>
          </button>
          {canDeleteReports && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onRequestBulkDeleteReports(selectedReportsList)}
              className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Move to Trash ({selectedReportIds.size})</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
  <div className="space-y-4 w-full min-w-0">
    {activeSubTab === 'credit_memos' ? (
      <CreditMemosTab
        creditMemosList={creditMemosList}
        recentReportsList={reportsList}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        onOpenCreateModal={onOpenCreateCreditMemo}
        onEditCreditMemo={onEditCreditMemo}
        onViewVoucher={onViewCreditMemoVoucher}
        onPrintBulk={onPrintBulkCreditMemos || onViewCreditMemoVoucher}
        onRequestDeleteCreditMemo={onRequestDeleteCreditMemo}
        onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo={onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo}
        isTestMode={isTestMode}
      />
    ) : (
  <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
    {/* Header & Responsive Action Toolbar */}
    <div className="flex flex-col 2xl:flex-row 2xl:items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full min-w-0">
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
            Customer RMA Hub (Inbound Logistics)
          </h3>
          {isTestMode && (
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shrink-0">
              🧪 Sandbox Test Mode
            </span>
          )}
          <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-black bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
            {processedReports.length} Returns Active
          </span>
          {onOpenCreditMemosLedger && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenCreditMemosLedger}
              className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-black bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              title="Switch to Credit Memos Ledger"
            >
              <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
              <span>Credit Memos Ledger ({creditMemosList.length}) →</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          Store &amp; branch merchandise returns, billing document matching, and customer credit memo vouchers.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Responsive Action Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 w-full 2xl:w-auto min-w-0">
        {/* View Switcher: Rows vs Cards */}
        <div className="flex items-center self-start sm:self-auto bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-0.5 sm:p-1 rounded-xl sm:rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSetReportsViewMode('table')}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg sm:rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${reportsViewMode === 'table'
              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
              }`}
            title="Rows / Table View"
          >
            <List className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Rows List</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSetReportsViewMode('grid')}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg sm:rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${reportsViewMode === 'grid'
              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
              }`}
            title="Grid / Cards View"
          >
            <LayoutGrid className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Cards</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons: Clean vertical stack on narrow phones (<sm), wrapping flex row on sm+ */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto min-w-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenReportsModal && onOpenReportsModal()}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto justify-center px-3 py-2 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            title="Open Full Audit Log"
          >
            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Full Audit Log</span>
            <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 hidden sm:inline" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenMatrixExport && onOpenMatrixExport('overall')}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto justify-center px-3 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 text-white font-extrabold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors shadow-2xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            title="Download Overall RMA Matrix (.xlsx) combining Customer Hub & Supplier RTV"
          >
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isTestMode ? 'Sandbox Overall Matrix (.xlsx)' : 'Overall RMA Matrix (.xlsx)'}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => exportCustomerInboundRMAsToXlsx(processedReports, null, savedProductsList, isTestMode)}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto justify-center px-3 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-extrabold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors shadow-2xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            title="Export Customer Inbound RMAs to Excel (.xlsx) with Store Branch, Customer Name, DR#, AE Name, and Credit Memo #"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Export Inbound (.xlsx)</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    {/* Filter / Search & Sort Controls Toolbar */}
    <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-3.5 space-y-2.5 w-full min-w-0 box-border">

      {/* Search Input: Full width row */}
      {customerFollowUpBanner && (
        <div className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-between gap-2 ${
          customerFollowUpBanner.type === 'success'
            ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
            : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'
        }`}>
          <span>{customerFollowUpBanner.text}</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setCustomerFollowUpBanner(null)} className="cursor-pointer opacity-70 hover:opacity-100">
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="relative w-full min-w-0">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3 shrink-0" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={reportsSearchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setReportsSearchQuery(e.target.value);
            setReportsCurrentPage(1);
          }}
          placeholder="Search by SN (#), RMA #, barcode, item name, reporter, or bin location..."
          className="w-full min-w-0 pl-10 pr-9 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 transition-all box-border"
        />
        {reportsSearchQuery && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setReportsSearchQuery('');
              setReportsCurrentPage(1);
            }}
            className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Dropdown Filters & Date Pickers in responsive grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-2 w-full min-w-0">

                          )}
                        </div>
                        {((item.supplier_name && !isPlaceholderSupplier(item.supplier_name)) || (matchedProduct?.supplier_name && !isPlaceholderSupplier(matchedProduct.supplier_name))) ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium mt-0.5">
                            <span className="truncate max-w-[125px]">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{(!isPlaceholderSupplier(item.supplier_name) ? item.supplier_name : matchedProduct?.supplier_name)}</span>
                            </span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setFollowUpModalReport(item)}
                              className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-[9px] font-bold cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
                              title="Configure Supplier Email & 10-Day Countdown SLA"
                            >
                              📧 SLA
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="mt-0.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setFollowUpModalReport(item)}
                              className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:hover:bg-amber-900 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-[9px] font-black cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
                              title="Set Supplier Name, Email (TO/CC) & 10-Day Countdown SLA"
                            >
                              + Set Supplier &amp; Email
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {(item.batch_lot_number || item.expiry_date) && (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap mt-0.5 font-normal">
                            {item.batch_lot_number && (
                              <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 font-semibold bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800 whitespace-nowrap">
                                Lot: {item.batch_lot_number}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {item.expiry_date && (
                              <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono font-semibold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800 whitespace-nowrap">
                                Exp: {formatDateYmd(item.expiry_date) || item.expiry_date}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 5. Quantity & Unit */}
                      <td className="py-2 px-1 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="font-mono font-black text-[11px] text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-2xs inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                          <span>
                            {isManifest
                              ? formatManifestBreakdown(manifestChildren, false)
                              : formatQuantityWithPackSize(item.quantity, item.unit_name, item.pieces_per_case || matchedProduct?.pieces_per_case)}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* 6. Defect Reason, Notes & Customer Branch / Reporter */}
                      <td className="py-2 px-1 max-w-[104px]">
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 font-bold text-[9.5px] inline-block truncate max-w-[98px]" title={item.reason || 'Damaged'}>
                            {item.reason || 'Damaged'}
                          </span>
                          {(() => {
                            const rawNote = String(
                              item.explanation ||
                              item.notes ||
                              (!isManifest && item.items?.[0]?.explanation ? item.items[0].explanation : '') ||
                              ''
                            ).trim();
                            const cleanNote = cleanExplanationText(rawNote);
                            if (!cleanNote) return null;
                            return (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onViewExplanation && onViewExplanation({
                                  rmaNumber: item.rma_number,
                                  productName: resolvedName,
                                  reason: item.reason || 'Damaged',
                                  explanation: cleanNote,
                                  reporter: item.reporter_name || item.reported_by || 'Staff'
                                })}
                                className="group text-left flex items-center gap-1 px-1 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100/90 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer max-w-full"
                                title="Click to read full reporter explanation"
                              >
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 italic truncate max-w-[68px]">
                                  &ldquo;{cleanNote}&rdquo;
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0 group-hover:underline">
                                  Read
                                </span>
                              </button>
                            );
                          })()}
                          {(() => {
                            const displayBranch = (item.store_branch && item.store_branch !== 'Direct Return') ? item.store_branch : 'N/A';
                            return (
                              <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 text-[10.5px] flex items-center gap-1 truncate" title={displayBranch}>
                                <span className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0">📍</span>
                                <span className="truncate font-extrabold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300">{displayBranch}</span>
                              </div>
                            );
                          })()}
                          <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium truncate">
                            {item.reporter_name || item.reported_by || 'Staff'}
                            {item.reporter_contact ? ` • ${item.reporter_contact}` : ''}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* 7. Lifecycle Stage, 4-Choice Disposition, SLA & Bin Location */}
                      <td className="py-2 px-1 text-center w-[116px] max-w-[116px]">
                        <div className="inline-flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                          {isManifest ? (() => {
                            const dynStage = resolveBatchManifestLifecycle(item, reportsList);
                            return (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  toggleManifestExpand(manifestKey);
                                }}
                                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider border inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs whitespace-nowrap ${dynStage.color}`}
                                title="Dynamically resolved from child item dispositions (click to open drawer)"
                              >
                                <span>{dynStage.label}</span>
                              </button>
                            );
                          })() : (() => {
                            const stageInfo = formatLifecycleStage(item.status, item);
                            const wf = computeFourStepWorkflow(item, savedProductsList, {
                              customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: followUpConfig.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled,
                              testStepIntervalSeconds: isTestMode ? followUpConfig.testStepIntervalSeconds : 0
                            });
                            return (
                              <>
                                <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9.5px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider inline-block shadow-2xs leading-tight text-center ${stageInfo.color}`}>
                                  {stageInfo.label}
                                </span>
                                {wf.isCountdownActive && !wf.isClosed && (
                                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 inline-flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap">
                                    <Clock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                    <span>{wf.step2.text}</span>
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </>
                            );
                          })()}

                          {isManifest ? (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                toggleManifestExpand(manifestKey);
                              }}
                              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:bg-purple-200 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs whitespace-nowrap"
                              title="Click to view child line items in drawer"
                            >
                              <span>📦 Line Items (Drawer)</span>
                            </button>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-extrabold border inline-block leading-tight text-center shadow-2xs ${outcome.badgeColor}`}>
                                {outcome.label}
                              </span>
                              {(() => {
                                const reorderInfo = resolveReorderStatus(item);
                                return (
                                  <span
                                    className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[9.5px] font-extrabold border inline-flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-0.5 leading-tight text-center ${reorderInfo.badgeColor}`}
                                    title={reorderInfo.isReordered
                                      ? `Reordered${reorderInfo.formattedTime ? ` on ${reorderInfo.formattedTime}` : ''}${reorderInfo.poNumber ? ` • PO #${reorderInfo.poNumber}` : ''}${reorderInfo.reorderedBy ? ` by ${reorderInfo.reorderedBy}` : ''}`
                                      : 'Replacement PO not yet ordered'}
                                  >
                                    <span>{reorderInfo.isReordered ? '✓ Reordered' : 'Reorder: Pending'}</span>
                                    {reorderInfo.poNumber && <span className="font-mono">({reorderInfo.poNumber})</span>}
                                  </span>
                                );
                              })()}
                              {outcome.choiceKey === 'scrap' && (
                                <div className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                  {getItemNeedsReorder(item) ? '🛒 Re-Order: YES' : '❌ No Re-Order'}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </>
                          )}

                          {item.warehouse_location && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-[9.5px] font-mono font-bold truncate max-w-[160px]" title={normalizeWarehouseLocation(item.warehouse_location, item)}>
                              {normalizeWarehouseLocation(item.warehouse_location, item)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* 8. Date & GPS */}
                      <td className="py-2 px-1 text-right font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 whitespace-nowrap max-w-[92px]">
                        <div>{item.created_at ? formatDateYmd(item.created_at) : ''}</div>
                        {(() => {
                          const mapUrl = getGpsMapUrl(item);
                          const gpsAddr = getGpsAddressDisplay(item);
                          return mapUrl ? (
                            <a
                              href={mapUrl}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-bold max-w-[88px]"
                              title={gpsAddr || 'View GPS Location on Google Maps'}
                            >
                              <MapPin className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />
                              <span className="truncate">{gpsAddr || 'Map'}</span>
                            </a>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 text-[9.5px]">No GPS</span>
                          );
                        })()}
                      </td>

                      {/* 9. Actions: 4-Choice / Pickup, Form, Split Qty / Details, Assign SKU, Credit Memo & Delete */}
                      <td className="py-2 px-1 text-center w-[118px]">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-stretch gap-1 w-[112px] mx-auto">
                          {/* 4-Choice Outcome & Pickup Verification */}
                          {onOpenSimpleWizard && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                const batchGroup = findConsolidatedRtvBatchReports(item, reportsList);
                                onOpenSimpleWizard(batchGroup.length > 1 ? batchGroup : item);
                              }}
                              className={`w-full px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight text-center transition-colors cursor-pointer border ${
                                outcome.hasDecision
                                  ? 'bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/70 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200 border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700'
                                  : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white border-indigo-600 shadow-2xs'
                              }`}
                              title={outcome.hasDecision ? 'Edit saved 4-Choice decision, claim details, or driver pickup photos' : 'Open 4-Choice / Driver Pickup Verification Wizard'}
                            >
                              {outcome.hasDecision ? '✏️ Edit Claim / 4-Choice' : '⚡ 4-Choice / Pickup'}
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* View / Re-print Buffer Replacement or Credit Return Form when generated */}
                          {onOpenPickupForm && outcome.formType && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                const batchGroup = findConsolidatedRtvBatchReports(item, reportsList);
                                onOpenPickupForm(batchGroup.length > 1 ? batchGroup : item);
                              }}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-center shadow-2xs"
                              title={outcome.formType === 'replacement' ? 'View / Re-print Buffer Replacement Form' : 'View / Re-print Credit Return Form'}
                            >
                              <span>{outcome.formType === 'replacement' ? '📄 Buffer Replacement Form' : '📄 Credit Return Form'}</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* Follow-Up Case Close Quick Action */}
                          {!computeFourStepWorkflow(item, savedProductsList, { customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: followUpConfig.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled, testStepIntervalSeconds: isTestMode ? followUpConfig.testStepIntervalSeconds : 0 }).isClosed && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={customerRowBusyId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => handleCustomerCloseCase(item)}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight text-center cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                              title="Close 4-Step Workflow Case & Stop 10-Day Countdown"
                            >
                              <span>✓ Case Close</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* Split Qty / Details */}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onInspectTriage(item)}
                            className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                            title={!isManifest && Number(item.quantity) > 1 ? `Split Qty or edit details for ${item.rma_number}` : `View details, documents, or audit trail for ${item.rma_number}`}
                          >
                            <span>{!isManifest && Number(item.quantity) > 1 ? '✂️ Split Qty' : '📋 Details'}</span>
                          </button>

                          {/* 1-Click Coworker WMS Restock Action */}
                          {isItemReadyToRestock(item, reportsList) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={updatingQueueId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => onConfirmCoworkerAction(item, 'restocked')}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white border border-emerald-500 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-50"
                              title="1-click confirm that this item has been stocked in WMS (updates status to 6- Restocked)"
                            >
                              <span>✓ Restocked in WMS</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* 1-Click Mark Reordered Action (Independent of 4-Choice Outcome & 10-Day SLA) */}
                          {!resolveReorderStatus(item).isReordered && !['rejected', 'deleted', 'trashed'].includes(String(item.status || '').toLowerCase()) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={customerRowBusyId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => handleMarkReordered(item, 'reordered')}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white border border-amber-500 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-50"
                              title="Mark replacement PO as Reordered (keeps 4-Choice Outcome & 10-Day SLA unchanged)"
                            >
                              <span>🔄 Mark Reordered</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* 1-Click Coworker Scrapped - No Re-Order Action */}
                          {isItemScrappedNoReorder(item, reportsList) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={updatingQueueId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => onConfirmCoworkerAction(item, 'scrapped')}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white border border-slate-600 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-50"
                              title="1-click confirm that this total loss is written off without re-ordering"
                            >
                              <span>✓ Written Off</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* Re-open / Reset to Pending Action */}
                          {Boolean(outcome.hasDecision || String(item.status || 'pending').toLowerCase() !== 'pending' || item.ai_document_metadata?.follow_up?.case_closed_at) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={updatingQueueId === (item.id || item.rma_number)}
                              onClick={() => onResetToPending && onResetToPending(item)}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title="Re-open item and reset to pending so coworker queues can test restocking/reordering again"
                            >
                              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                              <span>Reset to Pending</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* Release Hold Action */}
                          {isItemOnHold(item, reportsList) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => (onOpenSimpleWizard ? onOpenSimpleWizard(item) : onInspectTriage(item))}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white border border-amber-600 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title="Release hold via 4-Choice window"
                            >
                              <Unlock className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                              <span>Release Hold</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {/* Do NOT render Assign SKU on parent row if batch manifest */}
                          {!isManifest && canEditProducts && !savedProductsList.some(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode) === String(item.barcode)) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onEditProductFromReport(item)}
                              className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title={`Assign official SKU and save "${item.name || item.barcode}" to Products catalog`}
                            >
                              <Package className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                              <span>Assign SKU</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {(() => {
                            if (isManifest) {
                              const linkedMemos = creditMemosList.filter(m => doesCreditMemoLinkReport(m, item));
                              if (linkedMemos.length > 0) {
                                return (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => onViewCreditMemoVoucher(linkedMemos.length === 1 ? linkedMemos[0] : linkedMemos)}
                                    className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                    title={`View ${linkedMemos.length} Credit Memo Voucher(s) for this batch`}
                                  >
                                    <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                                    <span>CM Voucher{linkedMemos.length > 1 ? ` (${linkedMemos.length})` : ''}</span>
                                  </button>
                                );
                              }
                              return (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => toggleManifestExpand(manifestKey)}
                                  className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:hover:bg-purple-900/70 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                  title="View manifest line items to issue individual Credit Memos"
                                >
                                  <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 shrink-0" />
                                  <span>CM in Drawer</span>
                                </button>
                              );
                            }

                            const existingMemo = creditMemosList.find(m => doesCreditMemoLinkReport(m, item));
                            if (existingMemo) {
                              return (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => onViewCreditMemoVoucher(existingMemo)}
                                  className="w-full px-1.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-black leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                  title={`View Official Credit Memo Voucher: ${existingMemo.credit_memo_number}`}
                                >
                                  <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                                  <span>CM Voucher</span>
                                </button>
                              );
                            }
                            const isReportOnHold = isItemOnHold(item, reportsList);
                            const isReportRejected = isItemRejected(item, reportsList);
                            if (canEditProducts) {
                              return (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  disabled={isReportOnHold || isReportRejected}
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    if (isReportOnHold) {
                                      alert("Item is on Hold / Quarantine. Resolve hold before issuing financial claims.");
                                      return;
                                    }
                                    onOpenCreditMemo(item);
                                  }}
                                  className={`w-full px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold leading-tight flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-2xs ${
                                    isReportOnHold
                                      ? 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 opacity-70'
                                      : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/50 text-slate-700 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:text-emerald-300 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-emerald-400 cursor-pointer'
                                  }`}
                                  title={isReportOnHold ? "Item is on Hold / Quarantine. Resolve hold before issuing financial claims." : "Issue Finance Credit Memo for this Return"}
                                >
                                  {isReportOnHold ? <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500 shrink-0" /> : <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />}
                                  <span>{isReportOnHold ? 'On Hold' : '+ Credit Memo'}</span>
                                </button>
                              );
                            }
                            return null;
                          })()}

                          {/* Archive & Delete Icon Row */}
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 pt-0.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onArchiveReport(item.id, item.rma_number, item)}
                              className="p-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title={`Archive RMA #${item.rma_number} to Enterprise Vault`}
                            >
                              <Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700" />
                            </button>

                            {canDeleteReports && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onRequestDeleteReport(item.id, item.rma_number, item)}
                                className="p-1 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title={`Move RMA #${item.rma_number} to 30-Day Trash Bin`}
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>

                    {/* Expandable Multi-Item Manifest Sub-Table Drawer */}
                    {isManifest && isManifestExpanded && (
                      <tr className="bg-purple-50/40 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-y-2 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/60">
                        <td colSpan={10} className="p-3 sm:p-4">
                          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/90 rounded-xl border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800/60 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
                            {/* Manifest Header */}
                            <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50/70 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border-b border-purple-200/80 dark:border-purple-900/50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span className="p-1 rounded-md bg-purple-600 text-white">
                                  <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </span>
                                <span className="font-extrabold text-xs text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  Batch Return Manifest Items ({manifestChildren.length})
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 font-mono">
                                  RMA: {item.rma_number}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  Total manifest breakdown: <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{formatManifestBreakdown(manifestChildren, true)}</strong>
                                </span>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => onInspectTriage(item)}
                                  className="text-xs text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 hover:text-blue-900 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 hover:bg-blue-100 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  title="Edit individual batch line item quantities and suppliers"
                                >
                                  ✏️ Edit Qty / Suppliers
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => toggleManifestExpand(manifestKey)}
                                  className="text-xs text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 hover:text-purple-900 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-purple-100 dark:hover:bg-purple-900/50 transition-colors"
                                >
                                  Collapse ▲
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Child Items Table */}
                            <div className="overflow-x-auto lg:overflow-x-visible">
                              <table className="table-fixed w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                                <thead>
                                  <tr className="bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-800/50 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                                    <th className="py-2 px-1 text-center w-[50px]">Item</th>
                                    <th className="py-2 px-3 min-w-[200px]">Product Description / Name</th>
                                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-mono w-[140px]">Barcode</th>
                                    <th className="py-2 px-3 font-mono w-[120px]">Assigned SKU</th>
                                    <th className="py-2 px-3 text-center w-[80px]">Qty &amp; Unit</th>
                                    <th className="py-2 px-3 w-[170px]">Triage &amp; Reason</th>
                                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-center w-[170px]">Actions</th>
                                  </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/60">
                                  {manifestChildren.length === 0 ? (
                                    <tr>
                                      <td colSpan={7} className="py-4 text-center text-slate-400 italic">
                                        No line item breakdown records found for this batch manifest.
                                      </td>
                                    </tr>
                                  ) : (
                                    manifestChildren.map((child, cIdx) => {
                                      const childName = (child.name || child.item_name || child.productName || `Item #${cIdx + 1}`).trim();
                                      const childBarcode = (child.barcode || child.item_barcode || '').trim();
                                      const childSku = (child.sku || child.code || '').trim();
                                      const childQty = Number(child.quantity || child.qty) || 1;
                                      const childUnit = child.unit_name || child.unit || item.unit_name || 'pc';
                                      const childReason = child.reason || child.defect_reason || item.reason || 'Damaged';
                                      const childLocation = (child.warehouse_location || child.location || '').trim();
                                      const childDisposition = child.disposition || '1- Pending Triage';
                                      const matchedChild = savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode) === String(childBarcode));
                                      const isSkuAssigned = Boolean(
                                        (matchedChild?.code && String(matchedChild.code) !== String(childBarcode) && !matchedChild.code.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting')) ||
                                        (childSku && String(childSku) !== String(childBarcode) && !childSku.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting'))
                                      );
                                      const effectiveSku = (matchedChild?.code && String(matchedChild.code) !== String(childBarcode))
                                        ? matchedChild.code
                                        : (childSku && String(childSku) !== String(childBarcode) && !childSku.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') ? childSku : '—');

                                      // Extract child photos
                                      const cPhotos = Array.isArray(child.photos)
                                        ? child.photos
                                        : (Array.isArray(child.photoFiles) ? child.photoFiles : (child.photo_url ? [child.photo_url] : []));
                                      const cPhotoUrl = cPhotos[0] || (photoList[cIdx] || null);

                                      const childExistingMemo = creditMemosList.find(m =>
                                      (m.rma_number === item.rma_number && (
                                        (childBarcode && String(m.barcode).trim() === childBarcode) ||
                                        (child.id && String(m.report_id) === String(child.id)) ||
                                        (m.product_name && m.product_name === childName)
                                      ))
                                      );

                                      const childReportObject = {
                                        id: child.id || `${item.id || item.rma_number}_${childBarcode}`,
                                        rma_number: item.rma_number,
                                        barcode: childBarcode,
                                        code: effectiveSku !== '—' ? effectiveSku : (childSku || ''),
                                        sku: effectiveSku !== '—' ? effectiveSku : (childSku || ''),
                                        name: childName,
                                        product_name: childName,
                                        quantity: childQty,
                                        unit_name: childUnit,
                                        price: Number(child.price || matchedChild?.price || 0),
                                        price_with_vat: Number(child.price_with_vat || child.price || matchedChild?.price_with_vat || matchedChild?.price || 0),
                                        supplier_name: isRealSupplierName(child.supplier_name)
                                          ? child.supplier_name
                                          : (matchedChild?.supplier_name || (isRealSupplierName(item.supplier_name) ? item.supplier_name : 'Savemore')),
                                        store_branch: item.store_branch,
                                        customer_branch: item.store_branch,
                                        ae_name: item.ae_name,
                                        ae_email: item.ae_email,
                                        child_id: child.id,
                                        is_manifest_child: true,
                                        parent_rma_id: item.id
                                      };

                                      return (
                                        <tr key={child.id || `child_${cIdx}`} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                                          {/* Line # / Photo: 50px */}
                                          <td className="py-2 px-1 text-center w-[50px]">
                                            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1">
                                              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono font-bold leading-none">#{cIdx + 1}</span>
                                              {cPhotoUrl ? (
                                                <button
                                                  type="button"
                                                  onClick={() => onViewPhoto && onViewPhoto({
                                                    images: [cPhotoUrl],
                                                    initialIndex: 0,
                                                    url: cPhotoUrl,
                                                    title: childName,
                                                    subtitle: `Manifest item #${cIdx + 1} of ${item.rma_number} • ${childReason}`
                                                  })}
                                                  className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 inline-block hover:scale-105 transition-transform cursor-zoom-in"
                                                  title="Click to zoom image"
                                                >
                                                  <img src={cPhotoUrl} alt={childName} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                                                </button>
                                              ) : (
                                                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                                                  <ImageIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                                                </div>
                                              )}
                                            </div>
                                          </td>
                                          {/* Product Description: min-w-[200px] with truncate and title={it.name} */}
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white min-w-[200px] truncate" title={childName}>
                                            <div className="truncate">{childName}</div>
                                            {child.supplier_name && (
                                              <div className="text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-semibold truncate" title={`Supplier: ${child.supplier_name}`}>
