--- START FILE: src/components/CustomerRMAInvitesModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Mail, 
  Send, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  Clock, 
  Building2, 
  Trash2, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  AlertCircle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Plus, 
  Ticket,
  Truck,
  Store,
  Filter,
  Ban,
  FileEdit
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  inviteService,
  formatRemainingCountdown,
  isRmaEditorInvite,
  getInviteAllowedEmails,
  isPermanentInvite
} from '../services/inviteService';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';
import EmailRecipientsEditor from './EmailRecipientsEditor';
import { notificationService } from '../services/notificationService';
import { copyTextSafe } from '../utils/clipboard';
import { formatDateTimeYmdHm } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { useIsDesktopMd } from '../hooks/useIsDesktopMd';

const PRESET_EXPIRIES = [
  { label: '15 Mins', num: 15, unit: 'minutes' },
  { label: '30 Mins', num: 30, unit: 'minutes' },
  { label: '1 Hour', num: 1, unit: 'hours' },
  { label: '2 Hours', num: 2, unit: 'hours' },
  { label: '6 Hours', num: 6, unit: 'hours' },
  { label: '12 Hours', num: 12, unit: 'hours' },
  { label: '24 Hours (1 Day)', num: 24, unit: 'hours' },
  { label: '2 Days', num: 2, unit: 'days' },
  { label: '7 Days (1 Week)', num: 7, unit: 'days' }
];

export default function CustomerRMAInvitesModal({ isOpen, onClose, currentUser, isEmbeddedPage = false }) {
  const isDesktopMd = useIsDesktopMd();
  const [invites, setInvites] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  
  // Stream Type Toggle: 'customer_inbound' | 'supplier_outbound' | 'rma_editor'
  const [streamType, setStreamType] = useState('customer_inbound');
  const [inviteIsTestMode, setInviteIsTestMode] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
  const [authorizedEmail, setAuthorizedEmail] = useState('');
  const [entityName, setEntityName] = useState('');
  const [targetRmaNumber, setTargetRmaNumber] = useState('');
  
  // Customizable expiration limit (input number + unit: minutes, hours, days) or permanent never-expires
  const [expiryNumber, setExpiryNumber] = useState(24);
  const [expiryUnit, setExpiryUnit] = useState('hours');
  const [noExpiry, setNoExpiry] = useState(false);

  // Filter for the invites table
  const [streamFilter, setStreamFilter] = useState('all'); // 'all' | 'customer_inbound' | 'supplier_outbound'
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [deletingToken, setDeletingToken] = useState(null);

  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [generatedInvite, setGeneratedInvite] = useState(null);
  const [isSendingEmail, setIsSendingEmail] = useState(false);
  const [copiedToken, setCopiedToken] = useState(null);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState(null);
  const loadSeqRef = useRef(0);
  const [inviteExtraRecipients, setInviteExtraRecipients] = useState(() => {
    const prof = notificationService.getEmailProfile('invite_email', inviteIsTestMode);
    return { toList: prof.toList || [], ccList: prof.ccList || [] };
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen || isEmbeddedPage) {
      loadInvites();
      setGeneratedInvite(null);
      setErrorMessage(null);
      const prof = notificationService.getEmailProfile('invite_email', Boolean(inviteIsTestMode));
      setInviteExtraRecipients({ toList: prof.toList || [], ccList: prof.ccList || [] });
    }
  }, [isOpen, isEmbeddedPage, inviteIsTestMode]);

  const loadInvites = async () => {
    const reqId = ++loadSeqRef.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await inviteService.getInvites();
      if (reqId === loadSeqRef.current) {
        setInvites(data || []);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Error loading invites:', err);
    } finally {
      if (reqId === loadSeqRef.current) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const showToast = (msg) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
  };

  // Live computed expiration preview
  const computedExpiryPreview = useMemo(() => {
    if (noExpiry) {
      return 'No Expiry • Revocable anytime by Admin';
    }
    const num = Math.max(1, parseInt(expiryNumber, 10) || 1);
    const unit = String(expiryUnit || 'hours').toLowerCase();
    let ms = num * 3600 * 1000;
    if (unit.startsWith('min')) ms = num * 60 * 1000;
    else if (unit.startsWith('day')) ms = num * 24 * 3600 * 1000;

    const expDate = new Date(Date.now() + ms);
    return `Expires: ${formatDateTimeYmdHm(expDate)}`;
  }, [expiryNumber, expiryUnit, noExpiry]);

  const handleGenerate = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsedEmails = Array.from(new Set(
      authorizedEmail
        .split(/[,;\s]+/)
        .map((em) => em.trim().toLowerCase())
        .filter((em) => em.includes('@'))
    ));
    if (parsedEmails.length === 0) {
      setErrorMessage(
        streamType === 'rma_editor'
          ? 'Please enter one or more authorized Google emails (comma-separated for multiple recipients).'
          : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
            ? 'Please enter the authorized supplier / vendor representative email.'
            : 'Please enter the authorized customer / reporter email.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsGenerating(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const createdBy = currentUser?.name || 'Pingcon Staff';
      const newInv = await inviteService.createInvite({
        streamType,
        authorizedEmail: parsedEmails[0],
        authorizedEmails: parsedEmails,
        entityName: streamType === 'rma_editor' ? targetRmaNumber.trim() : entityName.trim(),
        storeBranch: streamType === 'rma_editor' ? targetRmaNumber.trim() : entityName.trim(),
        rmaNumber: streamType === 'rma_editor' ? targetRmaNumber.trim() : '',
        durationValue: noExpiry ? 0 : Math.max(1, parseInt(expiryNumber, 10) || 1),
        durationUnit: noExpiry ? 'permanent' : expiryUnit,
        noExpiry,
        createdBy,
        isTest: inviteIsTestMode
      });
      setGeneratedInvite(newInv);
      setAuthorizedEmail('');
      setEntityName('');
      setTargetRmaNumber('');
      setStreamFilter('all');
      setCurrentPage(1);
      loadSeqRef.current += 1;
      setInvites((prev) => [newInv, ...(prev || []).filter((i) => i.token !== newInv.token)]);
      showToast(
        `${inviteIsTestMode ? '🧪 TEST MODE ' : ''}${
          streamType === 'rma_editor'
            ? 'RMA Details Editor Link generated successfully!'
            : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
              ? 'Supplier RTV Invite generated successfully!'
              : 'Customer RMA Return Invite generated successfully!'
        }`
      );
      loadInvites();
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to generate invite.');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const buildInviteUrl = (invOrToken) => {
    const origin = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : 'https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app';
    const tok = typeof invOrToken === 'string' ? invOrToken : invOrToken?.token;
    const isTestTok = String(tok || '').startsWith('inv_test_');
    const rmaParam = (typeof invOrToken === 'object' && isRmaEditorInvite(invOrToken) && invOrToken?.rma_number)
      ? `&editRma=${encodeURIComponent(invOrToken.rma_number)}`
      : '';
    return `${origin}/intake?token=${encodeURIComponent(tok || '')}${rmaParam}${isTestTok ? '&mode=test' : ''}`;
  };

  const handleCopyLink = (invOrToken) => {
    const tok = typeof invOrToken === 'string' ? invOrToken : invOrToken?.token;
    const link = buildInviteUrl(invOrToken);
    copyTextSafe(link);
    setCopiedToken(tok);
    showToast('Secure link copied to clipboard!');
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedToken(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleSendEmail = async (inv) => {
    setIsSendingEmail(true);
    try {
      await inviteService.sendInviteEmail(inv, inviteExtraRecipients);
      const extras = [
        ...(inviteExtraRecipients?.toList || []),
        ...(inviteExtraRecipients?.ccList || [])
      ].filter(Boolean);
      showToast(`Invite emailed to ${inv.authorized_email}${extras.length > 0 ? ` (+ ${extras.length} extra CC)` : ''}!`);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Could not send email: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSendingEmail(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRevoke = async (token) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to revoke this authorization link? Access will be blocked immediately.')) {
      return;
    }
    loadSeqRef.current += 1;
    setInvites((prev) =>
      prev.map((inv) => ((inv.token === token || inv.id === token) ? { ...inv, status: 'revoked' } : inv))
    );
    showToast('Invite link revoked.');
    if (generatedInvite?.token === token) {
      setGeneratedInvite(null);
    }
    try {
      await inviteService.revokeInvite(token);
      loadInvites();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Failed to revoke invite: ${err.message}`);
      loadInvites();
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (inv) => {
    if (!inv) return;
    const email = inv.authorized_email || 'this recipient';
    if (!window.confirm(`Permanently delete RMA invite record for ${email}? This will invalidate any associated private return links.`)) {
      return;
    }

    const tokenKey = inv.token || inv.id;
    setDeletingToken(tokenKey);
    loadSeqRef.current += 1;
    setInvites((prev) =>
      prev.filter((item) => !((inv.token && item.token === inv.token) || (inv.id && item.id === inv.id)))
    );
    if (generatedInvite?.token === inv.token) {
      setGeneratedInvite(null);
    }
    try {
      await inviteService.deleteInvite(tokenKey);
      showToast('Invite record deleted successfully.');
      loadInvites();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Failed to delete invite: ${err.message}`);
      loadInvites();
    } finally {
      setDeletingToken(null);
    }
  };

  const filteredInvites = useMemo(() => {
    if (streamFilter === 'all') return invites;
    if (streamFilter === 'rma_editor') return invites.filter(i => isRmaEditorInvite(i));
    if (streamFilter === 'customer_inbound') {
      return invites.filter(i => !isRmaEditorInvite(i) && (i.stream_type || 'customer_inbound') === 'customer_inbound');
    }
    return invites.filter(i => (i.stream_type || 'customer_inbound') === streamFilter);
  }, [invites, streamFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [streamFilter]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredInvites.length / pageSize));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentPage > totalPages) {
      setCurrentPage(totalPages);
    }
  }, [totalPages, currentPage]);

  const paginatedInvites = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return filteredInvites.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [filteredInvites, currentPage, pageSize]);

  const editorCount = useMemo(() => {
    return invites.filter(i => isRmaEditorInvite(i)).length;
  }, [invites]);

  const customerCount = useMemo(() => {
    return invites.filter(i => !isRmaEditorInvite(i) && (i.stream_type || 'customer_inbound') === 'customer_inbound').length;
  }, [invites]);

  const supplierCount = useMemo(() => {
    return invites.filter(i => i.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound').length;
  }, [invites]);

  if (!isOpen && !isEmbeddedPage) return null;

  return (
    <div className={isEmbeddedPage
      ? 'w-full'
      : 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in'
    }>
      <div className={isEmbeddedPage
        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 w-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden'
        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden'
      }>
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
              <Ticket className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                  Generate RMA Invites
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">
                  Google Identity Lock
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Generate private return or RMA details editor links tied strictly to authorized Google accounts.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {!isEmbeddedPage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close Generate RMA Invites Modal"
              className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Scroll Body */}
        <div className={isEmbeddedPage ? 'p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-6' : 'flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-6'}>

          {/* Toast Notification */}
          {toastMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{toastMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error Message */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Stream Type Selector Toggle */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap p-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl gap-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setStreamType('customer_inbound');
                setNoExpiry(false);
                setErrorMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 min-w-[150px] py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
                streamType === 'customer_inbound'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shadow-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 scale-[1.01]'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Store className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>Customer Return Invite</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 shrink-0">
                Inbound
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setStreamType('supplier_outbound');
                setNoExpiry(false);
                setErrorMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 min-w-[150px] py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
                streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 shadow-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 scale-[1.01]'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Truck className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>Supplier RTV Invite</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/80 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 shrink-0">
                Outbound RTV
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setStreamType('rma_editor');
                setNoExpiry(true);
                setErrorMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 min-w-[150px] py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
                streamType === 'rma_editor'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 scale-[1.01]'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <FileEdit className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>RMA Details Editor</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/80 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 shrink-0">
                Scoped Edit
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Invite Generator Form Card */}
          <form onSubmit={handleGenerate} className={`p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-3xl space-y-4 shadow-xs border-2 ${
            streamType === 'rma_editor'
              ? 'bg-indigo-50/40 dark:bg-indigo-950/20 border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-900/60'
              : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                ? 'bg-purple-50/40 dark:bg-purple-950/20 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/60'
                : 'bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
          }`}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className={`w-4 h-4 ${streamType === 'rma_editor' ? 'text-indigo-600' : streamType === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'text-purple-600' : 'text-blue-600'}`} />
                <span>
                  {streamType === 'rma_editor'
                    ? 'Create Scoped RMA Details Editor Link'
                    : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'Create New Supplier RTV Invite'
                      : 'Create New Customer Return Invite'}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold">
                Anti-Hacker: Forwarding to unauthorized accounts is strictly blocked
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Environment Mode Selector: Live Production vs Sandbox Test Mode */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                Invite Environment:
                <span className="ml-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Choose whether this staff link saves to Live Production or Isolated Test Sandbox
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 gap-1 shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setInviteIsTestMode(false)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    !inviteIsTestMode
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  🟢 Live Mode
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setInviteIsTestMode(true)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    inviteIsTestMode
                      ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  🧪 Test Mode Sandbox
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {/* Authorized Google Email */}
              <div className="sm:col-span-1 space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {streamType === 'rma_editor'
                    ? 'Authorized Editor Google Email *'
                    : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'Authorized Supplier / Vendor Representative Email *'
                      : 'Authorized Customer Google Email *'}
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                  <input
                    type={streamType === 'rma_editor' ? 'text' : 'email'}
                    required
                    value={authorizedEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setAuthorizedEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={
                      streamType === 'rma_editor'
                        ? 'e.g. azgodev@gmail.com, mgan@pingconmarketing.com'
                        : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                          ? 'e.g. vendor.qa@liwayway.com'
                          : 'e.g. daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com'
                    }
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                  />
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                  {streamType === 'rma_editor'
                    ? 'Comma-separated Google emails allowed to edit details & commercial docs'
                    : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'Vendor QA or delivery lead Google account'
                      : 'Store manager or receiving supervisor Google account'}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Entity / Branch Name OR Target RMA # */}
              <div className="sm:col-span-1 space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {streamType === 'rma_editor'
                    ? 'Target RMA # (Optional Scope Lock)'
                    : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'Master Supplier / Vendor Name (Optional)'
                      : 'Store / Supermarket Branch / Supplier (Optional)'}
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={streamType === 'rma_editor' ? targetRmaNumber : entityName}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      streamType === 'rma_editor'
                        ? setTargetRmaNumber(e.target.value)
                        : setEntityName(e.target.value)
                    }
                    placeholder={
                      streamType === 'rma_editor'
                        ? (inviteIsTestMode ? 'Optional: RMA-TEST-2026-...' : 'Optional: RMA-2026-...')
                        : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                          ? 'Optional: Walter Mart, Mondelez'
                          : 'Optional: Walter Mart, Savemore'
                    }
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                  />
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                  {streamType === 'rma_editor'
                    ? 'If specified, recipient can strictly view & edit only that RMA ticket'
                    : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'If entered, auto-populates the Supplier field on the portal'
                      : 'If entered (e.g. Walter Mart), auto-populates on the portal'}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Customizable Expiry Duration (Input Number + Unit Selector) */}
              <div className="sm:col-span-1 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    Expiry Duration *
                  </label>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold truncate ${streamType === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400' : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400'}`}>
                    {computedExpiryPreview}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <div className="relative w-20 shrink-0">
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="1"
                      max="365"
                      required={!noExpiry}
                      disabled={noExpiry}
                      value={expiryNumber}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setNoExpiry(false);
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        if (val === '') {
                          setExpiryNumber('');
                        } else {
                          const parsed = parseInt(val, 10);
                          setExpiryNumber(isNaN(parsed) ? '' : parsed);
                        }
                      }}
                      onBlur={() => {
                        if (!expiryNumber || Number(expiryNumber) < 1) {
                          setExpiryNumber(1);
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-black font-mono text-center text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-45"
                      placeholder="24"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="relative flex-1">
                    <select
                      value={expiryUnit}
                      disabled={noExpiry}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setNoExpiry(false);
                        setExpiryUnit(e.target.value);
                      }}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-45"
                    >
                      <option value="minutes">Minutes</option>
                      <option value="hours">Hours</option>
                      <option value="days">Days</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Expiry Preset Chips */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap pt-0.5 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700/60">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold mr-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                Quick Presets:
              </span>
              {streamType === 'rma_editor' && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setNoExpiry((prev) => !prev)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    noExpiry
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50'
                  }`}
                >
                  Never Expires (Revocable)
                </button>
              )}
              {PRESET_EXPIRIES.map((preset) => {
                const isSelected = !noExpiry && Number(expiryNumber) === preset.num && expiryUnit === preset.unit;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={preset.label}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setNoExpiry(false);
                      setExpiryNumber(preset.num);
                      setExpiryUnit(preset.unit);
                    }}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                          ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                          : 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {preset.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="pt-1">
              <EmailRecipientsEditor
                emailType="invite_email"
                value={inviteExtraRecipients}
                onChange={setInviteExtraRecipients}
                compact={true}
                defaultExpanded={false}
                allowEmptyTo={true}
                isTestMode={inviteIsTestMode}
                title="Optional Extra Invite Email CCs"
                extraHint="Any addresses added here are automatically CC’d when clicking Send Invite Email."
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end pt-1">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isGenerating || !authorizedEmail.trim()}
                className={`px-5 py-2.5 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
                  streamType === 'rma_editor'
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-indigo-600/20'
                    : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 shadow-purple-600/20'
                      : 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-blue-600/20'
                }`}
              >
                {isGenerating ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Generating Invite...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {streamType === 'rma_editor' ? <FileEdit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    <span>
                      {streamType === 'rma_editor'
                        ? 'Generate RMA Editor Link'
                        : streamType === 'supplier_outbound'
                          ? 'Generate Supplier RTV Invite'
                          : 'Generate Customer Return Invite'}
                    </span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Generated Invite Link Banner */}
          {generatedInvite && (
            <div className={`p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-3xl space-y-3 animate-in fade-in border-2 ${
              isRmaEditorInvite(generatedInvite)
                ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800'
                : generatedInvite.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound'
                  ? 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800'
                  : 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800'
            }`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className={`w-5 h-5 ${
                    isRmaEditorInvite(generatedInvite)
                      ? 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
                      : generatedInvite.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound'
                        ? 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400'
                        : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                  }`} />
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    Ready: {isRmaEditorInvite(generatedInvite) ? 'RMA Details Editor Link' : generatedInvite.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'Supplier RTV Link' : 'Customer Return Link'} Generated!
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                  isRmaEditorInvite(generatedInvite)
                    ? 'text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-200/60 dark:bg-indigo-900/60'
                    : generatedInvite.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 bg-purple-200/60 dark:bg-purple-900/60'
                      : 'text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-200/60 dark:bg-emerald-900/60'
                }`}>
                  {isPermanentInvite(generatedInvite)
                    ? 'Validity: No Expiry • Revocable by Admin'
                    : `Validity: ${generatedInvite.duration_display || 'Custom'} • Expires: ${formatDateTimeYmdHm(generatedInvite.expires_at)}`}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 font-mono text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 break-all select-all flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span>{buildInviteUrl(generatedInvite)}</span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleCopyLink(generatedInvite)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {copiedToken === generatedInvite.token ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      <span>Copied to Clipboard!</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
                      <span>Copy Private Link</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSendEmail(generatedInvite)}
                  disabled={isSendingEmail}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer ${
                    isRmaEditorInvite(generatedInvite)
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700'
                      : generatedInvite.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound'
                        ? 'bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700'
                        : 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isSendingEmail ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                      <span>Sending Email...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>Send Invite Email</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Active / Past Invites Management Table */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  Authorized Invites ({filteredInvites.length})
                </h3>

                {/* Filter Tabs */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-0.5 rounded-xl text-[10.5px] flex-wrap">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setStreamFilter('all')}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      streamFilter === 'all'
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    All ({invites.length})
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setStreamFilter('customer_inbound')}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      streamFilter === 'customer_inbound'
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>📥 Customer</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-75">({customerCount})</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setStreamFilter('supplier_outbound')}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      streamFilter === 'supplier_outbound'
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>📤 Supplier</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-75">({supplierCount})</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setStreamFilter('rma_editor')}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      streamFilter === 'rma_editor'
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>✏️ Editor</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-75">({editorCount})</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={loadInvites}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>Refresh</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {filteredInvites.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold">
                No authorization invites found for this filter. Use the form above to generate your first secure return link.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {isDesktopMd ? (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-3">Stream</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Authorized Email</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Branch / Supplier / Target RMA</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Duration</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Remaining</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Status</th>
                      <th className="p-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                    {paginatedInvites.map((inv) => {
                      const countdown = formatRemainingCountdown(inv.expires_at, inv.status, inv);
                      const isRevoked = inv.status === 'revoked';
                      const isExpired = countdown.isExpired;
                      const isSupplier = inv.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound';
                      const isEditor = isRmaEditorInvite(inv);
                      const allowedEmailsList = getInviteAllowedEmails(inv);
                      const permanent = isPermanentInvite(inv);

                      return (
                        <tr key={inv.token || inv.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                          <td className="p-3">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">
                              {isEditor ? (
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <FileEdit className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>RMA Editor</span>
                                </span>
                              ) : isSupplier ? (
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/70 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <Truck className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>Supplier RTV</span>
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <Store className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>Customer Return</span>
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {(inv.is_test || String(inv.token || '').startsWith('inv_test_')) && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700">
                                  🧪 Test
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white max-w-[260px]">
                            {allowedEmailsList.length > 1 ? (
                              <div className="space-y-0.5">
                                <div className="truncate">{allowedEmailsList[0]}</div>
                                <div className="text-[10px] font-sans font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" title={allowedEmailsList.join(', ')}>
                                  +{allowedEmailsList.length - 1} CC recipient{allowedEmailsList.length - 1 > 1 ? 's' : ''}: {allowedEmailsList.slice(1).join(', ')}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              inv.authorized_email
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                            {isEditor
                              ? (inv.rma_number ? <span className="font-mono font-black text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">{inv.rma_number}</span> : <span className="text-slate-400 italic">Open RMA Lookup</span>)
                              : (inviteService.normalizeEntityName(inv.entity_name || inv.store_branch) || <span className="text-slate-400 italic">Optional / Open</span>)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            {permanent ? 'No Expiry' : (inv.duration_display || '24 hour(s)')}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            <span className={
                              isExpired
                                ? 'text-slate-400'
                                : permanent
                                  ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold'
                                  : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold'
                            }>
                              {permanent && !isRevoked ? 'No Expiry • Revocable by Admin' : countdown.text}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3">
                            {isRevoked ? (
                              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/70 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800">
                                Revoked
                              </span>
                            ) : isExpired ? (
                              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700">
                                Expired
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700">
                                Active
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 text-right">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                              {!isRevoked && !isExpired && (
                                <>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleCopyLink(inv)}
                                    className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"

                                  >
                                    <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>

                                    type="button"

                                  >
                                    <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleRevoke(inv.token || inv.id)}
                                    className="p-1.5 text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-50 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"

                                  >
                                    <Ban className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>
                                </>
                              )}
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={deletingToken === (inv.token || inv.id)}
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(inv)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                                title="Delete Invite Record"
                              >
                                {deletingToken === (inv.token || inv.id) ? (
                                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-rose-500" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                )}
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
                ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {paginatedInvites.map((inv) => {
                  const countdown = formatRemainingCountdown(inv.expires_at, inv.status, inv);
                  const isRevoked = inv.status === 'revoked';
                  const isExpired = countdown.isExpired;
                  const isSupplier = inv.stream_type === 'supplier_outbound';
                  const isEditor = isRmaEditorInvite(inv);
                  const allowedEmailsList = getInviteAllowedEmails(inv);
                  const permanent = isPermanentInvite(inv);
                  return (
                    <div key={`mob-${inv.token || inv.id}`} className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {isEditor ? (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <FileEdit className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>RMA Editor</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : isSupplier ? (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/70 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Truck className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>Supplier RTV</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Store className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>Customer Return</span>
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {(inv.is_test || String(inv.token || '').startsWith('inv_test_')) && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700">
                              🧪 Test
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {isRevoked ? (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/70 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800">Revoked</span>
                        ) : isExpired ? (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700">Expired</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700">Active</span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white break-all">{allowedEmailsList[0] || inv.authorized_email}</div>
                        {allowedEmailsList.length > 1 && (
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 break-all">
                            +{allowedEmailsList.length - 1} CC: {allowedEmailsList.slice(1).join(', ')}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                          {isEditor
                            ? (inv.rma_number || 'Open RMA Lookup')
                            : (inviteService.normalizeEntityName(inv.entity_name || inv.store_branch) || 'Optional / Open')}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                          {permanent ? 'No Expiry' : `${inv.duration_display || '24 hour(s)'} • ${countdown.text}`}
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          {!isRevoked && !isExpired && (
                            <>
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => handleCopyLink(inv)} className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg" title="Copy Invite Link"><Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => handleSendEmail(inv)} disabled={isSendingEmail} className="p-1.5 text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg" title="Send Link via Email"><Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRevoke(inv.token || inv.id)} className="p-1.5 text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded-lg" title="Revoke Active Invite Access"><Ban className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
                            </>
                          )}
                          <button type="button" disabled={deletingToken === (inv.token || inv.id)} onClick={() => handleDelete(inv)} className="p-1.5 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-50" title="Delete Invite Record">
                            {deletingToken === (inv.token || inv.id) ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-rose-500" /> : <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
                )}

                <TablePagination
                  currentPage={currentPage}
                  totalItems={filteredInvites.length}
                  pageSize={pageSize}
                  onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
                  onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
                    setPageSize(newSize);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  pageSizeOptions={[10, 25, 50]}
                  itemLabel="invites"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        {!isEmbeddedPage && (
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-900">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              Pingcon Operations • Customer Return & Supplier RTV Governance
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/DeleteConfirmationModal.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { Trash2, AlertTriangle, X, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';

export default function DeleteConfirmationModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  title = '',
  itemName = '',
  itemType = 'item', // 'product' | 'report' | 'item' | 'reports' | 'bulk_reports'
  itemDetails = '',
  isDeleting = false,
  isPermanent = false
}) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isSoftTrash = (itemType === 'report' || itemType === 'reports' || itemType === 'bulk_reports' || itemType === 'rma') && !isPermanent;
  const resolvedTitle = title || (isSoftTrash ? 'Move to Trash (30-Day Recovery)?' : 'Confirm Deletion');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/65 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div 
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 pb-safe"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden pt-2.5 pb-1 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Header with Hazard Icon */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 pb-4 flex items-start gap-4">
          <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner ${
            isSoftTrash 
              ? 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400' 
              : 'bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/70 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
          }`}>
            <Trash2 className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                {resolvedTitle}
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isDeleting}
                className="min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
              {isSoftTrash 
                ? 'Item will be safely stored in the 30-Day Trash Bin before permanent purge.'
                : `Please confirm if you want to permanently remove this ${itemType}.`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Item Info Callout */}
        <div className="px-6 pb-2">
          <div className={`p-4 border rounded-2xl space-y-1.5 ${
            isSoftTrash
              ? 'bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/60'
              : 'bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60'
          }`}>
            <div className={`text-xs font-black break-words ${
              isSoftTrash ? 'text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200' : 'text-rose-950 dark:text-rose-200'
            }`}>
              {itemName || `Selected ${itemType}`}
            </div>
            {itemDetails && (
              <div className={`text-[11px] font-mono ${
                isSoftTrash ? 'text-amber-800/80 dark:text-amber-300/80' : 'text-rose-800/80 dark:text-rose-300/80'
              }`}>
                {itemDetails}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className={`text-[11px] pt-1 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              isSoftTrash ? 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400'
            }`}>
              <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                {isSoftTrash 
                  ? '⏳ Can be fully restored from the Archive & Trash Vault within 30 days.' 
                  : 'This record will be permanently deleted from the database.'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer Actions */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 mt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isDeleting}
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isDeleting}
            onClick={onConfirm}
            className={`px-5 py-2.5 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
              isSoftTrash
                ? 'bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 shadow-amber-600/25'
                : 'bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 shadow-rose-600/25'
            }`}
          >
            {isDeleting ? (
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            <span>
              {isDeleting 
                ? (isSoftTrash ? 'Moving to Trash...' : 'Deleting...') 
                : (isSoftTrash ? '🗑️ Move to Trash (30-Day Recovery)' : 'Yes, Delete Permanently')}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
