--- START FILE: src/components/EmailRecipientsEditor.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Mail,
  Plus,
  X,
  Save,
  RotateCcw,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  AtSign,
  FlaskConical
} from 'lucide-react';
import { notificationService, EMAIL_PROFILE_TYPES } from '../services/notificationService';

const isValidEmail = (raw) => {
  const s = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(s);
};

export default function EmailRecipientsEditor({
  emailType = 'new_rma',
  value = null,
  onChange = null,
  onSaved = null,
  title = '',
  description = '',
  compact = false,
  defaultExpanded,
  isTestMode = false,
  allowEmptyTo,
  extraHint = ''
}) {
  const [sandboxEmail, setSandboxEmail] = useState(() => notificationService.getTestSandboxEmail());
  useEffect(() => {
    const syncSandbox = () => setSandboxEmail(notificationService.getTestSandboxEmail());
    window.addEventListener('rma-settings-changed', syncSandbox);
    window.addEventListener('storage', syncSandbox);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('rma-settings-changed', syncSandbox);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', syncSandbox);
    };
  }, []);

  const meta = useMemo(
    () => EMAIL_PROFILE_TYPES.find((t) => t.id === emailType) || EMAIL_PROFILE_TYPES[0],
    [emailType]
  );
  const canEmptyTo = allowEmptyTo !== undefined ? allowEmptyTo : emailType === 'invite_email';

  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(() => (
    defaultExpanded !== undefined ? Boolean(defaultExpanded) : !compact
  ));
  const [toList, setToList] = useState(() => {
    if (value?.toList) return [...value.toList];
    return notificationService.getEmailProfile(emailType, Boolean(isTestMode)).toList || [];
  });
  const [ccList, setCcList] = useState(() => {
    if (value?.ccList) return [...value.ccList];
    return notificationService.getEmailProfile(emailType, Boolean(isTestMode)).ccList || [];
  });
  const [newToInput, setNewToInput] = useState('');
  const [newCcInput, setNewCcInput] = useState('');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);
  const isDirtyRef = useRef(false);

  // Sync from controlled prop if provided, else keep synced when emailType, isTestMode, or storage changes
  useEffect(() => {
    isDirtyRef.current = false;
    if (value && (Array.isArray(value.toList) || Array.isArray(value.ccList))) {
      if (Array.isArray(value.toList)) setToList(value.toList);
      if (Array.isArray(value.ccList)) setCcList(value.ccList);
      return;
    }
    const loadSaved = (evt) => {
      if (evt?.detail?.loadedFromDb && isDirtyRef.current) {
        return;
      }
      const prof = notificationService.getEmailProfile(emailType, Boolean(isTestMode));
      setToList(prof.toList || []);
      setCcList(prof.ccList || []);
    };
    loadSaved();
    window.addEventListener('rma-settings-changed', loadSaved);
    window.addEventListener('storage', loadSaved);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('rma-settings-changed', loadSaved);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', loadSaved);
    };
  }, [emailType, isTestMode, value?.toList, value?.ccList]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const emitChange = (nextTo, nextCc) => {
    if (onChange) {
      onChange({ toList: nextTo, ccList: nextCc });
    }
  };

  const handleAddTo = () => {
    const candidates = newToInput
      .split(/[,;\s]+/)
      .map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return;

    const invalid = candidates.find((c) => !isValidEmail(c));
    if (invalid) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: `Invalid TO email address: "${invalid}"` });
      return;
    }

    const existing = new Set(toList.map((e) => e.toLowerCase()));
    const added = candidates.filter((c) => !existing.has(c));
    if (added.length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Email is already in the TO list.' });
      return;
    }

    isDirtyRef.current = true;
    const nextTo = [...toList, ...added];
    const addedSet = new Set(added);
    const nextCc = ccList.filter((e) => !addedSet.has(e.toLowerCase()));
    setToList(nextTo);
    setCcList(nextCc);
    setNewToInput('');
    setFeedback(null);
    emitChange(nextTo, nextCc);
  };

  const handleRemoveTo = (emailToRemove) => {
    isDirtyRef.current = true;
    const nextTo = toList.filter((e) => e.toLowerCase() !== emailToRemove.toLowerCase());
    setToList(nextTo);
    setFeedback(null);
    emitChange(nextTo, ccList);
  };

  const handleAddCc = () => {
    const candidates = newCcInput
      .split(/[,;\s]+/)
      .map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return;

    const invalid = candidates.find((c) => !isValidEmail(c));
    if (invalid) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: `Invalid CC email address: "${invalid}"` });
      return;
    }

    const existingCc = new Set(ccList.map((e) => e.toLowerCase()));
    const dupes = candidates.filter((c) => !existingCc.has(c));
    if (dupes.length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Email is already in the CC list.' });
      return;
    }

    isDirtyRef.current = true;
    const nextCc = [...ccList, ...dupes];
    setCcList(nextCc);
    setNewCcInput('');
    setFeedback(null);
    emitChange(toList, nextCc);
  };

  const handleRemoveCc = (emailToRemove) => {
    isDirtyRef.current = true;
    const nextCc = ccList.filter((e) => e.toLowerCase() !== emailToRemove.toLowerCase());
    setCcList(nextCc);
    setFeedback(null);
    emitChange(toList, nextCc);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!canEmptyTo && toList.length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'At least one valid Primary TO recipient is required.' });
      return;
    }
    setIsSaving(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const saved = await notificationService.saveEmailProfile(emailType, { toList, ccList }, Boolean(isTestMode));
      isDirtyRef.current = false;
      setToList(saved.toList);
      setCcList(saved.ccList);
      emitChange(saved.toList, saved.ccList);
      setFeedback({
        type: 'success',
        message: isTestMode
          ? 'Test Mode recipients saved & synced to cloud!'
          : 'Recipients saved & synced to cloud!'
      });
      if (onSaved) onSaved(saved);
      setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 4000);
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err?.message || 'Could not save recipients.' });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDefaults = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const restored = await notificationService.resetEmailProfileToDefaults(emailType, Boolean(isTestMode));
      isDirtyRef.current = false;
      setToList(restored.toList);
      setCcList(restored.ccList);
      emitChange(restored.toList, restored.ccList);
      setFeedback({
        type: 'success',
        message: isTestMode
          ? 'Reset to Test Mode Sandbox Defaults!'
          : 'Reset to Global Corporate Defaults!'
      });
      if (onSaved) onSaved(restored);
      setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 3500);
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err?.message || 'Could not reset defaults.' });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const displayTitle = title || meta.label;
  const displayDesc = description || meta.description;

  return (
    <div
      data-email-recipients-editor={emailType}
      className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 overflow-hidden shadow-2xs"
    >
      {/* Header / Compact Accordion Trigger */}
      <div
        className={`px-3.5 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 ${
          compact ? 'cursor-pointer select-none hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors' : 'border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
        }`}
        onClick={compact ? () => setIsExpanded((v) => !v) : undefined}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span>{displayTitle}</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800">
                TO: {toList.length} • CC: {ccList.length}
              </span>
            </div>
            {!compact && displayDesc && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate mt-0.5">{displayDesc}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0" onClick={(e) => compact && e.stopPropagation()}>
          {isExpanded && (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetDefaults}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                title={isTestMode ? 'Reset Test Mode recipients to Sandbox Defaults' : 'Reset recipients to Global Corporate Defaults'}
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{isTestMode ? 'Reset Test Defaults' : 'Reset to Global Defaults'}</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSave}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-white text-[11px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-50 ${
                  isTestMode ? 'bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700' : 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700'
                }`}
              >
                <Save className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{isSaving ? 'Saving...' : (isTestMode ? 'Save Test Recipients' : 'Save Recipients')}</span>
              </button>
            </>
          )}
          {compact && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsExpanded((v) => !v)}
              className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              aria-label={isExpanded ? 'Collapse email recipients' : 'Expand email recipients'}
            >
              {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Expandable Editor Body */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="p-3.5 space-y-3 text-xs border-t border-slate-200/70 dark:border-slate-700/70">
          {isTestMode && (
            <div className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
              <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                🧪 Editing Test Mode Recipients (isolated from Live) — When empty/reset, falls back exclusively to <code className="font-mono font-black">{sandboxEmail}</code>. Live stakeholders will never receive Test Mode emails.
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {feedback && (
            <div className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              feedback.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200'
                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200'
            }`}>
              {feedback.type === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <span>{feedback.message}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Primary TO Chips & Add Input */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                {(allowEmptyTo || emailType === 'invite_email' || emailType === 'supplier_followup') ? 'Extra TO Recipient(s) (Optional)' : 'Primary TO Recipient(s)'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                {toList.length} address{toList.length === 1 ? '' : 'es'}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 items-center min-h-[38px]">
              {toList.length === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic px-1">
                  {emailType === 'invite_email'
                    ? 'Uses invited user email automatically.'
                    : emailType === 'supplier_followup'
                      ? 'Uses each RMA record’s Supplier Email TO automatically.'
                      : 'No TO recipient added yet.'}
                </span>
              ) : (
                toList.map((email) => (
                  <span
                    key={`to-${email}`}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold max-w-full"
                  >
                    <span className="truncate max-w-[210px]">{email}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveTo(email)}
                      title={`Remove TO ${email}`}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${email}`}
                      className="text-blue-500 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 p-0.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-1.5">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <AtSign className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newToInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewToInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      handleAddTo();
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Add Primary TO email (e.g. finance@company.com)"
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAddTo}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Add TO</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* CC Chips & Add Input */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                CC Distribution List
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                {ccList.length} address{ccList.length === 1 ? '' : 'es'}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 items-center min-h-[38px]">
              {ccList.length === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic px-1">No CC recipients configured.</span>
              ) : (
                ccList.map((email) => (
                  <span
                    key={`cc-${email}`}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-mono text-[11px] shadow-2xs max-w-full"
                  >
                    <span className="truncate max-w-[210px]">{email}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveCc(email)}
                      title={`Remove ${email}`}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${email}`}
                      className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 p-0.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-1.5">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newCcInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCcInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      handleAddCc();
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Add CC email (e.g. manager@pingconmarketing.com)"
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAddCc}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Add CC</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {extraHint && (
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed pt-0.5">
              {extraHint}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/EmployeeManagementModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { X, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, UserCheck, UserX, Shield, RefreshCw, Plus, Users, Key, Search, Mail, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';

const ROLES = [
  { id: 'super_admin', label: '👑 Super Admin', desc: 'Full permissions (manage roles, catalog, verify barcodes, view reports)' },
  { id: 'admin', label: '🛡️ Admin', desc: 'Catalog management, verify barcodes, view reports' },
  { id: 'inventory_staff', label: '📦 Inventory Staff', desc: 'Can verify pending barcodes & update item details' },
  { id: 'viewer', label: '👁️ Viewer', desc: 'Read-only access to view RMA reports' }
];

export default function EmployeeManagementModal({ isOpen, onClose, currentUser, isEmbeddedPage = false }) {
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('all');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('name_asc');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [hrApiKey, setHrApiKey] = useState(authService.getHrApiKey());
  const [showApiKeyInput, setShowApiKeyInput] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState(null);

  // Add new employee state
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newEmail, setNewEmail] = useState('');
  const [newRole, setNewRole] = useState('inventory_staff');
  const [newDept, setNewDept] = useState('Operations');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen || isEmbeddedPage) {
      loadEmployees();
    }
  }, [isOpen, isEmbeddedPage]);

  const loadEmployees = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const list = await authService.getEmployees();
      setEmployees(list);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Load employees error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const showStatus = (text, type = 'success') => {
    setNotice({ text, type });
    setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleRoleChange = async (email, newRole) => {
    try {
      await authService.setEmployeeRole(email, newRole);
      setEmployees(prev => prev.map(e => e.email === email ? { ...e, role: newRole } : e));
      showStatus(`Updated role for ${email} to ${newRole}`);
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleStatusToggle = async (email, currentStatus) => {
    const nextStatus = !currentStatus;
    try {
      await authService.setEmployeeStatus(null, email, nextStatus);
      setEmployees(prev => prev.map(e => e.email === email ? { ...e, is_active: nextStatus } : e));
      showStatus(`Employee ${email} is now marked as ${nextStatus ? 'ACTIVE' : 'RESIGNED'}`);
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleAddEmployee = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newEmail.trim() || !newName.trim()) return;

    try {
      await authService.addEmployee({
        name: newName,
        email: newEmail,
        role: newRole,
        department: newDept
      });
      showStatus(`Added ${newName} (${newEmail}) to company directory!`);
      setNewName('');
      setNewEmail('');
      setIsAdding(false);
      loadEmployees();
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleSyncFromHRCenter = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const res = await authService.syncFromHRCenter(hrApiKey);
      showStatus(res.message, 'success');
      loadEmployees();
      setShowApiKeyInput(false);
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message, 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  // Filter and sort employees memo
  const filteredEmployees = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return employees
      .filter(emp => {
        if (q) {
          const matches = (
            (emp.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (emp.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (emp.department || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (emp.role || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
          );
          if (!matches) return false;
        }

        if (roleFilter !== 'all' && (emp.role || 'inventory_staff') !== roleFilter) {
          return false;
        }

        if (statusFilter === 'active' && emp.is_active === false) return false;
        if (statusFilter === 'resigned' && emp.is_active !== false) return false;

        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'name_asc') {
          return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '');
        } else if (sortBy === 'name_desc') {
          return (b.name || '').localeCompare(a.name || '');
        } else if (sortBy === 'role') {
          return (a.role || '').localeCompare(b.role || '');
        } else if (sortBy === 'status') {
          return (a.is_active === false ? 1 : 0) - (b.is_active === false ? 1 : 0);
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [employees, searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, sortBy]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedEmployees = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return filteredEmployees.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [filteredEmployees, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // All hooks declared above. Early return only right before JSX render!
  if (!isOpen && !isEmbeddedPage) return null;

  return (
    <div className={isEmbeddedPage
      ? 'w-full'
      : 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in'
    }>
      {/* Outer Card: Native full-width page when embedded, or crisp centered modal */}
      <div className={isEmbeddedPage
        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 w-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden'
        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-2xl w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[88vh] overflow-hidden my-0 sm:my-auto pb-safe'
      }>
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        {!isEmbeddedPage && <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />}
        
        {/* Pinned Header */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                Employee Access & Roles Management
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Super Admin portal to assign staff roles & toggle active / resigned status.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {!isEmbeddedPage && (
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close Employee Roles Modal"
              className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Top Controls & Search Bar */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 sm:py-3.5 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shrink-0">
          
          {/* Status Notice */}
          {notice && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in ${
              notice.type === 'success' 
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800' 
                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
            }`}>
              {notice.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600" />}
              <span>{notice.text}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick Toolbar: Add Staff & HR Sync */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAdding(!isAdding)}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Add Employee</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowApiKeyInput(!showApiKeyInput)}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all"
              >
                <Key className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
                <span>HR Center API Sync</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Total Staff: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-white">{isLoading && employees.length === 0 ? 'Loading...' : employees.length}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SEARCH BAR (Filter by name, company email, or department) */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-2.5" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              placeholder="Search name, email, or department..."
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 dark:focus:ring-blue-900/30 shadow-sm transition-all"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchQuery('');
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
                title="Clear search"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Quick Filters Strip */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            <select
              value={roleFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setRoleFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
            >
              <option value="all">All Roles</option>
              <option value="super_admin">👑 Super Admin</option>
              <option value="admin">🛡️ Admin</option>
              <option value="inventory_staff">📦 Inventory Staff</option>
              <option value="viewer">👁️ Viewer</option>
            </select>

            <select
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
            >
              <option value="all">All Status</option>
              <option value="active">Active Only</option>
              <option value="resigned">Resigned Only</option>
            </select>

            <select
              value={sortBy}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSortBy(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
            >
              <option value="name_asc">Sort: Name (A-Z)</option>
              <option value="name_desc">Sort: Name (Z-A)</option>
              <option value="role">Sort: Role</option>
              <option value="status">Sort: Status</option>
            </select>

            {(searchQuery.trim() !== '' || roleFilter !== 'all' || statusFilter !== 'all') && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchQuery('');
                  setRoleFilter('all');
                  setStatusFilter('all');
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="px-2 py-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-[11px] transition-colors"
              >
                Reset
              </button>
            )}

            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold ml-auto">
              Showing {filteredEmployees.length} of {employees.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* HR Center API Key Drawer */}
          {showApiKeyInput && (
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-purple-50/80 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 rounded-2xl space-y-2 text-xs animate-in fade-in">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-bold text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 block">
                  Sync Active Staff with HR Center API
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono">/api/v1/employees</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 leading-tight">
                Pulls employee records and strictly connects their official company emails (@keysysincorporated.com, @ph.keysys.com, @pingcon.com, @a2z2go.net).
              </p>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={hrApiKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setHrApiKey(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Bearer API Key..."
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600 shadow-sm"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isSyncing || !hrApiKey.trim()}
                  onClick={handleSyncFromHRCenter}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                >
                  {isSyncing ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>Sync Now</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Add Employee Form Drawer */}
          {isAdding && (
            <form onSubmit={handleAddEmployee} className="p-3.5 bg-blue-50/70 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-2xl space-y-2.5 text-xs animate-in fade-in">
              <span className="font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 block">Add Authorized Company Staff</span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Full Name (e.g. Maria Clara)"
                  value={newName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  placeholder="Company Email (@keysys, @pingcon...)"
                  value={newEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <select
                  value={newRole}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                >
                  {ROLES.map(r => (
                    <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>{r.label}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Department (e.g. Finance / Warehouse)"
                  value={newDept}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewDept(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Save Employee
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Employee List Container (Scrollbar stays strictly within this area, avoiding curved card borders) */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-3.5 space-y-2.5 overscroll-contain">
          {filteredEmployees.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 space-y-1">
              <Users className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold">No employees found matching "{searchQuery}"</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Try searching with a different name or company email address.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            paginatedEmployees.map((emp, idx) => (
              <div
                key={emp.email}
                className={`p-3 sm:p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs ${
                  emp.is_active === false 
                    ? 'bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 opacity-60' 
                    : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 shadow-sm'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-[10px] text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-300 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                      #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm truncate">
                      {emp.name}
                    </span>
                    {emp.email === currentUser?.email && (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/50 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 shrink-0">
                        YOU
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {emp.role === 'super_admin' && (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/50 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 shrink-0">
                        SUPER ADMIN
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {emp.is_active === false ? (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 shrink-0">
                        RESIGNED
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 shrink-0">
                        ACTIVE
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                    <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">{emp.email}</strong> • {emp.department || 'General'}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Role Selection & Active/Resigned Toggle */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 pt-1 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60">
                  <select
                    value={emp.role || 'inventory_staff'}
                    onChange={(e) => handleRoleChange(emp.email, e.target.value)}
                    disabled={emp.email === currentUser?.email}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {ROLES.map(r => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>{r.label}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleStatusToggle(emp.email, emp.is_active !== false)}
                    disabled={emp.email === currentUser?.email}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all disabled:opacity-30 ${
                      emp.is_active !== false
                        ? 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
                        : 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                    }`}
                    title={emp.is_active !== false ? 'Mark as Resigned (Block Access)' : 'Restore Active Access'}
                  >
                    {emp.is_active !== false ? (
                      <>
                        <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Mark Resigned</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Reactivate</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Footer with pagination */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0">
          <TablePagination
            currentPage={currentPage}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            totalItems={filteredEmployees.length}
            onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
            onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
              setPageSize(newSize);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
          />
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/FinanceCreditMemoTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  DollarSign, 
  CheckSquare, 
  Square, 
  FileCheck2, 
  Receipt, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Clock, 
  Building2, 
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  UserCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPeso, formatDateYmd } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function FinanceCreditMemoTab({ tickets = [], onUpdateTicket }) {
  const [selectedTicketId, setSelectedTicketId] = useState(null);
  const [creditMemoNo, setCreditMemoNo] = useState('');
  const [creditAmount, setCreditAmount] = useState('');
  const [issuedBy, setIssuedBy] = useState('Analiza B. Benoza');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState(null);

  // Financial Stats
  const totalRmaValue = tickets.reduce((acc, t) => acc + (Number(t.total_amount) || 0), 0);
  const totalCreditIssued = tickets
    .filter(t => t.status === 'Credit Memo Issued')
    .reduce((acc, t) => acc + (Number(t.credit_amount) || Number(t.total_amount) || 0), 0);
  const pendingCreditValue = tickets
    .filter(t => t.status !== 'Credit Memo Issued' && t.status !== 'Rejected')
    .reduce((acc, t) => acc + (Number(t.total_amount) || 0), 0);
  const totalPullOuts = tickets.filter(t => t.pull_out_confirmed).length;

  // Select ticket to issue memo
  const handleSelectTicketForMemo = (ticket) => {
    setSelectedTicketId(ticket.id);
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const randomSeq = String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000));
    setCreditMemoNo(`CM-${year}-${randomSeq}`);
    setCreditAmount(ticket.total_amount);
  };

  // Toggle Pull-Out confirmation checkbox
  const handleTogglePullOut = async (ticket) => {
    const updatedStatus = !ticket.pull_out_confirmed;
    await onUpdateTicket(ticket.id, {
      pull_out_confirmed: updatedStatus,
      status: updatedStatus && ticket.status === 'Pending Inspection' ? 'In Transit' : ticket.status
    });
    showToast(`Physical pull-out ${updatedStatus ? 'CONFIRMED' : 'UNCHECKED'} for ${ticket.id}`);
  };

  // Issue Credit Memo submission
  const handleIssueCreditMemo = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedTicketId) return;

    if (!creditMemoNo.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter a Credit Memo number.');
      return;
    }

    const amt = Number(creditAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
      alert('Please enter a valid credit amount in ₱.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onUpdateTicket(selectedTicketId, {
        credit_memo_no: creditMemoNo.trim(),
        credit_amount: amt,
        credit_issued_by: issuedBy,
        credit_issued_date: new Date().toISOString(),
        status: 'Credit Memo Issued',
        pull_out_confirmed: true
      });

      showToast(`Credit Memo ${creditMemoNo} successfully issued for ${formatPeso(amt)}!`);
      setSelectedTicketId(null);
      setCreditMemoNo('');
      setCreditAmount('');
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Error issuing credit memo: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const showToast = (msg) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 4000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Toast Alert */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs sm:text-sm animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 shadow-sm">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span className="font-semibold">{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 sm:gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Total Returns Value</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {formatPeso(totalRmaValue)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Gross claimed merchandise</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Credit Memos Issued</span>
            <Receipt className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {formatPeso(totalCreditIssued)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Credited to customer accounts</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Pending Credit Balance</span>
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
            {formatPeso(pendingCreditValue)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Awaiting finance reconciliation</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mb-1">
            <span>Pull-Out Verified</span>
            <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black font-mono text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
            {totalPullOuts} of {tickets.length} Units
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Physical receipt at warehouse</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Finance Workstation Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* Left Column: RMA Pull-out & Returns Table (2 Cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileCheck2 className="w-5 h-5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
                <span>Warehouse Pull-Out & Finance Clearance</span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Confirm physical pull-out checkbox, then select ticket to authorize Credit Memo.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[620px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {tickets.map((ticket) => {
              const isSelected = selectedTicketId === ticket.id;
              const isCredited = ticket.status === 'Credit Memo Issued';

              return (
                <div
                  key={ticket.id}
                  className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-brand-50/50 dark:bg-brand-950/40 border-brand-500 ring-1 ring-brand-500/40' 
                      : isCredited

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertTriangle, RotateCcw, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { computeFourStepWorkflow, formatDurationCompact } from '../utils/followUpWorkflow';
import { notificationService, SETTINGS_SYNC_EVENT } from '../services/notificationService';
import { isTestRecord } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

/**
 * Reusable Full 4-Step + 10-Calendar-Day (Day 0..Day 10) Timeline Card.
 * Displays Step 1 Report Date, Step 2 Waiting For Pickup (compact summary above the fold with collapsible Day 0..10 log),
 * Step 3 Driver Picked Up Date, and Step 4 Case Close.
 * For Test Mode Sandbox RMAs with accelerated testStepIntervalSeconds > 0, renders live countdowns.
 */
export default function FollowUpTimelineCard({
  report,
  catalogProducts = [],
  workflow = null,
  customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled = true,
  testStepIntervalSeconds = undefined,
  compact = false,
  defaultExpanded = false,
  onResetTimeline = null,
  isResettingTimeline = false
}) {
  const [isDaysExpanded, setIsDaysExpanded] = useState(Boolean(defaultExpanded));
  const [cfg, setCfg] = useState(() => notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig());
  const [nowTick, setNowTick] = useState(() => new Date());

  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setCfg(notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig());
    window.addEventListener(SETTINGS_SYNC_EVENT, sync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', sync);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(SETTINGS_SYNC_EVENT, sync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', sync);
    };
  }, []);

  const resolvedStepSec = testStepIntervalSeconds !== undefined
    ? Number(testStepIntervalSeconds || 0)
    : Number(cfg?.testStepIntervalSeconds || 0);
  const resolvedCustomerDefault = customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled ?? cfg?.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled ?? true;

  const isAcceleratedPreview = Boolean(report && isTestRecord(report) && resolvedStepSec > 0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAcceleratedPreview) return undefined;
    const id = setInterval(() => setNowTick(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [isAcceleratedPreview]);

  const wf = workflow || (report
    ? computeFourStepWorkflow(report, catalogProducts, {
        customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: resolvedCustomerDefault,
        testStepIntervalSeconds: resolvedStepSec,
        now: isAcceleratedPreview ? nowTick : undefined
      })
    : null);

  if (!wf) return null;

  const days = Array.isArray(wf.timelineDays) ? wf.timelineDays : [];

  const getBadgeClasses = (state) => {
    switch (state) {
      case 'picked_up':
        return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700';
      case 'halted':
        return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
      case 'expired':
        return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700';
      case 'dispatched':
        return 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700';
      case 'waiting':
      case 'past':
        return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-200 dark:border-amber-700';
      case 'reported':
        return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-300 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-200 dark:border-blue-700';
      default:
        return 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-900/70 p-3.5 space-y-2.5 text-xs">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
          <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>4-Step &amp; 10-Day Pickup Timeline</span>
          {wf.isAcceleratedTestSla && (
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9.5px] font-black bg-amber-200/80 dark:bg-amber-900/70 text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100 border border-amber-400 dark:border-amber-600 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
              <span>Test Speed: {formatDurationCompact(wf.testStepIntervalSeconds)}/day</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
          {typeof onResetTimeline === 'function' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isResettingTimeline}
              onClick={onResetTimeline}
              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-200/80 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Reset full 4-step workflow timeline, 10-day countdown & disposition outcome back to Pending"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{isResettingTimeline ? 'Resetting...' : 'Reset Timeline'}</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black border ${
            wf.isClosed
              ? (wf.isAutoDisposed ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700')
              : wf.isExpiredAfter10Days
                ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700'
                : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-200 dark:border-amber-700'
          }`}>
            {wf.step4.done ? wf.step4.dateDisplay : `Step ${wf.activeStepNumber} of 4 • ${wf.step2.text}`}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Accelerated Test Countdown Strip (only when Test Speed active & ticket open) */}
      {wf.isAcceleratedTestSla && wf.isCountdownActive && (
        <div className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-100/80 dark:bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              {wf.isExpiredAfter10Days
                ? 'Simulated Day 10 window elapsed — ready for Auto-Dispose on next tick.'
                : `Next simulated Day ${wf.calendarDay + 1} in ${formatDurationCompact(wf.nextStepInSeconds)}`}
            </span>
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
            Auto-Dispose in {formatDurationCompact(wf.autoDisposeInSeconds)}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Summary 4 Steps Row */}
      <div className={`grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 ${compact ? 'gap-1.5' : 'gap-2'}`}>
        <div className={`${compact ? 'p-2' : 'p-2.5'} rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Step 1: Report Date
          </div>
          <div className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-0.5 leading-snug">
            {wf.step1.dateDisplay}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={`${compact ? 'p-2' : 'p-2.5'} rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Step 2: Waiting For Pickup
          </div>
          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-0.5 leading-snug">
            {wf.step2.text} (10 Days Max)
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={`${compact ? 'p-2' : 'p-2.5'} rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Step 3: Driver Picked Up Date
          </div>
          <div className={`font-bold mt-0.5 leading-snug ${
            wf.isPickedUp ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : wf.step2.exceededAfter10 ? 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200'
          }`}>
            {wf.step3.dateDisplay}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={`${compact ? 'p-2' : 'p-2.5'} rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Step 4: Case Close
          </div>
          <div className={`font-bold mt-0.5 leading-snug ${
            wf.isClosed ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
          }`}>
            {wf.step4.dateDisplay}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Collapsible Day 0..Day 10 Progression Toggle */}
      {days.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsDaysExpanded((v) => !v)}
            aria-expanded={isDaysExpanded}
            className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-100/80 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-x-1.5 gap-y-0.5 text-left min-w-0">
              <span>{isDaysExpanded ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} Day 0 – Day 10 Schedule ({days.length} steps)</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 normal-case whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">
                • Sent: {wf.sentCount}
              </span>
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
              <span>{isDaysExpanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}</span>
              {isDaysExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            </span>
          </button>

          {isDaysExpanded && (
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/80 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              <div className="px-3 py-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span>{wf.isAcceleratedTestSla ? 'Simulated Step & Time (PHT)' : 'Day & Manila Calendar Date'}</span>
                <span>Pickup Check</span>
              </div>
              {days.map((row) => (
                <div
                  key={row.day}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]"
                >
                  <div className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {row.day === 0
                      ? `Day 0 (Report): ${row.dateLabel}`
                      : `Day ${row.day} (${row.dateLabel})`}
                  </div>
                  <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${getBadgeClasses(row.state)}`}>
                    {row.state === 'picked_up' && <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />}
                    {row.state === 'expired' && <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />}
                    {(row.state === 'waiting' || row.state === 'dispatched') && <Clock className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />}
                    <span>{row.statusText}</span>
                  </span>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
