--- START FILE: src/components/PortalAccessQRModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { 
  X, 
  QrCode, 
  Download, 
  Printer, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Camera, 
  Barcode, 
  FileCheck2, 
  Package, 
  Sparkles,
  Info,
  RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { downloadPortalPosterPng, downloadQrCodePng, printPortalPoster } from '../utils/qrDownload';
import { copyTextSafe } from '../utils/clipboard';
import { formatSaveFileTimestamp } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function PortalAccessQRModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [isCopied, setIsCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isDownloadingPoster, setIsDownloadingPoster] = useState(false);
  const [isDownloadingQr, setIsDownloadingQr] = useState(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const portalUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.origin 
    ? window.location.origin 
    : 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app';

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    copyTextSafe(portalUrl);
    setIsCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 2200);
  };

  const handleDownloadPoster = async () => {
    setIsDownloadingPoster(true);
    try {
      await downloadPortalPosterPng({
        svgElementOrId: 'portal-access-qr-svg',
        portalUrl,
        filename: `RMA-Public-Reporting-Poster ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}.png`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error downloading poster:', err);
      alert('Failed to generate poster. You can use browser print as an alternative.');
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingPoster(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadQr = async () => {
    setIsDownloadingQr(true);
    try {
      await downloadQrCodePng({
        svgElementOrId: 'portal-access-qr-svg',
        rmaNumber: 'PUBLIC-RMA-PORTAL',
        productName: 'Scan to Report Returned Merchandise',
        barcode: portalUrl,
        filename: `RMA-Portal-Access-QR ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}.png`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error downloading QR code:', err);
      alert('Failed to download QR code image.');
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingQr(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      await printPortalPoster({
        svgElementOrId: 'portal-access-qr-svg',
        portalUrl,
        documentTitle: `RMA-Public-Reporting-Poster ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error printing poster:', err);
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl sm:my-auto bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh] pb-safe animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden pt-2.5 pb-1 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 sm:px-8 py-5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/20">
              <QrCode className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base sm:text-lg tracking-tight">
                Public Reporting Portal QR
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Print or share this QR code for warehouse intake and customer returns
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain flex-1">
          
          {/* Main Card: QR Code & Live Portal URL */}
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-4">
            
            {/* Tag Badge */}
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-[11px] font-black text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>OFFICIAL SCAN-TO-REPORT PORTAL</span>
            </div>

            {/* QR SVG Frame */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-md inline-block">
              <QRCodeSVG
                id="portal-access-qr-svg"
                value={portalUrl}
                size={220}
                level="H"
                includeMargin={true}
              />
            </div>

            {/* URL Display with Copy Button */}
            <div className="w-full max-w-md">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xs">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate pl-2">
                  {portalUrl}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCopyLink}
                  className={`min-h-[38px] px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0 ${
                    isCopied
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isCopied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{isCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy URL'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* Visual Instructions for Users / Warehouse Receivers */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span>Step-by-Step Reporting Instructions</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  1
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Step 1: Scan QR with Google Lens</div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                    Open Google Lens (or QR scanner app) on your phone and point at this QR code to launch the reporting portal.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  2
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Step 2: Scan Barcode or Search</div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                    Use the built-in camera barcode reader or search the catalog.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">

                    Attach photos of damaged cartons or packaging breaches. Enter quantity and tap "Submit Return Ticket".

                </div>

--- START FILE: src/components/PrintBarcodesTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { Printer, Barcode, Layers, Filter } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPeso } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function PrintBarcodesTab({ catalog = [] }) {
  const [selectedBrand, setSelectedBrand] = useState('ALL');
  const [copiesPerItem, setCopiesPerItem] = useState(2);

  const filteredCatalog = catalog.filter(item => {
    if (selectedBrand === 'PINGCON') return item.sku.startsWith('PC-') || item.brand === 'Pingcon';
    if (selectedBrand === 'BONITA') return item.sku.startsWith('BON-') || item.brand === 'Bonita';
    if (selectedBrand === 'KEYSYS') return item.sku.startsWith('KS-') || item.sku.startsWith('A2Z-') || item.brand === 'Keysys' || item.brand === 'A2Z2Go';
    return true;
  });

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Top Banner (Hidden during print) */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 no-print">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/40">
              Warehouse Label Generator
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Barcode className="w-6 h-6 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
            Print SKU Barcodes (Letter Sheet &amp; Box Stickers)
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Printable sheet of Pingcon, Bonita & Keysys SKU barcodes for unlabelled wholesale boxes and repackers.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          {/* Brand Filter */}
          <select
            value={selectedBrand}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedBrand(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Product Lines</option>
            <option value="PINGCON">Pingcon Commercial Tissue</option>
            <option value="BONITA">Bonita Retail Tissue</option>
            <option value="KEYSYS">Keysys & A2Z2Go POS</option>
          </select>

          {/* Print Trigger Button */}
          <button
            onClick={handlePrint}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-brand-600/20 flex items-center space-x-2 transition-all active:scale-95"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Print Letter Label Sheet</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Printable Grid of Labels */}
      <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-inner">
        <div className="a4-print-sheet grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {filteredCatalog.flatMap((prod) => 
            Array.from({ length: copiesPerItem }).map((_, copyIndex) => (
              <div 
                key={`${prod.sku}-${copyIndex}`}
                className="barcode-sticker bg-white text-slate-900 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm relative group hover:border-brand-500 transition-colors"
              >
                {/* Brand & Supplier Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    {prod.brand ? `${prod.brand.toUpperCase()} WHOLESALE` : 'WHOLESALE PRODUCT'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                    COPY {copyIndex + 1}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Product Name */}
                <div className="py-2.5">
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                    {prod.name}
                  </h4>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-brand-700">SKU: {prod.sku}</span>
                    <span>{prod.case_pack || 'Carton Pack'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* QR and Barcode Graphic Container */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-2.5 my-1">
                  
                  {/* QR Code */}
                  <div className="shrink-0 bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      value={prod.barcode}
                      size={64}
                      level="M"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Visual Barcode Bars Representation */}
                  <div className="flex-1 ml-3 flex flex-col items-center">
                    <div className="h-10 w-full flex items-stretch justify-center space-x-[2px] overflow-hidden">
                      {prod.barcode.split('').map((char, i) => {
                        const digit = parseInt(char, 10) || 1;
                        const widthClass = digit % 3 === 0 ? 'w-1 bg-black' : digit % 2 === 0 ? 'w-0.5 bg-black' : 'w-1.5 bg-black';
                        return (
                          <React.Fragment key={i}>
                            <span className={widthClass}></span>
                            <span className="w-0.5 bg-transparent"></span>
                          </React.Fragment>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-black tracking-widest text-slate-800 mt-1">
                      {prod.barcode}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                </div>

                {/* Footer Tag */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                  <span>Standard Box Sticker</span>
                  <span>SRP: {formatPeso(prod.unit_price)}</span>
                </div>

              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/ProductAutoSuggest.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Building2, 
  Sparkles, 
  RefreshCw, 
  ArrowRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import { purchaseOrdersApi } from '../services/purchaseOrdersApi';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';

function mapSuggestionProduct(item, defaultSource, isCatalog) {
  const rawBrand = item.brandName || item.brand_name || item.brand || item.raw_data?.brandName || '';
  const pcsMatch = String(rawBrand).match(/\[Pcs\/Cs:(\d+)\]/);
  const rawPcs = item.pieces_per_case ?? item.piecesPerCase ?? (pcsMatch ? parseInt(pcsMatch[1], 10) : null);
  const numPcs = Number(rawPcs);
  const parsedPcs = Number.isFinite(numPcs) && numPcs > 0 ? numPcs : null;
  const barcodeStr = String(item.barcode || item.raw_data?.ean_code || '').trim();
  const rawCode = String(item.code || item.sku || '').trim();
  const rawSku = (rawCode && rawCode !== barcodeStr) ? rawCode : '';
  const netPrice = Number(item.price ?? item.unit_price ?? 0);
  const vatRaw = item.priceWithVat ?? item.price_with_vat ?? item.raw_data?.priceWithVat;
  const priceWithVat = Number(vatRaw || (netPrice > 0 ? netPrice * 1.12 : 0));
  const rawSup = String(item.supplierName || item.supplier_name || item.supplier || item.raw_data?.supplierName || '').trim();
  const cleanSup = rawSup.toLowerCase() === 'pending assignment' ? '' : rawSup;
  const cleanUnit = String(item.unitName || item.unit_name || item.raw_data?.unitName || 'pc').trim() || 'pc';

  return {
    id: item.id || rawSku || barcodeStr,
    name: item.name || '',
    code: rawSku,
    sku: rawSku,
    barcode: barcodeStr,
    supplierName: cleanSup,
    supplier_name: cleanSup,
    price: Number(netPrice.toFixed(2)),
    priceWithVat: priceWithVat.toFixed(2),
    price_with_vat: priceWithVat.toFixed(2),
    unitName: cleanUnit,
    unit_name: cleanUnit,
    pieces_per_case: parsedPcs,
    piecesPerCase: parsedPcs,
    imageUrl: item.imageUrl || item.image_url || '',
    brandName: String(rawBrand).replace(/\s*\[Pcs\/Cs:\d+\]/g, '').trim(),
    source: isCatalog ? defaultSource : (item.source || defaultSource),
    isCatalog
  };
}

/**
 * Product & SKU Real-Time Auto-Suggest Input
 * 
 * - Supports searching by Product Name OR SKU / Item Code
 * - Queries Enterprise Erply DB (5,793+ SKUs) & Supabase Saved Products
 * - Auto-populates all details on selection WITHOUT re-opening dropdown on other fields
 * - Strictly no fake/auto-generated images or data
 */
export default function ProductAutoSuggest({
  mode = 'name', // 'name' | 'code'
  value = '',
  onChange,
  onSelectProduct,
  placeholder,
  className = '',
  id,
  name,
  required = false,
  error = null,
  disabled = false
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [highlightedIndex, setHighlightedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const [localCatalog, setLocalCatalog] = useState([]);
  const [lastSelected, setLastSelected] = useState(null);

  const wrapperRef = useRef(null);
  const debounceTimerRef = useRef(null);
  const isFocusedRef = useRef(false);
  const userTypedRef = useRef(false);

  // Pre-fetch local catalog once for instant offline/zero-latency matching
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const loadCatalog = async () => {
      try {
        const fetchFn = catalogService.getSavedProducts || catalogService.getProducts;
        if (typeof fetchFn === 'function') {
          const products = await fetchFn.call(catalogService);
          if (isMounted && Array.isArray(products)) {
            setLocalCatalog(products);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[ProductAutoSuggest] Catalog prefetch notice:', err?.message || err);
      }
    };
    loadCatalog();
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Close dropdown on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
        userTypedRef.current = false;
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, []);

  // Perform search ONLY when value changes due to explicit user typing in THIS field
  useEffect(() => {
    // If change was not initiated by user typing in this specific input, never open or search
    if (!userTypedRef.current) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const query = String(value || '').trim();

    // If query is short or matches the exact item that was just selected, don't re-trigger popover
    if (query.length < 2) {
      setSuggestions([]);
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    if (lastSelected && (
      (mode === 'name' && query.toLowerCase() === (lastSelected.name || '').toLowerCase()) ||
      (mode === 'code' && query.toLowerCase() === (lastSelected.code || lastSelected.sku || '').toLowerCase())
    )) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
    }

    debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const cleanLower = query.toLowerCase();

      try {
        // 1. Search local saved products
        const localMatches = localCatalog
          .filter(p => {
            const pName = String(p.name || '').toLowerCase();
            const pCode = String(p.code || p.sku || '').toLowerCase();
            const pBarcode = String(p.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
            return pName.includes(cleanLower) || pCode.includes(cleanLower) || pBarcode.includes(cleanLower);
          })
          .map(p => mapSuggestionProduct(p, 'Master Catalog', true));

        // 2. Query live database API (via unified catalogService serverless proxy & purchaseOrdersApi)
        let apiMatches = [];
        try {
          const remoteResults = await catalogService.searchAllProducts(query, 30);
          if (Array.isArray(remoteResults) && remoteResults.length > 0) {
            apiMatches = remoteResults.map(item => mapSuggestionProduct(item, 'Catalog API', false));
          } else {
            const fallbackResults = await purchaseOrdersApi.searchProducts(query, 30);
            if (Array.isArray(fallbackResults)) {
              apiMatches = fallbackResults.map(item => mapSuggestionProduct(item, 'Erply Catalog', false));
            }
          }
        } catch (apiErr) {
          console.warn('[ProductAutoSuggest] API query notice:', apiErr.message);
        }

        // 3. Deduplicate by code / barcode / name (local catalog takes priority)
        const combined = [...localMatches];
        const seenKeys = new Set(
          localMatches.map(m => `${(m.code || m.barcode || '').toLowerCase()}-${(m.name || '').toLowerCase()}`)
        );

        for (const item of apiMatches) {
          const key = `${(item.code || item.barcode || '').toLowerCase()}-${(item.name || '').toLowerCase()}`;
          if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
            seenKeys.add(key);
            combined.push(item);
          }
        }

        // Open dropdown if user typed in this field
        if (userTypedRef.current) {
          setSuggestions(combined.slice(0, 20));
          setIsOpen(combined.length > 0);
          setHighlightedIndex(-1);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[ProductAutoSuggest] Search error:', err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }, 220);

    return () => {
      if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [value, mode, localCatalog, lastSelected]);

  const handleSelect = (product) => {
    userTypedRef.current = false;
    isFocusedRef.current = false;
    setLastSelected(product);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSuggestions([]);
    setHighlightedIndex(-1);

    if (onSelectProduct) {
      onSelectProduct(product);
    } else if (onChange) {
      const cleanSku = (product.code && product.code !== product.barcode) 
        ? product.code 
        : ((product.sku && product.sku !== product.barcode) ? product.sku : '');
      onChange(mode === 'code' ? cleanSku : product.name);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (!isOpen || suggestions.length === 0) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && suggestions.length > 0) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev < suggestions.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : suggestions.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && suggestions[highlightedIndex]) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(suggestions[highlightedIndex]);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsOpen(false);
      userTypedRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      <div className="relative flex items-center">
        <input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="text"
          autoComplete="off"
          disabled={disabled}
          required={required}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => {
            userTypedRef.current = true;
            onChange(e.target.value);
            setLastSelected(null);
          }}
          onFocus={() => {
            isFocusedRef.current = true;
            if (suggestions.length > 0 && userTypedRef.current) {
              setIsOpen(true);
            }
          }}
          onBlur={() => {
            isFocusedRef.current = false;
            // Delay closing to allow taps or clicks on dropdown items
            setTimeout(() => {
              setIsOpen(false);
              userTypedRef.current = false;
            }, 350);
          }}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder || (mode === 'code' ? 'e.g. P124124141' : 'e.g. Oishi Popcorn Chocolate 60g')}
          className={`${className} ${isLoading ? 'pr-8' : ''}`}
        />

        {isLoading && (
          <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 pointer-events-none">
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 mt-1">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Floating Suggestions Dropdown */}
      {isOpen && suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-hidden max-h-72 overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
          {/* Header pill strip */}
          <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 backdrop-blur-xs z-10 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span>Select to Auto-Populate Product Details</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[9px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold">
              {suggestions.length} match{suggestions.length > 1 ? 'es' : ''}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* List items */}
          <div className="p-1 space-y-0.5">
            {suggestions.map((item, idx) => {
              const isHighlighted = idx === highlightedIndex;

              return (
                <button
                  key={`${item.code}-${idx}`}
                  type="button"
                  onMouseDown={(e) => {
                    // Prevent blur from closing dropdown before click registers
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSelect(item);
                  }}
                  onTouchEnd={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSelect(item);
                  }}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(item)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHighlightedIndex(idx)}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-start justify-between gap-3 ${
                    isHighlighted
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/70 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 shadow-xs'
                      : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60 border border-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
                    {/* Item Name */}
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                      {item.name}
                    </div>

                    {/* Metadata tags: SKU, Supplier, Unit */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
                      {item.code && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                          SKU: {item.code}
                        </span>
                      )}

                      {item.supplierName && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                          <Building2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 opacity-70" />
                          <span>{item.supplierName}</span>
                        </span>
                      )}

                      {item.unitName && (
                        <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          • {item.unitName}
                        </span>
                      )}

                      <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[9px] font-extrabold ${
                        item.isCatalog 
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800'
                      }`}>
                        {item.source}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Price & Selection Pill */}
                  <div className="text-right shrink-0 space-y-0.5">
                    {item.priceWithVat && Number(item.priceWithVat) > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs">
                          ₱{Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          Base: ₱{Number(item.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono italic">
                        No Price
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                      <span>Select</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
