              <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-50 to-orange-50/70 dark:from-amber-950/40 dark:to-slate-900 border-2 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-2xl space-y-3 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                      <span>Current 4-Choice Outcome &amp; Pickup Status</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-black border inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs ${outcome.badgeColor}`}>
                        <span>{outcome.label}</span>
                      </span>
                      {outcome.choiceKey === 'scrap' && (
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black border ${
                          getItemNeedsReorder(report)
                            ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700'
                            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
                        }`}>
                          {getItemNeedsReorder(report) ? 'Re-Order: YES' : 'Re-Order: NO'}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {outcome.claimNumber && (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 font-mono text-[10px] font-black">
                          Claim: {outcome.claimNumber}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {pickupInfo && (pickupInfo.driver_name || pickupInfo.truck_plate || pickupInfo.supplier_email_to) && (
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60 text-[11px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                    {pickupInfo.supplier_name && (
                      <div><span className="text-slate-400">Supplier:</span> <strong>{pickupInfo.supplier_name}</strong></div>
                    )}
                    {pickupInfo.driver_name && (
                      <div><span className="text-slate-400">Driver:</span> <strong>{pickupInfo.driver_name}</strong> {pickupInfo.truck_plate ? `(${pickupInfo.truck_plate})` : ''}</div>
                    )}
                    {pickupInfo.supplier_email_to && (
                      <div className="sm:col-span-2 truncate"><span className="text-slate-400">To:</span> <span className="font-mono">{pickupInfo.supplier_email_to}</span></div>
                    )}
                    {pickupInfo.supplier_email_cc && (
                      <div className="sm:col-span-2 truncate"><span className="text-slate-400">CC:</span> <span className="font-mono">{pickupInfo.supplier_email_cc}</span></div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {onOpenSimpleSupplierWizard && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onOpenSimpleSupplierWizard(report)}
                      className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Open 4-Choice / Pickup Window</span>
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {outcome.formType && onOpenSupplierPickupForm && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onOpenSupplierPickupForm(report)}
                      className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <FileCheck2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>📄 {outcome.formType === 'replacement' ? 'Replacement Form' : 'Debit Claim Form'}</span>
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {(() => {
                    const defaultCfg = notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig();
                    const wfInfo = getCleanHumanWorkflowStatus(report, savedProductsList, {
                      customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: defaultCfg.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled,
                      testStepIntervalSeconds: defaultCfg.testStepIntervalSeconds
                    });
                    const wf = wfInfo.workflow;
                    return (
                      <>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setIsFollowUpModalOpen(true)}
                          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:hover:bg-amber-900 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{!wf.party.hasValidSupplier ? '+ Set Supplier & Email' : 'Edit Supplier & Email'}</span>
                        </button>
                        {!wf.isClosed && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={isFollowUpBusy}
                            onClick={async () => {
                              setIsFollowUpBusy(true);
                              setFollowUpFeedback(null);
                              try {
                                const updated = await catalogService.closeFollowUpCase(report, {
                                  markPickedUp: true,
                                  reason: 'Picked Up — Case Closed',
                                  actorName: verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name || 'Admin'
                                });
                                setReport(updated);
                                onReportUpdated?.(updated);
                                onRefresh?.();
                                setFollowUpFeedback({ type: 'success', text: 'Case closed & 10-day countdown stopped.' });
                              } catch (e) {
                                setFollowUpFeedback({ type: 'error', text: e?.message || 'Failed closing case.' });
                              } finally {
                                setIsFollowUpBusy(false);
                              }
                            }}
                            className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white text-xs font-black cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            <span>✓ Case Close</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </>
                    );
                  })()}
                </div>

                {followUpFeedback && (
                  <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold ${
                    followUpFeedback.type === 'success'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
                      : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'
                  }`}>
                    {followUpFeedback.text}
                  </div>
                )}

                <FollowUpTimelineCard
                  report={report}
                  catalogProducts={savedProductsList}
                  compact={true}
                  onResetTimeline={null}
                  isResettingTimeline={isFollowUpBusy}
                />
              </div>

              {/* (b2) Independent Reorder Status (Replacement PO) Controls */}
              {(() => {
                const reorderInfo = resolveReorderStatus(report);
                return (
                  <div
                    data-testid="quick-rma-reorder-card"
                    className="p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl space-y-3 shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          <span>Reorder Status (Replacement PO)</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                          Tracked independently from 4-Choice Claim Outcome &amp; 10-Day Pickup SLA.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <span
                        data-testid="quick-rma-reorder-badge"
                        className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-black border inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs ${reorderInfo.badgeColor}`}
                      >
                        <span>{reorderInfo.isReordered ? '✓ Reordered' : 'Reorder: Pending'}</span>
                        {reorderInfo.poNumber && <span className="font-mono">({reorderInfo.poNumber})</span>}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {reorderInfo.isReordered && (reorderInfo.formattedTime || reorderInfo.reorderedBy) && (
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        {reorderInfo.formattedTime && (
                          <span>Reordered: <strong className="font-mono">{reorderInfo.formattedTime}</strong></span>
                        )}
                        {reorderInfo.reorderedBy && (
                          <span>by <strong>{reorderInfo.reorderedBy}</strong></span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">
                          PO # (Optional)
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={reorderPoInput}
                          onChange={(e) => setReorderPoInput(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="e.g. PO-2026-8812"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">
                          Reorder Notes (Optional)
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={reorderNotesInput}
                          onChange={(e) => setReorderNotesInput(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Supplier replacement PO notes..."
                          className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {!reorderInfo.isReordered ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={isReorderBusy}
                          onClick={() => handleUpdateReorderStatus('reordered')}
                          className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                          <span>{isReorderBusy ? 'Saving...' : 'Mark Reordered'}</span>
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={isReorderBusy}
                            onClick={() => handleUpdateReorderStatus('reordered')}
                            className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            <span>{isReorderBusy ? 'Saving...' : 'Update PO / Notes'}</span>
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={isReorderBusy}
                            onClick={() => handleUpdateReorderStatus('pending')}
                            className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Reset Reorder to Pending
                          </button>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {reorderFeedback && (
                      <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold ${
                        reorderFeedback.type === 'success'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
                          : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'
                      }`}>
                        {reorderFeedback.text}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })()}

              {/* (c) Split Qty Feature Intact */}
              {(() => {
                const isChild = isSplitChildTicket(report);
                const splitChildTicket = recentReportsList.find(
                  r => isSplitChildTicket(r) && (
                    r.parent_rma_id === report?.id ||
                    String(r.parent_rma_id) === String(report?.id) ||
                    (report?.rma_number && r.rma_number?.startsWith(report.rma_number + '-'))
                  )
                );
                const parentTicket = isChild
                  ? recentReportsList.find(r => (
                      (report?.parent_rma_id && (r.id === report.parent_rma_id || String(r.id) === String(report.parent_rma_id))) ||
                      (report?.rma_number && r.rma_number === report.rma_number.replace(/-[B-Z]$/i, ''))
                    ))
                  : null;

                const canSplit = Number(report?.quantity) > 1 && !isMultiItemManifest;
                if (!canSplit && !splitChildTicket && !(isChild && parentTicket) && !splitSuccessMessage) {
                  return null;
                }

                return (
                  <div className="p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300">
                          <Scissors className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <h5 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Split Quantity</h5>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            Split partial units into separate tickets (e.g. partial restock &amp; partial scrap/claim).
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {canSplit && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={!isSkuAssigned}
                          onClick={() => setIsSplitting(prev => !prev)}
                          className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors ${
                            !isSkuAssigned
                              ? 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-60'
                              : isSplitting
                                ? 'bg-blue-700 text-white cursor-pointer'
                                : 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-100 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 cursor-pointer'
                          }`}
                          title={!isSkuAssigned ? 'Assign an official catalog SKU first before splitting.' : 'Split quantity into two tickets'}
                        >
                          <Scissors className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{isSplitting ? 'Close Split' : `Split Qty (${report.quantity})`}</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {splitChildTicket && !isChild && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/70 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-extrabold text-blue-950 dark:text-blue-200">Partially Split Return (Part 1 of 2)</span>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                            This ticket holds <strong>{report.quantity} {report.unit_name || 'pc'}</strong>. Part 2 (<strong>{splitChildTicket.quantity} {splitChildTicket.unit_name || 'pc'}</strong>) is tracked under <strong>{splitChildTicket.rma_number}</strong>.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setReport(splitChildTicket)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <span>Open Part 2 ({splitChildTicket.rma_number})</span>
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {isChild && parentTicket && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/70 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-extrabold text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200">Split Child Ticket (Part 2 of 2)</span>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
                            Holds <strong>{report.quantity} {report.unit_name || 'pc'}</strong> split from <strong>{parentTicket.rma_number}</strong>.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setReport(parentTicket)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <span>Open Parent ({parentTicket.rma_number})</span>
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {splitSuccessMessage && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/70 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{splitSuccessMessage}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {isSplitting && canSplit && (
                      <div className="p-3.5 bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border-2 border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-2xl space-y-3.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/80 pb-2 flex-wrap gap-2">
                          <div className="text-xs font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-blue-100">
                            Total to split: <strong>{totalSplitQty} {report.unit_name || 'pcs'}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={handleSwapSplit}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200 text-xs font-extrabold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Swap Quantities</span>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setIsSplitting(false)}
                              className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Cancel
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                          {/* PART 1 */}
                          <div className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 rounded-xl space-y-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                                Part 1 ({report.rma_number})
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                {splitPart1Qty !== '' ? splitPart1Qty : 0} {report.unit_name || 'pcs'}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => stepSplitPart1(-1)}
                                disabled={Number(splitPart1Qty) <= 1}
                                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 font-bold flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <Minus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                min="1"
                                max={maxSplitVal}
                                value={splitPart1Qty}
                                onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                                onChange={(e) => handleSplitPart1Change(e.target.value)}
                                onBlur={handleSplitPart1Blur}
                                className="flex-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-black text-center"
                              />
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => stepSplitPart1(1)}
                                disabled={Number(splitPart1Qty) >= maxSplitVal}
                                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 font-bold flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <label className="text-[9.5px] font-extrabold uppercase text-slate-500 block mb-0.5">4-Choice Outcome</label>
                              <select
                                value={splitPart1Choice}
                                onChange={(e) => setSplitPart1Choice(e.target.value)}
                                className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"
                              >
                                <option value="restock_good">Put Back on Good Shelf (Restock)</option>
                                <option value="scrap">Throw Away / Dispose (Scrap)</option>
                                <option value={isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_credit' : 'customer_credit'}>
                                  {isSupplierStream ? 'Return to supplier for Debit Claim' : 'Accepted for Debit / Credit'}
                                </option>
                                <option value={isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_exchange' : 'customer_exchange'}>
                                  {isSupplierStream ? 'Return to supplier for Replacement' : 'Replaced with Good Stock'}
                                </option>
                                <option value="pending">Pending Decision</option>
                              </select>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* PART 2 */}
                          <div className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 rounded-xl space-y-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                                Part 2 ({report.rma_number}-B)
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                                {derivedPart2Qty} {report.unit_name || 'pcs'}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => stepSplitPart2(-1)}
                                disabled={derivedPart2Qty <= 1}
                                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-slate-800 font-bold flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <Minus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                min="1"
                                max={maxSplitVal}
                                value={derivedPart2Qty}
                                onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                                onChange={(e) => handleSplitPart2Change(e.target.value)}
                                className="flex-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-black text-center"
                              />
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => stepSplitPart2(1)}
                                disabled={derivedPart2Qty >= maxSplitVal}
                                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-slate-800 font-bold flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <label className="text-[9.5px] font-extrabold uppercase text-slate-500 block mb-0.5">4-Choice Outcome</label>
                              <select
                                value={splitPart2Choice}
                                onChange={(e) => setSplitPart2Choice(e.target.value)}
                                className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"
                              >
                                <option value="scrap">Throw Away / Dispose (Scrap)</option>
                                <option value="restock_good">Put Back on Good Shelf (Restock)</option>
                                <option value={isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_credit' : 'customer_credit'}>
                                  {isSupplierStream ? 'Return to supplier for Debit Claim' : 'Accepted for Debit / Credit'}
                                </option>
                                <option value={isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_exchange' : 'customer_exchange'}>
                                  {isSupplierStream ? 'Return to supplier for Replacement' : 'Replaced with Good Stock'}
                                </option>
                                <option value="pending">Pending Decision</option>
                              </select>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <label className="text-[9.5px] font-extrabold uppercase text-slate-500 block mb-0.5">Reason for Part 2</label>
                              <input
                                type="text"
                                value={splitPart2Reason}
                                onChange={(e) => setSplitPart2Reason(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="e.g. Damaged packaging"
                                className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold"
                              />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/80">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setIsSplitting(false)}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Cancel
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={handleExecuteSplit}
                            disabled={isExecutingSplit}
                            className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            {isExecutingSplit ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Scissors className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                            <span>{isExecutingSplit ? 'Splitting Ticket...' : 'Confirm & Execute Split'}</span>
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })()}

              {/* (f) Customer Credit Memo section (Customer Hub only) */}
              {!isSupplierStream && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl ${existingMemo ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-400'}`}>
                        <Receipt className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <h5 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {existingMemo ? `Customer Credit Memo: ${existingMemo.credit_memo_number}` : 'Customer Credit Memo'}
                        </h5>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          {existingMemo
                            ? `₱${Number(existingMemo.credit_amount || existingMemo.amount || 0).toFixed(2)} credited by ${existingMemo.credit_issued_by || 'Finance'}`
                            : `Total Claim: ₱${totalClaimValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} (${isMultiItemManifest ? formatManifestBreakdown(manifestItems.length > 0 ? manifestItems : (Array.isArray(report?.items) ? report.items : []), false) : `${itemQty} ${report?.unit_name || 'pc'}`})`}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 ${
                      existingMemo
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300'
                        : isHighValueClaim
                          ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300'
                    }`}>
                      {existingMemo ? 'Issued' : isHighValueClaim ? 'High-Value Claim' : 'Standard Claim'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {isHighValueClaim && !existingMemo && (
                    <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs flex items-start gap-2.5 ${
                      isSuperAdmin
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
                        : 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200'
                    }`}>
                      {isSuperAdmin ? (
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      ) : (
                        <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                      <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="font-black">
                          {isSuperAdmin
                            ? '👑 Super Admin Approved (> ₱10,000 Claim)'
                            : '🔒 Financial Safety Lock (Claim > ₱10,000)'}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] opacity-90">
                          {isSuperAdmin
                            ? `Authorized by ${verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name} (Super Admin). Credit Memo issuance enabled.`
                            : `Total claim is ₱${totalClaimValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}, exceeding the ₱10,000 threshold. Only a Super Admin can issue this credit memo.`}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {isMultiItemManifest ? (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200">
                      <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="font-semibold text-[11px]">
                        ℹ️ Multi-Item Manifest: Finance Credit Memos are issued individually per line item in the Customer Hub drawer table.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ) : !existingMemo ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={!canIssueCreditMemo}
                      title={!canIssueCreditMemo ? 'Locked: Super Admin Approval Required' : undefined}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (canIssueCreditMemo && onOpenCreditMemo && report) {
                          onOpenCreditMemo(report);
                        }
                      }}
                      className={`w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm transition-all ${
                        canIssueCreditMemo
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white cursor-pointer'
                          : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed opacity-70'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {canIssueCreditMemo ? (
                        <>
                          <Receipt className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>+ Issue Credit Memo</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                          <span>Locked: Super Admin Approval Required</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onViewCreditMemoVoucher && onViewCreditMemoVoucher(existingMemo)}
                        className="py-2 px-3 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>CM Voucher</span>
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenCreditMemo && onOpenCreditMemo(report, existingMemo)}
                        className="py-2 px-3 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Edit CM</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* (g) RMA Audit Trail */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <RMATimelineAudit report={report} creditMemosList={creditMemosList} />
              </div>

              {/* (h) Collapsed Advanced / Danger Zone (Workflow Reset isolated from routine actions) */}
              {isAdminOrSuper && (
                <div className="border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsOverviewDangerOpen((v) => !v)}
                    aria-expanded={isOverviewDangerOpen}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-900 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                      <span>Advanced / Danger Zone</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">
                      <span>Workflow Reset</span>
                      {isOverviewDangerOpen ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  {isOverviewDangerOpen && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div className="space-y-0.5 text-xs min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Reset 4-Step Workflow &amp; 10-Day Countdown</div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Clears disposition &amp; pickup logs back to Pending while preserving supplier name and emails.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isFollowUpBusy}
                        onClick={async () => {
                          if (!report) return;
                          if (
                            typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
                            !window.confirm(`Reset the full 4-step workflow timeline, 10-calendar-day countdown, and disposition outcome for ${report.rma_number} back to Pending?`)
                          ) {
                            return;
                          }
                          setIsFollowUpBusy(true);
                          setFollowUpFeedback(null);
                          try {
                            const updated = await catalogService.resetReportToPending(
                              report.id,
                              report.rma_number,
                              verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name || 'Admin'
                            );
                            setReport(updated);
                            onReportUpdated?.(updated);
                            onRefresh?.(updated);
                            setFollowUpFeedback({
                              type: 'success',
                              text: `Timeline, 10-day countdown & disposition outcome reset to Pending for ${report.rma_number}.`
                            });
                          } catch (e) {
                            setFollowUpFeedback({
                              type: 'error',
                              text: e?.message || 'Failed resetting timeline to Pending.'
                            });
                          } finally {
                            setIsFollowUpBusy(false);
                          }
                        }}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 shrink-0"
                        title="Reset full 4-step workflow timeline, 10-day countdown & disposition outcome back to Pending"
                      >
                        <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isFollowUpBusy ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                        <span>{isFollowUpBusy ? 'Resetting...' : 'Reset Timeline'}</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="shrink-0 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-4 sm:px-6 py-3 pb-safe border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
          <span className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] truncate pr-2">
            {report?.rma_number || rmaNumber || 'RMA Portal'}
          </span>
          {report && isEditingAiDetails ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsEditingAiDetails(false)}
                className="touch-target px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isSavingAiDetails}
                onClick={handleSaveAiDetails}
                className="touch-target px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl font-black shadow-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                {isSavingAiDetails && <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />}
                <span>{isSavingAiDetails ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="touch-target px-5 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Done / Close
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <SupplierFollowUpModal
        isOpen={isFollowUpModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsFollowUpModalOpen(false)}
        report={report}
        catalogProducts={savedProductsList}
        isTestMode={Boolean(report && isTestRecord(report))}
        currentUser={verifiedAdmin || currentUser}
        onUpdated={(saved) => {
          if (saved) setReport(saved);
          onReportUpdated?.(saved);
          onRefresh?.();
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import {
  X, Printer, QrCode, ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle,
  Download, Lock, Move, RotateCcw, ArrowRight, Maximize2, Layers, CopyCheck,
  Plus, Search
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  PAPER_PRESETS,
  QR_SIZE_PRESETS,
  normalizeRmaQrCardData,
  packQrCardsIntoPages,
  autoFitGridCardSize,
  downloadCustomSizedStickerPng,
  downloadConsolidatedQrPagesPng
} from '../utils/customStickerCanvas';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';
import {
  buildPortalQrPayload,
  formatSaveFileTimestamp,
  getReportManifestItems,
  resolveBatchManifestForQr,
  sumManifestQuantity,
  isRealSupplierName,
  isMixedSuppliersSummary,
  isTestRecord,
  isTrashedRecord
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

const clampNum = (val, min, max, fallback) => {
  const n = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));
};

export default function ReturnQRModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  report,
  reports = [],
  availableReports = [],
  lookupReports = [],
  sessionReports = [],
  onOpenQuickAction
}) {
  // Base initial entries passed into the modal (used for reset signature ONLY, excluding picker additions).
  // Deduplicates by RMA key while preferring richer parent/manifest objects over unpacked child shells.
  const baseEntries = useMemo(() => {
    const rawList = Array.isArray(reports) && reports.length > 0
      ? reports
      : report
        ? [report]
        : [];
    const indexByUpperKey = new Map();
    const deduped = [];
    rawList.forEach((item, idx) => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
      const key = String(item.rma_number || item.rmaNumber || item.id || `row-${idx}`).trim();
      const upperKey = key.toUpperCase();
      if (!key) return;
      if (!indexByUpperKey.has(upperKey)) {
        indexByUpperKey.set(upperKey, deduped.length);
        deduped.push({ key, report: item });
        return;
      }
      const existingIdx = indexByUpperKey.get(upperKey);
      const prevRep = deduped[existingIdx].report;
      const prevScore = (prevRep?.is_parent ? 10 : 0) + (Array.isArray(prevRep?.items) ? prevRep.items.length : 0);
      const nextScore = (item?.is_parent ? 10 : 0) + (Array.isArray(item?.items) ? item.items.length : 0);
      if (nextScore > prevScore) {
        deduped[existingIdx] = {
          key: deduped[existingIdx].key,
          report: {
            ...item,
            ...(Array.isArray(prevRep?.manifest_items) && !item.manifest_items ? { manifest_items: prevRep.manifest_items } : {})
          }
        };
      }
    });
    return deduped;
  }, [reports, report]);

  const batchSignature = useMemo(
    () => baseEntries.map((entry) => entry.key).join('|'),
    [baseEntries]
  );

  // ALL state hooks strictly declared BEFORE any conditional return (prevents React Error #310)
  const [removedKeys, setRemovedKeys] = useState(() => new Set());
  const [extraReports, setExtraReports] = useState([]);
  const [hydratedPoolRows, setHydratedPoolRows] = useState([]);
  const [isAddPickerOpen, setIsAddPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [addSearchQuery, setAddSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [paperPresetId, setPaperPresetId] = useState('letter');
  const [customPaperMm, setCustomPaperMm] = useState({ widthMm: 215.9, heightMm: 279.4 });
  const [orientation, setOrientation] = useState('portrait');
  const [marginMm, setMarginMm] = useState(8);
  const [layoutMode, setLayoutMode] = useState('one_page');
  const [qrSplitMode, setQrSplitMode] = useState('consolidated'); // 'consolidated' | 'per_item'
  const [sizesByKey, setSizesByKey] = useState({});
  const [activeKey, setActiveKey] = useState(null);

  const [downloadingType, setDownloadingType] = useState(null);
  const [downloadNotice, setDownloadNotice] = useState(null);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState(false);
  const [canvasContainerWidth, setCanvasContainerWidth] = useState(() => (
    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.min(820, window.innerWidth - 40) : 720
  ));

  const dragStateRef = useRef(null);
  const canvasAreaRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;
    const measure = () => {
      const el = canvasAreaRef.current;
      if (el && el.clientWidth > 0) {
        setCanvasContainerWidth(el.clientWidth);
      } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        setCanvasContainerWidth(Math.min(820, window.innerWidth - 40));
      }
    };
    measure();
    let ro = null;
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && canvasAreaRef.current) {
      ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
      ro.observe(canvasAreaRef.current);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', measure);
    return () => {
      ro?.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Reset per-batch ephemeral state when opening or switching batch selection
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setRemovedKeys(new Set());
    setExtraReports([]);
    setHydratedPoolRows([]);
    setIsAddPickerOpen(false);
    setAddSearchQuery('');
    setSizesByKey({});
    setActiveKey(baseEntries[0]?.key || null);
    setDownloadNotice(null);
    setLayoutMode('one_page');
    setQrSplitMode('consolidated');
  }, [isOpen, batchSignature]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const modalIsTestScope = useMemo(
    () => (baseEntries[0]?.report ? isTestRecord(baseEntries[0].report) : false),
    [baseEntries]
  );

  const inputReports = useMemo(() => {
    const merged = [...baseEntries];
    const seen = new Set(baseEntries.map((e) => e.key.toUpperCase()));
    extraReports.forEach((item, idx) => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
      if (isTrashedRecord(item)) return;
      if (Boolean(isTestRecord(item)) !== Boolean(modalIsTestScope)) return;
      const key = String(item.rma_number || item.rmaNumber || item.id || `extra-${idx}`).trim();
      if (!key || seen.has(key.toUpperCase())) return;
      seen.add(key.toUpperCase());
      merged.push({ key, report: item });
    });
    return merged;
  }, [baseEntries, extraReports, modalIsTestScope]);

  const visibleEntries = useMemo(
    () => inputReports.filter((entry) => !removedKeys.has(entry.key)),
    [inputReports, removedKeys]
  );

  const visibleRmaKeysSet = useMemo(
    () => new Set(visibleEntries.map((e) => e.key.toUpperCase())),
    [visibleEntries]
  );

  const scopedSessionMissing = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(sessionReports) ? sessionReports : [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return list.filter((r) => {
      if (!r || isTrashedRecord(r)) return false;
      if (Boolean(isTestRecord(r)) !== Boolean(modalIsTestScope)) return false;
      const key = String(r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || r.id || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!key || visibleRmaKeysSet.has(key) || seen.has(key)) return false;
      seen.add(key);
      return true;
    });
  }, [sessionReports, modalIsTestScope, visibleRmaKeysSet]);

  const addableCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    const pool = [...(Array.isArray(sessionReports) ? sessionReports : []), ...(Array.isArray(availableReports) ? availableReports : [])];
    const seen = new Set();
    const q = addSearchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const out = [];
    for (const r of pool) {
      if (!r || isTrashedRecord(r)) continue;
      if (Boolean(isTestRecord(r)) !== Boolean(modalIsTestScope)) continue;
      const key = String(r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || r.id || '').trim();
      const upperKey = key.toUpperCase();
      if (!key || visibleRmaKeysSet.has(upperKey) || seen.has(upperKey)) continue;
      seen.add(upperKey);
      if (q) {
        const hay = `${key} ${r.name || r.productName || ''} ${r.code || r.sku || ''} ${r.barcode || ''} ${r.store_branch || ''} ${r.supplier_name || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) continue;
      }
      out.push(r);
      if (out.length >= 25) break;
    }
    return out;
  }, [sessionReports, availableReports, modalIsTestScope, visibleRmaKeysSet, addSearchQuery]);

  const manifestLookupPool = useMemo(() => {
    const merged = [
      ...(Array.isArray(sessionReports) ? sessionReports : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(lookupReports) ? lookupReports : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(availableReports) ? availableReports : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(hydratedPoolRows) ? hydratedPoolRows : [])
    ];
    const seen = new Set();
    return merged.filter((r) => {
      if (!r || typeof r !== 'object') return false;
      const k = r.id != null
        ? `id:${String(r.id)}`
        : `row:${String(r.rma_number || '').toUpperCase()}::${String(r.barcode || '').toUpperCase()}::${r.is_parent ? 'P' : 'C'}`;
      if (seen.has(k)) return false;
      seen.add(k);
      return true;
    });
  }, [sessionReports, lookupReports, availableReports, hydratedPoolRows]);

  // Hydrate missing parent/child/rma_items manifests when an Admin selects unpacked or child-only rows
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || inputReports.length === 0) return;
    let isMounted = true;
    const neededRmas = [];

    inputReports.forEach((entry) => {
      const rep = entry.report;
      const resolved = resolveBatchManifestForQr(rep, manifestLookupPool);
      if (resolved.items.length > 1) return;
      const looksLikeBatch = Boolean(
        rep?.is_parent ||
        rep?.is_unpacked_manifest_item ||
        rep?.parent_rma_id != null ||
        Number(rep?.total_items || rep?.totalItems || rep?.manifest_total_lines || 0) > 1 ||
        String(rep?.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest')
      );
      if (looksLikeBatch && rep?.rma_number) {
        neededRmas.push(String(rep.rma_number).trim());
      }
    });

    const uniqueRmas = Array.from(new Set(neededRmas)).filter(Boolean);
    if (uniqueRmas.length === 0) return;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const [{ data: rmaRows }, { data: riRows }] = await Promise.all([
          supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*').in('rma_number', uniqueRmas),
          supabase.from('rma_items').select('*').in('rma_number', uniqueRmas).order('id', { ascending: true })
        ]);
        if (!isMounted) return;
        const additions = [];
        if (Array.isArray(rmaRows)) {
          additions.push(...rmaRows.filter((r) => Boolean(isTestRecord(r)) === Boolean(modalIsTestScope) && !isTrashedRecord(r)));
        }
        if (Array.isArray(riRows) && riRows.length > 0) {
          uniqueRmas.forEach((rmaNum) => {
            const matchedItems = riRows.filter((ri) => String(ri.rma_number || '').toUpperCase() === rmaNum.toUpperCase());
            if (matchedItems.length > 1) {
              additions.push({
                rma_number: rmaNum,
                is_parent: true,
                is_test: modalIsTestScope,
                items: matchedItems,
                total_items: matchedItems.length
              });
            }
          });
        }
        if (additions.length > 0) {
          setHydratedPoolRows(additions);
        }
      } catch {}
    })();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [isOpen, batchSignature, inputReports.length, modalIsTestScope]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const resolvedEntriesByKey = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    visibleEntries.forEach((entry) => {
      const rep = entry.report;
      const resolved = resolveBatchManifestForQr(rep, manifestLookupPool);
      const effectiveItems = resolved.items.length > 1
        ? resolved.items
        : (Array.isArray(rep?.items) && rep.items.length > 1 ? rep.items : null);
      const canonicalParent = resolved.parentReport && resolved.items.length > 1
        ? resolved.parentReport
        : rep;
      map.set(entry.key, { canonicalParent, effectiveItems });
    });
    return map;
  }, [visibleEntries, manifestLookupPool]);

  const hasMultiItemRma = useMemo(() => {
    return visibleEntries.some((entry) => {
      const rep = entry.report;
      const res = resolvedEntriesByKey.get(entry.key);
      return Boolean(
        (res?.effectiveItems && res.effectiveItems.length > 1) ||
        Number(rep?.total_items || rep?.totalItems || rep?.manifest_total_lines || 0) > 1
      );
    });
  }, [visibleEntries, resolvedEntriesByKey]);

  const expandedEntries = useMemo(() => {
    const out = [];
    visibleEntries.forEach((entry) => {
      const rep = entry.report;
      const res = resolvedEntriesByKey.get(entry.key);
      const canonicalRep = res?.canonicalParent || rep;
      const effectiveItems = res?.effectiveItems || null;

      if (qrSplitMode === 'per_item' && effectiveItems && effectiveItems.length > 1) {
        effectiveItems.forEach((it, itemIdx) => {
          const itemKey = `${entry.key}__item-${itemIdx + 1}`;
          if (removedKeys.has(itemKey)) return;
          const itemBarcode = String(it?.barcode || canonicalRep.barcode || '').trim();
          const itemSku = String(it?.code || it?.sku || '').trim();
          const itemName = String(it?.name || it?.productName || it?.product_name || canonicalRep.name || 'Returned Merchandise').trim();
          const itemQty = Math.max(1, Number(it?.quantity ?? it?.qty) || 1);
          const itemUnit = String(it?.unit_name || it?.unit || canonicalRep.unit_name || 'pc').trim() || 'pc';
          const itemSupplierCandidate = it?.supplier_name || it?.supplierName || it?.supplier || '';
          const itemSupplier = isRealSupplierName(itemSupplierCandidate)
            ? String(itemSupplierCandidate).trim()
            : (!isMixedSuppliersSummary(canonicalRep.supplier_name) ? (canonicalRep.supplier_name || '') : '');
          out.push({
            key: itemKey,
            parentKey: entry.key,
            itemIndex: itemIdx + 1,
            totalLines: effectiveItems.length,
            isPerItemSplit: true,
            report: {
              ...canonicalRep,
              items: [{ ...it }],
              total_items: 1,
              totalItems: 1,
              name: itemName,
              productName: itemName,
              barcode: itemBarcode || canonicalRep.barcode,
              code: itemSku,
              sku: itemSku,
              quantity: itemQty,
              total_quantity: itemQty,
              unit_name: itemUnit,
              unit: itemUnit,
              supplier_name: itemSupplier || canonicalRep.supplier_name,
              pieces_per_case: Number(it?.pieces_per_case ?? it?.piecesPerCase ?? canonicalRep.pieces_per_case) || 1,
              expiry_date: it?.expiry_date || canonicalRep.expiry_date || '',
              reason: it?.reason || canonicalRep.reason || '',
              explanation: it?.explanation || canonicalRep.explanation || '',
              _manifestLineIndex: itemIdx + 1,
              _manifestTotalLines: effectiveItems.length
            }
          });
        });
      } else {
        const consolidatedReport = effectiveItems && effectiveItems.length > 1
          ? {
              ...canonicalRep,
              is_parent: true,
              items: effectiveItems,
              total_items: effectiveItems.length,
              total_quantity: sumManifestQuantity(effectiveItems, canonicalRep.total_quantity || canonicalRep.quantity)
            }
          : canonicalRep;
        out.push({
          key: entry.key,
          parentKey: entry.key,
          itemIndex: null,
          totalLines: null,
          isPerItemSplit: false,
          report: consolidatedReport
        });
      }
    });
    return out;
  }, [visibleEntries, resolvedEntriesByKey, qrSplitMode, removedKeys]);

  // Default card size: Medium 90x105mm for single QR, balanced 62x74mm for multi-select consolidated or per-item QRs
  const defaultCardSize = useMemo(
    () => (expandedEntries.length <= 1 ? { widthMm: 90, heightMm: 105 } : { widthMm: 62, heightMm: 74 }),
    [expandedEntries.length]
  );

  // Compute physical page dimensions based on Paper Preset + Orientation + Margins
  const effectivePaper = useMemo(() => {
    const preset = PAPER_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === paperPresetId) || PAPER_PRESETS[0];
    const baseW = paperPresetId === 'custom'
      ? clampNum(customPaperMm.widthMm, 50, 450, 215.9)
      : preset.widthMm;
    const baseH = paperPresetId === 'custom'
      ? clampNum(customPaperMm.heightMm, 50, 500, 279.4)
      : preset.heightMm;

    const widthMm = orientation === 'landscape' ? baseH : baseW;
    const heightMm = orientation === 'landscape' ? baseW : baseH;
    const safeMargin = clampNum(marginMm, 2, 30, 8);
    const printableW = Math.max(25, Number((widthMm - safeMargin * 2).toFixed(1)));
    const printableH = Math.max(25, Number((heightMm - safeMargin * 2).toFixed(1)));

    return {
      presetId: preset.id,
      label: preset.label,
      slug: preset.id.replace(/_/g, '-'),
      widthMm: Number(widthMm.toFixed(1)),
      heightMm: Number(heightMm.toFixed(1)),
      marginMm: safeMargin,
      printableW,
      printableH
    };
  }, [paperPresetId, customPaperMm, orientation, marginMm]);

  // Screen preview scale so any paper sheet fits neatly inside the modal without horizontal cropping
  const previewPxPerMm = useMemo(() => {
    const usableW = Math.max(240, Math.min(640, (canvasContainerWidth || 640) - 28));
    return Math.min(3.35, Math.max(0.85, usableW / Math.max(effectivePaper.widthMm, 1)));
  }, [effectivePaper.widthMm, canvasContainerWidth]);

  // Build normalized cards list with stable SVG DOM IDs and per-card mm dimensions
  const cards = useMemo(() => {
    return expandedEntries.map((entry, idx) => {
      const cardData = normalizeRmaQrCardData(entry.report);
      const custom = sizesByKey[entry.key] || defaultCardSize;
      const safeSvgSlug = entry.key.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
      return {
        key: entry.key,
        parentKey: entry.parentKey,
        itemIndex: entry.itemIndex,
        totalLines: entry.totalLines,
        isPerItemSplit: Boolean(entry.isPerItemSplit),
        index: idx,
        report: entry.report,
        cardData,
        qrPayload: buildPortalQrPayload(cardData.rmaNumber, cardData.isTest),
        svgId: `rma-qr-code-svg-${safeSvgSlug}`,
        widthMm: clampNum(custom.widthMm, 34, 220, defaultCardSize.widthMm),
        heightMm: clampNum(custom.heightMm, 40, 280, defaultCardSize.heightMm)
      };
    });
  }, [expandedEntries, sizesByKey, defaultCardSize]);

  const activeCard = useMemo(
    () => cards.find((c) => c.key === activeKey) || cards[0] || null,
    [cards, activeKey]
  );

  // Shelf-pack cards onto 1 or multiple physical sheets
  const packedLayout = useMemo(() => {
    return packQrCardsIntoPages({
      cards,
      printableW: effectivePaper.printableW,
      printableH: effectivePaper.printableH,
      gapMm: 4,
      layoutMode,
      centerSingleCard: cards.length === 1
    });
  }, [cards, effectivePaper.printableW, effectivePaper.printableH, layoutMode]);

  // Pointer drag resizing for individual cards
  useEffect(() => {
    const handlePointerMove = (e) => {
      const drag = dragStateRef.current;
      if (!drag) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const pxScale = drag.pxPerMm || 3.0;
      const dxMm = (e.clientX - drag.startX) / pxScale;
      const dyMm = (e.clientY - drag.startY) / pxScale;

      const nextW = drag.axis === 'y'
        ? drag.startW
        : Math.round(clampNum(drag.startW + dxMm, 34, 220, drag.startW));
      const nextH = drag.axis === 'x'
        ? drag.startH
        : Math.round(clampNum(drag.startH + dyMm, 40, 280, drag.startH));

      setSizesByKey((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [drag.key]: { widthMm: nextW, heightMm: nextH }
      }));
    };

    const handlePointerUp = () => {
      if (dragStateRef.current) {
        dragStateRef.current = null;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);
    };
  }, []);

  const startDrag = useCallback((cardKey, axis, startW, startH, pxPerMm, e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
    setActiveKey(cardKey);
    dragStateRef.current = {
      key: cardKey,
      axis,
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      startW,
      startH,
      pxPerMm
    };
  }, []);

  // Safe conditional return AFTER all hooks
  if (!isOpen || cards.length === 0) return null;

  const isMulti = cards.length > 1;
  const activeWidthMm = activeCard?.widthMm || defaultCardSize.widthMm;
  const activeHeightMm = activeCard?.heightMm || defaultCardSize.heightMm;

  const updateActiveCardSize = (nextW, nextH) => {
    if (!activeCard) return;
    setSizesByKey((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [activeCard.key]: {
        widthMm: clampNum(nextW, 34, 220, activeCard.widthMm),
        heightMm: clampNum(nextH, 40, 280, activeCard.heightMm)
      }
    }));
  };

  const applyPresetToActive = (preset) => {
    updateActiveCardSize(preset.widthMm, preset.heightMm);
  };

  const handleApplyActiveSizeToAll = () => {
    const next = {};
    cards.forEach((c) => {
      next[c.key] = { widthMm: activeWidthMm, heightMm: activeHeightMm };
    });
    setSizesByKey(next);
    setDownloadNotice({
      type: 'success',
      msg: `Applied ${activeWidthMm}×${activeHeightMm}mm to all ${cards.length} QR cards.`
    });
    setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleResetAllSizes = () => {
    setSizesByKey({});
    setDownloadNotice({ type: 'success', msg: `Reset QR sizes to default (${defaultCardSize.widthMm}×${defaultCardSize.heightMm}mm).` });
    setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleAutoFitOnePage = () => {
    const fit = autoFitGridCardSize(
      cards.length,
      effectivePaper.printableW,
      effectivePaper.printableH,
      4,
      1.18
    );
    const next = {};
    cards.forEach((c) => {
      next[c.key] = { widthMm: fit.widthMm, heightMm: fit.heightMm };
    });
    setSizesByKey(next);
    setLayoutMode('one_page');
    setDownloadNotice({
      type: 'success',
      msg: `Auto-fit all ${cards.length} QRs to 1 ${effectivePaper.label} page (${fit.widthMm}×${fit.heightMm}mm each).`
    });
    setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleRemoveCard = (key) => {
    if (cards.length <= 1) return;
    setRemovedKeys((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.add(key);
      return next;
    });
    if (activeKey === key) {
      const remaining = cards.find((c) => c.key !== key);
      if (remaining) setActiveKey(remaining.key);
    }
  };

  const handleAddReportToSheet = (rep) => {
    if (!rep || typeof rep !== 'object') return;
    const key = String(rep.rma_number || rep.rmaNumber || rep.id || '').trim();
    if (!key) return;
    setRemovedKeys((prev) => {
      if (!prev.has(key)) return prev;
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.delete(key);
      return next;
    });
    setExtraReports((prev) => {
      if (prev.some((x) => String(x?.rma_number || x?.rmaNumber || x?.id || '').trim().toUpperCase() === key.toUpperCase())) {
        return prev;
      }
      return [...prev, rep];
    });
    setActiveKey(key);
    setDownloadNotice({
      type: 'success',
      msg: `Added ${key} onto your consolidated QR print sheet.`
    });
    setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleAddSessionQrs = () => {
    if (scopedSessionMissing.length === 0) return;
    setRemovedKeys((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      scopedSessionMissing.forEach((r) => {
        const k = String(r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || r.id || '').trim();
        if (k) next.delete(k);
      });
      return next;
    });
    setExtraReports((prev) => {
      const seen = new Set(prev.map((x) => String(x?.rma_number || x?.rmaNumber || x?.id || '').trim().toUpperCase()));
      const additions = scopedSessionMissing.filter((r) => {
        const k = String(r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || r.id || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        return k && !seen.has(k);
      });
      return [...prev, ...additions];
    });
    setDownloadNotice({
      type: 'success',
      msg: `Added ${scopedSessionMissing.length} session QR${scopedSessionMissing.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} onto consolidated sheet.`
    });
    setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleSaveQrPng = async () => {
    setDownloadingType('qr');
    setDownloadNotice(null);
    try {
      if (!isMulti && cards.length === 1) {
        const single = cards[0];
        const savedName = await downloadCustomSizedStickerPng({
          ...single.cardData,
          svgElementOrId: single.svgId,
          widthMm: single.widthMm,
          heightMm: single.heightMm,
          filename: `${single.cardData.rmaNumber}-QR ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}.png`
        });
        setDownloadNotice({ type: 'success', msg: `Saved ${savedName}` });
      } else {
        const savedFiles = await downloadConsolidatedQrPagesPng({
          pages: packedLayout.pages,
          paperWidthMm: effectivePaper.widthMm,
          paperHeightMm: effectivePaper.heightMm,
          marginMm: effectivePaper.marginMm,
          paperSlug: effectivePaper.slug,
          totalQrCount: cards.length
        });
        setDownloadNotice({
          type: 'success',
          msg: `Saved ${savedFiles.length} consolidated sheet PNG(s): ${savedFiles[0]}${savedFiles.length > 1 ? ` (+${savedFiles.length - 1} more)` : ''}`
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to export QR PNG:', err);
      setDownloadNotice({ type: 'error', msg: 'Could not generate QR PNG.' });
    } finally {
      setDownloadingType(null);
      setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 4500);
    }
  };

  const handleChangeSplitMode = (nextMode) => {
    const normalized = nextMode === 'per_item' ? 'per_item' : 'consolidated';
    if (normalized === qrSplitMode) return;
    setQrSplitMode(normalized);
    setSizesByKey({});
    setRemovedKeys((prev) => {
      const next = new Set();
      prev.forEach((k) => {
        if (!String(k).includes('__item-')) next.add(k);
      });
      return next;
    });
    setDownloadNotice(null);
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      const rootEl = document.getElementById('rma-qr-batch-sheet-root');
      if (!rootEl) {
        setDownloadNotice({ type: 'error', msg: 'QR print canvas not ready.' });
        return;
      }

      const pageSizeCss = `${effectivePaper.widthMm}mm ${effectivePaper.heightMm}mm`;
      const baseTitle = isMulti
        ? `${cards.length}-RMA-QRs-${effectivePaper.slug}`
        : `RMA-QR-${cards[0].cardData.rmaNumber}-${cards[0].widthMm}x${cards[0].heightMm}mm`;
      const docTitle = `${baseTitle} ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}`;

      printIsolatedElement({
        elementId: 'rma-qr-batch-sheet-root',
        documentTitle: docTitle,
        pageSize: pageSizeCss,
        pageMargin: '0',
        allowMultiPage: layoutMode === 'multi_page' || packedLayout.pages.length > 1,
        customStyles: `
          :root, #rma-qr-batch-sheet-root {
            --u: 1mm !important;
          }
          .no-print-qr {
            display: none !important;
          }
          .rma-print-page {
            position: relative !important;
            width: ${effectivePaper.widthMm}mm !important;
            height: ${Math.max(10, Number((effectivePaper.heightMm - 0.5).toFixed(2)))}mm !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
          .rma-print-page:not(:last-child) {
            page-break-after: always !important;
            break-after: page !important;
          }
          .rma-print-page:last-child {
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
          }
          .rma-qr-card, .rma-qr-card * {
            color: #000000 !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
          }
          .rma-qr-card {
            outline: none !important;
            ring: 0 !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
        `
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Print QR failed:', err);
      setDownloadNotice({ type: 'error', msg: 'Could not open print dialog.' });
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setIsPrinting(false), 600);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:static print:bg-white print:p-0">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[96dvh] sm:max-h-[96vh] print:max-h-none print:border-0 print:shadow-none">

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="shrink-0 bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 py-3 sm:px-5 sm:py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 print:hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-600/20 border border-blue-500/40 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <QrCode className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                <span>
                  {isMulti ? `Consolidated QR Print Studio (${cards.length} QRs)` : 'Print RMA QR Code'}
                </span>
                {cards.some((c) => c.cardData.isTest) && (
                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-violet-500/30 border border-violet-400 text-violet-200 text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
                    TEST SANDBOX
                  </span>
                )}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 leading-snug">
                {isMulti
                  ? `${packedLayout.pages.length} ${effectivePaper.label} Page${packedLayout.pages.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} (${effectivePaper.widthMm}×${effectivePaper.heightMm}mm) • Drag any QR corner to resize`
                  : `${cards[0].cardData.rmaNumber} • Unified B&W QR Card on ${effectivePaper.label}`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            {!isMulti && onOpenQuickAction && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onOpenQuickAction(cards[0].report)}
