                className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                title="Open Admin Quick Processing Actions"
              >
                <span>Process Item</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Close modal"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Private Portal Scan Security Notice */}
        <div className="shrink-0 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border-b border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/60 px-4 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 print:hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold min-w-0">
            <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Private Portal QR: Standard cameras/Google Lens cannot open links — scan inside RMA Admin Scanner.</span>
          </div>
          <span className="font-mono font-black shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">B&amp;W Ink-Saver</span>
        </div>

        {/* Single Unified Scrollable Body (Toolbar + Paper Preview Canvas — prevents nested double scrollbars on mobile) */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden flex flex-col print:overflow-visible">
        {/* Dynamic Paper Size, Page Packing & Per-QR Resize Toolbar */}
        <div className="shrink-0 px-3 sm:px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2 print:hidden">

          {/* Row 1: Dynamic Paper Size + Orientation + Margins + Sheet Layout */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              <span>Paper:</span>
              <select
                aria-label="Paper Size"
                value={paperPresetId}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const nextId = e.target.value;
                  setPaperPresetId(nextId);
                  const found = PAPER_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === nextId);
                  if (found && nextId !== 'custom') {
                    setCustomPaperMm({ widthMm: found.widthMm, heightMm: found.heightMm });
                  }
                }}
                className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                {PAPER_PRESETS.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.label} ({p.sub})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            {paperPresetId === 'custom' && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono">
                <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">Page W</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="Custom Paper Width mm"
                  min={50}
                  max={450}
                  step="0.5"
                  value={customPaperMm.widthMm}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomPaperMm((prev) => ({ ...prev, widthMm: e.target.value }))}
                  className="w-14 text-center font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="text-slate-400">× H</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="Custom Paper Height mm"
                  min={50}
                  max={500}
                  step="0.5"
                  value={customPaperMm.heightMm}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomPaperMm((prev) => ({ ...prev, heightMm: e.target.value }))}
                  className="w-14 text-center font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="text-slate-400">mm</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Portrait / Landscape */}
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold">
              {['portrait', 'landscape'].map((dir) => (
                <button
                  key={dir}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOrientation(dir)}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md capitalize transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    orientation === dir
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-blue-600'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  {dir}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Adjustable Page Margin */}
            <label className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono">
              <span className="font-sans font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Margin:</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                aria-label="Page Margin mm"
                min={2}
                max={30}
                value={marginMm}
                onChange={(e) => setMarginMm(clampNum(e.target.value, 2, 30, 8))}
                className="w-9 text-center font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="text-slate-400">mm</span>
            </label>

            {/* Multi-Item Batch RMA QR Mode Toggle: Consolidated vs Single / Per-Item */}
            {hasMultiItemRma && (
              <div
                role="group"
                aria-label="Multi-Item QR Split Mode"
                className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:inline-flex items-stretch sm:items-center rounded-lg border border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold shadow-2xs w-full sm:w-auto gap-0.5 sm:gap-0"
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleChangeSplitMode('consolidated')}
                  aria-pressed={qrSplitMode === 'consolidated'}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 sm:py-0.5 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer text-center sm:whitespace-nowrap ${
                    qrSplitMode === 'consolidated'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                      : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                  title="Print or download 1 consolidated QR card per RMA ticket"
                >
                  📦 Consolidated (1 QR per RMA)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleChangeSplitMode('per_item')}
                  aria-pressed={qrSplitMode === 'per_item'}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 sm:py-0.5 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer text-center sm:whitespace-nowrap ${
                    qrSplitMode === 'per_item'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                      : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                  title="Expand multi-item RMAs into 1 separate QR card per individual line item"
                >
                  🏷️ Single / Per-Item QRs (1 QR per Item)
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Sheet Packing Mode (1 Page Consolidated vs Multiple Pages Multi-Up) */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:inline-flex items-center rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold w-full sm:w-auto">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLayoutMode('one_page')}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 sm:py-0.5 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  layoutMode === 'one_page'
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                    : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                }`}
              >
                <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">1 Page (Consolidated)</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLayoutMode('multi_page')}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 sm:py-0.5 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  layoutMode === 'multi_page'
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                    : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                }`}
              >
                <Layers className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">Multiple Pages ({packedLayout.pages.length})</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {isMulti && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAutoFitOnePage}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-[11px] font-black shadow-2xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Automatically resize all selected QR cards proportionally to fit cleanly onto 1 page"
              >
                ⚡ Auto-Fit All to 1 Page
              </button>
            )}

            {(availableReports.length > 0 || sessionReports.length > 0) && (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddPickerOpen((v) => !v)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer border ${
                    isAddPickerOpen
                      ? 'bg-indigo-700 text-white border-indigo-700'
                      : 'bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/70 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200 border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-700'
                  }`}
                  title="Append additional RMA QRs to print or download on the same consolidated sheet"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                  <span>Add More RMA QRs to Sheet</span>
                </button>

                {scopedSessionMissing.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleAddSessionQrs}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-[11px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Add all other QRs submitted in this session onto this print sheet"
                  >
                    <QrCode className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Add Recent Session QRs (+{scopedSessionMissing.length})</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Searchable Multi-QR Picker Dropdown Panel */}
          {isAddPickerOpen && (
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 space-y-2 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={addSearchQuery}
                    onChange={(e) => setAddSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={`Search ${modalIsTestScope ? 'Test Sandbox' : 'Live'} RMAs by RMA #, item, SKU, barcode, store or supplier...`}
                    className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddPickerOpen(false)}
                  className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                {addableCandidates.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="py-2 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">
                    No additional {modalIsTestScope ? 'Test Mode' : 'Live'} RMAs available matching filter.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  addableCandidates.map((cand) => {
                    const rmaNo = cand.rma_number || cand.rmaNumber || cand.id;
                    const itemName = cand.name || cand.productName || cand.barcode || 'Returned Merchandise';
                    const qty = cand.total_quantity ?? cand.quantity ?? 1;
                    const unit = cand.unit_name || cand.unit || 'pc';
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={rmaNo}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleAddReportToSheet(cand)}
                        className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-left hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer rounded"
                      >
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-mono font-black text-[11px] text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 shrink-0">
                            {rmaNo}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate">
                            {itemName}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 text-[10px]">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                            {qty} {unit}
                          </span>
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-600 text-white font-black">
                            + Add
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Row 2: Active QR Card Sizing Presets & Manual W × H mm Inputs */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700/80">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mr-0.5">
                {isMulti && activeCard ? `Selected (${activeCard.cardData.rmaNumber}):` : 'QR Card Size:'}
              </span>
              {QR_SIZE_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
                const isSelected = activeWidthMm === preset.widthMm && activeHeightMm === preset.heightMm;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={preset.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => applyPresetToActive(preset)}
                    className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 shadow-xs'
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 hover:border-blue-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {preset.label} <span className="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75">({preset.widthMm}×{preset.heightMm})</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono">
                <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">W</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="QR Card Width mm"
                  min={34}
                  max={220}
                  value={activeWidthMm}
                  onChange={(e) => updateActiveCardSize(e.target.value, activeHeightMm)}
                  className="w-11 text-center font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="text-slate-400">× H</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="QR Card Height mm"
                  min={40}
                  max={280}
                  value={activeHeightMm}
                  onChange={(e) => updateActiveCardSize(activeWidthMm, e.target.value)}
                  className="w-11 text-center font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="text-slate-400">mm</span>
              </div>

              {isMulti && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleApplyActiveSizeToAll}
                  className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                  title="Apply active card width & height to every QR card in this batch"
                >
                  <CopyCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Apply Active Size to All</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetAllSizes}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold"
                title="Reset sizes to default"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {isMulti && <span>Reset Sizes</span>}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Overflow Warning Banner when 1-page mode exceeds printable page bounds */}
          {layoutMode === 'one_page' && packedLayout.hasOverflow && (
            <div className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 text-[11px] font-bold flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  1-Page Overflow: {cards.length} QRs require {Math.ceil(packedLayout.neededHeightMm)}mm height (printable height is {effectivePaper.printableH}mm).
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAutoFitOnePage}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-[10px] font-black cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Auto-Fit All to 1 Page
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setLayoutMode('multi_page')}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white text-[10px] font-black cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Switch to Multiple Pages
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Live WYSIWYG Consolidated Paper Sheet(s) Canvas Area */}
        <div
          ref={canvasAreaRef}
          className="flex-1 p-3 sm:p-6 bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-slate-950/90 print:p-0 print:bg-white print:overflow-visible"
        >
          <div
            id="rma-qr-batch-sheet-root"
            style={{ '--u': `${previewPxPerMm}px` }}
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-6 print:block print:gap-0"
          >
            {packedLayout.pages.map((pageCards, pageIndex) => {
              const displayPageHeightMm = layoutMode === 'one_page' && packedLayout.hasOverflow
                ? Math.max(effectivePaper.heightMm, packedLayout.neededHeightMm + effectivePaper.marginMm * 2 + 4)
                : effectivePaper.heightMm;

              return (
                <div
                  key={`qr-page-${pageIndex}`}
                  data-page-index={pageIndex + 1}
                  style={{
                    width: `calc(${effectivePaper.widthMm} * var(--u))`,
                    height: `calc(${displayPageHeightMm} * var(--u))`
                  }}
                  className="rma-print-page relative bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-lg shrink-0 select-none print:border-0 print:shadow-none"
                >
                  {/* Screen-only page badge & printable margin frame */}
                  <div className="no-print-qr absolute top-1 left-2 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-400 pointer-events-none">
                    Page {pageIndex + 1} / {packedLayout.pages.length} • {effectivePaper.label} ({effectivePaper.widthMm}×{effectivePaper.heightMm}mm)
                  </div>

                  {/* Screen-only dashed printable margin boundary */}
                  <div
                    className="no-print-qr absolute border border-dashed border-slate-200 pointer-events-none"
                    style={{
                      left: `calc(${effectivePaper.marginMm} * var(--u))`,
                      top: `calc(${effectivePaper.marginMm} * var(--u))`,
                      width: `calc(${effectivePaper.printableW} * var(--u))`,
                      height: `calc(${effectivePaper.printableH} * var(--u))`
                    }}
                  />

                  {/* Placed Printable QR Cards on this page */}
                  {pageCards.map((placed) => {
                    const { cardData, svgId, qrPayload, wMm, hMm, xMm, yMm, key, itemIndex } = placed;
                    const isSelectedCard = isMulti && activeCard?.key === key;
                    // Smooth proportional scaling relative to 90x105mm baseline
                    const s = Math.min(wMm / 90, hMm / 105);
                    const qrMm = Math.max(18, Math.min(wMm * 0.56, hMm * 0.36));

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={key}
                        data-rma-qr-card={cardData.rmaNumber}
                        data-rma-qr-key={key}
                        {...(itemIndex ? { 'data-rma-qr-item-index': String(itemIndex) } : {})}
                        onClick={() => isMulti && setActiveKey(key)}
                        style={{
                          left: `calc(${effectivePaper.marginMm + xMm} * var(--u))`,
                          top: `calc(${effectivePaper.marginMm + yMm} * var(--u))`,
                          width: `calc(${wMm} * var(--u))`,
                          height: `calc(${hMm} * var(--u))`,
                          padding: `calc(${Math.max(2, 3 * s)} * var(--u))`,
                          borderWidth: `calc(${Math.max(0.4, 0.55 * s)} * var(--u))`
                        }}
                        className={`rma-qr-card absolute bg-white text-black border border-black flex flex-col justify-between box-border overflow-hidden transition-shadow ${
                          isSelectedCard ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-1' : ''
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Screen-only Remove Item button when multiple QRs are open */}
                        {isMulti && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleRemoveCard(key);
                            }}
                            title={`Remove ${cardData.rmaNumber} from print sheet`}
                            aria-label={`Remove ${cardData.rmaNumber}`}
                            className="no-print-qr absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 z-10 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow cursor-pointer print:hidden"
                          >
                            <X className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {/* 1. Unified Pure B&W Header Strip */}
                        <div
                          className="w-full border-b border-black flex items-center justify-between gap-1 shrink-0"
                          style={{ paddingBottom: `calc(${Math.max(1, 1.5 * s)} * var(--u))` }}
                        >
                          <span
                            className="font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-black truncate"
                            style={{ fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.8, 2.5 * s)} * var(--u))`, lineHeight: 1.1 }}
                          >
                            {cardData.headerTitle}
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className="font-mono font-bold text-black shrink-0 pr-3 sm:pr-0"
                            style={{ fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.6, 2.1 * s)} * var(--u))`, lineHeight: 1.1 }}
                          >
                            {Math.round(wMm)}×{Math.round(hMm)}mm
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {/* 2. Centered Body: Private Portal QR + RMA # + Product + Qty & Unit + Metadata */}
                        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center min-h-0 py-0.5">
                          {/* High-Contrast Private Portal QR */}
                          <div
                            className="bg-white border border-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
                            style={{
                              width: `calc(${qrMm} * var(--u))`,
                              height: `calc(${qrMm} * var(--u))`,
                              padding: `calc(${Math.max(1, 1.5 * s)} * var(--u))`
                            }}
                          >
                            <QRCodeSVG
                              id={svgId}
                              value={qrPayload || cardData.rmaNumber}
                              size={256}
                              level="H"
                              includeMargin={false}
                              bgColor="#ffffff"
                              fgColor="#000000"
                              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block' }}
                            />
                          </div>

                          <div
                            className="font-mono font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-black shrink-0"
                            style={{
                              fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.4, 1.8 * s)} * var(--u))`,
                              marginTop: `calc(${0.8 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              lineHeight: 1.05
                            }}
                          >
                            PORTAL SCAN ONLY
                          </div>

                          {/* Bold RMA Number */}
                          <div
                            className="font-mono font-black text-black tracking-tight w-full truncate shrink-0"
                            style={{
                              fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(2.6, 4.1 * s)} * var(--u))`,
                              marginTop: `calc(${0.8 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              lineHeight: 1.1
                            }}
                          >
                            {cardData.rmaNumber}
                          </div>

                          {/* Product Name or Batch Manifest */}
                          <div
                            className="font-extrabold text-black w-full line-clamp-2 shrink-0"
                            style={{
                              fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.9, 2.6 * s)} * var(--u))`,
                              marginTop: `calc(${0.6 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              lineHeight: 1.15
                            }}
                          >
                            {cardData.displayTitle}
                          </div>

                          {/* Quantity & Unit Badge (Always prominently visible) */}
                          <div
                            className="w-full border border-black font-black text-black shrink-0 truncate"
                            style={{
                              fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.85, 2.5 * s)} * var(--u))`,
                              marginTop: `calc(${1 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              padding: `calc(${0.6 * s} * var(--u)) calc(${1.2 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              lineHeight: 1.15
                            }}
                          >
                            Qty: {cardData.qtyFormatted}
                          </div>

                          {/* Structured Meta: Barcode/SKU, Optional Expiry (Supplier Name omitted by design) */}
                          <div
                            className="w-full font-mono font-bold text-black space-y-0.5 shrink-0"
                            style={{
                              fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.5, 2.0 * s)} * var(--u))`,
                              marginTop: `calc(${0.8 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              lineHeight: 1.15
                            }}
                          >
                            {!cardData.isManifest && (
                              <div className="truncate">
                                BC: {cardData.barcode}{cardData.sku ? ` • SKU: ${cardData.sku}` : ''}
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {cardData.expiryYmd && (
                              <div className="truncate">Exp (YYYY-MM-DD): {cardData.expiryYmd}</div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* 3. Pinned Footer: Reporter & Contact + Date/Time + Reporter Signature */}
                        <div className="w-full shrink-0 border-t border-black pt-0.5 space-y-0.5">
                          <div
                            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 text-black font-semibold truncate"
                            style={{ fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.45, 1.95 * s)} * var(--u))`, lineHeight: 1.15 }}
                          >
                            <span className="truncate">
                              By: <strong>{cardData.reporter || 'Staff'}</strong>
                              {cardData.reporterContact && cardData.reporterContact !== 'N/A' ? ` (${cardData.reporterContact})` : ''}
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-mono shrink-0">{cardData.dateTimeFormatted}</span>
                          </div>

                          <div
                            className="border border-black bg-white flex flex-col justify-end"
                            style={{
                              padding: `calc(${0.8 * s} * var(--u)) calc(${1.2 * s} * var(--u))`,
                              minHeight: `calc(${Math.max(5.5, 7.8 * s)} * var(--u))`
                            }}
                          >
                            <div
                              className="flex items-end justify-between gap-1 text-black font-bold"
                              style={{ fontSize: `calc(${Math.max(1.35, 1.75 * s)} * var(--u))`, lineHeight: 1 }}
                            >
                              <span className="shrink-0">Reporter Signature:</span>
                              <span className="flex-1 border-b border-black mx-1" />
                              <span className="shrink-0">Date: _____</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Screen-only Right, Bottom & Corner Drag Resize Handles */}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onPointerDown={(e) => startDrag(key, 'x', wMm, hMm, previewPxPerMm, e)}
                          title={`Drag horizontally to resize ${cardData.rmaNumber} width`}
                          aria-label={`Resize ${cardData.rmaNumber} width`}
                          className="no-print-qr absolute top-2 bottom-4 right-0 w-2 cursor-ew-resize print:hidden opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 bg-amber-500/60 transition-opacity"
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onPointerDown={(e) => startDrag(key, 'y', wMm, hMm, previewPxPerMm, e)}
                          title={`Drag vertically to resize ${cardData.rmaNumber} height`}
                          aria-label={`Resize ${cardData.rmaNumber} height`}
                          className="no-print-qr absolute left-2 right-4 bottom-0 h-2 cursor-ns-resize print:hidden opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 bg-amber-500/60 transition-opacity"
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onPointerDown={(e) => startDrag(key, 'xy', wMm, hMm, previewPxPerMm, e)}
                          title={`Drag corner to resize ${cardData.rmaNumber} (${wMm}×${hMm}mm)`}
                          aria-label={`Drag corner to resize ${cardData.rmaNumber}`}
                          className="no-print-qr absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center cursor-nwse-resize print:hidden rounded-tl"
                        >
                          <Move className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status Toast */}
        {downloadNotice && (
          <div className={`shrink-0 mx-4 sm:mx-6 mt-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 ${
            downloadNotice.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700'
              : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700'
          }`}>
            {downloadNotice.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
            <span>{downloadNotice.msg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Unified Action Footer: Strictly "Save QR (PNG)" and "Print QR" / "Print N QRs" */}
        <div className="shrink-0 p-3 sm:px-6 sm:py-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 grid grid-cols-2 sm:flex sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-2 print:hidden">
          <div className="contents sm:flex sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSaveQrPng}
              disabled={downloadingType !== null}
              className="px-3 sm:px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-white text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
              title={isMulti ? 'Download consolidated multi-up QR sheet PNG(s)' : `Download ${cards[0].cardData.rmaNumber}-QR.png`}
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{downloadingType === 'qr' ? 'Generating...' : 'Save QR (PNG)'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isPrinting}
              className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-1 order-first sm:order-none px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-black shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
              title={`Print on ${effectivePaper.label} (${effectivePaper.widthMm}×${effectivePaper.heightMm}mm)`}
            >
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">
                {isPrinting
                  ? 'Printing...'
                  : isMulti
                    ? `Print ${cards.length} QRs (${packedLayout.pages.length} ${effectivePaper.label} Page${packedLayout.pages.length > 1 ? 's' : ''})`
                    : `Print QR (${activeWidthMm}×${activeHeightMm}mm • ${effectivePaper.label})`}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-3 sm:px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>Done</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/ReturnQRModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/RmaEmailEditorView.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  FileEdit,
  Lock,
  Clock,
  Sun,
  Moon,
  Save,
  RefreshCw,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  ShieldCheck,
  Search,
  Package,
  FileText,
  FlaskConical,
  Mail
} from 'lucide-react';
import ProductAutoSuggest from './ProductAutoSuggest';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import {
  formatDateTimeYmdHm,
  formatDateYmd,
  sumManifestQuantity,
  summarizeBatchSuppliers,
  isMixedSuppliersSummary,
  isRealSupplierName
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

async function resolveBearerToken() {
  try {
    const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    if (session?.access_token) return session.access_token;
  } catch {}
  try {
    const cached = sessionStorage.getItem('rma_oauth_access_token');
    if (cached) return cached;
  } catch {}
  return '';
}

export default function RmaEmailEditorView({
  gateSession,
  sessionCountdown,
  allReports = [],
  catalogProducts = [],
  isDarkMode,
  onToggleTheme,
  onLockStation,
  onRefreshReports,
  onToast
}) {
  const initialRma = useMemo(() => {
    if (gateSession?.rma_number) return String(gateSession.rma_number).trim();
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      return String(p.get('editRma') || p.get('rma') || '').trim();
    }
    return '';
  }, [gateSession?.rma_number]);

  const [lookupRmaInput, setLookupRmaInput] = useState(initialRma);
  const [activeRmaNumber, setActiveRmaNumber] = useState(initialRma);
  const [isLoadingRecord, setIsLoadingRecord] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState('');
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState(null);
  const [scopeLockedRma, setScopeLockedRma] = useState(Boolean(gateSession?.rma_number));
  const [loadedReport, setLoadedReport] = useState(null);

  // Editable form fields matching QuickRMAActionModal Edit Details & Commercial Documents
  const [supplierName, setSupplierName] = useState('');
  const [productName, setProductName] = useState('');
  const [skuCode, setSkuCode] = useState('');
  const [barcode, setBarcode] = useState('');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const [unitName, setUnitName] = useState('pc');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState(0);
  const [priceWithVat, setPriceWithVat] = useState(0);
  const [expiryDate, setExpiryDate] = useState('');
  const [storeBranch, setStoreBranch] = useState('');
  const [siNumber, setSiNumber] = useState('');
  const [drNumber, setDrNumber] = useState('');
  const [poNumber, setPoNumber] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [manifestItems, setManifestItems] = useState([]);

  const knownSuppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    (catalogProducts || []).forEach((p) => {
      const s = String(p?.supplier_name || p?.supplierName || '').trim();
      if (isRealSupplierName(s)) set.add(s);
    });
    (allReports || []).forEach((r) => {
      const s = String(r?.supplier_name || '').trim();
      if (isRealSupplierName(s)) set.add(s);
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [catalogProducts, allReports]);

  const handleUpdateManifestRow = (idx, patch) => {
    setManifestItems((prev) => {
      const next = prev.map((row, i) => (i === idx ? { ...row, ...patch } : row));
      if (next.length > 0) {
        if (patch.quantity !== undefined) {
          setQuantity(sumManifestQuantity(next, 1));
        }
        if (patch.supplier_name !== undefined && next.length > 1) {
          setSupplierName((currSup) => summarizeBatchSuppliers(next, isMixedSuppliersSummary(currSup) ? '' : currSup));
        }
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const hydrateFromReport = (rep) => {
    if (!rep) return;
    setLoadedReport(rep);
    setActiveRmaNumber(rep.rma_number || '');
    setLookupRmaInput(rep.rma_number || '');
    const repSup = String(rep.supplier_name || '').trim();
    const rawItems = Array.isArray(rep.items) ? rep.items : [];
    const mappedItems = rawItems.map((it) => {
      const itemSup = it.supplier_name || it.supplierName || it.supplier || (!isMixedSuppliersSummary(repSup) ? repSup : '') || '';
      return {
        ...it,
        name: it.name || it.productName || '',
        code: it.code || it.sku || '',
        supplier_name: itemSup,
        supplierName: itemSup,
        supplier: itemSup,
        quantity: Math.max(1, Number(it.quantity ?? it.qty) || 1),
        unit_name: it.unit_name || it.unit || 'pc',
        price: Number(it.price || 0),
        price_with_vat: Number(it.price_with_vat || it.priceWithVat || 0),
        expiry_date: it.expiry_date ? String(it.expiry_date).slice(0, 10) : ''
      };
    });
    setSupplierName(mappedItems.length > 1 ? summarizeBatchSuppliers(mappedItems, isMixedSuppliersSummary(repSup) ? '' : repSup) : repSup);
    setProductName(rep.name || '');
    setSkuCode(rep.code || '');
    setBarcode(rep.barcode || '');
    setQuantity(mappedItems.length > 1 ? sumManifestQuantity(mappedItems, rep.quantity) : (Number(rep.quantity) || 1));
    setUnitName(rep.unit_name || 'pc');
    const netP = Number(rep.price || 0);
    setPrice(netP);
    const vatP = Number(rep.price_with_vat || 0);
    setPriceWithVat(vatP > 0 ? vatP : (netP > 0 ? Number((netP * 1.12).toFixed(2)) : 0));
    setExpiryDate(rep.expiry_date ? String(rep.expiry_date).slice(0, 10) : '');
    setStoreBranch(rep.store_branch || '');
    setSiNumber(rep.si_number || '');
    setDrNumber(rep.dr_number || rep.invoice_dr_number || '');
    setPoNumber(rep.po_number || '');
    setNotes(String(rep.notes || '').replace(/\[TEST_MODE\]/gi, '').trim());
    setManifestItems(mappedItems);
  };

  const fetchScopedReport = async (targetRma) => {
    const cleanRma = String(targetRma || '').trim();
    if (!cleanRma || !gateSession?.token) return;

    setIsLoadingRecord(true);
    setLoadError('');
    setSaveError('');
    setSaveSuccess(null);

    try {
      const jwt = await resolveBearerToken();
      if (!jwt) {
        throw new Error('Your Google Sign-In session is missing or expired. Please Lock & re-verify with Google.');
      }

      const qs = new URLSearchParams({
        token: gateSession.token,
        rma: cleanRma
      });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/rma-email-edit?${qs.toString()}`, {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}`
        }
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok || !data?.success || !data?.report) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || `Unable to load RMA record (${res.status}).`);
      }

      setScopeLockedRma(Boolean(data.scope_locked_rma));
      hydrateFromReport(data.report);
    } catch (err) {
      setLoadError(err.message || 'Failed to load RMA record.');
      setLoadedReport(null);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingRecord(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialRma && gateSession?.token) {
      fetchScopedReport(initialRma);
    }
  }, [initialRma, gateSession?.token]);

  const handleAutoPopulateProduct = (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    if (item.name) setProductName(item.name);
    const candidateSku = String(item.code || item.sku || '').trim();
    if (candidateSku && candidateSku !== barcode) {
      setSkuCode(candidateSku);
    }
    const sup = String(item.supplierName || item.supplier_name || item.supplier || '').trim();
    if (sup && !/^(pending assignment|unassigned|n\/a)$/i.test(sup)) {
      setSupplierName(sup);
    }
    if (item.unitName || item.unit_name) {
      setUnitName(item.unitName || item.unit_name);
    }
    const netP = Number(item.price || 0);
    const vatP = Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price_with_vat || 0);
    if (netP > 0) {
      setPrice(Number(netP.toFixed(2)));
      setPriceWithVat(vatP > 0 ? Number(vatP.toFixed(2)) : Number((netP * 1.12).toFixed(2)));
    } else if (vatP > 0) {
      setPriceWithVat(Number(vatP.toFixed(2)));
      setPrice(Number((vatP / 1.12).toFixed(2)));
    }
  };

  const handleSaveChanges = async (e) => {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    if (!activeRmaNumber || !gateSession?.token) return;

    setIsSaving(true);
    setSaveError('');
    setSaveSuccess(null);

    try {
      const jwt = await resolveBearerToken();
      if (!jwt) {
        throw new Error('Your Google Sign-In session expired. Please Lock & re-verify with Google.');
      }

      const isBatchEdit = manifestItems.length > 1;
      const computedBatchQty = isBatchEdit ? sumManifestQuantity(manifestItems, quantity) : Math.max(1, Number(quantity) || 1);
      const computedBatchSupplier = isBatchEdit
        ? summarizeBatchSuppliers(manifestItems, isMixedSuppliersSummary(supplierName) ? '' : supplierName.trim())
        : supplierName.trim();

      const res = await fetch('/api/v1/rma-email-edit', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          token: gateSession.token,
          rma_number: activeRmaNumber,
          updates: {
            supplier_name: computedBatchSupplier,
            name: productName.trim(),
            code: skuCode.trim(),
            quantity: computedBatchQty,
            total_quantity: computedBatchQty,
            unit_name: unitName.trim() || 'pc',
            price: parseFloat(price) || 0,
            price_with_vat: parseFloat(priceWithVat) || 0,
            expiry_date: expiryDate ? expiryDate.slice(0, 10) : '',
            ...(loadedReport?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? { store_branch: null } : { store_branch: storeBranch.trim() }),
            si_number: siNumber.trim(),
            dr_number: drNumber.trim(),
            po_number: poNumber.trim(),
            notes: notes.trim(),
            ...(manifestItems.length > 0 ? { items: manifestItems } : {})
          }
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok || !data?.success) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || `Failed to save changes (${res.status}).`);
      }

      if (data.report) {
        hydrateFromReport(data.report);
      }
      setSaveSuccess({
        editedBy: data.edited_by_email || gateSession.user_email || gateSession.authorized_email,
        updatedAt: data.updated_at || new Date().toISOString()
      });
      if (onToast) {
        onToast(`Saved RMA ${activeRmaNumber} updates cleanly.`, 'success');
      }
      if (onRefreshReports) {
        onRefreshReports();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setSaveError(err.message || 'Unable to save RMA updates.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const isTestEnv = Boolean(gateSession?.is_test || /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(activeRmaNumber));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Focused Editor Header Bar (Zero Admin Buttons/Tabs) */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 sm:p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div className={`p-2 rounded-2xl border shrink-0 ${
            isTestEnv
              ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/70 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
              : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/70 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400'
          }`}>
            <FileEdit className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                ✏️ RMA Details &amp; Documents Editor
              </span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black uppercase ${
                isTestEnv
                  ? 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700'
                  : 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700'
              }`}>
                {isTestEnv ? '🧪 Test Sandbox' : '🟢 Live Record'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mt-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                <Mail className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-500" />
                {gateSession?.user_email || gateSession?.authorized_email}
              </span>
              {(gateSession?.no_expiry || sessionCountdown?.isPermanent) ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono font-bold border bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>No Expiry • Revocable by Admin</span>
                </span>
              ) : sessionCountdown?.text && (
                <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono font-bold border ${
                  sessionCountdown.totalSeconds < 300
                    ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800'
                    : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800'
                }`}>
                  <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Link expires in: {sessionCountdown.text}</span>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onLockStation}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            <span>Lock Session</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleTheme}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Toggle Theme"
          >
            {isDarkMode ? <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Moon className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RMA Scope Lookup (only interactive when link is not bound to a single RMA #) */}
      {!scopeLockedRma && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-xs space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            Load Target RMA Ticket to Edit
          </label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={lookupRmaInput}
              onChange={(e) => setLookupRmaInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={isTestEnv ? 'Enter RMA-TEST-2026-...' : 'Enter RMA-2026-...'}
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!lookupRmaInput.trim() || isLoadingRecord}
              onClick={() => fetchScopedReport(lookupRmaInput)}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Load RMA</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Loading / Error / Saved Banners */}
      {isLoadingRecord && (
        <div className="p-8 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl text-center space-y-2">
          <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600 animate-spin mx-auto" />
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            Loading scoped RMA record &amp; verifying Google Identity...
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {loadError && !isLoadingRecord && (
        <div role="alert" className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div>{loadError}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {saveError && (
        <div role="alert" className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>{saveError}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {saveSuccess && (
        <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Changes saved cleanly! Updated At (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): <strong>{formatDateTimeYmdHm(saveSuccess.updatedAt)}</strong> • By <span className="font-mono">{saveSuccess.editedBy}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Standalone Edit Form */}
      {loadedReport && !isLoadingRecord && (
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveChanges} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 font-mono font-black text-xs border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
                  {loadedReport.rma_number}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold">
                  Submission Date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): {formatDateTimeYmdHm(loadedReport.created_at)}
                </span>
              </div>
              {loadedReport.ai_document_metadata?.last_email_edit?.edited_at && (
                <div className="text-[10.5px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>
                    Last Email Edit (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): {formatDateTimeYmdHm(loadedReport.ai_document_metadata.last_email_edit.edited_at)} by {loadedReport.ai_document_metadata.last_email_edit.edited_by_email}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
              Barcode: {loadedReport.barcode || '—'}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Product & Pricing Details */}
          <div className="space-y-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
              <span>Product &amp; Pricing Specifications</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">
                  Item Name / Product Description
                </label>
                <ProductAutoSuggest
                  mode="name"
                  value={productName}
                  onChange={setProductName}
                  onSelectProduct={handleAutoPopulateProduct}
                  placeholder="Type product name to search catalog..."
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">
                  Assigned SKU / Item Code
                </label>
                <ProductAutoSuggest
                  mode="code"
                  value={skuCode}
                  onChange={setSkuCode}
                  onSelectProduct={handleAutoPopulateProduct}
                  placeholder="Type SKU / code..."
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">
                  {manifestItems.length > 1 ? 'Total Quantity (Auto)' : 'Quantity'}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  readOnly={manifestItems.length > 1}
                  value={manifestItems.length > 1 ? sumManifestQuantity(manifestItems, quantity) : quantity}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    if (manifestItems.length <= 1) setQuantity(e.target.value);
                  }}
                  className={`w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-xl text-xs font-bold ${
                    manifestItems.length > 1
                      ? 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 cursor-not-allowed'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white'
                  }`}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">Unit</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={unitName}
                  onChange={(e) => setUnitName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="pc, case"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">Net Price (PHP)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  min="0"
                  value={price}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value;
                    setPrice(val);
                    const num = parseFloat(val);
                    if (Number.isFinite(num)) {
                      setPriceWithVat(Number((num * 1.12).toFixed(2)));
                    }
                  }}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">Price w/ VAT (PHP)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  min="0"
                  value={priceWithVat}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value;
                    setPriceWithVat(val);
                    const num = parseFloat(val);
                    if (Number.isFinite(num)) {
                      setPrice(Number((num / 1.12).toFixed(2)));
                    }
                  }}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Commercial Documents: SI, DR, PO */}
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
              <span>Commercial Documents &amp; Expiry</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 block mb-1">Sales Invoice (SI) #</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={siNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setSiNumber(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. SI-2026-8819"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300 block mb-1">Delivery Receipt (DR) #</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={drNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setDrNumber(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. DR-44120"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-violet-200 dark:border-violet-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 block mb-1">Purchase Order (PO) #</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={poNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setPoNumber(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. PO-99120"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className={`grid grid-cols-1 ${loadedReport?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'sm:grid-cols-2' : 'sm:grid-cols-3'} gap-3 pt-1`}>
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">Supplier Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  list="email-editor-supplier-list"
                  value={supplierName}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupplierName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Supplier / Vendor Name"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
                <datalist id="email-editor-supplier-list">
                  {knownSuppliers.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s} />
                  ))}
                </datalist>
              </div>
              {loadedReport?.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound' && (
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">Store / Customer Branch</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={storeBranch}
                    onChange={(e) => setStoreBranch(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Branch / Account Name"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">Expiry Date</label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={expiryDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpiryDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500">
                    {expiryDate ? formatDateYmd(expiryDate) : '—'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Multi-Item Manifest Line Items (if batch ticket) */}
          {manifestItems.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  Manifest Line Items ({manifestItems.length})
                </div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800">
                  Total Batch Qty: {sumManifestQuantity(manifestItems, 1)} pcs
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {manifestItems.map((it, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-8 gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                    <div className="col-span-2">
                      <label className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-400 block">Item #{idx + 1} Name</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={it.name || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleUpdateManifestRow(idx, { name: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2">
                      <label className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-400 block">Supplier Name</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        list="email-editor-supplier-list"
                        aria-label={`Item #${idx + 1} Supplier Name`}
                        value={it.supplier_name || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          handleUpdateManifestRow(idx, { supplier_name: val, supplierName: val, supplier: val });
                        }}
                        placeholder="Supplier / Vendor..."
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-400 block">SKU</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={it.code || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          handleUpdateManifestRow(idx, { code: val, sku: val });
                        }}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-400 block">Qty</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        aria-label={`Item #${idx + 1} Qty`}
                        value={it.quantity ?? 1}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const parsed = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
                          const val = Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 1 ? parsed : 1;
                          handleUpdateManifestRow(idx, { quantity: val });
                        }}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-400 block">Net Price</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="0.01"
                        value={it.price ?? 0}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const net = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                          handleUpdateManifestRow(idx, {
                            price: e.target.value,
                            ...(Number.isFinite(net) ? { price_with_vat: Number((net * 1.12).toFixed(2)) } : {})
                          });
                        }}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-slate-400 block">Expiry Date</label>
                      <input
                        type="date"
                        value={it.expiry_date || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleUpdateManifestRow(idx, { expiry_date: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Notes */}
          <div>
            <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 block mb-1">
              Operational Notes
            </label>
            <textarea
              rows={2}
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Optional notes regarding supplier, invoice correction, or delivery paperwork..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex-wrap">
            <span className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              {isTestEnv && <FlaskConical className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />}
              <span>Changes are verified server-side against your Google Identity Lock &amp; written to the audit trail.</span>
            </span>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSaving}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isSaving ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-4 h-4" />}
              <span>{isSaving ? 'Saving RMA Updates...' : 'Save RMA Changes'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
