              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              The primary destination mailbox for automated RMA alerts. In Live Mode, emails are dispatched directly to this address.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* CC Distribution List */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Carbon Copy Distribution List (CC Addresses)
              </label>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {ccRecipients.length} Recipient{ccRecipients.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* CC Chips / Badges Container */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl min-h-[58px] flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
              {ccRecipients.length === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No CC recipients configured. Add one below.</span>
              ) : (
                ccRecipients.map((email) => (
                  <span
                    key={email}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono shadow-2xs group max-w-full"
                  >
                    <span className="break-all sm:break-normal">{email}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveCcEmail(email)}
                      className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer p-0.5 rounded-md shrink-0"
                      title={`Remove ${email}`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Add new CC form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleAddCcEmail} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 w-full min-w-0">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={newCcInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCcInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter email to add to CC (e.g. manager@pingconmarketing.com)"
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 box-border"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full sm:w-auto px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 box-border"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Add CC</span>
              </button>
            </form>

            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/40 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>
                <strong>Smart Dynamic AE Addition:</strong> The Customer Account Executive (AE) assigned to the product (e.g. <code>alleli.almaida@ph.keysys.com</code>) is <strong>automatically appended</strong> to this CC list upon report dispatch.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CARD 1B: PER-EMAIL RECIPIENT MANAGER (ALL 9 SYSTEM EMAIL TYPES) */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-7 shadow-sm space-y-5 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
              <Mail className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Per-Email Recipient Manager
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
                  {EMAIL_PROFILE_TYPES.length} Email Profiles
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Customize Primary TO and CC recipients independently for each email workflow (synced to Supabase).
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {/* Live vs Test Scope Switcher for Per-Email Recipient Manager */}
            <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-0.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700" role="group" aria-label="Email Recipient Mode Scope">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRecipientScopeIsTest(false)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  !recipientScopeIsTest
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                    : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                🟢 Live Mode
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRecipientScopeIsTest(true)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  recipientScopeIsTest
                    ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow-2xs'
                    : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                🧪 Test Mode
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsDirectoryOpen(true)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              title="Open Persistent Supplier Emails Directory (Add, Edit, Search, Delete contacts)"
            >
              <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>Supplier Emails Directory</span>
            </button>

            {(activeEmailProfileType === 'daily_matrix_auto' || activeEmailProfileType === 'manual_matrix') && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSyncAutoAndManualMatrixRecipients}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Sync Recipients Between Auto &amp; Manual</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Profile Selector Pills */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {EMAIL_PROFILE_TYPES.map((t) => {
            const isActive = activeEmailProfileType === t.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={t.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveEmailProfileType(t.id)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-400'
                }`}
              >
                <span>{t.label}</span>
                <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-mono font-black uppercase ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-slate-200/70 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'
                }`}>
                  {t.badge}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {syncMatrixFeedback && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{syncMatrixFeedback}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <EmailRecipientsEditor
          emailType={activeEmailProfileType}
          isTestMode={recipientScopeIsTest}
          allowEmptyTo={activeEmailProfileType === 'invite_email' || activeEmailProfileType === 'supplier_followup'}
          extraHint={
            recipientScopeIsTest
              ? 'Test Mode profile is stored separately under test_email_recipients_by_type and falls back to Global Test Mode recipients / Sandbox email.'
              : activeEmailProfileType === 'invite_email'
                ? 'Addresses added here are included as extra CCs on generated Portal/Editor Invite emails.'
                : activeEmailProfileType === 'supplier_followup'
                  ? 'Extra internal CCs copied on automated 10-Calendar-Day pickup follow-up emails (Primary TO comes from each RMA’s Supplier Email).'
                  : activeEmailProfileType === 'pickup_debit_claim' || activeEmailProfileType === 'pickup_replacement'
                    ? 'Supplier To/CC fields entered in Driver Pickup Verification merge automatically with these base recipients.'
                    : 'Product Account Executive (AE) email is also CC’d automatically when applicable.'
          }
        />
      </div>
      </>
      )}

      {showConnectionsTab && (
      <>
      {/* CARD 2: TEST MODE SWITCH CARD */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Simulation / Test Mode Toggle</h2>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/60 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800">
                👑 Super Admin Exclusive
              </span>
              {isTestMode ? (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40">
                  ACTIVE
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                  OFF
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-xl">
              When ON, test emails are safely sent exclusively to <code className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 font-mono font-bold">{testSandboxEmail}</code> with <code className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 font-mono font-bold">[TEST] </code> at the very beginning of the subject. <strong>This setting is strictly restricted to Super Admin; all other staff roles and public intake users operate permanently in Live Mode.</strong>
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleTestMode}
            className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition-all shadow-sm ${
              isTestMode 
                ? 'bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 shadow-amber-500/20' 
                : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            {isTestMode ? (
              <>
                <ToggleRight className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-950" />
                <span>Test Mode: ON</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <ToggleLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
                <span>Test Mode: OFF</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Live email preview example */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-sans font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-1">
            Live Recipient Output with Current Configuration:
          </span>
          <div className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <strong>Target TO:</strong> <span className={isTestMode ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold'}>
              {isTestMode ? `${testGlobalRecipients?.toEmail || testSandboxEmail} (Live target "${mainRecipient}" safely bypassed)` : mainRecipient}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <strong>Target CC:</strong> <span className={isTestMode ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'}>
              {isTestMode 
                ? `${(testGlobalRecipients?.baseCcList || []).join(', ') || '[] (No Test Mode CC — Live CCs bypassed)'}` 
                : `${ccRecipients.join(', ') || 'None'} + [Customer AE email]`}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Configurable Test Mode Sandbox Email Override */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/70 space-y-2 text-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="font-bold text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
              <span>Test Mode Sandbox Email Override (Default: mgan@pingconmarketing.com)</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSaveSandboxEmail}
              disabled={isSavingSandboxEmail}
              className="px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-[11px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Save className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{isSavingSandboxEmail ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Sandbox Email'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <input
            type="email"
            aria-label="Test Mode Sandbox Email Override"
            value={sandboxEmailInput}
            onChange={(e) => setSandboxEmailInput(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="mgan@pingconmarketing.com"
            className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 font-mono font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
          />
          {sandboxEmailFeedback && (
            <div className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${sandboxEmailFeedback.type === 'success' ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300'}`}>
              {sandboxEmailFeedback.message}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Configurable Global Test Mode TO & CC Distribution (isolated key: test_email_recipients) */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50/40 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/70 space-y-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <div className="font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                <span>Test Mode Global Fallback Recipients (TO &amp; CC)</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-900/80 dark:text-amber-300/80 mt-0.5">
                Used across all Test Mode emails unless overridden in the per-email workflow profiles above (isolated from Live recipients).
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetTestGlobalFallback}
                disabled={isSavingTestGlobal}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Reset Test Fallback</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSaveTestGlobalRecipients}
                disabled={isSavingTestGlobal}
                className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-[11px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Save className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{isSavingTestGlobal ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Test Fallback'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {testGlobalFeedback && (
            <div className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold ${
              testGlobalFeedback.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200'
                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200'
            }`}>
              {testGlobalFeedback.message}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {/* Test Mode TO List */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300">
                Test Mode Global TO ({(testGlobalRecipients?.toList || []).length})
              </span>
              <div className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/70 rounded-xl flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 min-h-[36px]">
                {(testGlobalRecipients?.toList || []).map((em) => (
                  <span key={em} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/50 text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold">
                    <span>{em}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setTestGlobalRecipients((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        toList: (prev?.toList || []).filter((x) => x.toLowerCase() !== em.toLowerCase())
                      }))}
                      className="text-amber-700 hover:text-rose-600 cursor-pointer"
                      aria-label={`Remove Test TO ${em}`}
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={newTestToInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTestToInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      const clean = newTestToInput.trim().toLowerCase();
                      if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(clean)) return;
                      setTestGlobalRecipients((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        toList: Array.from(new Set([...(prev?.toList || []), clean]))
                      }));
                      setNewTestToInput('');
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Add Test Mode Global TO email..."
                  className="flex-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-[11px] font-mono"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const clean = newTestToInput.trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(clean)) return;
                    setTestGlobalRecipients((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      toList: Array.from(new Set([...(prev?.toList || []), clean]))
                    }));
                    setNewTestToInput('');
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Add Test TO
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Test Mode CC List */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300">
                Test Mode Global CC ({(testGlobalRecipients?.baseCcList || []).length})
              </span>
              <div className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/70 rounded-xl flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 min-h-[36px]">
                {(testGlobalRecipients?.baseCcList || []).length === 0 ? (
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">No Test Mode CC added.</span>
                ) : (testGlobalRecipients?.baseCcList || []).map((em) => (
                  <span key={em} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold">
                    <span>{em}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setTestGlobalRecipients((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        baseCcList: (prev?.baseCcList || []).filter((x) => x.toLowerCase() !== em.toLowerCase())
                      }))}
                      className="text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 cursor-pointer"
                      aria-label={`Remove Test CC ${em}`}
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={newTestCcInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTestCcInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      const clean = newTestCcInput.trim().toLowerCase();
                      if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(clean)) return;
                      setTestGlobalRecipients((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        baseCcList: Array.from(new Set([...(prev?.baseCcList || []), clean]))
                      }));
                      setNewTestCcInput('');
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Add Test Mode Global CC email..."
                  className="flex-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-[11px] font-mono"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const clean = newTestCcInput.trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(clean)) return;
                    setTestGlobalRecipients((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      baseCcList: Array.from(new Set([...(prev?.baseCcList || []), clean]))
                    }));
                    setNewTestCcInput('');
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Add Test CC
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Supabase Connection Status Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Supabase Backend Connection</h2>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleCheckConnection}
            disabled={connectionStatus.loading}

            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${connectionStatus.loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />

            <span>
              <strong>Daily Auto-Email Schedule:</strong> {formatTime12hFromHhmm(matrixConfig.autoSendTimePht || '13:00')} PHT (<code className="font-mono">Asia/Manila</code>) {matrixConfig.autoEnabled !== false ? '— Enabled' : '— Paused'} — Sends Overall RMA Matrix (<code className="font-mono">.xlsx</code>) using configured schedules &amp; recipients.

        {dailyMatrixStatus.done && (

            <div>
              <span className="font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">

                <span>{isSavingFollowUpConfig ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Follow-Up SLA'}</span>

                type="checkbox"

                  setFollowUpConfig((p) => ({ ...p, autoEnabled: e.target.checked }));
                }}

              />
              <span>Auto-Send Daily Follow-Ups (10-Day SLA)</span>
            </label>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                aria-label="Customer Hub Default Follow-Up Enabled"
                checked={Boolean(followUpConfig.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled)}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  followUpDirtyRef.current = true;
                  setFollowUpConfig((p) => ({ ...p, customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: e.target.checked }));
                }}
                className="rounded border-slate-300 text-amber-600 focus:ring-amber-500"
              />
              <span>Default Follow-Up ON for Customer Hub RMAs</span>
            </label>

              )}

            <div className="flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap items-center gap-2">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                <input
                  type={showPoApiKey ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  value={poApiKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setPoApiKey(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Paste EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO private key here..."
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-9 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPoApiKey(v => !v)}
                  aria-label={showPoApiKey ? 'Hide API Key' : 'Reveal API Key'}
                  title={showPoApiKey ? 'Hide API Key' : 'Reveal API Key'}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                >
                  {showPoApiKey ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSavePoKey}
                disabled={isSavingPoKey}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 shrink-0"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isSavingPoKey ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Key'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
              When assigning SKUs in Admin or Quick Process, typing into SKU or Product Name automatically suggests and auto-populates product details.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 6. MULTI-SYSTEM REST API KEYS & INTEGRATION (SHA-256 HASHED) */}
      <ApiKeysManagementSection />
      </>
      )}

      {showWarehouseLocationsView && (
      <>
      {/* Standalone Enterprise Page Header: Warehouse Locations & GPS */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm">
        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/40">
          Directory &amp; Locations
        </span>
        <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
          <MapPin className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <span>Warehouse Locations &amp; GPS Anchors</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
          Configure standard rack/bin staging locations and verified warehouse GPS geofence anchors for accurate watermark pins.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 5. WAREHOUSE LOCATIONS MANAGEMENT (CUSTOMIZABLE DROPDOWN) */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 rounded-2xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
              <MapPin className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Standard Warehouse Locations
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Customizable rack, bin, and staging areas used across triage, coworker queues, and label printing.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsLocationsModalOpen(true)}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <span>⚙️ Manage Locations</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
          {locationsList.map((loc, idx) => (
            <div
              key={loc}
              className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-2.5"

                      placeholder="Pingcon Warehouse"

                      />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={anchor.zip || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => handleUpdateGpsAnchor(idx, 'zip', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="1106"
                        className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step="0.000001"

                      onChange={(e) => handleUpdateGpsAnchor(idx, 'lat', e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="14.6683"
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"

                  </div>

                      placeholder="121.0114"
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase mb-1">Radius (Meters)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"

                      onChange={(e) => handleUpdateGpsAnchor(idx, 'radiusMeters', e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="250"
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase mb-1">Formatted Watermark &amp; Display Address</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={anchor.formatted || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateGpsAnchor(idx, 'formatted', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="64 Mendez Rd, Baesa, Quezon City, Metro Manila 1106"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  />

            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 6. MULTI-SYSTEM REST API KEYS & INTEGRATION (SHA-256 HASHED) */}
      {/* (Rendered under showApiKeysView above) */}
      </>
      )}

      {/* Warehouse Locations Modal */}
      <WarehouseLocationsModal
        isOpen={isLocationsModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsLocationsModalOpen(false);
          setLocationsList(getWarehouseLocations());
        }}
        onLocationsUpdated={(newLocs) => setLocationsList(newLocs)}
      />

      {/* Persistent Supplier Emails Directory Modal */}
      <SupplierDirectoryModal
        isOpen={isDirectoryOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDirectoryOpen(false)}
      />

    </div>
  );
}

function isPendingSupplierName(name) {
  const s = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return !s || s === 'pending assignment' || s === 'pending' || s === 'unassigned' || s === 'warehouse' || s === 'n/a';
}

function resolveSavedOptionId(report, isSupplierStream) {
  const meta = (report?.ai_document_metadata && typeof report.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? report.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const pickup = (meta.supplier_pickup && typeof meta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
    ? meta.supplier_pickup
    : {};
  const raw = String(meta.simple_rtv_disposition || pickup.disposition || report?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  if (!raw) return null;
  if (
    raw === 'supplier_credit' ||
    raw === 'customer_credit' ||
    raw.includes('debit claim') ||
    raw.includes('vendor credit') ||
    raw.includes('ap deduction') ||
    raw.includes('debit / credit')
  ) {
    return isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_credit' : 'customer_credit';
  }
  if (
    raw === 'supplier_exchange' ||
    raw === 'customer_exchange' ||
    raw.includes('replacement') ||
    raw.includes('exchange') ||
    raw.includes('buffer')
  ) {
    return isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_exchange' : 'customer_exchange';
  }
  if (raw === 'scrap' || raw.includes('scrap') || raw.includes('dispose')) {
    return 'scrap';
  }
  if (raw === 'restock_good' || raw.includes('restock')) {
    return 'restock_good';
  }
  if (pickup.picked_up_at) {
    return isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_credit' : 'customer_credit';
  }
  return null;
}

function extractExistingClaimIdFromReport(report) {
  if (!report) return null;
  const pickup = report.ai_document_metadata?.supplier_pickup || {};
  if (pickup.claim_number) return String(pickup.claim_number).trim();
  const noteMatch = String(report.notes || '').match(/\[(?:RTV|BUF):\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
  if (noteMatch && noteMatch[1]) return noteMatch[1].trim();
  if (Array.isArray(report.audit_trail)) {
    const entry = report.audit_trail.find((a) => a?.rtv_number || a?.buf_number);
    if (entry?.rtv_number) return String(entry.rtv_number).trim();
    if (entry?.buf_number) return String(entry.buf_number).trim();
  }
  return null;
}

    setDriverLicenseNo(pickup.driver_license_no || '');
    setTruckPlate(pickup.truck_plate || '');

    const activeBatchSnapshot = rawBatchReportsRef.current || [];
    setWizardReports(activeBatchSnapshot);
    setBundleSearchQuery('');
    setShowBundleDropdown(false);
    const savedProcessor = String(
      pickup.processed_by ||
      meta.simple_rtv_updated_by ||
      activeBatchSnapshot

    const hydratedSlots = {};
    PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.forEach((slot) => {
      const urlSet = new Set();
      const keysToCheck = Array.isArray(slot.legacyKeys) ? slot.legacyKeys : [slot.key];
      keysToCheck.forEach((k) => {
        normalizePhotoUrlArray(hydratedPhotos[k]).forEach((u) => urlSet.add(u));
      });
      hydratedSlots[slot.key] = Array.from(urlSet).slice(0, MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT).map((url, idx) => ({

    const rmaNumsToCheck = activeBatchSnapshot.map((r) => r.rma_number).filter(Boolean);

  useEffect(() => () => clearObjectUrls(), []);

  const workingBatchReports = useMemo(

    [wizardReports, rawBatchReports]

    const addCandidate = (rawVal) => {
      if (!isRealSupplierName(rawVal) || isPendingSupplierName(rawVal)) return;
      const clean = String(rawVal).trim();

    const primaryStream = primaryInputReport.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'supplier_outbound' : 'customer_inbound';

      .filter((r) => {

  if (!isOpen || !primaryInputReport) return null;

    setBundleSearchQuery('');
    setShowBundleDropdown(false);
    setErrorMsg('');
  };

  const handleRemoveBundledRma = (targetRmaNum) => {
    setWizardReports((prev) => {
      const base = prev.length > 0 ? prev : rawBatchReports;
      if (base.length <= 1) return base;
      return base.filter((x) => (x.rma_number || x.rmaNumber || String(x.id || '')) !== targetRmaNum);
    });
    setSavedBatchReports(null);
  };
  const activeReport = savedReport || activeBatchReports[0];
  const isConsolidatedBatch = activeBatchReports.length > 1;
  const batchRmaNumbers = activeBatchReports.map((r) => r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || String(r.id || '')).filter(Boolean);
  const rmaNumber = activeReport.rma_number || activeReport.rmaNumber || activeReport.id || 'N/A';
  const isTest = activeBatchReports.some((r) => isTestRecord(r));
  const isSupplierStream = activeReport.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
  const optionsList = getFourOptions(isSupplierStream);

  const hasMultipleSuppliersConflict = isConsolidatedBatch && distinctSuppliersInBatch.length > 1;

  const batchSummary = getConsolidatedPickupItems({
    report: activeReport,
    reports: activeBatchReports,
    allReports,
    catalogProducts,
    combineIdentical: false
  });
  const grandBatchPieces = batchSummary.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.totalPieces, 0);
  const grandBatchValue = batchSummary.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.lineTotal, 0);

  const manifestItems = getReportManifestItems(activeReport, allReports);
  const isManifest = manifestItems.length > 1 || Number(activeReport.total_items) > 1;
  const currentOutcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(activeReport);
  const isAlreadyPickedUp = currentOutcome.isPickedUp;
  const supplierMissing = isPendingSupplierName(supplierName);
  const effectiveClaimNumber =
    existingClaimNumber ||
    currentOutcome.claimNumber ||
    activeBatchReports.map((r) => extractExistingClaimIdFromReport(r)).find(Boolean) ||
    null;

  const handleSelectPhotos = async (slotKey, filesInput) => {
    const incomingFiles = filesInput instanceof File
      ? [filesInput]
      : Array.from(filesInput || []).filter((f) => Boolean(f));
    if (incomingFiles.length === 0) return;

    const slotObj = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.find((s) => s.key === slotKey);
    const currentSlotList = Array.isArray(photoSlots[slotKey]) ? photoSlots[slotKey] : [];
    const currentTotalCount = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.reduce(
      (sum, s) => sum + (Array.isArray(photoSlots[s.key]) ? photoSlots[s.key].length : 0),
      0
    );

    const slotRemaining = Math.max(0, MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT - currentSlotList.length);
    const totalRemaining = Math.max(0, MAX_TOTAL_PICKUP_PHOTOS - currentTotalCount);
    const allowedCount = Math.min(slotRemaining, totalRemaining);

    if (slotRemaining <= 0) {
      setErrorMsg(`Maximum ${MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT} photos allowed for "${slotObj?.title || slotKey}". Remove a photo to add another.`);
      return;
    }
    if (totalRemaining <= 0) {
      setErrorMsg(`Maximum ${MAX_TOTAL_PICKUP_PHOTOS} total pickup photos reached across all 5 categories. Remove a photo first.`);
      return;
    }

    const acceptedFiles = incomingFiles.slice(0, allowedCount);
    if (incomingFiles.length > allowedCount) {
      setErrorMsg(
        `Maximum ${MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT} photos per slot (${MAX_TOTAL_PICKUP_PHOTOS} total). Added ${acceptedFiles.length} photo(s); ${incomingFiles.length - acceptedFiles.length} extra photo(s) were skipped.`
      );
    } else {
      setErrorMsg('');
    }

    const reportGeoAddr = getGpsAddressDisplay(activeReport) || getGpsAddressDisplay(primaryInputReport);
    const stampedFiles = await stampWatermarkOnFiles(acceptedFiles, {
      addressText: reportGeoAddr,
      tagText: processedBy.trim() || activeUser?.name || driverName.trim() || 'Warehouse Staff'
    });

    const newEntries = stampedFiles.map((file, idx) => {
      const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      objectUrlsRef.current.push(previewUrl);
      return {
        id: `${slotKey}-${Date.now()}-${idx}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
        file,
        previewUrl,
        existingUrl: ''
      };
    });

    setPhotoSlots((prev) => {
      const prevList = Array.isArray(prev[slotKey]) ? prev[slotKey] : [];
      const prevTotal = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.reduce(
        (sum, s) => sum + (Array.isArray(prev[s.key]) ? prev[s.key].length : 0),
        0
      );
      const room = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT - prevList.length, MAX_TOTAL_PICKUP_PHOTOS - prevTotal));
      if (room <= 0) return prev;
      return {
        ...prev,
        [slotKey]: [...prevList, ...newEntries.slice(0, room)]
      };
    });

    // Auto-read Driver's Valid Gov't / Legal ID Front with Gemini AI Vision on first ID photo when Driver Name & ID # are empty
    if (
      slotKey === 'driver_license_front' &&
      currentSlotList.length === 0 &&
      !driverName.trim() &&
      !driverLicenseNo.trim()
    ) {
      setIsScanningId(true);
      setOcrNotice({ type: 'info', text: 'Reading Driver Name, Valid ID Type & ID # from photo...' });
      try {
        const res = await catalogService.inspectDriverLicense(acceptedFiles[0]);
        if (res?.id_type && res.id_type !== 'Unknown') {
          setDriverIdType(String(res.id_type).trim());
        }
        if (res?.driver_name) {
          setDriverName((prev) => prev.trim() || res.driver_name.trim());
        }
        if (res?.license_number) {
          setDriverLicenseNo((prev) => prev.trim() || res.license_number.trim());
        }
        if (res?.driver_name || res?.license_number) {
          const detectedLabel = res?.id_type && res.id_type !== 'Unknown' ? `${res.id_type}: ` : '';
          setOcrNotice({
            type: 'success',
            text: `Auto-filled from ${detectedLabel}${res.driver_name || 'Name n/a'}${res.license_number ? ` • ID # ${res.license_number}` : ''}`
          });
        } else {
          setOcrNotice({
            type: 'warn',
            text: res?.rejection_reason || 'Photo saved! Could not read ID text clearly — please select ID Type and enter Name & ID # below.'
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Valid ID OCR warning:', err);
        setOcrNotice({
          type: 'warn',
          text: 'Photo saved! Auto-read unavailable right now — please select Valid ID Type and enter Name & ID # below.'
        });
      } finally {
        setIsScanningId(false);
      }
    }

    // Auto-read Delivery Truck Plate Number with Gemini AI Vision on first Slot 3 photo when Truck Plate is empty
    if (
      slotKey === 'truck_plate' &&
      currentSlotList.length === 0 &&
      !truckPlate.trim()
    ) {
      setIsScanningPlate(true);
      setOcrNotice({ type: 'info', text: 'Reading Delivery Truck Plate Number from photo...' });
      try {
        const res = await catalogService.inspectTruckPlate(acceptedFiles[0]);
        if (res?.is_valid_plate !== false && res?.plate_number) {
          const cleanPlate = String(res.plate_number).trim().toUpperCase();
          setTruckPlate((prev) => prev.trim() || cleanPlate);
          setOcrNotice({
            type: 'success',
            text: `Auto-filled Truck Plate #: ${cleanPlate}${res?.vehicle_type && res.vehicle_type !== 'Unknown' ? ` (${res.vehicle_type})` : ''}`
          });
        } else {
          setOcrNotice({
            type: 'warn',
            text: res?.rejection_reason || 'Photo saved! Could not read truck plate clearly — please enter Truck Plate Number manually below.'
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Truck Plate OCR warning:', err);
        setOcrNotice({
          type: 'warn',
          text: 'Photo saved! Truck plate auto-read unavailable right now — please enter Truck Plate Number manually below.'
        });
      } finally {
        setIsScanningPlate(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = (slotKey, photoId) => {
    setErrorMsg('');
    setPhotoSlots((prev) => {
      const prevList = Array.isArray(prev[slotKey]) ? prev[slotKey] : [];
      const target = prevList.find((item) => item.id === photoId);
      if (target?.previewUrl && !target?.existingUrl) {
        try { URL.revokeObjectURL(target.previewUrl); } catch { }
      }
      return {
        ...prev,
        [slotKey]: prevList.filter((item) => item.id !== photoId)
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSaveSimpleDecision = async (optionId, waitOnly = false) => {
    setErrorMsg('');
    const opt = optionsList.find((o) => o.id === optionId);
    if (!opt) return;

    const cleanSupplier = supplierName.trim();
    if (opt.needsPickupForm && !cleanSupplier) {
      setErrorMsg(
        isSupplierStream
          ? 'Please type or choose the Supplier Company Name first.'
          : 'Please type or enter the Customer / Store Branch Name first.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (opt.needsPickupForm && hasMultipleSuppliersConflict && !confirmUnifySupplier) {
      setErrorMsg(
        `Single-Supplier Guard: Bundled RMAs come from different suppliers (${distinctSuppliersInBatch.join(', ')}). Check "Unify supplier across all bundled RMAs" below or go back and filter to one supplier.`
      );
      return;
    }

    // If Debit Claim or Replacement and staff chose "Driver Is Here Now" / "Edit Pickup"
    if (opt.needsPickupForm && !waitOnly) {
      setSelectedOption(optionId);
      setStep('pickup');
      return;
    }

    const cleanProcessedBy = processedBy.trim();
    if (!cleanProcessedBy) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter "Processed By (Staff Full Name)" before saving this decision.');
      return;
    }

    const effectiveSupplier = cleanSupplier || activeReport.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment';
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    setIsSaving(true);
    setUploadProgress(
      isConsolidatedBatch
        ? `Updating ${activeBatchReports.length} bundled RMAs...`
        : 'Saving your decision...'
    );
    try {
      const nextStatus = opt.needsPickupForm
        ? (isSupplierStream ? 'vendor_claimed' : 'under_inspection')
        : 'under_inspection';

      let nextLocation = isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)' : 'Receiving Area';
      if (optionId === 'scrap') {
        nextLocation = 'Disposal / Scrap Area';
      } else if (optionId === 'restock_good') {
        nextLocation = 'Good Stock Area';
      }

      const auditDetail = optionId === 'scrap'
        ? ` [Re-Order: ${scrapNeedsReorder ? 'YES' : 'NO'}]`
        : (waitOnly ? ' (waiting for driver)' : '');

      const updatedBatchList = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < activeBatchReports.length; i++) {
        const rep = activeBatchReports[i];
        if (isConsolidatedBatch) {
          setUploadProgress(`Updating RMA ${i + 1} of ${activeBatchReports.length} (${rep.rma_number})...`);
        }
        const repMeta = (rep.ai_document_metadata && typeof rep.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
          ? rep.ai_document_metadata
          : {};
        const repPickup = (repMeta.supplier_pickup && typeof repMeta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
          ? repMeta.supplier_pickup
          : {};

        const updatedPickup = (Object.keys(repPickup).length > 0 || supplierEmailTo.trim() || supplierEmailCc.trim() || isConsolidatedBatch || (!isSupplierStream && cleanSupplier))
          ? {
            ...repPickup,
            disposition: optionId,
            disposition_label: opt.title,
            supplier_name: effectiveSupplier,
            ...(isSupplierStream ? {} : { customer_name: cleanSupplier || repPickup.customer_name || rep.store_branch || '' }),
            supplier_email_to: supplierEmailTo.trim(),
            supplier_email_cc: supplierEmailCc.trim(),
            ...(isConsolidatedBatch ? { consolidated_rma_numbers: batchRmaNumbers } : {}),
            picked_up_at: null,
            updated_at: nowIso,
            processed_by: cleanProcessedBy
          }
          : undefined;

        const metadataPatch = {
          simple_rtv_disposition: optionId,
          simple_rtv_label: opt.title,
          simple_rtv_updated_at: nowIso,
          simple_rtv_updated_by: cleanProcessedBy,
          needs_reorder: optionId === 'scrap' ? Boolean(scrapNeedsReorder) : false
        };
        if (updatedPickup) {
          metadataPatch.supplier_pickup = updatedPickup;
        }

        const updated = await catalogService.saveSimpleSupplierRtvDisposition(rep, {
          disposition: optionId,
          status: nextStatus,
          warehouse_location: nextLocation,
          supplier_name: isSupplierStream ? effectiveSupplier : (rep.supplier_name || effectiveSupplier),
          unifyMixedSuppliers: Boolean(confirmUnifySupplier),
          actorName: cleanProcessedBy,
          inspected_by: cleanProcessedBy,
          clearWorkflowResolution: true,
          auditAction: isConsolidatedBatch ? 'CONSOLIDATED_4CHOICE_DECISION' : 'SIMPLE_4CHOICE_DECISION',
          auditNote: `Staff selected "${opt.title}"${auditDetail}${isConsolidatedBatch ? ` [Batch of ${activeBatchReports.length} RMAs]` : ''}`,
          metadataPatch
        });
        updatedBatchList.push(updated);
      }

      if (optionId === 'scrap' || optionId === 'restock_good') {
        setUploadProgress(
          isConsolidatedBatch
            ? `Sending ONE consolidated email for ${updatedBatchList.length} RMAs...`
            : 'Sending lifecycle email notification...'
        );
        try {
          await notificationService.sendRmaLifecycleNotification({
            eventType: optionId === 'scrap' ? 'scrapped' : 'restocked',
            report: updatedBatchList[0],
            reports: updatedBatchList,
            allReports,
            catalogProducts,
            actorName: cleanProcessedBy,
            isTestMode: isTest,
            customRecipients: wizardCustomRecipients
          });
        } catch (mailErr) {
          console.warn('Non-blocking error sending 4-Choice lifecycle email:', mailErr);
        }
      }

      setSavedReport(updatedBatchList[0]);
      setSavedBatchReports(updatedBatchList);
      setStep('done');
      onSuccess?.(updatedBatchList.length > 1 ? updatedBatchList : updatedBatchList[0]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed saving 4-Choice decision:', err);
      setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Could not save choice. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
      setUploadProgress('');
    }
  };

  const handleCompletePickupAndGenerateForm = async () => {
    setErrorMsg('');
    const cleanProcessedBy = processedBy.trim();
    if (!cleanProcessedBy) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter "Processed By (Staff Full Name)" before completing pickup verification.');
      return;
    }

    const cleanSupplier = supplierName.trim();
    if (!cleanSupplier) {
      setErrorMsg(
        isSupplierStream
          ? 'Please type or select the Supplier Company Name.'
          : 'Please type or enter the Customer / Store Branch Name.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (hasMultipleSuppliersConflict && !confirmUnifySupplier) {
      setErrorMsg(
        `Single-Supplier Guard: Bundled RMAs come from different suppliers (${distinctSuppliersInBatch.join(', ')}). Check "Unify supplier across all bundled RMAs" or go back and filter to one supplier.`
      );
      return;
    }

    const cleanEmailTo = supplierEmailTo.trim();
    const cleanEmailCc = supplierEmailCc.trim();

    const oversizedSlots = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.filter((slot) => (photoSlots[slot.key] || []).length > MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT);
    if (oversizedSlots.length > 0) {
      setErrorMsg(`Maximum ${MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SLOT} photos allowed per category (${oversizedSlots.map((s) => s.title).join(', ')}).`);
      return;
    }

    const totalPhotosSelected = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.reduce(
      (sum, slot) => sum + (Array.isArray(photoSlots[slot.key]) ? photoSlots[slot.key].length : 0),
      0
    );
    if (totalPhotosSelected > MAX_TOTAL_PICKUP_PHOTOS) {
      setErrorMsg(`Maximum ${MAX_TOTAL_PICKUP_PHOTOS} total pickup photos allowed across all 5 categories.`);
      return;
    }

    if (!driverName.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg("Please enter the Driver's / Representative's Full Name (from their valid gov't/legal ID).");
      return;
    }
    if (!truckPlate.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter the Truck Plate Number.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      let currentFolderId = extractGoogleDriveFolderId(
        activeReport.google_drive_folder_id || activeReport.google_drive_folder_url
      );
      let currentFolderUrl = activeReport.google_drive_folder_url || '';

      const uploadedUrlMap = {};
      const pendingUploads = [];
      PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.forEach((slot) => {
        const entries = Array.isArray(photoSlots[slot.key]) ? photoSlots[slot.key] : [];
        uploadedUrlMap[slot.key] = new Array(entries.length).fill('');
        entries.forEach((entry, idx) => {
          if (entry?.file) {
            pendingUploads.push({ slot, idx, entry });
          } else if (entry?.existingUrl) {
            uploadedUrlMap[slot.key][idx] = entry.existingUrl;
          }
        });
      });

      const newPhotoUrls = [];
      const totalToUpload = pendingUploads.length;
      if (totalToUpload > 0) {
        let completedUploads = 0;

        // Upload the first new photo sequentially to obtain/reuse currentFolderId before batch concurrency
        const firstTask = pendingUploads[0];
        setUploadProgress(`Uploading 1 of ${totalToUpload} photos (${firstTask.slot.title})...`);
        const firstRes = await catalogService.uploadPhotoWithDetails(
          firstTask.entry.file,
          rmaNumber,
          firstTask.slot.category,
          {
            targetFolderId: currentFolderId || null,
            driverName: driverName.trim(),
            truckPlate: truckPlate.trim(),
            supplierName: cleanSupplier
          }
        );
        if (!firstRes?.url) {
          throw new Error(`Photo upload failed for "${firstTask.slot.title}". Please check connection and retry.`);
        }
        uploadedUrlMap[firstTask.slot.key][firstTask.idx] = firstRes.url;
        newPhotoUrls.push(firstRes.url);
        completedUploads = 1;
        if (!currentFolderId && firstRes.rmaFolderId) currentFolderId = firstRes.rmaFolderId;
        if (!currentFolderUrl && firstRes.rmaFolderUrl) currentFolderUrl = firstRes.rmaFolderUrl;

        // Upload remaining new photos in controlled batches of 4
        const UPLOAD_BATCH_SIZE = 4;
        const remainingTasks = pendingUploads.slice(1);
        for (let b = 0; b < remainingTasks.length; b += UPLOAD_BATCH_SIZE) {
          const chunk = remainingTasks.slice(b, b + UPLOAD_BATCH_SIZE);
          setUploadProgress(`Uploading ${completedUploads + 1} of ${totalToUpload} photos...`);
          const chunkResults = await Promise.all(
            chunk.map(async (task) => {
              const res = await catalogService.uploadPhotoWithDetails(
                task.entry.file,
                rmaNumber,
                task.slot.category,
                {
                  targetFolderId: currentFolderId || null,
                  driverName: driverName.trim(),
                  truckPlate: truckPlate.trim(),
                  supplierName: cleanSupplier
                }
              );
              if (!res?.url) {
                throw new Error(`Photo upload failed for "${task.slot.title}". Please check connection and retry.`);
              }
              completedUploads += 1;
              setUploadProgress(`Uploading ${completedUploads} of ${totalToUpload} photos...`);
              if (!currentFolderId && res.rmaFolderId) currentFolderId = res.rmaFolderId;
              if (!currentFolderUrl && res.rmaFolderUrl) currentFolderUrl = res.rmaFolderUrl;
              return { task, res };
            })
          );
          chunkResults.forEach(({ task, res }) => {
            uploadedUrlMap[task.slot.key][task.idx] = res.url;
            newPhotoUrls.push(res.url);
          });
        }
      }

      PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.forEach((slot) => {
        uploadedUrlMap[slot.key] = (uploadedUrlMap[slot.key] || []).filter(Boolean);
      });
      const totalSavedPhotosCount = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.reduce(
        (sum, slot) => sum + (uploadedUrlMap[slot.key]?.length || 0),
        0
      );

      const activeOpt = optionsList.find((o) => o.id === selectedOption) || optionsList[0];
      const existingMeta = (activeReport.ai_document_metadata && typeof activeReport.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
        ? activeReport.ai_document_metadata
        : {};
      const existingPickup = (existingMeta.supplier_pickup && typeof existingMeta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
        ? existingMeta.supplier_pickup
        : {};

      // Reuse existing RTV- / BUF- ref if present across any bundled RMA; only generate ONE shared ID
      let resolvedClaimNumber = effectiveClaimNumber || existingPickup.claim_number || null;
      const shouldPersistSupplierClaim =
        isSupplierStream && (
          activeOpt.id === 'supplier_credit' ||
          activeOpt.id === 'supplier_exchange' ||
          isConsolidatedBatch
        );

      let existingClaimsList = null;
      if (shouldPersistSupplierClaim && !resolvedClaimNumber) {
        setUploadProgress('Checking existing claim records...');
        existingClaimsList = await supplierClaimService.getClaims();
        const existingInStore = (existingClaimsList || []).find((c) =>
          Array.isArray(c.items) && c.items.some((it) => batchRmaNumbers.includes(it.rma_number))
        );
        if (existingInStore) {
          resolvedClaimNumber = existingInStore.claimNumber || existingInStore.claim_number;
        } else {
          resolvedClaimNumber = supplierClaimService.generateRtvId(existingClaimsList || [], isTest);
        }
      } else if (!isSupplierStream && activeOpt.id === 'customer_exchange' && !resolvedClaimNumber) {
        resolvedClaimNumber = supplierClaimService.generateBufferId([...allReports, ...activeBatchReports], isTest);
      }

      if (resolvedClaimNumber) {
        setExistingClaimNumber(resolvedClaimNumber);
      }

      setUploadProgress(
        isConsolidatedBatch
          ? `Synchronizing ${activeBatchReports.length} bundled RMAs (${resolvedClaimNumber || rmaNumber})...`
          : 'Saving pickup verification & generating Letter form...'
      );
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const pickedUpAtIso = existingPickup.picked_up_at || nowIso;

      const updatedBatchList = [];
      for (let idx = 0; idx < activeBatchReports.length; idx++) {
        const rep = activeBatchReports[idx];
        const repMeta = (rep.ai_document_metadata && typeof rep.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
          ? rep.ai_document_metadata
          : {};
        const repPickup = (repMeta.supplier_pickup && typeof repMeta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
          ? repMeta.supplier_pickup
          : {};

        const pickupPayload = {
          ...repPickup,
          disposition: activeOpt.id,
          disposition_label: activeOpt.title,
          claim_number: resolvedClaimNumber || null,
          consolidated_rma_numbers: batchRmaNumbers,
          supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
          ...(isSupplierStream ? {} : { customer_name: cleanSupplier }),
          supplier_email_to: cleanEmailTo,
          supplier_email_cc: cleanEmailCc,
          driver_name: driverName.trim(),
          driver_id_type: driverIdType.trim() || "Driver's License (LTO)",
          driver_license_no: driverLicenseNo.trim(),
          truck_plate: truckPlate.trim().toUpperCase(),
          photos: uploadedUrlMap,
          drive_folder_id: currentFolderId || null,
          drive_folder_url: currentFolderUrl || null,
          picked_up_at: repPickup.picked_up_at || pickedUpAtIso,
          updated_at: nowIso,
          processed_by: cleanProcessedBy
        };

        const nextLocation = isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)' : 'Customer Return Area';
        const updatedRep = await catalogService.saveSimpleSupplierRtvDisposition(rep, {
          disposition: activeOpt.id,
          status: 'picked_up',
          warehouse_location: nextLocation,
          supplier_name: isSupplierStream ? cleanSupplier : (rep.supplier_name || cleanSupplier),
          unifyMixedSuppliers: Boolean(confirmUnifySupplier),
          actorName: cleanProcessedBy,
          inspected_by: cleanProcessedBy,
          clearWorkflowResolution: true,
          google_drive_folder_id: currentFolderId || null,
          google_drive_folder_url: currentFolderUrl || null,
          appendPhotoUrls: newPhotoUrls,
          auditAction: repPickup.picked_up_at ? 'PICKUP_DETAILS_UPDATED' : 'SUPPLIER_DRIVER_PICKUP_VERIFIED',
          auditNote: `${repPickup.picked_up_at ? 'Updated' : 'Picked up by'} ${driverName.trim()} (Plate ${truckPlate.trim().toUpperCase()}) for "${activeOpt.title}"${resolvedClaimNumber ? ` [${resolvedClaimNumber}]` : ''}${isConsolidatedBatch ? ` (Consolidated Batch: ${batchRmaNumbers.length} RMAs)` : ''} with ${totalSavedPhotosCount} Drive photo(s) archived.`,
          metadataPatch: {
            simple_rtv_disposition: activeOpt.id,
            simple_rtv_label: activeOpt.title,
            simple_rtv_updated_at: pickupPayload.picked_up_at,
            simple_rtv_updated_by: cleanProcessedBy,
            needs_reorder: false,
            supplier_pickup: pickupPayload
          }
        });
        updatedBatchList.push(updatedRep);
      }

      // Persist ONE consolidated Claim record across all bundled RMAs (without creating duplicate RTV- IDs)
      if ((shouldPersistSupplierClaim || resolvedClaimNumber) && isSupplierStream && resolvedClaimNumber) {
        const claimItems = [];
        updatedBatchList.forEach((rep) => {
          const repRma = rep.rma_number || rep.rmaNumber;
          const repChildren = getReportManifestItems(rep, allReports);
          const lines = repChildren.length > 0 ? repChildren : [rep];
          lines.forEach((it) => {
            const calc = computeItemPiecesAndValue(it, catalogProducts);
            claimItems.push({
              ...it,
              rma_number: repRma,
              supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
              quantity: calc.rawQty || Number(it.quantity) || 1,
              price: calc.recordedUnitPrice,
              price_with_vat: calc.recordedUnitPrice
            });
          });
        });
        const totalUnits = claimItems.reduce((sum, it) => sum + (Number(it.quantity) || 1), 0);
        const totalClaimAmt = claimItems.reduce((sum, it) => {
          const calc = computeItemPiecesAndValue(it, catalogProducts);
          return sum + calc.lineTotal;
        }, 0);

        await supplierClaimService.saveClaim({
          claimNumber: resolvedClaimNumber,
          supplierName: cleanSupplier,
          generatedBy: cleanProcessedBy,
          items: claimItems,
          totalQuantity: totalUnits,
          totalClaimAmount: totalClaimAmt,
          notes: isTest
            ? `[TEST_MODE] Sandbox${isConsolidatedBatch ? ' Consolidated' : ''} RTV Claim (${batchRmaNumbers.length} RMAs)`
            : (isConsolidatedBatch ? `Consolidated Claim (${batchRmaNumbers.length} RMAs): ${batchRmaNumbers.join(', ')}` : ''),
          isTest,
          preserveReportFields: true
        });

        const tag = `[RTV: ${resolvedClaimNumber}]`;
        for (let i = 0; i < updatedBatchList.length; i++) {
          const curNotes = String(updatedBatchList[i]?.notes || '');
          if (!curNotes.includes(tag)) {
            updatedBatchList[i] = {
              ...updatedBatchList[i],
              notes: curNotes ? `${curNotes}\n${tag}` : tag
            };
          }
        }
      }

      const isExchangeOutcome =
        activeOpt.id === 'supplier_exchange' ||
        activeOpt.id === 'customer_exchange';
      setUploadProgress(
        isConsolidatedBatch
          ? `Generating consolidated PDF & emailing for ${updatedBatchList.length} RMAs...`
          : 'Generating PDF form & dispatching email notification...'
      );
      try {
        await notificationService.sendRmaLifecycleNotification({
          eventType: isExchangeOutcome ? 'pickup_replacement' : 'pickup_debit_claim',
          report: updatedBatchList[0],
          reports: updatedBatchList,
          allReports,
          catalogProducts,
          actorName: cleanProcessedBy,
          isTestMode: isTest,
          customRecipients: wizardCustomRecipients
        });
      } catch (mailErr) {
        console.warn('Non-blocking error sending pickup notification email:', mailErr);
      }

      setSavedReport(updatedBatchList[0]);
      setSavedBatchReports(updatedBatchList);
      setStep('done');
      setShowA4Form(true);
      onSuccess?.(updatedBatchList.length > 1 ? updatedBatchList : updatedBatchList[0]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Pickup verification failed:', err);
      setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Failed to upload photos or save pickup verification. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
      setUploadProgress('');
    }
  };

  const completedPhotoCount = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.filter((s) => Array.isArray(photoSlots[s.key]) && photoSlots[s.key].length > 0).length;
  const totalPhotoCount = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + (Array.isArray(photoSlots[s.key]) ? photoSlots[s.key].length : 0),
    0
  );
  const newPendingPhotoCount = PICKUP_PHOTO_SLOTS.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + (Array.isArray(photoSlots[s.key]) ? photoSlots[s.key].filter((p) => p?.file).length : 0),
    0
  );
  const processedByMissing = !processedBy.trim();
  const chosenOptionObj = optionsList.find((o) => o.id === selectedOption);
  const existingFormLabel = !isSupplierStream
    ? (currentOutcome.formType === 'replacement' ? 'Buffer Replacement Form' : 'Credit Return Form')
    : (currentOutcome.formType === 'replacement' ? 'Replacement Form' : 'Debit Claim Form');
  const activePartySuggestions = isSupplierStream ? supplierSuggestions : customerBranchSuggestions;

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[110] flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[94dvh] flex flex-col rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 overflow-hidden">

          {/* Modal Header */}
          <div className={`shrink-0 px-4 sm:px-6 py-3.5 text-white flex items-center justify-between border-b ${isTest ? 'bg-amber-900 border-amber-800' : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800'
            }`}>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span className="font-mono font-black text-base sm:text-lg tracking-tight">
                  {isConsolidatedBatch ? `Consolidated Batch (${activeBatchReports.length} RMAs)` : rmaNumber}
                </span>
                {isTest && (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                    🧪 Test Mode
                  </span>
                )}
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border ${isSupplierStream
                  ? 'bg-purple-500/20 border-purple-400/40 text-purple-200'
                  : 'bg-blue-500/20 border-blue-400/40 text-blue-200'
                  }`}>
                  {isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier RTV' : 'Customer Hub'}
                </span>
                {effectiveClaimNumber && (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/40 text-emerald-200 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold">
                    {effectiveClaimNumber}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-slate-300 truncate mt-0.5">
                {step === 'choose'
                  ? 'Step 1 of 2: Choose 4-Choice Outcome (Edit or Update Anytime)'
                  : step === 'pickup'
                    ? (isSupplierStream
                      ? 'Step 2 of 2: Driver Pickup Verification, Supplier Emails & Drive Photos (Max 10/Slot)'
                      : 'Step 2 of 2: Customer Handover Verification, Customer Emails & Drive Photos (Max 10/Slot)')
                    : (isSupplierStream
                      ? 'Decision Saved — Ready for Warehouse & Supplier Records'
                      : 'Decision Saved — Ready for Warehouse & Customer Records')}
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              aria-label="Close modal"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Scrollable Body */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5">

            {/* Interactive Add / Bundle Another RMA to This Pickup */}
            {step !== 'done' && (
              <div className="p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <div className="text-xs font-black text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-100 flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span>Add / Bundle Another RMA to This Pickup</span>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px] font-mono">
                      {activeBatchReports.length} RMA{activeBatchReports.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-black text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200">
                    {batchSummary.items.length} Line(s) • {grandBatchPieces.toLocaleString()} pcs • {formatPeso(grandBatchValue)}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Removable Bundled RMA Chips */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {activeBatchReports.map((rep, repIdx) => {
                    const num = rep.rma_number || rep.rmaNumber || String(rep.id || '');
                    const canRemove = activeBatchReports.length > 1;
                    return (
                      <span
                        key={num || repIdx}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-100"
                      >
                        <span>{num}</span>
                        {rep.supplier_name && rep.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment' && (
                          <span className="font-sans text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">({rep.supplier_name})</span>
                        )}
                        {canRemove && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleRemoveBundledRma(num)}
                            className="ml-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-200 hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            aria-label={`Remove ${num} from bundle`}
                            title={`Remove ${num} from this pickup`}
                          >
                            ×
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </span>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* Searchable Combobox */}
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={bundleSearchQuery}
                      onFocus={() => setShowBundleDropdown(true)}
                      onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowBundleDropdown(false), 180)}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setBundleSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                        setShowBundleDropdown(true);
                      }}
                      placeholder={`Search ${wizardCurrentIsTest ? 'Sandbox Test ' : 'Live '}${isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier RTV' : 'Customer Hub'} RMA#, SKU, or product name to bundle...`}
                      className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                    />
                  </div>
                  {showBundleDropdown && (
                    <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1 z-40 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700 rounded-xl shadow-xl max-h-52 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                      {bundleCandidateOptions.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="p-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500 text-center">
                          No matching active {wizardCurrentIsTest ? 'Sandbox ' : 'Live '}RMAs found to bundle.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        bundleCandidateOptions.map((cand) => {
                          const cNum = cand.rma_number || cand.rmaNumber || String(cand.id || '');
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={cNum}
                              type="button"
                              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                handleAddBundledRma(cand);
                              }}
                              className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                  <span className="font-mono font-black text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">{cNum}</span>
                                  {(cand.code || cand.sku) && (
                                    <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500">SKU: {cand.code || cand.sku}</span>
                                  )}
                                  {cand.supplier_name && cand.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment' && (
