  id: '',
  supplier_name: '',
  email_to: '',
  email_cc: '',
  contact_person: '',
  notes: ''
};

/**
 * Persistent Supplier Emails Directory Modal (Supabase rma_settings -> supplier_directory_store).
 * Allows Add, Edit, Search, and Delete of supplier contacts used to auto-fill To/CC fields
 * across 4-Choice Wizard, + Set Supplier & Email, Quick Actions, and automated follow-up cron.
 */
export default function SupplierDirectoryModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onShowToast = null,
  isEmbeddedPage = false
}) {
  // Always declare ALL React hooks unconditionally before any early returns
  const isDesktopMd = useIsDesktopMd();
  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState(() => supplierDirectoryService.getCachedDirectory());
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncHandler = (e) => {
      if (Array.isArray(e?.detail)) {
        setContacts(e.detail);
      } else {
        setContacts(supplierDirectoryService.getCachedDirectory());
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener(SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_EVENT, syncHandler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_EVENT, syncHandler);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen && !isEmbeddedPage) return;
    let active = true;
    setFeedback(null);
    setShowForm(false);
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setIsLoading(true);
    supplierDirectoryService
      .loadDirectory()
      .then((list) => {
        if (active && Array.isArray(list)) {
          setContacts(list);
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setIsLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isOpen, isEmbeddedPage]);

  const filteredContacts = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return contacts;
    return contacts.filter((c) => {
      return (
        String(c.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.email_to || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.email_cc || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.contact_person || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(c.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [contacts, searchTerm]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleStartAdd = () => {
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setFeedback(null);
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (contact) => {
    setForm({
      id: contact.id || '',
      supplier_name: contact.supplier_name || '',
      email_to: contact.email_to || '',
      email_cc: contact.email_cc || '',
      contact_person: contact.contact_person || '',
      notes: contact.notes || ''
    });
    setFeedback(null);
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleSaveForm = async (e) => {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    const cleanName = form.supplier_name.trim();
    if (!cleanName) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Supplier / Vendor Name is required.' });
      return;
    }
    if (!form.email_to.trim() && !form.email_cc.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Enter at least one Email Address (To or CC).' });
      return;
    }
    setIsSaving(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const { saved, directory } = await supplierDirectoryService.upsertContact(form, {
        explicitEdit: true
      });
      setContacts(directory);
      setShowForm(false);
      setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
      const msg = `Saved contact "${saved.supplier_name}" to Supplier Emails Directory.`;
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: msg });
      onShowToast?.(msg, 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err?.message || 'Failed saving supplier contact.' });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (contact) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${contact.supplier_name}" from Supplier Emails Directory?`)) return;
    setDeletingId(contact.id || contact.supplier_name);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const updatedList = await supplierDirectoryService.deleteContact(contact.id || contact.supplier_name);
      setContacts(updatedList);
      const msg = `Removed "${contact.supplier_name}" from directory.`;
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: msg });
      onShowToast?.(msg, 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err?.message || 'Failed deleting supplier contact.' });
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen && !isEmbeddedPage) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={isEmbeddedPage
        ? 'w-full'
        : 'fixed inset-0 z-[95] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in'
      }
      onClick={isEmbeddedPage ? undefined : onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={isEmbeddedPage
          ? 'w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-sm flex flex-col overflow-hidden'
          : 'w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92dvh] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden'
        }
        onClick={isEmbeddedPage ? undefined : (e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className={isEmbeddedPage
          ? 'px-5 py-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0'
          : 'px-5 py-4 bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 shrink-0'
        }>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl border shrink-0 ${isEmbeddedPage
              ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
              : 'bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-400/40'
            }`}>
              <BookOpen className={`w-5 h-5 ${isEmbeddedPage ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-amber-300'}`} />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-black tracking-tight truncate">
                  Supplier Emails Directory
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-black font-mono">
                  {contacts.length} Saved Supplier{contacts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className={`text-[11px] leading-snug ${isEmbeddedPage ? 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400' : 'text-slate-300'}`}>
                Auto-populates To / CC emails everywhere a Supplier Name is typed or selected, and feeds automated follow-ups.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!isEmbeddedPage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close Supplier Emails Directory"
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Controls Bar */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search supplier name, To email, CC email, or contact person..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
            />
            {searchTerm && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Clear search"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleStartAdd}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Add Supplier Contact</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className={isEmbeddedPage ? 'p-5 space-y-4 text-xs' : 'p-5 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-xs'}>
          {feedback && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border font-bold flex items-center gap-2 ${
              feedback.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'
            }`}>
              {feedback.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
              <span>{feedback.message}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Add / Edit Contact Form */}
          {showForm && (
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSaveForm}
              className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 border-2 border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-700 space-y-3"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  <span>{form.id ? 'Edit Supplier Contact' : 'New Supplier Contact'}</span>
                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowForm(false);
                    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
                  }}
                  className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mb-1">
                    Supplier / Vendor Name *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.supplier_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, supplier_name: e.target.value }))}
                    placeholder="e.g. Mondelez, Century Pacific Food"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mb-1">
                    Contact Person (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.contact_person}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, contact_person: e.target.value }))}
                    placeholder="e.g. Juan Dela Cruz (RTV Coordinator)"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mb-1">
                    Primary Email(s) — TO
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.email_to}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, email_to: e.target.value }))}
                    placeholder="claims@supplier.com, rtv@supplier.com"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mb-1">
                    CC Email(s) (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.email_cc}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, email_cc: e.target.value }))}
                    placeholder="billing@supplier.com, rep@supplier.com"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mb-1">
                    Notes / Pickup Instructions (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, notes: e.target.value }))}
                    placeholder="e.g. Consolidate weekly pickups every Tuesday"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSaving}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {isSaving ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save to Directory'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* Directory List */}
          {isLoading && contacts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
              <span className="font-bold">Loading supplier contacts...</span>
            </div>
          ) : filteredContacts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl text-slate-500 space-y-2">
              <BookOpen className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                {searchTerm ? `No suppliers matching "${searchTerm}"` : 'No supplier email contacts saved yet.'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px]">
                Add contacts manually above, or enter any Supplier Email inside the 4-Choice Wizard / + Set Supplier &amp; Email to auto-save it here.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            isDesktopMd ? (
              <div className="border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 min-w-[160px]">Supplier / Contact</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 min-w-[200px]">Primary Email(s) (TO)</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 min-w-[180px]">CC Email(s)</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">Last Updated</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                    {filteredContacts.map((c) => (
                      <tr key={c.id || c.supplier_name} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 align-top">
                          <div className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{c.supplier_name}</div>
                          {c.contact_person && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                              <User className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>{c.contact_person}</span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {c.notes && (
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 italic mt-0.5">{c.notes}</div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 align-top break-words">
                          {c.email_to || <span className="text-slate-400 italic">None</span>}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 align-top break-words">
                          {c.email_cc || <span className="text-slate-400 italic">None</span>}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 align-top whitespace-nowrap">
                          {c.updated_at ? formatDateTimeYmdHm(c.updated_at) : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right align-top whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleStartEdit(c)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                              title={`Edit ${c.supplier_name}`}
                            >
                              <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={deletingId === (c.id || c.supplier_name)}
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(c)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:hover:bg-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                              title={`Delete ${c.supplier_name}`}
                            >
                              {deletingId === (c.id || c.supplier_name) ? (
                                <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                              ) : (
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              )}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {filteredContacts.map((c) => (
                  <div
                    key={`mob-${c.id || c.supplier_name}`}
                    className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 space-y-2"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="font-black text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white break-words">{c.supplier_name}</div>
                        {c.contact_person && (
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                            <User className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{c.contact_person}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleStartEdit(c)}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                          title={`Edit ${c.supplier_name}`}
                        >
                          <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={deletingId === (c.id || c.supplier_name)}
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(c)}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:hover:bg-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                          title={`Delete ${c.supplier_name}`}
                        >
                          {deletingId === (c.id || c.supplier_name) ? (
                            <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1 text-[11px]">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400 mr-1.5">TO:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 break-all">{c.email_to || 'None'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400 mr-1.5">CC:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 break-all">{c.email_cc || 'None'}</span>
                      </div>
                      {c.notes && (
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 italic">{c.notes}</div>
                      )}
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 pt-0.5">
                        Updated: {c.updated_at ? formatDateTimeYmdHm(c.updated_at) : '—'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/SupplierDirectoryModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/SupplierFollowUpModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Building2,
  Mail,
  Send,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  Save,
  FlaskConical,
  Loader2,
  ShieldCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import SupplierInput from './SupplierInput';
import FollowUpTimelineCard from './FollowUpTimelineCard';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';
import { notificationService } from '../services/notificationService';
import { supplierDirectoryService } from '../services/supplierDirectoryService';
import { formatQuantityWithPackSize, isTestRecord } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import {
  computeFourStepWorkflow,
  resolveReportPartyAndEmails,
  isPlaceholderSupplier,
  FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS
} from '../utils/followUpWorkflow';

export default function SupplierFollowUpModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  report,
  catalogProducts = [],
  isTestMode = false,
  currentUser = null,
  onUpdated = null,
  onShowToast = null
}) {
  const [supplierName, setSupplierName] = useState('');
  const [supplierEmailTo, setSupplierEmailTo] = useState('');
  const [supplierEmailCc, setSupplierEmailCc] = useState('');
  const [followUpEnabled, setFollowUpEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isClosing, setIsClosing] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !report) return;
    let active = true;
    const party = resolveReportPartyAndEmails(report, catalogProducts);
    const defaultCfg = notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig();
    const wf = computeFourStepWorkflow(report, catalogProducts, {
      customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: defaultCfg.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled,
      testStepIntervalSeconds: defaultCfg.testStepIntervalSeconds
    });
    const cleanSup = isPlaceholderSupplier(party.supplierName) ? '' : party.supplierName;
    const dirMatch = cleanSup ? supplierDirectoryService.findBySupplierName(cleanSup) : null;

    setSupplierName(cleanSup);
    setSupplierEmailTo(party.supplierEmailTo || dirMatch?.email_to || '');
    setSupplierEmailCc(party.supplierEmailCc || dirMatch?.email_cc || '');
    setFollowUpEnabled(Boolean(wf.followUpEnabled));
    setFeedback(null);

    supplierDirectoryService.loadDirectory().then(() => {
      if (!active || !cleanSup) return;
      const freshMatch = supplierDirectoryService.findBySupplierName(cleanSup);
      if (freshMatch) {
        setSupplierEmailTo((prev) => prev.trim() ? prev : (freshMatch.email_to || ''));
        setSupplierEmailCc((prev) => prev.trim() ? prev : (freshMatch.email_cc || ''));
      }
    }).catch(() => { });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isOpen, report?.id, report?.rma_number]);

  const recordIsTest = useMemo(
    () => Boolean(isTestMode || (report && isTestRecord(report))),
    [isTestMode, report]
  );

  const wfPreview = useMemo(() => {
    if (!report) return null;
    const defaultCfg = notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig();
    return computeFourStepWorkflow(
      {
        ...report,
        supplier_name: supplierName.trim() || report.supplier_name,
        ai_document_metadata: {
          ...(report.ai_document_metadata || {}),
          follow_up: {
            ...(report.ai_document_metadata?.follow_up || {}),
            supplier_email_to: supplierEmailTo,
            supplier_email_cc: supplierEmailCc,
            enabled: followUpEnabled
          }
        }
      },
      catalogProducts,
      {
        customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: defaultCfg.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled,
        testStepIntervalSeconds: defaultCfg.testStepIntervalSeconds
      }
    );
  }, [report, supplierName, supplierEmailTo, supplierEmailCc, followUpEnabled, catalogProducts]);

  if (!isOpen || !report || !wfPreview) return null;

  const actorName = currentUser?.full_name || currentUser?.email || 'Admin';
  const sandboxEmail = notificationService.getTestSandboxEmail();

  const handleSupplierNameChange = (nextVal) => {
    setSupplierName(nextVal);
    const dirMatch = supplierDirectoryService.findBySupplierName(nextVal);
    if (dirMatch) {
      setSupplierEmailTo((prev) => prev.trim() ? prev : (dirMatch.email_to || ''));
      setSupplierEmailCc((prev) => prev.trim() ? prev : (dirMatch.email_cc || ''));
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    const cleanSup = supplierName.trim();
    if (!cleanSup) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Please enter a valid Supplier / Vendor Name.' });
      return null;
    }
    setIsSaving(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const saved = await catalogService.saveSupplierAndFollowUpSettings(report, {
        supplier_name: cleanSup,
        supplier_email_to: supplierEmailTo.trim(),
        supplier_email_cc: supplierEmailCc.trim(),
        followUpEnabled,
        actorName
      });
      await supplierDirectoryService.upsertFromSubmission({
        supplier_name: cleanSup,
        supplier_email_to: supplierEmailTo.trim(),
        supplier_email_cc: supplierEmailCc.trim()
      }).catch(() => { });
      setFeedback({
        type: 'success',
        message: `Saved supplier "${cleanSup}" and contact email(s)${followUpEnabled ? ' — 10-Calendar-Day follow-up countdown active.' : ' — Auto daily follow-up paused.'}`
      });
      onShowToast?.(`Updated supplier & email details for ${report.rma_number}`, 'success');
      onUpdated?.(saved);
      return saved;
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err?.message || 'Failed to save supplier & email details.' });
      return null;
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCloseCase = async () => {
    setIsClosing(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const saved = await catalogService.closeFollowUpCase(report, {
        markPickedUp: true,
        reason: wfPreview.isSupplierStream ? 'Picked Up — Case Closed' : 'Handover Completed — Case Closed',
        actorName
      });
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: `${report.rma_number} marked Picked Up / Case Closed. Countdown stopped.` });
      onShowToast?.(`${report.rma_number} Case Closed.`, 'success');
      onUpdated?.(saved);
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err?.message || 'Failed to close case.' });
    } finally {
      setIsClosing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl max-w-2xl w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92vh]">
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-950/60">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200">
                {report.rma_number}
              </span>
              {recordIsTest && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700">
                  <FlaskConical className="w-3 h-3" /> TEST ({sandboxEmail})
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              <span>Set Supplier &amp; Email Details</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate max-w-md">
              {report.name || report.barcode} • {formatQuantityWithPackSize(report.quantity || 1, report.unit_name || 'pc', report.pieces_per_case)}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close supplier follow-up modal"
            className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto text-xs">
          {/* Supplier Name */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
              Supplier / Vendor Name *
            </label>
            <SupplierInput
              id="followup-modal-supplier-input"
              name="followUpSupplierName"
              value={supplierName}
              onChange={handleSupplierNameChange}
              placeholder="Search or type vendor / manufacturer (e.g. Mondelez, URC)..."
              className="w-full"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Supplier Emails */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
                Supplier Email (To)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                aria-label="Supplier Primary Email(s) (TO)"
                value={supplierEmailTo}
                onChange={(e) => setSupplierEmailTo(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="claims@supplier.com, rtv@supplier.com"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs font-mono outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
                Supplier Email (CC) (Optional)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                aria-label="Supplier CC Email(s) (Optional)"
                value={supplierEmailCc}
                onChange={(e) => setSupplierEmailCc(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="coordinator@supplier.com"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-xs font-mono outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
            Saved values automatically populate whenever you open Debit Claim or Replacement in the 4-Choice Wizard, and are stored in the persistent Supplier Emails Directory.
          </p>

          {/* 10-Calendar-Day SLA Toggle */}
          <label className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/70 bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/30 cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label="Auto Daily Follow-Up (10-Day SLA)"
              checked={followUpEnabled}
              onChange={(e) => setFollowUpEnabled(e.target.checked)}
              className="mt-0.5 rounded border-amber-400 text-amber-600 focus:ring-amber-500"
            />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <div className="font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                <span>Auto Daily Follow-Up (10-Day SLA): {followUpEnabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-900/80 dark:text-amber-300/80 leading-relaxed">
                Starts a <strong>10-calendar-day pickup countdown</strong> (Asia/Manila). Sends daily pickup reminders with proof photos &amp; the health/sanitation notice, stops immediately when Picked Up / Closed, and automatically marks overdue items <strong>Scrapped / Disposed</strong> after Day 10.
              </p>
            </div>
          </label>

          {/* Full 4-Step & 10-Day Timeline */}
          <FollowUpTimelineCard
            report={report}
            catalogProducts={catalogProducts}
            workflow={wfPreview}
            compact={true}
          />

          {wfPreview.isExpiredAfter10Days && !wfPreview.isClosed && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200 flex items-start gap-2 font-bold">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-rose-600" />
              <span>
                Overdue ({wfPreview.calendarDay} calendar days elapsed). Running Follow-Up Check will auto-dispose this RMA and notify configured New RMA Alert recipients.
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {feedback && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border font-bold flex items-center gap-2 ${feedback.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
              : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'
              }`}>
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{feedback.message}</span>
            </div>
          )}

        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-950/60 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold text-xs hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {!wfPreview.isClosed && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCloseCase}
                disabled={isClosing || isSaving}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isClosing ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span>✓ Case Close</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={isSaving || isClosing}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isSaving ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              <span>Save Supplier &amp; Email</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/SupplierInput.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Building2, Check, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';

const DEFAULT_SUPPLIER_INPUT_CLASS =
  'w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 shadow-2xs transition-all';

/**
 * Modern Autocomplete Input for Supplier Names
 * - Automatically loads existing suppliers from catalog and RMA returns
 * - Shows instantaneous match suggestions (e.g. typing "Save" suggests "Savemore")
 * - Prevents discrepancies like Savemore vs Save More vs savemore
 */
export default function SupplierInput({
  value = '',
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'e.g. Savemore, Walter Mart, Mondelez',
  className = DEFAULT_SUPPLIER_INPUT_CLASS,
  id = 'supplier-name-input',
  name = 'supplierName',
  required = false
}) {
  const [knownSuppliers, setKnownSuppliers] = useState([
    'Savemore',
    'Walter Mart',
    'SM Supermarket',
    'Puregold',
    'Robinsons Supermarket',
    'Mondelez',
    'Universal Robina Corporation (URC)',
    'Bonita',
    'Keysys',
    'A2Z2GO',
    'Pingcon Marketing'
  ]);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [highlightedIndex, setHighlightedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const wrapperRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    catalogService.getUniqueSuppliers().then(list => {
      if (mounted && Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
        setKnownSuppliers(list);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Close on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const cleanValue = String(value || '').trim();
  const cleanLower = cleanValue.toLowerCase();

  // Find matches that contain the query
  const matchingSuppliers = knownSuppliers.filter(s => {
    if (!cleanLower) return true;
    return s.toLowerCase().includes(cleanLower);
  });

  // Check if there is a primary suggestion that doesn't exactly match what was typed
  const topSuggestion = matchingSuppliers.find(
    s => s.toLowerCase() !== cleanLower && s.toLowerCase().startsWith(cleanLower)
  ) || matchingSuppliers.find(s => s.toLowerCase() !== cleanLower);

  const handleSelect = (supplier) => {
    onChange(supplier);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setHighlightedIndex(-1);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (!isOpen || matchingSuppliers.length === 0) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        setIsOpen(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev < matchingSuppliers.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : matchingSuppliers.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && matchingSuppliers[highlightedIndex]) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(matchingSuppliers[highlightedIndex]);
      } else if (topSuggestion) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(topSuggestion);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      <div className="relative">
        <input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="text"
          autoComplete="off"
          list="known-suppliers-datalist"
          value={value}
          required={required}
          onChange={(e) => {
            onChange(e.target.value);
            setIsOpen(true);
            setHighlightedIndex(-1);
          }}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className={(className && /\bborder\b|\bborder-/.test(className))
            ? className
            : `${DEFAULT_SUPPLIER_INPUT_CLASS} ${className || ''}`.trim()}
        />

        <datalist id="known-suppliers-datalist">
          {knownSuppliers.map((s) => (
            <option key={s} value={s} />
          ))}
        </datalist>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Suggestion Pill when typing (e.g. typing "Save" suggests "Savemore") */}
      {cleanValue && topSuggestion && cleanLower !== topSuggestion.toLowerCase() && (
        <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] animate-in fade-in">
          <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Suggestion:</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSelect(topSuggestion)}
            className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
            title={`Auto-fill "${topSuggestion}" to prevent discrepancy`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Use "{topSuggestion}"</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Dropdown of Matching Suppliers */}
      {isOpen && matchingSuppliers.length > 0 && cleanValue && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl z-50 overflow-hidden max-h-56 overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          <div className="p-1.5">
            <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Recorded Suppliers</span>
              <span>{matchingSuppliers.length} match{matchingSuppliers.length > 1 ? 'es' : ''}</span>
            </div>
            {matchingSuppliers.slice(0, 8).map((supplier, idx) => {
              const isSelected = supplier.toLowerCase() === cleanLower;
              const isHighlighted = idx === highlightedIndex;

              return (
                <button
                  key={supplier}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(supplier)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    isHighlighted || isSelected
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold'
                      : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Building2 className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                    <span>{supplier}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/SupplierInput.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/SupplierPickupFormModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { X, Printer, Scissors, CheckCircle2, FileCheck2, FolderOpen, Layers, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';
import { buildPickupFormCopiesList } from '../utils/pickupFormPdf';
import {
  formatPeso,
  getConsolidatedPickupItems,
  formatFourChoiceOutcome,
  formatDateTimeYmdHm,
  formatSaveFileTimestamp,
  isTestRecord,
  getPickupPhotosSummary
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

const isPlaceholderSupplier = (val) => {
  const s = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return !s || s === 'pending assignment' || s === 'pending' || s === 'unassigned' || s === 'warehouse' || s === 'n/a';
};

const clampCopies = (val) => {
  const parsed = parseInt(val, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(10, parsed));
};

/**
 * Unified Letter-Size (8.5" x 11") Handover, Debit Claim, Buffer Replacement & Driver Pickup Form.
 * - Pure black & white outline layout (#ffffff background, #000000 ink & borders only).
 * - Automatically distinguishes Customer Hub (`customer_inbound`) vs Supplier RTV (`supplier_outbound`).
 * - Page Separation & Customizable Copy Count:
 *   - Separated Full Pages (auto-selected when items >= 4 or copy count !== 1+1): dedicated page breaks, no clipping, repeating thead.
 *   - Combined 1-Page (Cut at 50%): 1 Our Company Copy + 1 Counterparty Copy on one US Letter sheet with overflow warning when items >= 4.
 */
export default function SupplierPickupFormModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  report = null,
  reports = [],
  allReports = [],
  catalogProducts = []
}) {
  const effectiveReports = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = Array.isArray(reports) && reports.length > 0 ? reports : (report ? [report] : []);
    const seen = new Set();
    return raw.filter((r) => {
      if (!r) return false;
      const k = String(r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || r.id || '');
      if (!k || seen.has(k)) return false;
      seen.add(k);
      return true;
    });
  }, [report, reports]);

  const primaryReport = effectiveReports[0] || null;

  // Always declare ALL React hooks unconditionally before any early returns
  const [layoutMode, setLayoutMode] = useState('separated'); // 'separated' | 'combined'
  const [combineIdentical, setCombineIdentical] = useState(true);
  const [ourCopyCount, setOurCopyCount] = useState(1);
  const [otherCopyCount, setOtherCopyCount] = useState(1);
  const [preparedBy, setPreparedBy] = useState('');

  const {
    items: normalizedItems,
    rawCount: rawLineCount,
    hasCombinableDuplicates
  } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!primaryReport) {
      return { items: [], rawCount: 0, hasCombinableDuplicates: false };
    }
    return getConsolidatedPickupItems({
      report: primaryReport,
      reports: effectiveReports,
      allReports,
      catalogProducts,
      combineIdentical
    });
  }, [primaryReport, effectiveReports, allReports, catalogProducts, combineIdentical]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !primaryReport) return;
    setCombineIdentical(true);
    setOurCopyCount(1);
    setOtherCopyCount(1);
    const initialItems = getConsolidatedPickupItems({
      report: primaryReport,
      reports: effectiveReports,
      allReports,
      catalogProducts,
      combineIdentical: true
    }).items;
    setLayoutMode(initialItems.length >= 4 ? 'separated' : 'combined');
    const pickupMeta = primaryReport?.ai_document_metadata?.supplier_pickup || {};
    const initialPrepared = String(pickupMeta.processed_by || '')
      .replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '')
      .trim();
    setPreparedBy(initialPrepared);
  }, [isOpen, primaryReport?.id, primaryReport?.rma_number, effectiveReports.length]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (!isOpen || !primaryReport) return null;

  const meta = primaryReport.ai_document_metadata || {};
  const pickup = meta.supplier_pickup || {};
  const outcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(primaryReport);
  const preparedDateTime = formatDateTimeYmdHm(
    pickup.updated_at ||
    pickup.picked_up_at ||
    meta.simple_rtv_updated_at ||
    new Date()
  );

  const isBatch = effectiveReports.length > 1;
  const rmaNumbersList = effectiveReports
    .map((r) => r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || String(r.id || ''))
    .filter(Boolean);
  const rmaNumber = primaryReport.rma_number || primaryReport.rmaNumber || primaryReport.id || 'N/A';
  const rmaDisplayHeadline = isBatch
    ? `${effectiveReports.length} Consolidated RMAs (${rmaNumbersList[0]} + ${effectiveReports.length - 1})`
    : rmaNumber;
  const isTest = effectiveReports.some((r) => isTestRecord(r));
  const isCustomerStream = primaryReport.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound';
  const isSupplierStream = !isCustomerStream;

  const bc = String(primaryReport.barcode || '').trim();
  const skuCode = String(primaryReport.code || primaryReport.sku || '').trim();
  const matchedCatalogProd = (catalogProducts || []).find((p) =>
    (bc && p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === bc) ||
    (skuCode && (String(p.code || '').trim() === skuCode || String(p.sku || '').trim() === skuCode))
  );

  const partyCandidates = isCustomerStream
    ? [
        pickup.customer_name,
        !isPlaceholderSupplier(pickup.supplier_name) ? pickup.supplier_name : '',
        primaryReport.store_branch,
        primaryReport.customer_name,
        primaryReport.reporter_name
      ]
    : [
        pickup.supplier_name,
        primaryReport.supplier_name,
        primaryReport.supplierName,
        primaryReport.supplier,
        matchedCatalogProd?.supplier_name,
        matchedCatalogProd?.supplierName
      ];
  const partyDisplayName = partyCandidates.find((cand) => !isPlaceholderSupplier(cand))
    || (isCustomerStream ? 'Wholesale Customer' : 'Pending Assignment');

  const supplierEmailTo = pickup.supplier_email_to || '';
  const supplierEmailCc = pickup.supplier_email_cc || '';
  const claimNumber = outcome.claimNumber || pickup.claim_number || '';
  const driverName = pickup.driver_name || primaryReport.driver_name || '';
  const driverIdType = pickup.driver_id_type || '';
  const driverLicense = pickup.driver_license_no || '';
  const formattedDriverIdDisplay = driverLicense
    ? (driverIdType ? `${driverIdType}: ${driverLicense}` : driverLicense)
    : (driverIdType ? `${driverIdType}: ___________________` : '__________________________');
  const truckPlate = pickup.truck_plate || '';
  const driveUrl = primaryReport.google_drive_folder_url || pickup.drive_folder_url || '';
  const pickupPhotosStats = getPickupPhotosSummary(pickup.photos);
  const photoSlotCount = pickupPhotosStats.slotCount;
  const photoTotalCount = pickupPhotosStats.totalPhotos;

  const dispositionCode = String(pickup.disposition || meta.simple_rtv_disposition || primaryReport.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  const isReplacementForm =
    dispositionCode === 'supplier_exchange' ||
    dispositionCode === 'customer_exchange' ||
    outcome.choiceKey === 'replacement';

  const formHeaderTitle = isCustomerStream
    ? (isReplacementForm
      ? 'CUSTOMER BUFFER REPLACEMENT & HANDOVER FORM'
      : 'CUSTOMER CREDIT MEMO / RETURN HANDOVER FORM')
    : (isReplacementForm
      ? 'SUPPLIER REPLACEMENT / EXCHANGE & PICKUP FORM'
      : 'SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIM & PICKUP VALIDATION FORM');

  const claimPurposeLabel = isCustomerStream
    ? (isReplacementForm
      ? '1-to-1 Buffer Replacement / Good Stock Exchange with Customer'
      : 'Customer Return Accepted for Credit Memo / Account Deduction')
    : (isReplacementForm
      ? 'Return to Supplier for Replacement / Exchange'
      : 'Return to Supplier for Debit Claim / AP Deduction');

  const refLineLabel = isCustomerStream
    ? (isReplacementForm ? `Buffer Ref #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}` : `Ref / CM #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}`)
    : (isReplacementForm ? `Replacement Ref #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}` : `Claim #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}`);

  const modalTitleLabel = isCustomerStream
    ? (isReplacementForm ? 'Customer Buffer Replacement Form' : 'Customer Credit Return Handover Form')
    : (isReplacementForm ? 'Replacement & Pickup Form' : 'Debit Claim & Pickup Form');

  const grandTotalPieces = normalizedItems.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.totalPieces, 0);
  const grandTotalValue = normalizedItems.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.lineTotal, 0);

  const copiesList = buildPickupFormCopiesList({
    ourCopyCount,
    otherCopyCount,
    isCustomerStream
  });
  const totalCopiesCount = copiesList.length;

  const canUseCombinedOnePage =
    layoutMode === 'combined' &&
    ourCopyCount === 1 &&
    otherCopyCount === 1 &&
    totalCopiesCount === 2;
  const isCompactMode = canUseCombinedOnePage;
  const showCombinedOverflowWarning =
    canUseCombinedOnePage &&
    (normalizedItems.length >= 4 || isBatch);

  const handleApplyCopyPreset = (ours, others) => {
    setOurCopyCount(ours);
    setOtherCopyCount(others);
    if (ours + others !== 2 || ours !== 1 || others !== 1 || normalizedItems.length >= 4) {
      setLayoutMode('separated');
    }
  };

  const handlePrintLetter = () => {
    if (totalCopiesCount === 0) return;

    const docSlug = isCustomerStream
      ? (isReplacementForm ? 'Customer-Buffer-Replacement-Form' : 'Customer-Credit-Handover-Form')
      : (isReplacementForm ? 'RMA-Replacement-Pickup' : 'RMA-Debit-Claim-Pickup');

    const compactStyles = `
      @media print {
        #letter-supplier-pickup-form {
          width: 8.5in !important;
          height: 10.95in !important;
          max-width: 8.5in !important;
          margin: 0 auto !important;
          padding: 0.35in 0.4in !important;
          display: flex !important;
          flex-direction: column !important;
          justify-content: space-between !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          color: #000000 !important;
          border: none !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
          overflow: hidden !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .pickup-copy-compact {
          height: 4.75in !important;
          max-height: 4.75in !important;
          overflow: hidden !important;
          padding: 0.14in 0.18in !important;
          border: 1.5px solid #000000 !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          color: #000000 !important;
          display: flex !important;
          flex-direction: column !important;
          justify-content: space-between !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .pickup-cut-line {
          height: 0.75in !important;
          margin: 0 !important;
          display: flex !important;
          align-items: center !important;
          justify-content: center !important;
        }
      }
    `;

    const fullPageStyles = `
      @media print {
        #letter-supplier-pickup-form {
          display: block !important;
          width: 7.7in !important;
          max-width: 7.7in !important;
          margin: 0 auto !important;
          padding: 0 !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          color: #000000 !important;
          border: none !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          max-height: none !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        .pickup-copy-full {
          display: block !important;
          width: 100% !important;
          height: auto !important;
          max-height: none !important;
          padding: 0.22in !important;
          border: 1.5px solid #000000 !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          color: #000000 !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        .pickup-copy-full table {
          width: 100% !important;
          border-collapse: collapse !important;
        }
        .pickup-copy-full thead {
          display: table-header-group !important;
        }
        .pickup-copy-full tr {
          break-inside: avoid !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .pickup-signatures-block {
          break-inside: avoid !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .pickup-copy-break {
          page-break-before: always !important;
          break-before: page !important;
          height: 0 !important;
          margin: 0 !important;
          padding: 0 !important;
          border: none !important;
          display: block !important;
        }
      }
    `;

    printIsolatedElement({
      elementId: 'letter-supplier-pickup-form',
      documentTitle: `${docSlug}-${claimNumber || rmaNumber} ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}`,
      pageSize: 'letter portrait',
      pageMargin: isCompactMode ? '0' : '0.4in',
      allowMultiPage: !isCompactMode,
      customStyles: `
        #letter-supplier-pickup-form, #letter-supplier-pickup-form * {
          color: #000000 !important;
          background-color: #ffffff !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
        }
        ${isCompactMode ? compactStyles : fullPageStyles}
      `
    });
  };

  const renderFormCopy = (copyTitle, layoutClass, keyPrefix = 'copy') => (
    <div
      key={keyPrefix}
      className={`${layoutClass} bg-white border-[1.5px] border-black text-black ${
        isCompactMode ? 'p-3 space-y-1.5 text-[9.5px]' : 'p-4 space-y-3 text-[11px]'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Top Header Strip — Pure B&W Outline */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 pb-1.5 border-b-[1.5px] border-black bg-white text-black">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 border-[1.5px] border-black bg-white text-black font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[8.5px]">
              {copyTitle}
            </span>
            {isBatch && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 border-[1.5px] border-black bg-white text-black font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[8.5px]">
                BATCH ({effectiveReports.length} RMAs)
              </span>
            )}
            {isTest && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 border-[1.5px] border-black bg-white text-black font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[8.5px]">
                [TEST MODE RECORD]
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <h3 className={`font-black tracking-tight text-black mt-1 leading-tight ${isCompactMode ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm'}`}>
            {formHeaderTitle}
          </h3>
          <div className="font-bold text-[9.5px] text-black mt-0.5">
            Purpose: {claimPurposeLabel}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="text-right shrink-0">
          <div className="text-[9px] font-black font-mono text-black">
            {refLineLabel}
          </div>
          <div className={`font-mono font-black text-black leading-tight ${isCompactMode ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm'}`}>
            {isBatch ? `Batch (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : `RMA #: ${rmaNumber}`}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[8.5px] text-black font-semibold">
            {outcome.formattedTime ? `${outcome.formattedTime} • ` : ''}
            {photoTotalCount > 0 && photoTotalCount !== photoSlotCount
              ? `${photoSlotCount}/5 Cats (${photoTotalCount} Photos) Verified`
              : `${photoSlotCount}/5 Drive Photos Verified`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Party (Customer / Store Branch OR Supplier), Driver, & Handwritten Fields — Pure B&W Box */}
      <div className={`grid grid-cols-12 gap-x-3 gap-y-1 border border-black bg-white text-black ${isCompactMode ? 'p-1.5' : 'p-2.5'}`}>
        <div className="col-span-6">
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black block">
            {isCustomerStream ? 'Customer / Store Branch Name' : 'Supplier Company Name'}
          </span>
          <span className={`font-black text-black break-words ${isCompactMode ? 'text-[10.5px]' : 'text-xs'}`}>
            {partyDisplayName}
          </span>
          {(supplierEmailTo || supplierEmailCc) && (
            <div className="text-[8px] text-black font-mono break-all mt-0.5">
              {supplierEmailTo ? `To: ${supplierEmailTo}` : ''}
              {supplierEmailTo && supplierEmailCc ? ' • ' : ''}
              {supplierEmailCc ? `CC: ${supplierEmailCc}` : ''}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="col-span-6">
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black block">Truck Plate #</span>
          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-black">
            {truckPlate || '__________________________'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="col-span-6">
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black block">Driver / Representative Name</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-black">
            {driverName || '_______________________________'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="col-span-6">
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black block">Valid PH Gov&apos;t / Legal ID #</span>
          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-black">
            {formattedDriverIdDisplay}
          </span>
        </div>
        {/* Handwritten blank lines for physical handover */}
        <div className="col-span-6 pt-1 border-t border-black">
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black block">
            Pickup Date &amp; Time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm) (Driver Writes)
          </span>
          <div className={`${isCompactMode ? 'h-3' : 'h-4'} border-b border-black mt-0.5`} />
        </div>
        <div className="col-span-6 pt-1 border-t border-black">
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black block">
            Driver Contact # (Driver Writes)
          </span>
          <div className={`${isCompactMode ? 'h-3' : 'h-4'} border-b border-black mt-0.5`} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Itemized Table — Pure B&W Outline & Repeating Header Support */}
      <div className="border border-black bg-white text-black">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-white text-black border-b-[1.5px] border-black text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
              <th className="py-1 px-1.5 border-r border-black w-6 text-center">#</th>
              <th className="py-1 px-1.5 border-r border-black">Item Description / SKU</th>
              <th className="py-1 px-1.5 border-r border-black text-center whitespace-nowrap">Expiry Date (YYYY-MM-DD)</th>
              <th className="py-1 px-1.5 border-r border-black text-right whitespace-nowrap">Qty (Converted to Pcs)</th>
              <th className="py-1 px-1.5 border-r border-black text-right whitespace-nowrap">Unit Price</th>
              <th className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Line Total</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {normalizedItems.map((it) => (
              <tr key={it.idx} className="align-top border-b border-black last:border-b-0 bg-white text-black">
                <td className="py-1 px-1.5 font-mono text-black text-center border-r border-black">{it.idx}</td>
                <td className="py-1 px-1.5 border-r border-black">
                  <div className="font-bold text-black leading-tight">{it.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-[8px] font-mono text-black">SKU: {it.sku}</div>
                  {(isBatch || (Array.isArray(it.rmaNumbers) && it.rmaNumbers.length > 1)) && Array.isArray(it.rmaNumbers) && it.rmaNumbers.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-black break-words">
                      {it.rmaNumbers.length > 1 ? `RMAs: ${it.rmaNumbers.join(', ')}` : `RMA: ${it.rmaNumbers[0]}`}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-center font-mono text-black whitespace-nowrap border-r border-black">
                  {it.expiry}
                </td>
                <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-black whitespace-nowrap border-r border-black">
                  {it.isCaseUnit && it.piecesPerCase > 1
                    ? `${it.totalPieces.toLocaleString()} pcs (${it.rawQty} ${it.unitName} × ${it.piecesPerCase})`
                    : `${it.totalPieces.toLocaleString()} ${it.unitName === 'pc' || it.totalPieces === 1 ? 'pc' : 'pcs'}`}
                </td>
                <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right font-mono text-black whitespace-nowrap border-r border-black">
                  {formatPeso(it.isCaseUnit && it.piecesPerCase > 1 ? it.pricePerPiece : it.recordedUnitPrice)}/pc
                </td>
                <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-black whitespace-nowrap">
                  {formatPeso(it.lineTotal)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
          <tfoot>
            <tr className="bg-white border-t-[1.5px] border-black font-black text-black">
              <td colSpan={3} className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right uppercase text-[9px] border-r border-black">
                Total Summary ({normalizedItems.length} line{normalizedItems.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}):
              </td>
              <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right font-mono whitespace-nowrap border-r border-black">
                {grandTotalPieces.toLocaleString()} pcs
              </td>
              <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right text-[8.5px] font-bold border-r border-black">
                Total Value:
              </td>
              <td className="py-1 px-1.5 text-right font-mono text-[10.5px] whitespace-nowrap">
                {formatPeso(grandTotalValue)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          </tfoot>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Signatures & Editable Prepared By Block — Pure B&W */}
      <div className="pickup-signatures-block grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-0.5 text-center bg-white text-black">
        <div className={`border border-black bg-white ${isCompactMode ? 'p-1.5' : 'p-2'}`}>
          <div className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black">
            Prepared By (Logistics / Warehouse)
          </div>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={preparedBy}
            onChange={(e) => setPreparedBy(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Staff Printed Name"
            className={`w-full text-center font-bold text-black bg-transparent border-0 border-b border-black focus:outline-none print:placeholder-transparent text-[10px] ${
              isCompactMode ? 'mt-3 pb-0.5' : 'mt-5 pb-1'
            }`}
            title="Click to edit Prepared By name"
          />
          <div className="text-[8px] text-black mt-0.5">Printed Name &amp; Date</div>
          <div className="text-[7.5px] font-mono font-bold text-black mt-0.5">
            Prepared Date &amp; Time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): {preparedDateTime}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={`border border-black bg-white ${isCompactMode ? 'p-1.5' : 'p-2'}`}>
          <div className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black">
            {isCustomerStream ? "Customer / Receiving Driver's Signature" : "Supplier Driver's Signature"}
          </div>
          <div className={`${isCompactMode ? 'mt-5' : 'mt-7'} border-b border-black`} />
          <div className="text-[8px] text-black mt-0.5">Signature Over Printed Name &amp; Date</div>
        </div>

        <div className={`border border-black bg-white ${isCompactMode ? 'p-1.5' : 'p-2'}`}>
          <div className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase text-black">
            Releasing Staff&apos;s Signature
          </div>
          <div className={`${isCompactMode ? 'mt-5' : 'mt-7'} border-b border-black`} />
          <div className="text-[8px] text-black mt-0.5">Verified &amp; Released (Sign &amp; Date)</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[95dvh] flex flex-col rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 overflow-hidden">

        {/* Top Modal Header */}
        <div className="shrink-0 bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 sm:px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 print:hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className="p-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-xl shrink-0">
              <FileCheck2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold truncate">
                Letter {modalTitleLabel} — {rmaDisplayHeadline}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-slate-300 truncate">
                8.5&quot; × 11&quot; Letter • Pure B&amp;W Ink-Saver ({totalCopiesCount} Copy Paper{totalCopiesCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}) • {outcome.label}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close form"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Non-Printed Page Separation & Customizable Copy Count Control Bar */}
        <div className="shrink-0 px-4 sm:px-6 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2 text-xs print:hidden">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>{outcome.label}</span>
              </span>

              <span
                className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-black border ${
                  isCompactMode
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700'
                    : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-700'
                }`}
              >
                {isCompactMode
                  ? `Combined 1-Page (${normalizedItems.length} item${normalizedItems.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} • Cut at 50%)`
                  : `Separated Full Pages (${totalCopiesCount} Paper${totalCopiesCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} • Repeating Headers)`}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              {(isBatch || rawLineCount > 1) && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCombineIdentical((prev) => !prev)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-black border flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    combineIdentical
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                  title="Automatically combine items sharing the exact same SKU, Unit Price, and Expiry Date"
                >
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span>
                    Auto-Combine Identical Items: {combineIdentical ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
                    {hasCombinableDuplicates ? (combineIdentical ? ` (${rawLineCount}→${normalizedItems.length})` : ` (${rawLineCount} rows)`) : ''}
                  </span>
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Page Separation Mode Selector */}
              <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 p-0.5 shadow-2xs">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setLayoutMode('separated')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    !isCompactMode
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                  title="Dedicated full US Letter sheet per copy with repeating headers & zero clipping"
                >
                  Separated Full Pages (Dedicated Paper per Copy)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setOurCopyCount(1);
                    setOtherCopyCount(1);
                    setLayoutMode('combined');
                  }}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    isCompactMode
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                  title="Fit 1 Our Company Copy + 1 Counterparty Copy onto 1 cut US Letter sheet"
                >
                  Combined 1-Page (Cut at 50%)
                </button>
              </div>

              {driveUrl && (
                <a
                  href={driveUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FolderOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Open RMA Drive Folder
                </a>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Customizable Copy Count Steppers & Presets */}
