            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                Paper Copies:
              </span>

              <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                <span>Our Company Copies:</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label="Our Company Copies"
                  min={0}
                  max={10}
                  value={ourCopyCount}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const nextVal = clampCopies(e.target.value);
                    setOurCopyCount(nextVal);
                    if (nextVal !== 1 || otherCopyCount !== 1) setLayoutMode('separated');
                  }}
                  className="w-11 text-center font-mono font-black bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                <span>{isCustomerStream ? 'Customer Copies:' : 'Supplier Copies:'}</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  aria-label={isCustomerStream ? 'Customer Copies' : 'Supplier Copies'}
                  min={0}
                  max={10}
                  value={otherCopyCount}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const nextVal = clampCopies(e.target.value);
                    setOtherCopyCount(nextVal);
                    if (ourCopyCount !== 1 || nextVal !== 1) setLayoutMode('separated');
                  }}
                  className="w-11 text-center font-mono font-black bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                />
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleApplyCopyPreset(1, 1)}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                1 + 1 (2 Papers)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleApplyCopyPreset(2, 1)}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                2 Ours + 1 Theirs (3 Papers)
              </button>
            </div>

            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              Total Output: {totalCopiesCount} Cop{totalCopiesCount === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {showCombinedOverflowWarning && (
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                Overflow Risk: {normalizedItems.length} item line(s) may clip inside a half-page 50% cut sheet. Switch to Separated Full Pages to avoid cut text.
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLayoutMode('separated')}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-[10px] font-black shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Use Separated Pages
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {totalCopiesCount === 0 && (
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>Total copy count is 0. Increase Our Company Copies or {isCustomerStream ? 'Customer' : 'Supplier'} Copies to at least 1 before printing.</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Letter Sheet Preview */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-3 sm:p-6 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-center">
          {totalCopiesCount === 0 ? (
            <div className="my-auto p-8 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-2 max-w-md">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-rose-500 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Copies Selected (0 Total Copies)</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Set Our Company Copies or {isCustomerStream ? 'Customer' : 'Supplier'} Copies to 1 or higher above to preview and print.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : isCompactMode ? (
            <div
              id="letter-supplier-pickup-form"
              className="w-full max-w-[816px] bg-white p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-lg border border-black my-auto flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              {renderFormCopy(copiesList[0].title, 'pickup-copy-compact', copiesList[0].key)}

              <div className="pickup-cut-line my-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-black">
                <div className="flex-1 border-t-[1.5px] border-dashed border-black" />
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 border border-dashed border-black bg-white text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-black shrink-0">
                  <Scissors className="w-3 h-3" />
                  {isCustomerStream
                    ? '✂ Cut Here (50%) — Separate Company & Customer Copies'
                    : '✂ Cut Here (50%) — Separate Company & Supplier Copies'}
                </span>
                <div className="flex-1 border-t-[1.5px] border-dashed border-black" />
              </div>

              {renderFormCopy(copiesList[1].title, 'pickup-copy-compact', copiesList[1].key)}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              id="letter-supplier-pickup-form"
              className="w-full max-w-[816px] bg-white p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-lg border border-black my-auto space-y-6"
            >
              {copiesList.map((cp, idx) => (
                <React.Fragment key={cp.key}>
                  {idx > 0 && (
                    <div className="pickup-copy-break border-t-2 border-dotted border-black pt-2 text-center text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-black print:hidden">
                      — Page Break Before {cp.title} —
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {renderFormCopy(cp.title, 'pickup-copy-full', cp.key)}
                </React.Fragment>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer Buttons */}
        <div className="shrink-0 p-3.5 sm:px-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 print:hidden">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hidden sm:block">
            Set printer paper size to <strong>Letter (8.5&quot; × 11&quot;)</strong> • Pure B&amp;W ink-saver output.
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 ml-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={totalCopiesCount === 0}
              onClick={handlePrintLetter}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-200 dark:text-slate-900 text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-black rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>
                {isCompactMode
                  ? 'Print Letter Dual-Copy Form'
                  : `Print Separated Letter Copies (${totalCopiesCount})`}
              </span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/TablePagination.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TablePagination({
  currentPage = 1,
  totalItems = 0,
  pageSize = 10,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = [10, 25, 50, 100],
  itemLabel = 'items'
}) {
  if (totalItems === 0) return null;

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize));
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const endIndex = Math.min(totalItems, currentPage * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold select-none rounded-b-2xl">
      {/* Left: Rows Per Page & Item Range */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Rows per page:</span>
          <select
            value={pageSize}
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (onPageSizeChange) onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value));
              if (onPageChange) onPageChange(1);
            }}
            className="px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
          >
            {pageSizeOptions.map(opt => (
              <option key={opt} value={opt}>{opt}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700">|</span>

        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          Showing <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{startIndex} - {endIndex}</strong> of <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{totalItems}</strong> {itemLabel}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Right: Page Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 self-end sm:self-auto">
        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mr-1.5">
          Page <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{currentPage}</strong> of <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{totalPages}</strong>
        </span>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
          disabled={currentPage <= 1}
          className="min-h-[44px] px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-white dark:disabled:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          title="Previous Page"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Prev</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
          disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
          className="min-h-[44px] px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-white dark:disabled:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          title="Next Page"
        >
          <span>Next</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  FlaskConical,
  Trash2,
  Copy,
  Check,
  FileText,
  Building2,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Terminal,
  ChevronDown,
  Zap,
  Clock,
  Play,
  RefreshCw,
  Sliders
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  isManifestSubItem,
  isBatchManifest,
  getReportManifestItems
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import {
  computeFourStepWorkflow,
  formatDurationCompact,
  normalizeTestStepIntervalSeconds
} from '../utils/followUpWorkflow';
import { notificationService, SETTINGS_SYNC_EVENT } from '../services/notificationService';
import CustomerHubTab from './CustomerHubTab';
import SupplierClaimsTab from './SupplierClaimsTab';
import { copyTextSafe } from '../utils/clipboard';

export default function TestModeSandboxTab({
  testReportsList = [],
  testCreditMemosList = [],
  savedProductsList = [],
  currentUser,
  coworkerQueueFilter = 'all',
  onClearCoworkerQueueFilter,
  updatingQueueId = null,
  activeSubTab: controlledSubTab,
  onSubTabChange,
  customerHubSubTab = 'returns',
  externalCustomerSubTab = null,
  onCustomerHubSubTabChange,
  onRefresh,
  onInspectTriage,
  onOpenQuickAction,
  onViewQR,
  onViewPhoto,
  onViewExplanation,
  onEditProductFromReport,
  onResetToPending,
  onConfirmCoworkerAction,
  onOpenReportsModal,
  onOpenMatrixExport,
  onArchiveReport,
  onBulkArchiveReports,
  onRequestDeleteReport,
  onRequestBulkDeleteReports,
  onClearAllSandbox,
  onAssignSku,
  onOpenCreateCreditMemo,
  onOpenCreditMemoForReport,
  onOpenCreditMemosLedger,
  onEditCreditMemo,
  onViewCreditMemoVoucher,
  onRequestDeleteCreditMemo,
  onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemos,
  onOpenSimpleWizard,
  onOpenPickupForm
}) {
  const [internalSubTab, setInternalSubTab] = useState('customer');
  const rawSubTab = controlledSubTab || internalSubTab;
  const activeSubTab = rawSubTab === 'supplier' ? 'supplier' : 'customer';
  const setActiveSubTab = (nextTab) => {
    const normalized = nextTab === 'supplier' ? 'supplier' : 'customer';
    if (onSubTabChange) {
      onSubTabChange(normalized);
    } else {
      setInternalSubTab(normalized);
    }
  };

  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState(null);
  const [showApiGuide, setShowApiGuide] = useState(false);

  // Isolated Test Mode Accelerated 10-Day SLA Speed & Live Countdown Ticker
  const [followUpConfig, setFollowUpConfig] = useState(() => notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig());
  const [autoTickEnabled, setAutoTickEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [isRunningTick, setIsRunningTick] = useState(false);
  const [tickFeedback, setTickFeedback] = useState(null);
  const [nowTick, setNowTick] = useState(() => new Date());
  const tickInFlightRef = useRef(false);
  const lastAutoTickAtRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncCfg = () => setFollowUpConfig(notificationService.getDailyFollowUpConfig());
    window.addEventListener(SETTINGS_SYNC_EVENT, syncCfg);
    window.addEventListener('storage', syncCfg);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(SETTINGS_SYNC_EVENT, syncCfg);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', syncCfg);
    };
  }, []);

  const testStepSec = normalizeTestStepIntervalSeconds(followUpConfig?.testStepIntervalSeconds || 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (testStepSec <= 0) return undefined;
    const id = setInterval(() => setNowTick(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [testStepSec]);

  const activeCountdownSummary = useMemo(() => {
    if (testStepSec <= 0) return null;
    const openCandidates = testReportsList.filter((r) => !isManifestSubItem(r, testReportsList));
    let activeCount = 0;
    let soonestNextStep = null;
    let dueStepCount = 0;
    let dueDisposeCount = 0;

    for (const r of openCandidates) {
      const wf = computeFourStepWorkflow(r, savedProductsList, {
        now: nowTick,
        customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: followUpConfig.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled,
        testStepIntervalSeconds: testStepSec
      });
      if (!wf.isCountdownActive || wf.isClosed) continue;
      activeCount++;
      if (wf.isExpiredAfter10Days) {
        dueDisposeCount++;
      } else if (wf.calendarDay >= 1 && !wf.alreadySentToday) {
        dueStepCount++;
      }
      if (!wf.isExpiredAfter10Days) {
        if (soonestNextStep === null || wf.nextStepInSeconds < soonestNextStep) {
          soonestNextStep = wf.nextStepInSeconds;
        }
      }
    }

    return { activeCount, soonestNextStep, dueStepCount, dueDisposeCount };
  }, [testReportsList, savedProductsList, nowTick, followUpConfig.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled, testStepSec]);

  const handleRunTestSlaTick = async (sourceLabel = 'manual') => {
    if (tickInFlightRef.current) return;
    tickInFlightRef.current = true;
    setIsRunningTick(true);
    try {
      const res = await notificationService.runDailyFollowUpNow({
        isTestMode: true,
        force: false,
        dryRun: false,
        operation: 'run_all',
        respectSchedule: false
      });
      if (res?.success) {
        const sent = Number(res?.summary?.followUpsSent || 0);
        const disposed = Number(res?.summary?.autoDisposed || 0);
        const skipped = Number(res?.summary?.skippedCount || 0);
        setTickFeedback({
          type: 'success',
          text: `${sourceLabel === 'auto' ? 'Auto-Tick' : 'Test SLA Tick'}: ${sent} follow-up(s) sent, ${disposed} auto-disposed (${skipped} waiting/up-to-date).`
        });
        if (sent > 0 || disposed > 0) {
          onRefresh?.();
        }
      } else {
        setTickFeedback({
          type: 'error',
          text: res?.error || 'Failed running Test SLA tick.'
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setTickFeedback({ type: 'error', text: err?.message || 'Error triggering Test SLA tick.' });
    } finally {
      tickInFlightRef.current = false;
      setIsRunningTick(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoTickEnabled || testStepSec <= 0 || !activeCountdownSummary) return;
    if (activeCountdownSummary.dueStepCount === 0 && activeCountdownSummary.dueDisposeCount === 0) return;
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    if (nowMs - lastAutoTickAtRef.current < 8000) return;
    lastAutoTickAtRef.current = nowMs;
    handleRunTestSlaTick('auto');
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [autoTickEnabled, testStepSec, activeCountdownSummary?.dueStepCount, activeCountdownSummary?.dueDisposeCount]);

  const handleQuickSelectSpeed = async (seconds) => {
    const saved = await notificationService.saveDailyFollowUpConfig({
      ...followUpConfig,
      testStepIntervalSeconds: seconds
    });
    setFollowUpConfig(saved);
    setTickFeedback({
      type: 'success',
      text: seconds > 0
        ? `Sandbox SLA speed set to ${formatDurationCompact(seconds)} per simulated day (Live RMAs unaffected).`
        : 'Sandbox SLA speed reset to Normal (1 Manila calendar day).'
    });
  };

  const canManage = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  // Top-level counts mirroring CustomerHubTab & SupplierClaimsTab predicates
  const sandboxCustomerCount = useMemo(() => {
    return testReportsList.filter(
      (r) => r.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound' && !isManifestSubItem(r, testReportsList)
    ).length;
  }, [testReportsList]);

  const sandboxSupplierCount = useMemo(() => {
    return testReportsList.filter((r) => {
      if (isManifestSubItem(r, testReportsList)) return false;
      const isExplicitSupplier = r.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
      if (isExplicitSupplier) return true;
      if (isBatchManifest(r, testReportsList)) {
        const children = getReportManifestItems(r, testReportsList);
        return children.some((c) => {
          const cDisp = String(c?.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
          return c?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' || cDisp.includes('rtv') || cDisp.includes('vendor') || cDisp.includes('supplier_credit') || cDisp.includes('supplier_exchange');
        });
      }
      const disp = String(r.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
      return disp.includes('rtv') || disp.includes('vendor') || disp.includes('supplier exchange') || disp.includes('supplier credit') || disp.includes('supplier_credit') || disp.includes('supplier_exchange');
    }).length;
  }, [testReportsList]);

  const totalSandboxRecords = testReportsList.length + testCreditMemosList.length;

  const copyToClipboard = (text, key) => {
    copyTextSafe(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  const curlGetRestock = `curl -X GET "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma?test_mode=true&queue=restock" \\
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_SECRET_API_KEY"`;

  const curlPostTest = `curl -X POST "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma" \\
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_SECRET_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{
    "is_test": true,
    "barcode": "4800016644833",
    "name": "Oishi Prawn Crackers 50g",
    "quantity": 5,
    "disposition": "Restock to Inventory",
    "warehouse_location": "Good Stock Area"
  }'`;

  const curlPatchRestock = `curl -X PATCH "https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/api/v1/rma/RMA-ID-HERE" \\
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_SECRET_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{
    "status": "restocked",
    "warehouse_location": "Good Stock Area",
    "notes": "Added to inventory counts in WMS"
  }'`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* 1. Coworker API Sandbox Guide Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/15 via-orange-500/10 to-amber-500/5 dark:from-amber-950/40 dark:via-orange-950/30 dark:to-slate-900 border-2 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">

              )}

              <button
                type="button"

                disabled={isRunningTick}

                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'

        {/* cURL Quick-Copy Cards */}
        {showApiGuide && (

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => copyToClipboard(curlGetRestock, 'get')}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {copiedKey === 'get' ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                  <span>{copiedKey === 'get' ? 'Copied' : 'Copy cURL'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <pre className="text-[9px] font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-2 rounded-xl overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre">
                {curlGetRestock}
              </pre>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/80 rounded-2xl p-3 space-y-1.5 shadow-2xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 font-mono">2. Ingest Test Return</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => copyToClipboard(curlPostTest, 'post')}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {copiedKey === 'post' ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                  <span>{copiedKey === 'post' ? 'Copied' : 'Copy cURL'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <pre className="text-[9px] font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-2 rounded-xl overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre">
                {curlPostTest}
              </pre>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/80 rounded-2xl p-3 space-y-1.5 shadow-2xs">

                <button

                  onClick={() => copyToClipboard(curlPatchRestock, 'patch')}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"

                </button>
              </div>

                {curlPatchRestock}

        <button
          type="button"

            activeSubTab === 'customer'
              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
        >
          <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>Sandbox Customer RMAs ({sandboxCustomerCount})</span>

          type="button"

              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
        >
          <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>Sandbox Supplier RTVs ({sandboxSupplierCount})</span>

          coworkerQueueFilter={coworkerQueueFilter}

--- START FILE: src/components/TicketsVaultTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Search, 
  Filter, 
  Download, 
  QrCode, 
  Building2, 
  Package, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  ExternalLink,
  MapPin,
  ChevronDown,
  Hash
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPeso, getEmailRoutingPayload, formatDateYmd, formatSaveFileTimestamp } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { downloadTableXlsx } from '../utils/exportXlsx';

export default function TicketsVaultTab({ 
  tickets = [], 
  onUpdateTicketStatus, 
  onOpenTicketModal, 
  isTestMode = false 
}) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [selectedGroup, setSelectedGroup] = useState('ALL');
  const [expandedTicketId, setExpandedTicketId] = useState(null);

  // Status badge styling helper
  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'Credit Memo Issued':
        return 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30';
      case 'Buffer Replacement':
        return 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30';
      case 'Approved':
        return 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30';
      case 'In Transit':
        return 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30';
      case 'Rejected':
        return 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  // Filtered tickets
  const filteredTickets = useMemo(() => {
    return tickets.filter(ticket => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        ticket.id?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.customer_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.product_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.ae_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

      const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'ALL' || ticket.status === statusFilter;
      const matchesGroup = selectedGroup === 'ALL' || ticket.group?.includes(selectedGroup);

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesGroup;
    });
  }, [tickets, searchTerm, statusFilter, selectedGroup]);

  // Export to genuine Excel (.xlsx)
  const handleExportXlsx = () => {
    const columns = [
      { header: 'Serial No.', width: 11, type: 'number' },
      { header: 'Ticket ID', width: 18, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Date', width: 14, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Customer', width: 24, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Branch', width: 22, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Product', width: 34, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'SKU', width: 16, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Brand', width: 18, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Serial Numbers', width: 22, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Qty', width: 10, type: 'number' },
      { header: 'Unit Price', width: 14, type: 'currency' },
      { header: 'Total Value (PHP)', width: 18, type: 'currency' },
      { header: 'Status', width: 16, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Defect Category', width: 22, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'AE Name', width: 20, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Credit Memo #', width: 18, type: 'text' },
      { header: 'Supplier', width: 22, type: 'text' }
    ];

    const rows = filteredTickets.map((t, idx) => [
      idx + 1,
      t.id || '',
      t.created_at ? formatDateYmd(t.created_at) : '',
      t.customer_name || '',
      t.store_branch || '',
      t.product_name || '',
      t.sku || '',
      t.brand || '',
      t.serial_numbers || '',
      Number(t.quantity || 0),
      Number(t.unit_price || 0),
      Number(t.total_amount || 0),
      t.status || '',
      t.defect_category || '',
      t.ae_name || '',
      t.credit_memo_no || '',
      t.supplier || ''
    ]);

    downloadTableXlsx({
      sheetName: 'RMA Vault',
      filename: `RMA_Vault_Export ${formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date())}.xlsx`,
      columns,
      rows
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header & Stats Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>RMA Tickets Vault</span>
            <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-300 font-mono font-bold">
              {filteredTickets.length} of {tickets.length} Records
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Complete archive of wholesale returns, return authorization QR codes, and resolution audit trail.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleExportXlsx}
          className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center space-x-2 transition-colors shadow-sm"
        >
          <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
          <span>Export Vault (.xlsx)</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search Ticket ID, SKU, Customer..."
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Status Filter */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
            <option value="Pending Inspection">Pending Inspection</option>
            <option value="Approved">Approved</option>
            <option value="In Transit">In Transit</option>
            <option value="Buffer Replacement">Buffer Replacement</option>
            <option value="Credit Memo Issued">Credit Memo Issued</option>
            <option value="Rejected">Rejected</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Business Group Filter */}
        <div>
          <select
            value={selectedGroup}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedGroup(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Business Groups</option>
            <option value="Group 2">Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA)</option>
            <option value="Group 1">Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tickets List */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {filteredTickets.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-12 text-center text-slate-500">
            <Package className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto mb-3" />
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">No RMA tickets found</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Try modifying your search or filter criteria.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredTickets.map((ticket) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedTicketId === ticket.id;

            return (
              <div 
                key={ticket.id}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm transition-all space-y-4"
              >
                {/* Primary Row */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-wide">
                        {ticket.id}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase border ${getStatusBadge(ticket.status)}`}>
                        {ticket.status}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
                        {ticket.created_at ? `${formatDateYmd(ticket.created_at)} (YYYY-MM-DD)` : ''}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{ticket.customer_name}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600">•</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-500">{ticket.store_branch}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Actions & QR Code Launch */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onOpenTicketModal(ticket)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-600/15 hover:bg-brand-100 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-colors border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/30"
                      title="View Printable Return QR Code"
                    >
                      <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
                      <span>Return QR</span>
                    </button>

                    {/* Inline Status Changer */}
                    <select
                      value={ticket.status}
                      onChange={(e) => onUpdateTicketStatus(ticket.id, e.target.value)}
                      className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
                    >
                      <option value="Pending Inspection">Pending Inspection</option>
                      <option value="Approved">Approved</option>
                      <option value="In Transit">In Transit</option>
                      <option value="Buffer Replacement">Buffer Replacement</option>
                      <option value="Credit Memo Issued">Credit Memo Issued</option>
                      <option value="Rejected">Rejected</option>
                    </select>

                    {/* Expand Toggle */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setExpandedTicketId(isExpanded ? null : ticket.id)}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                      title="Expand details"
                    >
                      <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 transition-transform ${isExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Second Line: Product Summary Chips */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-xs pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80">
                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Product & SKU</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block">
                      {ticket.product_name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">{ticket.sku}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Return Quantity</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-sm">{ticket.quantity} Units</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block font-mono">@{formatPeso(ticket.unit_price)}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Total Claim Value</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono text-sm">{formatPeso(ticket.total_amount)}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">{ticket.supplier}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Responsible AE</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block">{ticket.ae_name}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 truncate block">{ticket.credit_memo_no ? `CM: ${ticket.credit_memo_no}` : 'CM Pending'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Expanded Details Drawer */}
                {isExpanded && (
                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-2xl">
                    {ticket.serial_numbers && (
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                        <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600" />
                        <span className="font-bold">Serial Numbers:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono">{ticket.serial_numbers}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Defect Statement */}
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 block mb-1">
                        Reason: {ticket.defect_category}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                        {ticket.technical_diagnosis}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Metadata & GPS */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                      {ticket.gps_coordinates && (
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                          <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                          <span>GPS: {ticket.gps_coordinates}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div>
                        <span>Invoice: </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{ticket.invoice_no || 'N/A'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span>Group: </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{ticket.group}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Photos Preview */}
                    {ticket.photos && ticket.photos.length > 0 && (
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] font-medium block mb-1.5">Defect Documentation Photos:</span>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          {ticket.photos.map((p, idx) => (
                            <a key={idx} href={p} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 group shrink-0">
                              <img src={p} alt="Defect" className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-opacity">
                                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                              </div>
                            </a>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/WarehouseLocationsModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  MapPin, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Edit2, 
  Check, 
  RotateCcw, 
  AlertCircle 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE_LOCATIONS, 
  getWarehouseLocations, 
  saveWarehouseLocations 
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function WarehouseLocationsModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [locations, setLocations] = useState([]);
  const [newLocInput, setNewLocInput] = useState('');
  const [editingIndex, setEditingIndex] = useState(null);
  const [editingValue, setEditingValue] = useState('');
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setLocations(getWarehouseLocations());
      setNewLocInput('');
      setEditingIndex(null);
      setFeedback(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleAddLocation = (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const clean = newLocInput.trim();
    if (!clean) return;
    if (locations.some(l => l.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', text: 'This warehouse location name already exists.' });
      return;
    }
    const updated = [...locations, clean];
    setLocations(updated);
    saveWarehouseLocations(updated);
    setNewLocInput('');
    setFeedback({ type: 'success', text: `Added "${clean}" to warehouse locations.` });
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (idx) => {
    setEditingIndex(idx);
    setEditingValue(locations[idx]);
    setFeedback(null);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = (idx) => {
    const clean = editingValue.trim();
    if (!clean) return;
    const updated = [...locations];
    updated[idx] = clean;
    setLocations(updated);
    saveWarehouseLocations(updated);
    setEditingIndex(null);
    setFeedback({ type: 'success', text: `Renamed location to "${clean}".` });
  };

  const handleDeleteLocation = (idx) => {
    const locToDelete = locations[idx];
    if (locations.length <= 1) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', text: 'At least one warehouse location must remain.' });
      return;
    }
    const updated = locations.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
    setLocations(updated);
    saveWarehouseLocations(updated);
    setFeedback({ type: 'success', text: `Deleted location "${locToDelete}".` });
  };

  const handleResetDefaults = () => {
    setLocations([...DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE_LOCATIONS]);
    saveWarehouseLocations([...DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE_LOCATIONS]);
    setFeedback({ type: 'success', text: 'Reset locations to default 6 warehouse areas.' });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div 
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-xl">
              <MapPin className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Warehouse Locations & Areas
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                Manage standardized rack, bin, and area locations.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Alert */}
        {feedback && (
          <div className={`mx-5 mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 ${
            feedback.type === 'error'
              ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300'
              : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300'
          }`}>
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{feedback.text}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Add Location Input */}
        <form onSubmit={handleAddLocation} className="p-5 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newLocInput}
              onChange={(e) => setNewLocInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Bin Rack C-04..."
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={!newLocInput.trim()}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-xs transition-colors"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Add</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Locations List */}
        <div className="p-5 pt-0 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 flex-1 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
          {locations.map((loc, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="pt-1.5 first:pt-0 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              {editingIndex === idx ? (
                <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editingValue}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingValue(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-indigo-500 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold font-mono"
                    autoFocus
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(idx)}
                    className="p-1.5 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-700 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setEditingIndex(null)}
                    className="p-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{loc}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleStartEdit(idx)}
                      className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                      title="Rename location"
                    >
                      <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleDeleteLocation(idx)}
                      className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                      title="Delete location"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetDefaults}
            className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>Reset to Defaults</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-100 text-white dark:text-slate-900 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/hooks/useIsDesktopMd.js ---
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const MD_MEDIA_QUERY = '(min-width: 768px)';

/**
 * Matches Tailwind's `md` breakpoint (`>= 768px`).
 * Used to mount either the Desktop table view or the Mobile card view (not both simultaneously),
 * keeping DOM lightweight and avoiding duplicate text nodes across hidden responsive containers.
 */
export function useIsDesktopMd() {
  const [isDesktopMd, setIsDesktopMd] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
      return true;
    }
    return window.matchMedia(MD_MEDIA_QUERY).matches;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') return undefined;
    const mql = window.matchMedia(MD_MEDIA_QUERY);
    const update = (e) => setIsDesktopMd(e ? e.matches : mql.matches);
    setIsDesktopMd(mql.matches);
    if (typeof mql.addEventListener === 'function') {
      mql.addEventListener('change', update);
      return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', update);
    }
    mql.addListener(update);
    return () => mql.removeListener(update);
  }, []);

  return isDesktopMd;
}
