    const rmaNumbers = reportsList.map(r => r.rma_number).filter(Boolean);

    // Extract all photos and folders across reports to delete from Google Drive / Supabase Storage
    const allPhotos = [];
    const allFolders = [];
    const allFolderUrls = [];

    const harvestReportAssets = (r) => {
      if (!r) return;
      if (r.google_drive_folder_id) allFolders.push(r.google_drive_folder_id);
      if (r.google_drive_folder_url) allFolderUrls.push(r.google_drive_folder_url);

      const candidates = [r.photos, r.paperwork_photos, r.proof_photos, r.photo_url, r.image_url, r.photo];
      candidates.forEach(cand => {
        if (!cand) return;
        if (Array.isArray(cand)) {
          allPhotos.push(...cand);
        } else if (typeof cand === 'string') {
          if (cand.startsWith('[') && cand.endsWith(']')) {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(cand);
              if (Array.isArray(parsed)) allPhotos.push(...parsed);
              else allPhotos.push(cand);
            } catch (e) {
              allPhotos.push(cand);
            }
          } else {
            allPhotos.push(cand);
          }
        }
      });
    };

    // First harvest from passed objects
    reportsList.forEach(harvestReportAssets);

    // Also query Supabase to ensure full paperwork_photos and google_drive_folder_id are harvested for all selected rows
    try {
      if (numericIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: dbRecords } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('id, rma_number, barcode, name, photos, paperwork_photos, google_drive_folder_id, google_drive_folder_url')
          .in('id', numericIds);
        if (dbRecords && Array.isArray(dbRecords)) {
          dbRecords.forEach(harvestReportAssets);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Bulk Delete Fetch Notice]:', e.message);
    }

    try {
      let deleteError = null;
      if (numericIds.length > 0) {
        const { error } = await supabase.from('rma_reports').delete().in('id', numericIds);
        if (error) deleteError = error;
      }
      if (rmaNumbers.length > 0) {
        const { error } = await supabase.from('rma_reports').delete().in('rma_number', rmaNumbers);
        if (error && !deleteError) deleteError = error;
      }

      // Soft delete fallback if hard delete blocked by RLS
      if (deleteError) {
        console.warn('Hard delete blocked or failed, executing soft-delete fallback in bulk:', deleteError.message);
        if (numericIds.length > 0) {
          await supabase.from('rma_reports').update({ status: 'deleted' }).in('id', numericIds);
        }
        if (rmaNumbers.length > 0) {
          await supabase.from('rma_reports').update({ status: 'deleted' }).in('rma_number', rmaNumbers);
        }
      }

      // Delete all stored photos & Google Drive folders in parallel
      const cleanPhotos = [...new Set(allPhotos.filter(Boolean))];
      const cleanFolders = [...new Set(allFolders.filter(Boolean))];
      const cleanFolderUrls = [...new Set(allFolderUrls.filter(Boolean))];

      await this.deleteStoredImages(cleanPhotos, cleanFolders, cleanFolderUrls, { rmaNumbers });

      this.notifyChange('reports-bulk-deleted', { count: reportsList.length });
      return { success: true, count: reportsList.length };
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Bulk delete RMA reports error:', e);
      throw e;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get unique list of verified and recorded suppliers across catalog and returns
   */
  async getUniqueSuppliers() {
    const defaultSuppliers = [
      'Savemore',
      'Walter Mart',
      'SM Supermarket',
      'Puregold',
      'Robinsons Supermarket',
      'Mondelez',
      'Universal Robina Corporation (URC)',
      'Bonita',
      'Keysys',
      'A2Z2GO',
      'Pingcon Marketing'
    ];

    const supplierSet = new Set(defaultSuppliers);

    try {
      // 1. Fetch from Supabase products
      const { data: prodData } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('supplier_name')
        .limit(200);

      if (prodData && Array.isArray(prodData)) {
        prodData.forEach(p => {
          if (p.supplier_name && p.supplier_name.trim() && p.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment') {
            supplierSet.add(p.supplier_name.trim());
          }
        });
      }

      // 2. Fetch from Supabase rma_reports
      const { data: reportData } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .select('supplier_name')
        .limit(200);

      if (reportData && Array.isArray(reportData)) {
        reportData.forEach(r => {
          if (r.supplier_name && r.supplier_name.trim() && r.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment') {
            supplierSet.add(r.supplier_name.trim());
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Notice loading unique suppliers:', e);
    }

    return Array.from(supplierSet).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  },

  /**
   * Shared lifecycle mutator for Trash / Archive / Restore.
   * Cascades atomically to manifest sibling rows sharing the exact same non-split rma_number
   * while leaving split children (e.g. -B, -C with distinct rma_number) untouched.
   */
  async _updateReportLifecycleState(id, rmaNumber, { buildMeta, auditAction, auditStage, auditNotes, eventName }) {
    return enqueueLifecycleOp(async () => {
      if (!id && !rmaNumber) return false;
      const cleanId = id && /^\d+$/.test(String(id)) ? parseInt(id, 10) : null;

      let seedRows = [];
      if (cleanId) {
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('id, rma_number, parent_rma_id, ai_document_metadata, audit_trail')
          .eq('id', cleanId)
          .limit(1);
        if (Array.isArray(data)) seedRows = data;
      }

      const resolvedRma = rmaNumber || seedRows[0]?.rma_number || null;
      const isManifestChildOnly = Boolean(seedRows[0]?.parent_rma_id && seedRows[0]?.rma_number === resolvedRma);
      let targetRows = seedRows;
      if (resolvedRma && !isManifestChildOnly) {
        const { data: siblingRows } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('id, rma_number, parent_rma_id, ai_document_metadata, audit_trail')
          .eq('rma_number', resolvedRma)
          .limit(25);
        if (Array.isArray(siblingRows) && siblingRows.length > 0) {
          targetRows = siblingRows;
        }
      }

      const now = new Date();
      const nowIso = now.toISOString();
      const auditEntry = {
        timestamp: nowIso,
        action: auditAction,
        stage: auditStage,
        actor: auditNotes?.actor || 'Staff',
        notes: typeof auditNotes === 'string' ? auditNotes : auditNotes?.text || ''
      };

      for (const row of targetRows) {
        const updatedMeta = buildMeta(row.ai_document_metadata || {}, now, nowIso);
        const existingAudit = Array.isArray(row.audit_trail) ? row.audit_trail : [];
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            ai_document_metadata: updatedMeta,
            audit_trail: [...existingAudit, auditEntry]
          })
          .eq('id', row.id);
        if (error) throw error;
      }

      if (targetRows.length === 0 && resolvedRma) {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            ai_document_metadata: buildMeta({}, now, nowIso),
            audit_trail: [auditEntry]
          })
          .eq('rma_number', resolvedRma);
        if (error) throw error;
      }

      this.notifyChange(eventName, { id: cleanId || targetRows[0]?.id, rmaNumber: resolvedRma });
      return true;
    });
  },

  /**
   * ENTERPRISE SOFT-DELETE: Move report to 30-Day Trash Bin (<100ms instant execution)
   */
  async moveReportToTrash(id, rmaNumber, actorName = 'Staff') {
    try {
      let scheduledPurge = '';
      return await this._updateReportLifecycleState(id, rmaNumber, {
        buildMeta: (existingMeta, now, nowIso) => {
          const purgeAfter = new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
          scheduledPurge = purgeAfter;
          return {
            ...existingMeta,
            is_trashed: true,
            is_archived: false,
            trashed_at: nowIso,
            trashed_by: actorName,
            purge_after: purgeAfter
          };
        },
        auditAction: 'MOVED_TO_TRASH',
        auditStage: 'TRASH_BIN',
        auditNotes: {
          actor: actorName,
          text: `Moved to 30-day Trash Bin by ${actorName}. Auto-purge scheduled (${scheduledPurge || '30 days'})`
        },
        eventName: 'report-trashed'
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('moveReportToTrash error:', e);
      throw e;
    }
  },

  /**
   * ENTERPRISE ARCHIVE: Store report in Archive Vault indefinitely
   */
  async archiveReport(id, rmaNumber, actorName = 'Staff') {
    try {
      return await this._updateReportLifecycleState(id, rmaNumber, {
        buildMeta: (existingMeta, _now, nowIso) => ({
          ...existingMeta,
          is_archived: true,
          is_trashed: false,
          archived_at: nowIso,
          archived_by: actorName
        }),
        auditAction: 'ARCHIVED',
        auditStage: 'ARCHIVE_VAULT',
        auditNotes: { actor: actorName, text: `Archived into Enterprise Vault by ${actorName}` },
        eventName: 'report-archived'
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('archiveReport error:', e);
      throw e;
    }
  },

  /**
   * RESTORE REPORT: Return record from Trash or Archive back to active hub
   */
  async restoreReport(id, rmaNumber, actorName = 'Staff') {
    try {
      return await this._updateReportLifecycleState(id, rmaNumber, {
        buildMeta: (existingMeta) => {
          const updatedMeta = { ...existingMeta };
          delete updatedMeta.is_trashed;
          delete updatedMeta.trashed_at;
          delete updatedMeta.trashed_by;
          delete updatedMeta.purge_after;
          delete updatedMeta.is_archived;
          delete updatedMeta.archived_at;
          delete updatedMeta.archived_by;
          return updatedMeta;
        },
        auditAction: 'RESTORED',
        auditStage: 'ACTIVE_HUB',
        auditNotes: { actor: actorName, text: `Restored back to active hub by ${actorName}` },
        eventName: 'report-restored'
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('restoreReport error:', e);
      throw e;
    }
  },

  /**
   * PERMANENT HARD-DELETE: Clean up from database and delete storage photos
   */
  async permanentlyDeleteReport(id, rmaNumber, item = null) {
    return enqueueLifecycleOp(() => this.deleteReport(id, rmaNumber, item));
  },

  /**
   * BULK MOVE TO TRASH
   */
  async moveMultipleReportsToTrash(reportsList, actorName = 'Staff') {
    if (!Array.isArray(reportsList) || reportsList.length === 0) return true;
    for (const r of reportsList) {
      try {
        await this.moveReportToTrash(r.id, r.rma_number, actorName);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`Failed moving report ${r.rma_number} to trash:`, e);
      }
    }
    this.notifyChange('reports-bulk-trashed', { count: reportsList.length });
    return true;
  },

  /**
   * BULK ARCHIVE
   */
  async archiveMultipleReports(reportsList, actorName = 'Staff') {
    if (!Array.isArray(reportsList) || reportsList.length === 0) return true;
    for (const r of reportsList) {
      try {
        await this.archiveReport(r.id, r.rma_number, actorName);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`Failed archiving report ${r.rma_number}:`, e);
      }
    }
    this.notifyChange('reports-bulk-archived', { count: reportsList.length });
    return true;
  },

  /**
   * AUTO-PURGE EXPIRED TRASH: Automatically hard-delete any trashed items past 30 days
   */
  async autoPurgeExpiredTrash(reportsList) {
    if (!Array.isArray(reportsList) || reportsList.length === 0) return;
    const expired = reportsList.filter(r => isTrashedRecord(r) && getTrashDaysRemaining(r) <= 0);
    if (expired.length === 0) return;

    console.info(`[Auto-Purge]: Found ${expired.length} expired trashed items past 30 days. Purging...`);
    for (const r of expired) {
      try {
        await this.permanentlyDeleteReport(r.id, r.rma_number, r);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[Auto-Purge Notice]: Failed to purge ${r.rma_number}:`, err);
      }
    }
  },

  async _resolveLatestRmaParentRow(report) {
    const cleanId = (report?.id && /^\d+$/.test(String(report.id))) ? Number(report.id) : null;
    const rmaNumber = report?.rma_number || report?.rmaNumber || null;
    if (!cleanId && !rmaNumber) {
      throw new Error('Missing RMA identifier to update.');
    }

    const fetchLatestParentRow = async () => {
      if (cleanId) {
        const { data } = await supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*').eq('id', cleanId).limit(1);
        if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) return data[0];
      }
      if (rmaNumber) {
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('*')
          .eq('rma_number', rmaNumber)
          .order('is_parent', { ascending: false })
          .order('id', { ascending: true })
          .limit(10);
        if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
          return (
            data.find((r) => !isTrashedRecord(r) && r.parent_rma_id == null && r.is_parent) ||
            data.find((r) => !isTrashedRecord(r) && r.parent_rma_id == null) ||
            data.find((r) => !isTrashedRecord(r)) ||
            data[0]
          );
        }
      }
      return null;
    };

    let existing = await fetchLatestParentRow();
    if (!existing && rmaNumber) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt += 1) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 450));
        existing = await fetchLatestParentRow();
        if (existing) break;
      }
    }
    if (!existing) {
      existing = report;
    }

    const resolvedId = (existing?.id && /^\d+$/.test(String(existing.id))) ? Number(existing.id) : cleanId;
    if (!resolvedId) {
      throw new Error(`RMA "${rmaNumber || ''}" is still syncing to the database. Please try again in a moment.`);
    }

    return { existing, resolvedId, rmaNumber };
  },

  /**
   * Saves Simple 4-Option Supplier RTV Choice & Pickup Verification Metadata
   * Handles supplier name assignment, disposition/status/bin auto-sync,
   * Drive folder sync, and automatic 'picked_up' tagging when A4 handover form is finalized.
   */
  async saveSimpleSupplierRtvDisposition(report, payload = {}) {
    const { existing, resolvedId, rmaNumber } = await this._resolveLatestRmaParentRow(report);

    const existingMeta = (existing?.ai_document_metadata && typeof existing.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
      ? { ...existing.ai_document_metadata }
      : {};
    const recordIsTest = Boolean(isTestRecord(existing) || isTestRecord(report));
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const updatedMeta = {
      ...existingMeta,
      ...(payload.metadataPatch || {}),
      ...(recordIsTest ? { is_test: true, test_mode: true } : {})
    };
    if (payload.clearWorkflowResolution) {
      delete updatedMeta.workflow_resolution;
      delete updatedMeta.resolved_at;
      delete updatedMeta.resolved_by;
    }

    const prevFollowUp = (existingMeta.follow_up && typeof existingMeta.follow_up === 'object')
      ? { ...existingMeta.follow_up }
      : {};
    const isPickupRecorded = payload.status === 'picked_up' || Boolean(payload.metadataPatch?.supplier_pickup?.picked_up_at);
    const effectiveSup = payload.supplier_name || existing?.supplier_name;

    if (isPickupRecorded) {
      updatedMeta.follow_up = {
        ...prevFollowUp,
        enabled: false,
        picked_up_at: payload.metadataPatch?.supplier_pickup?.picked_up_at || prevFollowUp.picked_up_at || nowIso,
        case_closed_at: prevFollowUp.case_closed_at || nowIso,
        case_status: 'picked_up_closed'
      };
    } else if (prevFollowUp.manually_disabled !== true && prevFollowUp.enabled !== false) {
      updatedMeta.follow_up = {
        ...prevFollowUp,
        enabled: true,
        started_at: prevFollowUp.started_at || nowIso
      };
    }

    let baseNotes = String(existing?.notes || '').replace(/\s*\[REORDER:[^\]]*\]/gi, '').trim();
    const preservedNotes = recordIsTest
      ? (baseNotes.includes('[TEST_MODE]')
          ? baseNotes
          : `${baseNotes ? `${baseNotes} ` : ''}[TEST_MODE] Sandbox Return`)
      : baseNotes;

    const updates = {
      disposition: payload.disposition ?? existing?.disposition,
      status: payload.status ?? existing?.status,
      warehouse_location: payload.warehouse_location ?? existing?.warehouse_location,
      inspected_by: payload.inspected_by || payload.actorName || existing?.inspected_by || 'Staff',
      inspected_at: nowIso,
      ai_document_metadata: updatedMeta,
      ...(preservedNotes !== undefined ? { notes: preservedNotes } : {})
    };

    if (payload.supplier_name && String(payload.supplier_name).trim()) {
      updates.supplier_name = String(payload.supplier_name).trim();
      if (updatedMeta.supplier_pickup && typeof updatedMeta.supplier_pickup === 'object') {
        updatedMeta.supplier_pickup = {
          ...updatedMeta.supplier_pickup,
          supplier_name: updates.supplier_name
        };
      }
    }
    if (payload.google_drive_folder_url) {
      updates.google_drive_folder_url = payload.google_drive_folder_url;
    }
    if (payload.google_drive_folder_id) {
      updates.google_drive_folder_id = payload.google_drive_folder_id;
    }

    // Append any newly uploaded pickup photos cleanly onto the report's photos array too
    if (Array.isArray(payload.appendPhotoUrls) && payload.appendPhotoUrls.length > 0) {
      const prevPhotos = Array.isArray(existing?.photos) ? existing.photos : [];
      updates.photos = [...new Set([...prevPhotos, ...payload.appendPhotoUrls.filter(Boolean)])];
    }

    const existingItemsArr = Array.isArray(existing?.items) ? existing.items : [];
    const existingItemSups = extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems(existingItemsArr);
    const hasMixedItemSuppliers = existingItemSups.length > 1;
    const allowCascadeSupplier = Boolean(updates.supplier_name) && (!hasMixedItemSuppliers || Boolean(payload.unifyMixedSuppliers));

    // Update manifest item array if batch manifest (never clobbering mixed suppliers unless explicitly unifying)
    if (existingItemsArr.length > 0) {
      updates.items = existingItemsArr.map(it => {
        const itemHasRealSup = !this._isPlaceholderSupplier(it?.supplier_name) && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(it?.supplier_name);
        const shouldSetSup = Boolean(updates.supplier_name) && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(updates.supplier_name) && (allowCascadeSupplier || !itemHasRealSup);
        return {
          ...it,
          ...(shouldSetSup ? { supplier_name: updates.supplier_name, supplier: updates.supplier_name } : {}),
          ...(payload.disposition ? { disposition: payload.disposition } : {}),
          ...(payload.status ? { status: payload.status } : {})
        };
      });
      if (hasMixedItemSuppliers && !payload.unifyMixedSuppliers) {
        updates.supplier_name = summarizeBatchSuppliers(updates.items, existing?.supplier_name);
      }
    }

    const existingAudit = Array.isArray(existing?.audit_trail) ? existing.audit_trail : [];
    updates.audit_trail = [
      ...existingAudit,
      {
        timestamp: nowIso,
        action: payload.auditAction || 'SUPPLIER_RTV_WORKFLOW_UPDATE',
        stage: String(updates.status || 'UNDER_INSPECTION').toUpperCase(),
        actor: payload.actorName || 'Staff',
        note: payload.auditNote || `Updated disposition to ${updates.disposition}`
      }
    ];

    let { data: savedRows, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('rma_reports')
      .update(updates)
      .eq('id', resolvedId)
      .select();

    if (updateErr) {
      const fallback = { ...updates };
      const colMatch = updateErr.message.match(/Could not find the '([^']+)' column/i) ||
        updateErr.message.match(/column rma_reports\.([a-zA-Z0-9_]+) does not exist/i);
      if (colMatch && colMatch[1]) {
        delete fallback[colMatch[1]];
      }
      if (String(updateErr.message || '').includes('rma_reports_status_check')) {
        fallback.status = 'under_inspection';
      }
      delete fallback.google_drive_folder_id;
      const { data: retryRows, error: retryErr } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .update(fallback)
        .eq('id', resolvedId)
        .select();
      if (retryErr) throw retryErr;
      savedRows = retryRows;
    }

    const savedRow = Array.isArray(savedRows) && savedRows.length > 0 ? savedRows[0] : null;

    try {
      const supForDir = updates.supplier_name || existing?.supplier_name;
      const toForDir = updatedMeta?.supplier_pickup?.supplier_email_to;
      const ccForDir = updatedMeta?.supplier_pickup?.supplier_email_cc;
      if (supForDir && (toForDir || ccForDir)) {
        supplierDirectoryService.upsertFromSubmission({
          supplier_name: supForDir,
          supplier_email_to: toForDir,
          supplier_email_cc: ccForDir
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch {}

    // Sync child rows only if this record is a multi-item parent manifest
    if (resolvedId && (existing?.is_parent === true || existingItemsArr.length > 0)) {
      try {
        await supabase.from('rma_reports').update({
          ...(allowCascadeSupplier && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(updates.supplier_name) ? { supplier_name: updates.supplier_name } : {}),
          disposition: updates.disposition,
          status: savedRow?.status || updates.status,
          warehouse_location: updates.warehouse_location
        }).eq('parent_rma_id', resolvedId);
      } catch {}
    }

    this.notifyChange('triage-updated', { id: resolvedId, rmaNumber, status: savedRow?.status || updates.status });
    return savedRow || { ...existing, ...updates, id: resolvedId };
  },

  /**
   * Persist Supplier Name, Email (TO/CC), and 10-Calendar-Day Auto Follow-Up toggle for any RMA.
   */
  async saveSupplierAndFollowUpSettings(report, payload = {}) {
    const { existing, resolvedId, rmaNumber } = await this._resolveLatestRmaParentRow(report);
    const existingMeta = (existing?.ai_document_metadata && typeof existing.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
      ? { ...existing.ai_document_metadata }
      : {};
    const prevFollowUp = (existingMeta.follow_up && typeof existingMeta.follow_up === 'object')
      ? { ...existingMeta.follow_up }
      : {};
    const prevPickup = (existingMeta.supplier_pickup && typeof existingMeta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
      ? { ...existingMeta.supplier_pickup }
      : {};
    const recordIsTest = Boolean(isTestRecord(existing) || isTestRecord(report));
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const cleanSupplier = String(payload.supplier_name || '').trim();
    const toEmailStr = String(payload.supplier_email_to ?? prevFollowUp.supplier_email_to ?? '').trim();
    const ccEmailStr = String(payload.supplier_email_cc ?? prevFollowUp.supplier_email_cc ?? '').trim();
    const followUpEnabled = payload.followUpEnabled !== undefined
      ? Boolean(payload.followUpEnabled)
      : (prevFollowUp.enabled ?? true);

    const nextFollowUp = {
      ...prevFollowUp,
      supplier_email_to: toEmailStr,
      supplier_email_cc: ccEmailStr,
      enabled: followUpEnabled,
      manually_disabled: !followUpEnabled,
      updated_at: nowIso
    };
    if (followUpEnabled && (!nextFollowUp.started_at || payload.resetTimer)) {
      nextFollowUp.started_at = nowIso;
    }
    if (payload.reopenCase) {
      delete nextFollowUp.case_closed_at;
      delete nextFollowUp.case_status;
      delete nextFollowUp.auto_disposed_at;
      delete nextFollowUp.close_reason;
    }

    const updatedMeta = {
      ...existingMeta,
      ...(recordIsTest ? { is_test: true, test_mode: true } : {}),
      supplier_pickup: {
        ...prevPickup,
        ...(cleanSupplier ? { supplier_name: cleanSupplier } : {}),
        supplier_email_to: toEmailStr,
        supplier_email_cc: ccEmailStr
      },
      follow_up: nextFollowUp
    };

    const existingAudit = Array.isArray(existing?.audit_trail) ? existing.audit_trail : [];
    const updates = {
      ...(cleanSupplier ? { supplier_name: cleanSupplier } : {}),
      ai_document_metadata: updatedMeta,
      audit_trail: [
        ...existingAudit,
        {
          timestamp: nowIso,
          action: 'SUPPLIER_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG_UPDATED',
          stage: String(existing?.status || 'FOLLOW_UP').toUpperCase(),
          actor: payload.actorName || 'Admin',
          note: `Supplier: ${cleanSupplier || existing?.supplier_name || 'Pending'} | Email TO: ${toEmailStr || 'None'} | Auto Follow-Up: ${followUpEnabled ? 'ON (10-Day SLA)' : 'OFF'}`
        }
      ]
    };

    const existingItemsArr = Array.isArray(existing?.items) ? existing.items : [];
    const hasMixedFollowUpSups = extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems(existingItemsArr).length > 1;
    const allowCascadeFollowUpSup = Boolean(cleanSupplier) && (!hasMixedFollowUpSups || Boolean(payload.unifyMixedSuppliers));

    if (cleanSupplier && existingItemsArr.length > 0) {
      updates.items = existingItemsArr.map((it) => {
        const itemHasRealSup = !this._isPlaceholderSupplier(it?.supplier_name) && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(it?.supplier_name);
        if (!allowCascadeFollowUpSup && itemHasRealSup) return it;
        return {
          ...it,
          supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
          supplier: cleanSupplier
        };
      });
      if (hasMixedFollowUpSups && !payload.unifyMixedSuppliers) {
        updates.supplier_name = summarizeBatchSuppliers(updates.items, cleanSupplier);
      }
    }

    let { data: savedRows, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('rma_reports')
      .update(updates)
      .eq('id', resolvedId)
      .select();

    if (updateErr) {
      const fallback = { ...updates };
      if (String(updateErr.message || '').includes('updated_at')) delete fallback.updated_at;
      const retry = await supabase.from('rma_reports').update(fallback).eq('id', resolvedId).select();
      if (retry.error) throw retry.error;
      savedRows = retry.data;
    }

    if (allowCascadeFollowUpSup && !isMixedSuppliersSummary(cleanSupplier)) {
      try {
        await supabase.from('rma_reports').update({ supplier_name: cleanSupplier }).eq('parent_rma_id', resolvedId);
      } catch {}
    }

    const savedRow = Array.isArray(savedRows) && savedRows.length > 0 ? savedRows[0] : null;
    try {
      const supForDir = cleanSupplier || existing?.supplier_name;
      if (supForDir && (toEmailStr || ccEmailStr)) {
        supplierDirectoryService.upsertFromSubmission({
          supplier_name: supForDir,
          supplier_email_to: toEmailStr,
          supplier_email_cc: ccEmailStr
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch {}
    this.notifyChange('triage-updated', { id: resolvedId, rmaNumber, status: savedRow?.status || existing?.status });
    return savedRow || { ...existing, ...updates, id: resolvedId };
  },

  /**
   * Explicitly close the 4-Step Follow-Up workflow (Picked Up / Handover Completed or Manual Case Close)
   */
  async closeFollowUpCase(report, { reason = 'Picked Up — Case Closed', markPickedUp = true, actorName = 'Admin' } = {}) {
    const { existing, resolvedId, rmaNumber } = await this._resolveLatestRmaParentRow(report);
    const existingMeta = (existing?.ai_document_metadata && typeof existing.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
      ? { ...existing.ai_document_metadata }
      : {};
    const prevFollowUp = (existingMeta.follow_up && typeof existingMeta.follow_up === 'object')
      ? { ...existingMeta.follow_up }
      : {};
    const prevPickup = (existingMeta.supplier_pickup && typeof existingMeta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
      ? { ...existingMeta.supplier_pickup }
      : {};
    const recordIsTest = Boolean(isTestRecord(existing) || isTestRecord(report));
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const pickedUpTimestamp = markPickedUp ? (prevPickup.picked_up_at || prevFollowUp.picked_up_at || nowIso) : prevFollowUp.picked_up_at;
    const updatedMeta = {
      ...existingMeta,
      ...(recordIsTest ? { is_test: true, test_mode: true } : {}),
      ...(markPickedUp ? {
        supplier_pickup: {
          ...prevPickup,
          picked_up_at: pickedUpTimestamp
        }
      } : {}),
      follow_up: {
        ...prevFollowUp,
        enabled: false,
        ...(pickedUpTimestamp ? { picked_up_at: pickedUpTimestamp } : {}),
        case_closed_at: nowIso,
        case_status: markPickedUp ? 'picked_up_closed' : 'manual_closed',
        close_reason: reason,
        closed_by: actorName
      }
    };

    const nextStatus = markPickedUp && existing?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'picked_up' : 'resolved';
    const existingAudit = Array.isArray(existing?.audit_trail) ? existing.audit_trail : [];
    const updates = {
      status: nextStatus,
      ai_document_metadata: updatedMeta,
      audit_trail: [
        ...existingAudit,
        {
          timestamp: nowIso,
          action: 'FOLLOWUP_CASE_CLOSED',
          stage: String(nextStatus).toUpperCase(),
          actor: actorName,
          note: reason
        }
      ]
    };

    let { data: savedRows, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('rma_reports')
      .update(updates)
      .eq('id', resolvedId)
      .select();

    if (updateErr) {
      const fallback = { ...updates };
      if (String(updateErr.message || '').includes('rma_reports_status_check')) {
        fallback.status = 'resolved';
      }
      if (String(updateErr.message || '').includes('updated_at')) delete fallback.updated_at;
      const retry = await supabase.from('rma_reports').update(fallback).eq('id', resolvedId).select();
      if (retry.error) {
        if (String(retry.error.message || '').includes('rma_reports_status_check')) {
          fallback.status = 'under_inspection';
          const retry2 = await supabase.from('rma_reports').update(fallback).eq('id', resolvedId).select();
          if (retry2.error) throw retry2.error;
          savedRows = retry2.data;
        } else {
          throw retry.error;
        }
      } else {
        savedRows = retry.data;
      }
    }

    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_reports').update({ status: savedRows?.[0]?.status || nextStatus }).eq('parent_rma_id', resolvedId);
    } catch {}

    const savedRow = Array.isArray(savedRows) && savedRows.length > 0 ? savedRows[0] : null;
    this.notifyChange('triage-updated', { id: resolvedId, rmaNumber, status: savedRow?.status || nextStatus });
    return savedRow || { ...existing, ...updates, id: resolvedId };
  }
};

import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { authService } from './authService';
import {
  isTestRecord,
  stripCreditMemoMetaTag,
  parseCreditMemoMeta,
  getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems,
  getCreditMemoRmaNumbers
} from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

const CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_credit_memos_v2';
const CONSOLIDATED_CM_SETTINGS_KEY = 'consolidated_cm_items_store';
const CONSOLIDATED_CM_LOCAL_KEY = 'rma_consolidated_cm_items_v1';

// Prevent in-flight background fetches or stale localStorage caches from resurrecting voided Credit Memos
let cmMutationEpoch = 0;
const recentlyVoidedCmNumbers = new Set();

function buildPackedCmNotes(humanNotes, isTest, consolidatedItems = [], rmaNumbers = [], reportIds = []) {
  let base = stripCreditMemoMetaTag(humanNotes || '');
  if (isTest && !base.includes('[TEST_MODE]')) {
    base = base ? `[TEST_MODE] ${base}` : '[TEST_MODE] Sandbox Credit Memo';
  }
  if (Array.isArray(consolidatedItems) && consolidatedItems.length > 1) {
    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      consolidated_items: consolidatedItems,
      rma_numbers: rmaNumbers,
      report_ids: reportIds
    });
    if (payload.length <= 12000) {
      return `${base ? `${base}\n` : ''}[CM_META:${payload}]`;
    }
  }
  return base;
}

/**
 * Service for managing Finance Credit Memos
 * Persists directly to the dedicated 'credit_memos' table in Supabase
 * with seamless fallback to 'rma_reports' notes and localStorage
 */
export const creditMemoService = {
  /**
   * Generate sequential Credit Memo Number
   * Format: CM-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (e.g. CM-2026-0001-H7D2)
   */
  generateCreditMemoNumber(existingCount = 0, isTestMode = false) {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    let count = existingCount;
    if (!count) {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          const list = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(list)) count = list.length;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const seq = String(count + 1).padStart(4, '0');
    const chars = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let rand = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    return `CM-${isTestMode ? 'TEST-' : ''}${currentYear}-${seq}-${rand}`;
  },

  /**
   * Generate sequential Pull Out Reference (POR)
   * Format: POR-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (e.g. POR-2026-0001-1A4D)
   * Format: POR _ + Current Year + increasing serial number + random unique alphanumeric
   */
  generatePullOutReference(existingCount = 0) {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    let count = existingCount;
    if (!count) {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          const list = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(list)) count = list.length;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const seq = String(count + 1).padStart(4, '0');
    const chars = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let rand = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    return `POR-${currentYear}-${seq}-${rand}`;
  },

  async getConsolidatedItemsStore() {
    let localMap = {};
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(CONSOLIDATED_CM_LOCAL_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') localMap = parsed;
      }
    } catch {}

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', CONSOLIDATED_CM_SETTINGS_KEY)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!error && data?.value && typeof data.value === 'object') {
        const merged = { ...localMap, ...data.value };
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(CONSOLIDATED_CM_LOCAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
        } catch {}
        return merged;
      }
    } catch {}

    return localMap;
  },

  async saveConsolidatedItemsEntry(cmNumber, entryOrNull) {
    if (!cmNumber) return;
    try {
      const current = await this.getConsolidatedItemsStore();
      const next = { ...current };
      if (entryOrNull === null) {
        delete next[cmNumber];
      } else {
        next[cmNumber] = entryOrNull;
      }
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(CONSOLIDATED_CM_LOCAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      } catch {}
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: CONSOLIDATED_CM_SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: next,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'key' });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not sync consolidated_cm_items_store to rma_settings:', e?.message || e);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get all Credit Memos from dedicated Supabase 'credit_memos' table,
   * legacy 'rma_reports' notes, and local storage
   */
  async getCreditMemos() {
    const fetchEpoch = cmMutationEpoch;
    const memosMap = new Map();
    let dbTableQuerySucceeded = false;
    const consolidatedStore = await this.getConsolidatedItemsStore();

    // 1. Primary Source: Dedicated Supabase 'credit_memos' table
    try {
      const { data: dbMemos, error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .select('*')
        .order('credit_issued_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(dbMemos)) {
        dbTableQuerySucceeded = true;
        for (const m of dbMemos) {
          if (m.credit_memo_number && !recentlyVoidedCmNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number)) {
            const creditAmt = Number(m.credit_amount ?? m.amount ?? 0);
            const grossAmt = Number(m.amount ?? m.credit_amount ?? 0);
            memosMap.set(m.credit_memo_number, {
              ...m,
              credit_amount: creditAmt,
              amount: grossAmt || creditAmt,
              is_synced_to_db: true
            });
          }
        }
      } else if (error) {
        console.warn('Supabase credit_memos table read note:', error.message || error);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos fetch catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Legacy / Secondary fallback: Supabase rma_reports (checking notes for credit memo payload)
    try {
      const { data: reports, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .select('*')
        .not('status', 'eq', 'deleted')
        .like('notes', '%credit_memo_number%')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(reports)) {
        for (const r of reports) {
          if (r.notes && typeof r.notes === 'string' && r.notes.includes('credit_memo_number')) {
            try {
              const memoData = JSON.parse(r.notes);
              if (
                memoData &&
                memoData.credit_memo_number &&
                !recentlyVoidedCmNumbers.has(memoData.credit_memo_number) &&
                !memosMap.has(memoData.credit_memo_number)
              ) {
                const creditAmt = Number(memoData.credit_amount ?? memoData.amount ?? 0);
                const grossAmt = Number(memoData.amount ?? memoData.credit_amount ?? 0);
                const combined = {
                  ...memoData,
                  credit_amount: creditAmt,
                  amount: grossAmt || creditAmt,
                  report_id: r.id,
                  rma_number: r.rma_number || memoData.rma_number,
                  barcode: r.barcode || memoData.barcode,
                  product_name: r.name || memoData.product_name,
                  sku: r.code || memoData.sku,
                  supplier_name: r.supplier_name || memoData.supplier_name,
                  company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
                  customer_ae_name: r.ae_name || memoData.customer_ae_name,
                  customer_ae_email: r.ae_email || memoData.customer_ae_email,
                  is_synced_to_db: true
                };
                memosMap.set(memoData.credit_memo_number, combined);
              }
            } catch (err) {}
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase rma_reports memos fallback notice:', e);
    }

    // 3. Merge with local cache ONLY for unsynced offline entries (or when DB query failed)
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          parsed.forEach(m => {
            if (!m?.credit_memo_number || recentlyVoidedCmNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number)) return;
            // If Supabase table read succeeded, never resurrect DB-synced memos already deleted on server
            if (dbTableQuerySucceeded && m.is_synced_to_db !== false) return;
            if (!memosMap.has(m.credit_memo_number)) {
              memosMap.set(m.credit_memo_number, m);
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    const list = Array.from(memosMap.values()).map((m) => {
      const storeEntry = consolidatedStore?.[m.credit_memo_number];
      const meta = parseCreditMemoMeta(m.notes);
      const items = (Array.isArray(storeEntry?.consolidated_items) && storeEntry.consolidated_items.length > 0)
        ? storeEntry.consolidated_items
        : getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems(m);
      const rmaNums = (Array.isArray(storeEntry?.rma_numbers) && storeEntry.rma_numbers.length > 0)
        ? storeEntry.rma_numbers
        : getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(m);
      const reportIds = Array.isArray(storeEntry?.report_ids)
        ? storeEntry.report_ids
        : (Array.isArray(meta?.report_ids) ? meta.report_ids : (m.report_id ? [m.report_id] : []));
      return {
        ...m,
        clean_notes: stripCreditMemoMetaTag(m.notes),
        consolidated_items: items,
        consolidated_rma_numbers: rmaNums,
        consolidated_report_ids: reportIds
      };
    });
    list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.credit_issued_at || b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.credit_issued_at || a.created_at || 0));

    // Update local cache with latest merged list ONLY if no newer mutation occurred while fetching
    if (fetchEpoch === cmMutationEpoch) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return list;
  },

  /**
   * Save a newly issued Credit Memo to Supabase 'credit_memos' table
   */
  async createCreditMemo(memoData) {
    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const consolidatedItems = Array.isArray(memoData.consolidated_items)
      ? memoData.consolidated_items
      : [];
    const rmaNumbersList = Array.from(new Set([
      ...(Array.isArray(memoData.consolidated_rma_numbers) ? memoData.consolidated_rma_numbers : []),
      ...consolidatedItems.map((it) => it?.rma_number),
      ...String(memoData.rma_number || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim())
    ].map((s) => String(s || '').trim()).filter(Boolean)));
    const reportIdsList = Array.from(new Set([
      ...(Array.isArray(memoData.consolidated_report_ids) ? memoData.consolidated_report_ids : []),
      ...consolidatedItems.map((it) => it?.report_id),
      memoData.report_id
    ].filter((id) => id !== null && id !== undefined && /^\d+$/.test(String(id))).map((id) => Number(id))));

    const isTest = Boolean(
      memoData.is_test ||
      memoData.test_mode ||
      /^CM-TEST-/i.test(String(memoData.credit_memo_number || '')) ||
      rmaNumbersList.some((n) => /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(n)) ||
      String(memoData.notes || '').includes('[TEST_MODE]')
    );
    const modeExisting = existing.filter((m) => isTestRecord(m) === isTest);
    const cmNumber = memoData.credit_memo_number || this.generateCreditMemoNumber(modeExisting.length, isTest);

    recentlyVoidedCmNumbers.delete(cmNumber);
    cmMutationEpoch += 1;
    const isConsolidated = consolidatedItems.length > 1 || rmaNumbersList.length > 1;
    const joinedRmas = rmaNumbersList.join(', ');
    const displayRmaField = isConsolidated
      ? (joinedRmas.length <= 120 ? joinedRmas : `${rmaNumbersList[0]} (+${rmaNumbersList.length - 1} RMAs)`)
      : (rmaNumbersList[0] || memoData.rma_number || '');

    const cleanHumanNotes = stripCreditMemoMetaTag(memoData.notes || '');
    const packedNotes = buildPackedCmNotes(cleanHumanNotes, isTest, consolidatedItems, rmaNumbersList, reportIdsList);

    const unitPrice = Number((Number(memoData.unit_price) || 0).toFixed(2));
    const qty = Number(memoData.quantity) || 1;
    const grossAmount = Number((Number(memoData.amount) || (qty * unitPrice)).toFixed(2));
    const creditAmount = Number((Number(memoData.credit_amount) || grossAmount).toFixed(2));
    const pullOutRef = memoData.pull_out_ref ? memoData.pull_out_ref.trim() : this.generatePullOutReference(existing.length);
    const pullOutDate = memoData.pull_out_date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // STRICTLY ONLY valid columns on public.credit_memos (no root 'items' column)
    const dbMemoRow = {
      credit_memo_number: cmNumber,
      rma_number: displayRmaField,
      report_id: reportIdsList[0] ?? (memoData.report_id ? Number(memoData.report_id) : null),
      barcode: memoData.barcode || (isConsolidated ? 'CONSOLIDATED' : 'N/A'),
      product_name: isConsolidated
        ? (memoData.product_name || `Consolidated Credit Memo (${rmaNumbersList.length} RMAs)`)
        : (memoData.product_name || memoData.name || 'Item'),
      sku: memoData.sku || memoData.code || null,
      supplier_name: memoData.supplier_name || memoData.supplierName || 'Savemore',
      company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
      customer_ae_name: memoData.customer_ae_name || memoData.ae_name || 'N/A',
      customer_ae_email: memoData.customer_ae_email || memoData.ae_email || '',
      quantity: qty,
      unit_name: memoData.unit_name || memoData.unit || 'pc',
      unit_price: unitPrice,
      amount: grossAmount,
      credit_amount: creditAmount,
      pull_out_ref: pullOutRef,
      pull_out_date: pullOutDate,
      credit_issued_by: memoData.credit_issued_by || 'Analiza B. Benoza',
      credit_issued_by_email: memoData.credit_issued_by_email || 'analiza@savemore.com',
      credit_issued_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      notes: packedNotes,
      status: 'issued'
    };

    const newMemo = {
      ...dbMemoRow,
      clean_notes: cleanHumanNotes,
      consolidated_items: consolidatedItems,
      consolidated_rma_numbers: rmaNumbersList,
      consolidated_report_ids: reportIdsList,
      is_test: isTest
    };

    let dbSuccess = false;

    // 1. Primary: Save to dedicated 'credit_memos' table in Supabase (strict schema columns only)
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .upsert([dbMemoRow], { onConflict: 'credit_memo_number' })
        .select();

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        dbSuccess = true;
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Credit memo ${cmNumber} inserted into credit_memos table.`);
        if (data[0].id) {
          newMemo.id = data[0].id;
        }
      } else if (error) {
        console.warn(`[Supabase DB] credit_memos table insert notice:`, error.message || error);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos insert catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Persist full consolidated item breakdown safely in rma_settings ('consolidated_cm_items_store')
    if (isConsolidated) {
      await this.saveConsolidatedItemsEntry(cmNumber, {
        consolidated_items: consolidatedItems,
        rma_numbers: rmaNumbersList,
        report_ids: reportIdsList,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }

    // 3. Also update ALL linked rma_reports rows to 'credit_memo_issued' and store compact backup in notes
    if (rmaNumbersList.length > 0 || reportIdsList.length > 0) {
      try {
        const rmaReportBackup = JSON.stringify({
          credit_memo_number: cmNumber,
          pull_out_ref: pullOutRef,
          pull_out_date: pullOutDate,
          credit_amount: creditAmount,
          amount: grossAmount,
          credit_issued_by: dbMemoRow.credit_issued_by,
          credit_issued_at: dbMemoRow.credit_issued_at,
          consolidated_rma_numbers: rmaNumbersList,
          ...(isTest ? { is_test: true } : {})
        });
        if (rmaNumbersList.length > 0) {
          const { error: rmaErr } = await supabase
            .from('rma_reports')
            .update({
              notes: rmaReportBackup,
              status: 'credit_memo_issued'
            })
            .in('rma_number', rmaNumbersList);
          if (!rmaErr && !dbSuccess) dbSuccess = true;
        }
        if (reportIdsList.length > 0) {
          await supabase
            .from('rma_reports')
            .update({
              notes: rmaReportBackup,
              status: 'credit_memo_issued'
            })
            .in('id', reportIdsList);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('rma_reports status sync notice:', e);
      }
    }

    newMemo.is_synced_to_db = dbSuccess;

    // 4. Save to local storage
    const updatedList = [newMemo, ...existing.filter(m => m.credit_memo_number !== cmNumber)];
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: true, memo: newMemo, dbSaved: dbSuccess };
  },

  /**
   * Update an existing Credit Memo in Supabase 'credit_memos' table
   */
  async updateCreditMemo(cmNumber, updates) {
    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const index = existing.findIndex(m => m.credit_memo_number === cmNumber);
    if (index === -1) throw new Error(`Credit Memo ${cmNumber} not found.`);
    const currentMemo = existing[index];
    const isTestMemo = isTestRecord(currentMemo) || /^CM-TEST-/i.test(String(cmNumber || '')) || isTestRecord(updates);

    const consolidatedItems = Array.isArray(updates?.consolidated_items) && updates.consolidated_items.length > 0
      ? updates.consolidated_items
      : (currentMemo.consolidated_items || []);
    const rmaNumbersList = Array.from(new Set([
      ...(Array.isArray(updates?.consolidated_rma_numbers) ? updates.consolidated_rma_numbers : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(currentMemo.consolidated_rma_numbers) ? currentMemo.consolidated_rma_numbers : []),
      ...getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(currentMemo)
    ].filter(Boolean)));
    const reportIdsList = Array.from(new Set([
      ...(Array.isArray(updates?.consolidated_report_ids) ? updates.consolidated_report_ids : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(currentMemo.consolidated_report_ids) ? currentMemo.consolidated_report_ids : []),
      currentMemo.report_id
    ].filter((id) => id !== null && id !== undefined && /^\d+$/.test(String(id))).map((id) => Number(id))));

    const rawHumanNotes = updates?.notes !== undefined
      ? stripCreditMemoMetaTag(updates.notes || '')
      : (currentMemo.clean_notes ?? stripCreditMemoMetaTag(currentMemo.notes || ''));
    const packedNotes = buildPackedCmNotes(rawHumanNotes, isTestMemo, consolidatedItems, rmaNumbersList, reportIdsList);

    const unitPrice = updates.unit_price !== undefined ? Number(Number(updates.unit_price).toFixed(2)) : currentMemo.unit_price;
    const qty = updates.quantity !== undefined ? Number(updates.quantity) : currentMemo.quantity;
    const amount = updates.amount !== undefined ? Number(Number(updates.amount).toFixed(2)) : Number((qty * unitPrice).toFixed(2));
    const creditAmount = updates.credit_amount !== undefined ? Number(Number(updates.credit_amount).toFixed(2)) : currentMemo.credit_amount;

    const updated = {
      ...currentMemo,
      ...updates,
      unit_price: unitPrice,
      quantity: qty,
      amount: amount,
      credit_amount: creditAmount,
      notes: packedNotes,
      clean_notes: stripCreditMemoMetaTag(rawHumanNotes),
      consolidated_items: consolidatedItems,
      consolidated_rma_numbers: rmaNumbersList,
      consolidated_report_ids: reportIdsList,
      company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      is_synced_to_db: true
    };

    // 1. Update in dedicated 'credit_memos' table (strict schema columns only)
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .update({
          quantity: qty,
          unit_price: unitPrice,
          amount: amount,
          pull_out_ref: updated.pull_out_ref,
          pull_out_date: updated.pull_out_date,
          credit_amount: creditAmount,
          credit_issued_by: updated.credit_issued_by,
          notes: packedNotes,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('credit_memo_number', cmNumber);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('credit_memos table update notice:', error.message || error);
      } else {
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Credit memo ${cmNumber} updated in credit_memos table.`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos update catch:', e);
    }

    if (consolidatedItems.length > 1) {
      await this.saveConsolidatedItemsEntry(cmNumber, {
        consolidated_items: consolidatedItems,
        rma_numbers: rmaNumbersList,
        report_ids: reportIdsList,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }

    // 2. Update ALL linked rma_reports rows
    if (rmaNumbersList.length > 0) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: JSON.stringify({
              credit_memo_number: cmNumber,
              pull_out_ref: updated.pull_out_ref,
              pull_out_date: updated.pull_out_date,
              credit_amount: creditAmount,
              amount,
              consolidated_rma_numbers: rmaNumbersList
            }),
            status: 'credit_memo_issued'
          })
          .in('rma_number', rmaNumbersList);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 3. Update localStorage
    existing[index] = updated;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(existing));
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: true, memo: updated };
  },

  /**
   * Delete / Void a Credit Memo (resets ALL linked rma_reports rows for consolidated memos)
   */
  async deleteCreditMemo(cmNumber, reportId) {
    if (cmNumber) recentlyVoidedCmNumbers.add(cmNumber);
    cmMutationEpoch += 1;
    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const target = existing.find(m => m.credit_memo_number === cmNumber);
    const filtered = existing.filter(m => m.credit_memo_number !== cmNumber);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    } catch (e) {}

    // Run consolidated items cleanup, credit_memos deletion, and linked RMA resets in parallel
    const linkedRmas = Array.from(new Set([
      ...(target ? getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(target) : [])
    ].filter(Boolean)));
    const linkedIds = Array.from(new Set([
      ...(Array.isArray(target?.consolidated_report_ids) ? target.consolidated_report_ids : []),
      target?.report_id,
      reportId
    ].filter((id) => id !== null && id !== undefined && /^\d+$/.test(String(id))).map((id) => Number(id))));

    const ops = [
      this.saveConsolidatedItemsEntry(cmNumber, null),
      supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .delete()
        .eq('credit_memo_number', cmNumber)
        .then(({ error }) => {
          if (error) {
            console.warn('credit_memos table delete notice:', error.message || error);
          } else {
            console.log(`[Supabase DB] Credit memo ${cmNumber} deleted from credit_memos table.`);
          }
        })
    ];

    if (linkedRmas.length > 0) {
      ops.push(
        supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .in('rma_number', linkedRmas)
      );
    }
    if (linkedIds.length > 0) {
      ops.push(
        supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .in('id', linkedIds)
      );
    }

    await Promise.allSettled(ops);
    cmMutationEpoch += 1;

    return { success: true };
  },

  /**
   * Bulk Delete / Void multiple Credit Memos
   */
  async deleteMultipleCreditMemos(memoNumbers = []) {
    if (!memoNumbers || memoNumbers.length === 0) return { success: true };
    memoNumbers.forEach((n) => { if (n) recentlyVoidedCmNumbers.add(n); });
    cmMutationEpoch += 1;
    const numSet = new Set(memoNumbers);

    const existing = await this.getCreditMemos();
    const targets = existing.filter(m => numSet.has(m.credit_memo_number));
    const filtered = existing.filter(m => !numSet.has(m.credit_memo_number));

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CREDIT_MEMOS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    } catch (e) {}

    for (const cmNum of memoNumbers) {
      await this.saveConsolidatedItemsEntry(cmNum, null);
    }

    // 1. Bulk delete from 'credit_memos' table
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('credit_memos')
        .delete()
        .in('credit_memo_number', memoNumbers);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('credit_memos bulk delete notice:', error.message || error);
      } else {
        console.log(`[Supabase DB] Bulk deleted ${memoNumbers.length} rows from credit_memos table.`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('credit_memos bulk delete catch:', e);
    }

    // 2. Reset ALL affected rma_reports across single & consolidated memos
    const targetRmaSet = new Set();
    const targetIdSet = new Set();
    targets.forEach((t) => {
      getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(t).forEach((n) => targetRmaSet.add(n));
      if (t.report_id && /^\d+$/.test(String(t.report_id))) targetIdSet.add(Number(t.report_id));
      (Array.isArray(t.consolidated_report_ids) ? t.consolidated_report_ids : []).forEach((id) => {
        if (id && /^\d+$/.test(String(id))) targetIdSet.add(Number(id));
      });
    });

    const targetRmas = Array.from(targetRmaSet);
    const targetIds = Array.from(targetIdSet);
    if (targetRmas.length > 0) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .in('rma_number', targetRmas);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (targetIds.length > 0) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update({
            notes: null,
            status: 'pending'
          })
          .in('id', targetIds);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return { success: true, deletedCount: targets.length };
  }
};
