            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 16px;">
              Modified by: <strong>${escapeEmailHtml(editorName || 'Admin')}</strong> on ${formatDateTimeYmdHm(new Date())} (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="footer">
            Sender: ${config.senderEmail} • Dispatched by Pingcon RMA Portal
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
      </html>
    `;
  },

  /**
   * Dispatch email notification after a product is edited, created, or verified
   */
  async sendProductUpdateNotification({ product, isNew = false, editorName = 'Admin', customRecipients = null }, isTestMode = false) {
    if (!product) return { success: false, error: 'No product data' };

    const currentUser = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? authService.getCurrentUser() : null;
    const isSuperAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin';
    let hasActiveTestInvite = false;
    try {
      const rawGate = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_gate_session') : null;
      if (rawGate) {
        const parsedGate = JSON.parse(rawGate);
        if (parsedGate?.is_test === true && (!parsedGate.expires_at || new Date(parsedGate.expires_at) > new Date())) {
          hasActiveTestInvite = true;
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    const testActive = Boolean(
      isTestRecord(product) ||
      hasActiveTestInvite ||
      (isSuperAdmin && (
        isTestMode ||
        (typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true')
      ))
    );

    try {
      const config = this.resolveCompanyConfig(product, 'product_update', testActive);
      const sandboxEmail = this.getTestSandboxEmail();
      const resolvedToList = customRecipients && (Array.isArray(customRecipients.toList) || customRecipients.toEmail)
        ? splitEmailList(customRecipients.toList ?? customRecipients.toEmail)
        : config.toList;
      const toList = resolvedToList.length > 0
        ? resolvedToList
        : (testActive ? [sandboxEmail] : [...DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS.toList]);
      const toEmail = toList.join(', ');

      const resolvedBaseCc = customRecipients && Array.isArray(customRecipients.ccList)
        ? splitEmailList(customRecipients.ccList)
        : config.baseCcList;

      // Assemble CC list: NEVER merge Live Customer AE email when Test Mode is active
      const toSet = new Set(toList);
      const ccSet = new Set(resolvedBaseCc.filter((e) => !toSet.has(e)));
      const aeEmail = product.aeEmail || product.ae_email;
      if (!testActive && aeEmail && aeEmail.includes('@')) {
        const cleanAe = aeEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!toSet.has(cleanAe)) ccSet.add(cleanAe);
      }
      const finalCcList = Array.from(ccSet);

      const rawSubject = `[Product Catalog] ${isNew ? 'New Product Added' : 'Product Details Updated'}: ${product.name} (${product.barcode})`;
      const subject = formatTestEmailSubject(rawSubject, testActive);

      const htmlBody = this.generateProductEmailHtml(product, config, isNew, editorName, testActive);

      console.log(`[Product Update Email] (TestMode: ${testActive}) Dispatching from "${config.senderEmail}" to "${toEmail}", CC: [${finalCcList.join(', ')}]`);

      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          from: config.senderEmail,
          fromName: testActive ? `[TEST] ${config.senderName}` : config.senderName,
          to: toEmail,
          cc: finalCcList,
          subject,
          html: htmlBody,
          isTestMode: testActive,
          isTestModeExplicitRecipients: testActive,
          emailType: 'product_update',
          sandboxEmail,
          text: `${testActive ? '[TEST] ' : ''}Product ${isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'}: ${product.name} (${product.barcode}). SKU: ${product.code || 'N/A'}. AE: ${product.aeName || product.ae_name || 'N/A'}`
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorText = await res.text();
        console.warn('send-email response was not ok:', res.status, errorText);
        return { success: false, error: errorText };
      }

      const result = await res.json();
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Non-blocking error dispatching product email notification:', err.message);
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Build HTML body for the 4 lifecycle events:
   * - 'scrapped' | 'restocked' | 'pickup_debit_claim' | 'pickup_replacement'
   */
  generateLifecycleEmailHtml({
    eventType,
    report,
    reports = [],
    allReports = [],
    catalogProducts = [],
    config,
    actorName = '',
    isTestMode = false,
    pickupPhotoGroups = [],
    pickupPhotoEntries = [],
    intakePhotos = [],
    pdfAttachedFilename = null
  }) {
    const effectiveReports = Array.isArray(reports) && reports.length > 0 ? reports : (report ? [report] : []);
    const primaryReport = report || effectiveReports[0] || {};
    const isBatch = effectiveReports.length > 1;
    const isDebitClaimEvent = eventType === 'pickup_debit_claim';
    const isCustomerStream = primaryReport.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound';
    const rmaNumbersList = Array.from(new Set(
      effectiveReports.map((r) => r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || String(r.id || '')).filter(Boolean)
    ));
    const rmaNumber = primaryReport.rma_number || primaryReport.rmaNumber || primaryReport.id || 'RMA-PENDING';
    const meta = (primaryReport.ai_document_metadata && typeof primaryReport.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
      ? primaryReport.ai_document_metadata
      : {};
    const pickup = (meta.supplier_pickup && typeof meta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
      ? meta.supplier_pickup
      : {};
    const effectiveActor = String(actorName || pickup.processed_by || meta.simple_rtv_updated_by || '').trim();
    const claimNo = pickup.claim_number || (String(primaryReport.notes || '').match(/\[(?:RTV|BUF):\s*([^\]]+)\]/i)?.[1]?.trim()) || '';
    const refHeadline = isBatch
      ? `${effectiveReports.length} Consolidated RMAs (${claimNo || rmaNumber})`
      : rmaNumber;

    const eventMetaMap = {
      scrapped: {
        badge: isBatch ? `BATCH RMA SCRAPPED (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : 'RMA SCRAPPED / DISPOSED',
        title: `RMA Scrapped / Disposed: ${refHeadline}`,
        headerBg: '#9f1239',
        subtitle: 'Warehouse Disposal & Scrap Confirmation'
      },
      restocked: {
        badge: isBatch ? `BATCH RMA RESTOCKED (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : 'RMA RESTOCKED TO GOOD INVENTORY',
        title: `RMA Restocked: ${refHeadline}`,
        headerBg: '#0f766e',
        subtitle: 'Good Stock Restock & ERP Inventory Verification'
      },
      pickup_debit_claim: {
        badge: isCustomerStream
          ? (isBatch ? `CONSOLIDATED CUSTOMER HANDOVER — CREDIT / RETURN (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : 'CUSTOMER HANDOVER — CREDIT / RETURN')
          : (isBatch ? `CONSOLIDATED DRIVER PICKUP — DEBIT CLAIM (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : 'DRIVER PICKUP — DEBIT CLAIM'),
        title: `Driver Picked Up for Debit Claim: ${refHeadline}`,
        headerBg: '#1e3a8a',
        subtitle: isCustomerStream
          ? 'Customer Return Handover • Credit Return Form PDF Attached'
          : 'Supplier Return Picked Up • Debit Claim Form PDF Attached'
      },
      pickup_replacement: {
        badge: isCustomerStream
          ? (isBatch ? `CONSOLIDATED CUSTOMER BUFFER REPLACEMENT (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : 'CUSTOMER BUFFER REPLACEMENT / EXCHANGE')
          : (isBatch ? `CONSOLIDATED DRIVER PICKUP — REPLACEMENT (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs)` : 'DRIVER PICKUP — REPLACEMENT / EXCHANGE'),
        title: `Driver Picked Up for Replacement: ${refHeadline}`,
        headerBg: '#4338ca',
        subtitle: isCustomerStream
          ? 'Customer Buffer Replacement Completed • Buffer Replacement Form PDF Attached'
          : 'Supplier Replacement / Exchange Picked Up • Replacement Form PDF Attached'
      }
    };
    const ev = eventMetaMap[eventType] || eventMetaMap.scrapped;
    const isPickupEvent = eventType === 'pickup_debit_claim' || eventType === 'pickup_replacement';

    const { items: itemsTable } = getConsolidatedPickupItems({
      report: primaryReport,
      reports: effectiveReports,
      allReports,
      catalogProducts,
      combineIdentical: isPickupEvent
    });

    const grandPieces = itemsTable.reduce((s, it) => s + it.totalPieces, 0);
    const grandValue = itemsTable.reduce((s, it) => s + it.lineTotal, 0);
    const explanationSummary = collectUniqueExplanations(effectiveReports, itemsTable);
    const normalizedPhotoGroups = normalizePickupPhotoGroupsInput(pickupPhotoGroups, pickupPhotoEntries);
    const totalPickupPhotosCount = normalizedPhotoGroups.reduce((sum, grp) => sum + grp.urls.length, 0);

    const partyDisplayName = isCustomerStream
      ? (pickup.customer_name || pickup.supplier_name || primaryReport.store_branch || primaryReport.reporter_name || 'Wholesale Customer')
      : (pickup.supplier_name || primaryReport.supplier_name || primaryReport.supplierName || 'Pending Assignment');
    const eventTimeStr = formatDateTimeYmdHm(
      (isPickupEvent && pickup.picked_up_at) ||
      meta.resolved_at ||
      meta.simple_rtv_updated_at ||
      new Date()
    );
    const driveUrl = primaryReport.google_drive_folder_url || pickup.drive_folder_url || '';
    const needsReorderFlag = primaryReport.needs_reorder === true || meta.needs_reorder === true || String(primaryReport.notes || '').includes('[REORDER: YES]');
    const hubLabel = primaryReport.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'Supplier RTV' : 'Customer Hub';
    const branchSummary = Array.from(new Set(
      effectiveReports.map((r) => String(r.store_branch || '').trim()).filter(Boolean)
    )).join(', ') || 'Warehouse / N/A';
    const aeSummary = Array.from(new Set(
      effectiveReports
        .map((r) => r.ae_name ? `${r.ae_name}${r.ae_email ? ` (${r.ae_email})` : ''}` : (r.ae_email || ''))

    return `

          .container { max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }
          .header { background: ${ev.headerBg}; padding: 24px 28px; color: #ffffff; }
          .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 8px; }
          .title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; }
          .content { padding: 26px; }
          .card { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
          .grid { display: table; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
          .row { display: table-row; }
          .col-label { display: table-cell; width: 38%; padding: 6px 8px 6px 0; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; font-weight: 600; vertical-align: top; }
          .col-val { display: table-cell; padding: 6px 0; font-size: 13px; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; }
          .section-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #475569; margin: 20px 0 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid #f1f5f9; padding-bottom: 6px; }
          table.items { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; }
          table.items th { background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }
          table.items td { border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px; vertical-align: top; }
          .footer { background: #f1f5f9; padding: 16px 28px; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="container">
          <div class="header">
            <span class="badge">${isTestMode ? `[TEST] ${ev.badge}` : ev.badge}</span>
            <h1 class="title">${isTestMode ? '[TEST] ' : ''}${escapeEmailHtml(ev.title)}</h1>
            <div style="font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 4px;">${escapeEmailHtml(ev.subtitle)}</div>
          </div>

          <div class="content">
            ${pdfAttachedFilename ? `

              📎 Attached Official PDF Form: <span style="font-family: monospace;">${escapeEmailHtml(pdfAttachedFilename)}</span>
            </div>` : ''}

              <div class="grid">
                <div class="row">
                  <div class="col-label">${isBatch ? `Bundled RMA Numbers (${rmaNumbersList.length}):` : 'RMA Number:'}</div>
                  <div class="col-val" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #1e3a8a;">${escapeEmailHtml(isBatch ? rmaNumbersList.join(', ') : rmaNumber)}</div>

            ${normalizedPhotoGroups.length > 0 ? `
            <div class="section-title">Driver Pickup Verification Photos (${normalizedPhotoGroups.length}/5 categories • ${totalPickupPhotosCount} photo${totalPickupPhotosCount === 1 ? '' : 's'})</div>
            <div style="margin-top: 12px;">
              ${normalizedPhotoGroups.map((grp, grpIdx) => `
              <div style="margin-bottom: 16px; padding: 12px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 10px;">
                <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                  ${grpIdx + 1}. ${escapeEmailHtml(grp.label)} (${grp.urls.length} photo${grp.urls.length === 1 ? '' : 's'})
                </div>
                ${grp.urls.map((imgUrl, photoIdx) => `
                <div style="margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;">
                  ${grp.urls.length > 1 ? `<div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 4px;">Photo ${photoIdx + 1} of ${grp.urls.length}</div>` : ''}
                  <img src="${escapeEmailHtml(imgUrl)}" alt="${escapeEmailHtml(grp.label)} #${photoIdx + 1}" style="max-width: 100%; max-height: 360px; width: auto; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;" />
                </div>`).join('')}
              </div>`).join('')}
            </div>` : ''}

            ${intakePhotos.length > 0 ? `
            <div class="section-title">Uploaded RMA Intake Photos (${intakePhotos.length})</div>
            <div style="margin-top: 12px;">
              ${intakePhotos.map((url, idx) => `
              <div style="margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: center;">
                <img src="${escapeEmailHtml(url)}" alt="RMA Intake Photo ${idx + 1}" style="max-width: 100%; max-height: 360px; width: auto; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;" />
                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 4px; font-weight: 700;">Intake Photo ${idx + 1} of ${intakePhotos.length}</div>
              </div>`).join('')}
            </div>` : ''}
          </div>

          <div class="footer">
            Automated RMA Lifecycle Notification — Pingcon Marketing Corp. RMA Portal<br/>
            Sender: ${escapeEmailHtml(config.senderEmail)} • Event Time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): ${escapeEmailHtml(eventTimeStr)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
      </html>
    `;
  },

  /**
   * Dispatch lifecycle email for:
   * - 'scrapped' | 'restocked' | 'pickup_debit_claim' | 'pickup_replacement'
   */
  async sendRmaLifecycleNotification({
    eventType,
    report = null,
    reports = [],
    allReports = [],
    catalogProducts = [],
    actorName = '',
    isTestMode = false,
    customRecipients = null
  }) {
    const effectiveReports = Array.isArray(reports) && reports.length > 0
      ? reports
      : (report ? [report] : []);
    const primaryReport = report || effectiveReports[0];
    if (!primaryReport || !eventType) return { success: false, error: 'Missing report or eventType' };

    const testActive = Boolean(
      this.resolveTestModeActive(primaryReport, isTestMode) ||
      effectiveReports.some((r) => isTestRecord(r))
    );

    try {
      const profileKey = resolveEmailProfileKey(eventType);
      const config = this.resolveCompanyConfig(primaryReport, profileKey, testActive);
      const sandboxEmail = this.getTestSandboxEmail();
      const isBatch = effectiveReports.length > 1;
      const isDebitClaimEvent = eventType === 'pickup_debit_claim';
      const isCustomerStream = primaryReport.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound';
      const rmaNumber = primaryReport.rma_number || primaryReport.rmaNumber || primaryReport.id || 'RMA';
      const meta = (primaryReport.ai_document_metadata && typeof primaryReport.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
        ? primaryReport.ai_document_metadata
        : {};
      const pickup = (meta.supplier_pickup && typeof meta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
        ? meta.supplier_pickup
        : {};
      const effectiveActor = String(actorName || pickup.processed_by || meta.simple_rtv_updated_by || '').trim();
      const claimNo = pickup.claim_number || (String(primaryReport.notes || '').match(/\[(?:RTV|BUF):\s*([^\]]+)\]/i)?.[1]?.trim()) || '';

      const isPickupEvent = isDebitClaimEvent || eventType === 'pickup_replacement';
      const supplierToList = isPickupEvent ? splitEmailList(pickup.supplier_email_to) : [];
      const supplierCcList = isPickupEvent ? splitEmailList(pickup.supplier_email_cc) : [];

      const baseToList = customRecipients && (Array.isArray(customRecipients.toList) || customRecipients.toEmail)
        ? splitEmailList(customRecipients.toList ?? customRecipients.toEmail)
        : config.toList;
      const baseCcList = customRecipients && Array.isArray(customRecipients.ccList)
        ? splitEmailList(customRecipients.ccList)
        : config.baseCcList;

      const mergedTo = Array.from(new Set([
        ...baseToList,
        ...supplierToList
      ]));
      const toList = mergedTo.length > 0
        ? mergedTo
        : (testActive ? [sandboxEmail] : [...DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS.toList]);
      const toEmail = toList.join(', ') || config.toEmail;

      const toSet = new Set(toList);
      const ccSet = new Set([
        ...baseCcList,
        ...supplierCcList
      ].filter((e) => !toSet.has(e)));
      if (!testActive) {
        effectiveReports.forEach((r) => {
          if (r?.ae_email && String(r.ae_email).includes('@')) {
            const cleanAe = String(r.ae_email).trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!toSet.has(cleanAe)) ccSet.add(cleanAe);
          }
        });
      }
      const finalCcList = Array.from(ccSet);

      const savedTestMap = testActive ? this._readSavedProfilesMap(true) : {};
      const hasCustomTestProfileOrGlobal = testActive && Boolean(
        savedTestMap[profileKey] ||
        (typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem(TEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS_STORAGE_KEY)) ||
        (customRecipients && (
          splitEmailList(customRecipients.toList ?? customRecipients.toEmail).join(',') !== sandboxEmail ||
          splitEmailList(customRecipients.ccList).length > 0
        ))
      );

      const batchTag = isBatch ? `Consolidated (${effectiveReports.length} RMAs) — ` : '';
      const subjectLabelMap = {
        scrapped: `[RMA Scrapped] ${batchTag}${claimNo || rmaNumber}: ${primaryReport.name || primaryReport.barcode || 'Items'}`,
        restocked: `[RMA Restocked] ${batchTag}${claimNo || rmaNumber}: ${primaryReport.name || primaryReport.barcode || 'Items'}`,
        pickup_debit_claim: `[Driver Picked Up - Debit Claim] ${batchTag}${claimNo || rmaNumber}: ${pickup.supplier_name || primaryReport.supplier_name || 'Supplier'}`,
        pickup_replacement: `[Driver Picked Up - Replacement] ${batchTag}${claimNo || rmaNumber}: ${pickup.supplier_name || primaryReport.supplier_name || 'Supplier'}`
      };
      const baseSubject = subjectLabelMap[eventType] || `[RMA Update] ${batchTag}${rmaNumber}`;
      const subject = formatTestEmailSubject(baseSubject, testActive);

      // Collect pickup verification photos (normalizing string | string[]) + RMA intake photos across all bundled RMAs
      const pickupPhotoGroups = collectPickupPhotoGroupsFromReports(effectiveReports);
      const pickupPhotoEntries = pickupPhotoGroups.flatMap((grp) =>
        grp.urls.map((url) => ({ label: grp.label, url }))
      );

      const pickupUrlSet = new Set(pickupPhotoEntries.map((e) => e.url));
      const intakePhotoSet = new Set();
      effectiveReports.forEach((r) => {
        getRealPhotos(r).forEach((u) => {
          if (u && !pickupUrlSet.has(u)) intakePhotoSet.add(u);
        });
      });
      const allIntakePhotos = Array.from(intakePhotoSet);

      const attachments = [];
      let pdfAttachedFilename = null;
      if (isPickupEvent) {
        const pdfAttachment = generatePickupFormPdfAttachment({
          report: primaryReport,
          reports: effectiveReports,
          allReports,
          catalogProducts,
          preparedByOverride: pickup.processed_by || effectiveActor || '',
          combineIdentical: true
        });
        if (pdfAttachment) {
          attachments.push({
            filename: pdfAttachment.filename,
            content: pdfAttachment.content,
            encoding: 'base64',
            contentType: 'application/pdf'
          });
          pdfAttachedFilename = pdfAttachment.filename;
        }
      }

      // Attach remote HTTPS image links up to safe Gmail/Vercel cap (first cover at least 1 photo per pickup category,
      // then remaining pickup photos, then intake photos; all photos remain embedded in HTML).
      const attachedUrls = new Set();
      let remoteImgCount = 0;
      const tryPushRemoteImage = (url, filename) => {
        if (remoteImgCount >= MAX_REMOTE_IMAGE_ATTACHMENTS) return;
        const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
        if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(cleanUrl) || attachedUrls.has(cleanUrl)) return;
        attachedUrls.add(cleanUrl);
        remoteImgCount += 1;
        attachments.push({ filename, path: cleanUrl });
      };

      if (isPickupEvent) {
        // Pass 1: 1 representative photo per category
        pickupPhotoGroups.forEach((grp) => {
          if (grp.urls[0]) {
            tryPushRemoteImage(grp.urls[0], `${grp.key || 'pickup'}_1.jpg`);
          }
        });
        // Pass 2: remaining multi-photo uploads per category up to cap
        pickupPhotoGroups.forEach((grp) => {
          grp.urls.slice(1).forEach((url, idx) => {
            tryPushRemoteImage(url, `${grp.key || 'pickup'}_${idx + 2}.jpg`);
          });
        });
        // Pass 3: intake photos up to cap
        allIntakePhotos.forEach((url, idx) => {
          tryPushRemoteImage(url, `rma_intake_photo_${idx + 1}.jpg`);
        });
      }

      const { items: itemsTable } = getConsolidatedPickupItems({
        report: primaryReport,
        reports: effectiveReports,
        allReports,
        catalogProducts,
        combineIdentical: isPickupEvent
      });
      const explanationSummary = collectUniqueExplanations(effectiveReports, itemsTable);

      const htmlBody = this.generateLifecycleEmailHtml({
        eventType,
        report: primaryReport,
        reports: effectiveReports,
        allReports,
        catalogProducts,
        config,
        actorName: effectiveActor,
        isTestMode: testActive,
        pickupPhotoGroups: isPickupEvent ? pickupPhotoGroups : [],
        pickupPhotoEntries: isPickupEvent ? pickupPhotoEntries : [],
        intakePhotos: isPickupEvent ? allIntakePhotos : [],
        pdfAttachedFilename
      });

      const eventTimeStr = formatDateTimeYmdHm(new Date());
      const partyDisplay = isCustomerStream && isPickupEvent
        ? (pickup.customer_name || pickup.supplier_name || primaryReport.store_branch || primaryReport.reporter_name || 'Wholesale Customer')
        : (pickup.supplier_name || primaryReport.supplier_name || primaryReport.supplierName || 'Pending Assignment');
      const branchSummaryText = Array.from(new Set(
        effectiveReports.map((r) => String(r.store_branch || '').trim()).filter(Boolean)
      )).join(', ') || 'Warehouse / N/A';

      const wfForText = computeFourStepWorkflow(primaryReport, catalogProducts, {
        customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: this.getDailyFollowUpConfig().customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled
      });
      const plainTextLines = [
        `${testActive ? '[TEST] ' : ''}${baseSubject}`,
        `${isCustomerStream && isPickupEvent ? 'Customer / Outlet' : 'Supplier / Vendor'}: ${partyDisplay}`,
        ...(isDebitClaimEvent
          ? [
              `Defect / Return Reason: ${primaryReport.reason || 'Damaged / Defective'}`,
              `Explanation / Defect Notes: ${explanationSummary}`
            ]
          : [
              ...(primaryReport.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound' ? [`Store / Branch: ${branchSummaryText}`] : []),
              `Defect / Return Reason: ${primaryReport.reason || 'Damaged / Defective'}`,
              `Warehouse Location: ${primaryReport.warehouse_location || 'Receiving / Warehouse'}`
            ]),
        `Workflow Timeline: Step 1 Report=${wfForText.step1.dateDisplay} | Step 2=${wfForText.step2.text} | Step 3 Picked Up=${wfForText.step3.dateDisplay} | Step 4=${wfForText.step4.dateDisplay}`,
        ...(Array.isArray(wfForText.timelineDays)
          ? wfForText.timelineDays.map((d) => (
              d.day === 0
                ? `  - Day 0 (Report Date): ${d.dateLabel} => ${d.statusText}`
                : `  - Day ${d.day} (${d.dateLabel}) => ${d.statusText}`
            ))
          : []),
        ...(itemsTable.length > 0
          ? [
              `Items (${itemsTable.length} line${itemsTable.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}):`,
              ...itemsTable.map((it) => {
                const expSuffix = isDebitClaimEvent && it.explanation ? ` | Explanation: ${it.explanation}` : '';
                return `- ${it.name} (SKU: ${it.sku}) • Qty: ${it.totalPieces} pcs${expSuffix}`;
              })
            ]
          : []),
        `Processed By: ${effectiveActor || 'Not specified'}`,
        `Event Time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm): ${eventTimeStr}`
      ];

      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          from: config.senderEmail,
          fromName: testActive ? `[TEST] ${config.senderName}` : config.senderName,
          to: toEmail,
          cc: finalCcList,
          subject,
          html: htmlBody,
          isTestMode: testActive,
          isTestModeExplicitRecipients: testActive && !isPickupEvent,
          ...(testActive && isPickupEvent ? {
            hasCustomTestRecipients: hasCustomTestProfileOrGlobal,
            testToList: baseToList,
            testCcList: baseCcList
          } : {}),
          emailType: profileKey,
          sandboxEmail,
          attachments,
          text: plainTextLines.join('\n')
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorText = await res.text();
        console.warn(`Lifecycle email (${eventType}) response not ok:`, res.status, errorText);
        return { success: false, error: errorText };
      }

      return await res.json();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`Non-blocking error sending lifecycle email (${eventType}):`, err.message);
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Manually trigger the Overall RMA Matrix (.xlsx) email dispatch
   */
  async sendDailyMatrixEmailNow({
    startDate,
    endDate,
    rollingDays,
    includeAllRecords,
    stream,
    includeZeroCatalogSkus,
    to,
    toList,
    cc,
    ccList,
    isTestMode = false,
    force = true,
    dryRun = false,
    respectSchedule = false
  } = {}) {
    try {
      let accessToken = '';
      try {
        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
        accessToken = session?.access_token || '';
      } catch {}

      const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
      if (accessToken) {
        headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
      }

      const payload = {
        action: 'daily-matrix',
        isTestMode: Boolean(isTestMode),
        sandboxEmail: this.getTestSandboxEmail(),
        force: Boolean(force),
        dryRun: Boolean(dryRun),
        ...(respectSchedule ? { respectSchedule: true } : {})
      };
      if (startDate) payload.startDate = startDate;
      if (endDate) payload.endDate = endDate;
      if (rollingDays !== undefined && rollingDays !== null) {
        payload.rollingDays = Number(rollingDays);
      }
      if (includeAllRecords !== undefined) {
        payload.includeAllRecords = Boolean(includeAllRecords);
      }
      if (stream) payload.stream = stream;
      if (includeZeroCatalogSkus !== undefined) {
        payload.includeZeroCatalogSkus = Boolean(includeZeroCatalogSkus);
      }
      if (toList !== undefined || to !== undefined) {
        payload.to = to ?? toList;
        payload.toList = Array.isArray(toList) ? toList : splitEmailList(to);
        if (isTestMode && payload.toList.length > 0) {
          payload.isTestModeExplicitRecipients = true;
        }
      }
      if (ccList !== undefined || cc !== undefined) {
        payload.cc = ccList ?? cc;
        payload.ccList = Array.isArray(ccList) ? ccList : splitEmailList(cc);
        if (isTestMode) {
          payload.isTestModeExplicitRecipients = true;
        }
      }

      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email?action=daily-matrix', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          status: res.status,
          error: data?.message || data?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`
        };
      }
      return data || { success: false, error: 'Empty response from server.' };
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Manually trigger or dry-run the 10-Calendar-Day Pickup Follow-Up & Auto-Dispose Check
   */
  async runDailyFollowUpNow({
    isTestMode = false,
    force = false,
    dryRun = false,
    rmaNumber = '',
    operation = 'run_all',

  } = {}) {

    } catch (err) {

    }
  },

  /**
   * Poll Gmail IMAP replies with edited `.xlsx` attachments and apply RMA updates
   */
  async syncEmailRepliesNow({ source = 'admin_auto_poll', includeIdleLogs = false, strict = false } = {}) {
    try {
      let accessToken = '';
      try {
        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
        accessToken = session?.access_token || '';
      } catch {}

      const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
      if (accessToken) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;

      const qs = new URLSearchParams({ action: 'sync-email-replies', source });
      if (includeIdleLogs) qs.set('includeIdleLogs', '1');
      if (strict) qs.set('strict', '1');

      const res = await fetch(`/api/send-email?${qs.toString()}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'sync-email-replies', source, includeIdleLogs })
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          ...(data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {}),
          success: false,
          status: res.status,
          error: data?.message || data?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`
        };
      }
      return data || { success: false, error: 'Empty response from server.' };
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Fetch persisted 2-way email reply sync health status & recent execution/error logs
   */
  async getEmailReplySyncLogs() {
    try {
      let accessToken = '';
      try {
        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
        accessToken = session?.access_token || '';
      } catch {}

      const headers = {};
      if (accessToken) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;

      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email?action=reply-sync-logs', {
        method: 'GET',
        headers
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          status: res.status,
          error: data?.message || data?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`,
          statusSummary: null,
          logs: []
        };
      }
      return data || { success: false, error: 'Empty response from server.', statusSummary: null, logs: [] };
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message, statusSummary: null, logs: [] };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Manually upload an edited New RMA Alert `.xlsx` workbook to update its matching RMA ticket
   */
  async ingestEditedRmaXlsx({ file, rmaNumber = '', actorName = 'Admin' } = {}) {
    if (!file) return { success: false, error: 'Please select a .xlsx file.' };
    try {
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
      let binary = '';
      const chunk = 0x8000;
      for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunk) {
        binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + chunk));
      }
      const fileBase64 = btoa(binary);

      let accessToken = '';
      try {
        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
        accessToken = session?.access_token || '';
      } catch {}

      const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
      if (accessToken) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;

      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email?action=ingest-xlsx-reply', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: 'ingest-xlsx-reply',
          fileBase64,
          filename: file.name || 'edited-rma.xlsx',
          rmaNumber,
          actorName
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          status: res.status,
          error: data?.message || data?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`
        };
      }
      return data || { success: false, error: 'Empty response from server.' };
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Diagnostic: Test Google SMTP connection and authentication credentials
   */
  async testSmtpConnection() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/send-email?action=test-connection', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'test-connection' })
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        return { success: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}: ${await res.text()}` };
      }
      return await res.json();
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }
};

import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { notificationService } from './notificationService';
import { formatDateTimeYmdHm } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_pin_requests_v2';
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'pin_requests_store';

function notifyPinRequestsChanged(record = null) {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-pin-requests-changed', { detail: { record } }));
    try {
      if (window.BroadcastChannel) {
        const ch = new BroadcastChannel('rma_portal_sync_bus');
        ch.postMessage({ type: 'pin-requests-changed', record });
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}

export const pinRequestService = {
  /**
   * GET ALL PIN REQUESTS
   * Queries public.pin_requests table -> fallback to rma_settings -> fallback to localStorage
   */
  async getRequests() {
    let remoteRequests = null;

    // 1. Try dedicated table in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .select('*')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
        remoteRequests = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet in database
    }

    // 2. Fallback to rma_settings store
    if (remoteRequests === null) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', SETTINGS_KEY)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (!error && data?.value && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
          remoteRequests = data.value;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Settings fallback
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to localStorage
    let localRequests = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        localRequests = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      localRequests = [];
    }

    const finalRequests = remoteRequests !== null ? remoteRequests : localRequests;

    // Keep localStorage in sync
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(finalRequests));
    } catch (e) {}

    return finalRequests;
  },

  /**
   * GET PENDING REQUESTS COUNT (for badges in header)
   */
  async getPendingCount() {
    const requests = await this.getRequests();
    return requests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length;
  },

  /**
   * SUBMIT NEW PIN REQUEST
   */
  async createPinRequest({
    accessSlug,
    accessKeyId = null,
    requesterEmail,
    requesterName,
    organizationName = '',
    notes = '',
    isTestMode = false
  }) {
    if (!accessSlug || !requesterEmail || !requesterName) {
      throw new Error('Please provide Access Slug, Email, and Name.');
    }

    const newRecord = {
      id: typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : `req_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`,
      access_slug: String(accessSlug).trim().toLowerCase(),
      access_key_id: accessKeyId || null,
      requester_email: String(requesterEmail).trim().toLowerCase(),
      requester_name: String(requesterName).trim(),
      organization_name: String(organizationName || '').trim(),
      notes: String(notes || '').trim(),
      status: 'pending',
      approved_by: null,
      reviewed_at: null,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    let insertedRemote = false;

    // 1. Try dedicated table
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .insert([newRecord])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (!error && data) {
        insertedRemote = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet
    }

    // 2. Always update local storage & sync to rma_settings fallback
    const allRequests = await this.getRequests();
    const updatedRequests = [newRecord, ...allRequests.filter(r => r.id !== newRecord.id)];

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedRequests));
    } catch (e) {}

    if (!insertedRemote) {
      try {
        await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .upsert({
            key: SETTINGS_KEY,
            value: updatedRequests,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'key' });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 3. Dispatch automated alert email to Admin team (recipients same as RMA reports, strictly EXCLUDING AE email)
    this.sendPinRequestAlertEmail(newRecord, Boolean(isTestMode)).catch(err => {
      console.warn('Non-blocking PIN request email notification error:', err);
    });

    notifyPinRequestsChanged(newRecord);
    return { success: true, data: newRecord };
  },

  /**
   * DISPATCH ALERT EMAIL TO ADMINS ON NEW PIN REQUEST
   * Recipients: Same recipients as RMA reports, strictly EXCLUDING AE email.
   */
  async sendPinRequestAlertEmail(requestRecord, isTestMode = false) {
    try {
      const emailSettings = notificationService.getEmailSettings();
      const toEmail = String(emailSettings?.toEmail || 'azgodev@gmail.com').trim();
      const baseCcList = Array.isArray(emailSettings?.baseCcList) ? emailSettings.baseCcList : [
        'mgan@pingconmarketing.com',
        'marketing@pingconmarketing.com',
        'azgan@pingconmarketing.com',
        'jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com'
      ];

      // Filter valid email addresses and ensure NO Account Executive email is included
      const cleanCcList = baseCcList.filter(e => typeof e === 'string' && e.includes('@'));

      const rawSubject = `[Action Required] New Return PIN Authorization Request: ${requestRecord.requester_name} (${requestRecord.organization_name || requestRecord.access_slug})`;
      const subject = isTestMode ? `[TEST] ${rawSubject}` : rawSubject;

      const portalUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.origin

  /**

  async approveRequest({

        .from('pin_requests')

          status: 'approved',
          approved_by: approvedBy,
          reviewed_at: reviewedAt

        .eq('id', requestId);

Keep this PIN safe—you can reuse it for future damaged item reports under this QR profile.`;

    notifyPinRequestsChanged();

  /**
   * REJECT REQUEST
   */
  async rejectRequest({ requestId, rejectedBy = 'Admin', reason = '' }) {
    const allRequests = await this.getRequests();
    const target = allRequests.find(r => r.id === requestId);
    if (!target) {
      throw new Error('PIN request not found.');
    }

    const reviewedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedTarget = {
      ...target,
      status: 'rejected',
      approved_by: rejectedBy,
      reviewed_at: reviewedAt,
      notes: reason ? `${target.notes ? `${target.notes} | ` : ''}[Rejection reason: ${reason}]` : target.notes
    };

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .update({
          status: 'rejected',
          approved_by: rejectedBy,
          reviewed_at: reviewedAt,
          notes: updatedTarget.notes
        })
        .eq('id', requestId);
    } catch (e) {}

    const updatedList = allRequests.map(r => r.id === requestId ? updatedTarget : r);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'key' });
    } catch (e) {}

    notifyPinRequestsChanged();
    return { success: true, request: updatedTarget };
  },

  /**
   * BATCH APPROVE REQUESTS
   */
  async approveBatch({ requestIds, approvedBy = 'Admin', getProfilePinFn, isTestMode = false }) {
    const results = [];
    for (const id of requestIds) {
      try {
        const pinInfo = getProfilePinFn ? await getProfilePinFn(id) : { pinCode: '123456', profileName: 'RMA Station', accessSlug: 'dock' };
        const res = await this.approveRequest({
          requestId: id,
          approvedBy,
          pinCode: pinInfo.pinCode,
          profileName: pinInfo.profileName,
          accessSlug: pinInfo.accessSlug,
          isTestMode
        });
        results.push(res);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Batch approval error for request', id, err);
      }
    }
    notifyPinRequestsChanged();
    return results;
  },

  /**
   * DELETE REQUEST
   */
  async deleteRequest(requestId) {
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('pin_requests')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', requestId);
    } catch (e) {}

    const allRequests = await this.getRequests();
    const updatedList = allRequests.filter(r => r.id !== requestId);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'key' });
    } catch (e) {}

    notifyPinRequestsChanged();
    return { success: true };
  }
};

/**
 * Antigravity Finance & Purchase Orders API v1 Service
 * 
 * Direct integration with Laravel Cloud database containing:
 * - erply_products: 5,793+ live SKU catalog with names, prices, VAT & suppliers
 * - auto_po_supplier_contacts: 610+ supplier directory with terms, emails & contacts
 * - proof_of_delivery_items: 554,000+ line items history
 */

import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_PO_API_URL || 'https://purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1';
const getApiKey = () => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const storedDanilo = localStorage.getItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO');
    if (storedDanilo && storedDanilo.trim()) return storedDanilo.trim();
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('rma_po_api_key');
    if (stored && stored.trim()) return stored.trim();
  }
  return import.meta.env.VITE_EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO || import.meta.env.VITE_PO_API_KEY || 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key';
};

let isApiUnauthorized = (() => {
  try {
    return sessionStorage.getItem('rma_po_api_disabled') === 'true';
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
})();

const markUnauthorized = () => {
  isApiUnauthorized = true;
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_disabled', 'true');
  } catch (e) {}
};

const clearUnauthorized = () => {
  isApiUnauthorized = false;
  try {
    sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_po_api_disabled');
  } catch (e) {}
};

let lastCheckTime = 0;

// Routing Group inference
const inferGroup = (name = '', brand = '') => {
  const text = `${name} ${brand}`.toLowerCase();
  if (text.includes('keysys') || text.includes('a2z2go') || text.includes('terminal') || text.includes('pos')) {
    return 'Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)';
  }
  return 'Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA TISSUE)';
};

// Normalize API item to app standard format
export const normalizeProduct = (item) => {
  if (!item) return null;
  const sku = item.code || item.sku || `SKU-${item.id}`;
  // In coworker's API, ean_code stores the barcode values from the items, and code stores our SKU
  const barcode = item.ean_code || item.code2 || item.barcode || sku;
  const priceWithVat = parseFloat(item.priceWithVat) || parseFloat(item.price) || 0;
  const netPrice = parseFloat(item.price) || (priceWithVat / 1.12);

  return {
    id: String(item.id || sku),
    sku: sku,
    code: sku,
    barcode: barcode,
    ean_code: item.ean_code || null,
    name: item.name || '',
    brand: item.brandName || '',
    brand_name: item.brandName || '',
    supplier: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
    supplier_name: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
    supplierName: item.supplierName || 'Savemore',
    unit_price: netPrice,
    price: netPrice,
    price_with_vat: priceWithVat,
    priceWithVat: priceWithVat,
    case_pack: item.unitName ? `Per ${item.unitName}` : '1 pc',
    unit_name: item.unitName || 'pc',
    unitName: item.unitName || 'pc',
    image_url: item.imageUrl || item.image_url || null, // Strictly real images only, no fake/stock photos
    group: inferGroup(item.name || '', item.brandName || ''),
    requires_serial: Boolean(item.hasSerialNumbers),
    has_serial_numbers: Boolean(item.hasSerialNumbers),
    ae_name: null,
    ae_email: null,
    is_verified: true,
    source: 'erply_api',
    raw_data: item
  };
};

export const purchaseOrdersApi = {
  /**
   * Healthcheck & table access check
  /**
   * Load API key from Supabase cloud so mobile devices automatically get the key without manual re-entry
   */
  async loadApiKeyFromCloud() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO') || localStorage.getItem('rma_po_api_key');
    if (stored && stored.trim() && stored.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      return stored.trim();
    }

    try {
      // 1. Primary: Check rma_settings table where Admin stores the key
      const { data: settingData } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', 'EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (settingData?.value && typeof settingData.value === 'string' && settingData.value.trim() && settingData.value.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
        const cloudKey = settingData.value.trim();
        localStorage.setItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO', cloudKey);
        localStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_key', cloudKey);
        clearUnauthorized();
        return cloudKey;
      }

      // 2. Secondary: Check products table __CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('code')
        .eq('barcode', '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (data?.code && data.code.trim() && data.code.trim() !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
        const cloudKey = data.code.trim();
        localStorage.setItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO', cloudKey);
        localStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_key', cloudKey);
        clearUnauthorized();
        return cloudKey;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Notice loading cloud API key:', e?.message || e);
    }
    return null;
  },

  /**
   * Set API key and sync to Supabase for all devices (PC, mobile, tablet)
   */
  async setApiKey(key) {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      if (key && key.trim()) {
        const clean = key.trim();
        localStorage.setItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO', clean);
        localStorage.setItem('rma_po_api_key', clean);
        clearUnauthorized();

        // Sync to cloud so mobile devices have instant access
        try {
          await supabase.from('products').upsert({
            barcode: '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__',
            name: 'System Config PO API Key',
            code: clean,
            is_verified: false,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'barcode' });

          await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
            key: 'EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO',
            value: clean,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { onConflict: 'key' });
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Cloud API key sync notice:', e);
        }
      } else {
        localStorage.removeItem('EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO');
        localStorage.removeItem('rma_po_api_key');
        clearUnauthorized();
        try {
          await supabase.from('products').delete().eq('barcode', '__CONFIG_PO_API_KEY__');
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  },

  getApiKey() {
    return getApiKey();
  },

  isUnauthorized() {
    return isApiUnauthorized;
  },

  /**
   * Healthcheck & table access check
   */
  async testConnection(force = false) {
    let key = getApiKey();
    if (!key || key === 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) key = cloudKey;
    }

    if (isApiUnauthorized && !force) {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) {
        key = cloudKey;
      } else {
        return { connected: false, error: 'Product Catalog API Key is unauthorized (HTTP 401). Update key in Settings.' };
      }
    }

    lastCheckTime = Date.now();

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/tables`, {
        headers: {
          'X-API-Key': key,
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        if (res.status === 401) markUnauthorized();
        return { connected: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}` };
      }
      clearUnauthorized();
      const data = await res.json();
      return { 
        connected: true, 
        tableCount: data.total_tables || 24,
        message: 'Connected to Live Purchase Orders API v1 (Laravel Cloud)'
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return { connected: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Fast lookup of a single product by Barcode or SKU code
   * Checks erply_products table (5,793 items)
   */
  async findProductByBarcode(barcodeOrCode) {
    if (!barcodeOrCode) return null;
    const clean = String(barcodeOrCode).trim();
    if (!clean) return null;

    let key = getApiKey();
    if (!key || key === 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key' || isApiUnauthorized) {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) {
        key = cloudKey;
      } else if (isApiUnauthorized) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    // Backend SQL is case-sensitive. Try exact code variations:
    const codeCandidates = Array.from(new Set([clean, clean.toUpperCase(), clean.toLowerCase()]));

    const fetchWithTimeout = async (url) => {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);
      try {
        return await fetch(url, {
          headers: {
            'X-API-Key': key,
            'Accept': 'application/json'
          },
          signal: controller.signal
        });
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    };

    for (const code of codeCandidates) {
      try {
        // 1. FIRST PRIORITY: Direct equality lookup on ean_code (Manufacturer / Retail Barcode!): ?ean_code=...
        const eanUrl = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?ean_code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const resEan = await fetchWithTimeout(eanUrl);

        if (resEan.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          return null;
        }

        if (resEan.ok) {
          const jsonEan = await resEan.json();
          if (jsonEan.data && jsonEan.data.length > 0) {
            return normalizeProduct(jsonEan.data[0]);
          }
        }

        // 2. SECOND PRIORITY: Direct equality lookup on code2 (Secondary Barcode / UPC): ?code2=...
        const code2Url = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?code2=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const res2 = await fetchWithTimeout(code2Url);

        if (res2.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          return null;
        }

        if (res2.ok) {
          const json2 = await res2.json();
          if (json2.data && json2.data.length > 0) {
            return normalizeProduct(json2.data[0]);
          }
        }

        // 3. THIRD PRIORITY: Direct equality lookup on code (Internal SKU): ?code=...
        const directUrl = `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&columns=id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers`;
        const res = await fetchWithTimeout(directUrl);

        if (res.status === 401) {
          markUnauthorized();
          return null;
        }

        if (res.ok) {
          const json = await res.json();
          if (json.data && json.data.length > 0) {
            return normalizeProduct(json.data[0]);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Quiet catch
      }
    }

    // If not found by direct ean_code, code2, or code equality, it is not in the live database.
    return null;
  },

  /**
   * Real-time search across live products in erply_products
   * Overcomes backend case-sensitivity by testing capitalized and uppercase terms
   */
  async searchProducts(query, limit = 250) {
    if (!query || query.trim().length === 0) return [];
    const trimmed = query.trim();

    let key = getApiKey();
    if (!key || key === 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key' || isApiUnauthorized) {
      const cloudKey = await this.loadApiKeyFromCloud();
      if (cloudKey) {
        key = cloudKey;
      } else if (isApiUnauthorized) {
        return [];
      }
    }

    // Build variations to handle case-sensitive SQL (e.g., 'tissue' -> 'Tissue', 'TISSUE', 'tissue')
    const capitalized = trimmed.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + trimmed.slice(1);
    const uppercase = trimmed.toUpperCase();
    const lowercase = trimmed.toLowerCase();
    const variations = Array.from(new Set([trimmed, capitalized, uppercase, lowercase]));
    const cols = 'id,code,code2,ean_code,name,priceWithVat,price,supplierName,brandName,unitName,hasSerialNumbers';
    const queryUrls = variations.map(
      (term) => `${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?search=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&per_page=${limit}&columns=${cols}`
    );
    if (!/\s/.test(trimmed)) {
      const codeVariations = Array.from(new Set([trimmed, uppercase, lowercase]));
      codeVariations.forEach((codeTerm) => {
        queryUrls.push(`${BASE_URL}/data/erply_products?code=${encodeURIComponent(codeTerm)}&per_page=${limit}&columns=${cols}`);
      });
    }

    const merged = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    let sawUnauthorized = false;

    const batches = await Promise.all(
      queryUrls.map(async (url) => {
        if (isApiUnauthorized) return [];
        try {
          const res = await fetch(url, {
            headers: {
              'X-API-Key': key,
              'Accept': 'application/json'
            }
          });
          if (res.status === 401) {
            sawUnauthorized = true;
            return [];
          }
          if (res.ok) {
            const json = await res.json();
            return Array.isArray(json?.data) ? json.data : [];
          }
        } catch {}
        return [];
      })
    );

    if (sawUnauthorized) {
      markUnauthorized();
      return [];
    }

    for (const batch of batches) {
      for (const rawItem of batch) {
        const norm = normalizeProduct(rawItem);
        const k = String(norm?.barcode || norm?.code || norm?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (norm && !seen.has(k)) {
          seen.add(k);
          merged.push(norm);
        }
      }
    }

    merged.totalRecords = merged.length;
    merged.totalPages = 1;
    return merged.slice(0, limit);
  },

  /**
   * Fetch supplier directory from auto_po_supplier_contacts (610 records)
   */
  async getSuppliers(limit = 100) {
    try {
      const url = `${BASE_URL}/data/auto_po_supplier_contacts?per_page=${limit}&sort_by=full_company_name&sort_dir=asc`;
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        headers: {
          'X-API-Key': API_KEY,
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.data && Array.isArray(json.data)) {
          return json.data;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[PurchaseOrdersAPI] Fetch suppliers error:', err);
    }
    return [];
  }
};

import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { isTestRecord } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

const CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_supplier_claims_v2';
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'supplier_claims_store';

export const supplierClaimService = {
  /**
   * Shared helper to generate sequential prefixed tracking IDs (`RTV-` / `BUF-`)
   */
  _generatePrefixedRefId(prefix, existingItems = [], extractors = [], isTestMode = false) {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    const seqRegex = new RegExp(`^${prefix}-(?:TEST-)?\\d{4}-(\\d+)-`, 'i');
    let maxSeq = 0;

    if (Array.isArray(existingItems)) {
      existingItems.forEach((item) => {
        extractors.forEach((getVal) => {
          const num = getVal(item) || '';
          const match = String(num).match(seqRegex);
          if (match && match[1]) {
            const parsed = parseInt(match[1], 10);
            if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > maxSeq) {
              maxSeq = parsed;
            }
          }
        });
      });
    }

    const nextSeq = String(maxSeq + 1).padStart(4, '0');
    const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    let rand = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      rand += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }

    return `${prefix}-${isTestMode ? 'TEST-' : ''}${currentYear}-${nextSeq}-${rand}`;
  },

  /**
   * GENERATE UNIQUE RTV ID
   * Format: RTV-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (e.g. RTV-2026-0001-HY67)
   */
  generateRtvId(existingClaims = [], isTestMode = false) {
    return this._generatePrefixedRefId(
      'RTV',
      existingClaims,
      [(c) => c?.claim_number || c?.claimNumber],
      isTestMode
    );
  },

  /**
   * GENERATE UNIQUE CUSTOMER BUFFER REPLACEMENT ID
   * Format: BUF-YYYY-XXXX-RAND (or BUF-TEST-YYYY-XXXX-RAND in Test Mode)
   */
  generateBufferId(existingReports = [], isTestMode = false) {
    return this._generatePrefixedRefId(
      'BUF',
      existingReports,
      [
        (r) => r?.ai_document_metadata?.supplier_pickup?.claim_number,
        (r) => r?.claim_number || r?.claimNumber
      ],
      isTestMode
    );
  },

  /**
   * GET ALL SAVED SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIMS
   * Fetches from:
   * 1. Supabase public.supplier_claims table (if exists)
   * 2. Supabase rma_settings table (key: 'supplier_claims_store')
   * 3. LocalStorage fallback
   */
  async getClaims() {
    let remoteClaims = null;

    // 1. Try dedicated table first
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('supplier_claims')
        .select('*')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
        remoteClaims = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet in Postgres
    }

    // 2. If table not found, fetch from rma_settings
    if (!remoteClaims) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', SETTINGS_KEY)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (!error && data?.value && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
          remoteClaims = data.value;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not read supplier_claims_store from rma_settings:', e.message);
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to localStorage if offline or first load
    let localClaims = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        localClaims = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Merge by claim_number
    const claimMap = new Map();
    localClaims.forEach(c => {
      const id = c.claim_number || c.claimNumber;
      if (id) claimMap.set(id, c);
    });
    (remoteClaims || []).forEach(c => {
      const id = c.claim_number || c.claimNumber;
      if (id) claimMap.set(id, c);
    });

    const merged = Array.from(claimMap.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || a.createdAt || 0).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || b.createdAt || 0).getTime();
      return dateB - dateA;
    });

    // Cache to localStorage
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
    } catch (e) {}

    return merged;
  },

  /**
   * SAVE NEW SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIM (RTV)
   * Automatically persists to Supabase (supplier_claims table & rma_settings)
   * and updates linked rma_reports with the RTV identifier and audit trail.
   */
  async saveClaim({
    claimNumber,
    supplierName,
    generatedBy,
    items = [],
    totalQuantity = 0,
    totalClaimAmount = 0,
    notes = '',
    isTest = null,
    preserveReportFields = false
  }) {
    const effectiveIsTest = Boolean(
      isTest === true ||
      /^RTV-TEST-/i.test(String(claimNumber || '')) ||
      String(notes || '').includes('[TEST_MODE]') ||
      (Array.isArray(items) && items.some(it => isTestRecord(it)))
    );
    const trimmedNotes = String(notes || '').trim();
    const finalClaimNotes = effectiveIsTest && !trimmedNotes.includes('[TEST_MODE]')
      ? (trimmedNotes ? `[TEST_MODE] ${trimmedNotes}` : '[TEST_MODE] Sandbox RTV Claim')
      : trimmedNotes;
    if (!claimNumber) throw new Error('Claim number is required');
    if (!items.length) throw new Error('At least one item is required to save claim');

    const cleanClaimNumber = String(claimNumber).trim();
    const cleanSupplier = String(supplierName || 'Savemore').trim();
    const cleanGeneratedBy = String(generatedBy || 'Warehouse Staff').trim();
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const claimRecord = {
      claim_number: cleanClaimNumber,
      claimNumber: cleanClaimNumber,
      supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
      supplierName: cleanSupplier,
      generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
      generatedBy: cleanGeneratedBy,
      total_quantity: Number(totalQuantity) || items.length,
      totalQuantity: Number(totalQuantity) || items.length,
      total_claim_amount: Number(totalClaimAmount) || 0,
      totalClaimAmount: Number(totalClaimAmount) || 0,
      created_at: nowIso,
      createdAt: nowIso,
      notes: finalClaimNotes,
      status: 'generated',
      items: items.map(item => ({
        rma_number: item.rma_number,
        barcode: item.barcode,
        name: item.name,
        code: item.code || item.sku || '',
        quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1,
        unit_name: item.unit_name || 'pc',
        price: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
        total: (Number(item.quantity) || 1) * Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
        reason: item.reason || 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging'
      }))
    };

    // 1. Try inserting into public.supplier_claims table
    let savedToTable = false;
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('supplier_claims')
        .upsert([
          {
            claim_number: cleanClaimNumber,
            supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
            generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
            total_quantity: claimRecord.total_quantity,
            total_claim_amount: claimRecord.total_claim_amount,
            items: claimRecord.items,
            notes: claimRecord.notes || '',
            status: 'generated',
            created_at: nowIso
          }
        ], { onConflict: 'claim_number' });

      if (!error) savedToTable = true;
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet
    }

    // 2. Persist to rma_settings (key: 'supplier_claims_store') as universal sync
    try {
      const existing = await this.getClaims();
      const updatedList = [claimRecord, ...existing.filter(c => (c.claim_number || c.claimNumber) !== cleanClaimNumber)];
      
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: nowIso
        });

      localStorage.setItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not update rma_settings with new claim:', e);
    }

    // 3. Update all linked rma_reports: set disposition to RTV and append to audit_trail & notes
    try {
      for (const item of items) {
        const rmaNum = item.rma_number;
        if (!rmaNum) continue;

        // Fetch current row to append to audit_trail
        const { data: currentRows } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('id, audit_trail, notes')
          .eq('rma_number', rmaNum);

        const row = currentRows && currentRows[0];
        if (row) {
          const currentAudit = Array.isArray(row.audit_trail) ? row.audit_trail : [];
          const hasExistingAudit = currentAudit.some(
            (a) => a?.action === 'RTV_CLAIM_GENERATED' && a?.rtv_number === cleanClaimNumber
          );
          const updatedAudit = hasExistingAudit
            ? currentAudit
            : [
                ...currentAudit,
                {
                  action: 'RTV_CLAIM_GENERATED',
                  rtv_number: cleanClaimNumber,
                  supplier_name: cleanSupplier,
                  generated_by: cleanGeneratedBy,
                  timestamp: nowIso
                }
              ];

          const existingNotes = row.notes || '';
          const tag = `[RTV: ${cleanClaimNumber}]`;
          const updatedNotes = existingNotes.includes(tag) 
            ? existingNotes 
            : (existingNotes ? `${existingNotes}\n${tag}` : tag);

          const reportUpdate = {
            audit_trail: updatedAudit,
            notes: updatedNotes
          };
          if (!preserveReportFields) {
            reportUpdate.status = 'vendor_claimed';
            reportUpdate.disposition = 'Return to Vendor (RTV)';
          }

          await supabase
            .from('rma_reports')
            .update(reportUpdate)
            .eq('id', row.id);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not update linked rma_reports with RTV info:', e);
    }

    return claimRecord;
  },

  /**
   * DELETE / VOID A SUPPLIER CLAIM
   */
  async deleteClaim(claimNumber) {
    if (!claimNumber) return;

    // Delete from table
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('supplier_claims')
        .delete()
        .eq('claim_number', claimNumber);
    } catch (e) {}

    // Update rma_settings
    try {
      const existing = await this.getClaims();
      const updatedList = existing.filter(c => (c.claim_number || c.claimNumber) !== claimNumber);
      
      await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .upsert({
          key: SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: updatedList,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        });

      localStorage.setItem(CLAIMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}
  }
};

--- START FILE: src/services/supplierDirectoryService.js ---
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

export const SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_SETTINGS_KEY = 'supplier_directory_store';
export const SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_supplier_directory_store';
export const SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_EVENT = 'rma-supplier-directory-changed';

const PLACEHOLDER_SUPPLIERS = new Set([
  '',
  'pending',
  'pending assignment',
  'unassigned',
  'warehouse',
  'n/a',
  'none',
  'unknown'
]);

function isPlaceholderName(name) {
  return PLACEHOLDER_SUPPLIERS.has(String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase());
}

export function normalizeSupplierKey(name) {
  return String(name || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function normalizeEmailString(raw) {
  if (!raw) return '';
  const arr = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : String(raw).split(/[,;\n]+/);
  const unique = new Set();
  for (const part of arr) {
    const clean = String(part || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (clean && clean.includes('@') && clean.includes('.')) {
      unique.add(clean);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(unique).join(', ');
}

function normalizeContactRecord(entry) {
  if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return null;
  const cleanName = String(entry.supplier_name || entry.supplierName || '').trim();
  if (isPlaceholderName(cleanName)) return null;
  const emailTo = normalizeEmailString(entry.email_to || entry.supplier_email_to || entry.to || '');
  const emailCc = normalizeEmailString(entry.email_cc || entry.supplier_email_cc || entry.cc || '');
  const contactPerson = String(entry.contact_person || entry.contactPerson || '').trim();
  const notes = String(entry.notes || '').trim();
  const id = String(entry.id || `sup_${normalizeSupplierKey(cleanName).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')}`).trim();
  const updatedAt = entry.updated_at || new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    id,
    supplier_name: cleanName,
    email_to: emailTo,
    email_cc: emailCc,
    contact_person: contactPerson,
    notes,
    updated_at: updatedAt
  };
}

function normalizeDirectoryList(raw) {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  const map = new Map();
  for (const item of raw) {
    const norm = normalizeContactRecord(item);
    if (!norm) continue;
    const k = normalizeSupplierKey(norm.supplier_name);
    const existing = map.get(k);
    if (!existing) {
      map.set(k, norm);
    } else {
      map.set(k, {
        ...existing,
        ...norm,
        email_to: norm.email_to || existing.email_to,
        email_cc: norm.email_cc || existing.email_cc,
        contact_person: norm.contact_person || existing.contact_person,
        notes: norm.notes || existing.notes
      });
    }
  }
  return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.supplier_name.localeCompare(b.supplier_name));
}

function writeLocalCache(list) {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_EVENT, { detail: list }));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[supplierDirectoryService] Cache write warning:', err?.message || err);
  }
}

async function persistDirectoryToDb(list) {
  const normalized = normalizeDirectoryList(list);
  writeLocalCache(normalized);
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('rma_settings')
      .upsert(
        {
          key: SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_SETTINGS_KEY,
          value: normalized,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        { onConflict: 'key' }
      );
    if (error) {
      console.warn('[supplierDirectoryService] Supabase upsert warning:', error.message);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[supplierDirectoryService] Supabase upsert exception:', err?.message || err);
  }
  return normalized;
}

export const supplierDirectoryService = {
  getCachedDirectory() {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          return normalizeDirectoryList(JSON.parse(raw));
        }
      }
    } catch {}
    return [];
  },

  async loadDirectory() {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_SETTINGS_KEY)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!error && data && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
        const normalized = normalizeDirectoryList(data.value);
        writeLocalCache(normalized);
        return normalized;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[supplierDirectoryService] Load warning:', err?.message || err);
    }
    return this.getCachedDirectory();
  },

  findBySupplierName(name) {
    const key = normalizeSupplierKey(name);
    if (!key || isPlaceholderName(key)) return null;
    const list = this.getCachedDirectory();
    const exact = list.find((c) => normalizeSupplierKey(c.supplier_name) === key);
    if (exact) return exact;
    const compactKey = key.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    if (!compactKey) return null;
    return list.find((c) => normalizeSupplierKey(c.supplier_name).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') === compactKey) || null;
  },

  async upsertContact(contact = {}, { explicitEdit = true } = {}) {
    const cleanName = String(contact.supplier_name || contact.supplierName || '').trim();
    if (isPlaceholderName(cleanName)) {
      throw new Error('Please enter a valid Supplier / Company Name.');
    }
    const emailTo = normalizeEmailString(contact.email_to ?? contact.supplier_email_to ?? '');
    const emailCc = normalizeEmailString(contact.email_cc ?? contact.supplier_email_cc ?? '');
    const contactPerson = String(contact.contact_person ?? contact.contactPerson ?? '').trim();
    const notes = String(contact.notes ?? '').trim();

    let current = [];
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_SETTINGS_KEY)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (data && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
        current = normalizeDirectoryList(data.value);
      } else {
        current = this.getCachedDirectory();
      }
    } catch {
      current = this.getCachedDirectory();
    }

    const targetKey = normalizeSupplierKey(cleanName);
    const prevIdx = current.findIndex((c) => (contact.id && c.id === contact.id) || normalizeSupplierKey(c.supplier_name) === targetKey);
    const prev = prevIdx >= 0 ? current[prevIdx] : null;

    const merged = {
      id: (contact.id && String(contact.id).trim()) || prev?.id || `sup_${targetKey.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')}_${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      supplier_name: cleanName,
      email_to: explicitEdit ? emailTo : (emailTo || prev?.email_to || ''),
      email_cc: explicitEdit ? emailCc : (emailCc || prev?.email_cc || ''),
      contact_person: explicitEdit ? contactPerson : (contactPerson || prev?.contact_person || ''),
      notes: explicitEdit ? notes : (notes || prev?.notes || ''),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    const nextList = [...current];
    if (prevIdx >= 0) {
      nextList[prevIdx] = merged;
    } else {
      nextList.push(merged);
    }

    const persisted = await persistDirectoryToDb(nextList);
    return {
      saved: persisted.find((c) => normalizeSupplierKey(c.supplier_name) === targetKey) || merged,
      directory: persisted
    };
  },

  async upsertFromSubmission({ supplier_name, supplier_email_to, supplier_email_cc }) {
    const cleanName = String(supplier_name || '').trim();
    const emailTo = normalizeEmailString(supplier_email_to || '');
    const emailCc = normalizeEmailString(supplier_email_cc || '');
    if (isPlaceholderName(cleanName) || (!emailTo && !emailCc)) {
      return null;
    }
    return this.upsertContact(
      {
        supplier_name: cleanName,
        email_to: emailTo,
        email_cc: emailCc
      },
      { explicitEdit: false }
    );
  },

  async deleteContact(idOrName) {
    const rawKey = normalizeSupplierKey(idOrName);
    const idTarget = String(idOrName || '').trim();
    if (!idTarget) return this.getCachedDirectory();

    let current = this.getCachedDirectory();
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('rma_settings')
        .select('value')
        .eq('key', SUPPLIER_DIRECTORY_SETTINGS_KEY)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (data && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
        current = normalizeDirectoryList(data.value);
      }
    } catch {}

    const filtered = current.filter(
      (c) => c.id !== idTarget && normalizeSupplierKey(c.supplier_name) !== rawKey
    );
    return persistDirectoryToDb(filtered);
  }
};

const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  PRODUCTS: 'wholesale_rma_products_v2',
  TICKETS: 'wholesale_rma_tickets_v2',
  SETTINGS: 'wholesale_rma_settings_v2'
};

export const getLocalProducts = () => {
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS);
    if (!cached) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PRODUCTS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_PRODUCTS));
      return INITIAL_PRODUCTS;

    return JSON.parse(cached);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error reading local products fallback:', err);
    return INITIAL_PRODUCTS;
  }
};

    if (!cached) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TICKETS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_TICKETS));
      return INITIAL_TICKETS;

  } catch (err) {

  }
