function inlineStrCell(ref, styleIdx, value) {
  return `<c r="${ref}" s="${styleIdx}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${escapeXml(value)}</t></is></c>`;
}

function numCell(ref, styleIdx, value) {
  return `<c r="${ref}" s="${styleIdx}"><v>${Number(value) || 0}</v></c>`;
}

function formulaNumCell(ref, styleIdx, formula, cachedVal) {
  return `<c r="${ref}" s="${styleIdx}"><f>${escapeXml(formula)}</f><v>${Number(cachedVal) || 0}</v></c>`;
}

/**
 * Generates the raw Uint8Array bytes of the Overall RMA Matrix .xlsx file.
 * Exported directly so automated verification can inspect ZIP + XML + formulas + totals.
 */
export function buildRmaMatrixXlsxBytes({
  reports = [],
  catalogProducts = [],
  creditMemos = [],
  stream = 'overall',
  isTestMode = false,
  startDate = '',
  endDate = '',
  includeAllRecords = false,
  includeZeroCatalogSkus = false
}) {
  const dataset = buildRmaMatrixDataset({
    reports,
    catalogProducts,
    creditMemos,
    stream,
    isTestMode,
    startDate,
    endDate,
    includeAllRecords,
    includeZeroCatalogSkus
  });

  const {
    stream: activeStream,
    startDate: sDate,
    endDate: eDate,
    weekBlocks,
    rows,
    lineCount,
    monitoredSkuCount,
    grandTotalPcs,
    grandTotalValue
  } = dataset;

  // Frozen Columns A..E (indices 0..4)
  const columns = [
    { kind: 'serial', header: 'Serial No.', width: 11, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'category', header: 'Category', width: 14, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'supplier', header: 'Supplier Name', width: 28, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'sku', header: 'SKU', width: 16, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'desc', header: 'Description', width: 40, align: 'left' }
  ];

  const firstDailySectionCol = columns.length; // Col F (idx 5)
  const weekMeta = [];
  const weekTotalCols = [];

  weekBlocks.forEach((wb, wIdx) => {
    const startCol = columns.length;
    wb.dates.forEach((ymd) => {
      columns.push({ kind: 'date', ymd, header: ymd, width: 13, outlineLevel: 1 });
    });
    const lastDateCol = columns.length - 1;
    const weekTotalCol = columns.length;
    columns.push({
      kind: 'weekTotal',
      header: 'Week total (pcs)',
      width: 16,
      startDateCol: startCol,
      endDateCol: lastDateCol
    });
    weekTotalCols.push(weekTotalCol);
    weekMeta.push({
      label: wb.label,
      startCol,
      endCol: weekTotalCol,
      bannerStyle: wIdx % 2 === 0 ? 3 : 4
    });
  });

  const lastDailySectionCol = columns.length - 1;
  const grandTotalCol = columns.length;
  columns.push({ kind: 'grandTotal', header: 'Total pcs returned', width: 19 });

  const badStockCol = columns.length;
  columns.push({ kind: 'badStock', header: 'Return Bad Stock (pcs)', width: 21 });
  const goodStockCol = columns.length;
  columns.push({ kind: 'goodStock', header: 'Return Good Stock (pcs)', width: 21 });

  const detailStartCol = columns.length;
  const detailCols = [
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'hubLabel', header: 'Source / Hub', width: 16, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'rmaId', header: 'RMA ID', width: 22, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'barcode', header: 'Barcode', width: 18, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'dateReported', header: 'Date Reported (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)', width: 24, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'expiryDate', header: 'Expiry Date (YYYY-MM-DD)', width: 21, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'storeBranch', header: 'Store / Branch', width: 24, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'reason', header: 'Defect / Return Reason', width: 28, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'workflowOutcome', header: 'Workflow Outcome', width: 32, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'reorderStatus', header: 'Reorder Status', width: 15, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'reorderPoNumber', header: 'Reorder PO #', width: 18, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'reordered', header: 'Re-Ordered?', width: 13, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'restocked', header: 'Restocked?', width: 13, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'scrapped', header: 'Scrapped?', width: 13, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'replaced', header: 'Replaced?', width: 13, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'pickedUp', header: 'Picked Up by Driver?', width: 19, align: 'center' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'pickupDateTime', header: 'Driver Pickup Date & Time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)', width: 28, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'driverAndPlate', header: 'Driver Name & Truck Plate #', width: 28, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'detail', field: 'claimOrMemoNo', header: 'Debit Claim / Credit Memo #', width: 24, align: 'left' },
    { kind: 'totalValue', field: 'totalValue', header: 'Total Value (PHP)', width: 18, align: 'right' }
  ];
  columns.push(...detailCols);

  const lastColIdx = columns.length - 1;
  const lastColLetter = colToLetter(lastColIdx);
  const grandTotalLetter = colToLetter(grandTotalCol);

  const scopeLabel = activeStream === 'supplier_outbound'
    ? 'SUPPLIER RTV'
    : activeStream === 'customer_inbound'
      ? 'CUSTOMER HUB'
      : 'OVERALL RMA (CUSTOMER HUB + SUPPLIER RTV)';
  const modePrefix = isTestMode ? 'TEST MODE SANDBOX — ' : '';
  const row1Title = `${modePrefix}${scopeLabel} MATRIX REPORT`;
  const row2Meta = `Generated: ${formatManilaTimestampDisplay()} | Period (YYYY-MM-DD): ${sDate} to ${eDate} | Line Items: ${lineCount} | SKUs: ${monitoredSkuCount} | Total Returned: ${grandTotalPcs.toLocaleString()} pcs | Total Value: PHP ${grandTotalValue.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;

  const sheetRows = [];
  const merges = [];

  // Row 1: Title
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="1" ht="24" customHeight="1">${inlineStrCell('A1', 1, row1Title)}</row>`);

  // Row 2: Yellow Metadata Strip A2..lastCol2
  const r2Cells = [inlineStrCell('A2', 2, row2Meta)];
  for (let c = 1; c <= lastColIdx; c++) {
    r2Cells.push(`<c r="${colToLetter(c)}2" s="2"/>`);
  }
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="2" ht="18" customHeight="1">${r2Cells.join('')}</row>`);
  if (lastColIdx > 0) merges.push(`A2:${lastColLetter}2`);

  // Row 3 & Row 4: Banners
  const r3Map = new Map();
  const r4Map = new Map();

  // Frozen A..E banner (A3:E4)
  r3Map.set(0, inlineStrCell('A3', 3, 'FROZEN PRODUCT MASTER (A..E)'));
  for (let c = 1; c <= 4; c++) r3Map.set(c, `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}3" s="3"/>`);
  for (let c = 0; c <= 4; c++) r4Map.set(c, `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}4" s="3"/>`);
  merges.push('A3:E4');

  // Daily section banner row 3 + Alternating Navy/Sky Blue week blocks row 4
  if (lastDailySectionCol >= firstDailySectionCol) {
    r3Map.set(firstDailySectionCol, inlineStrCell(`${colToLetter(firstDailySectionCol)}3`, 16, 'DAILY RETURNED PIECES (YYYY-MM-DD)'));
    for (let c = firstDailySectionCol + 1; c <= lastDailySectionCol; c++) {
      r3Map.set(c, `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}3" s="16"/>`);
    }
    if (lastDailySectionCol > firstDailySectionCol) {
      merges.push(`${colToLetter(firstDailySectionCol)}3:${colToLetter(lastDailySectionCol)}3`);
    }

    weekMeta.forEach((wm) => {
      const sRef = `${colToLetter(wm.startCol)}4`;
      const eRef = `${colToLetter(wm.endCol)}4`;
      r4Map.set(wm.startCol, inlineStrCell(sRef, wm.bannerStyle, wm.label));
      for (let c = wm.startCol + 1; c <= wm.endCol; c++) {
        r4Map.set(c, `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}4" s="${wm.bannerStyle}"/>`);
      }
      if (wm.endCol > wm.startCol) {
        merges.push(`${sRef}:${eRef}`);
      }
    });
  }

  // Green TOTAL banner across row 3-4 above Total pcs returned
  r3Map.set(grandTotalCol, inlineStrCell(`${grandTotalLetter}3`, 5, 'TOTAL'));
  r4Map.set(grandTotalCol, `<c r="${grandTotalLetter}4" s="5"/>`);
  merges.push(`${grandTotalLetter}3:${grandTotalLetter}4`);

  // Danilo RMA / RMA banner above Return Bad Stock (pcs) & Return Good Stock (pcs)
  r3Map.set(badStockCol, inlineStrCell(`${colToLetter(badStockCol)}3`, 15, 'Danilo RMA'));
  r3Map.set(goodStockCol, `<c r="${colToLetter(goodStockCol)}3" s="15"/>`);
  merges.push(`${colToLetter(badStockCol)}3:${colToLetter(goodStockCol)}3`);
  r4Map.set(badStockCol, inlineStrCell(`${colToLetter(badStockCol)}4`, 4, 'RMA'));
  r4Map.set(goodStockCol, `<c r="${colToLetter(goodStockCol)}4" s="4"/>`);
  merges.push(`${colToLetter(badStockCol)}4:${colToLetter(goodStockCol)}4`);

  // Right-side 17 columns banner row 3-4: RMA ITEM DETAILS & WORKFLOW STATUS
  r3Map.set(detailStartCol, inlineStrCell(`${colToLetter(detailStartCol)}3`, 16, 'RMA ITEM DETAILS & WORKFLOW STATUS'));
  for (let c = detailStartCol + 1; c <= lastColIdx; c++) {
    r3Map.set(c, `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}3" s="16"/>`);
  }
  for (let c = detailStartCol; c <= lastColIdx; c++) {
    r4Map.set(c, `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}4" s="16"/>`);
  }
  if (lastColIdx > detailStartCol) {
    merges.push(`${colToLetter(detailStartCol)}3:${lastColLetter}4`);
  }

  const r3Cells = [];
  const r4Cells = [];
  for (let c = 0; c <= lastColIdx; c++) {
    r3Cells.push(r3Map.get(c) || `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}3" s="3"/>`);
    r4Cells.push(r4Map.get(c) || `<c r="${colToLetter(c)}4" s="3"/>`);
  }
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="3" ht="20" customHeight="1">${r3Cells.join('')}</row>`);
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="4" ht="20" customHeight="1">${r4Cells.join('')}</row>`);

  // Row 5: Column Headers
  const r5Cells = columns.map((col, cIdx) => {
    const style = (col.kind === 'date' || col.kind === 'weekTotal' || col.kind === 'grandTotal' || col.kind === 'badStock' || col.kind === 'goodStock' || col.kind === 'totalValue')
      ? 21
      : (col.align === 'center' ? 21 : 6);
    return inlineStrCell(`${colToLetter(cIdx)}5`, style, col.header);
  });
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="5" ht="26" customHeight="1">${r5Cells.join('')}</row>`);

  // Data Rows starting at Row 6
  const firstDataRow = 6;
  rows.forEach((entry, rIdx) => {
    const rowNum = firstDataRow + rIdx;
    const cells = [];

    columns.forEach((col, cIdx) => {
      const ref = `${colToLetter(cIdx)}${rowNum}`;
      if (col.kind === 'serial') {
        cells.push(numCell(ref, 17, entry.serialNo));
      } else if (col.kind === 'category') {
        cells.push(inlineStrCell(ref, 8, '')); // Strictly blank
      } else if (col.kind === 'supplier') {
        cells.push(inlineStrCell(ref, 8, entry.supplierName));
      } else if (col.kind === 'sku') {
        cells.push(inlineStrCell(ref, 8, entry.sku)); // Strictly "" when unassigned
      } else if (col.kind === 'desc') {
        cells.push(inlineStrCell(ref, 8, entry.description));
      } else if (col.kind === 'date') {
        const val = entry.dailyPcs[col.ymd] || 0;
        cells.push(numCell(ref, val > 0 ? 10 : 9, val));
      } else if (col.kind === 'weekTotal') {
        const weekDates = weekBlocks.find((_, wIdx) => weekTotalCols[wIdx] === cIdx)?.dates || [];
        const cachedWeekSum = weekDates.reduce((s, d) => s + (entry.dailyPcs[d] || 0), 0);
        const startL = colToLetter(col.startDateCol);
        const endL = colToLetter(col.endDateCol);
        const formula = startL === endL
          ? `${startL}${rowNum}`
          : `SUM(${startL}${rowNum}:${endL}${rowNum})`;
        cells.push(formulaNumCell(ref, 11, formula, cachedWeekSum));
      } else if (col.kind === 'grandTotal') {
        const refs = weekTotalCols.map((wtIdx) => `${colToLetter(wtIdx)}${rowNum}`);
        const formula = refs.length > 0 ? `SUM(${refs.join(',')})` : '0';
        cells.push(formulaNumCell(ref, 12, formula, entry.totalInPeriod));
      } else if (col.kind === 'badStock') {
        cells.push(numCell(ref, entry.badStockPcs > 0 ? 10 : 9, entry.badStockPcs));
      } else if (col.kind === 'goodStock') {
        cells.push(numCell(ref, entry.goodStockPcs > 0 ? 10 : 9, entry.goodStockPcs));
      } else if (col.kind === 'totalValue') {
        cells.push(numCell(ref, 19, entry.totalValue));
      } else if (col.kind === 'detail') {
        const styleIdx = col.align === 'center' ? 18 : 8;
        cells.push(inlineStrCell(ref, styleIdx, entry[col.field] ?? ''));
      }
    });

    sheetRows.push(`<row r="${rowNum}" ht="19" customHeight="1">${cells.join('')}</row>`);
  });

  // Grand Totals Footer Row with Excel =SUM(...) formulas
  const footerRowNum = firstDataRow + rows.length;
  const lastDataRow = Math.max(firstDataRow, footerRowNum - 1);
  const footerCells = columns.map((col, cIdx) => {
    const L = colToLetter(cIdx);
    const ref = `${L}${footerRowNum}`;
    if (col.kind === 'serial') return inlineStrCell(ref, 14, 'TOTAL');
    if (col.kind === 'desc') {
      return inlineStrCell(ref, 14, `${lineCount} Line Item(s) • ${monitoredSkuCount} SKU(s) (${sDate} to ${eDate})`);
    }
    if (col.kind === 'category' || col.kind === 'supplier' || col.kind === 'sku' || col.kind === 'detail') {
      return `<c r="${ref}" s="14"/>`;
    }

    let cachedColSum = 0;
    if (col.kind === 'date') {
      cachedColSum = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.dailyPcs[col.ymd] || 0), 0);
    } else if (col.kind === 'weekTotal') {
      const weekDates = weekBlocks.find((_, wIdx) => weekTotalCols[wIdx] === cIdx)?.dates || [];
      cachedColSum = rows.reduce(
        (s, r) => s + weekDates.reduce((ws, d) => ws + (r.dailyPcs[d] || 0), 0),
        0
      );
    } else if (col.kind === 'grandTotal') {
      cachedColSum = grandTotalPcs;
    } else if (col.kind === 'badStock') {
      cachedColSum = dataset.totalBadStockPcs;
    } else if (col.kind === 'goodStock') {
      cachedColSum = dataset.totalGoodStockPcs;
    } else if (col.kind === 'totalValue') {
      cachedColSum = grandTotalValue;
    }

    const formula = rows.length > 0 ? `SUM(${L}${firstDataRow}:${L}${lastDataRow})` : '0';
    return formulaNumCell(ref, col.kind === 'totalValue' ? 20 : 13, formula, cachedColSum);
  });
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="${footerRowNum}" ht="22" customHeight="1">${footerCells.join('')}</row>`);

  const colsXml = `<cols>${columns.map((col, idx) => {
    const n = idx + 1;
    const outlineAttr = col.outlineLevel ? ` outlineLevel="${col.outlineLevel}"` : '';
    return `<col min="${n}" max="${n}" width="${col.width}" customWidth="1"${outlineAttr}/>`;
  }).join('')}</cols>`;

  const mergeXml = merges.length > 0
    ? `<mergeCells count="${merges.length}">${merges.map((m) => `<mergeCell ref="${m}"/>`).join('')}</mergeCells>`
    : '';

  // frozenRows=5, frozenColumns=5 (A..E + rows 1..5 frozen -> topLeftCell="F6")
  const sheetXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">
  <sheetViews>
    <sheetView tabSelected="1" workbookViewId="0">
      <pane xSplit="5" ySplit="5" topLeftCell="F6" activePane="bottomRight" state="frozen"/>
      <selection pane="bottomRight" activeCell="F6" sqref="F6"/>
    </sheetView>
  </sheetViews>
  <sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="19" outlineLevelCol="1"/>
  ${colsXml}
  <sheetData>
    ${sheetRows.join('\n    ')}
  </sheetData>
  ${mergeXml}
</worksheet>`;

  const rawSheetTabName = activeStream === 'supplier_outbound'
    ? (isTestMode ? 'Test Supplier RTV Matrix' : 'Supplier RTV Matrix')
    : activeStream === 'customer_inbound'
      ? (isTestMode ? 'Test Customer Hub Matrix' : 'Customer Hub Matrix')
      : (isTestMode ? 'Test Overall RMA Matrix' : 'Overall RMA Matrix');
  const sheetTabName = rawSheetTabName.replace(/[\\/?*[\]:]/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 31) || 'Matrix';

  // Keep OPC package/relationship XML compact (zero inter-element newlines/indentation inside
  // <Types> or <Relationships>) so desktop Microsoft Excel's strict OPC parser opens it cleanly.
  const workbookXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><sheets><sheet name="${escapeXml(sheetTabName)}" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>`;

  const contentTypesXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/></Types>`;

  const rootRelsXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>`;

  const wbRelsXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/></Relationships>`;

  const bytes = buildStoredZip([
    { name: '[Content_Types].xml', content: contentTypesXml },
    { name: '_rels/.rels', content: rootRelsXml },
    { name: 'xl/workbook.xml', content: workbookXml },
    { name: 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', content: wbRelsXml },
    { name: 'xl/styles.xml', content: buildStylesXml() },
    { name: 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', content: sheetXml }
  ]);

  return { bytes, dataset };
}

/**
 * Generates and downloads the real Overall RMA Matrix .xlsx file in the browser.
 */
export function downloadRmaMatrixXlsx(options) {
  const { bytes, dataset } = buildRmaMatrixXlsxBytes(options);
  const blob = new Blob([bytes], {
    type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
  });

  const prefix = options.isTestMode ? 'TEST_' : '';
  const ts = formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date());
  const streamTag = dataset.stream === 'supplier_outbound'
    ? 'Supplier_RTV_Matrix_Report'
    : dataset.stream === 'customer_inbound'
      ? 'Customer_Hub_Matrix_Report'
      : 'Overall_RMA_Matrix_Report';
  const filename = `${prefix}${streamTag}_${dataset.startDate}_to_${dataset.endDate} ${ts}.xlsx`;

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);

  return { filename, dataset };
}

/**
 * Zero-dependency OOXML (.xlsx) Table & ZIP Builder
 * Generates genuine .xlsx files (Stored ZIP + OOXML workbook) compatible with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and Vercel/browser.
 * - Optional Title Row 1 + Metadata Subtitle Row 2 (matching Pingcon Matrix .xlsx styling)
 * - Bold navy header row with frozen panes
 * - Auto-fitted column widths
 * - Numeric & currency cells for quantities/prices/totals
 * - Plain inlineStr text cells for barcodes/SKUs/RMA#/phone numbers (no scientific notation, no ="..." raw formulas)
 */

const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();

export function escapeXml(str) {
  return String(str ?? '')
    .replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
}

export function colToLetter(colIdxZeroBased) {
  let n = colIdxZeroBased + 1;
  let result = '';
  while (n > 0) {
    const rem = (n - 1) % 26;
    result = String.fromCharCode(65 + rem) + result;
    n = Math.floor((n - 1) / 26);
  }
  return result;
}

// ==========================================
// Minimal CRC-32 + Stored ZIP Builder
// ==========================================
const CRC_TABLE = (() => {
  const tbl = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
    let c = i;
    for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
      c = (c & 1) ? (0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
    }
    tbl[i] = c >>> 0;
  }
  return tbl;
})();

function crc32(bytes) {
  let c = 0xffffffff;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    c = CRC_TABLE[(c ^ bytes[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
  }
  return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

export function buildStoredZip(files) {
  const localParts = [];
  const centralParts = [];
  let offset = 0;

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const nameBytes = textEncoder.encode(file.name);
    const dataBytes = textEncoder.encode(file.content);
    const crc = crc32(dataBytes);

    const lh = new ArrayBuffer(30 + nameBytes.length);
    const lv = new DataView(lh);
    lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
    lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
    lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
    lv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
    lv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
    lv.setUint16(12, 0x5421, true);
    lv.setUint32(14, crc, true);
    lv.setUint32(18, dataBytes.length, true);
    lv.setUint32(22, dataBytes.length, true);
    lv.setUint16(26, nameBytes.length, true);
    lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
    new Uint8Array(lh, 30).set(nameBytes);

    localParts.push(new Uint8Array(lh), dataBytes);

    const ch = new ArrayBuffer(46 + nameBytes.length);
    const cv = new DataView(ch);
    cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
    cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
    cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
    cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
    cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(12, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(14, 0x5421, true);
    cv.setUint32(16, crc, true);
    cv.setUint32(20, dataBytes.length, true);
    cv.setUint32(24, dataBytes.length, true);
    cv.setUint16(28, nameBytes.length, true);
    cv.setUint16(30, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(32, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(34, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(36, 0, true);
    cv.setUint32(38, 0, true);
    cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
    new Uint8Array(ch, 46).set(nameBytes);

    centralParts.push(new Uint8Array(ch));
    offset += 30 + nameBytes.length + dataBytes.length;
  });

  const centralSize = centralParts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.length, 0);
  const eocd = new ArrayBuffer(22);
  const ev = new DataView(eocd);
  ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
  ev.setUint16(4, 0, true);
  ev.setUint16(6, 0, true);
  ev.setUint16(8, files.length, true);
  ev.setUint16(10, files.length, true);
  ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
  ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
  ev.setUint16(20, 0, true);

  const totalLen = offset + centralSize + 22;
  const out = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
  let pos = 0;
  [...localParts, ...centralParts, new Uint8Array(eocd)].forEach((chunk) => {
    out.set(chunk, pos);
    pos += chunk.length;
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Build genuine .xlsx bytes from tabular columns & rows.
 * @param {{ sheetName?: string, title?: string, subtitle?: string, columns: Array<{header: string, width?: number, type?: 'text'|'number'|'currency'}>, rows: Array<Array<any>> }} params
 */
export function buildTableXlsxBytes({ sheetName = 'Export', title = '', subtitle = '', columns = [], rows = [] }) {
  const safeSheetName = String(sheetName || 'Export').replace(/[\\/?*\[\]:]/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 31) || 'Export';

  const colWidths = columns.map((col, cIdx) => {
    if (col.width) return col.width;
    let maxLen = String(col.header || '').length;
    const sampleLimit = Math.min(rows.length, 200);
    for (let r = 0; r < sampleLimit; r++) {
      const valLen = String(rows[r]?.[cIdx] ?? '').length;
      if (valLen > maxLen) maxLen = valLen;
    }
    return Math.min(48, Math.max(12, maxLen + 4));
  });

  const colsXml = `<cols>${colWidths.map((w, idx) => {
    const n = idx + 1;
    return `<col min="${n}" max="${n}" width="${w}" customWidth="1"/>`;
  }).join('')}</cols>`;

  const sheetRows = [];
  const merges = [];
  const lastColIdx = Math.max(0, columns.length - 1);
  const lastColLetter = colToLetter(lastColIdx);
  let currentRow = 1;

  if (title) {
    sheetRows.push(
      `<row r="${currentRow}" ht="24" customHeight="1"><c r="A${currentRow}" s="8" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${escapeXml(title)}</t></is></c></row>`
    );
    currentRow += 1;
  }

  if (subtitle) {
    const subCells = [
      `<c r="A${currentRow}" s="9" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${escapeXml(subtitle)}</t></is></c>`
    ];
    for (let c = 1; c <= lastColIdx; c++) {
      subCells.push(`<c r="${colToLetter(c)}${currentRow}" s="9"/>`);
    }
    sheetRows.push(`<row r="${currentRow}" ht="18" customHeight="1">${subCells.join('')}</row>`);
    if (lastColIdx > 0) {
      merges.push(`A${currentRow}:${lastColLetter}${currentRow}`);
    }
    currentRow += 1;
  }

  // Bold Navy Header Row
  const headerRowNum = currentRow;
  const headerCells = columns.map((col, cIdx) => {
    const ref = `${colToLetter(cIdx)}${headerRowNum}`;
    return `<c r="${ref}" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${escapeXml(col.header)}</t></is></c>`;
  });
  sheetRows.push(`<row r="${headerRowNum}" ht="24" customHeight="1">${headerCells.join('')}</row>`);
  currentRow += 1;

  const firstDataRowNum = currentRow;

  // Data Rows
  rows.forEach((row, rIdx) => {
    const rowNum = firstDataRowNum + rIdx;
    const isAlt = rIdx % 2 === 1;
    const cells = columns.map((col, cIdx) => {
      const ref = `${colToLetter(cIdx)}${rowNum}`;
      const rawVal = row[cIdx];
      const colType = col.type || 'text';

      if (colType === 'number' || colType === 'currency') {
        const num = Number(rawVal);
        if (rawVal !== '' && rawVal !== null && rawVal !== undefined && Number.isFinite(num)) {
          const styleIdx = colType === 'currency' ? (isAlt ? 7 : 6) : (isAlt ? 5 : 4);
          return `<c r="${ref}" s="${styleIdx}"><v>${num}</v></c>`;
        }
      }

      const textStyle = isAlt ? 3 : 2;
      const strVal = rawVal === null || rawVal === undefined ? '' : String(rawVal);
      return `<c r="${ref}" s="${textStyle}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${escapeXml(strVal)}</t></is></c>`;
    });
    sheetRows.push(`<row r="${rowNum}" ht="19" customHeight="1">${cells.join('')}</row>`);
  });

  const mergeXml = merges.length > 0
    ? `<mergeCells count="${merges.length}">${merges.map((m) => `<mergeCell ref="${m}"/>`).join('')}</mergeCells>`
    : '';

  const sheetXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">
  <sheetViews>
    <sheetView tabSelected="1" workbookViewId="0">
      <pane ySplit="${headerRowNum}" topLeftCell="A${firstDataRowNum}" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/>
      <selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="A${firstDataRowNum}" sqref="A${firstDataRowNum}"/>
    </sheetView>
  </sheetViews>
  <sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="19"/>
  ${colsXml}
  <sheetData>
    ${sheetRows.join('\n    ')}
  </sheetData>
  ${mergeXml}
</worksheet>`;

  const workbookXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><sheets><sheet name="${escapeXml(safeSheetName)}" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>`;

  const contentTypesXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/></Types>`;

  const rootRelsXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>`;

  const wbRelsXml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/></Relationships>`;

  return buildStoredZip([
    { name: '[Content_Types].xml', content: contentTypesXml },
    { name: '_rels/.rels', content: rootRelsXml },
    { name: 'xl/workbook.xml', content: workbookXml },
    { name: 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', content: wbRelsXml },
    { name: 'xl/styles.xml', content: buildTableStylesXml() },
    { name: 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', content: sheetXml }
  ]);
}

/**
 * Download a genuine .xlsx file in the browser.
 */
export function downloadTableXlsx({ sheetName = 'Export', title = '', subtitle = '', filename, columns = [], rows = [] }) {
  const bytes = buildTableXlsxBytes({ sheetName, title, subtitle, columns, rows });
  const rawBase = String(filename || 'Export.xlsx').replace(/\.(csv|xlsx)$/i, '');
  let safeFilename = `${rawBase}.xlsx`;
  if (!/\b(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)\s+\d{2},\s+\d{4}\s+\d{4}\b/.test(rawBase)) {
    try {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
        month: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        year: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
      }).formatToParts(new Date());
      const m = {};
      parts.forEach((p) => { if (p.type !== 'literal') m[p.type] = p.value; });
      const hh = m.hour === '24' ? '00' : String(m.hour || '00').padStart(2, '0');
      safeFilename = `${rawBase} ${m.month || 'Jan'} ${String(m.day || '01').padStart(2, '0')}, ${m.year || new Date().getFullYear()} ${hh}${String(m.minute || '00').padStart(2, '0')}.xlsx`;
    } catch {
      safeFilename = `${rawBase}.xlsx`;
    }
  }
  const blob = new Blob([bytes], {
    type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
  });

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = safeFilename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);

  return safeFilename;
}

/**

export const FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS = 10;
export const DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL = 'mgan@pingconmarketing.com';
export const DEFAULT_MATRIX_SEND_TIME_PHT = '13:00';
export const DEFAULT_FOLLOWUP_SEND_TIME_PHT = '13:00';

export const DEFAULT_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG = {
  autoEnabled: true,
  autoSendTimePht: DEFAULT_FOLLOWUP_SEND_TIME_PHT,
  customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled: true,
  testStepIntervalSeconds: 0, // 0 = Normal 1 Manila Calendar Day; > 0 applies STRICTLY to Test Mode Sandbox RMAs only
  testAutoCronEnabled: false // Allows automated cron sweeps to advance Test Mode Sandbox RMAs
};

export function normalizeTestStepIntervalSeconds(raw) {
  const n = Math.floor(Number(raw) || 0);
  if (n <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.max(10, Math.min(86400, n));
}

export function formatDurationCompact(totalSeconds) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(totalSeconds) || 0));
  if (s < 60) return `${s}s`;
  const mins = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const remSec = s % 60;
  if (mins < 60) return remSec > 0 ? `${mins}m ${remSec}s` : `${mins}m`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  const remMin = mins % 60;
  return remMin > 0 ? `${hrs}h ${remMin}m` : `${hrs}h`;
}

export function formatManilaTimeHms(dateInput) {
  const d = dateInput instanceof Date ? dateInput : new Date(dateInput || Date.now());
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '00:00:00';
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
      hour12: false
    }).formatToParts(d);
    const map = {};
    parts.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });
    const hh = map.hour === '24' ? '00' : String(map.hour || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(map.minute || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    const ss = String(map.second || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    return `${hh}:${mm}:${ss}`;
  } catch {
    const pht = new Date(d.getTime() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    return `${String(pht.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(pht.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(pht.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
}

export function normalizeSandboxEmail(raw) {
  const s = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(s)) return s;
  return DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL;
}

export function normalizeTimeHhmm(raw, fallback = DEFAULT_MATRIX_SEND_TIME_PHT) {
  const m = String(raw || '').trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
  if (!m) return fallback;
  const hh = parseInt(m[1], 10);
  const mm = parseInt(m[2], 10);
  if (hh < 0 || hh > 23 || mm < 0 || mm > 59) return fallback;
  return `${String(hh).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mm).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function formatTime12hFromHhmm(hhmm) {
  const norm = normalizeTimeHhmm(hhmm, '13:00');
  const [hh, mm] = norm.split(':').map(Number);
  const ampm = hh >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = hh % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hh % 12;
  return `${h12}:${String(mm).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}`;
}

export function getManilaDateYmd(dateInput = new Date()) {
  return formatDateYmd(dateInput) || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function getManilaTimeHhmm(dateInput = new Date()) {
  const d = dateInput instanceof Date ? dateInput : new Date(dateInput || Date.now());
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '00:00';
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false
    }).formatToParts(d);
    const map = {};
    parts.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });
    const hh = map.hour === '24' ? '00' : String(map.hour || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(map.minute || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    return `${hh}:${mm}`;
  } catch {
    const utcMs = d.getTime() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const pht = new Date(utcMs);
    return `${String(pht.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(pht.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
}

export function hasReachedManilaSchedule(targetHhmm = '13:00', nowDate = new Date()) {
  const target = normalizeTimeHhmm(targetHhmm, '13:00');
  const current = getManilaTimeHhmm(nowDate);
  const [th, tm] = target.split(':').map(Number);
  const [ch, cm] = current.split(':').map(Number);
  return ch * 60 + cm >= th * 60 + tm;
}

export function formatMonthDayYear(dateInput) {
  if (!dateInput) return '';
  const ymd = formatDateYmd(dateInput);
  if (!ymd) return '';
  try {
    const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
    const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, 4, 0, 0));
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      month: 'short',
      day: '2-digit',
      year: 'numeric'
    }).format(dt);
  } catch {
    return ymd;
  }
}

export function formatMonthDayYearHm(dateInput) {
  if (!dateInput) return '';
  const hm = formatDateTimeYmdHm(dateInput);
  const ymd = hm ? hm.slice(0, 10) : formatDateYmd(dateInput);
  const timePart = hm && hm.length >= 16 ? hm.slice(11, 16) : '';
  const mdy = formatMonthDayYear(ymd);
  if (!mdy) return hm || '';
  return timePart ? `${mdy} ${timePart}` : mdy;
}

export function addManilaCalendarDaysYmd(ymd, offsetDays) {
  if (!ymd || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(ymd)) return '';
  const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
  const utc = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + Number(offsetDays || 0)));
  return utc.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function diffManilaCalendarDays(startVal, nowDate = new Date()) {
  const startYmd = getManilaDateYmd(startVal);
  const endYmd = getManilaDateYmd(nowDate);
  if (!startYmd || !endYmd) return 0;
  const [sy, sm, sd] = startYmd.split('-').map(Number);
  const [ey, em, ed] = endYmd.split('-').map(Number);
  const sUtc = Date.UTC(sy, sm - 1, sd);
  const eUtc = Date.UTC(ey, em - 1, ed);
  return Math.max(0, Math.round((eUtc - sUtc) / 86400000));
}

export function isPlaceholderSupplier(val) {
  const s = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    !s ||
    s === 'pending assignment' ||
    s === 'pending' ||
    s === 'unassigned' ||
    s === 'warehouse' ||
    s === 'n/a' ||
    s === 'direct return'
  );
}

export function splitEmailStringOrList(raw) {
  if (!raw) return [];
  const items = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : String(raw).split(/[,;\s]+/);
  const unique = new Set();
  for (const entry of items) {
    const clean = String(entry || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (clean && clean.includes('@') && clean.includes('.') && !clean.endsWith('.test')) {
      unique.add(clean);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(unique);
}

function escapeHtml(val) {
  return String(val ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

export function resolveReportPartyAndEmails(report, catalogProducts = []) {
  const meta = (report?.ai_document_metadata && typeof report.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? report.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const pickup = (meta.supplier_pickup && typeof meta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
    ? meta.supplier_pickup
    : {};
  const followUp = (meta.follow_up && typeof meta.follow_up === 'object')
    ? meta.follow_up
    : {};

  const bc = String(report?.barcode || '').trim();
  const matchedCatalog = (Array.isArray(catalogProducts) && bc)
    ? catalogProducts.find((p) => p?.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === bc)
    : null;

  const supplierCandidate = [
    pickup.supplier_name,
    report?.supplier_name,
    report?.supplierName,
    report?.supplier,
    matchedCatalog?.supplier_name,
    matchedCatalog?.supplierName
  ].find((cand) => !isPlaceholderSupplier(cand));

  const supplierName = supplierCandidate ? String(supplierCandidate).trim() : '';
  const hasValidSupplier = Boolean(supplierName);

  const isSupplierStream = report?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
  const customerBranch = !isPlaceholderSupplier(pickup.customer_name)
    ? String(pickup.customer_name).trim()
    : (!isPlaceholderSupplier(report?.store_branch) ? String(report.store_branch).trim() : '');

  const supplierEmailTo = String(followUp.supplier_email_to ?? pickup.supplier_email_to ?? '').trim();
  const supplierEmailCc = String(followUp.supplier_email_cc ?? pickup.supplier_email_cc ?? '').trim();

  const toEmails = splitEmailStringOrList(supplierEmailTo);
  const ccEmails = splitEmailStringOrList(supplierEmailCc).filter((e) => !toEmails.includes(e));

  return {
    supplierName: supplierName || 'Pending Assignment',
    hasValidSupplier,
    customerBranch: customerBranch || 'Wholesale Customer',
    supplierEmailTo,
    supplierEmailCc,
    toEmails,
    ccEmails,
    aeEmail: String(report?.ae_email || '').trim().toLowerCase(),
    pickupMeta: pickup,
    followUpMeta: followUp,
    meta
  };
}

/**
 * Computes the complete 4-Step Workflow & 10-Calendar-Day SLA state for an RMA report.
 */
export function computeFourStepWorkflow(report, catalogProducts = [], options = {}) {
  const nowDate = options.now instanceof Date ? options.now : new Date(options.now || Date.now());
  const stream = report?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'supplier_outbound' : 'customer_inbound';
  const isSupplierStream = stream === 'supplier_outbound';
  const party = resolveReportPartyAndEmails(report, catalogProducts);
  const { meta, pickupMeta, followUpMeta } = party;

  const statusLower = String(report?.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const workflowRes = String(meta.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const dispLower = String(meta.simple_rtv_disposition || pickupMeta.disposition || report?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const outcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(report);

  const pickedUpAtIso =
    pickupMeta.picked_up_at ||
    followUpMeta.picked_up_at ||
    (['picked_up', 'picked_up_by_supplier', 'buffer_replacement_dispatched', 'buffer_dispatched'].includes(statusLower)
      ? (pickupMeta.updated_at || meta.simple_rtv_updated_at || report?.updated_at || null)
      : null);

  const autoDisposedAtIso =
    followUpMeta.auto_disposed_at ||
    (followUpMeta.case_status === 'auto_disposed_after_10_days'
      ? followUpMeta.case_closed_at
      : null);

  const isAutoDisposed = Boolean(followUpMeta.auto_disposed_at) || followUpMeta.case_status === 'auto_disposed_after_10_days';
  const isAutoClosed = followUpMeta.case_status === 'auto_closed_10_days' || isAutoDisposed;

  const isRestocked = workflowRes === 'restocked' || statusLower === 'restocked';
  const isScrapped =
    isAutoDisposed ||
    workflowRes === 'scrapped_no_reorder' ||
    statusLower === 'scrapped' ||
    statusLower === 'disposed';
  const isCreditMemoIssued =
    statusLower === 'credit_memo_issued' ||
    Boolean(report?.credit_memo_number || report?.credit_memo_no);
  const isRejected = statusLower === 'rejected' || dispLower.includes('8- rejected');

  const caseClosedAtIso =
    followUpMeta.case_closed_at ||
    pickedUpAtIso ||
    ((isRestocked || isScrapped || isRejected || statusLower === 'resolved' || statusLower === 'closed' || (stream === 'customer_inbound' && isCreditMemoIssued && !followUpMeta.updated_at))
      ? (meta.resolved_at || meta.simple_rtv_updated_at || report?.inspected_at || report?.updated_at || null)
      : null);

  const isPickedUp = Boolean(pickedUpAtIso) || outcome.isPickedUp;
  const isClosed = Boolean(
    caseClosedAtIso ||
    isPickedUp ||
    isRestocked ||
    isScrapped ||
    isRejected ||
    statusLower === 'resolved' ||
    statusLower === 'closed'
  );

  const defaultCustomerEnabled =
    options.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled !== undefined
      ? Boolean(options.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled)
      : Boolean(DEFAULT_FOLLOWUP_CONFIG.customerFollowUpDefaultEnabled);

  const wasExplicitlyDisabled = Boolean(
    followUpMeta.manually_disabled === true ||
    (followUpMeta.enabled === false && (
      followUpMeta.updated_at ||
      followUpMeta.case_closed_at ||
      followUpMeta.auto_disposed_at
    ))
  );

  let followUpEnabled = true;
  if (wasExplicitlyDisabled) {
    followUpEnabled = false;
  } else if (followUpMeta.enabled === true) {
    followUpEnabled = true;
  } else if (isSupplierStream) {
    followUpEnabled = true;
  } else {
    followUpEnabled = defaultCustomerEnabled;
  }

  const reportDateIso = report?.created_at || followUpMeta.started_at || meta.simple_rtv_updated_at || report?.updated_at || nowDate.toISOString();
  const startedAtIso =
    followUpMeta.started_at ||
    report?.created_at ||
    meta.simple_rtv_updated_at ||
    report?.updated_at ||
    nowDate.toISOString();

  // STRICT LIVE ISOLATION: Accelerated seconds/minutes interval ONLY activates if BOTH:
  // (1) isTestRecord(report) === true, AND (2) testStepIntervalSeconds > 0.
  // Live Production RMAs unconditionally stay on Asia/Manila 1-calendar-day logic.
  const isReportTest = isTestRecord(report);
  const requestedStepSeconds = normalizeTestStepIntervalSeconds(
    options.testStepIntervalSeconds ?? options.followUpConfig?.testStepIntervalSeconds ?? 0
  );
  const testStepIntervalSeconds = isReportTest && requestedStepSeconds > 0 ? requestedStepSeconds : 0;
  const isAcceleratedTestSla = testStepIntervalSeconds > 0;

  const parsedStartMs = new Date(startedAtIso).getTime();
  const startedMs = Number.isNaN(parsedStartMs) ? nowDate.getTime() : parsedStartMs;
  const elapsedSeconds = isAcceleratedTestSla
    ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((nowDate.getTime() - startedMs) / 1000))
    : 0;

  const calendarDay = isAcceleratedTestSla
    ? Math.floor(elapsedSeconds / testStepIntervalSeconds)
    : diffManilaCalendarDays(startedAtIso, nowDate);
  const isCountdownActive = !isClosed && followUpEnabled;
  const isExpiredAfter10Days = isCountdownActive && calendarDay > FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS;
  const todayManila = getManilaDateYmd(nowDate);
  const lastSentPhtDate = String(followUpMeta.last_sent_pht_date || '').trim() || null;

  const lastSentSimDay =
    followUpMeta.last_sent_sim_day !== undefined && followUpMeta.last_sent_sim_day !== null
      ? Number(followUpMeta.last_sent_sim_day)
      : null;
  const lastSentSimInterval = Number(followUpMeta.last_sent_sim_interval_sec || 0);
  const sameSimConfig = isAcceleratedTestSla && lastSentSimDay !== null && lastSentSimInterval === testStepIntervalSeconds;

  const alreadySentToday = isAcceleratedTestSla
    ? (sameSimConfig && lastSentSimDay >= calendarDay)
    : (lastSentPhtDate === todayManila);
  const sentCount = Number(followUpMeta.sent_count || 0);

  const nextStepInSeconds = isAcceleratedTestSla && isCountdownActive && !isExpiredAfter10Days
    ? Math.max(0, (calendarDay + 1) * testStepIntervalSeconds - elapsedSeconds)
    : 0;
  const autoDisposeInSeconds = isAcceleratedTestSla && isCountdownActive
    ? Math.max(0, (FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS + 1) * testStepIntervalSeconds - elapsedSeconds)
    : 0;

  // Build Day 0..Day 10 timeline matrix anchored on Manila calendar dates (or exact simulated step timestamps for Test Sandbox)
  const day0Ymd = getManilaDateYmd(reportDateIso) || getManilaDateYmd(startedAtIso);
  const dispatchedPhtDates = new Set();
  const dispatchedDays = new Set();
  if (!isAcceleratedTestSla) {
    if (lastSentPhtDate) dispatchedPhtDates.add(lastSentPhtDate);
    if (followUpMeta.last_sent_day !== undefined && followUpMeta.last_sent_day !== null) {
      dispatchedDays.add(Number(followUpMeta.last_sent_day));
    }
    if (Array.isArray(report?.audit_trail)) {
      report.audit_trail.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry?.action === 'FOLLOWUP_EMAIL_SENT' && entry?.timestamp) {
          const y = getManilaDateYmd(entry.timestamp);
          if (y) dispatchedPhtDates.add(y);
        }
      });
    }
  } else {
    if (Array.isArray(followUpMeta.sent_sim_days)) {
      followUpMeta.sent_sim_days.forEach((d) => {
        const num = Number(d);
        if (!Number.isNaN(num)) dispatchedDays.add(num);
      });
    }
    if (sameSimConfig && lastSentSimDay !== null) {
      dispatchedDays.add(lastSentSimDay);
    }
  }

  const parsedPickedUpMs = pickedUpAtIso ? new Date(pickedUpAtIso).getTime() : NaN;
  const pickedUpDayIdx = pickedUpAtIso
    ? (isAcceleratedTestSla
        ? (!Number.isNaN(parsedPickedUpMs)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((parsedPickedUpMs - startedMs) / (testStepIntervalSeconds * 1000)))
            : null)
        : (day0Ymd ? diffManilaCalendarDays(`${day0Ymd}T00:00:00+08:00`, pickedUpAtIso) : null))
    : null;
  const pickedUpDisplayHm = pickedUpAtIso ? formatMonthDayYearHm(pickedUpAtIso) : '';
  const currentDayFromReport = isAcceleratedTestSla
    ? calendarDay
    : (day0Ymd ? diffManilaCalendarDays(`${day0Ymd}T00:00:00+08:00`, nowDate) : calendarDay);
  const exceededAfter10 = !isPickedUp && (isAutoDisposed || (!isClosed && calendarDay > FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS));

  const timelineDays = [];
  if (day0Ymd) {
    const day0Display = isAcceleratedTestSla
      ? `${formatManilaTimeHms(startedMs)} (+0s)`
      : (formatMonthDayYearHm(reportDateIso) || formatMonthDayYear(day0Ymd));
    timelineDays.push({
      day: 0,
      dateYmd: day0Ymd,
      dateLabel: day0Display,
      statusText: pickedUpAtIso && pickedUpDayIdx === 0
        ? `Yes — Picked up on ${pickedUpDisplayHm}`
        : `Report Logged (${day0Display})`,
      state: pickedUpAtIso && pickedUpDayIdx === 0 ? 'picked_up' : 'reported'
    });

    for (let d = 1; d <= FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS; d++) {
      const simStepMs = startedMs + d * testStepIntervalSeconds * 1000;
      const dYmd = isAcceleratedTestSla ? getManilaDateYmd(simStepMs) : addManilaCalendarDaysYmd(day0Ymd, d);
      const dDateLabel = isAcceleratedTestSla
        ? `${formatManilaTimeHms(simStepMs)} (+${formatDurationCompact(d * testStepIntervalSeconds)})`
        : (formatMonthDayYear(`${dYmd}T12:00:00+08:00`) || dYmd);
      const wasPickedUpOnDay = Boolean(pickedUpAtIso) && pickedUpDayIdx === d;
      const wasPickedUpEarlier = Boolean(pickedUpAtIso) && pickedUpDayIdx !== null && pickedUpDayIdx < d;
      const wasDispatched = isAcceleratedTestSla
        ? dispatchedDays.has(d)
        : (dispatchedPhtDates.has(dYmd) || dispatchedDays.has(d));

      let statusText = 'Upcoming';
      let state = 'upcoming';

      if (wasPickedUpOnDay) {
        statusText = `Yes — Picked up on ${pickedUpDisplayHm}`;
        state = 'picked_up';
      } else if (wasPickedUpEarlier) {
        statusText = `Halted — Picked up on ${pickedUpDisplayHm}`;
        state = 'halted';
      } else if (exceededAfter10) {
        if (d === FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS) {
          statusText = 'Exceeded Day 10 — Auto-Scrapped & Case Closed';
          state = 'expired';
        } else {
          statusText = wasDispatched
            ? (isAcceleratedTestSla ? 'No — Simulated follow-up dispatched' : 'No — Daily follow-up dispatched')
            : 'No — Not picked up';
          state = 'past';
        }
      } else if (isClosed) {
        statusText = `Halted — Case closed (${formatMonthDayYearHm(caseClosedAtIso || nowDate)})`;
        state = 'halted';
      } else if (d <= currentDayFromReport) {
        if (wasDispatched) {
          statusText = isAcceleratedTestSla ? 'No — Simulated follow-up dispatched' : 'No — Daily follow-up dispatched';
          state = 'dispatched';
        } else {
          statusText = 'No — Waiting for pickup';
          state = 'waiting';
        }
      }

      timelineDays.push({
        day: d,
        dateYmd: dYmd,
        dateLabel: dDateLabel,
        statusText,
        state
      });
    }
  }

  const step1 = {
    key: 'report_date',
    label: 'Step 1: Report Date',
    dateIso: reportDateIso,
    dateYmd: formatDateYmd(reportDateIso),
    dateDisplay: formatMonthDayYearHm(reportDateIso) || 'N/A',
    done: true
  };

  const simSpeedTag = isAcceleratedTestSla ? ` (${formatDurationCompact(testStepIntervalSeconds)}/day)` : '';
  const step2Text = isClosed
    ? (isAutoDisposed ? 'Exceeded Day 10 — Auto-Scrapped' : isPickedUp ? 'Completed (Picked Up)' : 'Closed')
    : !followUpEnabled
      ? (isSupplierStream && !party.hasValidSupplier ? 'Waiting Supplier Info' : 'Waiting Pickup Tracking')
      : calendarDay > FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS
        ? `Exceeded Day 10 (Day ${calendarDay})${simSpeedTag}`
        : `Day ${calendarDay} of ${FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS}${simSpeedTag}`;

  const step2 = {
    key: 'waiting_pickup',
    label: isSupplierStream ? 'Step 2: Waiting For Pickup' : 'Step 2: Waiting For Handover',
    calendarDay,
    maxDays: FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS,
    status: isClosed ? 'completed' : isExpiredAfter10Days ? 'expired' : (isCountdownActive ? 'active' : 'paused'),
    text: step2Text,
    exceededAfter10,
    timelineDays,
    lastSentPhtDate,
    lastSentSimDay,
    sentCount,
    isAcceleratedTestSla,
    testStepIntervalSeconds,
    elapsedSeconds,
    nextStepInSeconds,
    autoDisposeInSeconds,
    done: isClosed
  };

  const step3DateDisplay = pickedUpAtIso
    ? `Picked up on ${pickedUpDisplayHm}`
    : (isAutoDisposed || isAutoClosed || isExpiredAfter10Days
        ? 'Not Picked Up (Auto-Scrapped after Day 10)'
        : 'Pending Pickup');

  const step3 = {
    key: 'pickup_date',
    label: 'Step 3: Driver Picked Up Date',
    dateIso: pickedUpAtIso,
    dateYmd: pickedUpAtIso ? formatDateYmd(pickedUpAtIso) : '',
    dateDisplay: step3DateDisplay,
    done: Boolean(pickedUpAtIso)
  };

  const step4Reason = isAutoDisposed
    ? 'Auto-Scrapped (>10 Days)'
    : followUpMeta.case_status === 'auto_closed_10_days'
      ? 'Auto-Closed (>10 Days)'
      : isPickedUp
        ? 'Picked Up — Case Closed'
        : isRestocked
          ? 'Restocked'
          : isScrapped
            ? 'Scrapped / Disposed'
            : isCreditMemoIssued
              ? 'Credit Memo Issued'
              : isClosed
                ? 'Case Closed'
                : 'Open';

  const step4Display = isClosed
    ? `Case Closed (${formatMonthDayYearHm(caseClosedAtIso || nowDate)})`
    : 'Open';

  const step4 = {
    key: 'case_close',
    label: 'Step 4: Case Close',
    dateIso: caseClosedAtIso,
    dateYmd: caseClosedAtIso ? formatDateYmd(caseClosedAtIso) : '',
    dateDisplay: step4Display,
    reason: step4Reason,
    done: isClosed
  };

  const activeStepNumber = isClosed ? 4 : isPickedUp ? 3 : 2;
  const stepSummary = isClosed
    ? `Step 4: ${step4Reason}`
    : isCountdownActive
      ? (calendarDay > FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS
          ? `Step 2: Exceeded Day 10 (Day ${calendarDay})`
          : `Step 2: Waiting (Day ${calendarDay} of 10)`)
      : (isSupplierStream && !party.hasValidSupplier
          ? 'Step 2: Waiting Supplier Info'
          : 'Step 2: Intake / Triage');

  return {
    stream,
    isSupplierStream,
    isAcceleratedTestSla,
    testStepIntervalSeconds,
    elapsedSeconds,
    nextStepInSeconds,
    autoDisposeInSeconds,
    party,
    startedAtIso,
    startedAtYmd: formatDateYmd(startedAtIso),
    startedAtDisplay: formatMonthDayYearHm(startedAtIso),
    calendarDay,
    maxDays: FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS,
    followUpEnabled,
    isCountdownActive,
    isClosed,
    isPickedUp,
    isScrapped,
    isRestocked,
    isAutoDisposed,
    isAutoClosed,
    isCreditMemoIssued,
    isRejected,
    isExpiredAfter10Days,
    lastSentPhtDate,
    lastSentSimDay,
    alreadySentToday,
    sentCount,
    pickedUpAtIso,
    pickedUpAtYmd: step3.dateYmd,
    caseClosedAtIso,
    caseClosedAtYmd: step4.dateYmd,
    activeStepNumber,
    stepSummary,
    timelineDays,
    step1,
    step2,
    step3,
    step4,
    outcome
  };
}

/**
 * Resolves a human-readable status label (zero raw DB snake_case strings)
 * for Supplier Claims, Customer Hub, and Excel exports.
 */
export function getCleanHumanWorkflowStatus(report, catalogProducts = [], options = {}) {
  const wf = computeFourStepWorkflow(report, catalogProducts, options);
  const statusLower = String(report?.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const skuAssigned = hasAssignedSku(report, catalogProducts);

  if (wf.isAutoDisposed) {
    return {
      label: 'Auto-Disposed (>10 Days)',
      badgeColor: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isAutoClosed) {
    return {
      label: 'Auto-Closed (>10 Days)',
      badgeColor: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isPickedUp) {
    return {
      label: wf.outcome.formType === 'replacement' ? 'Picked Up (Replaced) — Case Closed' : 'Picked Up — Case Closed',
      badgeColor: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isCreditMemoIssued) {
    return {
      label: 'Credit Memo Issued',
      badgeColor: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isRestocked) {
    return {
      label: 'Restocked to Good Stock',
      badgeColor: 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 border-teal-300 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isScrapped) {
    const resolvedStage = formatLifecycleStage(report?.status, report);
    return {
      label: resolvedStage?.label || 'Scrapped / Disposed',
      badgeColor: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isRejected) {
    return {
      label: 'Claim Rejected',
      badgeColor: 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isExpiredAfter10Days) {
    return {
      label: `10-Day Window Expired (Day ${wf.calendarDay})`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-200 dark:border-rose-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isCountdownActive) {
    return {
      label: wf.isSupplierStream
        ? `Waiting Pickup (Day ${wf.calendarDay} of 10)`
        : `Waiting Handover (Day ${wf.calendarDay} of 10)`,
      badgeColor: wf.calendarDay >= 8
        ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700'
        : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (!skuAssigned || statusLower === 'pending_admin_details') {
    return {
      label: 'Awaiting SKU',
      badgeColor: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-200 dark:bg-orange-950/70 dark:text-orange-300 dark:border-orange-800',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.isSupplierStream && !wf.party.hasValidSupplier) {
    return {
      label: 'Needs Supplier & Email',
      badgeColor: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700',
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  if (wf.outcome.hasDecision) {
    return {
      label: wf.outcome.shortStatus,
      badgeColor: wf.outcome.badgeColor,
      workflow: wf
    };
  }
  const fallbackStage = formatLifecycleStage(report?.status, report);
  return {
    label: fallbackStage?.label || 'Pending Triage',
    badgeColor: fallbackStage?.color || 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700',
    workflow: wf
  };
}

export function buildFollowUpEmailSubject({ report, supplierName, calendarDay, isTestMode = false, now = new Date() }) {
  const rmaNumber = report?.rma_number || report?.rmaNumber || 'RMA-PENDING';
  const monthDayYr = formatMonthDayYear(now);
  const clampedDay = Math.max(0, Math.min(FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS, Number(calendarDay || 0)));
  const isSupplier = report?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
  const partyLabel = supplierName || 'Pending Assignment';
  const base = isSupplier
    ? `[Follow-Up | ${monthDayYr} — Day ${clampedDay} of ${FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS}] ${rmaNumber}: Waiting for Supplier Pickup (${partyLabel})`
    : `[Follow-Up | ${monthDayYr} — Day ${clampedDay} of ${FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS}] ${rmaNumber}: Waiting for Customer Handover (${partyLabel})`;
  return formatTestEmailSubject(base, isTestMode);
}

export function renderWorkflowStepsHtml(wf) {
  const rows = [
    { step: 'Step 1: Report Date', status: wf.step1.dateDisplay, detail: `ISO (YYYY-MM-DD): ${wf.step1.dateYmd || 'N/A'}` },
    { step: 'Step 2: Waiting For Pickup (10 Calendar Days Max)', status: wf.step2.text, detail: `Day ${Math.min(wf.calendarDay, wf.maxDays)} of ${wf.maxDays} Calendar Days (Asia/Manila)` },
    { step: 'Step 3: Driver Picked Up Date', status: wf.step3.dateDisplay, detail: wf.step3.dateYmd ? `ISO (YYYY-MM-DD): ${wf.step3.dateYmd}` : 'Did the RMA get picked up yet?' },
    { step: 'Step 4: Case Close', status: wf.step4.dateDisplay, detail: wf.step4.reason }
  ];

  const days = Array.isArray(wf.timelineDays) ? wf.timelineDays : [];

  return `
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th style="background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase;">4-Step Workflow Stage</th>
          <th style="background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase;">Status / Date &amp; Time</th>
          <th style="background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase;">Details</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows.map((r) => `
          <tr>
            <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${escapeHtml(r.step)}</td>
            <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight: 800; color: #1e3a8a; font-family: monospace;">${escapeHtml(r.status)}</td>
            <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; color: #475569;">${escapeHtml(r.detail)}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    ${days.length > 0 ? `
    <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; margin: 14px 0 6px;">Step 2 Daily Pickup Tracker — Day 0 to Day 10 (Did the RMA get picked up?)</div>
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155; text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">Day &amp; Manila Date</th>
          <th style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155; text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">Did the RMA get picked up?</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${days.map((d) => {
          const badgeColor = d.state === 'picked_up'
            ? '#065f46'
            : d.state === 'expired'
              ? '#9f1239'
              : d.state === 'dispatched'
                ? '#3730a3'
                : d.state === 'waiting' || d.state === 'past'
                  ? '#92400e'
                  : '#64748b';
          return `
            <tr>
              <td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">
                ${escapeHtml(d.day === 0 ? `Day 0 (Report Date): ${d.dateLabel}` : `Day ${d.day} (${d.dateLabel})`)}
              </td>
              <td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight: 700; color: ${badgeColor};">
                ${escapeHtml(d.statusText)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table>` : ''}
  `;
}

function renderItemsAndPhotosHtml(report, allReports, catalogProducts) {
  const { items: itemsTable } = getConsolidatedPickupItems({
    report,
    reports: [report],
    allReports: allReports || [report],
    catalogProducts,
    combineIdentical: false
  });
  const rows = itemsTable.length > 0 ? itemsTable : [{
    idx: 1,
    name: report?.name || report?.barcode || 'Returned Item',
    cleanSku: report?.code || report?.sku || '',
    barcode: report?.barcode || '',
    totalPieces: Number(report?.quantity || 1),
    unitName: report?.unit_name || 'pc',
    reason: report?.reason || 'Damaged / Defective',
    explanation: cleanExplanationText(report?.explanation || '')
  }];

  const photos = getRealPhotos(report?.photos || []);
  const tableHtml = `
    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th style="background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px;">Item / SKU / Barcode</th>
          <th style="background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: right; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px;">Qty</th>
          <th style="background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px;">Reason &amp; Explanation</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows.map((it) => `
          <tr>
            <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
              <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${escapeHtml(it.name)}</div>
              <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; font-family: monospace;">
                ${it.cleanSku ? `SKU: ${escapeHtml(it.cleanSku)}` : ''}${it.cleanSku && it.barcode ? ' • ' : ''}${it.barcode ? `BC: ${escapeHtml(it.barcode)}` : ''}${it.supplierName && !isPlaceholderSupplier(it.supplierName) ? ` • Supplier: ${escapeHtml(it.supplierName)}` : ''}
              </div>
            </td>
            <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; text-align: right; font-weight: 800; font-family: monospace; white-space: nowrap;">
              ${Number(it.totalPieces || 1).toLocaleString()} ${escapeHtml(it.unitName || 'pc')}
            </td>
            <td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; color: #334155;">
              <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #be123c;">${escapeHtml(it.reason || report?.reason || 'Damaged')}</div>
              ${it.explanation ? `<div style="font-size: 11px; color: #475569; margin-top: 2px;">${escapeHtml(it.explanation)}</div>` : ''}
            </td>
          </tr>
        `).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;

  const photosHtml = photos.length > 0
    ? `
      <div style="margin-top: 16px;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 8px;">Proof Photos (${photos.length})</div>
        ${photos.slice(0, 6).map((url, idx) => `
          <div style="margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;">
            <img src="${escapeHtml(url)}" alt="Proof Photo ${idx + 1}" style="max-width: 100%; max-height: 280px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;" />
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    `
    : '';

  return { rows, photos, tableHtml, photosHtml };
}

export function buildFollowUpEmailContent({
  report,
  allReports = [],
  catalogProducts = [],
  workflow = null,
  isTestMode = false,
  sandboxEmail = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_EMAIL,
  now = new Date()
}) {
  const wf = workflow || computeFourStepWorkflow(report, catalogProducts, { now });
  const rmaNumber = report?.rma_number || report?.rmaNumber || 'RMA-PENDING';
  const partyName = wf.isSupplierStream ? wf.party.supplierName : (wf.party.supplierName !== 'Pending Assignment' ? wf.party.supplierName : wf.party.customerBranch);
  const subject = buildFollowUpEmailSubject({
    report,
    supplierName: partyName,
    calendarDay: wf.calendarDay,
    isTestMode,
    now
  });

  const { rows, photos, tableHtml, photosHtml } = renderItemsAndPhotosHtml(report, allReports, catalogProducts);
  const warningText = wf.isSupplierStream
    ? 'Waiting for supplier to pick up bad order for only 10 calendar days. After 10 calendar days, items will be automatically disposed of / scrapped due to health and sanitation risks.'
    : 'Waiting for pickup / handover completion within 10 calendar days. After 10 calendar days, held items may be automatically closed / disposed of due to health and sanitation risks.';

  const daysRemaining = Math.max(0, FOLLOW_UP_MAX_DAYS - wf.calendarDay);
  const html = `
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head><meta charset="utf-8"></head>
    <body style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background-color: #f8fafc; margin: 0; padding: 24px; color: #1e293b;">
      <div style="max-width: 660px; margin: 0 auto; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; overflow: hidden;">
        <div style="background: #92400e; padding: 22px 26px; color: #ffffff;">
          <div style="display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); margin-bottom: 8px;">
            ${isTestMode ? `[TEST] DAY ${wf.calendarDay} OF 10 FOLLOW-UP` : `DAY ${wf.calendarDay} OF 10 PICKUP FOLLOW-UP`}
          </div>
          <h1 style="margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800;">${isTestMode ? '[TEST] ' : ''}Bad Order Pickup Follow-Up: ${escapeHtml(rmaNumber)}</h1>
          <div style="font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 4px;">
            ${wf.isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier / Vendor' : 'Customer / Party'}: <strong>${escapeHtml(partyName)}</strong> • ${daysRemaining} calendar day(s) remaining in 10-day window
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="padding: 24px;">
          ${isTestMode ? `
          <div style="background: #fef3c7; border: 2px dashed #f59e0b; color: #92400e; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;">
            🧪 TEST MODE ACTIVE${wf.isAcceleratedTestSla ? ` (Accelerated SLA: 1 Simulated Day = ${escapeHtml(formatDurationCompact(wf.testStepIntervalSeconds))})` : ''} — Delivered safely to ${escapeHtml(normalizeSandboxEmail(sandboxEmail))} only.
          </div>` : ''}

          <div style="background: #fff1f2; border: 2px solid #fda4af; color: #881337; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5;">
            <div style="font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin-bottom: 4px;">⚠️ 10-Calendar-Day Health &amp; Sanitation Disposal Notice</div>
            <strong>${escapeHtml(warningText)}</strong>
          </div>

          <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px;">4-Step Workflow &amp; Dates (${escapeHtml(rmaNumber)})</div>
          ${renderWorkflowStepsHtml(wf)}

          <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; margin: 18px 0 4px;">Item Details</div>
          ${tableHtml}
          ${photosHtml}
        </div>
        <div style="background: #f1f5f9; padding: 14px 24px; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
          Pingcon Marketing Operations • Automated 10-Calendar-Day RMA Follow-Up Reminder (${escapeHtml(getManilaDateYmd(now))} Asia/Manila)
        </div>
      </div>
    </body>
    </html>
  `;

  const timelineText = Array.isArray(wf.timelineDays)
    ? wf.timelineDays.map((d) => (
        d.day === 0
          ? `  - Day 0 (Report Date): ${d.dateLabel} => ${d.statusText}`
          : `  - Day ${d.day} (${d.dateLabel}) => ${d.statusText}`
      ))
    : [];

  const text = [
    subject,
    `${wf.isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier' : 'Party'}: ${partyName}`,
    warningText,
    `Step 1 (Report Date): ${wf.step1.dateDisplay} | Step 2: ${wf.step2.text} | Step 3 (Driver Picked Up): ${wf.step3.dateDisplay} | Step 4 (Case Close): ${wf.step4.dateDisplay}`,
    ...timelineText,
    ...rows.map((it) => `- ${it.name} (${it.totalPieces} ${it.unitName}) • ${it.reason || 'Damaged'}${it.explanation ? ` | ${it.explanation}` : ''}`),
    ...(photos.length > 0 ? [`Proof Photos: ${photos.join(', ')}`] : [])
  ].join('\n');

  return { subject, html, text };
}

          </div>

          <div style="font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 4px;">
            ${wf.isSupplierStream ? 'Supplier / Vendor' : 'Customer / Party'}: <strong>${escapeHtml(partyName)}</strong> • Case automatically closed on ${escapeHtml(formatDateTimeYmdHm(now))} (Asia/Manila)
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="padding: 24px;">
          ${isTestMode ? `
          <div style="background: #fef3c7; border: 2px dashed #f59e0b; color: #92400e; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;">
            🧪 TEST MODE ACTIVE${wf.isAcceleratedTestSla ? ` (Accelerated SLA: 1 Simulated Day = ${escapeHtml(formatDurationCompact(wf.testStepIntervalSeconds))})` : ''} — Delivered safely to ${escapeHtml(normalizeSandboxEmail(sandboxEmail))} only.
          </div>` : ''}

          <div style="background: #fff1f2; border: 1px solid #fecdd3; color: #881337; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 13px;">
            The 10-calendar-day pickup window (${wf.step1.dateYmd} to ${wf.step4.dateYmd || getManilaDateYmd(now)}) expired with no pickup recorded. This item has been automatically marked <strong>Scrapped / Disposed</strong> (<strong>Disposal / Scrap Area</strong>) due to health and sanitation risks, and the case is now closed.
          </div>

          <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px;">4-Step Workflow &amp; Closure Audit</div>
          ${renderWorkflowStepsHtml(wf)}

          <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; margin: 18px 0 4px;">Disposed Item Summary</div>
          ${tableHtml}
          ${photosHtml}
        </div>
        <div style="background: #f1f5f9; padding: 14px 24px; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
          Pingcon Marketing Operations • Dispatched to Configured New RMA Alert Recipients + Customer AE
        </div>
      </div>
    </body>
    </html>
  `;

  const text = [
    subject,
    `Party: ${partyName}`,
    `10-calendar-day pickup window expired on ${getManilaDateYmd(now)} (Asia/Manila). Item automatically disposed / case closed.`,
    `Step 1 Report: ${wf.step1.dateYmd} | Step 2: Expired (Day ${wf.calendarDay}) | Step 3: ${wf.step3.dateDisplay} | Step 4: ${wf.step4.dateDisplay} (${wf.step4.reason})`,
    ...rows.map((it) => `- ${it.name} (${it.totalPieces} ${it.unitName}) • ${it.reason || 'Damaged'}`)
  ].join('\n');

  return { subject, html, text };
}

import {
  formatPeso,
  formatFourChoiceOutcome,
  formatDateTimeYmdHm,

  isTestRecord,

  getPickupPhotosSummary
