const PAGE_W = 1700; // 8.5 in * 200 dpi
const PAGE_H = 2200; // 11.0 in * 200 dpi
const PDF_W = 612;   // 8.5 in * 72 pt
const PDF_H = 792;   // 11.0 in * 72 pt

const MARGIN_X = 76;
const CONTENT_W = PAGE_W - MARGIN_X * 2; // 1548 px

const isPlaceholderSupplier = (val) => {
  const s = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return !s || s === 'pending assignment' || s === 'pending' || s === 'unassigned' || s === 'warehouse' || s === 'n/a';
};

function sanitizeFilenamePart(val) {
  return String(val || 'RMA').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'RMA';
}

/**
 * Builds the exact ordered list of labeled printable copies (`1..N`) for
 * both Customer Hub and Supplier RTV forms (and Credit Memo Vouchers).
 */
export function buildPickupFormCopiesList({
  ourCopyCount = 1,
  otherCopyCount = 1,
  isCustomerStream = false
} = {}) {
  const safeOurs = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, parseInt(ourCopyCount, 10) || 0));
  const safeOther = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, parseInt(otherCopyCount, 10) || 0));
  const totalCopies = safeOurs + safeOther;
  if (totalCopies === 0) return [];

  const copies = [];
  let seq = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < safeOurs; i++) {
    seq += 1;
    const roleLabel = i === 0
      ? 'OUR COMPANY COPY (PINGCON RETAIN)'
      : 'OUR COMPANY COPY (DUPLICATE)';
    copies.push({
      key: `ours-${i}`,
      index: seq,
      total: totalCopies,
      kind: 'ours',
      title: `COPY ${seq} OF ${totalCopies} — ${roleLabel}`,
      shortTitle: i === 0 ? 'OUR COMPANY COPY' : 'OUR COMPANY COPY (DUPLICATE)'
    });
  }

  for (let j = 0; j < safeOther; j++) {
    seq += 1;
    const baseRole = isCustomerStream
      ? 'CUSTOMER COPY (HAND TO CUSTOMER / DRIVER)'
      : 'SUPPLIER COPY (HAND TO DRIVER)';
    const roleLabel = j === 0
      ? baseRole
      : (isCustomerStream ? 'CUSTOMER COPY (DUPLICATE)' : 'SUPPLIER COPY (DUPLICATE)');
    copies.push({
      key: `other-${j}`,
      index: seq,
      total: totalCopies,
      kind: 'other',
      title: `COPY ${seq} OF ${totalCopies} — ${roleLabel}`,
      shortTitle: j === 0
        ? (isCustomerStream ? 'CUSTOMER COPY' : "SUPPLIER DRIVER'S COPY")
        : (isCustomerStream ? 'CUSTOMER COPY (DUPLICATE)' : 'SUPPLIER COPY (DUPLICATE)')
    });
  }

  return copies;
}

function uint8ToBase64(bytes) {
  const chunkSize = 0x8000;
  let binary = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunkSize) {
    const slice = bytes.subarray(i, i + chunkSize);
    binary += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, slice);
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

function base64ToUint8(b64) {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const len = bin.length;
  const out = new Uint8Array(len);
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Assemble valid PDF 1.4 binary bytes from JPEG page buffers (612x792 US Letter pt).
 * Exported for deterministic unit verification in Node.
 */
export function buildPdfFromJpegPages(jpegBytePages = [], widthPx = PAGE_W, heightPx = PAGE_H) {
  if (!Array.isArray(jpegBytePages) || jpegBytePages.length === 0) {
    return new Uint8Array(0);
  }

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const parts = [];
  let byteLen = 0;
  const pushBytes = (u8) => {
    parts.push(u8);
    byteLen += u8.length;
  };
  const pushStr = (str) => pushBytes(encoder.encode(str));

  // Header + 4-byte binary marker recommended by PDF 1.4 spec
  pushStr('%PDF-1.4\n');
  pushBytes(new Uint8Array([0x25, 0xe2, 0xe3, 0xcf, 0xd3, 0x0a]));

  // Object ID allocation:
  // 1 = Catalog, 2 = Pages
  // For each page i: pageObjId = 3 + i*3, imgObjId = 4 + i*3, contentObjId = 5 + i*3
  const pageCount = jpegBytePages.length;
  const totalObjs = 2 + pageCount * 3;
  const offsets = new Array(totalObjs + 1).fill(0);

  const pageKidsRefs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
    pageKidsRefs.push(`${3 + i * 3} 0 R`);
  }

  offsets[1] = byteLen;
  pushStr('1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj\n');

  offsets[2] = byteLen;
  pushStr(`2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [ ${pageKidsRefs.join(' ')} ] /Count ${pageCount} >>\nendobj\n`);

  for (let i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
    const jpegBytes = jpegBytePages[i];
    const pageObjId = 3 + i * 3;
    const imgObjId = 4 + i * 3;
    const contentObjId = 5 + i * 3;
    const imName = `/Im${i + 1}`;

    offsets[pageObjId] = byteLen;
    pushStr(
      `${pageObjId} 0 obj\n` +
      `<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${PDF_W} ${PDF_H}] ` +
      `/Resources << /XObject << ${imName} ${imgObjId} 0 R >> >> ` +
      `/Contents ${contentObjId} 0 R >>\nendobj\n`
    );

    offsets[imgObjId] = byteLen;
    pushStr(
      `${imgObjId} 0 obj\n` +
      `<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width ${widthPx} /Height ${heightPx} ` +
      `/ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length ${jpegBytes.length} >>\n` +
      `stream\n`
    );
    pushBytes(jpegBytes);
    pushStr('\nendstream\nendobj\n');

    const contentStream = `q\n${PDF_W} 0 0 ${PDF_H} 0 0 cm\n${imName} Do\nQ\n`;
    offsets[contentObjId] = byteLen;
    pushStr(
      `${contentObjId} 0 obj\n<< /Length ${contentStream.length} >>\nstream\n${contentStream}endstream\nendobj\n`
    );
  }

  const xrefOffset = byteLen;
  pushStr(`xref\n0 ${totalObjs + 1}\n`);
  pushStr('0000000000 65535 f \n');
  for (let id = 1; id <= totalObjs; id++) {
    const offStr = String(offsets[id]).padStart(10, '0');
    pushStr(`${offStr} 00000 n \n`);
  }

  pushStr(
    `trailer\n<< /Size ${totalObjs + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n` +
    `startxref\n${xrefOffset}\n%%EOF\n`
  );

  const out = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
  let pos = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    out.set(parts[i], pos);
    pos += parts[i].length;
  }
  return out;
}

function wrapTextLines(ctx, text, maxWidth) {
  const str = String(text ?? '');
  if (!str) return [''];
  const paragraphs = str.split(/\r?\n/);
  const lines = [];

  for (const para of paragraphs) {
    const words = para.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length === 0) {
      lines.push('');
      continue;
    }
    let current = '';
    for (const word of words) {
      const candidate = current ? `${current} ${word}` : word;
      if (ctx.measureText(candidate).width <= maxWidth) {
        current = candidate;
      } else {
        if (current) lines.push(current);
        if (ctx.measureText(word).width <= maxWidth) {
          current = word;
        } else {
          // Break very long token (e.g. email string without spaces)
          let chunk = '';
          for (const ch of word) {
            if (ctx.measureText(chunk + ch).width > maxWidth && chunk) {
              lines.push(chunk);
              chunk = ch;
            } else {
              chunk += ch;
            }
          }
          current = chunk;
        }
      }
    }
    if (current) lines.push(current);
  }
  return lines.length > 0 ? lines : [''];
}

function createBlankPageCanvas() {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = PAGE_W;
  canvas.height = PAGE_H;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, PAGE_W, PAGE_H);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  return { canvas, ctx };
}

function drawBadge(ctx, x, y, text, fontSize = 17, compact = false) {
  ctx.font = `900 ${fontSize}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  const padX = compact ? 10 : 12;
  const h = compact ? 26 : 30;
  const w = Math.ceil(ctx.measureText(text).width) + padX * 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(text, x + padX, y + h / 2 + 1);
  return w;
}

function drawCopyHeaderAndMeta(ctx, startX, startY, width, copyTitle, info, compact = false) {
  let y = startY;
  const pad = compact ? 18 : 24;
  const innerX = startX + pad;
  const innerW = width - pad * 2;

  // Badges row + right-side Ref/RMA strip
  let badgeX = innerX;
  const bw1 = drawBadge(ctx, badgeX, y, copyTitle.toUpperCase(), compact ? 15 : 16, compact);
  badgeX += bw1 + 10;
  if (info.batchCount > 1) {
    const bwBatch = drawBadge(ctx, badgeX, y, `BATCH (${info.batchCount} RMAs)`, compact ? 15 : 16, compact);
    badgeX += bwBatch + 10;
  }
  if (info.isTest) {
    drawBadge(ctx, badgeX, y, '[TEST MODE RECORD]', compact ? 15 : 16, compact);
  }

  // Right column info
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 17 : 19}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText(info.refLineLabel, innerX + innerW, y);
  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 20 : 24}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(
    info.batchCount > 1 ? `BATCH: ${info.batchCount} RMAs` : `RMA #: ${info.rmaNumber}`,
    innerX + innerW,
    y + (compact ? 22 : 26)
  );
  ctx.font = `600 ${compact ? 14 : 15}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  const slotCount = info.photoSlotCount ?? info.photoCount ?? 0;
  const totalPhotos = info.photoTotalCount ?? slotCount;
  const photoSummaryLabel = totalPhotos > 0 && totalPhotos !== slotCount
    ? `${slotCount}/5 Cats (${totalPhotos} Photos) Verified`
    : `${slotCount}/5 Drive Photos Verified`;
  const statusLine = `${info.formattedTime ? `${info.formattedTime} • ` : ''}${photoSummaryLabel}`;
  ctx.fillText(statusLine, innerX + innerW, y + (compact ? 47 : 54), innerW * 0.42);

  // Title on left
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  const leftMaxW = innerW * 0.62;
  y += compact ? 32 : 38;
  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 22 : 27}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(info.formHeaderTitle, innerX, y, leftMaxW);
  y += compact ? 27 : 33;
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 16 : 18}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(`Purpose: ${info.claimPurposeLabel}`, innerX, y, leftMaxW);

  y = Math.max(y + (compact ? 24 : 28), startY + (compact ? 86 : 100));
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(innerX, y);
  ctx.lineTo(innerX + innerW, y);
  ctx.stroke();

  y += compact ? 10 : 14;

  // Supplier, Driver, Handwritten box
  const boxX = innerX;
  const boxW = innerW;
  const colHalf = boxW / 2;

  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 14 : 15}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  const emailSummary = [
    info.supplierEmailTo ? `To: ${info.supplierEmailTo}` : '',
    info.supplierEmailCc ? `CC: ${info.supplierEmailCc}` : ''
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
  ctx.font = `600 ${compact ? 14 : 15}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  const emailLines = emailSummary ? wrapTextLines(ctx, emailSummary, colHalf - 24).slice(0, 2) : [];

  const row1H = compact ? (52 + emailLines.length * 16) : (62 + emailLines.length * 18);
  const row2H = compact ? 44 : 52;
  const row3H = compact ? 52 : 62;
  const metaBoxH = row1H + row2H + row3H;

  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.strokeRect(boxX, y, boxW, metaBoxH);

  // Row 1: Party Name (Supplier OR Customer / Store Branch) | Truck Plate #
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 13 : 14}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(info.partyFieldLabel || 'SUPPLIER COMPANY NAME', boxX + 12, y + 8);
  ctx.fillText('TRUCK PLATE #', boxX + colHalf + 12, y + 8);

  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 19 : 22}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(info.supplierName, boxX + 12, y + 26, colHalf - 24);
  if (emailLines.length > 0) {
    ctx.font = `600 ${compact ? 13 : 14}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
    emailLines.forEach((line, idx) => {
      ctx.fillText(line, boxX + 12, y + (compact ? 48 : 54) + idx * (compact ? 16 : 18), colHalf - 24);
    });
  }

  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 18 : 20}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(info.truckPlate || '________________________', boxX + colHalf + 12, y + 27, colHalf - 24);

  // Row 2: Driver Name | Valid Gov't / Legal ID #
  const r2Y = y + row1H;
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 13 : 14}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('DRIVER / REPRESENTATIVE NAME', boxX + 12, r2Y + 4);
  ctx.fillText("VALID PH GOV'T / LEGAL ID #", boxX + colHalf + 12, r2Y + 4);
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 17 : 19}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(info.driverName || '___________________________', boxX + 12, r2Y + 21, colHalf - 24);
  const idDisplay = info.driverLicense
    ? (info.driverIdType ? `[${info.driverIdType}] ${info.driverLicense}` : info.driverLicense)
    : (info.driverIdType ? `[${info.driverIdType}] ________________` : '___________________________');
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 16 : 18}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(idDisplay, boxX + colHalf + 12, r2Y + 21, colHalf - 24);

  // Row 3: Handwritten fields
  const r3Y = r2Y + row2H;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(boxX, r3Y);
  ctx.lineTo(boxX + boxW, r3Y);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 13 : 14}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('PICKUP DATE & TIME (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm) (DRIVER WRITES)', boxX + 12, r3Y + 7);
  ctx.fillText('DRIVER CONTACT # (DRIVER WRITES)', boxX + colHalf + 12, r3Y + 7);

  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(boxX + 12, r3Y + metaBoxH - row1H - row2H - 10);
  ctx.lineTo(boxX + colHalf - 16, r3Y + metaBoxH - row1H - row2H - 10);
  ctx.moveTo(boxX + colHalf + 12, r3Y + metaBoxH - row1H - row2H - 10);
  ctx.lineTo(boxX + boxW - 12, r3Y + metaBoxH - row1H - row2H - 10);
  ctx.stroke();

  return y + metaBoxH + (compact ? 10 : 14);
}

function getTableColumns(width) {
  // Proportions sum to 1.0: #, Desc/SKU, Expiry, Qty, Unit Price, Line Total
  const w0 = 48;
  const w2 = 225;
  const w3 = 270;
  const w4 = 165;
  const w5 = 175;
  const w1 = width - (w0 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5);
  return [
    { x: 0, w: w0, label: '#', align: 'center' },
    { x: w0, w: w1, label: 'ITEM DESCRIPTION / SKU', align: 'left' },
    { x: w0 + w1, w: w2, label: 'EXPIRY DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)', align: 'center' },
    { x: w0 + w1 + w2, w: w3, label: 'QTY (CONVERTED TO PCS)', align: 'right' },
    { x: w0 + w1 + w2 + w3, w: w4, label: 'UNIT PRICE', align: 'right' },
    { x: w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4, w: w5, label: 'LINE TOTAL', align: 'right' }
  ];
}

function drawTableHeader(ctx, tableX, y, tableW, cols, compact = false) {
  const h = compact ? 32 : 38;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.strokeRect(tableX, y, tableW, h);
  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 13 : 14}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';

  cols.forEach((c, idx) => {
    const cx = tableX + c.x;
    if (idx > 0) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, y);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, y + h);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.textAlign = c.align;
    const textX = c.align === 'center' ? cx + c.w / 2 : (c.align === 'right' ? cx + c.w - 8 : cx + 8);
    ctx.fillText(c.label, textX, y + h / 2 + 1, c.w - 14);
  });

  return y + h;
}

function measureItemRowHeight(ctx, it, cols, compact = false, showRmaLine = false) {
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 16 : 18}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  const nameLines = wrapTextLines(ctx, it.name, cols[1].w - 16);
  const lineH = compact ? 20 : 23;
  let extraRmaH = 0;
  if (showRmaLine && Array.isArray(it.rmaNumbers) && it.rmaNumbers.length > 0) {
    ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 12 : 13}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
    const rmaLines = wrapTextLines(ctx, `RMAs: ${it.rmaNumbers.join(', ')}`, cols[1].w - 16);
    extraRmaH = rmaLines.length * (compact ? 15 : 17);
  }
  return Math.max(compact ? 42 : 48, 12 + nameLines.length * lineH + (compact ? 16 : 19) + extraRmaH);
}

function drawItemRow(ctx, tableX, y, tableW, cols, it, rowH, compact = false, showRmaLine = false) {
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.strokeRect(tableX, y, tableW, rowH);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';

  cols.forEach((c, idx) => {
    if (idx > 0) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tableX + c.x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(tableX + c.x, y + rowH);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

  // Col 0: #
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 15 : 17}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(String(it.idx), tableX + cols[0].x + cols[0].w / 2, y + 8);

  // Col 1: Description + SKU + Consolidated RMAs
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 16 : 18}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  const nameLines = wrapTextLines(ctx, it.name, cols[1].w - 16);
  const lineH = compact ? 20 : 23;
  nameLines.forEach((ln, i) => {
    ctx.fillText(ln, tableX + cols[1].x + 8, y + 7 + i * lineH, cols[1].w - 14);
  });
  let subY = y + 7 + nameLines.length * lineH;
  ctx.font = `600 ${compact ? 13 : 14}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`SKU: ${it.sku}`, tableX + cols[1].x + 8, subY, cols[1].w - 14);
  if (showRmaLine && Array.isArray(it.rmaNumbers) && it.rmaNumbers.length > 0) {
    subY += compact ? 16 : 18;
    ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 12 : 13}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
    const rmaLines = wrapTextLines(ctx, `RMAs: ${it.rmaNumbers.join(', ')}`, cols[1].w - 16);
    rmaLines.forEach((ln, idx) => {
      ctx.fillText(ln, tableX + cols[1].x + 8, subY + idx * (compact ? 15 : 17), cols[1].w - 14);
    });
  }

  // Col 2: Expiry Date
  ctx.font = `600 ${compact ? 15 : 17}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(it.expiry, tableX + cols[2].x + cols[2].w / 2, y + 8, cols[2].w - 12);

  // Col 3: Qty
  const qtyText = it.isCaseUnit && it.piecesPerCase > 1
    ? `${it.totalPieces.toLocaleString()} pcs (${it.rawQty} ${it.unitName} × ${it.piecesPerCase})`
    : `${it.totalPieces.toLocaleString()} ${it.unitName === 'pc' || it.totalPieces === 1 ? 'pc' : 'pcs'}`;
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 15 : 17}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(qtyText, tableX + cols[3].x + cols[3].w - 8, y + 8, cols[3].w - 14);

  // Col 4: Unit Price
  const unitPrice = it.isCaseUnit && it.piecesPerCase > 1 ? it.pricePerPiece : it.recordedUnitPrice;
  ctx.font = `600 ${compact ? 15 : 17}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`${formatPeso(unitPrice)}/pc`, tableX + cols[4].x + cols[4].w - 8, y + 8, cols[4].w - 14);

  // Col 5: Line Total
  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 15 : 17}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(formatPeso(it.lineTotal), tableX + cols[5].x + cols[5].w - 8, y + 8, cols[5].w - 14);

  return y + rowH;
}

function drawTotalRow(ctx, tableX, y, tableW, cols, info, compact = false) {
  const h = compact ? 36 : 42;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.0;
  ctx.strokeRect(tableX, y, tableW, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  const col3X = tableX + cols[3].x;
  const col4X = tableX + cols[4].x;
  const col5X = tableX + cols[5].x;

  [col3X, col4X, col5X].forEach((vx) => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(vx, y);
    ctx.lineTo(vx, y + h);
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 14 : 16}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(
    `TOTAL SUMMARY (${info.normalizedItems.length} LINE${info.normalizedItems.length > 1 ? 'S' : ''}):`,
    col3X - 10,
    y + h / 2 + 1
  );

  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 16 : 18}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`${info.grandTotalPieces.toLocaleString()} pcs`, col4X - 8, y + h / 2 + 1, cols[3].w - 14);

  ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 14 : 15}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('Total Value:', col5X - 8, y + h / 2 + 1, cols[4].w - 14);

  ctx.font = `900 ${compact ? 17 : 19}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(formatPeso(info.grandTotalValue), tableX + tableW - 8, y + h / 2 + 1, cols[5].w - 14);

  return y + h;
}

function drawSignatures(ctx, innerX, y, innerW, preparedBy, compact = false, isCustomerStream = false, preparedDateTime = '') {
  const gap = 20;
  const boxW = (innerW - gap * 2) / 3;
  const boxH = compact ? 112 : 134;

  const boxes = [
    {
      title: 'PREPARED BY (LOGISTICS / WAREHOUSE)',
      name: preparedBy,
      footer: 'Printed Name & Date',
      preparedDateTime: preparedDateTime || ''
    },
    {
      title: isCustomerStream ? "CUSTOMER / RECEIVING DRIVER'S SIGNATURE" : "SUPPLIER DRIVER'S SIGNATURE",
      name: '',
      footer: 'Signature Over Printed Name & Date',
      preparedDateTime: ''
    },
    {
      title: "RELEASING STAFF'S SIGNATURE",
      name: '',
      footer: 'Verified & Released (Sign & Date)',
      preparedDateTime: ''
    }
  ];

  boxes.forEach((b, idx) => {
    const bx = innerX + idx * (boxW + gap);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, y, boxW, boxH);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 12.5 : 13.5}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText(b.title, bx + boxW / 2, y + (compact ? 9 : 11), boxW - 14);

    if (b.name) {
      ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 16 : 18}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillText(b.name, bx + boxW / 2, y + (compact ? 30 : 38), boxW - 20);
    }

    const lineY = b.preparedDateTime ? (y + boxH - (compact ? 42 : 48)) : (y + boxH - (compact ? 30 : 34));
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(bx + 18, lineY);
    ctx.lineTo(bx + boxW - 18, lineY);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.font = `500 ${compact ? 12 : 13}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText(b.footer, bx + boxW / 2, lineY + 5, boxW - 14);

    if (b.preparedDateTime) {
      ctx.font = `700 ${compact ? 11.5 : 12.5}px "Courier New", Courier, monospace`;
      ctx.fillText(`Prepared: ${b.preparedDateTime}`, bx + boxW / 2, lineY + (compact ? 21 : 24), boxW - 14);
    }
  });

  return y + boxH;
}

function renderCompactDualCopyPage(info, copiesList = []) {
  const { canvas, ctx } = createBlankPageCanvas();
  const topBoxY = 64;
  const boxH = 950;
  const bottomBoxY = 1186;

  const copy1Title = copiesList[0]?.title || 'COPY 1 OF 2 — OUR COMPANY COPY (PINGCON RETAIN)';
  const copy2Title = copiesList[1]?.title || (
    info.isCustomerStream
      ? 'COPY 2 OF 2 — CUSTOMER COPY (HAND TO CUSTOMER / DRIVER)'
      : 'COPY 2 OF 2 — SUPPLIER COPY (HAND TO DRIVER)'
  );

  [
    { title: copy1Title, y: topBoxY },
    { title: copy2Title, y: bottomBoxY }
  ].forEach(({ title, y }) => {
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.strokeRect(MARGIN_X, y, CONTENT_W, boxH);

    const pad = 18;
    const innerX = MARGIN_X + pad;
    const innerW = CONTENT_W - pad * 2;
    let curY = drawCopyHeaderAndMeta(ctx, MARGIN_X, y + pad, CONTENT_W, title, info, true);

    const cols = getTableColumns(innerW);
    curY = drawTableHeader(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, true);
    const showRmaSub = info.batchCount > 1;
    for (const it of info.normalizedItems) {
      const rh = measureItemRowHeight(ctx, it, cols, true, showRmaSub || (it.rmaNumbers?.length > 1));
      curY = drawItemRow(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, it, rh, true, showRmaSub || (it.rmaNumbers?.length > 1));
    }
    drawTotalRow(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, info, true);

    drawSignatures(ctx, innerX, y + boxH - pad - 112, innerW, info.preparedBy, true, info.isCustomerStream, info.preparedDateTime);
  });

  // Dead-center cut line
  const cutY = 1100;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([12, 10]);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(MARGIN_X, cutY);
  ctx.lineTo(MARGIN_X + CONTENT_W, cutY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.font = `900 17px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
  const cutLabel = '  CUT HERE (50% US LETTER)  ';
  const tw = ctx.measureText(cutLabel).width;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect((PAGE_W - tw) / 2 - 12, cutY - 14, tw + 24, 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(cutLabel, PAGE_W / 2, cutY);

  return [canvas];
}

function renderFullPageCopy(info, copyTitle) {
  const canvases = [];
  const boxY = 70;
  const boxH = PAGE_H - 140;
  const bottomLimit = boxY + boxH - 26;
  const pad = 24;
  const innerX = MARGIN_X + pad;
  const innerW = CONTENT_W - pad * 2;
  const cols = getTableColumns(innerW);

  let pageObj = createBlankPageCanvas();
  let { canvas, ctx } = pageObj;
  canvases.push(canvas);

  const drawFrame = () => {
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.strokeRect(MARGIN_X, boxY, CONTENT_W, boxH);
  };
  drawFrame();

  let curY = drawCopyHeaderAndMeta(ctx, MARGIN_X, boxY + pad, CONTENT_W, copyTitle, info, false);
  curY = drawTableHeader(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, false);
  const showRmaSub = info.batchCount > 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < info.normalizedItems.length; i++) {
    const it = info.normalizedItems[i];
    const showRowRma = showRmaSub || (it.rmaNumbers?.length > 1);
    const rowH = measureItemRowHeight(ctx, it, cols, false, showRowRma);
    const isLast = i === info.normalizedItems.length - 1;
    const reserveAfter = isLast ? (42 + 16 + 134) : 0;

    if (curY + rowH + reserveAfter > bottomLimit) {
      pageObj = createBlankPageCanvas();
      canvas = pageObj.canvas;
      ctx = pageObj.ctx;
      canvases.push(canvas);
      drawFrame();

      ctx.font = `900 18px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
      ctx.fillText(
        `${copyTitle} (Continued) — ${info.formHeaderTitle} • ${info.batchCount > 1 ? `Claim: ${info.claimNumber || info.rmaNumber}` : `RMA #: ${info.rmaNumber}`}`,
        innerX,
        boxY + pad
      );
      curY = boxY + pad + 32;
      curY = drawTableHeader(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, false);
    }

    curY = drawItemRow(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, it, rowH, false, showRowRma);
  }

  curY = drawTotalRow(ctx, innerX, curY, innerW, cols, info, false);
  drawSignatures(ctx, innerX, curY + 18, innerW, info.preparedBy, false, info.isCustomerStream, info.preparedDateTime);

  return canvases;
}

/**
 * Generates a Base64-encoded Letter-size Plain B&W PDF attachment matching SupplierPickupFormModal.
 * Returns null gracefully if running outside a Canvas-capable browser.
 */
export function generatePickupFormPdfAttachment({
  report = null,
  reports = [],
  allReports = [],
  catalogProducts = [],
  preparedByOverride = null,
  combineIdentical = true,
  ourCopyCount = 1,
  otherCopyCount = 1,
  layoutMode = 'auto'
}) {
  const effectiveReports = Array.isArray(reports) && reports.length > 0
    ? reports
    : (report ? [report] : []);
  const primaryReport = effectiveReports[0];
  if (!primaryReport || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  try {
    const meta = primaryReport.ai_document_metadata || {};
    const pickup = meta.supplier_pickup || {};
    const outcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(primaryReport);

    const rmaNumber = primaryReport.rma_number || primaryReport.rmaNumber || primaryReport.id || 'N/A';
    const rmaNumbersList = Array.from(new Set(
      effectiveReports.map((r) => r.rma_number || r.rmaNumber || String(r.id || '')).filter(Boolean)
    ));
    const isTest = effectiveReports.some((r) => isTestRecord(r));
    const isCustomerStream = primaryReport.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound';
    const bc = String(primaryReport.barcode || '').trim();
    const skuCode = String(primaryReport.code || primaryReport.sku || '').trim();
    const matchedCatalogProd = (catalogProducts || []).find((p) =>
      (bc && p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === bc) ||
      (skuCode && (String(p.code || '').trim() === skuCode || String(p.sku || '').trim() === skuCode))
    );

    const partyCandidates = isCustomerStream
      ? [
          pickup.customer_name,
          !isPlaceholderSupplier(pickup.supplier_name) ? pickup.supplier_name : '',
          primaryReport.store_branch,
          primaryReport.customer_name,
          primaryReport.reporter_name
        ]
      : [
          pickup.supplier_name,
          primaryReport.supplier_name,
          primaryReport.supplierName,
          primaryReport.supplier,
          matchedCatalogProd?.supplier_name,
          matchedCatalogProd?.supplierName
        ];
    const supplierName = partyCandidates.find((cand) => !isPlaceholderSupplier(cand))
      || (isCustomerStream ? 'Wholesale Customer' : 'Pending Assignment');

    const dispositionCode = String(pickup.disposition || meta.simple_rtv_disposition || primaryReport.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
    const isReplacementForm =
      dispositionCode === 'supplier_exchange' ||
      dispositionCode === 'customer_exchange' ||
      outcome.choiceKey === 'replacement';

    const claimNumber = outcome.claimNumber || pickup.claim_number || '';
    const formHeaderTitle = isCustomerStream
      ? (isReplacementForm
        ? 'CUSTOMER BUFFER REPLACEMENT & HANDOVER FORM'
        : 'CUSTOMER CREDIT MEMO / RETURN HANDOVER FORM')
      : (isReplacementForm
        ? 'SUPPLIER REPLACEMENT / EXCHANGE & PICKUP FORM'
        : 'SUPPLIER DEBIT CLAIM & PICKUP VALIDATION FORM');

    const claimPurposeLabel = isCustomerStream
      ? (isReplacementForm
        ? '1-to-1 Buffer Replacement / Good Stock Exchange with Customer'
        : 'Customer Return Accepted for Credit Memo / Account Deduction')
      : (isReplacementForm
        ? 'Return to Supplier for Replacement / Exchange'
        : 'Return to Supplier for Debit Claim / AP Deduction');

    const refLineLabel = isCustomerStream
      ? (isReplacementForm ? `Buffer Ref #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}` : `Ref / CM #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}`)
      : (isReplacementForm ? `Replacement Ref #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}` : `Claim #: ${claimNumber || rmaNumber}`);

    const { items: normalizedItems } = getConsolidatedPickupItems({
      report: primaryReport,
      reports: effectiveReports,
      allReports,
      catalogProducts,
      combineIdentical
    });

    const preparedBy = String(
      preparedByOverride ||
      pickup.processed_by ||
      ''
    ).replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '').trim();
    const preparedDateTime = formatDateTimeYmdHm(
      pickup.updated_at ||
      pickup.picked_up_at ||
      meta.simple_rtv_updated_at ||
      new Date()
    );

    const pickupPhotosStats = getPickupPhotosSummary(pickup.photos);

    const info = {
      rmaNumber,
      batchCount: effectiveReports.length,
      rmaNumbersList,
      claimNumber,
      isTest,
      isCustomerStream,
      isReplacementForm,
      partyFieldLabel: isCustomerStream ? 'CUSTOMER / STORE BRANCH NAME' : 'SUPPLIER COMPANY NAME',
      formHeaderTitle,
      claimPurposeLabel,
      refLineLabel,
      formattedTime: outcome.formattedTime || '',
      photoCount: pickupPhotosStats.slotCount,
      photoSlotCount: pickupPhotosStats.slotCount,
      photoTotalCount: pickupPhotosStats.totalPhotos,
      supplierName,
      supplierEmailTo: pickup.supplier_email_to || '',
      supplierEmailCc: pickup.supplier_email_cc || '',
      truckPlate: pickup.truck_plate || '',
      driverName: pickup.driver_name || primaryReport.driver_name || '',
      driverIdType: pickup.driver_id_type || '',
      driverLicense: pickup.driver_license_no || '',
      preparedBy,
      preparedDateTime,
      normalizedItems,
      grandTotalPieces: normalizedItems.reduce((s, it) => s + it.totalPieces, 0),
      grandTotalValue: normalizedItems.reduce((s, it) => s + it.lineTotal, 0)
    };

    const copiesList = buildPickupFormCopiesList({
      ourCopyCount,
      otherCopyCount,
      isCustomerStream
    });
    if (copiesList.length === 0) return null;

    const canUseCombinedOnePage =
      layoutMode !== 'separated' &&
      layoutMode !== 'full_page' &&
      normalizedItems.length < 4 &&
      copiesList.length === 2;

    const canvases = canUseCombinedOnePage
      ? renderCompactDualCopyPage(info, copiesList)
      : copiesList.flatMap((cp) => renderFullPageCopy(info, cp.title));

    const encodeAtQuality = (quality) => {
      const jpegPages = canvases.map((c) => {
        const dataUrl = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
        const b64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1] || '';
        return base64ToUint8(b64);
      });
      const pdfBytes = buildPdfFromJpegPages(jpegPages, PAGE_W, PAGE_H);
      return uint8ToBase64(pdfBytes);
    };

    let base64Pdf = encodeAtQuality(0.82);
    if (base64Pdf.length > 2_400_000) {
      base64Pdf = encodeAtQuality(0.65);
    }

    const safeRef = sanitizeFilenamePart(claimNumber || rmaNumber);
    const saveTs = formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date());
    const filename = isCustomerStream
      ? (isReplacementForm
        ? `Customer-Buffer-Replacement-Form-${safeRef} ${saveTs}.pdf`
        : `Customer-Credit-Handover-Form-${safeRef} ${saveTs}.pdf`)
      : (isReplacementForm
        ? `Replacement-Form-${safeRef} ${saveTs}.pdf`
        : `Debit-Claim-Form-${safeRef} ${saveTs}.pdf`);

    return {
      filename,
      content: base64Pdf,
      encoding: 'base64',
      contentType: 'application/pdf',
      pageCount: canvases.length
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Could not generate pickup PDF attachment:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Bulletproof Isolated Print Engine
 * Synchronously serializes all loaded CSS rules directly from `document.styleSheets`
 * alongside lightweight structural utility CSS and mounts via `iframe.srcdoc`
 * (zero network `<link>` racing, zero `document.write()`, zero blind timeouts).
 */

function stripConflictingPageRules(cssText) {
  if (!cssText) return '';
  return String(cssText).replace(/@page\b(?:[^{]*)\{[\s\S]*?\}/gi, '');
}

function collectSerializedDocumentCss() {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return '';
  const chunks = [];

  if (document.styleSheets) {
    for (const sheet of Array.from(document.styleSheets)) {
      try {
        const rules = sheet?.cssRules;
        if (!rules) continue;
        const ruleTexts = [];
        for (const rule of Array.from(rules)) {
          const text = rule?.cssText || '';
          if (!text || /^\s*@page\b/i.test(text)) continue;
          ruleTexts.push(stripConflictingPageRules(text));
        }
        if (ruleTexts.length > 0) {
          chunks.push(ruleTexts.join('\n'));
        }
      } catch {
        // Cross-origin stylesheets (e.g. external font CDNs) cannot be read cleanly; ignore safely
      }
    }
  }

  // Also grab any inline <style> tags not reflected in styleSheets for maximum safety
  if (chunks.length === 0) {
    try {
      const styleEls = document.querySelectorAll('style');
      for (const el of Array.from(styleEls)) {
        const cleaned = stripConflictingPageRules(el.textContent || '');
        if (cleaned.trim()) chunks.push(cleaned);
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return chunks.join('\n');
}

function escapeHtmlTitle(val) {
  return String(val || 'Print Document')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

export function printIsolatedElement({
  elementId,
  documentTitle = 'Print Document',
  pageSize = 'letter portrait', // 'letter portrait' | '4in 6in' | '3in 3in' | '2in 2in'
  pageMargin = '0.2in',
  scale = 1.0,
  allowMultiPage = false,
  customStyles = ''
}) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  const sourceEl = typeof elementId === 'string' ? document.getElementById(elementId) : elementId;
  if (!sourceEl) {
    console.error('printIsolatedElement: Target element not found:', elementId);
    return;
  }

  // Clone target element
  const clone = sourceEl.cloneNode(true);
  // Ensure pixel preview scaling variables (e.g. --u: 2.9px) convert strictly to physical millimeters in print
  if (
    clone?.style &&
    (clone.id === 'rma-qr-batch-sheet-root' || clone.id === 'rma-qr-print-root' || clone.style.getPropertyValue('--u'))
  ) {
    clone.style.setProperty('--u', '1mm', 'important');
  }

  // Synchronize dynamic form controls (inputs, textareas, selects) from live DOM into cloned DOM
  try {
    const sourceInputs = sourceEl.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select');
    const cloneInputs = clone.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select');
    sourceInputs.forEach((srcInput, idx) => {
      const clnInput = cloneInputs[idx];
      if (clnInput) {
        if (srcInput.type === 'checkbox' || srcInput.type === 'radio') {
          clnInput.checked = srcInput.checked;
          if (srcInput.checked) clnInput.setAttribute('checked', 'checked');
          else clnInput.removeAttribute('checked');
        } else if (srcInput.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
          clnInput.value = srcInput.value;
          clnInput.textContent = srcInput.value;
        } else if (srcInput.tagName === 'SELECT') {
          clnInput.selectedIndex = srcInput.selectedIndex;
        } else {
          clnInput.value = srcInput.value;
          clnInput.setAttribute('value', srcInput.value);
        }
      }
    });
  } catch (syncErr) {
    console.warn('Form controls clone sync notice:', syncErr);
  }

  // Remove existing print iframe if any
  const existingIframe = document.getElementById('app-isolated-print-iframe');
  if (existingIframe) {
    existingIframe.remove();
  }

  // Create clean isolated iframe
  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.id = 'app-isolated-print-iframe';
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.left = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.width = '1024px';
  iframe.style.height = '1320px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.style.opacity = '0';
  iframe.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  iframe.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

  // Synchronously serialize already-loaded CSS rules (never depends on external <link> refetching)
  const serializedCss = collectSerializedDocumentCss();

  const fullHtmlString = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>${escapeHtmlTitle(documentTitle)}</title>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <style>
      ${FALLBACK_UTILITY_CSS}
    </style>
    ${serializedCss ? `<style>\n${serializedCss}\n</style>` : ''}
    <style>
      @page {
        size: ${pageSize} !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
      }
      *, *::before, *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        print-color-adjust: exact !important;
      }
      html, body {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: auto !important;
        background: #ffffff !important;
        color: #000000 !important;
        font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
      }
      body {
        display: ${allowMultiPage ? 'block' : 'flex'} !important;
        ${allowMultiPage ? '' : `
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: flex-start !important;
        page-break-before: avoid !important;
        page-break-after: avoid !important;
        page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        break-inside: avoid !important;`}
      }
      .isolated-print-sheet {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: auto !important;
        display: ${allowMultiPage ? 'block' : 'flex'} !important;
        ${allowMultiPage ? '' : `
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: flex-start !important;`}
        margin: 0 auto !important;
        padding: ${pageMargin} !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        text-align: ${allowMultiPage ? 'left' : 'center'} !important;
        ${allowMultiPage ? '' : `
        page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        break-inside: avoid !important;
        page-break-after: avoid !important;
        break-after: avoid !important;`}
      }
      .isolated-print-card {
        margin: 0 auto !important;
        display: ${allowMultiPage ? 'block' : 'flex'} !important;
        ${allowMultiPage ? '' : `
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: flex-start !important;
        page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        break-inside: avoid !important;
        page-break-after: avoid !important;
        break-after: avoid !important;`}
        box-shadow: none !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        transform-origin: top center !important;
        ${scale !== 1.0 ? `zoom: ${scale};` : ''}
      }
      @media print {
        ${allowMultiPage ? '' : `
        body, .isolated-print-sheet, .isolated-print-card, #thermal-label-mount, #rtv-voucher-mount {
          page-break-after: avoid !important;
          break-after: avoid !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          break-inside: avoid !important;
        }`}
      }
      ${customStyles}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div class="isolated-print-sheet">
      <div class="isolated-print-card">
        ${clone.outerHTML}
      </div>
    </div>
  </body>
</html>`;

  let printed = false;
  const triggerPrintOnce = () => {
    if (printed) return;
    printed = true;
    const execute = () => {
      const cleanupIframe = () => {
        if (iframe && iframe.parentNode) {
          iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
        }
      };
      try {
        iframe.contentWindow?.addEventListener?.('afterprint', cleanupIframe, { once: true });
        iframe.contentWindow?.focus();
        iframe.contentWindow?.print();
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Isolated print warning:', err);
      } finally {
        setTimeout(cleanupIframe, 60000);
      }
    };

    const raf = window.requestAnimationFrame || ((cb) => setTimeout(cb, 16));
    const fontWait = Promise.race([
      Promise.resolve(iframe.contentDocument?.fonts?.ready).catch(() => {}),
      Promise.resolve(document.fonts?.ready).catch(() => {}),
      new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400))
    ]);

    fontWait.then(() => {
      raf(() => {
        raf(execute);
      });
    });
  };

  iframe.onload = triggerPrintOnce;
  iframe.srcdoc = fullHtmlString;
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  // Safety fallback in case a browser does not re-fire onload cleanly on srcdoc
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!printed && iframe.contentDocument?.readyState === 'complete') {
      triggerPrintOnce();
    }
  }, 450);
}

/**
 * QR Code & Box Sticker Download Utility
 * Client-side high-resolution PNG & SVG generation for mobile and desktop devices.
 */
import {
  formatQuantityWithPackSize,
  formatManifestBreakdown,
  formatDateYmd,
  formatDateTimeYmdHm,
  appendSaveTimestampToFilename
} from './rmaHelpers';
import { drawUnifiedRmaQrCard, normalizeRmaQrCardData } from './customStickerCanvas';

/**
 * Convert an SVG element to an HTMLImageElement
 */
function svgToImage(svgElement) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgElement);
      const svgBlob = new Blob([xml], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
      const URL = window.URL || window.webkitURL || window;
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        resolve({ img, blobUrl });
      };
      img.onerror = (err) => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
        reject(err);
      };
      img.src = blobUrl;
    } catch (e) {
      reject(e);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Trigger file download via a transient anchor element
 */
function triggerDownload(dataUrlOrBlob, filename) {
  const isBlob = dataUrlOrBlob instanceof Blob;
  const url = isBlob ? URL.createObjectURL(dataUrlOrBlob) : dataUrlOrBlob;
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.style.display = 'none';
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    if (isBlob) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 200);
}

/**
 * Helper: Draw multi-line wrapped text with strict boundary management (left aligned)
 * Returns the Y coordinate after the last line of text drawn.
 */
function drawWrappedText(ctx, text, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines = 2) {
  if (!text) return y;
  const words = String(text).trim().split(/\s+/);
  let line = '';
  let currentY = y;
  let linesDrawn = 0;

  for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
    const testLine = line ? `${line} ${words[n]}` : words[n];
    const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
    if (metrics.width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
      linesDrawn++;
      if (linesDrawn >= maxLines) {
        // Last line limit hit: append ellipsis only if more words remain
        let truncatedLine = line;
        while (ctx.measureText(truncatedLine + '...').width > maxWidth && truncatedLine.length > 0) {
          truncatedLine = truncatedLine.slice(0, -1);
        }
        ctx.fillText(truncatedLine + '...', x, currentY);
        return currentY + lineHeight;
      }
      ctx.fillText(line, x, currentY);
      line = words[n];
      currentY += lineHeight;
    } else {
      line = testLine;
    }
  }

  if (line) {
    ctx.fillText(line, x, currentY);
    currentY += lineHeight;
  }

  return currentY;
}

/**
 * Helper: Draw multi-line wrapped text with center alignment
 */
function drawWrappedTextCentered(ctx, text, centerX, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines = 2) {
  if (!text) return y;
  const words = String(text).trim().split(/\s+/);
  let line = '';
  let currentY = y;
  let linesDrawn = 0;

  for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
    const testLine = line ? `${line} ${words[n]}` : words[n];
    const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
    if (metrics.width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
      linesDrawn++;
      if (linesDrawn >= maxLines) {
        let truncatedLine = line;
        while (ctx.measureText(truncatedLine + '...').width > maxWidth && truncatedLine.length > 0) {
          truncatedLine = truncatedLine.slice(0, -1);
        }
        ctx.fillText(truncatedLine + '...', centerX, currentY);
        return currentY + lineHeight;
      }
      ctx.fillText(line, centerX, currentY);
      line = words[n];
      currentY += lineHeight;
    } else {
      line = testLine;
    }
  }

  if (line) {
    ctx.fillText(line, centerX, currentY);
    currentY += lineHeight;
  }

  return currentY;
}

/**
 * Download High-Resolution QR Code (PNG)
 * Generates an ultra-crisp card with the QR code and RMA Ticket info.
 */
/**
 * Generate and download a high-resolution Printable RMA QR Card PNG.
 * Uses the unified centered B&W QR card layout so quantity, unit, expiry,
 * supplier/branch, reporter & signature are consistently included everywhere.
 */
export async function downloadQrCodePng({
  svgElementOrId,
  rmaNumber = 'RMA-TICKET',
  productName = '',
  barcode = '',
  sku = '',
  quantity = 1,
  unit = 'pc',
  piecesPerCase = 1,
  expiryDate = '',
  supplier = '',
  storeBranch = '',
  streamType = 'customer_inbound',
  isTestMode = false,
  reason = '',
  reporter = '',
  reporterContact = '',
  dateFormatted = '',
  dateTimeFormatted = '',
  items = [],
  totalItems = 1,
  totalQuantity = 1,
  widthMm = 95,
  heightMm = 112,
  filename
}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) {
    throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    const clampedW = Math.max(40, Math.min(220, Number(widthMm) || 95));
    const clampedH = Math.max(45, Math.min(280, Number(heightMm) || 112));
    const pxPerMm = 12;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = Math.round(clampedW * pxPerMm);
    canvas.height = Math.round(clampedH * pxPerMm);

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize 2D canvas context.');

    const normalized = normalizeRmaQrCardData({
      rmaNumber,
      productName,
      barcode,
      sku,
      quantity,
      unit,
      piecesPerCase,
      expiryDate,
      supplier,
      storeBranch,
      streamType,
      isTestMode,
      reason,
      reporter,
      reporterContact,
      dateTimeFormatted: dateTimeFormatted || dateFormatted,
      items,
      totalItems,
      totalQuantity
    });

    drawUnifiedRmaQrCard(
      ctx,
      { x: 0, y: 0, width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height },
      normalized,
      img,
      { widthMm: clampedW, heightMm: clampedH }
    );

    const finalFilename = appendSaveTimestampToFilename(filename || `${rmaNumber}-QR.png`);
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (blob) {
        triggerDownload(blob, finalFilename);
      } else {
        triggerDownload(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), finalFilename);
      }
    }, 'image/png');

    return finalFilename;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Complete Official RMA Box Verification Label Canvas
 * High-res 1200 x 1680 px graphic formatted specifically for box adhesion & thermal prints.
 * Completely eliminates overlap and truncation of RMA number, full product names, and return reasons.
 */
export async function generateBoxStickerCanvas({
  svgElementOrId,
  rmaNumber = 'RMA-TICKET',
  supplier = '',
  itemName = 'Returned Merchandise',
  barcode = '',
  sku = '',
  quantity = 1,
  unit = 'pc',
  reason = 'Defective / Return',
  reporter = 'Warehouse Staff',
  reporterContact = '',
  dateFormatted = '',
  storeBranch = '',
  store = '',
  totalItems = 1,
  totalQuantity = 1,
  items = []
}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) {
    throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const resolvedStore = storeBranch || store || '';
  const isManifest = (Array.isArray(items) && items.length > 1) || (Number(totalItems) > 1);
  const effectiveTotalItems = Math.max(1, Number(totalItems) || (Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : 1));
  const effectiveTotalQuantity = Math.max(1, Number(totalQuantity) || (Array.isArray(items) ? items.reduce((acc, it) => acc + (Number(it.quantity) || 1), 0) : Number(quantity) || 1));

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 1680;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize canvas context.');

    // 1. Crisp White Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // 2. Outer Heavyweight Border (Plain B&W)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 12;
    ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, width - 80, height - 80);

    // 3. Top Header: Wholesale Operations & Dock Intake badge
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('WHOLESALE RMA OPERATIONS', 80, 110);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = '900 38px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('RETURN VERIFICATION LABEL', 80, 160);

    // Dock intake outline pill on top right (Plain B&W)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(width - 320, 95, 240, 65);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.strokeRect(width - 320, 95, 240, 65);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('DOCK INTAKE', width - 200, 140);

    // Header divider line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(80, 195);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 80, 195);
    ctx.stroke();

    // 4. Middle Right: High-contrast QR Code with framed border
    const qrSize = 380;
    const qrX = width - 80 - qrSize; // 740
    const qrY = 225;

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrX, qrY, qrSize, qrSize);
    ctx.drawImage(img, qrX + 15, qrY + 15, qrSize - 30, qrSize - 30);

    // Outline strip below QR: "SCAN FOR RMA DETAILS"
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(qrX, qrY + qrSize, qrSize, 42);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrX, qrY + qrSize, qrSize, 42);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SCAN FOR RMA DETAILS', qrX + qrSize / 2, qrY + qrSize + 29);

    // 5. Middle Left Column: RMA Number, Supplier, and Status
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('RETURN AUTHORIZATION #', 80, 260);

    let rmaFontSize = 54;
    ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    while (ctx.measureText(rmaNumber).width > 610 && rmaFontSize > 26) {
      rmaFontSize -= 2;
      ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillText(rmaNumber, 80, 335);

    // 6. Section 2: Returned Item Details Container Box (Plain white + solid black outline)
    const boxY = 670;
    const boxH = 760;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(80, boxY, width - 160, boxH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(80, boxY, width - 160, boxH);

    let div2Y = boxY + 410;

    if (isManifest) {
      // Header for Batch Manifest
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('BATCH RETURN MANIFEST DETAILS', 120, boxY + 50);

      if (resolvedStore) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`STORE / BRANCH: ${resolvedStore.toUpperCase()}`, 540, boxY + 50);
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = '900 32px "Inter", sans-serif';
      const manifestSummaryText = Array.isArray(items) && items.length > 0
        ? formatManifestBreakdown(items, true)
        : `${effectiveTotalItems} LINE ITEMS`;
      ctx.fillText(manifestSummaryText, 120, boxY + 100);

      // Divider 1
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, boxY + 125);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, boxY + 125);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Line items breakdown
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('SUMMARY OF INCLUDED ITEMS IN THIS BOX:', 120, boxY + 160);

      let itemY = boxY + 200;
      const manifestList = Array.isArray(items) && items.length > 0 ? items : [{ name: itemName, quantity, unit, reason, barcode }];
      const maxDisplay = 4;
      const displayItems = manifestList.slice(0, maxDisplay);

      displayItems.forEach((it) => {
        const itName = it.name || it.productName || 'Merchandise';
        const itQty = formatQuantityWithPackSize(it.quantity || 1, it.unit_name || it.unit || 'pc', it.pieces_per_case || it.piecesPerCase);
        const itCode = it.code || it.sku || it.barcode || '';
        const itReason = it.reason || 'Defective';

        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
        const lineText = `• [${itQty}] ${itName}`;
        ctx.fillText(lineText.length > 55 ? lineText.slice(0, 52) + '...' : lineText, 120, itemY);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        ctx.font = 'bold 19px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
        const subText = `${itCode ? `BC/SKU: ${itCode} • ` : ''}Reason: ${itReason}`;
        ctx.fillText(subText.length > 65 ? subText.slice(0, 62) + '...' : subText, 145, itemY + 28);

        itemY += 60;
      });

      if (manifestList.length > maxDisplay) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`+ ${manifestList.length - maxDisplay} more line item(s) listed on digital manifest`, 145, itemY + 10);
        itemY += 35;
      }

      div2Y = Math.max(itemY + 15, boxY + 410);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, div2Y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, div2Y);
      ctx.stroke();

    } else {
      // Single Item Layout
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('RETURNED ITEM DETAILS', 120, boxY + 55);

      if (resolvedStore) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`STORE: ${resolvedStore.toUpperCase()}`, 640, boxY + 55);
      }

      // Item name
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = '900 38px "Inter", sans-serif';
      const prodNextY = drawWrappedText(ctx, itemName || 'Returned Merchandise', 120, boxY + 115, 960, 48, 2);

      // Barcode and SKU line
      const codeY = Math.max(prodNextY + 10, boxY + 185);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 30px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
      let codeStr = `Barcode: ${barcode || 'N/A'}`;
      if (sku) codeStr += `   •   SKU: ${sku}`;
      ctx.fillText(codeStr, 120, codeY);

      // Horizontal Divider 1
      const div1Y = codeY + 35;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, div1Y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, div1Y);
      ctx.stroke();

      // 2-Column Specs: Quantity & Defect / Return Reason
      const row1HeaderY = div1Y + 45;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('QUANTITY', 120, row1HeaderY);
      ctx.fillText('DEFECT / RETURN REASON', 520, row1HeaderY);

      const row1ValY = row1HeaderY + 50;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = '900 48px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
      ctx.fillText(`${quantity} ${unit || 'pc'}`, 120, row1ValY);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 32px "Inter", sans-serif';
      const reasonNextY = drawWrappedText(ctx, reason || 'Defective / Return', 520, row1ValY - 10, 560, 42, 2);

      // Horizontal Divider 2
      div2Y = Math.max(row1ValY + 50, reasonNextY + 25);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, div2Y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, div2Y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 2-Column Specs: Reported By & Date Recorded
    const row2HeaderY = div2Y + 45;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('REPORTED BY & CONTACT', 120, row2HeaderY);
    ctx.fillText('DATE & TIME RECORDED', 520, row2HeaderY);

    const row2ValY = row2HeaderY + 45;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Inter", sans-serif';
    const repInfo = reporterContact && reporterContact !== 'N/A'
      ? `${reporter || 'Warehouse Staff'} (${reporterContact})`
      : (reporter || 'Warehouse Staff');
    drawWrappedText(ctx, repInfo, 120, row2ValY, 380, 36, 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.fillText(dateFormatted || formatDateTimeYmdHm(new Date()), 520, row2ValY);

    // Reporter Signature Block
    const sigBlockY = Math.max(row2ValY + 70, 1315);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(120, sigBlockY);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 120, sigBlockY);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('REPORTER SIGNATURE / HANDOVER ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:', 120, sigBlockY + 32);

    // Signature line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(120, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.lineTo(600, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Sign Above (${reporter || 'Staff'})`, 120, sigBlockY + 125);

    // Date line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(680, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 120, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillText('Date: ____________________', 680, sigBlockY + 125);

    // 7. Dashed Tear Line and Footer
    const cutLineY = 1495;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.setLineDash([14, 10]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(80, cutLineY);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 80, cutLineY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]); // Reset line dash

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('ATTACH SECURELY TO OUTER BOX OR RETURNED MERCHANDISE', width / 2, 1560);

    return canvas;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Official Workplace Instruction Poster Canvas

export async function generatePortalPosterCanvas({

    // 4. Center QR Code Frame (Plain B&W outline)
    const qrFrameX = 260;
    const qrFrameY = 280;
    const qrFrameSize = 680;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(qrFrameX, qrFrameY, qrFrameSize, qrFrameSize);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrFrameX, qrFrameY, qrFrameSize, qrFrameSize);

    // Draw QR code inside frame
    const qrSize = 580;
    const qrOffset = (qrFrameSize - qrSize) / 2;
    ctx.drawImage(img, qrFrameX + qrOffset, qrFrameY + qrOffset, qrSize, qrSize);

    // 5. Portal URL Outline Pill (Plain B&W)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect((width - 640) / 2, 990, 640, 60, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", monospace, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(portalUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''), width / 2, 1030);

    // 6. Step-by-Step Instructions Container
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = '900 32px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('HOW TO FILE A RETURN REPORT', width / 2, 1110);

    const steps = [
      { num: '1', title: 'Step 1: Scan QR with Phone', desc: 'Open camera app on mobile phone/tablet and point at this code' },
      { num: '2', title: 'Step 2: Scan Barcode or Search', desc: 'Use the built-in camera barcode reader or search the catalog.' },
      { num: '3', title: 'Step 3: Attach Defect Photos', desc: 'Snap photo of damaged packaging and enter return quantity' },
      { num: '4', title: 'Step 4: Print Box QR Sticker', desc: 'Tape generated thermal sticker on outer box for dock receiving' }
    ];

    steps.forEach((step, idx) => {
      const stepY = 1170 + idx * 115;

      // Step pill outline (Plain B&W — zero shaded background)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(80, stepY, width - 160, 95, 18);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.stroke();

      // Number outline badge
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(135, stepY + 47, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = '900 28px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(step.num, 135, stepY + 57);

      // Text
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = 'bold 26px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(step.title, 190, stepY + 40);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.font = '500 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(step.desc, 190, stepY + 75);
    });

    // 7. Footer note
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('No login required to submit return tickets • Authorized Wholesale System', width / 2, 1690);

    return canvas;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Download Official Workplace Instruction Poster (PNG)
 */
export async function downloadPortalPosterPng({
  svgElementOrId,
  portalUrl = 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app',
  filename = 'RMA-Scan-To-Report-Poster.png'
}) {
  const finalFilename = appendSaveTimestampToFilename(filename);
  const canvas = await generatePortalPosterCanvas({ svgElementOrId, portalUrl });
  canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
    if (blob) {
      triggerDownload(blob, finalFilename);
    } else {
      triggerDownload(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), finalFilename);
    }
  }, 'image/png');
  return finalFilename;
}

/**
 * Print Official Workplace Instruction Poster
 * Targets the high-resolution downloadable poster canvas directly.
 */
export async function printPortalPoster({
  svgElementOrId,
  portalUrl = 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app',
  documentTitle = 'RMA-Public-Reporting-Poster'
}) {
  const canvas = await generatePortalPosterCanvas({ svgElementOrId, portalUrl });
  await printHighResCanvas(canvas, appendSaveTimestampToFilename(documentTitle));
  return true;
}

/**
 * Mount and print a high-resolution canvas element directly in an isolated iframe via srcdoc.
 * Eliminates document.write() and blind fixed timeouts.
 */
export async function printHighResCanvas(canvas, documentTitle = 'Print Document') {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  const safeTitle = String(documentTitle || 'Print Document')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

  let iframe = document.getElementById('canvas-isolated-print-iframe');
  if (iframe) iframe.remove();

  iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.id = 'canvas-isolated-print-iframe';
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.left = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.width = '1024px';
  iframe.style.height = '1320px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.style.opacity = '0';
  iframe.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  iframe.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>${safeTitle}</title>
    <style>
      @page {
        size: letter portrait;
        margin: 0;
      }
      *, *::before, *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        print-color-adjust: exact !important;
      }
      html, body {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        background: #ffffff !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        break-inside: avoid !important;
      }
      img {
        display: block !important;
        margin: auto !important;
        max-width: 7.7in !important;
        max-height: 10.2in !important;
        width: auto !important;
        height: auto !important;
        object-fit: contain !important;
        page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        break-inside: avoid !important;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <img src="${dataUrl}" alt="${safeTitle}" />
  </body>
</html>`;

  let printed = false;
  const triggerPrintOnce = () => {
    if (printed) return;
    printed = true;
    const raf = window.requestAnimationFrame || ((cb) => setTimeout(cb, 16));
    const doc = iframe.contentDocument;
    const img = doc?.querySelector('img');
    const waitImg = img && !img.complete
      ? new Promise((resolve) => {
          img.onload = resolve;
          img.onerror = resolve;
          setTimeout(resolve, 400);
        })
      : Promise.resolve();

    waitImg.then(() => {
      raf(() => {
        raf(() => {
          try {
            iframe.contentWindow?.focus();
            iframe.contentWindow?.print();
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Canvas print error:', e);
          } finally {
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (iframe && iframe.parentNode) iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
            }, 3000);
          }
        });
      });
    });
  };

  iframe.onload = triggerPrintOnce;
  iframe.srcdoc = html;
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!printed && iframe.contentDocument?.readyState === 'complete') {
      triggerPrintOnce();
    }
  }, 450);
}

/**
 * Download raw SVG file
 */
export function downloadQrSvg(svgElementOrId, filename = 'rma-qr-code.svg') {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');

  const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgEl);
  const blob = new Blob([xml], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
  const datedBase = appendSaveTimestampToFilename(filename.endsWith('.svg') ? filename : `${filename}.svg`);
  triggerDownload(blob, datedBase);
  return true;
}

import { escapeXml, colToLetter, buildStoredZip } from './exportXlsx.js';

function sanitizeFilenameSegment(raw) {
  return String(raw || 'RMA Alert')
    .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|[\]]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 90);
}

/**
 * Generates an unambiguous save filename matching the New RMA Email subject
 * followed by `formatSaveFileTimestamp()` (e.g. `TEST RMA Alert RMA-TEST-2026-0001 Nov 25, 2026 0832.xlsx`).
 */
export function buildRmaAlertFilename(subjectOrRma, date = new Date()) {
  const base = sanitizeFilenameSegment(subjectOrRma || 'RMA Alert');
  const ts = formatSaveFileTimestamp(date);
  return `${base} ${ts}.xlsx`;
}

function makeCellXml(ref, value, styleIdx = 2, type = 'text') {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return `<c r="${ref}" s="${styleIdx}"/>`;
  }
  if (type === 'number' && typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return `<c r="${ref}" s="${styleIdx}"><v>${value}</v></c>`;
  }
  const str = String(value);
  const preserve = /^\s|\s$|\n/.test(str) ? ' xml:space="preserve"' : '';
  return `<c r="${ref}" t="inlineStr" s="${styleIdx}"><is><t${preserve}>${escapeXml(str)}</t></is></c>`;
}
