/**
 * Builds strict OOXML `.xlsx` bytes mirroring a New RMA Email Alert payload.
 * Preserves Field | Value mapping and optional MANIFEST LINE ITEMS table for 2-way reply ingestion.
 */
export function buildRmaAlertXlsxBytes(report = {}, { subject = '', editUrl = '', resolvedRecipients = null, allReports = [] } = {}) {
  const rmaNumber = String(report.rma_number || report.rmaNumber || 'RMA-PENDING').trim();
  const isTest = isTestRecord(report);
  const meta = (report.ai_document_metadata && typeof report.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? report.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const followUpMeta = (meta.follow_up && typeof meta.follow_up === 'object') ? meta.follow_up : {};
  const items = getReportManifestItems(report, allReports);

  const isMultiItemBatch = items.length > 1;
  const effectiveQuantity = isMultiItemBatch
    ? sumManifestQuantity(items, report.quantity ?? report.total_quantity ?? 1)
    : (Number(report.quantity ?? report.total_quantity ?? 1) || 1);
  const rawTopSupplier = String(report.supplier_name || report.supplierName || '').trim();
  const effectiveTopSupplier = isMultiItemBatch
    ? summarizeBatchSuppliers(items, isMixedSuppliersSummary(rawTopSupplier) ? '' : rawTopSupplier)
    : rawTopSupplier;

  const gpsAddress = getGpsAddressDisplay(report) || '';
  const gpsMapUrl = getGpsMapUrl(report) || '';
  const isSupplierStream = report.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound';
  const toSummary = Array.isArray(resolvedRecipients?.toList) ? resolvedRecipients.toList.join(', ') : '';
  const ccSummary = Array.isArray(resolvedRecipients?.ccList) ? resolvedRecipients.ccList.join(', ') : '';

  const fieldRows = [
    ['RMA Number', rmaNumber, 'Identifier — do not rename'],
    ['Test Mode', isTest ? 'YES (Sandbox)' : 'NO (Live)', 'Test vs Live isolation guard'],
    ['Logistics Stream', isSupplierStream ? 'supplier_outbound' : 'customer_inbound', 'customer_inbound or supplier_outbound'],
    ...(isSupplierStream ? [] : [['Store / Branch', report.store_branch || '', 'Editable text']]),
    ['Supplier / Vendor Name', effectiveTopSupplier, isMultiItemBatch ? 'Auto-summarized from item suppliers below' : 'Editable supplier / updates Supplier Directory'],
    ['Supplier Email (To)', followUpMeta.supplier_email_to || '', 'Comma-separated emails for auto follow-ups'],
    ['Supplier Email (CC)', followUpMeta.supplier_email_cc || '', 'Comma-separated CC emails'],
    ['Barcode', report.barcode || '', 'Plain text barcode'],
    ['Assigned SKU', report.code || report.sku || '', 'Editable SKU / Item Code'],
    ['Product Description', report.name || report.productName || report.product_name || '', 'Editable product name'],
    ['Quantity', effectiveQuantity, isMultiItemBatch ? 'Auto-calculated sum of MANIFEST LINE ITEMS Qty on reply' : 'Numeric quantity', 'number'],
    ['Packaging Unit', report.unit_name || report.unitName || 'pc', 'pc / pack / box / case'],
    ['Unit Price (PHP)', Number(report.price || 0), 'Net unit price', 'currency'],
    ['Price w/ VAT (PHP)', Number(report.price_with_vat || report.priceWithVat || 0), 'VAT-inclusive unit price', 'currency'],
    ['Defect / Return Reason', report.reason || '', 'Editable defect reason'],
    ['Explanation / Notes', report.explanation || report.notes || '', 'Editable detailed explanation / notes'],
    ['Sales Invoice (SI) #', report.si_number || '', 'Editable SI number'],
    ['Delivery Receipt (DR) #', report.dr_number || report.invoice_dr_number || '', 'Editable DR number'],
    ['Purchase Order (PO) #', report.po_number || '', 'Editable PO number'],
    ['Batch / Lot #', report.batch_lot_number || '', 'Editable batch / lot number'],
    ['Expiry Date (YYYY-MM-DD)', formatDateYmd(report.expiry_date) || '', 'Format: YYYY-MM-DD'],
    ['Warehouse Location', report.warehouse_location || '', 'Editable rack / bin location'],
    ['Account Executive (AE)', report.ae_name || '', 'Optional AE Name'],
    ['AE Email', report.ae_email || '', 'Optional AE Email'],
    ['Reported By', report.reporter_name || report.reported_by || '', 'Reporter full name'],
    ['Contact Number/Email', report.reporter_contact || '', 'Phone number or email'],
    ['Submission Date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)', formatDateTimeYmdHm(report.created_at || new Date()), 'Asia/Manila timestamp'],
    ['GPS Location', gpsAddress || (report.gps_latitude && report.gps_longitude ? `${report.gps_latitude}, ${report.gps_longitude}` : 'No GPS'), 'Clear Street / Barangay / City / ZIP'],
    ['GPS Maps Link', gpsMapUrl, 'Google Maps search URL'],
    ['Google Drive Folder', report.google_drive_folder_url || '', 'Attached photos & paperwork folder'],
    ['Email Subject', subject || `${isTest ? '[TEST] ' : ''}[RMA Alert] ${rmaNumber}`, 'Email alert mirror subject'],
    ['Alert Recipients (To)', toSummary, 'Authorized TO list'],
    ['Alert Recipients (CC)', ccSummary, 'Authorized CC list'],
    ['Online RMA Editor Link', editUrl || '', 'Never-expiring To/CC portal edit link']
  ];

  const rowsXml = [];
  let rIdx = 1;

  // Title Row
  rowsXml.push(`<row r="${rIdx}" ht="26" customHeight="1">${makeCellXml(`A${rIdx}`, `${isTest ? '[TEST] ' : ''}WHOLESALE RMA ALERT WORKSHEET — ${rmaNumber}`, 1)}${makeCellXml(`B${rIdx}`, '', 1)}${makeCellXml(`C${rIdx}`, '', 1)}${makeCellXml(`D${rIdx}`, '', 1)}</row>`);
  rIdx += 1;

  // Instructions Row
  rowsXml.push(`<row r="${rIdx}" ht="24" customHeight="1">${makeCellXml(`A${rIdx}`, '', 4)}${makeCellXml(`B${rIdx}`, '2-WAY EMAIL REPLY EDITABLE WORKSHEET', 4)}${makeCellXml(`C${rIdx}`, 'Edit any Value cells in Column C (or Manifest rows below), save .xlsx, and Reply / Reply-All to this alert email.', 2)}${makeCellXml(`D${rIdx}`, formatSaveFileTimestamp(new Date()), 4)}</row>`);
  rIdx += 1;

  // Table Headers
  rowsXml.push(`<row r="${rIdx}" ht="22" customHeight="1">${makeCellXml(`A${rIdx}`, 'Serial No.', 3)}${makeCellXml(`B${rIdx}`, 'Field', 3)}${makeCellXml(`C${rIdx}`, 'Value', 3)}${makeCellXml(`D${rIdx}`, 'Format / Notes', 3)}</row>`);
  rIdx += 1;

  fieldRows.forEach(([label, val, note, kind], idx) => {
    const valStyle = kind === 'currency' ? 6 : 5;
    const valType = (kind === 'number' || kind === 'currency') ? 'number' : 'text';
    rowsXml.push(
      `<row r="${rIdx}" ht="20" customHeight="1">` +
      makeCellXml(`A${rIdx}`, idx + 1, 2, 'number') +
      makeCellXml(`B${rIdx}`, label, 4, 'text') +
      makeCellXml(`C${rIdx}`, val, valStyle, valType) +
      makeCellXml(`D${rIdx}`, note, 2, 'text') +
      `</row>`
    );
    rIdx += 1;
  });

  // Manifest table when multi-item batch return (2+ lines)
  if (items.length > 1) {
    rIdx += 1;
    rowsXml.push(`<row r="${rIdx}" ht="22" customHeight="1">${makeCellXml(`A${rIdx}`, `MANIFEST LINE ITEMS (${items.length})`, 1)}${makeCellXml(`B${rIdx}`, '', 1)}${makeCellXml(`C${rIdx}`, '', 1)}${makeCellXml(`D${rIdx}`, '', 1)}</row>`);
    rIdx += 1;
    const mHeaders = ['Serial No.', 'Supplier Name', 'Barcode', 'Assigned SKU', 'Product Description', 'Quantity', 'Packaging Unit', 'Expiry Date (YYYY-MM-DD)', 'Defect Reason', 'Explanation'];
    rowsXml.push(
      `<row r="${rIdx}" ht="22" customHeight="1">` +
      mHeaders.map((h, i) => makeCellXml(`${colToLetter(i)}${rIdx}`, h, 3, 'text')).join('') +
      `</row>`
    );
    rIdx += 1;
    items.forEach((it, idx) => {
      const itemSup = isRealSupplierName(it.supplier_name)
        ? String(it.supplier_name).trim()
        : (isRealSupplierName(it.supplierName)
            ? String(it.supplierName).trim()
            : (!isMixedSuppliersSummary(report.supplier_name) ? String(report.supplier_name || '').trim() : ''));
      const vals = [
        [idx + 1, 'number', 2],
        [itemSup, 'text', 5],
        [it.barcode || '', 'text', 2],
        [it.code || it.sku || '', 'text', 5],
        [it.name || it.productName || '', 'text', 5],
        [Math.max(1, Number(it.quantity ?? it.qty) || 1), 'number', 5],
        [it.unit_name || it.unit || 'pc', 'text', 5],
        [formatDateYmd(it.expiry_date) || '', 'text', 5],
        [it.reason || report.reason || '', 'text', 5],
        [it.explanation || '', 'text', 5]
      ];
      rowsXml.push(
        `<row r="${rIdx}" ht="20" customHeight="1">` +
        vals.map(([v, t, s], i) => makeCellXml(`${colToLetter(i)}${rIdx}`, v, s, t)).join('') +
        `</row>`
      );
      rIdx += 1;
    });
  }

  const maxCols = items.length > 1 ? 10 : 4;
  const maxRow = rIdx - 1;
  const colWidths = [11, 32, 46, 40, 36, 12, 16, 22, 24, 34].slice(0, maxCols);
  const colsXml = `<cols>${colWidths.map((w, idx) => `<col min="${idx + 1}" max="${idx + 1}" width="${w}" customWidth="1"/>`).join('')}</cols>`;

  const sheetXml = [
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
    '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">',
    `<dimension ref="A1:${colToLetter(maxCols - 1)}${maxRow}"/>`,
    '<sheetViews><sheetView tabSelected="1" workbookViewId="0"><pane ySplit="3" topLeftCell="A4" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="C4" sqref="C4"/></sheetView></sheetViews>',
    '<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="20"/>',
    colsXml,
    `<sheetData>${rowsXml.join('')}</sheetData>`,
    '<mergeCells count="1"><mergeCell ref="A1:D1"/></mergeCells>',
    '</worksheet>'
  ].join('');

  const contentTypes = [
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
    '<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">',
    '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>',
    '<Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>',
    '<Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/>',
    '<Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/>',
    '<Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>',
    '</Types>'
  ].join('');

  const relsRoot = [
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
    '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">',
    '<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/>',
    '</Relationships>'
  ].join('');

  const workbookXml = [
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
    '<workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',
    '<sheets><sheet name="RMA Alert Mirror" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets>',
    '</workbook>'
  ].join('');

  const workbookRels = [
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
    '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">',
    '<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/>',
    '<Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>',
    '</Relationships>'
  ].join('');

  return buildStoredZip([
    { name: '[Content_Types].xml', content: contentTypes },
    { name: '_rels/.rels', content: relsRoot },
    { name: 'xl/workbook.xml', content: workbookXml },
    { name: 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', content: workbookRels },
    { name: 'xl/styles.xml', content: buildMirrorStylesXml() },
    { name: 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', content: sheetXml }
  ]);
}

function uint8ToBase64(bytes) {
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') {
    return Buffer.from(bytes).toString('base64');
  }
  let binary = '';
  const chunk = 0x8000;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += chunk) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + chunk));
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

/**
 * Generates an email-ready base64 `.xlsx` attachment object for `sendRMANotification`.
 */
export function buildRmaAlertXlsxAttachment(report = {}, options = {}) {
  const filename = buildRmaAlertFilename(options.subject || report.rma_number || 'RMA Alert');
  const bytes = buildRmaAlertXlsxBytes(report, options);
  return {
    filename,
    content: uint8ToBase64(bytes),
    encoding: 'base64',
    contentType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
    byteLength: bytes.length
  };
}

// Utility functions for RMA Portal

/**
 * Generate RMA Ticket ID matching format: RMA-2026-####-[4 alphanumeric chars]
 * Example: RMA-2026-0004-3YNZ
 */
export function generateTicketId(existingCount = 0) {
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear(); // e.g. 2026
  const seqNum = String(existingCount + 1).padStart(4, '0');

  const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'; // exclude ambiguous 0,1,I,O
  let randomSuffix = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    randomSuffix += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }

  return `RMA-${currentYear}-${seqNum}-${randomSuffix}`;
}

/**
 * Generate a provisional tracking identifier for unlabeled / missing-barcode items.
 * Example: NO-LABEL-2026-K9P2
 */
export function generateUnlabeledBarcode() {
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  let randomSuffix = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    randomSuffix += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }
  return `NO-LABEL-${currentYear}-${randomSuffix}`;
}

/**
 * Checks whether a barcode string is a provisional unlabeled tracking tag.
 */
export function isUnlabeledBarcode(barcode) {
  if (!barcode) return false;
  return /^NO-LABEL/i.test(String(barcode).trim());
}

/**
 * Automatically maps a user-selected defect reason to its corresponding condition grade.
 */
export function mapReasonToConditionGrade(reason) {
  if (!reason) return 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';
  const r = String(reason).toLowerCase();
  if (r.includes('wrong item') || r.includes('pull-out') || r.includes('unsold') || r.includes('resellable') || r.includes('like new') || r.includes('incorrect shipment')) {
    return 'A - Like New / Resellable';
  }
  if (r.includes('expired') || r.includes('expiry') || r.includes('spoiled') || r.includes('leaking') || r.includes('broken seal') || r.includes('total loss') || r.includes('scrap')) {
    return 'D - Total Loss / Scrap';
  }
  if (r.includes('factory defect') || r.includes('not working') || r.includes('parts only') || r.includes('other defect') || r.includes('defective')) {
    return 'C - Defective / Parts Only';
  }
  if (r.includes('box') || r.includes('packaging') || r.includes('crushed') || r.includes('dent') || r.includes('damaged box')) {
    return 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';
  }
  return 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';
}

/**
 * Warehouse scanner audio confirmation beep (Web Audio API)
 */
export function playBeep(type = 'success') {
  try {
    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);

    if (type === 'success') {
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1760, audioCtx.currentTime); // A6
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.12);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.12);
    } else if (type === 'increment') {
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1318.5, audioCtx.currentTime); // E6
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.09);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.09);
    } else {
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(350, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Audio context not allowed before gesture or not supported
    console.debug('Audio play skipped:', e);
  }
}

    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  });
}

export function generateAiDiagnosis(productName, defectCategory, photosCount = 0) {

  const diagnoses = [

/**
 * Helper to identify whether a ticket is a split child ticket (Part 2 of 2)
 * Robustly checks:
 * 1. RMA number ends with split suffix (e.g. -B, -C, -D)
 * 2. Or ticket explicitly references parent RMA ID with a split explanation/note
 */
export function isSplitChildTicket(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  const num = String(item.rma_number || '');
  const hasSplitSuffix = /-[B-Z]$/i.test(num);
  const hasSplitNote = String(item.explanation || '').toLowerCase().includes('split from') ||
    String(item.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes('split from parent');
  return Boolean(hasSplitSuffix || (item.parent_rma_id && hasSplitNote));
}

/**
 * Helper to identify whether a ticket is a split parent ticket (Part 1 of 2)
 */
export function isSplitParentTicket(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  const num = String(item.rma_number || '');
  if (/-[B-Z]$/i.test(num)) return false; // Child cannot be parent Part 1
  const hasChildInList = Array.isArray(allReports) && allReports.some(other => (
    (other.parent_rma_id === item.id || String(other.parent_rma_id) === String(item.id)) &&
    other.rma_number !== item.rma_number &&
    /-[B-Z]$/i.test(String(other.rma_number || ''))
  ));
  const hasSplitAudit = Array.isArray(item.audit_trail) && item.audit_trail.some(a => a.stage === 'SPLIT_EXECUTED');
  const hasSplitNotes = String(item.notes || '').includes('Split: Kept');
  return Boolean(hasChildInList || hasSplitAudit || hasSplitNotes);
}

/**
 * Validates whether a return report or product has an official assigned SKU and non-zero unit price.
 * Barcode and SKU are strictly distinct:
 * - A barcode value (e.g. 214124124) is NOT a valid SKU.
 * - Placeholders like "Awaiting SKU" or "Unidentified" are NOT valid SKUs.
 * - Unit price must be > 0.
 * Used as a Financial Validation & Safety Guard for Credit Memos & Claims.
 */
export function hasAssignedSku(report, savedProductsList = []) {
  if (!report) return false;
  const barcodeStr = report.barcode ? String(report.barcode).trim() : '';

  // Look up matched catalog product if available
  const matched = (barcodeStr && Array.isArray(savedProductsList))
    ? savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === barcodeStr)
    : null;

  // Check matched product SKU
  const matchedCode = matched?.code || matched?.sku || '';
  const matchedCodeStr = String(matchedCode).trim();
  const isMatchedCodeValid = Boolean(
    matchedCodeStr &&
    matchedCodeStr !== barcodeStr &&
    !matchedCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') &&
    !matchedCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')
  );

  // Check report SKU
  const reportCode = report.code || report.sku || '';
  const reportCodeStr = String(reportCode).trim();
  const isReportCodeValid = Boolean(
    reportCodeStr &&
    reportCodeStr !== barcodeStr &&
    !reportCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') &&
    !reportCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')
  );

  // Must have a real SKU assigned either directly on report or in catalog
  const hasValidSku = isMatchedCodeValid || isReportCodeValid;
  if (!hasValidSku) return false;

  // Price validation: Credit memo / claim requires price > 0
  const price = Number(report.price_with_vat ?? report.price ?? matched?.price_with_vat ?? matched?.price ?? 0);
  if (price <= 0) return false;

  return true;
}

/**
 * Returns true if a string is a wrapped multi-supplier parent summary
 * e.g. "Multiple Suppliers (Supplier A, Suysing)".
 */
export function isMixedSuppliersSummary(val) {
  return /^multiple suppliers\s*\(/i.test(String(val || '').trim());
}

/**
 * Pure check for whether a supplier string represents an assigned vendor
 * (ignoring empty strings, placeholders, and wrapped multi-supplier summaries).
 */
export function isRealSupplierName(val) {
  const s = String(val || '').trim();
  if (!s) return false;
  const lower = s.toLowerCase();
  if (
    lower === 'pending assignment' ||
    lower === 'pending' ||
    lower === 'unassigned' ||
    lower === 'warehouse' ||
    lower === 'n/a' ||
    lower === 'direct return' ||
    isMixedSuppliersSummary(s)
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Computes total item quantity across normalized manifest line items.
 */
export function sumManifestQuantity(items = [], fallback = 1) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    return Math.max(1, Number(fallback) || 1);
  }
  return items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + Math.max(1, Number(it?.quantity ?? it?.qty) || 1), 0);
}

/**
 * Extracts deduplicated, non-placeholder supplier names from manifest line items
 * while preserving first-seen display casing.
 */
export function extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems(items = []) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];
  items.forEach((it) => {
    const cand = [it?.supplier_name, it?.supplierName, it?.supplier].find((v) => isRealSupplierName(v));
    if (!cand) return;
    const clean = String(cand).trim();
    const key = clean.toLowerCase();
    if (!seen.has(key)) {
      seen.add(key);
      out.push(clean);
    }
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Produces parent rma_reports.supplier_name summary from manifest line items:
 * - Single unique supplier -> that supplier name
 * - Multiple unique suppliers -> "Multiple Suppliers (Supplier A, Suysing)"
 * - None -> fallbackSupplier (if real) or 'Pending Assignment'
 */
export function summarizeBatchSuppliers(items = [], fallbackSupplier = '') {
  const unique = extractDistinctSuppliersFromItems(items);
  if (unique.length === 1) return unique[0];
  if (unique.length > 1) return `Multiple Suppliers (${unique.join(', ')})`;
  if (isRealSupplierName(fallbackSupplier)) return String(fallbackSupplier).trim();
  return 'Pending Assignment';
}

/**
 * Resolves the full batch manifest items (and canonical parent record) for a report,
 * including unpacked child rows from Supplier Claims or DB child rma_reports rows.
 */
export function resolveBatchManifestForQr(report, allReports = []) {
  if (!report) return { parentReport: report, items: [] };

  const direct = getReportManifestItems(report, allReports);
  if (direct.length > 1) {
    return { parentReport: report, items: direct };
  }

  if (Array.isArray(report.manifest_items) && report.manifest_items.length > 1) {
    return { parentReport: report, items: report.manifest_items };
  }

  const rawList = Array.isArray(allReports) ? allReports : [];
  const seenListKeys = new Set();
  const list = rawList.filter((item) => {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return false;
    const dedupKey = item.id != null
      ? `id:${String(item.id)}`
      : `row:${String(item.rma_number || '').toUpperCase()}::${String(item.barcode || '').toUpperCase()}::${item.is_parent ? 'P' : 'C'}`;
    if (seenListKeys.has(dedupKey)) return false;
    seenListKeys.add(dedupKey);
    return true;
  });
  const parentMatch = list.find((p) => {
    if (!p || String(p.id) === String(report.id)) return false;
    if (report.parent_rma_id != null && String(p.id) === String(report.parent_rma_id)) return true;
    if (report.rma_number && p.rma_number === report.rma_number) {
      const pItems = Array.isArray(p.items) ? p.items : [];
      return (
        p.is_parent === true ||
        pItems.length > 1 ||
        Number(p.total_items || 0) > 1 ||
        String(p.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest')
      );
    }
    return false;
  });

  if (parentMatch) {
    const parentItems = getReportManifestItems(parentMatch, list);
    if (parentItems.length > 1) {
      return { parentReport: parentMatch, items: parentItems };
    }
  }

  if (report.rma_number && !isSplitChildTicket(report) && list.length > 0) {
    const rawSiblings = list.filter((s) => (
      s &&
      s.rma_number === report.rma_number &&
      !s.is_parent &&
      !isSplitChildTicket(s)
    ));
    const persistentBarcodes = new Set(
      rawSiblings
        .filter((s) => s.id != null && s.barcode)
        .map((s) => String(s.barcode).trim().toUpperCase())
    );
    const siblings = rawSiblings.filter((s) => (
      s.id != null ||
      !s.barcode ||
      !persistentBarcodes.has(String(s.barcode).trim().toUpperCase())
    ));
    if (siblings.length > 1) {
      return { parentReport: parentMatch || report, items: siblings };
    }
  }

  return { parentReport: parentMatch || report, items: direct };
}

/**
 * Safely extracts child line items from a batch manifest report
 */
export function getReportManifestItems(report, allReports = []) {
  if (!report) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0) return report.items;
  if (typeof report.items === 'string' && report.items.trim()) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(report.items);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    } catch (e) { }
  }
  if (Array.isArray(allReports) && allReports.length > 0 && report.id) {
    const children = allReports.filter(r => (
      (r.parent_rma_id === report.id || String(r.parent_rma_id) === String(report.id)) &&
      r.id !== report.id &&
      !r.is_parent
    ));
    if (children.length > 0) return children;
  }
  // Robust fallback: Match child records by rma_number if parent_rma_id was unpopulated
  if (Array.isArray(allReports) && allReports.length > 0 && report.rma_number) {
    const childrenByRma = allReports.filter(r => (
      r &&
      r.rma_number === report.rma_number &&
      r.id !== report.id &&
      !r.is_parent &&
      r.barcode !== report.barcode
    ));
    if (childrenByRma.length > 0) return childrenByRma;
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * Checks whether an RMA return ticket is a multi-item batch manifest
 */
export function isBatchManifest(report, allReports = []) {
  if (!report) return false;
  if (report.is_parent) return true;
  const items = getReportManifestItems(report, allReports);
  if (items.length > 1) return true;
  const nameStr = String(report.name || '');
  if (nameStr.toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest')) return true;
  return false;
}

/**
 * Checks if a report item is a child line item of a batch manifest
 */
export function isManifestSubItem(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  // Standalone split tickets (e.g. -B, -C, -D) must ALWAYS be visible in the table
  if (/-(?:B|C|D|E)$/i.test(String(item.rma_number || ''))) {
    return false;
  }
  // Only collapse child items that share the EXACT same rma_number as an existing parent manifest container
  if (Array.isArray(allReports) && item.rma_number) {
    const parent = allReports.find(p => (
      p && p.rma_number === item.rma_number &&
      (p.is_parent === true || String(p.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest'))
    ));
    if (parent && String(parent.id) !== String(item.id)) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Safely extracts clean SKU decoupling it strictly from barcode.
 * Returns empty string if sku matches barcode, or is empty/placeholder.
 */
export function getCleanSku(skuOrCode, barcode) {
  if (!skuOrCode) return '';
  const cleanCode = String(skuOrCode).trim();
  const cleanBarcode = String(barcode || '').trim();
  if (cleanBarcode && cleanCode === cleanBarcode) return '';
  if (cleanCode.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') || cleanCode.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')) return '';
  return cleanCode;
}

/**
 * Format quantity and unit, appending pack size when unit is 'case' and pieces_per_case is available
 */
export function formatQuantityWithPackSize(quantity, unitName, piecesPerCase) {
  const qty = Number(quantity) || 1;
  const unit = String(unitName || 'pc').trim().toLowerCase();
  const pcs = Number(piecesPerCase || 0);

  if ((unit === 'case' || unit === 'cases' || unit === 'cs') && pcs > 0) {
    const totalPcs = qty * pcs;
    return `${qty} case${qty === 1 ? '' : 's'} (${totalPcs} pcs total)`;
  }
  return `${qty} ${unitName || 'pc'}`;
}

/**
 * Formats a multi-item manifest quantity breakdown by UOM without summing mixed units.
 * e.g., "3 Line Items (2 pcs, 24 cases)" or "2 pcs, 24 cases"
 */
export function formatManifestBreakdown(items = [], includeLineCount = true) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    return includeLineCount ? '0 Line Items' : '0 pcs';
  }
  let totalPcs = 0;
  let totalCases = 0;
  const otherUnits = {};

  items.forEach(it => {
    const q = Number(it?.quantity ?? it?.qty) || 1;
    const rawUnit = String(it?.unit_name || it?.unit || 'pc').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (rawUnit === 'case' || rawUnit === 'cases' || rawUnit === 'cs') {
      totalCases += q;
    } else if (rawUnit === 'pc' || rawUnit === 'pcs' || rawUnit === 'piece' || rawUnit === 'pieces' || !rawUnit) {
      totalPcs += q;
    } else {
      otherUnits[rawUnit] = (otherUnits[rawUnit] || 0) + q;
    }
  });

  const parts = [];
  if (totalPcs > 0) {
    parts.push(`${totalPcs} ${totalPcs === 1 ? 'pc' : 'pcs'}`);
  }
  if (totalCases > 0) {
    parts.push(`${totalCases} ${totalCases === 1 ? 'case' : 'cases'}`);
  }
  Object.entries(otherUnits).forEach(([u, count]) => {
    parts.push(`${count} ${u}`);
  });

  const breakdownStr = parts.join(', ') || '1 pc';
  if (includeLineCount) {
    return `${items.length} Line Item${items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} (${breakdownStr})`;
  }
  return breakdownStr;
}

/**
 * Format any date input strictly as unambiguous YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Manila timezone.
 */
export function formatDateYmd(val) {
  if (!val) return '';
  const trimmed = String(val).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  const d = new Date(val);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit'
    }).format(d);
  } catch {
    const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Format any date/time input strictly as unambiguous YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm (24h Asia/Manila).
 */
export function formatDateTimeYmdHm(val) {
  if (!val) return '';
  const trimmed = String(val).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(trimmed)) return `${trimmed} 00:00`;
  const d = new Date(val);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false
    }).formatToParts(d);
    const map = {};
    parts.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });
    const hh = map.hour === '24' ? '00' : map.hour;
    return `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day} ${hh}:${map.minute}`;
  } catch {
    const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const min = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd} ${hh}:${min}`;
  }
}

export function formatDateTimeMinute(val) {
  return formatDateTimeYmdHm(val);
}

/**
 * Format current or given Date strictly as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss PHT" (Asia/Manila)
 * for live camera viewfinders and stamped photo corner watermarks.
 */
export function formatCameraTimestamp(date = new Date()) {
  const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date || Date.now());
  const valid = Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date() : d;
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
      hour12: false
    }).formatToParts(valid);
    const map = {};
    parts.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });
    const hh = map.hour === '24' ? '00' : String(map.hour || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    return `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day} ${hh}:${map.minute}:${map.second} PHT`;
  } catch {
    return `${formatDateTimeYmdHm(valid)}:00 PHT`;
  }
}

  }
