/**
 * Formats structured GPS address parts (street, barangay, city, region, zip) into
 * clean display string and wrapped corner lines.
 */
export function formatGpsAddressParts(parts) {
  if (!parts || typeof parts !== 'object') return '';
  if (typeof parts.formatted === 'string' && parts.formatted.trim()) {
    return parts.formatted.trim();
  }
  const street = String(parts.street || '').trim();
  const barangay = String(parts.barangay || '').trim();
  const city = String(parts.city || '').trim();
  const region = String(parts.region || '').trim();
  const zip = String(parts.zip || '').trim();
  const regionZip = [
    region && region.toLowerCase() !== city.toLowerCase() ? region : '',
    zip
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();
  return [
    street,
    barangay && barangay.toLowerCase() !== city.toLowerCase() ? barangay : '',
    city,
    regionZip
  ].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
}

/**
 * Extracts clean street/barangay/city/ZIP address string stored on a report or GPS object.
 */
export function getGpsAddressDisplay(record) {
  if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') return '';
  const direct = record.gps_address ?? record.address ?? '';
  if (typeof direct === 'string' && direct.trim()) return direct.trim();
  if (direct && typeof direct === 'object') {
    const formattedDirect = formatGpsAddressParts(direct);
    if (formattedDirect) return formattedDirect;
  }
  if (record.addressParts && typeof record.addressParts === 'object') {
    const formattedFromParts = formatGpsAddressParts(record.addressParts);
    if (formattedFromParts) return formattedFromParts;
  }
  const meta = (record.ai_document_metadata && typeof record.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? record.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const metaAddr = meta.gps_address;
  if (typeof metaAddr === 'string' && metaAddr.trim()) return metaAddr.trim();
  if (metaAddr && typeof metaAddr === 'object') {
    const formattedMeta = formatGpsAddressParts(metaAddr);
    if (formattedMeta) return formattedMeta;
  }
  return '';
}

/**
 * Returns formatted raw decimal GPS coordinates if present on the record.
 */
export function getGpsCoordinatesText(record) {
  const meta = (record?.ai_document_metadata && typeof record.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? record.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const rawLat = record?.gps_latitude ?? record?.latitude ?? meta.gps_latitude;
  const rawLng = record?.gps_longitude ?? record?.longitude ?? meta.gps_longitude;
  if (rawLat === null || rawLat === undefined || rawLat === '' || rawLng === null || rawLng === undefined || rawLng === '') {
    return '';
  }
  const lat = Number(rawLat);
  const lng = Number(rawLng);
  if (Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng) && (lat !== 0 || lng !== 0)) {
    return `${lat.toFixed(5)}, ${lng.toFixed(5)}`;
  }
  return '';
}

/**
 * Builds the Google Maps URL anchoring the formatted street/city/ZIP label to exact GPS
 * coordinates via /maps/place/{address}/@{lat},{lon},18z so Google Maps never snaps
 * onto an unrelated subdivision. Falls back cleanly to search query or raw coordinates.
 */
export function getGpsMapUrl(record) {
  const addr = getGpsAddressDisplay(record);
  const meta = (record?.ai_document_metadata && typeof record.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? record.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const rawLat = record?.gps_latitude ?? record?.latitude ?? meta.gps_latitude;
  const rawLng = record?.gps_longitude ?? record?.longitude ?? meta.gps_longitude;
  const hasCoordVals = rawLat !== null && rawLat !== undefined && rawLat !== '' &&
    rawLng !== null && rawLng !== undefined && rawLng !== '';
  const lat = hasCoordVals ? Number(rawLat) : NaN;
  const lng = hasCoordVals ? Number(rawLng) : NaN;
  const hasCoords = Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng) && (lat !== 0 || lng !== 0);
  const isRawCoordAddr = Boolean(addr) && /^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*,\s*-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(addr);

  if (addr && !isRawCoordAddr && hasCoords) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/place/${encodeURIComponent(addr)}/@${lat},${lng},18z`;
  }
  if (addr && !isRawCoordAddr) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(addr)}`;
  }
  if (hasCoords) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps?q=${lat},${lng}`;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Formats a date/time as "Nov 25, 2026 0832" (Asia/Manila, zero colons)
 * so downloaded PDF, XLSX, and PNG files never collide on local drives.
 */
export function formatSaveFileTimestamp(date = new Date()) {
  const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date || Date.now());
  const valid = Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date() : d;
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
      month: 'short',
      day: '2-digit',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false
    }).formatToParts(valid);
    const map = {};
    parts.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    });
    const hh = map.hour === '24' ? '00' : String(map.hour || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    const min = String(map.minute || '00').padStart(2, '0');
    const dd = String(map.day || '01').padStart(2, '0');
    return `${map.month || 'Jan'} ${dd}, ${map.year || valid.getFullYear()} ${hh}${min}`;
  } catch {
    const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
    const m = months[valid.getMonth()] || 'Jan';
    const dd = String(valid.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const hh = String(valid.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const min = String(valid.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${m} ${dd}, ${valid.getFullYear()} ${hh}${min}`;
  }
}

export function appendSaveTimestampToFilename(filename, date = new Date()) {
  const raw = String(filename || 'Export').trim();
  const ts = formatSaveFileTimestamp(date);
  if (/\b(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)\s+\d{2},\s+\d{4}\s+\d{4}\b/.test(raw)) {
    return raw;
  }
  const m = raw.match(/^(.*?)(\.[a-z0-9]{2,5})$/i);
  if (m) {
    return `${m[1]} ${ts}${m[2]}`;
  }
  return `${raw} ${ts}`;
}

/**
 * Formats an RMA report's 4-Choice decision / pickup status into a human-readable label
 * with exact YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm date/time and normalized metadata flags.
 * Strictly avoids inferring Scrapped from condition_grade or intake reason.
 */
export function formatFourChoiceOutcome(item) {
  const meta = (item?.ai_document_metadata && typeof item.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? item.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const pickup = (meta.supplier_pickup && typeof meta.supplier_pickup === 'object')
    ? meta.supplier_pickup
    : {};
  const isCustomerStream = item?.rma_type !== 'supplier_outbound';

  const simpleDisp = String(meta.simple_rtv_disposition || '').trim();
  const rawDisp = String(simpleDisp || pickup.disposition || item?.disposition || '').trim();
  const dispLower = rawDisp.toLowerCase();
  const statusLower = String(item?.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const workflowResolution = String(meta.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  const pickedUpAt = pickup.picked_up_at || null;
  const isPickedUp =
    Boolean(pickedUpAt) ||
    statusLower === 'picked_up' ||
    statusLower === 'picked_up_by_supplier' ||
    statusLower === 'buffer_replacement_dispatched' ||
    statusLower === 'buffer_dispatched';

  const notesMatch = String(item?.notes || '').match(/\[(?:RTV|BUF):\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
  const auditRtv = Array.isArray(item?.audit_trail)
    ? item.audit_trail.find((a) => a?.rtv_number || a?.buf_number)
    : null;
  const claimNumber = pickup.claim_number || (notesMatch && notesMatch[1]?.trim()) || auditRtv?.rtv_number || auditRtv?.buf_number || null;

  const decisionTs =
    pickedUpAt ||
    pickup.updated_at ||
    meta.simple_rtv_updated_at ||
    meta.resolved_at ||
    item?.inspected_at ||
    item?.updated_at ||
    item?.created_at ||
    null;
  const formattedTime = formatDateTimeMinute(decisionTs);
  const tsSuffix = formattedTime ? ` (${formattedTime})` : '';

  const pendingTs = item?.created_at || item?.updated_at || null;
  const pendingFormattedTime = formatDateTimeMinute(pendingTs);
  const pendingTsSuffix = pendingFormattedTime ? ` (${pendingFormattedTime})` : '';

  if (workflowResolution === 'restocked' || statusLower === 'restocked') {
    return {
      choiceKey: 'restock',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus: 'Restocked',
      label: `Restocked${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 border-teal-300 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-700'
    };
  }

  if (
    workflowResolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder' ||
    statusLower === 'scrapped' ||
    statusLower === 'disposed'
  ) {
    return {
      choiceKey: 'scrap',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus: 'Scrapped',
      label: `Scrapped${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700'
    };
  }

  if (
    dispLower === 'supplier_credit' ||
    dispLower === 'customer_credit' ||
    dispLower.includes('debit claim') ||
    dispLower.includes('vendor credit') ||
    dispLower.includes('ap deduction') ||
    dispLower.includes('debit / credit') ||
    dispLower.includes('credit return')
  ) {
    if (isPickedUp) {
      const shortStatus = isCustomerStream ? 'Credit Return Handover' : 'Picked Up — Debit Claim';
      return {
        choiceKey: 'debit',
        formType: 'debit',
        isPickedUp: true,
        hasDecision: true,
        claimNumber,
        timestamp: decisionTs,
        formattedTime,
        shortStatus,
        label: `${shortStatus}${tsSuffix}`,
        badgeColor: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700'
      };
    }
    const shortStatus = isCustomerStream ? 'Credit Return Pending' : 'Waiting Pickup — Debit Claim';
    return {
      choiceKey: 'debit',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus,
      label: `${shortStatus}${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700'
    };
  }

  if (
    dispLower === 'supplier_exchange' ||
    dispLower === 'customer_exchange' ||
    dispLower.includes('replacement') ||
    dispLower.includes('exchange')
  ) {
    if (isPickedUp) {
      const shortStatus = isCustomerStream ? 'Buffer Replaced' : 'Picked Up — Replacement';
      return {
        choiceKey: 'replacement',
        formType: 'replacement',
        isPickedUp: true,
        hasDecision: true,
        claimNumber,
        timestamp: decisionTs,
        formattedTime,
        shortStatus,
        label: `${shortStatus}${tsSuffix}`,
        badgeColor: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border-sky-300 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300 dark:border-sky-700'
      };
    }
    const shortStatus = isCustomerStream ? 'Buffer Replacement Pending' : 'Waiting Pickup — Replacement';
    return {
      choiceKey: 'replacement',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus,
      label: `${shortStatus}${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border-sky-300 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300 dark:border-sky-700'
    };
  }

  if (
    dispLower === 'scrap' ||
    dispLower.includes('scrap') ||
    dispLower.includes('dispose') ||
    dispLower.includes('claim rejected by vendor')
  ) {
    return {
      choiceKey: 'scrap',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus: 'Scrapped',
      label: `Scrapped${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700'
    };
  }

  if (dispLower === 'restock_good' || dispLower.includes('restock')) {
    return {
      choiceKey: 'restock',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus: 'Restocked',
      label: `Restocked${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 border-teal-300 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-700'
    };
  }

  if (isPickedUp) {
    const shortStatus = isCustomerStream ? 'Credit Return Handover' : 'Picked Up — Debit Claim';
    return {
      choiceKey: 'debit',
      formType: 'debit',
      isPickedUp: true,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus,
      label: `${shortStatus}${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700'
    };
  }

  if (dispLower.includes('quarantine') || dispLower.includes('hold') || statusLower === 'quarantine' || statusLower === 'hold') {
    return {
      choiceKey: 'hold',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus: 'On Hold / Quarantine',
      label: `On Hold / Quarantine${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700'
    };
  }

  if (statusLower === 'rejected' || dispLower.includes('8- rejected')) {
    return {
      choiceKey: 'rejected',
      formType: null,
      isPickedUp: false,
      hasDecision: true,
      claimNumber,
      timestamp: decisionTs,
      formattedTime,
      shortStatus: 'Rejected',
      label: `Rejected${tsSuffix}`,
      badgeColor: 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
    };
  }

  return {
    choiceKey: 'pending',
    formType: null,
    isPickedUp: false,
    hasDecision: false,
    claimNumber,
    timestamp: pendingTs,
    formattedTime: pendingFormattedTime,
    shortStatus: 'Pending',
    label: `Pending${pendingTsSuffix}`,
    badgeColor: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
  };
}

/**
 * Dynamically resolves parent batch manifest lifecycle status from child line item dispositions.
 * - All child items 'Restock to Inventory' -> '6- Restocked' (status: 'restocked')
 * - All child items 'Scrap / Dispose' -> '7- Scrapped / Disposed' (status: 'scrapped')
 * - Child items have mixed completed dispositions -> 'Partially Completed' (status: 'partially_completed')
 * - Child items are pending inspection -> Pending outcome label
 */
export function resolveBatchManifestLifecycle(report, allReports = []) {
  const outcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(report);
  if (outcome.isPickedUp) {
    return {
      status: 'picked_up',
      label: outcome.label,
      color: outcome.badgeColor
    };
  }

  const items = getReportManifestItems(report, allReports);
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    if (outcome.hasDecision) {
      return {
        status: outcome.choiceKey,
        label: outcome.label,
        color: outcome.badgeColor
      };
    }
    return {
      status: 'pending',
      label: outcome.label,
      color: outcome.badgeColor
    };
  }

  let restockCount = 0;
  let scrapCount = 0;
  let pendingCount = 0;
  let otherCompletedCount = 0;

  items.forEach(child => {
    const disp = String(child?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const st = String(child?.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    if (disp.includes('restock') || disp.includes('replacement stock received') || st === 'restocked') {
      restockCount += 1;
    } else if (disp.includes('scrap') || disp.includes('dispose') || st === 'scrapped' || st === 'disposed') {
      scrapCount += 1;
    } else if (
      (!disp || disp.includes('pending triage') || disp.includes('pending vendor pickup') || disp === 'pending') &&
      st !== 'credit_memo_issued' &&
      st !== 'buffer_replacement_dispatched'
    ) {
      pendingCount += 1;
    } else {
      otherCompletedCount += 1;
    }
  });

  const total = items.length;

  if (restockCount === total) {
    return {
      status: 'restocked',
      label: '6- Restocked',
      color: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 border-teal-200 dark:border-teal-800'
    };
  }

  if (scrapCount === total) {
    return {
      status: 'scrapped',
      label: '7- Scrapped / Disposed',
      color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
    };
  }

  if (pendingCount === total) {
    return {
      status: 'pending',
      label: outcome.label,
      color: outcome.badgeColor
    };
  }

  return {
    status: 'partially_completed',
    label: 'Partially Completed',
    color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800'
  };
}

/**
 * Strips internal operational bracket tags (e.g. [REORDER: NO], [HOLD REASON: ...], [REJECTED: ...])
 * from customer explanation or notes strings so UI displays clean human-readable text.
 */
export function cleanExplanationText(text) {
  if (!text) return '';
  return String(text)
    .replace(/\s*\[(REORDER|HOLD REASON|REJECTED):[^\]]*\]/gi, '')
    .trim();
}

/**
 * Standardized Lifecycle Stage Formatter supporting 4-Pillar Resolutions
 */
export function formatLifecycleStage(status, item = null) {
  if (item) {
    const outcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(item);
    if (
      outcome.isPickedUp &&
      !['closed', 'resolved', 'restocked', 'scrapped', 'disposed', 'credit_memo_issued'].includes(String(status || '').toLowerCase())
    ) {
      return { label: outcome.shortStatus, color: outcome.badgeColor };
    }
    if (
      outcome.hasDecision &&
      ['scrap', 'restock', 'debit', 'replacement'].includes(outcome.choiceKey) &&
      !['closed', 'resolved', 'credit_memo_issued'].includes(String(status || '').toLowerCase())
    ) {
      return { label: outcome.shortStatus, color: outcome.badgeColor };
    }
  }
  if (!status) return { label: '2- Received at Dock', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800' };
  const s = String(status).toLowerCase();

  if (s === 'resolved' || s === 'closed') {
    const resolution = item?.ai_document_metadata?.workflow_resolution;
    const disp = String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
    if (resolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder' || (resolution !== 'restocked' && resolution !== 'reordered' && (disp.includes('scrap') || disp.includes('dispose')))) {
      return { label: '7- Scrapped / Written Off', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800' };
    }
    if (resolution === 'restocked' || disp.includes('restock') || disp.includes('replacement')) {
      return { label: '6- Restocked', color: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 border-teal-200 dark:border-teal-800' };
    }
    const resolvedOutcome = formatFourChoiceOutcome(item);
    if (resolvedOutcome.hasDecision) {
      return { label: resolvedOutcome.shortStatus, color: resolvedOutcome.badgeColor };
    }
    return { label: 'Closed', color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700' };
  }

  switch (s) {
    case 'draft':
      return { label: '1- Draft / Intake', color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700' };
    case 'pending':
    case 'received_at_dock':
      return { label: '2- Received at Dock', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800' };
    case 'under_inspection':
      return { label: '3- Under Inspection', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800' };
    case 'pending_finance_approval':
      return { label: '4- Pending Finance Approval', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800' };
    case 'credit_memo_issued':
      return { label: '5- Credit Memo Issued', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800' };
    case 'restocked':
      return { label: '6- Restocked', color: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 border-teal-200 dark:border-teal-800' };
    case 'scrapped':
    case 'disposed':
      return { label: '7- Scrapped / Disposed', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800' };
    case 'partially_completed':
      return { label: 'Partially Completed', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800' };
    case 'buffer_replacement_dispatched':
    case 'buffer_dispatched':
      return { label: '🚚 Buffer Dispatched', color: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-300 border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800' };
    case 'picked_up':
    case 'picked_up_by_supplier':
      return { label: '🚚 Picked Up', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700' };
    case 'rejected':
      return { label: '8- Rejected / Invalid Claim', color: 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700' };
    case 'vendor_claimed':
      return { label: 'RTV Claimed', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700' };
    case 'triaged':
      return { label: 'Triaged / Staged', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700' };
    case 'pending_admin_details':
      return { label: 'Awaiting SKU', color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-950/70 dark:text-orange-300 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800' };
    default:
      return { label: s.replace(/_/g, ' '), color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300' };
  }
}

/**
 * Resolves the independent Reorder / Replacement PO status ('pending' | 'reordered')
 * strictly orthogonal to the 4-Choice Outcome and 10-day pickup SLA.
 */
export function resolveReorderStatus(item) {
  const meta = (item?.ai_document_metadata && typeof item.ai_document_metadata === 'object')
    ? item.ai_document_metadata
    : {};
  const reorderMeta = (meta.reorder && typeof meta.reorder === 'object') ? meta.reorder : {};
  const workflowRes = String(meta.workflow_resolution || item?.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const explicitStatus = String(
    reorderMeta.status || item?.reorder_status || ''
  ).toLowerCase().trim();

  const hasPendingReset = explicitStatus === 'pending' || explicitStatus === 'pending_reorder';
  const isReordered = !hasPendingReset && (
    explicitStatus === 'reordered' ||
    Boolean(reorderMeta.reordered_at || item?.reordered_at) ||
    workflowRes === 'reordered'
  );

  const reorderedAt = isReordered
    ? (reorderMeta.reordered_at || item?.reordered_at || (workflowRes === 'reordered' ? meta.resolved_at : null) || null)
    : null;
  const reorderedBy = isReordered
    ? (reorderMeta.reordered_by || item?.reordered_by || (workflowRes === 'reordered' ? meta.resolved_by : null) || null)
    : null;
  const poNumber = String(
    reorderMeta.po_number ||
    item?.reorder_po_number ||
    item?.reordered_po_number ||
    (isReordered ? (item?.po_number || '') : '')
  ).trim();
  const notes = String(reorderMeta.notes || item?.reorder_notes || '').trim();
  const formattedTime = reorderedAt ? formatDateTimeMinute(reorderedAt) : '';

  return {
    status: isReordered ? 'reordered' : 'pending',
    isReordered,
    label: isReordered ? 'Reordered' : 'Pending',
    reorderedAt,
    reorderedBy,
    formattedTime,
    poNumber,
    notes,
    badgeColor: isReordered
      ? 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700'
      : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
  };
}

/**
 * Resolves the explicit or inferred purchasing replenishment flag (needs_reorder).
 * Returns true if the lost stock should be reordered from supplier, false otherwise.
 */
export function getItemNeedsReorder(item) {
  if (item?.needs_reorder !== undefined && item?.needs_reorder !== null) {
    return Boolean(item.needs_reorder);
  }
  if (item?.ai_document_metadata?.needs_reorder !== undefined && item?.ai_document_metadata?.needs_reorder !== null) {
    return Boolean(item.ai_document_metadata.needs_reorder);
  }
  const notes = String(item?.notes || '');
  if (notes.includes('[REORDER: NO]')) return false;
  if (notes.includes('[REORDER: YES]')) return true;
  // Default for Scrap / RTV / Buffer Swap / Vendor Rejected is true
  return true;
}

/**
 * Computes recovery source for items flagged for replenishment: 'scrap' | 'vendor_rtv' | 'buffer_swap'
 */
export function getRecoverySource(item) {
  const disp = String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  if (disp.includes('buffer')) return 'buffer_swap';
  if (disp.includes('rtv') || disp.includes('vendor') || item?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound') return 'vendor_rtv';
  return 'scrap';
}

/**
 * Helper to check if an item (or child items in a batch manifest) belongs to the Ready to Restock queue:
 * disposition: 'Restock to Inventory' OR 'Vendor Replacement Stock Received'
 * and status !== 'restocked' and not finalized/resolved.
 */
export function isItemReadyToRestock(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (!item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && (item.is_parent || (Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 1))) {
    const children = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 0 ? item.items : [];
    return children.some(c => isItemReadyToRestock(c, allReports));
  }
  const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const resolution = String(item?.ai_document_metadata?.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase();
  if (resolution === 'restocked' || resolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder' || ['restocked', 'closed', 'resolved', 'scrapped', 'disposed', 'rejected'].includes(st)) {
    return false;
  }
  const isRestockDisp = disp.includes('restock') || disp.includes('replacement stock received');
  return isRestockDisp;
}

/**
 * Helper to check if an item belongs to the Pending Supplier Re-Order queue:
 * disposition: Scrap / RTV / Buffer Swap / Claim Rejected by Vendor
 * AND needs_reorder !== false
 * AND not yet marked Reordered (and not finalized/restocked).
 */
export function isItemReorderNeeded(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (!item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && (item.is_parent || (Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 1))) {
    const children = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 0 ? item.items : [];
    return children.some(c => isItemReorderNeeded(c, allReports));
  }
  if (resolveReorderStatus(item).isReordered) {
    return false;
  }
  const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const resolution = String(item?.ai_document_metadata?.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase();
  if (resolution === 'restocked' || resolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder' || ['scrapped', 'disposed', 'closed', 'resolved', 'restocked', 'rejected'].includes(st)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (
    disp.includes('restock') ||
    disp.includes('replacement stock received') ||
    disp.includes('quarantine') ||
    disp.includes('hold') ||
    st === 'rejected' ||
    disp.includes('8- rejected')
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const isLossDisp =
    disp.includes('scrap') ||
    disp.includes('dispose') ||
    disp.includes('reorder') ||
    disp.includes('rtv') ||
    disp.includes('vendor') ||
    disp.includes('buffer') ||
    disp.includes('claim rejected by vendor') ||
    disp.includes('pending vendor pickup');

  const needsReorder = getItemNeedsReorder(item);
  return isLossDisp && needsReorder !== false;
}

/**
 * Helper to check if an item is Scrapped with No Re-Order / Write-Off:
 * Any item in Scrap, RTV, Pending Vendor Pickup, Buffer Swap, or Vendor Rejected
 * where needs_reorder === false AND not finalized/resolved.
 */
export function isItemScrappedNoReorder(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (!item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && (item.is_parent || (Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 1))) {
    const children = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 0 ? item.items : [];
    return children.some(c => isItemScrappedNoReorder(c, allReports));
  }
  const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const resolution = String(item?.ai_document_metadata?.workflow_resolution || '').toLowerCase();
  if (resolution === 'restocked' || resolution === 'scrapped_no_reorder' || ['scrapped', 'disposed', 'closed', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'restocked'].includes(st)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (
    disp.includes('restock') ||
    disp.includes('replacement stock received') ||
    disp.includes('quarantine') ||
    disp.includes('hold') ||
    st === 'rejected' ||
    disp.includes('8- rejected')
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const isLossDisp =
    disp.includes('scrap') ||
    disp.includes('dispose') ||
    disp.includes('reorder') ||
    disp.includes('rtv') ||
    disp.includes('vendor') ||
    disp.includes('buffer') ||
    disp.includes('claim rejected by vendor') ||
    disp.includes('pending vendor pickup');

  const needsReorder = getItemNeedsReorder(item);
  return isLossDisp && needsReorder === false;
}

/**
 * Helper to check if an item is On Hold / Quarantine:
 * disposition includes Quarantine or Hold or status is quarantine / hold
 */
export function isItemOnHold(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (!item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && (item.is_parent || (Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 1))) {
    const children = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 0 ? item.items : [];
    return children.some(c => isItemOnHold(c, allReports));
  }
  const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
  return (disp.includes('quarantine') || disp.includes('hold') || st === 'quarantine' || st === 'hold') && !['closed', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'deleted'].includes(st);
}

/**
 * Helper to check if an item is Rejected:
 * status === 'rejected' OR disposition includes '8- Rejected / Return to Customer' OR 'Claim Rejected by Vendor'
 */
export function isItemRejected(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (!item.is_unpacked_manifest_item && (item.is_parent || (Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 1))) {
    const children = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 0 ? item.items : [];
    return children.some(c => isItemRejected(c, allReports));
  }
  const disp = String(item.disposition || '').toLowerCase();
  const st = String(item.status || '').toLowerCase();
  return (st === 'rejected' || disp.includes('8- rejected') || disp.includes('claim rejected by vendor')) && !['closed', 'resolved', 'deleted'].includes(st);
}

/**
 * Filter out fake Unsplash stock photos and parse input cleanly.
 */
export function getRealPhotos(photosInput) {
  if (!photosInput) return [];
  let list = [];
  if (Array.isArray(photosInput)) {
    list = photosInput;
  } else if (typeof photosInput === 'string') {
    const trimmed = photosInput.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith('[') && trimmed.endsWith(']')) {
      try {
        list = JSON.parse(trimmed);
      } catch (e) {
        list = [trimmed];
      }
    } else if (trimmed) {
      list = [trimmed];
    }
  }
  return list.filter(url => typeof url === 'string' && url.trim().length > 0 && !url.includes('images.unsplash.com'));
}

/**
 * Standardized, Plain-English Warehouse Locations
 */
export const DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE_LOCATIONS = [
  'Receiving Area',
  'Good Stock Area',
  'Supplier Return Area (RTV)',
  'Customer Return Area',
  'Hold / Inspection Area',
  'Disposal / Scrap Area'
];

/**
 * Map legacy or messy location strings to clean, standard names.
 */
export function normalizeWarehouseLocation(loc, item = null) {
  const raw = String(loc || '').trim();
  const isSupplierOutbound = item?.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ||
    String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().includes('rtv') ||
    String(item?.disposition || '').toLowerCase().includes('vendor');

  if (!raw || raw === '—' || raw === 'N/A' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'dock' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'dock-intake' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'rtv-dock') {
    return isSupplierOutbound ? 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)' : 'Receiving Area';
  }

  const upper = raw.toUpperCase();
  if (upper.includes('SCRAP') || upper.includes('DISPOS')) return 'Disposal / Scrap Area';
  if (upper.includes('QUARANTINE') || upper.includes('HOLD') || upper.includes('INSPECT')) return 'Hold / Inspection Area';
  if (upper.includes('OUTBOUND-RETURN') || upper.includes('CUSTOMER RETURN') || upper.includes('STORE')) return 'Customer Return Area';
  if (upper.includes('GOOD STOCK') || upper.includes('SHELF') || upper.includes('RESTOCK')) return 'Good Stock Area';
  if (upper.includes('SUPPLIER') || upper.includes('RTV') || upper.includes('VENDOR')) return 'Supplier Return Area (RTV)';
  if (upper.includes('RECEIV') || upper.includes('DOCK')) return 'Receiving Area';

  return raw;
}

/**
 * Load customized warehouse locations from localStorage (with fallback).
 */
export function getWarehouseLocations() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('rma_warehouse_locations');
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
          return parsed;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to parse stored warehouse locations:', e);
    }
  }
  return [...DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE_LOCATIONS];
}

/**
 * Save customized warehouse locations to localStorage and broadcast change.
 */
export function saveWarehouseLocations(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return;
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('rma_warehouse_locations', JSON.stringify(list));
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-locations-changed', { detail: { locations: list } }));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save warehouse locations:', e);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Test Mode helper: Check if an RMA report, Credit Memo, or Supplier Claim is a sandbox test record.
 */
export function isTestRecord(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  const rmaNum = String(item.rma_number || item.rmaNumber || '');
  const cmNum = String(item.credit_memo_number || item.creditMemoNumber || '');
  const rtvNum = String(item.claim_number || item.claimNumber || '');
  const itemArrayHasTestRef = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.some((sub) =>
    /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(String(sub?.rma_number || sub?.rmaNumber || '')) ||
    sub?.is_test === true ||
    sub?.test_mode === true ||
    sub?.ai_document_metadata?.is_test === true ||
    sub?.ai_document_metadata?.test_mode === true
  );
  return Boolean(
    item.is_test === true ||
    item.test_mode === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.is_test === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.test_mode === true ||
    String(item.notes || '').includes('[TEST_MODE]') ||
    /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(rmaNum) ||
    /^CM-TEST-/i.test(cmNum) ||
    /^RTV-TEST-/i.test(rtvNum) ||
    itemArrayHasTestRef
  );
}

export const DEFECT_REASONS = [
  '1- Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
  '2- Expired / Near Expiry Date',
  '3- Spoiled / Broken Seal / Leaking',
  '4- Wrong Item / Incorrect Shipment',
  '5- Customer Pull-out / Unsold',
  '6- Other Defect'
];

/**
 * Resolve cleanly separated SI / DR / PO document numbers with legacy fallback.
 */
export function getDocumentNumbers(item) {
  if (!item) return { si: 'N/A', dr: 'N/A', po: 'N/A' };

  let si = item.si_number ? String(item.si_number).trim() : null;
  let dr = item.dr_number ? String(item.dr_number).trim() : null;
  let po = item.po_number ? String(item.po_number).trim() : null;

  const legacy = item.invoice_dr_number ? String(item.invoice_dr_number).trim() : null;
  if (legacy) {
    if (!si && /^SI/i.test(legacy)) {
      si = legacy;
    } else if (!po && /^PO/i.test(legacy)) {
      po = legacy;
    } else if (!dr && !si && !po) {
      dr = legacy;
    }
  }

  return {
    si: si || 'N/A',
    dr: dr || 'N/A',
    po: po || 'N/A'
  };
}

/**
 * Generates an internal, non-URL QR payload scoped cleanly by mode (TEST vs LIVE).
 * Prevents external Google Lens / standard phone camera scanners from opening portal routes.
 */
export function buildPortalQrPayload(rmaNumber, isTestMode = false) {
  const cleanRma = String(rmaNumber || '').trim();
  if (!cleanRma) return '';
  const inferredTest = Boolean(isTestMode || /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(cleanRma));
  const scope = inferredTest ? 'TEST' : 'LIVE';
  return `PINGCON-RMA:${scope}:${cleanRma}`;
}

/**
 * Parses an internal portal QR code or legacy RMA scan into normalized RMA identity + mode.
 * Returns null if the scanned code is a regular product barcode.
 */
export function parsePortalQrPayload(rawText) {
  if (!rawText) return null;
  const str = String(rawText).trim();

  // Preferred internal format: PINGCON-RMA:TEST:<RMA> or PINGCON-RMA:LIVE:<RMA>
  const privateMatch = str.match(/^PINGCON-RMA:\s*(TEST|LIVE)\s*:\s*(.+)$/i);
  if (privateMatch) {
    const scope = privateMatch[1].toUpperCase();
    const rmaNumber = privateMatch[2].trim();
    if (!rmaNumber) return null;
    return {
      rmaNumber,
      qrMode: scope === 'TEST' ? 'test' : 'live',
      isPrivatePayload: true
    };
  }

  // Legacy URL or JSON or raw RMA string formats (fallback for older printed labels)
  if (str.includes('rma=') || str.includes('rma_number=')) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(str.startsWith('http') ? str : `https://example.com/${str.replace(/^\/?/, '')}`);
      const val = url.searchParams.get('rma') || url.searchParams.get('rma_number');
      if (val) {
        return {
          rmaNumber: val.trim(),
          qrMode: /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(val.trim()) ? 'test' : 'live',
          isPrivatePayload: false
        };
      }
    } catch { }
  }

  if (str.startsWith('{') && str.endsWith('}')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(str);
      if (parsed.rma) {
        const clean = String(parsed.rma).trim();
        return {
          rmaNumber: clean,
          qrMode: (parsed.mode === 'test' || /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(clean)) ? 'test' : 'live',
          isPrivatePayload: true
        };
      }
    } catch { }
  }

  if (/^RMA-TEST-/i.test(str) || /^RMA-\d{4}-\d+/i.test(str) || /^RMA-/i.test(str)) {
    return {
      rmaNumber: str,
      qrMode: /^RMA-TEST-/i.test(str) ? 'test' : 'live',
      isPrivatePayload: false
    };
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Extracts a Google Drive folder ID from either a raw folder ID or folder URL.
 */
export function extractGoogleDriveFolderId(folderUrlOrId) {
  if (!folderUrlOrId) return null;
  const s = String(folderUrlOrId).trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  const match = s.match(/\/folders\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
  if (match && match[1]) return match[1];
  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}$/.test(s) && !s.includes('http')) return s;
  return null;
}

/**
 * Trash helper: Check if an item is moved to 30-day soft trash bin.
 */
export function isTrashedRecord(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  return Boolean(
    item.is_trashed === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.is_trashed === true ||
    String(item.notes || '').includes('[TRASHED]')
  );
}

/**
 * Archive helper: Check if an item is stored in the Enterprise Archive Vault.
 */
export function isArchivedRecord(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  if (isTrashedRecord(item)) return false;
  return Boolean(
    item.is_archived === true ||
    item.ai_document_metadata?.is_archived === true ||
    String(item.notes || '').includes('[ARCHIVED]')
  );
}

/**
 * Calculate remaining days before 30-day auto-purge for trashed items.
 */
export function getTrashDaysRemaining(item) {
  if (!item) return 0;
  const purgeAfterStr = item.purge_after || item.ai_document_metadata?.purge_after;
  const trashedAtStr = item.trashed_at || item.ai_document_metadata?.trashed_at;
  let targetDate;
  if (purgeAfterStr) {
    targetDate = new Date(purgeAfterStr).getTime();
  } else if (trashedAtStr) {
    targetDate = new Date(trashedAtStr).getTime() + (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  } else {
    return 30;
  }
  const diffMs = targetDate - Date.now();
  const days = Math.ceil(diffMs / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  return days > 0 ? days : 0;
}

/**
 * Resolve piece conversion & monetary totals for a single RMA item or manifest child.
 * Converts case/box/carton quantities to pieces using pieces_per_case (or pack-size patterns like x24).
 */
export function computeItemPiecesAndValue(item, catalogProducts = []) {
  if (!item) {
    return {
      rawQty: 0,
      unitName: 'pc',
      isCaseUnit: false,
      piecesPerCase: 1,
      totalPieces: 0,
      recordedUnitPrice: 0,
      pricePerPiece: 0,
      lineTotal: 0
    };
  }

  const rawQty = Math.max(0, Number(item.quantity) || 0);
  const unitName = String(item.unit_name || item.unit || 'pc').trim() || 'pc';
  const unitLower = unitName.toLowerCase();
  const isCaseUnit =
    /^(case|cs|box|bx|ctn|carton|pack|pk|tray|sack|bag|bndl|bundle)s?$/i.test(unitLower) ||
    unitLower.includes('case') ||
    unitLower.includes('carton') ||
    unitLower.includes('box') ||
    unitLower.includes('pack');

  let matchedProduct = null;
  if (Array.isArray(catalogProducts) && catalogProducts.length > 0) {
    const itemBc = String(item.barcode || '').trim();
    const itemSku = String(item.code || item.sku || '').trim();
    matchedProduct = catalogProducts.find((p) => (
      (itemBc && String(p.barcode || '').trim() === itemBc) ||
      (itemSku && String(p.code || p.sku || '').trim() === itemSku)
    )) || null;
  }

  let piecesPerCase = Number(
    item.pieces_per_case ||
    item.piecesPerCase ||
    matchedProduct?.pieces_per_case ||
    matchedProduct?.piecesPerCase ||
    0
  );

  if (!piecesPerCase || piecesPerCase <= 0) {
    const nameStr = String(item.name || item.product_name || matchedProduct?.name || '');
    const packMatch =
      nameStr.match(/\bx\s*(\d+)\b/i) ||
      nameStr.match(/(\d+)\s*(?:pcs|pc|s)\b/i);
    if (packMatch) {
      const parsed = parseInt(packMatch[1], 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 1) piecesPerCase = parsed;
    }
  }
  if (!piecesPerCase || piecesPerCase <= 0) piecesPerCase = 1;

  const totalPieces = isCaseUnit && piecesPerCase > 1
    ? rawQty * piecesPerCase
    : rawQty;

  const recordedUnitPrice = Number(
    item.price_with_vat ??
    item.price ??
    item.unit_price ??
    matchedProduct?.price_with_vat ??
    matchedProduct?.price ??
    0
  ) || 0;

  const lineTotal = Number((rawQty * recordedUnitPrice).toFixed(2));
  const pricePerPiece = totalPieces > 0
    ? Number((lineTotal / totalPieces).toFixed(4))
    : recordedUnitPrice;

  return {
    rawQty,
    unitName,
    isCaseUnit,
    piecesPerCase,
    totalPieces,
    recordedUnitPrice,
    pricePerPiece,
    lineTotal
  };
}

const CM_META_REGEX = /\s*\[CM_META:([\s\S]*?)\]$/;

/**
 * Remove hidden [CM_META:...] JSON suffix so human-visible Credit Memo notes stay clean.
 */
export function stripCreditMemoMetaTag(rawNotes) {
  if (!rawNotes) return '';
  return String(rawNotes).replace(CM_META_REGEX, '').trim();
}

/**
 * Parse embedded [CM_META:{...}] payload from a Credit Memo's notes field.
 */
export function parseCreditMemoMeta(rawNotes) {
  if (!rawNotes || typeof rawNotes !== 'string') return null;
  const match = rawNotes.match(CM_META_REGEX);
  if (!match || !match[1]) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(match[1]);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Resolve consolidated line items attached to a Credit Memo record.
 */
export function getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems(memo) {
  if (!memo) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(memo.consolidated_items) && memo.consolidated_items.length > 0) {
    return memo.consolidated_items;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(memo.items) && memo.items.length > 0) {
    return memo.items;
  }
  const meta = parseCreditMemoMeta(memo.notes);
  if (meta && Array.isArray(meta.consolidated_items) && meta.consolidated_items.length > 0) {
    return meta.consolidated_items;
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * Extract all RMA numbers associated with a single or consolidated Credit Memo.
 */
export function getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(memo) {
  if (!memo) return [];
  const set = new Set();
  if (Array.isArray(memo.consolidated_rma_numbers)) {
    memo.consolidated_rma_numbers.forEach((n) => {
      const clean = String(n || '').trim();
      if (clean) set.add(clean);
    });
  }
  const meta = parseCreditMemoMeta(memo.notes);
  if (meta && Array.isArray(meta.rma_numbers)) {
    meta.rma_numbers.forEach((n) => {
      const clean = String(n || '').trim();
      if (clean) set.add(clean);
    });
  }
  getCreditMemoConsolidatedItems(memo).forEach((it) => {
    const clean = String(it?.rma_number || '').trim();
    if (clean) set.add(clean);
  });
  String(memo.rma_number || '')
    .split(',')
    .map((part) => part.replace(/\s*\(\+\d+[^)]*\)$/i, '').trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .forEach((n) => set.add(n));
  return Array.from(set);
}

/**
 * Checks if a (single or consolidated) Credit Memo is linked to a given RMA report.
 */
export function doesCreditMemoLinkReport(memo, report) {
  if (!memo || !report) return false;
  if (report.id != null) {
    if (memo.report_id != null && String(memo.report_id) === String(report.id)) return true;
    const meta = parseCreditMemoMeta(memo.notes);
    if (Array.isArray(meta?.report_ids) && meta.report_ids.some((rid) => String(rid) === String(report.id))) {
      return true;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(memo.consolidated_report_ids) && memo.consolidated_report_ids.some((rid) => String(rid) === String(report.id))) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  const rma = String(report.rma_number || '').trim();
  if (!rma) return false;
  return getCreditMemoRmaNumbers(memo).includes(rma);
}

/**
 * Find all RMA reports sharing the same consolidated Debit Claim / Replacement batch.
 */
export function findConsolidatedRtvBatchReports(targetReport, allReports = []) {
  if (!targetReport) return [];
  const list = Array.isArray(allReports) ? allReports : [];
  const targetIsTest = isTestRecord(targetReport);
  const pickup = targetReport.ai_document_metadata?.supplier_pickup || {};

  const targetClaim = String(
    pickup.claim_number ||
    String(targetReport.notes || '').match(/\[RTV:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i)?.[1] ||
    ''
  ).trim();

  const listedRmas = new Set(
    (Array.isArray(pickup.consolidated_rma_numbers) ? pickup.consolidated_rma_numbers : [])
      .map((n) => String(n || '').trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
  );
  if (targetReport.rma_number) {
    listedRmas.add(String(targetReport.rma_number).trim());
  }

  const matched = list.filter((cand) => {
    if (!cand || isTrashedRecord(cand) || isTestRecord(cand) !== targetIsTest) return false;
    if (isManifestSubItem(cand, list)) return false;
    if (cand.id && targetReport.id && String(cand.id) === String(targetReport.id)) return true;
    const candRma = String(cand.rma_number || '').trim();
    if (candRma && listedRmas.has(candRma)) return true;

    if (targetClaim) {
      const candPickup = cand.ai_document_metadata?.supplier_pickup || {};
      const candClaim = String(
        candPickup.claim_number ||
        String(cand.notes || '').match(/\[RTV:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i)?.[1] ||
        ''
      ).trim();
      if (candClaim && candClaim === targetClaim) return true;
    }
    return false;
  });

  if (matched.length === 0) return [targetReport];
  // Deduplicate by rma_number/id while keeping targetReport's freshest snapshot
  const byKey = new Map();
  matched.forEach((r) => {
    const key = String(r.rma_number || r.id || '');
    if (key) byKey.set(key, r);
  });
  const targetKey = String(targetReport.rma_number || targetReport.id || '');
  if (targetKey && !byKey.has(targetKey)) {
    byKey.set(targetKey, targetReport);
  }
  return Array.from(byKey.values());
}

/**
 * Normalizes a photo field (`string | string[] | null | undefined`) into a clean non-empty string array.
 */
export function normalizePhotoUrlArray(val) {
  if (Array.isArray(val)) {
    return val.map((u) => String(u || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }
  if (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim()) {
    return [val.trim()];
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * Summarizes supplier pickup photos across legacy string slots and multi-photo string[] slots.
 */
export function getPickupPhotosSummary(photosObj) {
  if (!photosObj || typeof photosObj !== 'object') {
    return { totalPhotos: 0, slotCount: 0, entriesBySlot: {} };
  }
  let totalPhotos = 0;
  let slotCount = 0;
  const entriesBySlot = {};
  Object.entries(photosObj).forEach(([slotKey, rawVal]) => {
    const urls = Array.from(new Set(normalizePhotoUrlArray(rawVal)));
    if (urls.length > 0) {
      entriesBySlot[slotKey] = urls;
      slotCount += 1;
      totalPhotos += urls.length;
    }
  });
  return { totalPhotos, slotCount, entriesBySlot };
}

/**
 * Build normalized item rows for 1 or many consolidated RMA reports,
 * supporting automatic combination of identical items (SKU + Price + Expiry Date).
 */
export function getConsolidatedPickupItems({
  report = null,
  reports = [],
  allReports = [],
  catalogProducts = [],
  combineIdentical = false
}) {
  const sourceReports = Array.isArray(reports) && reports.length > 0
    ? reports
    : (report ? [report] : []);

  const flatRows = [];
  sourceReports.forEach((rep) => {
    if (!rep) return;
    const repRma = rep.rma_number || rep.rmaNumber || String(rep.id || 'N/A');
    const manifestChildren = getReportManifestItems(rep, allReports);
    const lines = manifestChildren.length > 0 ? manifestChildren : [rep];

    lines.forEach((it, idx) => {
      const calc = computeItemPiecesAndValue(it, catalogProducts);
      const rawExp = String(it.expiry_date || it.ai_document_metadata?.expiry_date || rep.expiry_date || '').trim();
      const expiry = formatDateYmd(rawExp) || rawExp || '—';
      const sku = getCleanSku(it.code || it.sku || rep.code || rep.sku, it.barcode || rep.barcode);
      const barcode = String(it.barcode || rep.barcode || '').trim();
      const displaySku = sku || barcode || '—';
      const name = it.name || it.product_name || it.productName || rep.name || `Item ${barcode || idx + 1}`;
      const explanation = cleanExplanationText(it.explanation) || cleanExplanationText(rep.explanation) || '';
      const reason = String(it.reason || rep.reason || '').trim();
      const unitPricePerPiece = calc.totalPieces > 0
        ? Number((calc.lineTotal / calc.totalPieces).toFixed(4))
        : Number(calc.recordedUnitPrice || 0);

      // Grouping identity: SKU (or barcode/name fallback) + Price + Expiry Date
      const identityCode = (sku || barcode || name).trim().toUpperCase();
      const groupKey = `${identityCode}|${unitPricePerPiece.toFixed(2)}|${expiry}`;

      flatRows.push({
        idx: flatRows.length + 1,
        rmaNumber: repRma,
        rmaNumbers: [repRma],
        name,
        sku: displaySku,
        cleanSku: sku,
        barcode,
        expiry,
        explanation,
        reason,
        rawQty: calc.rawQty,
        unitName: calc.unitName,
        piecesPerCase: calc.piecesPerCase,
        isCaseUnit: calc.isCaseUnit,
        totalPieces: calc.totalPieces,
        recordedUnitPrice: calc.recordedUnitPrice,
        pricePerPiece: unitPricePerPiece,
        lineTotal: calc.lineTotal,
        groupKey
      });
    });
  });

  const groupCounts = new Map();
  flatRows.forEach((row) => {
    groupCounts.set(row.groupKey, (groupCounts.get(row.groupKey) || 0) + 1);
  });
  const hasCombinableDuplicates = Array.from(groupCounts.values()).some((cnt) => cnt > 1);

  if (!combineIdentical) {
    return {
      items: flatRows,
      rawCount: flatRows.length,
      hasCombinableDuplicates
    };
  }

  const combinedMap = new Map();
  flatRows.forEach((row) => {
    if (!combinedMap.has(row.groupKey)) {
      combinedMap.set(row.groupKey, {
        ...row,
        rmaNumbers: [...row.rmaNumbers],
        _explanations: row.explanation ? [row.explanation] : [],
        _reasons: row.reason ? [row.reason] : []
      });
      return;
    }
    const existing = combinedMap.get(row.groupKey);
    existing.totalPieces += row.totalPieces;
    existing.lineTotal = Number((existing.lineTotal + row.lineTotal).toFixed(2));
    if (existing.isCaseUnit && row.isCaseUnit && existing.piecesPerCase === row.piecesPerCase) {
      existing.rawQty += row.rawQty;
    } else {
      existing.isCaseUnit = false;
      existing.piecesPerCase = 1;
      existing.rawQty = existing.totalPieces;
      existing.unitName = 'pc';
      existing.recordedUnitPrice = existing.pricePerPiece;
    }
    if (row.explanation && !existing._explanations.includes(row.explanation)) {
      existing._explanations.push(row.explanation);
    }
    if (row.reason && !existing._reasons.includes(row.reason)) {
      existing._reasons.push(row.reason);
    }
    if (!existing.rmaNumbers.includes(row.rmaNumber)) {
      existing.rmaNumbers.push(row.rmaNumber);
    }
    existing.rmaNumber = existing.rmaNumbers.join(', ');
  });

  const combinedItems = Array.from(combinedMap.values()).map((it, idx) => {
    const { _explanations = [], _reasons = [], ...rest } = it;
    return {
      ...rest,
      explanation: _explanations.join(' | '),
      reason: _reasons.join(' | ') || rest.reason || '',
      idx: idx + 1
    };
  });

  return {
    items: combinedItems,
    rawCount: flatRows.length,
    hasCombinableDuplicates
  };
}

/**
 * Normalizes email subjects in Test Mode so "[TEST]" is strictly the first word
 * without duplicate "[TEST]" / "[TEST MODE]" / "Test -" prefixes.
 */
export function formatTestEmailSubject(subject, isTestMode = false) {
  const raw = String(subject || '').trim();
  if (!isTestMode) return raw;
  let clean = raw;
  while (/^(?:\[test(?:\s+mode)?\]|test\s*[-:])\s*/i.test(clean)) {
    clean = clean.replace(/^(?:\[test(?:\s+mode)?\]|test\s*[-:])\s*/i, '').trim();
  }
  return clean ? `[TEST] ${clean}` : '[TEST] Notification';
}
